name: Kotikjeff
title: This company is not easy to deal with
text: This company is not easy to deal with. A phantom.  They do not communicate. CannotTrack and take payments properly. They are totally disorganised. Seem to be a third party with Hoseasons. Keep to Hoseasons.What an ordeal. Steer clear.

name: VICKY H
title: Deliberately misleading property description
text: I recently booked a chalet in Tignes Les Breviaries called 'Crystal Ridge' through VRBO. The chalet was described to us as 'ski-in/ski-out' and in the event there isn't much snow, it is only 100m from the Boisses gondola (this was also verified by the host through VRBO before I booked). Both of these statements are categorically untrue. The chalet is no where near a piste and it was 500-700m from the Gondola which is an issue when you have young kids and a partially sighted guest. In addition to this, the water pump/pipes in the boiler room on the ground floor where the washing machine is situated were leaking. There was water all over the floor which had been soaked up with towels and blankets. They all had a stench of stale water. At one point the water leaked out into the main ground floor area and we had to mop it up with our own allocated towels. These were not replaced despite asking 3 times. The kitchen was full of broken crockery which we asked to be removed - this request was ignored and on checkout, i insisted the managing agent had a look and their solution was to put the pile of broken items back on top of the fridge and leave them to the end of season!! The carpets throughout were dirty and stained, the bathtubs had mould around the silicon and the car park and ski/boot room are actually about 100m away from the chalet!I have liaised extensively with the host 'Poplidays' and VRBO, neither of whom are prepared to make a proper partial refund for the deliberately misleading description. AND on top of this, Poplidays attempted to get me to sign a legal agreement containing a non-disclosure clause to prevent me leaving a review!! Funnily enough, VRBO won't allow my review to be posted either!DO NOT USE VRBO or POPLIDAYS (France)Update: Your 'dedicated team' have completely failed to help, i've already been liaising with them on a daily basis basis. The VRBO 'book with confidence' guarantee which protects for material misrepresentation of the property description is completely meaningless as a chalet described as 'Ski-in/Ski-out' when it is nowhere near a piste and is impossible to access by ski is indeed a material misrepresentation. I'm now pursuing the matter with the bank and the trading ombudsman.

name: Wilson Miller
title: Host cancelled the hose we were staying…
text: Host canceled the house we were staying in 17 days before graduation for my daughter from college.  Reservation has been made for a year on which they sat on the money.  VRBO will do nothing!  Makes me not want to use them.  Can you imagine flying to an island, Europe, etc and the house is not available.  You purchase plane tickets etc and the same.  No, Thank you.  Airbnb is just as bad!

name: Ann Catterlin
title: We’re in 662 Cottage Dr at Napa’s…
text: We’re in 662 Cottage Dr at Napa’s Silverado Resort.There’s NO Heat. The coffee pot they claim to have, doesn’t work.There’s only 2 salad forks…We called customer service 2x, left messages, NO ONE returned the call.I will never forget and never rent again.I plan on finding out the owner of this unit. Pretty disappointed…

name: Enrica Bridgwater
title: The worst possible platform to advertise your property
text: The worst possible platform. The customer service is literally useless. They never answer any questions. They don’t know anything and they keep passing the call to somebody else. I usually spend hours purely because they pass my call onto other departments but at the end no one can deal with my query. They are NOT a transparent company and you cannot talk to anyone at the accounts department. Does it actually exist?  If I could I would give 0 stars to this company. Do not advertise with them.

name: Babi
title: Scam host using Vrbo
text: My complaint is not against this platform but against a host who has an ad for a studio for rent in Swansea. I tried to make the reservation through the platform in early January, but it was having difficulties in accepting payment with my card details and With the payment deadline approaching, I asked what payment alternative the lady had available to me so that I could guarantee the reservation. She sent me bank details to do a bank transfer. I did but after a few days without a response I asked the lady again to which she replied that the reservation had been cancelled and that my messages were suspicious!! I went to my bank to ask for the refund, and till now I have nothing. I contacted the platform asking for help, and they promptly provided me with her phone number and email address. As I do not live in the UK, I contacted them via WhatsApp and have not been able to do so yet. The lady's name is Sandra Lopez and I hope that at least what happened to me will not happen to anyone else in the future. I also hope to could have my money back somehow, because I haven't given up on finding that person and getting in touch with her.

name: Emily Smith
title: Overdue payment demands despite never booking
text: Made the mistake of asking a host a question about their property. I am being bombard with emails saying "payment overdue" despite never tying to even make a reservation. Emails are pressuring in tone and sound as if I have failed to make an agreed payment.  Even after explaining I hadnt made a reservation and didn't want to book. Seems to be no way of stopping this. Wouldn't book as do not like this pressurising tactic.

name: James H
title: Cancelled and Abandoned.
text: I recently booked accommodation through VRBO, only to later find the same property listed on Airbnb for the same dates — but at four times the price. When I contacted VRBO about this, they told me the host was considering removing the listing and suggested that I cancel the booking myself.When I asked VRBO for help, their support was completely unhelpful and offered no real solutions or protection, leaving me to deal with skyrocketing prices elsewhere.This experience has left me questioning why anyone would book through a platform that offers renters no security or support when things go wrong.

name: S. Bailey
title: VRBO not paying hosts? Hacked?
text: I have been an owner whose property is hosted by VRBO for 7 years now, and until this year they were very good.BUT this year we have had guests who have received spam messages from them in January with concerns re’ guests payment security, and now we haven’t received the payments from VRBO long after guests have been and gone.Vrbo help line chat assistants just bump up the issue to a specialist team or an accounts team (depending on the chat assistant) and you never hear anything again and don’t receive your host payments.Was VRBO hacked in January 2025?Are payments made by guests safe?Next guest arrives in 30 days and if we aren’t paid out then more bad press will follow asI’m starting to think it’s best to leave VRBO to ensure the longer term security of our business.

name: Blake Choplin
title: HORRIBLE experience
text: HORRIBLE experience.  I booked a reservation on March 10 for a trip on April 4.  When I called the location on March 30, I was told the reservation was cancelled.  Vrbo had not given me notice or provided a refund.  As of April 11, I still have not received a refund.  I sent an email to their customer service.  They replied and asked for details and told me to reply to that email, but the email address was "donotreply" so of course my response was bounced back to me.  I had to call customer service and demand a refund.  I also called my credit card company to dispute the charge because I don't trust Vrbo to actually refund the money.  We will see if I can actually get my money back.  I will NEVER use this service again.  STAY AWAY!

name: Jed Graham
title: I am a host and owner
text: I am a host and owner. I wanted to add VRBO because they claim their guests stay longer, and I wanted to increase my booking frequency. In the last 6 months, I have not had one booking. Then, per their crazy gimics to increase frequency, they offer discounted rates. For my short-term rental during the high-traffic season in Florida, the going rate is $6000 to $7000 per month. VRBO makes a deal for $2400 per month. (for 6 weeks at $3600). I will lose 1600 plus 800 which is $2400. A 50% loss. Then they add $1400 booking fees to my portion. I called them and complained that this was not a fair contract. Of course, you get the usual corporation story. I sent them notice of failure to perform as expected and a breach of contract due to there not being a meeting of the minds. Their legal department referred me back to Vrbo for help. What a joke. As a result, we see so many owner-hosts cancel their reservations. Now, VRBO claims I will owe them 10% for cancelation. Good collecting that money.

name: Enrique Schmid
title: Very Disappointing Experience – Reservation Canceled Again
text: This is the second time I’ve had a reservation with VRBO canceled after booking. In both cases, the explanation was that there was "no availability" — yet the listing still shows as available for the exact same dates I had selected. This is misleading and unacceptable.The process has been extremely inconvenient and time-consuming. I spent valuable time planning my trip and coordinating logistics, only to have everything fall through without a valid reason. VRBO needs to do a better job vetting listings and ensuring availability is accurate. I’m very disappointed and now seriously reconsidering whether to use this platform again.

name: Rebecca Davis
title: Terrible
text: Terrible. Booked 2 places both of which were cancelled because they no longer use vrbo as a booking agent. Checked with a 3rd to be told that they too no longer use them. All 3 were marked as available. We are now holiday-less and still waiting for around £1000 in refunds. Disgraceful company. Customer service friendly but they can't change the processes that lead to these kinds of issues.

name: Jenni
title: No, No, No - Do Not Use VRBO
text: I will keep this short - do not use this company!They change prices/payment due with no clear explanation, take more money from your account than you have authorised and finally make Customer Service so painful that you eventually give up.I will never use this company again.Note: VRBO responses to negative reviews are all a mix of the same generic words - suspect artificial intelligence generated.

name: M. Schoenmaeckers
title: Landlord cancels for a higher bidder
text: For the second time this year, the owner of a property we booked via VRBO this year canceled on us, because they got offered a higher price for their property. VRBO do absolutely nothing, despite their promise the first time this happened. Holiday home brokerage platforms should be avoided at any time- there’s a fundamental flaw in that they take a hefty fee but no responsibility, leaving tenants in the cold. If you want to rent a property, either have a rental contract agreed directly with the owner on the right terms, or through a platform where the platform is a party to the contract. VRBO should start taking responsibility and forbid landlords to apply unethical practices through their platform. Barring such measures, VRBO should be closed down and not be allowed to lure innocent tourists into contracts that are meaningless and where they enjoy ZERO protection!

name: Kia
title: AVOID AT ALL COST
text: AVOID! Absolutely awful customer service. The host was not reachable on the day of my arrival to Turkey in Oct. We were left stranded and had to book alternative accommodation. The host then cancelled the booking the following day and I have been trying to get a refund for 5 months. I have also been asking for the transcript of my chat with the VRBO customer service which proves that they also could not reach the host on the day of my arrival.Mariam has been very unhelpful and ignoring my requests to escalate the matter to her senior management.

name: Lisa
title: Scammed on my holidays last month
text: On my holidays last month, I booked 2 flats in 2 different cities in Morocco with VRBO. Both of them were cancelled last minute in the evening, when we were waiting for the check-in details.The reason for cancelling? Not complying with "Minimal age"!!!I am 53 years old. Is there minimal age 100 years old?2 "ghost houses" or scams in 2 bookings means that we had 100% bad experience  with VRBO and we do not want to use it again, we only want our money back and will delete the app soon after this is solved.They are offering us credits to use in next bookings even though we told them that after 2 scams we are not interested in being scammed again. Twice is more then enough.WE DO NOT RECOMMEND VRBO cause we had 2 (two) "ghost houses" in 2 bookings, within 7 days.On our poor experience, we can say that they are very bad 👎 and they're customer service in not helpful.I would stay away from using VRBO app.

name: Shaun
title: Horrible company
text: Horrible company! Call center is in India and they are no help. Stayed at a property that was falsely advertised and I called VRBO for a refund. They refused and said to talk to the Host. The Host stop responding to me. DO NOT USE VRBO FOR ANY BOOKINGS!

name: Sarah
title: If I could give zero stars
text: If I could give zero stars, I would. ★☆☆☆☆  10 months of absolute incompetenceMy property has been showing in the WRONG LOCATION on VRBO for 10 months. I’ve contacted them repeatedly — emails, calls, support tickets — all ignored or closed without resolution.Guests are confused, I’m losing bookings, and VRBO’s response? Non-existent.They’re quick to take thousands in commission, but when it comes to basic support or fixing THEIR error? Silence.Shocking customer service. Shocking platform. Avoid listing with VRBO unless you enjoy talking to a brick wall while watching your income disappear.

name: Rupesh Patel
title: Hire a flat in Camden, pay for it and be homeless
text: Absolute farce of a company/organisation.  For my wife's birthday, we decided to visit London for the weekend.  Obviously, we made plans for certain places we wanted to visit so we chose a suitable apartment in a lively part of London, Camden.  Found a lovely apartment at a reasonable price, even invited friends to visit us the evening we get there.  When we got there, the post code provided was wrong and so, my family and I had to walk two miles to get to the given address as the Uber had dropped us off according to the postcode.We were sent a video to obtain our key, which was a bit of an adventure by itself.  So we walked to the property only to find the address provided looked nothing like the place in the video.  So no key to get in either.  Puzzled, I started looking at the paperwork.Even though I clearly booked the apartment in Camden, I eventually found out by investigating the numerous emails that the landlord of this property owns more than one place and we were booked into the place shown in the video - ten miles away.On a cold, rainy Winter's night, my family and I are stranded standing in a lobby of a building where we had nothing booked.  Last minute I found (expensive and probably) the only room available for my wife and I.  My friends, luckily accomodated my two teenage children.Next day I finally receive a message from the landlord that the apartment is ready for us on Saturday at 5pm and that I have to collect the key at 2pm.  We had plans and so I refused to check in and demanded a full refund and some compensation towards the extra expense and inconvenience we had to endure.On numerous occasions, I have contacted the landlord (who insists that I contact Vrbo) and Vrbo as well.  NOTHING!  No reply, no refund, no compensation.  This is an absolute joke of an organisation - AVOID LIKE THE PLAGUE.

name: Mike
title: VRBO  IS A VERY VERY VERY VERY BAD …JUST ASK PAPA AND THE GRANDKIDS
text: VRBO  IS A VERY VERY VERY VERY BAD  COMPANY  THEY HAVE NO PROBLEM PULLING THE RUG OUT FROM UNDER YOU.......Me and my grand kids spent week looking at aruba homes to rent , they had a ton of fun,, pappa we like that one papa we want that one, they finally settle in on the one with the flamingo in the pool ! we booked the vacation home thru vrbo 4 months ago, 12 people total going kids grandkids family... we are all going down to watch papa run the aruba marathon .....6 weeks to are vacation they send email , heres the emailHi Mike, I hope you're doing well. Unfortunately, the house Moko 119 is no longer part of our program. We explored alternative options for you, but we regret to inform you that there is no availability for your reservation dates. We will proceed with the cancellation. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to assist you further. thats was it no help as they claim they will do. first they said i didnt send the documents , then they said the property  is not part of are program,, my first time booking this stuff,, just shameful.  never new this could happen legal ? moral?  bad buisness. now i need to find a place for 12 people including 5 kids, in a short time

name: vr-no
title: Should have looked at TrustPilot
text: I was stupid for not looking at Trustpilot before booking through vrbo.Booked an apartment, was nearly immediately contacted by the host trying to get me to cancel and book direct.  I didn't respond, the next day the host tries calling me.This really frustrated me, we just wanted to book, arrive and enjoy... instead we get hassled about cancelling/booking direct to presumably save them some money.Called vrbo, asked to cancel/refund the booking based on their host breaking guidelines... You would think vrbo would have been appreciative when we brought this to their attention.  No.  3 hours on the phone over 3 days with various different people, none of whom are authorised to do anything.  Nobody calls or emails back as they say they will.Upshot, we lost 50% of the money and til the end vrbo were trying to stop us cancelling (before the 50% deadline) to wait for some mystical 'violations' department to respond.  Can't help but feel they were just trying to get 100% of the money instead of the 50%.The guy on the last correspondence even told me not to worry because of the 'book with confidence guarantee'.  This absolutely does not exist.Absolute joke, please use a different portal.

name: Kerre Woodham
title: Despair is spelt Vrbo
text: I have been trying for nearly a month to get paid for hosting a stay at my holiday home.  Six separate agents have given me six different reasons for why I have yet to be paid.  I spent 45 minutes on hold with one agent before hanging up.  When it was escalated, the agent rang me at midnight my time.  I didn't pick up.  I was asleep.  She then emailed me and asked me to email her back.  I did and received an email back saying the email address is no longer monitored.  I rang an 8th agent - after hanging up on the 7th - and he told me my situation hadn't been escalated.  I've now been assured by a 9th agent the escalation agent will call me back before midnight.  I have lost faith and hope I will ever be paid.  I have lost faith and hope in Vrbo.  I have lost faith and hope in humanity.

name: Rosie
title: Stayed at 421 Hamden
text: Stayed at 421 Hamden, pictures on website totally deceiving , showed large refrigerator, full kitchen, had no stove and small refrigerator, said had hot tub and hair dryer, neither , lousy cable and internet service , showed two beds, only 1, small pool, used hot plate for cooking , asked to be moved to better condo with said amenities , didn’t happen

name: Jazzy
title: So in the end I'm very dissapointed got ranted at by an owner, have no vacation rental and lost $44,14
text: I booked an luxary home on Bonaire. Paid and got a confirmation.Then I get a message from the owner that the object is sold and not for rent and he tells me I have to cancel. name: Trei Cap
title: VRBO Bait and Switch
text: I booked a unit through VRBO that was apparently managed by Retreatia. I arrived at the Retreatia office and was surprised at the partially damaged check-in kiosks and workers slopping down ramen take-out on the couch by the check-in area. It was not what I was expecting for a $500+ nightly rental. Nonetheless I tried to keep an open mind and proceeded with the check-in process.I was greeted by a rude check in attendant who threw some papers in front of me and asked me to sign. I regularly review contracts in my profession so I very quickly scanned the document and noted that there were several terms and conditions that were substantially different from what I signed when I booked the unit through VRBO.com.I asked the check in attendent about that and she immedialy took offense. She explained that they would refund my money or I could sign. It was obvious that this check-in attendent really wanted to exert her authority by threatening to cancel my rental which would have been really problematic after traveling more than 1,500 miles with my family.These types of strongarm tactics are not acceptable. Retreatia is a bait and switch operation and you are left with little choice but to sign and accept their onerous terms and conditions even if they differ from what you accepted in your original reservation.Many of the additional terms and conditions were reasonable but one in particular was not. At check-in you are told that you will be charged $300 if you fail to clean all dishes and remove all trash/recycling from the unit as part of your "check-out" duties. I have stayed at many vacation rentals and this is not a standard policy. They have a very early check-out time of 10AM and no one needs the added stress of cleaning the condo on the day they check out. Policies like this should be disclosed before they charge your credit card $500+ per night for their units.On the check-out day I noted the cleaning service only spent about 5 minutes cleaning each vacant unit. After witnessing this I realized that 1) the units are not very clean and 2) Retreatia is essentially not cleaning these units and passing that duty off to you as the customer. That is why they threaten customers with a $300 fine for failing to clean dirty dishes and remove garbage.The unit itself was nice but there were no pool/hottub towels and  the on-site HOA manager instructs you to contact your respective rental manager to obtain towels. I hesitated to contact Retreatia for anything after the disappointing check-in experience.

text: Update – Latest Regarding Case 137589675After leaving my last review on Trustpilot, I was contacted via email by someone named Tania, who told me that she would review the case again.The details are below, but to summarize what happened briefly: regarding the booking in question, Vrbo withheld commission fees both on a canceled payment—which I never received—and on the replacement payments I issued for the canceled one. In other words, they charged the commission twice.Today, Tania wrote to me again, and I quote:"Hola, Alessandra:Nuestro departamento superior respondió a la solicitud.Si desea tomar acciones legales pídale a su representante que contacte nuestro equipo a legal*vrbo.comAtentamente,TaniaVrbo Support Team"They are taking advantage of the fact that I would need to hire a lawyer to recover the unjustified commission charge, which amounts to €100. Truly a wonderful strategy (the email legal*vrbo.com only responds to certified and forensic email addresses).But I will do it anyway—it will be my pleasure.However, I’d like to give you an extra tip: Vrbo is also part of this platform, where I have already filed a complaint:"In case of a dispute with Vrbo, you may use a conventional mediation procedure or any other dispute resolution method established by law. Once you have submitted your written request to Vrbo and, if you do not receive a satisfactory response within 60 days, you may take your dispute to the mediator under the conditions outlined on their website. Our entity is a member of Confianza Online (a non-profit association), registered in the National Register of Associations Group 1, Section 1, national number 594400, CIF G85804011, Calle Castelló 24, Esc 1 2° izq., 28001 Madrid (Spain), phone (+34) 91 309 13 47 and fax (+34) 91 402 83 39 (www. confianzaonline .es). You may turn to Confianza Online for alternative dispute resolution (: https://www. confianzaonline. es/como-reclamar/formulario-de-reclamaciones/). If the claims concern digital advertising or data protection related to this field, they will be submitted to the Advertising Jury of AUTOCONTROL. Additionally, you may use the mediation services provided by e-POM, available at https://e-pom. eu/."Furthermore, I have also filed a complaint through OCU.Of course, I have already closed my calendars on VRBO (for the little revenue it generates, it won’t be a big loss), and as far as I’m concerned, I’ll see them in the appropriate legal venues.Here are the details of my unfortunate experience.On August 2, 2024, I received the following booking HA-DP28JH with the guest's payment split into two installments:€811.10 at the time of booking€1,365.00 on January 20, 2025The total amount of the booking was €1,950, from which the commissions (5%) and transaction fee (3%) would be deducted, resulting in an estimated net amount of €1,831.99. After deducting an additional 3% for transaction fees, the final estimated amount to be received was approximately €1,780.It is clear that the Vrbo commission of €118.01 (including VAT) had already been deducted from the guest’s first payment.In January, I was contacted by your customer support (email exchange available), requesting that the second payment be split into two installments, as the guest had a €1,000 limit on their credit card.Following this request, I canceled the second payment of €1,365.00 and issued two new payments:One for €1,000One for €350The traveler successfully completed both payments.However, upon receiving the payments, I noticed that in addition to the initial €118.01 (the total commission for the booking), additional commissions totaling €82.58 (€22.08 + €60.50) were charged. title: VRBO owes me 600 Euros
text: My case involves an offer I accepted from VRBO  which they have completely failed to honour. I rented a house from them in the north part of Gran Canaria in February. I did exactly what they said and booked a new place to stay through booking.com – it wasn’t really ideal for us but it was the only thing available in that area at such short notice. We packed up all our stuff that we’d just unpacked the night before and moved out the same morning.True to their word, the rental money was refunded to my credit card 3 days later, but no sign of the 600 euros.  I sent them a couple of emails on the subject and then eventually received a reply stating that they were not going to pay the 600 euros because I hadn’t followed their terms which they now said were that the new booking had to be made with themselves, Expedia, Hotels.com, or Stayz.   I replied and explained that these were not the instructions I was given and sent them a Word file with a transcript of the entire online chat conversation where they made the original offer of 600 euros and told me to use (amongst other choices) Booking.com. I then received a reply where they didn’t address my argument at all and ended it with this rather ugly warning:“However, your concern has been heard by our company's leadership, and the decision is final. We regret that we will not be able to respond to any further escalations of this issue. We understand that this outcome may have not been the one you were seeking, but we have to make sure the program is administered fairly.As we have thoroughly explained this matter to you and this decision is final. Any further replies to discuss and/or argue the reimbursement amount will be closed without reply. “It was the promise of the 600 euros compensation that made up our minds to move to a new place rather than stay put and try not to use the rooms with the cameras in them. I regarded the offer as a firm contract with VRBO and I find their current position quite shocking. I did look into suing them in the Small Claims Court but it turns out that (conveniently for them) their operation is based in Dublin, ROI which would make that option extremely complicated and impractical.

title: 🚨 VRBO Trapped Me in a Scam…
text: 🚨 VRBO Trapped Me in a Scam Cancellation Loop 🚨I tried to cancel my booking within the allowed timeframe (we had a death in the family requiring emergency travel and could no longer afford both trips), but VRBO’s system had a technical glitch that repeatedly looped me back to their AI “travel agent” instead of processing my cancellation. Use Airbnb or book directly—VRBO will trap you with their own errors.#VRBOScam #TerribleCustomerService**Edit following reply—you’ve had the details for over a month.  I contacted customer service IMMEDIATELY.  I was strung along for days with a “Don’t worry, the tech team is working on it, and we’ll make sure you get your refund.”  I finally had to contact the rental owner and beg them to try and cancel from their end because I recognized they, too, were being screwed out of an opportunity to rebook.  I forwarded screenshots and gave the reservation number, the stay dates, the rental details, and all other details to at least six different “customer service” reps…. all for VRBO to act like their hands were tied and nothing could be done.  You then went radio silent for three weeks as I calmly and repeatedly asked for updates on the email thread where you promised you were “looking into it.”  I am out thousands of dollars and nearly forty hours of my time, all while juggling funeral arrangements, the grief of losing a loved one, and the heartbreak of missing a family vacation we spent years planning.  The indignity of having to beg a colossal corporation to honor their most basic contractual obligations is demoralizing and humiliating, not that I should ever be surprised by corporate indifference and incompetence.**Testing the waters to see if I “could” take screenshots and then observably slow-rolling me when it appeared I could not is a duplicitous strategy.  I think it would read as such in a court of law when the customer service rep suddenly admitted they could indeed manually cancel a reservation from their end once I was able to forward the screenshots (during the first conversation, I was focused on canceling the reservation and I was afraid to navigate away from the chat and lose my progress to save screenshots).  To the extent you claim you needed “proof” of the technical glitch to confirm things happened as I represented, (1) within the required timeframe, I specifically asked REPEATEDLY for assistance canceling the reservation because the deadline was looming, technical glitch or not, the customer service reps should have taken action to cancel, seeking details regarding the technical error would be secondary, (2) because the glitch looped me into the AI agent chat, the technical glitch was already documented and transcribed for the customer service “agent” to see… all they had to do was “scroll up,” (3) there’s no way that a company as large and well resourced as VRBO doesn’t have the technical capability to pull logs that would help them diagnose a user interface glitch from their end, and it’s undoubtedly not believable that VRBO can’t manually cancel reservations, which is what I specifically asked for you to do.***Your customer service reps are halfway around the world, but MY timestamps still read correctly… please do not AGAIN waste time by claiming I first attempted to cancel 12 hours later than I did.Update after contact with Executive Customer Service Team: They insist on a phone call "to discuss" and still claim they need time to "investigate."  I think all of this needs to be handled in writing.  The storyline is simple--I attempted to cancel within the allowable timeframe for a full refund but was unable due to a glitch that pushed me to the robot agent when clicking the cancellation button instead of processing the cancellation.  The robot agent then told me that it couldn't retrieve my reservation details, even though it displayed the reservation details.  When I fought through to a real agent, they insisted that the issue must be "elevated to a tech team." Despite multiple demands for VRBO to manually cancel the reservation, they refused. title: DON'T BELIEVE THE FALSE ADVERTISING ON…
text: DON'T BELIEVE THE FALSE ADVERTISING ON TV! You don't always get the "whole house" to yourself when you rent from VRBO. They play this little dirty trick where they define getting the "whole house" as having any space that does not share space with others. For example, if you get the entire first floor of a two-story house, you are getting the whole house, because you are not sharing any bedrooms, bathrooms, or common areas with others. Nevermind if the people upstairs are loud, or they have small children running around, babies crying, etc. - you have the whole house! My family and I recently rented a "Lovely 2-bedroom house with Wifi" in Big Island, Hawaii. In the property listing, there was no mention of anybody else living or using the property, and especially no mention of the host family with three kids under 11 (including a baby and a toddler) living upstairs. No mention that by "whole house" they meant the entire first floor of a two-story house. When we arrived there after 1 2 hours of travel, we were surprised to learn that the host family was living upstairs and that we would be sharing the property, especially considering we were paying $300+ per night for a somewhat remote location, but we were too exhausted to complain. When I called VRBO customer service after the trip, they played a lot of word games with me, saying exactly what I stated above - that "whole house" means no shared bedroom, bathrooms, or common areas. When I hear "whole house", I interpret it to mean nobody else is on the property! At least on airbnb they are clear about what you are getting.

title: Wow .. but not terribly surprising
text: Wow ... this is a company that has over 117,000 reviews and is barely making 1 star. I guess I should not be terribly shocked that I am now going to add to that abysmal record.Here's the thing about relying on a third-party platform to manage your vacation rental property - you are beholden to what can sometimes be capricious and arbitrary behavior, and there is simply no recourse.  And what's a bit worse is that there is generally barely an acknowledgement that they care in the least bit that they are causing havoc and behaving in a way that would result in 1 star on a platform like Trustpilot.In our case, a disgruntled minority (16%) shareholder in a property that has been listed on VRBO for 8 years , and which has over 50 5-star reviews, hired an attorney to write a letter to VRBO in an effort to sabotage the listing.  And VRBO decided to deactivate the listing permanently "... until all parties are in agreement...".Of course, they are free to do whatever they want, as is made clear in the terms of their service.  And we cannot be shocked that this tactic worked, because legal departments in large corporations will always take the position of caution.  And finally - when you have 20+ competing properties in the same area on their platform, why should VRBO care? They are still going to get their fees - just from another property.So, I get it. If anything , this experience reveals that strictly from a tactical perspective  that the sole reliance on these systems is risky.  And it's also folly to expect any kind of loyalty or value of the "partnership" that they tout so much.My suggestion?  Build yourself a website, and invest in the marketing of it, and figure out direct payments using something like Stripe, etc as a backup. And be sure to discount the price from your VBRO and other large platform listings as you market the property.Whether or not you have a great deal of success, it's a smart idea because you will be prepared, since you just never know what they are going to do.  The least you can do is have a plan and a system to replace them if it comes to it.

text: I booked an apartment in London for 2 weeks, then within days had to cancel due to sickness in the family. I received my money back within 24 hours, so impressed.

name: customer
title: Really bad experience
text: Really bad experience. Stay away from this platform. There was a mistake on the ad. The location of the property was wrong. I spend hours and hours on the phone and I got zero support from the host or Vrbo. At the end they had my money and don't care about client satisfaction.

name: Charlotte Alman
title: Complete waste of time…..
text: Tried to contact multiple property owners. No one responded, clearly a problem with my account. Requested help on the phone line. Was told they can only help if I have a confirmed booking.I CANT CONFIRM A BOOKING IF NO ONE REPLIES!!! Arrrggghhhhh!!!!!

name: Yvette Redmond
title: Left us stranded in Jamaica
text: If I could give 0 stars I would. They have left us stranded in Jamaica. We are on our honeymoon. Had a villa booked. We arrived to be told it shouldn’t have been advertised as they are booked out for months ahead. Used the chat to contact vrbo. The worst experience ever! They told me they can’t let us book somewhere else as they don’t allow same day check in. They promised we were entitled to a refund that would take 5-7 days. They also promised to find us a hotel for 2 nights. They asked for my number which I gave. They said they couldn’t connect. We then gave them the n bar owners number and they claimed they couldn’t connect to that either. No missed calls on either number so they lied. They then gave me a number to call which I did. It was automated and asked for the last 4 digits of my card which I entered. It then said it didn’t recognize it and would let me proceed with the call. I went back to the chat and was told they would email me. As I’m writing this, they still have not emailed me. We spent last night at the bar owners house out of the kindness of his heart. If he hadn’t done that we would have been stranded. I tried to go back to the chat but have been told ‘we will be in touch soon’This company is disgraceful. To leave people stranded in a country that’s not safe after dark is unacceptable. We have had to contact our insurance company to fly us home. We don’t have big money to spend on another property. Vrbo does not care. They list properties that are unavailable and take your money. As I write this they have not contacted me once or cancelled the booking to start our refund and the property is STILL showing as available! Please listen to the reviews people and don’t use this sham of a company. You’ve been warned!

name: Mark Campbell
title: Vrbo didn't refund me for hurricane…
text: Vrbo didn't refund me for hurricane Helen after they issued a letter stating they would refund the victims of cancellations due to the hurricane.   They lied in print!  Never again will I use their service.

name: Emma Kelly
title: Dodgy
text: Tried twice to book two separate apartments in Amsterdam.  Both times the booking was accepted and then within hours the booking was declined with no explanation.  Both times the apartment was still available after. Will not be using this company again as something just feels off about it and after reading the reviews on here it seems we are not alone.

name: Alyson Lynch
title: Vrbo HA-18GMW5
text: Vrbo HA-18GMW5Thankyou for replying to my Trustpilot review.You have made it impossible to complain or get a resolution to our issue.  To the point you sent a link so I can review and when I replied with an honest review you have said it doesn’t meet with your standards and will not publish.I would be very pleased if someone from your company would contact us regarding the money you have unlawfully kept from us. Even the email you last sent does not allow us to reply. I’ve spent hours on the phone only to be cut off.We would welcome a resolution of this before we pursue legal council.

name: Anon
title: Awful VRBO and Villa Owner
text: Awful, both this company along with the dodgy villa owners  !We rented 'The View' in Lanzarote Vrbo property p10431940 (you can search this online I can not add a link)It was awful we provided images. We managed to move our flight dates 2 days as I had flu that is correct. But we paid for 7 days and we were supposed to go Saturday to Saturday but instead went Monday to Monday. It was that bad we moved our dates back to the Saturday. On their reply to our review they state we could not change our flights which is why we came back early - simply a lie. They have the messages where I confirmed I moved the flights.Anyway the villa was awful it was dirty like a hostel. It was in poor repair and nothing like the images. VRBO did nothing to support us.The vendor has now replied to our VRBO review making us out to be liars apparently we even told them that we 'loved the villa' I would like VRBO to obtain this evidence !!!!!!!!We could not claim our money back via Paypal as it is very difficult to claim this back on Paypal however we did use AMEX and they are putting a claim in with all of the images.We were offered £200 from VRBO (did not receive this) because the villa was not clean. Yet the Vendor states that the villa was immaculate. We have images of this.To gaslight your honest reviewer with Lies just shows what VRBO allow and also what kind of people you are renting a villa from.Use a reputable company VRBO will NOT support you.EDIT YOU REPLYAbsolute NONSESE - There was no resolution your company are crooks !

name: PS
title: Disgrace of a service
text: Disgrace of a service. I booked one property and they put me into a different one, in another part of the city!!! Stitched me right up, I complained, they opened up the complaint then just ignored me. When I chased it, it didn't exist. Never again

name: Jo Duff
title: Hopstays - Palmela Quinta das Oliveiras. Shocking
text: This property was 6 miles from the described location.It was filthy. it was ill-equipped. We left and moved to a hotel. We have tried everything to complain and claim compensation BUT VRBO makes it impossible to complain or even reach them. we have sent many photos and a full report

name: Fredy Ulloa
title: Horrible platform and very poor app
text: Horrible platform and very poor app. They charge out rages fees for cancellations that are months ahead of travlers dates. They also spam call you all the time trying to change your stuff around, you won't make much money with them. Removed all my properties off their platform.

name: Sally
title: Absolutely shocking company
text: Absolutely shocking company. Quick enough to take your money but then spent almost 3 hours on the phone trying to find our booking so that we could get help with the checking in process. Transferred to Expedia numerous times as was told our booking was actually with them, only to be transferred back again. 3 hours of this and still none the wiser and apparently with no booking even though they took the money, sent confirmation emails, the lot. Absolutely disgusting, will NOT be using again. No point adding my booking number, none of the clowns could find it!

name: ZAN
title: Warning! DO NOT BOOK
text: We booked a townhome that held 8 people and discussed with the host prior to our stay that we'd have 5 family members that would be visiting the home during our stay. The host had two Ring doorbell cameras mounted at two entrances (no big deal). The host sent VRBO screenshots of each family member insisting that we were all staying in the home and that he didn't 'record' 4 people leaving the home. Insane, and even more insane is that VRBO allowed the host to cancel the reservation causing our family to leave the townhome and book another home with no refund. The townhome was already nasty looking, which we were going to write a review about. So when I mentioned everything that happened on the VRBO site under the property, they removed it citing "We have received a request to remove a review you left for listing #2426203. The partner reported that during your stay you failed to comply with their House Rule number of guests; therefore, your review has been permanently removed from the listing. You will not be able to submit a new review for this stay" This issue is not going away and we will pursue every avenue up the ranks. We are a law enforcement family and will not be bullied and taken lightly. The property number is 2426203 townhome in Champions Gate, Fl.

name: mark davis
title: double service fee just because i extended my stay
text: Below is correspondence I have sent to vrboNO response from anyonewe are displaced by California firesAirbnb is given people $1300 credits and i cant even get vrbo to refund a double service feeMy correspondence:This is the worst in customer service I have seen in a long time.Particularly during a crisisCustomer service supervisor was supposed to contact host and call me back but never didI am in the California wildfires and displaced from my homeI booked a rental through you and paid a $655 service feeI went to extend it a week and had to make a new reservation as the site would not let me modify my original one. I was now charged another $553 service fee.  Your customer service line says there is nothing they can do to waive that. This was after spending nearly an hour of the phone with themSeems ridiculous to me to have to pay double (in total over $1000) for your service particularly in light of the fact that Airbnb is offering $1300 credits to those impacted by the wildfires and I have seen nothing from VRBo along those linesPlease let me know what can be done to remove that second feeapparently this is because i made a new reservation to extend stay because my original reservation would not let me modify it

name: DJW
title: Beware of customer service lies
text: We rented a condo for the week after Christmas. I had not heard about check in information so called. Apparently it was already rented and we were stranded with my 6 year old son. Called VRBO, spent 60 mins on the phone and was told that they would reimburse us for up to $638 per night at a hotel for the firs two nights till they could rebook us and to make the reservation through one of their sites or with the hotel directly. We did. I was also told that someone would call to rebook us immediately after the call and 3 hours later, still no one had called. So called back, because we were no staying in a tiny room with no refrigerator and all this food for 6 days I was upset and the woman hung up on me. I called again and was escalated to resolutions team. Giovannie assured me I would get reimbursed and to send him the itemized bills, I told him for the whole week and he said yes. Again the first person said we would be reimbursed for the first two nights but since we had to throw away all our food, pay now for all of our meals and be stuck in a tiny room instead of a lovely 2 bedroom condo, I was adamant about this. Well comes to sending the itemized bill to Giovannie and crickets. Nothing, called and emailed. Still nothing, escalated it to another person ( who promised to help) and escalated and after many many hours on the phone and being lied to many times, we are now not getting reimbursed anything. Because our stay was less than the original price. Never mind that it was not with all the food wasted and meals we then had to purchase. And they lied as they said we would be reimbursed. I will now only use Air B n B and I will not use anything Expedia or VRBO related. BEWARE

name: kristi
title: Feeling lucky? Then this is the booking app for you
text: Imagine you've spent hours scouring the various listings to find the perfect vacation home for your upcoming epic group trip with family. You've looked at every detail, so many properties, but you found just the right one. You click the button. You make the reservation. The payment is made. The owner accepts the booking. Life is good. All you have to do now is book your experiences/excursions. Good times ahead! Until.....the host/property owner decides to cancel your booking without warning somewhere between the day you booked it and the day you are supposed to check-in. That sinking feeling you get when you see the email in your inbox that there has been a vrbo refund. What?! Did I accidentally cancel it somehow? This can't be true. Log into vrbo and sure enough, it is. Still unclear what happened, initiate chat with customer service where I'm told the owner simply canceled the booking. Now I initially thought vrbo was meh to ok with the customer service on this as they gave a $30 (not earth shattering or remotely compensating for the trouble, but something) onekey credit. Silly me didn't realize said credit is just a token gesture and expires within 2 weeks. Great. I had already booked another property in my panic and the silly policy only allows onekey cash to be used at the time of booking. So, I have essentially received nothing for the roller coaster experience. When I contacted vrbo yet again, the response was simply there is nothing we can do and lots of referring me to the fine print.

name: Hedwig
title: I am incredibly grateful to VRBO for…
text: I am incredibly grateful to VRBO for their outstanding support and professionalism after I faced an unfortunate situation with one of their listings. The listing contained false information that severely impacted my holiday, leaving me frustrated and disappointed. However, when I reached out to VRBO’s customer service team, they truly went above and beyond to address the issue.After explaining the situation, they took my concerns seriously and worked quickly to investigate the matter. Ultimately, they provided me with a fair and generous compensation for the inconvenience I had experienced. This thoughtful gesture truly showed me that VRBO values its customers and is committed to ensuring a positive experience, even when things go wrong.While the situation was far from ideal, I feel reassured knowing that VRBO handled it with such care and consideration. It’s not every day that a company takes accountability and shows appreciation for its customers in such a meaningful way. I’m thankful for their quick resolution, and it’s a relief to know that they genuinely care about their customers' well-being. I will certainly continue to use VRBO for my future travels

name: barry hutchinson
title: They locked my account so I lost…
text: I have tried to contact VRBO over this issue but their customer services have not responded so I'm going to stop using them.Corporate greed seems to be the order of the day. They really don't care about their customers all they care about is money.I think everyone should stop using them.

name: Mabel
title: Misleading listings and horrible customer service
text: 1 star is actually way more than vrbo deserves. My first (and only) experience with Vrbo.  I booked a property in New York for a work trip and I became very sick and contagious 4 days before my trip and could not travel.  I also simultaneously learned that the property I had booked had a shared bathroom, which was not disclosed anywhere in the listing. I knew this listing didn't offer refunds but tried anyway since it was an emergency situation. After being sent on a run-around by your call center representatives and by the person who listed the property, I was told there was nothing they could do since the property owners set the refund policy NOT Vrbo.  Vrbo doesn't care about their customers even when there is a health emergency and a misleading, false listing.  Shared bathroom is kind of a big deal for someone not to disclose. now I'm stuck paying $1800 (including an absurdly high cleaning fee, for a place with apparently major hygiene and pest issues) that I cannot afford for a place I never stayed at. I understand that the property said no refunds but I've dealt with a lot of hotels/companies who will issue at least a partial refund for extenuating circumstances, especially when I was several days away from my trip, and again, the listing with not what I signed up for.  I've deleted the vrbo and expedia apps and will never use again. Shame on you for not putting your customers first and not addressing false and misleading listings.

name: SR
title: Trustpilot Reviews Stopped Us Booking & Probably Saved Us!
text: UPDATE - 19 January 2025 - even owners of properties have advised that Vrbo is not up-to-date, it promotes properties that owners have advised are fully booked - so all in all - not reliable or another way of putting it, lacks integrity.Even Vrbo reply below does nothing to support consumer - it's a pseudo (insincere) customer service reply. No-one to engage with and that is Vrbo's biggest barrier for a customer.12 Jan 2025 - Vrbo just feels off. AirBnB property owners all replied within 24-hours but with Vrbo - radio silence, so I decided to check Vrbo out.Most of their social media icons on site don't work - red flag!Cannot get hold of any customer service - second red flag!Trustpilot given insight that Vrbo probably not good site.Other reviews also not great.

name: Vivienne Brugmans
title: Wonderful 🌟
text: HiWell what can I say about my trip to poland last September 🤔My friend & i both in our mid 70s decided to visit Kraków! And the best trip. I  have had in a while, we visited  all the usual places Salt Mine! Wonderful  experience! But a long day and Iadvise you need to be fit !!!Then our trip to Auschwitz-Birkenau brilliant and should not be missed , the insight to what happened  is very eye opening ! Regards the treatment  of mainly jewish people but also other people  such as gypsies dutch and other nations  , will leave you very sad indeed and thank God it's not happing today ( well we hope )Just saying other places we didn't vist but we are going back again in September to see what we missed  , The people are polite and helpful!! We loved our apartment  and everything  about the food .try the dumplings!! Overall our holiday was a blessing and we are going back for more 🙏 and we have an apartment  from Vrbo again great prices for wonderful apartment ect..❤️

name: Craig
title: We had two bookings - neither went ahead. terrible service. Ended up in worse properties. Fake listings. Terrible customer service
text: We had two bookings. 1 the host never received it and told us on the way to the airport. Despite 2 hours on hold at the airport, no help from VRBO. Ended up in worse accommodation, worse location and paid more. got a refund for the difference but ended up paying what we were supposed to pay for a much better property.Second booking. No response from host. VRBO said we had to turn up to property and check it couldnt go ahead - traveling with pregnant wife, 4 yr old son, elderly parents. Same thing, rental didnt go ahead and had to book somewhere else that wasnt as good and only gpot difference refunded.Just avoid. So many of the listings are fake, and youre trapped when youve booked and they make you book with 'them or their partner' where selection is terrible.Its a scam

name: Kim C
title: VRBO NOT PAYING HOSTS
text: UpdateSince posting this review, I was immediately contacted by phone and in writing by Les from the VRBO Social Response Team, who completely understood my problem, oversaw it's resolution, made a goodwill gesture and kept in touch throughout the whole process. I couldn't have asked for a better service, and it's a real pity that this level of professionalism is a rare find. Thank you Les.ref:!00DC00PxQg.!5008b02j6fKW:ref ]Vrbo 135038809     [ ref:!00DC00PxQg.!5008b02iyaIC:refVrbo 134506137    [ ref:!00DC00PxQg.!5008b02iOcwL:ref ]For the second time, VRBO is not paying rent owed to me and has consistently failed to take action despite my opening several cases with support.  A renter cancelled a stay before making the final payment. Under my terms, no refund is due to the renter. VRBO took their full commission, as if full payment had been received and the rent taken place. The residual amount of the deposit is due to me.  This took place on 5th December 2024.  The payment should have immediately been activated and according to the booking information was actioned on that date.  However, no payment was made and every single day, my account updates to fraudulently state that the payment was made on that particular date. On 16th December 2024, a supervisor called Richard assured me the payment had been made. It hadn't.  On 20th December a customer service rep, Sushmita, said that the payment had definitely been made on that date, and confirmed this in writing.  It hadn't of course. Every time I have tried to reply to a customer service email, I simply get the message that my case is closed.  On 2nd January 2025, I managed to summon the energy for a miserable afternoon on the chat and phone service to customer support. After spending far too long with a brain dead rep, I finally insisted that I get put through to another Supervisor. This time I got Ammar, who sent me an email telling me that my case has been referred on.  Since then I have written to him four times including a screenshot showing that my account has once again updated to say that payment was made on 3rd, then 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th January etc etc. Ammar has not given me the courtesy of a reply. The only communication VRBO has initiated to me was on 2nd January to tell me that they were suspending my account as I had signed in too many times!!!  The inefficiency, the indifference and total indolence I have experienced from customer service is unbelievable. I am posting here to demand action from VRBO.  Pay me what I am owed.

name: Tash Recsky
title: I want to give a ZERO. DO NOT USE VRBO
text: DO NOT USE VRBOMy husband and two friends rented what was advertised as a beautiful Cliff House in Hawaii. When we arrived we found cockroaches and rodent droppings all over the house. And a filthy house with stains on furniture, walls, windows and Cobb webs everywhere. As well as bugs in the fridge and mold in the showers. The photos that were advertised for this home were nothing like the rundown dirty home we arrived at. We made the decision it would be a health risk and definitely not what we paid $5700 CDN for and took a bunch of photos as evidence. Surely VRBO would be just as surprised and upset as we were and would refund our money right?  NO THEY DIDNT. Instead my husband and I have been back and forth with them, having them call it all minor and they haven’t done a thing but offer us $300 back. We feel robbed by and disappointed in VRBO. Anyone else who has seen our photos is shocked and can’t believe it either. We struggled to find additional accommodations and were out more money to stay the week. AGAIN DO NOT USE VRBO. They don’t appreciate their customers or stand up for them.  The also clearly don’t make sure the homes advertised are what they say they are. DO NOT RENT FROM VRBO and tell your friends and family so they are not robbed like we have been

name: Rob
title: From the host's side...
text: From the host's side, it is also terrible.  The user interface is absolute garbage, everything is difficult and all over the website.  Support is utterly useless in almost all cases.  The App barely works and my feedback goes nowhere.

name: polly
title: Awful service
text: Would be zero if I had a choice.I am still trying to sort out a issue from October where the property was not as advertised.My guests from abroad were unable to stay at the property due to the state yet even though I informed the company nothing had been done to date I lost 1600.00 and was left ill and stressed out during my daughter's wedding.

name: Natalie Kelly
title: If I could rate a 0 I would. This company is a scam & needs to be shut down! Unethical practices to guests & hosts alike! Stay away! Never again!
text: What went wrong-geez what didn’t?! I had an exasperating & horrible experience with VRBO and the property managed by AAA Lux Villas Inc in Florida.We paid lots of money way in advance to rent a home in FL. This home was dirty upon arrival, had junky furniture, old ripped towels, broken lights, doors, but most importantly was unsafe & unhealthy to stay at for our extended stay due to fire & pool safety violations. I contacted host immediately and requested refund for the time we did not use after evacuating the premises. Months later of trying to negotiate with host, VRBO and even doing dispute with my credit card, this is still an ongoing nightmare.The home had so many violations. VRBO took no accountability neither did the owner hosts. Trying to communicate with VRBO offshore customer “service” is a joke. The reps who can barely speak English regurgitate the same frustrating script over and over with no solutions in sight. It’s a communication rabbit hole with no escape. I even tried exchanging, instead of refund towards new property (we had vetted) which they say is possible with their “book with confidence” guarantee. They did not comply.This business needs to be shut down. All they care about is collecting money from both sides but don’t care to solve problems or supporting us.VRBO has poor reputation on the US BBB for their shady practices, double bookings, not refunding money etc.Hosts are not held accountable for the condition, cleanliness and safety of their homes.There are even social media groups dedicated to complaints against VRBO.At this point, I’ve contacted the BBB, and in process of contacting the state attorney generals. If my demand letters do not yield results, I am prepared to sue them & AAA lux villas. This nightmare has been so time-consuming, draining and very stressful.EDIT UPDATE 1/14/25: VRBO you’re saying you’ve requested “necessary information” but where? No one has reached out to me to request anything

name: Leena Rai
title: No More Vrbo!
text: No oversight of who these so called property owners are. They are quick to take the money but then change the reservations ONE DAY before we were coming. We had to scramble to find new accommodations. Not great with young children and elderly parents.This is my third time getting shafted by Vrbo - I gave them too many chances.I AM DONE!  Hope Vrbo dies an agonizing death.

name: Mary Pat Rondthaler
title: Paris VRBO cancellation for Two Senior Citizen Travelers
text: My husband and I booked an apartment in Paris through VRBO. On our walk from the train to the apartment, on the day we expected to use the apartment,  we received an email saying it had all ready been booked, by another platform. We were in a park in Paris with our suitcases, talking to Customer Service at VRBO. After much haggling the agent told us VRBO would cover three nights in a comparable price hotel. Upon returning home, I sent three emails to the agent at VRBO, with all the necessary paperwork regarding their reimbursing us. I have received no response, whatsoever.

name: Alex Tsai
title: If I could give 0 stars I would (edited with resolution)
text: January 10, 2024 (Edit):A representative named Marcques from Vrbo reached out to me via email to address this issue. I am not sure if it was a result from this review specifically or from another call where I connected with a supervisor on their customer service phone line (the call was after posting the original review).He emailed me apologizing for the incident, and called me personally the next day for another apology and compensated for the troubles I went through.I want to call out Marcques's handling of this situation was 5 star customer service, but this review is about my experience as a whole when take into account of the original ordeal, I am only adjusting the stars from 1 to 3. I hope Vrbo does better with their first line customer service agents and empower them to be able to help like Marcques did.________________________________________December 27, 2024 (Original Review):If I could give 0 stars I would. This is a company that takes your money and provides no services nor support for what you paid for.I booked a stay on the platform to have to host cancel on me last minute. Instead of rebooking me onto another stay, they took 2 days "trying to reach the host" and promised to call me back with a resolution.Come the day of my check in, no communication from Vrbo. I had spent over 5 hours of my vacation time on the chat / phone with them getting no answers. At the end of the day they wanted me to book another stay on my own on the day of the stay (which means last minute booking for very limited options & high prices)  and did not refund my original booking even after they said they would (it's been over 10 days and I have followed every procedure they outlined to get a refund).Scam practice, would not recommend this company. Go to Airbnb instead

name: Frequent Traveler
title: Awful. Run Away. Don't Plan To Sleep Through Water Noise
text: 1. Water pipe noise in bedroom from pool directly above PH 04 all night the first night. Took management 24 hours to stop it temporarily. Noise kept coming back, and when they got around to it, they would stop the noise. Management admitted that's a problem with PH 04 -- after they got our money and after we'd complained for three days.2. Water leaks visible in ceiling and walls.3. Bedroom windows face the hall which has a motion sensor light so whenever anyone walks down the hall the bedroom gets the light - even with the shades down.4. Third day there was no hot water. Surprisingly it was fixed in an hour with new flashlight batteries.5. Management tries to ignore the issues by not responding to complaints. One phone number is disconnected. Another phone goes to voice mail.6. VRBO answers its phone and service rep tried calling Nola Homes (the management company) but didn't get an answer either. They say it's Nola's problem. Wait times were between 20-40 minutes with VRBO.7. Asked for partial refund and Nola and VRBO ignored request - no response. Will call credit card company to file a dispute.8. Messages from Nola Homes are all automated and have nothing to do with questions asked.\9. Check-in rep was 30 minutes late.10. Neighborhood is what you'd expect - a mix of new but mostly run-down buildings. View from terrace is of the run-down area with 2 slivers of ocean in front of you. If you look to the side you can see more ocean. Pics very deceptive.

name: Drithal Kala
title: VBRO and their hosts are scammers …
text: If I could give this scam of a company 0 stars I will happily do it. We had 2 properties booked for new year eve, booked back in Oct. the first host cancelled on us with a lie of an excuse 1 month before and then blocked the reviews and his property. We rebooked with another host and they said it was non refundable. Less than 48 hrs before our booking he cancels, sad excuse, then disappears and hasn’t provided a refund for over a week now. His ignoring all messages and vbro won’t do anything to contact him.  The main point of this review is just how unethical and pathetic vbro service is. They will do nothing to help, don’t answer the phone and use AI to give useless generic responses saying they understand the inconvenience and would love to help and then nothing. This company is allowing hosts to scam people and take money with no consequences or help to the traveller. Never ever use this. Air b n b is still a safer option. Vbro is UNETHICAL

name: Nannymcphee
title: Poor operating system
text: After having to reduce our stay by one day, rather than amend and reduce the outstanding balance they took 10 days to issue a credit against the deposit. I now cannot see my review for the host or their review for me in the app, even though I’ve had notification it’s available to view. Not a good system at all, I don’t know why owners use this company.

name: Nancy
title: Terrible company will never rent…
text: Terrible company will never rent through VRBO again. All they do is take the home owners side and make you jump through hurdles to get anything done… when in fact you get nothing accomplished. I left a rental after one night (had it booked Nov 3-8) it was so dirty, many things broken and no battery in smoke detector yet listed as “luxury” I got zero dollars back from VRBO and I spent $2000 on that rental yet stayed less than 24hrs. They took my review down of the rental too so now that dirty unit only has 5 star reviews. What a scam company! How is this allowed?!

name: Estuardo
title: Don’t use VRBO!
text: Don’t use VRBO!! They scammed me , with a listing that hasn’t been listed for 4 year, keeping my family stock in Costa Rica, loosing a lot of time on our vacation!!! I finished paying a lot more for multiple hotel rooms a lot more expensive!!!

name: Gaynor
title: LEFT STRANDED
text: Do not use this site , booked for fuerteventura for 3 weeks over Xmas and new year , only to find the apartment wasn't trading anymore so left stranded with now to stay, I had informed them earlier of my concerns but was assured it was OK. We were 3 older laddies over 60 , as it was so close to xmas there wasn't really anything available to us so ended up having to book a all-inclusive which ended up costing us a extra £750 each and that was after the refund and a little compensation they give us .but didn't have any help finding something else for us ; so BEWARE when booking with this company.I for one will be never using them again.

name: Tom Barry
title: Just when I thought they couldn't get any worse...
text: I am a host and I advertise on VRBO. Against my better judgement, I was persuaded by them to allow instant bookings with the promise that this would lead to more reservations. It didn't, but that is not the current cause of complaint. I was told that I could set house rules which would enable me to reject any instant bookings which contravened those rules - and to reject them without penalty.This turned out to be untrue. I set a rule to say that groups with more than six adults had to contact me before booking. A second rule said that guests with pets must contact me before booking. Finally I got an instant booking - from a group of eight adults with a pet. So I immediately cancelled the reservation.During the cancellation process (which was not easy) I was informed that my listing would be suspended for seven days. So in fact there WAS a penalty. I was also asked to agree to refund the guest's payment - this is complete nonsense of course, as the guest had not paid me. VRBO had taken and were holding the payment.I contacted VRBO. This meant 25 minutes in a queue, 1 minute of conversation and then being cut off. Another call, another queue. The online chat promised a 30 minute wait - until you joined it, when 30 minutes became 60. And they call this support.I did eventually get VRBO to cancel the booking. They then sent a message to the French guest in English. VRBO gave my UK phone number for the guest to call if they had any queries about the 5 to 7 day delay on repayment. I have a French number for Francophone guests and always speak to them in French.In all VRBO made the experience unpleasant and stressful for me and for my potential guest. They made me look unprofessional, which I work hard not to be. The lack of professionalism was not mine.

name: Susan
title: Bait and Switch and Dishonestly Not Posting Negative Reviews
text: I originally wrote the following as a review on vrbo.com, but it was inexplicably rejected.  I think VRBO is both dishonest and stupid for not allowing unfavorable but honest reviews.  Eventually the public will figure out that the reason all the reviews are so good on VRBO is because VRBO won't post bad reviews.  The only possible inaccuracy below is whether the host or VRBO provided the refund.  I was unsure who initiated it."I reserved apartment #2, but we were given the entry codes to apartment #3 without being told they were for apartment #3. We couldn’t gain entry and missed the first night. The host refunded the money for that night. The next day we were told we were to be in apartment #3. Although I asked twice I never received an answer as to why we were switched. I had reserved #2 because it had a king-sized bed. Apartment #3 has a queen. Having a larger bed may not be important to some guests, but it was important to us."Additionally, the host gave me a hard time about the refund claiming I only paid for 4 nights instead of 5.  I did initially pay for 4 nights but then added and paid for a 5th night.  He was too lazy to do the researrch to realize this, so I had to do it for him.  I told him via private message that I will NEVER rent from him again, which is sad because we visit the Uptown area in Minneapolis where he has rentals once or twice each year.I had initially thought that the host was the problem, but after reading the reviews on Trustpilot, I see that VRBO has many of its own problems.A few days after I posted the above paragraphs, a nice VRBO agent called me and said he would find out why my negative review was not accepted to be posted on vrbo.com.  I received an email from VRBO stating, "I wanted to inform you that your review has been submitted to our system; however, it has unfortunately been rejected due to the disclosure of the property's location."  I do not mention an address or any way to locate the property in my review.  This just seems like another bogus reason not to post a negative review.VRBO now says that mentioning apartment numbers is disclosing the location.  I rewrote the review without apartment numbers.  We'll see if they post it now.Now they say only I can post it if I have the email in which they rejected my review the first time.  I no longer have it, so they win.  A bad review will not be posted on vrbo.com.I GIVE UP!  It's no wonder people don't post bad reviews there.  I have jumped through hoop after hoop and still can't post the review so people know that the host where we rented an apartment is not so great and definitely NOT responsive.

name: Shay
title: Hosts not being paid
text: I’ve been waiting weeks for my pay out as a host! I’m told it’s pending but nothing. Other host have shared that they have been waiting months for payments. Will not take anymore booking from this site, sticking to Airbnb who pay their hosts on time.

name: Chris
title: Avoid this company
text: We booked a property and when we showed up, the code didn’t work but there were 4 unknown individuals inside that opened the door and said they were fixing the lock. We felt unsafe. Eventually got in touch with VRBO and told them what happened. Owner now refuses to give the refund and company says that since we did not take pictures of the unknown individuals at the property that they won’t issue a refund. Even though the supervisor we spoke to admitted they wouldn’t have taken pictures either. Avoid this company!  Awful to deal with! Deceitful and no integrity.

text: Neither the platform nor the host for a Helsinki flat costing over 180euros per night announced that the check in was only possibly until 10pm! name: Colin Murray
title: Booked an apartment at 23 Rue De La…
text: Booked an apartment at 23 Rue De La Reverence Brussels for first Christmas away.On arriving greeter was unfriendly/unhelpful, basically handed us the keys and left us to it.The apartment was large but five floors up(75 steps).The decor was minimalist, white walls black wood floors.Kitchen light was broken.Shower was broken.Fridge door broken.Lounge settee(large L shaped)and its throws/cushions were filthy.Smelt and looked really bad.Dining chairs, lifted cushions to discover crumbs/nuts etc.Bedroom one, mattress is to small for divan and constantly slid about as did the sheet which was to large for the mattress.Water for bath was somewhere between lukewarm and a few degrees higher.Pressure was so low it took ages to run a bath.We had asked for a tree as it was Christmas and we had our 5 year old Grandson along.A tree was present on arrival put no pot or stand for it and no decorations(despite telling us we would have both).The heat in the apartment soon dried it out and the needles fell.We ended up buying a small imitation tree locally.This could be a great apartment but sadly is neglected and dirty.We continually tried to address issues with the owner but clearly he had no interest.He just wants the money and no fuss.I strongly advise you do not stay at this apartment.We presented our concerns to Vrbo but they also showed no interest whatsoever.

name: Toni and Kevin and family Riga
title: Arapawa Island, Gunyah homestead, Arapawa Seafarms
text: Arapawa Island Sea Farms holiday rental was wonderful in many ways.  The location was magical with views to the mouth of Kura Te Au (Tory Chanel).  Two beaches offered safe swimming within a short stroll from the old homestead house, Gunyah.  The hosts warmly welcomed us on the wharf and efficiently transported us with our belongings to the house.  The house was spacious and well equipped, including an ample supply of towels,  and had a log fire.  The children enjoyed the freedom of the  grounds around the house,  feeding the resident eels and fishing off the wharf.  Historically it was interesting with the ruins of the old Perano whaling station within easy walk. Whekenui Bay is where the great explorer Kupe killed his pursuer the octopus.  The tui, weka and kererū were plentiful and the pōhutakawa trees put on a magnificent show of red flowers. The Picton Water Taxi (Beachcomber Cruises) service was excellent.

text: Avoid at all costs!!!This is the first and last time I'll book a property via VRBO. name: Peter Axton

name: WB
title: I've removed my apartment from VRBO site because they're a disgrace
text: My experience of VRBO is from the opposite side than most reviews on here. I rent out a holiday apartment.
