Yesterday on Christmas Eve I was notified that a guest had booked my property for 6 nights arriving on 28th December!As my apartment is fully booked it should not have been possible for anyone to book it. I checked the calendar and was horrified to see that it was completely empty and showing all dates as being available. I messaged the person who had booked and explained something had gone wrong with the VRBO system. I had to cancel his booking and I ordered a full refund (hosts don't get the payment until VRBO send it). I spent Christmas eve trying to sort it out with VRBO, who said I had to send a photo of my calendar from before his booking to prove it was already booked!! How am I supposed to do that?!? All my bookings reappeared later, then disappeared and reappeared again in front of my eyes.VRBO said I am going to be charged a cancellation fee for cancelling this booking and they are not going to offer any compensation to the man who booked.It's an absolute disgrace. I have removed my apartment from the VRBO website and deleted my account. My guests are very important to me and I feel terrible knowing  that this poor man probably hates me for what has happened even though it was not my fault and VRBO couldn't care less.My advice to hosts and guests..... Do not use VRBO.

name: Lona Manning
title: Hundreds of dollars down the drain, miserable experience.
text: I planned a trip to Boston in October ahead of a conference in Cleveland. I found a cozy one bedroom suite to recover from jet lag and work on my conference presentation and speech.  I waited at the airport for the host to give me the address. When we finally got the address and got there, it was clear it was not the property I had seen and rented on VRBO. Bait and switch. Further, although we were tired from our flight, we couldn't check in until after 6 pm because it was still being set up. We had to leave and wait for another two hours. When we did check in we discovered there was no internet. I mean no server, there was nothing there. No chair, no table, no desk, not even an end table. Exhausted, we fell asleep. The next morning we left the property, I said I would pay for that first night but wanted a refund for the next two nights. I had just three nights in Boston but I was supposed to contact VRBO and then wait for them and the host to resolve the issue. With no internet and no international data plan on my phone. The host later messaged me he was going to "replace" the server as though there was a repair that needed to be done, but there was no server there. The place had just been set up and was half-furnished. Since my experience in October he has gotten more bad reviews but VRBO is standing behind him, not me.

name: Chris Morgan

title: Horrible customer service for home…
text: Horrible customer service for home owners, My guest checked in on Dec 10 and today is the 22 of december, still hav not been paid, their cusomer service/managment is useless, they charge double in fees compared to @airbnb, just host there people!

name: Peter
title: “Homes all to yourself”?!!!
text: So much for offering homes “all to yourself”. Maybe the most unsafe uncomfortable travel experience of my life and when I called vrbo they told me I needed photo proof of the random guy staying in the house to issue a refund. What a miserable business.

name: John Stevens
title: I am extremely disappointed with VRBO…
text: I am extremely disappointed with VRBO and will never use this site for travel plans again. I booked a property three months ago, only to receive a call yesterday (December 20) from a company called Distinctive Beach Rentals (DBR), claiming they were canceling my reservation. The person who called spoke poor English, was dismissive, and left me questioning whether the call was even legitimate.When I sent a message through VRBO for clarification, they forwarded my email to DBR, who then emailed me back stating that the reservation wasn't canceled but that I would need to move to a different property. The "alternatives" they sent were up to 100 miles away from my original booking, which is completely unacceptable.This is not an isolated incident—this is the third time a booking has been canceled through VRBO. The lack of reliability and accountability is appalling. If you want peace of mind for your travel plans, look elsewhere. VRBO has proven to be completely untrustworthy, and I will never use this service again.

name: Kirsty Hunter
title: Christmas booking cancelled 2 days before traveling
text: On the 29th October I booked an expensive country cottage via VRBO for Christmas. I live in the Netherlands and wanted to spend Christmas in the UK with my family. I paid in full on the day of booking and received an email confirmation. Today 2 days before I get on the ferry to travel to have Christmas with my family VRBO sent an email canceling my booking - I am absolutely devastated and disgusted that a company (and the owner - who ignored all my messages) can treat consumers with such disregard and disrespect. To top it all off I have to wait 15 days for a full refund!!

name: Ibro Gulamov
title: Bad experience
text: Bad experience. Fraudulent moves from hosts. No control under service. Don't recommend to use stressful ervice.

name: Sarah Shabanie
title: Muhammad was wonderful and he helped me…
text: Muhammad was wonderful and he helped me resolve an issue I had with an owner. He is very professional and his customer service is over the top. Thank you.

name: Guillaume Paturel
title: extreme caution.
text: A few months ago, I opened a VRBO account without realizing that the rental calendar was automatically open to bookings. To be fair, the option to manage the calendar is far from intuitive—finding it feels like solving a puzzle, which seems intentional. You practically need to be an expert to figure it out.The worst happened: my house was rented without my knowledge. When I tried to log into my account to fix the situation, I found myself locked out due to endless security procedures. It was an incredibly frustrating experience.After multiple attempts, I finally managed to contact VRBO. I asked them to close my account, and they were able to cancel the unauthorized booking. But this morning, I received yet another blow: a $1,900 bill, due immediately.This whole experience has been nothing short of a nightmare. VRBO’s system feels designed to trap users. If you’re considering using this platform, proceed with extreme caution.

name: Lars Pedersen
title: Not at all as it should be
text: We hired a castle in France for the 2024 family summer holidays. All looked wonderful on the pictures on VRBO.com and matched the seemingly fake reviews.Unfortunately the very first moment of our stay showed to be symbolic for how this magnificent property has been taken care of during the last 10 years or more. There were no host to receive us on the agreed arrival time, and the host did not answer his phone. All doors were locked and prior to this we haven’t received any information apart from the arrival time. Imagine the frustration and panic in our group of 36 guests. We managed to get into the property via Vrbo support during a 35 minute long phone call. Ridiculous when you have paid 20,000 euros upfront for one week stay.The add on Vrbo.com said “…. Castle in perfect condition”. That is a lie. The castle is falling apart on the outside and the same picture is taking form in the basement, some of the rooms and all of the windows. The surrounding areas have not been taken care of apart from 5-10 meter surrounding the castle. I could go on. The overall cleaning was limited to the main corridors and staircase, leaving dust and filth in almost every corner of every room.Such a shame for such a wonderful property. We tried to get the host to reason on a refund on some of the paid rent but he newer bothered to answer any of our messages. Afterwards we got a really bad review as a guest from the host, and since July 2024 I have tried to get VRBO.com to post our review of the property and host. They keep ignoring us and instead I can read new reviews with perfect ratings on the property from guest who apparently have stayed right after our visit...Stay away from VRBO.comBest regardsLars PedersenNB!Just to prove my point regarding vrbo.com, I have inserted a copy of the e-mails I have recevied from vrbo.com after I published this review on Trustpilot on December 19, 2024 and gave vrbo.com the required details about my booking and trip.E-mail from Vrbo Support on December 23, 2024:"Dear LarsThank you for reaching out to Social Response TeamThe Social Response team has received your concerns about your previous booking complaint. We're empowered to help with escalations of this nature.Please be assured that we’ll look into this immediately and get back to you as soon as we've completed the necessary research.To make sure any replies to this email remains linked to your open case, please don’t remove the subject line or reply in a separate email.Thank you for the opportunity to assist with your concern.Regards,JainzVrbo Social Response Team"E-mail from Vrbo Support on December 27, 2024:"Dear LarsHi,I hope this email finds you well.As we further investigate, it seems that your booking is already a post-stay. However, we would like to request proof of your misrepresentation claim at that time. We need this evidence so that we can proceed or look for possible ways to help you with your concern. We will wait until December 30, 2024, for your response along with the requested proof.I hope everything is in order now.Have a wonderful day!Regards,JainzVrbo Social Response Team"E-mail from Vrbo Support on December 30, 2024:"Dear Lars,Thank you for your continued patience and understanding as we addressed the concerns you brought to our attention.We have ensured that a comprehensive summary of our discussions has been communicated to our Leadership Team, ensuring they are fully aware of the situation and your valuable feedback.We deeply regret that we cannot provide you with further assistance due to the lack of responsiveness to our emails, and we extend our sincerest apologies for any inconvenience this may have caused.Should there be any additional documentation that necessitates a re-evaluation of your case, we encourage you to respond directly to this email to ensure continuity.Please understand that without new documentation, we will not be able to revisit the resolution for this issue, as all options have been fully explored. For any new issues or assistance required, do not hesitate to reach out to Customer Support at 877-202-4291 or visit our Help Center for guidance.Regards,JainzVrbo Social Response Team"

name: Anna Jackson
title: Dreadful company as a host AVOID
text: Dreadful company. As a host they currently owe me almost 5,000gbp. They have been palming me off with an excuse for the past 6 weeks that they can’t pay it into my given bank account, despite me using this same account for air b n b and booking.com without an issue. In addition I have offered to give them another bank account of mine which they refused to allow me to do. Essentially I can’t win and I can’t think of any other reason for this other than they essentially don’t want to pay me. The customer service team including Eman and Neha have been useless as best. Despite being told I would be kept updated I’ve barely heard from them and I’ve never heard from the illusive ‘hyperwallets’ team, I have asked 3 times for this to be escalated to a manager with absolutely no luck what so ever. I will be seeking legal action as I don’t know what else to do.

name: Adrian Bullock
title: Refunded my money Poor host partners
text: This is my first experience using this app, it appealed as it was the platform where I found a very nice property for my xmas get away.  I booked months in advance and was definitely worried about paying in advance.  Fast forward to 3 days before travel and no information from the host, no answer to my in app message or direct text message.  Spoke to the online customer services who also tried to contact the host (total 3 times I spoke with them and they tried to contact the host) now hours before I fly and 1 day from check in I have asked for a refund so I can source alternative accommodation.  This has been agreed to and confirmed by email although the money has yet to land.  I expected the worst given all the reviews but am happy they have refunded the money but very annoyed one of their partners! Has caused me so much hassle hours before I travel……

name: Suzette
title: Vrbo not honoring booking and not refunding
text: I booked accommodation on Expedia and paid in full; last week I wanted to check the details of the property and it shows on Expedia, but the details could not be accessed. Expedia then informed me it was with Vrbo. I contacted the host as well as Vrbo but my booking (still on Expedia) did not exist on Vrbo. According to the host Vrbo was not suppose to advertise it. I have spent a lot of time and money to phone Vrbo (I am in South Africa) and have sent numerous emails. I do not get any reply/feedback as to how they are going to refund me.On Thursday they told me that they could not see the payment on their system and I had to provide them with a ct card statement to proof that I have actually paid!! This after I have sent them the receipt as well as the confirmation of the booking.I have thus lodged a case of fraud via my bank which results in the ct card being cancelled and replaced (again at our cost). We also had to book and pay for another accommodation option as we are leaving for Dublin on 22 December.I have never had such a bad experience and I regard this as either a case of fraud or plain theft.

name: Richard Ganley
title: First booking cancelled
text: Signed up and made my first booking. It's was cancelled a couple of days later with no explanation as to why. Seems to be a pointless waste of time to me and won't bother using again! Pretty offended.

name: Graham Logan
title: 1 star is the lowest you can award
text: I have been a Vrbo host, and it's previous name since 2006. It used to be such a good company, now it is disgraceful. Terrible system, pitiful support, no system to complaint about them, and no way to recieve a refund from them for a new listing that has not worked since it was set up. Shocking to see how unprofessional they have become-

name: JEANETTE
title: Customer service is non existent
text: I had a reservation at a property in Bali, which said 7 minute walk to beach and it was incorrect as it was in a mountain.I contacted host via vrbo who was happy to refund me but says he has not received the payment.I have been in contact with VRBO via chat, several times, as I  cannot call using my phone in Bali and keep getting told to go through the host. I am going from host to vrbo and still no closer to the refund back to the card I made payment on.It is an impossible situation and they do not have a complaint email either.The host is having the same difficulty trying to contact them.I would avoid VRBO as a host or traveller

name: Julien Brungard
title: Do NOT use them!
text: Do NOT use them!Luxury penthouse in Hills Road, Number 9 The Levels (City View Terrace), Cambridge, was an awful experience. Cleaning not done, half of what they advertised for didn't work, even the wi-fi, for which we got the owner to provide a mobile wi-fi, but he didn't want to top it up himself - he tried to get us to do it with the promise to pay us back later. That was a lie as he hasn't even re-funded us the deposit; plus the discount he promised us. He has now been silent for almost 2 months. VRBO not only claims not to be liable, but they won't even let us put this in the review, which explains why the guy doesn't have any reviews at all. We have a strong feeling that he has done this to a lot of people, and VRBO is protecting him somehow by not letting people report this.

name: Luke Moore
title: Is there a zero stars option?
text: Is there a zero stars option?Booking made for a property in Birmingham (host Mariam Alvi under the name brightside properties). Had a message on the day of arrival saying it was booked in error. Requested refund. No replies and 2 weeks later now about to take further action. Vrbo customer service non existent. Utterly shit.

name: Lida Maria
title: THEY CANCELLED MY RESERVATION AND DID NOT FULLY REFUND ME!
text: I received a cancellation from the owner because the house had some damages but then I di not receive full refund! I have been trying to find a customer support line BUT THERE IS NONE! How is it possible to have a booking platform where too many things can go wrong without a support line?! Really not recommended!

name: Jalla Hertoghe
title: Terrible experience!!! Scammers villa didn’t exist
text: Terrible experience!!!! We lost 20.000 euros and the villa actually never existed. We have been scammed and VBRO did not do anything, no reimbursement, they never took the responsibility of contacting us back. They did not respect their engagement and we didn’t get our money back. Be careful and don’t be scammed

name: A. Hudson
title: Customer support for hosts doesn't exist!
text: Customer support for hosts doesn't exist! It is unclear what number to dial if you even find that information. I had a problem with a reservation, I was finally able to talk to somebody in english who could not help me. He said that it will be forwarded to a "concern" department and that they will get back to me. I never heard back from anybody! I talked to 4 more persons who could not speak english and also could not transfer me to english speaking service agents. How can you trust working with a company without customer service!!!

name: Amy Ziegelmeyer
title: Beware! Owners can make strange requirements!
text: We are currently dealing with VRBO over a last minute rental. We booked a cabin in Gatlinburg, TN a week before check in. After booking, the property owner called and forced us to have an hour long conversation on all things Gatlinburg (even though we told her we had been there more than 30 times). Once we completed the conversation to her satisfaction, she sent us her contracts to sign. There were lots of unreasonable things required in the contract. All giant red flags so we contacted her and asked to cancel since we did not agree or the terms of the contract. She refused. I explained that had she disclosed these “requirements” on the property listing, I would not have booked but she still refused. VRBO also refused to assist us and lied, saying the contract is available on their page. I checked again, and it is not. We have used VRBO without incident for 20 years. We will never use them again. So beware. They protect the property owner, not the consumer.

name: Sue Thompson
title: VRBO endorses rogue hosts
text: VRBO allow rogue business to operate on their sites as hosts and endorse them promising “ trust and security”, “ VRBO has your back”, “price guarantee”. total rubbish. Host took thousands from me then “cancelled” a booking they never made. I have no holiday and no refund.AND VRBO STILL DO NOTHING. There appears to be no consequences for the host and no support or money back for me. I am truly appalled.I will never use them again and suggests no one else does until they clean up their business.After posting this review I was contacted by VRBO social media team who apologised and sympathised with my position.Funnily enough …… they still have done NOTHING to help me regain my money or find me alternative accommodation. It’s a big con.

name: Nigel
title: DONT STAY AT LUXURY OASIS HOUSE : SPECTACULAR 5 STARS RETREAT IN LAS VEGAS
text: Booked a place in Las Vegas called Luxury Oasis via Vrbo. Place stated views of the strip. True if you had military grade binoculars as this place was 10 miles away! We didn’t stay there. Owner not refunding us anything. Suggest payments should go to Vrbo and when clients pleased with the stay the money is then moved to the owner.

name: Alex
title: Shambolic customer service
text: If I could give this company, zero stars, I would. We booked an apartment through Expedia who used VRBO to source the property. First the property was listed In the wrong location (10km away from listed location) and this was only found out on arrival at the airport. The property was listed falsely on bookingcom and Expedia. When we arrived the appartment was run down and in need of repair. There was an inspection going on as we arrived to the room as the bath had been leaking into a property below.After going through Expedia to be told our complaint needed to be taken up with VRBO themselves. We were given a refund that was arranged by the hotel themselves and not the providers, VRBO then agreed on a further amount of compensation to be credited our account for future holidays, so far it’s been over 40 days and approximately 15 hours on the phone. Majority of that being put on hold. This company falls so short of customer service they should be embarrassed. We have emails to back the issue and hope that it is resolved soon. But for now the situation has been more than frustrating.

name: Miki Heinrich
title: Horrible customer support and host…
text: Horrible customer support and host support! I used to like this company and it went down the hill with horrible support app bugs and overcharging customers and hosts. This company will bankrupt in no time with the way they run business . I used to do 95% business with vrbo now I avoid . The support lies constantly create own rules , lie about waiving cancellation fees so they can  push you to cancel reservations that is agains your cancellation policy and then suspend your 5* listing !

name: Catherine Chen
title: I want to unsubscribe Vrbo
text: I want to unsubscribe Vrbo. Tried numerous time but the unsubscribe link always says "opps, there is error".

name: Riley
title: It’s a scam
text: It’s a scam, they won’t help if there was an issue with the home. The property stole from our safe cause the maintenance or house manager has the override codes. It’s a company that has no standards like hotels or even Airbnb.Don’t use this platform.

name: Lou
title: Suspisciously property I had booked was no longer available
text: I recently booked somewhere and then after a few weeks got a phone call from the company that rented out the property who told me it was no longer availble and offered me another place with a £500 discount. They sent me through a link to this other property directly to my email address. I phoned Vrbo as I thought it seemed suspiscious but all they did was confirm that the link was valid. The person I spoke to did not seem at all bothered by this. To have one property cancelled and offered another one outside of Vrbo is not what i want to do. Hmm, anyway I have cancelled my booking so let's hope that I get my money back soon. I will NOT be using Vrbo again and will definately let others know about this.

name: Barry o connor
title: Booked and paid 1850€ for a camper van…
text: VRBO subsequently contacted me and tried to blame everybody else for their short comings.Ultimately there service was deplorable and it is not good enough to blame the banks when they take 5-7 working days to return funds.Albeit that they said the funds leave their account immediately when the cancellation is enacted, this does not take into account the 1 week my funds were sitting in their account prior to cancellation. Multiply the interest on that by how ever many transactions do not get to completion and you have a lot of interest accruing (2 million properties is advertised).Worth considering (as some companies do) keeping the customers card details only yo secure the boking and then take funds after cancellation period has expired.However, I don't think this is part of the business plan.Regards, Barry.Booked and paid 1850€ for a camper van vacation in Tenerife. Money taken immediately.No confirmation or receipt email which I had to go chasing!Then camper owner won't reply so I get on Chat site (AI bot very frustrating) and eventually vented to agent.Agent says they will offer alternative which they did at nothing less than 3500€!!Cancelled booking then they tell me 5-7 working days for return. Absolutely outrageous and ordering on illegal I imagine (I'm gonna find out through my solicitor).Now I have no chance of a Xmas alternative booking in 5-7 days time and don't have the cash otherwise.Horrible shower of cowboys and I will be going legal for interest payment on my money which they will have held for over 7 days by the time I get it back (I have my doubts as to whether I will get it back)Absolute fly by nights...stay well clear folksIrish guy

name: MIchael Indelicato
title: Why would anyone host with VRBO?
text: Why would anyone host with VRBO? I just removed my listed because as others have said their customer service sucks. Their fee's are higher than other vendors, but the amount of bookings I get from them are far below their competitors.  If you are new to their platform they hold your money for at least 30 days, which is a scam because hosts have real costs to cover. Of course their competitors don't follow this horrible practice.  Not only won't I use them to host but after reading the other reviews I'd never book with them either. Glad to be free from their horrible business practices.

name: Bass Reeves
title: Consumer ALERT
text: Consumer ALERT.  There are no words to explain how I feel about VRBO and this homeowner. Betrayed! Scammed and Ripped Off!...are good starters.  This was supposed to be a Thanksgiving vacation for my family.  I never heard from the owner, and I couldn’t gain access to the property.  This stay should have cost us approximately $2500. *WHICH HAS NOT BEEN RETURNED TO ME. Last minute reservations at hotels cost me over $4000.  VRBO help center-Completely LAME and USELESS!  Their response-“NOT OUR PROBLEM! They used another software on our website for your booking-Good Luck getting your money back!” I WILL NEVER! Use VRBO again!  I recommend the same for ALL CONSUMERS-for your own protection!

name: Sara
title: Disgraceful customer service
text: After 3 previous positive experiences booking via Vrbo my latest booking now confirms why other reviews are so poor. Booked an apartment (Smartflats Midi) in Brussels for myself and children to experience the Christmas markets, wish I hadn’t! I was meant to receive check in details from the host 48 hours in advance, when these were not received and I was unable to contact the host I contacted customer service at Vrbo, initially the agent was understanding and apologetic but unable to do anything, my case was escalated to a manager who refused to refund my money so I could book elsewhere and advised I still had to travel to Brussels, arrive at night with 2 kids and hope by then I had received check in details… absolute disgrace! I won’t be booking via Vrbo again. I eventually got check in details 28 minutes before I was due to check in, however had the host done what they advised (sent them 48 hours before) or Vrbo been more understanding of the situation, they were unable to contact the host as number was unobtainable, I wouldn’t have spent the 24 hours prior to my trip stressing about where my children and I would be sleeping when we arrived in Brussels on our first night. My advice… avoid Vrbo

name: Simon Young
title: Disgusting host support...
text: Disgusting host support...was advised by a Vrbo advisor to offer instant booking but nervous of this. The Vrbo advisor persuaded us saying it was fine to stipulate in the rules that "the guests must have some good feedback". We get an instant booking from someone who has no feedback and writes nothing!! Nervous to accept an anonymous stranger with no feedback, we didn't accept the booking and are now being penalised, with one Vrbo advisor saying they don't call it feedback, so it's not clear to people booking what that means?? Yet the word "feedback" appears on the Vrbo site? No decent explanation and barely an answer to our lengthy  mails....awful experience AVOID dedicated team NOT ...passed from one rep. to another with each one adding to the frustration, because they all say a different thing or don't carry out what they say they're going to...a robot would give better host support 🤖

name: Amber Porras
title: Did a review on VRBO customer service 5…
text: Did a review on VRBO customer service 5 days ago! They said they would email me, but they still haven’t!! Just proving their customer service is horrible!! This is what I will always book with Air B and B from now on!!

name: Dianne Gibson
title: Yikes
text: Yikes, I wanted to book a vrbo for a week, after looking at some if these negative reviews, and there are many, it seems sketchy A.F,, too many horror stories, hard pass..

name: Iza
title: We are very dissatisfied and would not…
text: We are very dissatisfied and would not recommend with them as they confirmed the booking we then booked a flight but after half a hour they cancelled the booking and we are left with tickets as they don't have any properties in the time that we booked the flights for and they said the best they can do is to keep checking the apps to see if they have any to book for the dates that we booked for.

name: Shannon
title: Terrible experience
text: Terrible experience. Booked an apartment in London hours away from home to be ignored by the host all day and eventually had our booking cancelled after waiting around for 2 hours left stranded in a different city. Left out of pocket and with nowhere to stay. Called Vrbo as we needed them to find us somewhere to stay, to be told they were putting us through to someone then being disconnected. Called back and spoke to someone who found the agent we spoke to, and that they would call us back to help us find a solution, but they did not call us back. Had to spend £550 for a hotel on a credit card somewhere else for the night. Been stuck in a car all day and our plans for the evening are ruined. I expected they would have funded us a room for the night or at the very least found us one. Very stressed, tired and unhappy

name: john
title: vrbo sucks
text: 1. vrbo sent me a bill before i had booked.2. the listing was in US$. the bill was in euros.3. the bill shows “1 traveler”, which is correct, but the bill details include a charge for “extra guest”. i checked another listing to see whether vrbo would do the same thing. yep.4. i have to log in multiple times and get sent a code, even though im trying to navigate the same listing.5. i would have given up but for the fact that the host has been super responsive and pleasant.6. airbnb isnt saintly but by comparison vrbo sucks. this will be my first and last experience with vrbo.

name: Clearwater Beach Bunny
title: VRBO seems ripe for scams!
text: vrbo seems like it’s just a ripe platform for scams preying on travelers desperately searching for places reasonably priced! All the response replies in trustpilot from vrbo seem to just be “canned auto responses” not directly regarding the specific customer. I only have exp booking thru Airbnb so I guess I’m spoiled. Airbnb has host profiles listed w/ at the very least a first name. most of the time there’s a photo of & brief bio of the host. Airbnb has a Clear policy of VERIFYING host IDENTITIES & legitimacy BEFORE allowed to list a property. Reviews of Airbnb properties are easy to view & star ratings listed in the title of the listings. But when I searched VRBO I don’t see any reviews, or host profiles connected to the listings? everytime I try to contact a host thru the “contact host” button the app freezes? I finally logged into the desktop site. I found a listing & had questions about the property pre-book. ive sent 3 messages to host over the past 2 weeks & not heard back at all from host!!?!  I don’t feel confident the listing is legit or even a real host?  I also don’t like how vrbo doesn’t show a history of messages I’ve sent in the “messages” section of my account?!  This whole system is very shady. I called vrbo & spoke w/ a cust rep who was very difficult to understand? I wanted to find out if property was listed by a real host & if vrbo verified identity of hosts & legitimate properties? She first told me the host was a real human & the property was using the platform thru a partner site. Then she said the property owner didn’t have a profile bc he still needed to submit tax/financial paperwork to vrbo?  I asked how he was eligible to post a listing if the site hasn’t even verified their identity?  And why does the listing have the option to immediately “book now” if they didn’t have all the tax ppwk required to accept  money from travelers? Other listings have the option of “request to book” which is not immediate so why was this listing immediate booking? she then told me the host was fully verified which is why he could post & she kept giving me different answers about their identity verification process & what the policy was for renters to be protected from scams. She was just saying anything until I received an answer I liked?!  I’m basically just posting this review to warn other travelers about this site! It doesn’t appear they have systems & processes in place to protect travelers? Based on the reviews here I can see that’s true :(  my heart goes out to all the travelers who had a bad experiences. I just want to let ppl know there are “other platforms” you can to book thru, who are trustworthy & make it clear who the hosts are & verifiable identities.  And who make reviews clearly visible & Airbnb has actual host profiles. There’s no way to post a review about a property unless you’ve actually stayed there. That helps to avoid fake reviews.  I’ve had Amazing experiences w/ Airbnb every time , 10 bookings! I’ve also used booking.com & Expedia for vacation rentals (they list more than just hotels!) I’ve also used actual property management companies who specialize in vacation rentals.. you can do searches on google & just do research to verify they are legit. Vrbo doesn’t seem trustworthy or has reliable cust service. Please please be careful & do your homework if you book thru vrbo!!  And trust your instincts, if it doesn’t feel right!

name: Miami Vacation
title: As a host
text: As a host, renting to strangers can be intimidating. While most guests are great, occasionally you encounter a difficult person, and it can quickly turn into a nightmare, with no real support. The customer service experience is incredibly frustrating, you’re passed from one representative to another, with no resolution in sight. It feels like they don’t understand the issue, and each person gives you a different answer. In the end, it’s a complete waste of time, leaving you bitter because they profit from your efforts but don’t provide the protection you need when things go wrong.

name: Vicky Ottenbacher
title: Not getting what is advertised
text: I rented a placed advertising as “ New boutique tiny home on Saluda river Easley SC.The pictures were taken or photo shopped. They showed this cute tiny home with private fire pit and on the river.However when you pull in it is in the Sakura Outdoor Center with Butler Bar, tubing and 15 tiny places plus a crashed bus people live in. This is not any picture shown and until I said anything was not even in the post the type of setting. The owners Nate and Jessica changed the verbiage and pictures. They complained about me asking for address ahead of time but if the post originally said it was in center I would have just google that.Everyone is sucked up to each other no privacy calming environment. Drunk guy to left as I am checking in and trying to unload. This running thru “ my private area” until after midnight. The cabin most part was clean but guess maid was off to change bed sheets, which mattress cover was off, sand and glitter, plus something I will call snot was on sheets. The floor was dirty after a few minutes walking around. Only after arriving on the check in paperwork did it say that there was not stove top or hot plate to cook on, however you have a microwave and air fryer. Next came the barking dog to my right often on thru the night.Next day I get up to go walk my dog and in again what is suppose to me my private area is someone else’s dog off leash and aggressive. name: Ujabule Hoedspruit
title: Think twice before making a booking with Vrbo..
text: We are a small family owned business in South Africa that owns a Bed & Breakfast. As you can imagine, being a small business, we are reliant on each and every client's payments to make ends meet.We have never listed our business with Vrbo, yet we have had an experience with an international client of theirs just showing up on our doorstep, having booked and paid through Vrbo. This happened on a Saturday afternoon.  We scrambled around and made a plan for the client who was now standing on our doorstep, although we did not have a booking for this person. We had to move other bookings around to accommodate him for his "booking" of seven nights. We went out of our way to act professionally, although we could have shown the client away, as we did not have a booking. We later found out that the previous owner who we had bought the business from, had the company listed on Vrbo, so there was a way to book without us knowing about it.This happened in July 2024. We have now, on the 13th November 2024 not yet received payment for this booking of seven nights. This client occupied a room of our B&B for seven nights "for free". The client paid Vrbo, yet we have not been paid. We have spoken to five different agents about the matter and each is less helpful than the previous. One of these agents told us to contact the client and get the money back from him. Can you believe this? You can imagine that not getting paid for a seven night stay, is quite a substantial amount for a B&B that only has five rooms. Vrbo just does not seem to care. No one has contacted us with a solution. They have been in contact with the previous owner who cannot log into his old account. He also had very little assistance in the matter.What bugs us, is the fact that Vrbo got paid for the booking, but we on the ground are the ones out of an income. I cannot help but assume that they have now pocketed the money at the expense of a small business owner. Not one agent of theirs saw the problem through to the end. They just try and get rid of you as quickly as possible, with no end result in sight.We therefore, after more than three months, seem to have to make peace with the fact that we have been done in by this tourism company. We therefore wish to warn potential clients of theirs to rather not make bookings through them, as the small business owner at the end of the value chain, is the one that gets done in. We have come to realise that we are not going to get any assistance from them and that we will probably have to write off the income for that booking.Please think twice before making a booking with them.

Since then Vrbo and the property owner have tried to make it appear as if we had a great stay!  That is so far from the truth it’s laughable.We spent 4 hours on the phone with Vrbo reps trying to fix our issues.  All we got was stone walled.  I don’t know of a single person that would willingly stay in a location that was not clean, maintained or safely accessible.  Let alone one that had a gas leak.We told the “host” all of our concerns and were basically ignored.  When the host said we could cancel and “possibly” get a partial refund that was the final straw.  We told the host we would cancel and be speaking with our CC company about the validity of their listing and lack of refund for misrepresentation of the property.Since that time Vrbo has posted a 4 star review under my name for the place.  We never submitted a review as we were waiting for our CC company to finish it’s review of our request for compensation for funds not returned by Vrbo.  It’s apparent that Vrbo believes in using fraudulent reviews to promote business.  We definitely will never use Vrbo again.

name: Mark
title: Booked villa in Spain
text: Booked villa in Spain, had to seek alternative accommodation after 1 night due to the uncleanliness of the property.Vrbo advised to speak with host direct, which we did, but after no joy, on our return, Vrbo said they couldn’t help as we’d not contacted them whilst at the villa!! Although they push you towards host in first instance!!Review we left for property doesn’t even show on the website, so the reviews can be deleted or edited by host to suit them, which means they are all totally useless and inaccurate.Book through another agent or correct with owners….Vrbo will not help you if you have a problem.06/11/2024Further to the above review, Vrbo have been in touch to advise our review of property is live on the listing. On clicking there link, the review is there…however, it’s has obviously only just been posted as the owners response to our review is dated yesterday (05/11/24)! It’s clear Vrbo do not post reviews until they have shown owner first…so that they can defend themselves, even if their defence is lies.The owner finished his response with a question, although he has the answer to that question in our Whatspp correspondence…along with pictures proving our comments regarding cleanliness. It’s unfortunate that Vrbo do not allow reviews to show pictures….then there would be no lack of clarity regarding comments, and potential customers can see for themselves.We await Vrbo response in regards to the host returning monies paid!

name: Charles Potter
title: Lakefront Cozy Cabin at The Blueberry…
text: Lakefront Cozy Cabin at The Blueberry Farm.  We booked this on a Thursday night. We paid immediately. We were informed that verification could take a day. I thought it was because we booked at night. Next day we get an E-mail we were rejected with no explanation. We will never book with Vrbo again.....Now hopefully there will something else since we lost a day waiting on them.

name: thomas roffey
title: "Appalling Experience
text: "Appalling Experience – Misleading Listings, Intimidating Hosts, and Complete Lack of Support from Vrbo!"Avoid Vrbo at all costs. My colleague’s recent experience was nothing short of disgraceful. The property she rented was far from the glossy photos advertised – it was in dreadful condition, reeking of urine and with no proper key, only a flimsy push-button lock that felt entirely insecure. When she raised these issues with the owner, their response was aggressive and intimidating, leaving her feeling unsafe and ultimately prompting her to leave.However, the worst part was Vrbo’s complete lack of responsibility. For four days now, we’ve been chasing a refund through emails and live chat, only to be met with hollow promises, evasions, and a total failure to take ownership. Not one representative has followed through on what they said they'd do. Vrbo’s customer service is utterly appalling – they simply don’t care, no matter how legitimate the complaint.For anyone considering booking with Vrbo, think twice. They allow property owners to misrepresent listings with impunity and abandon customers who raise valid issues. This experience has shown that Vrbo is unreliable, unsupportive, and frankly, not worth the risk. Take your business elsewhere if you want a safe, dependable booking platform.

name: Tom Miller
title: Vrbo worst company ever for rental…
text: Vrbo worst company ever for rental listing's. Worst customer services! They will not help you with any problems you have had with rentals that you rent thru them. We stayed in a property listed on vrbo and this place was a completely disgusting unsanitary property. The house wasn't cleaned before we arrived. We showed up and called the owner of the property telling him it was left disgusting and unsanitary. He responded he was sorry but the he didn't get cleaners out there until the 3 day we were there. So we had to buy cleaning supplies the first day to do all the cleaning ourselves. We had $400 in out of pocket cleaning products including shop vac and mops and paper towels and disinfected wipes. Pool cleaners showed up on the 3rd day and told us that the pool we had been swimming in for the 2 previous days didn't have a filtering system or pump that worked. And they haven't been out to clean the pool in a month so we were swimming in a unsanitary disgusting pool! We reached out to VRBO and sent in 30 plus pictures and videos of this disgusting property. We also let them know the back doors don't lock so we were staying a property that wasn't safe or secure for our multiple families. Every staff member apologize and said they would never have been able to stay there and the would work to get us refunded. Today marks 6 weeks since we stayed at that property and VRBO contacted us and said they can't give us any type of reimbursement for cleaning supplies or refund for stay due to cleanliness???? Which is absolutely horrible!!! We will be filing legal actions and just submitted all pictures and videos and correspondence from VRBO to the health department! I hope there property get closed down along with VRBO! No body should have to go through this! It's a horrible business practice!

name: PHIL
title: Booked with an excellent owner
text: Booked with an excellent owner, that refunded his portion within a day after the hurricane.  I bought the extra insurance with vrbo in case of cancelation.  It's been about a month And they still owe me 197.00. How that is possible, when I protected myself with insurance is beyond me. And I couldn't even find reviews on Google.  I can absorb the loss... and will never use them again. I'll tell anyone that says they are looking for a vacation place not to use them. I've called 3 times and not going to waste anymore time.

name: Peer Fallin
title: VRBO do not erase your personal data
text: I wanted to try to see what VRBO could offer me as an owner of an apartment, but it was impossible without making an account - easy enough.After the login I could see the had the most hefty fees in the renting business, so I wanted - after 5 min - to delete my account.Unfortunately it was NOT possible on their web site,NO, NO you need to beg in a separate email to have your account deleted - but of course only after a VERY long chat.First I had to ask patiently to have them delete my account, but I only succeeded after several emails.OK, now my account was deleted then....NO not at all as VRBO still retain much of my PERSONAL data.I then asked VRBO to delete ALL my personal data according to GDPR (EU) "Right to be forgotten".This was even harder...many, many emails and questions later I also succeeded with this.I THOUGHT!About 4-5 weeks later VRBO began sending me marketing emails (twice a week) and have no been doing that for 6 month.So "Right to be forgotten" GDPR legislation does not mean much to VRBO.I ended up - in frustration - to contact the Danish Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) with a GDPR complain.The Danish Data Protection Authority received and acknowledged my complain September 16 2024.Please join me in complaining if yo have experienced similar GDPR problems - the fine is hefty...up to 20% of the turn over in VRBO.

name: Sherry Tyler
title: I rented a house located @ 1647 Pike…
text: I rented a house located @ 1647 Pike Falls Jamaica, Vermont. The house was full of Black mold. Holes in walls, mold shoes as decoration on shelf. Mold on ceiling, mold spores on books, caulk board, flyers hanging on the fridge, ect..The smell was strong.I contacted the host and was polite and professional and when I asked for a refund, I am now blocked. The host Cindy Estrada did not want to see any of the photos I took. I am concerned Ms. Estrada will continue to rent 1647 Pikes Fall in Jamaica  Vermont..without proper disposal of mold items, fix walls.This place needs to have an indoor air quality test done. I can not believe not only was my experience unpleasant but rudelytreated by the host. I only hope I can upload pictures.Sherry Tyler

name: Margaret Pinard
title: VRBO customer service
text: We had booked a few homes for a trip to Italy.  One of the homes ended up being a fraud.  The owners (or who we thought to be owners) used our credit card for over $18,000 CAD!  I called VRBO immediately and had numerous conversations on numerous occasions with them.  One time I was told to call the owner to ensure they were legit.  I did cancel the home through VRBO and got our money back excepting there was a large exchange difference.  My complaint is with customer service.  They were not helpful at all.  I asked to speak to a manager but they said a manager would call back.  I never heard from them.  Mysteriously, a generic email came through saying that the home was taken off the site.  I would think at a minimum, an apology would have been given and an offer to pay the exchange difference we lost.  I will not book with them again.UPDATE:  VRBO did send me a message after reading this as they wanted to know more.  Unfortunately all went to junk mail and I just found the messages.

name: John Newell
title: Never had a problem using VRBO until…
text: Never had a problem using VRBO until this year.  After booking a home I was sent an email stating that my reservation was not complete until I sent in a photo of my driver's license or passport. This new policy was never stated prior to paying with my credit card.  I sent an email claiming that this would be a security issue for me. Identity theft is real and I did not want to become another victim.  They already had my address, credit card number and telephone number and now they want a copy of my passport or driver's license?  I decided to cancel the reservation rather than put myself and my family at a security risk.  After cancelling the reservation, they sent me an email indicating that the owner had cancelled the reservation.  An absolute lie.  I wonder how many hosts lose business because of this VRBO policy?  From now on I will use other rental agencies that are more honest and up front about their policies.

name: Mike
title: Bug Infestation and No Help
text: Very unhappy at the moment - found bugs in my bed and left the property immediately. Can't get a refund as of yet, because the owner refuses. VRBO is being no help. I wouldn't book through VRBO again if I got the place for free.

name: Mike G
title: Worst organization to deal with
text: Worst organization to deal with. Tried to list a property and was told it would go live within 72 hours. 3 weeks later and nothing. Call centre is useless and so is chat. Tried to delete listing and even that failed. Went live on Airbnb within 48 hours.?

name: Lisa
title: Just light your money on fire so you don't have to waste time fighting with Vrbo
text: Vrbo booked a room for us at a motel that was actually closed and charged the full amount against my credit card. Because the window for a cancellation refund ended 2 days before I made the reservation (made the reservation 9-28, but the cancellation window closed 9-26), they are refusing to refund any of the amount they charged. Edit - they replied to the above with a suggestion to reach out to customer support, but I have done that with no change so have engaged the help of the BBB. Vrbo has still not removed the charge.

name: e n
title: Worst customer service on the planet
text: This is one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had in my entire life. Basically, verbo rented me a rental that no longer existed, even though the host had made it clear that the rental was to be taken down, no one contacted me about it until I reached out to the host, and it has been several weeks of vrbo telling me they will reimburse me and then ignoring every follow-up I have. Everyone I've spoken to is obviously doing as little as possible to help, I've been passed around to five or six different people at least.

name: Jo
title: Dreadful service and no support
text: Dreadful service and no support. They could not explain how a booking reoccurred the following week from a place I had previously stayed at, and would NEVER stay at again. The only confirmation advice I got was the checking email the day before the supposed reservation. Would not give a refund and then charged me twice. The ‘support’ team and the accommodation just kept blaming each other, but neither bothered to rectify the situation.In response to Vrbos answer I ended up calling them back and discussing the issues. They said I will be refund for the overcharge. As of today the 8/11/2024 I have NOT been refunded

name: Maribel Herrera
title: Double booked, worst host
text: I reserved the house 6 weeks before the date of rental. I received the confirmation and the credit card was charged. I sent an email thru vrbo asking if we can arrive early and didn't get a reply. 5 days before arrival I confirmed the reservation with vrbo. Three days before arrival I spoke to the host asking if we could arrive early and he said the house was booked and people would leave at 11 am on the day our reservation starts. The day of the rental, one hour before check in I asked for the key code becauseI hadn't heard from the host.  The host called saying they were going to be a bit late on letting us into the house. 20 minutes later I get a second call and was informed that we were not able to stay because the  house didn't have power. I received a full refund from the host.  I called vrbo and the agent asked that I take a picture of the property and send it to them.  Upon arrivel at the property I noticed that the garage light was on. I got off the car to take a picture when a vehicle arrived.  I spoke to the gentleman and he informed me they reserved the house through Airbnb in September for 4 nights, arrival Thursday (one day before our reservation was set to begin). During that time I was on the phone with the vrbo agent, who tried finding a place for 10 people to stay.  After more than two hours of looking neither a house nor hotel were available.  We were left stranded without a place to stay.  Essentially our host double booked his house and didn't inform us until 30 minutes after our reservation was set to start.

name: David
title: Awful company
text: We drove 300 miles only to arrive at the property and not be able to get in at 5pm. I phoned the owner who just said she didn't rent it out any more and VRBO were told.I phoned customer services who refunded my money but then my family and dog had nowhere to stay. Their "booking promise" only covers if you rebook through one of their websites. But at 5pm they dont do same-day bookings. No hotels would take the dog so we literally had nowhere to go.We found somewhere nearby on AirBnb and had to book that even though it cost a lot more. Was promised compensation by VRBO but no email came. When I phoned up again they said no as I didn't book through one of their websites, even though that wasn't an option.This is an awful company and I will never use them again.

name: Mickey “PYEZO” Pye
title: GLEN BAR. DERRY, DUNGIVEN ROAD.
text: So having studied in Derry iam a huge fan of how the locals do Halloween. I went for maybe five years even after finishing uni there.My Dad and I love the place so finally we thought let's go for Halloween.We secured a place for two days being the 30th and 31st and had planned to see friends that I remained in contact with ever since.We had a booking for two months plus ( booking on 25th July ) and just yesterday we received a cancellation siting a double booked apartment.How on earth was a double booking allowed to happen in a digital age ??? Surely this shouldn't be able to happen ??? IE through the booking software and platform ?But better still, surely there are bums on seats there ( in their offices ) to double check in case of computer error ?OR ??? Was it simply the case of being offered more money from another party ?We have contacted the booking company and received nothing as yet by way of explanation.We have received our fully paid monies returned but when contacted for an explanation they simply sent the same cancellation email.No means of explanation. No alternative booking. No apologies. No means of compensation for travel arrangements having to be cancelled along with bookings while in the city.Having worked twenty five years in a customer facing role this is a shockingly bad piece of customer service.Disgusting.

name: Mr M Hughes
title: BEWARE
text: BEWARE - left outside property after 18 hours journey not able to get in. Customer service useless and told us to find a hotel, pay for it and get money back? Sounds easy eh? try to get your money back despite emails confirming they would. Promise after promise, and the alternative hotel we had to sort and fund ourselves they were not willing to support! still waiting for a return call/email. Sat in a hotel instead of our booked villa, lost 1 1/2 days of our holiday!

name: Joyce Laituri
title: I made a reservation in July to rent a…
text: I made a reservation in July to rent a unit in September. VRBO charged me in full and never sent a confirmation from VRBO, although I was issued a reservation number at the time of booking.  Several days later I started calling them (on hold for HOURS) and they never found my reservation or confirmation in their system even though I had an Itinerary ID and Reservation number from when I initially booked. There was no reservation in their system. I have been communicating with their resolution group to no avail. They are truly dishonest in my opinion. Be cautious, they will take your money and not provide you the service you pay for. Go to Airbnb instead.

name: T Moores
title: We arrived and the place was nasty. Beyond gross.
text: We arrived and the place was nasty. The smell of cigarette smoke and air freshener was horrible. The entire condo was nasty. Dirty comforters, sheets, toilets, mold and mildew. Dirty band-aid and dental floss stuck to the wall. I could go on and on.Because it was late, and we had a dog it was not possible to find another place to stay. We washed the bed sheets and comforter and stayed one night and left early the next morning. vrbo would only refund $320.00 of the $752.64 for a 4-night stay and we stayed only one night. On the phone call the next morning they led me to believe they were going to refund all of my money. Beware vrbo is not a good choice.

name: Ethics
title: Not worth the money
text: It was a bait and switch experience and not worth the final price.VRBO has excellent customer service people, but the platform is faulty.  The price you are enticed with is NOT the price you will pay to book the place.  So instead of paying $112 a night, you will pay $335 a night which is way more than a hotel.  Also there is no guarantee that you will get what you pay for.For whatever reason, VRBO is NOT the platform it used to be and I will never use them again.

name: Amber Bant
title: Still waiting !!!
text: When we arrived we found, the apartment wasn't for rent, host tel nr disconnected, Host company not registered with KvK. DUE DILIGENCE svbo?!!! After acknowledgement of the issue svbo pledged that they would refund EUR 3900 on 5/6/24..we are still waiting!!! Special thanks to Olivier, Gabrielle, Jesse from vrbo support 4 trying 2 solve the issue.

name: Michael Martin
title: I will not use VRBO again
text: I will not use VRBO again. Though I've used this company for more than 15 years when I had an issue with a recent VRBO rental because it was dirty and the refrigerator and freezer were full, VRBO never responded to me though I was told by the VRBO representative that I spoke with on the phone to report the matter that she could not help me but a VRBO representative would contact me regarding the matter. I was never contacted. I was never contacted by anyone with VRBO. After I disputed the charge because I had to obtain a second VRBO last minute and stay in a hotel a couple of nights, VRBO claimed that I did not cancel the stay. I did so and the VRBO host informed me by phone that she would not charge me for the stay. Yet VRBO did so. NO customer service. STAY AWAY.G. Martin

name: Floris Ruys
title: Terrible organisation
text: Terrible website and really bad that bookings are made instantaneously without approval from the host. This was not clearly communicated and has now led to me having to do a cancellation to a request I never approved (due to the property not being available), and me being stuck with a 25% cancellation fee. Will be sticking to AirBnB!

name: EDDPM
title: Unreliable Service wHigh Fees and Frequent App Glitches
text: This company consistently changes its policies and imposes excessive fees. I strongly advise against using them for hosting or booking services. Their customer service is unreliable, often withholding or misrepresenting critical information when interacting with hosts. Additionally, their app is prone to frequent glitches, especially during critical moments like guest check-ins, making it highly frustrating to use. It seems they have little regard for the well-being of either guests or hosts. Their policies have become overly restrictive, and they frequently suspend or delete listings for reasons that seem unreasonable. Proceed with caution, as their practices feel increasingly exploitative.

name: TE
title: Avoid!
text: This company continues to to change their policies and continues to raise and charge outrageous fees. DO NOT use this company for hosting or booking.

name: Cody Zey
title: Horrible horrible customer service if I…
text: Horrible horrible customer service if I was able to give a 0 star I would. Charged me 70 dollars because I had to cancel a booking due to flood damage so now I have to pay for water damage on top of a 70 dollar Bs charge for something I had no control over.

name: AA Aa
title: SCAMMED ME
text: SCAMMED ME, for £189 they booked us in the wrong day we appealed it with our bank they won disputes so we lost our money. They didn’t even offer us a different date the only holiday week afford as a countries in a crisis right now, our money was taken. We have no more money left my poor children.

name: Eddie Ranch
title: Horrendous, glitchy platform
text: What a horrendous platform Vrbo is. A booking inquiry has now blocked by Thanksgiving weekend calendar for 3 weeks even though a booking was never confirmed by me or the guest. The inquiry says the I have negative 341 hours to respond and the hours keep going up. Customer service after much hold time says it's been "escalated" but that was 2 weeks ago. Meanwhile I lose out on critical revenue for a holiday weekend. Congrats VRBO you just helped make me a 100% exclusive AirBnB host for my 3 rental properties.

name: David Y
title: Bribes allowed to remove reviews?!
text: I was searching for a place in Waikiki and notice one place which had a low rating an issue with a non-working refrigerator. After searching other possible rental locations, I returned to the Waikiki house and was surprised that the low rating review was eliminated and the rating score went back up. Okay, so now VRBO is allowing some reviews to be removed with bribes from the owners?! Hmm, it's not like Yelp, which supposedly does not allow reviews to be removed no matter how bad it may be.

name: J G
title: Really bad. Host never showed & refund only given when bad review taken down
text: Just awful. Had zero response from the booking host for checking in, trying to contact multiple times 48hrs before arrival. Resulted in being stranded in Bergamo, Italy on a Champions League night. Vrbo support were good on the phone but I had to disconnect them in order to find another hotel, ending up paying hundreds of pounds. Took over a month to get a refund which I was only given on the condition that I'd remove a legit review of the bad property. I had to chase Vrbo four times in order to get this refund. For some reason I was put on the 3-way phone call by Vrbo with the host that lasted 30+ minutes where the review demand was made. I could hear the conversation between Vrbo and the host but couldn't contribute myself as I was muted - very bizarre.

name: Christine
title: SCAMMMM!!!!!!
text: SCAMMMM!!!!!!Apartment fake advertisement! I booked it for 6 nights - host never send check in details. The two contact numbers provided are fake!!Vbro website don't vet their hosts and don't provide any support.They left me and my 9 month old baby on the street with no compensation, refused to book me another property - its pouring rain, I have travelled 3 hours to be let down by these summers!!!The customer support told me that they will look for a property via Expedia - when I asked why not using their own website - she didn't know what to say as they are all scams!DONT BOOK WASTE OF MONEY AND ONLY HEADACHES

name: Eoin Laird
title: Host charged me 500 euro cleaning fee…
text: Host charged me 500 euro cleaning fee after we checked out. Clearly far more than any cleaning could have cost them, Vrbo did absolutely nothing to help. I won't be using Vrbo or any associated companies again.

name: L C
title: WON'T LET YOU USE REWARDS POINTS, SO WHY BOTHER?
text: I, too, am disillusioned at what is happening with VRBO.  First, to even CHAT with someone has been made very difficult to find.  Second, don't book with the intentions of using the points they "award".  Twice I've booked trips that didn't have a place to apply the rewards, but we needed or wanted the place for specific reasons.  Now I have points expiring that won't be usable after just 15 months (we can't travel terribly often) and NOW I'm being told "not all units will allow you to use One Key cash rewards"... and they won't apply them, extend them or allow you to have them applied to your credit card charge after the fact.  SO... DON'T USE THEM BECAUSE OF POINTS AND THEIR CUSTOMER SERVICE HAS REALLY GONE DOWN HILL.  I won't book through VRBO ever again, I can promise you that!  In fact, I'm filing a consumer complaint and looking to start a class-action lawsuit if anyone is interested!

name: Freya Kaye
title: Awful. AVOID. Scammers!
text: Awful. Scamming company. They list properties that are fake/scams. I booked my property 12 months in advance through Expedia - somehow the booking was moved in these twelve months to Vrbo. No way to contact them. The host refused to send any check in information when I messaged him and he told me it would be given between 2 and 3pm on the day of check in. In London, 1 hr is simply not enough time to get anywhere. Making it extremely stressful as we had to leave again at 4pm to get to the concert on time. The man ‘Cooley’ finally responded with a phone call after I messaged him repeatedly and called him, to tell us that we couldn’t have our property because there was some kind of plumbing problem. (I booked in early July 23, and since then there have been similar reviews where people have also been scammed). He told us they were moving us somewhere else.We were sent to an area which we hadn’t researched, that did not seem as safe as the area we had deliberately, with lots of men loitering in the streets, leering at us. We are a group of four women. This new apartment is 1 bedroom and what we had originally booked was two bedroom. When speaking to the man on the phone, he was extremely aggressive and threatening. He threatened to cancel our booking when I complained that we had booked and paid for a 2 bedroom apartment and now we were in an apartment with 1 bedroom and two small ‘sofas’. He made everyone feel extremely unsafe and uncomfortable.AVOID AVOID AVOID.

name: Fran & Colin
title: No Refunds on international travel is VBRO policy
text: Refund policy designed to fail:We are due a refund from a 4 night stay in Romania where the host never provided access to the unit.(scam?)  VBRO's policy states"Your bank account’s currency type must match the transfer’s currency type. Mismatched currencies cannot be transferred."This means that to access a refund you are required to have bank account in a different currency than your home county. VBRO refuses to reimburse the credit card that we paid with and insists it must be a bank account in the currency of their choosing. ( our bank would gladly do the conversion but VBRO insists that the account MUST be in the other currency). Moreover the account had to have been in operation at the time of travel. This feel like a  fraud to me. So you need to have a bank account in the currency of each county you travel to or VBRO will not process refunds.

name: George Donnachie
title: Where’s the refund?
text: We booked a villa in Siesta Key Florida for October this year however the property flooded due to the recent hurricane and the owner cancelled the booking. He assured me that the refund would be processed ASAP however I am still waiting for a refund. He has told VRBO that he has already refunded me which is not true. I get a real bad feeling about this. Thankfully I should be covered by my credit card company but it looks like I will be out of pocket for $8.5k for a while before this is sorted.Please take my advice, do not use VRBO

name: Steve
title: Pet charges and cleaning fees
text: Houses are nice and very easy to use and book . Cleaning is expensive and expect you to clean before you leave even though cleaning charge . Pet allowance means they will charge you for a pet even though does not say extra charge! Definitely would be nice if explain both of these on site .

name: Yugi
title: booking not work and there is 0 support.
text: booking not work and there is 0 support.

name: Mike Kimball
title: VRBO stole our money
text: I have used VRBO for many years with good success.  This last time we booked on the beach in Fla.  When hurricane Milton approached we canceled.  Now VRBO and vacasa are not refunding our money even in a hurricane.  This was last time I will use them.  Thye have lost me as a customer

name: FJM
title: Poor Customer Service with No Resolution
text: I requested a change to my booking to ADD an extra night. The host had agreed to this with no issue. I requested the change through VRBO. Instead of modifying our booking VRBO cancelled it instead and took 50% of my money. The host contacted me when they noticed this and contacted me immediately. I rang VRBO to rectify their mistake, but they refuse to acknowledge that it is their mistake. VRBO was unable to help me with this issue at all.

name: Susanne R
title: I felt compelled to write this
text: I felt compelled to write this. honestly gives me no joy but the way they operate the customer support I think might be actually fraudulent. if you have a problem with your stay they are no help.

name: Ex-Petflow Customer
title: They rented to us in a hurricane impact area - Two Payment Systems
text: DO YOU KNOW THAT Vrbo only takes their portion of the fees, the rest of what you pay goes through some other app and Vrbo has no access to your funds. You can't get a refund unless the owner does it. You find that out after the fact.1) Owner said construction in the area. Some days just trucks but it ends at 4:00 PM.  They added pictures to their listing after we rented it and paid. The pictures we not at all accurate. Construction noise was ridiculous and still going on at 5:30 PM.2) Port-a-pots for construction workers directly under the deck/lanai. Nice to see workers going in and out.3) No internet4) no TV5) Hurricane Helene hit and they had a 5 ft storm surge 2 weeks prior.  Beach closed, beach road closed due to hurricane. Everything in the area was still a mess and very little human life present except clean up workers during the day.6) Electric went out around 6:30 - 7 PM. No timing as to when it would come on. Pitch black all around the building.7) Patio furniture piled up in the small living room that we had to move.8) Arrived and breakers were off for AC, fridge, stove, etc.9) Owner could not change the code on the lock because no internet and electric issues.10) We arrived around 1 PM and left/checked out (if you will) at 7:30 PM same day.This unit in a location after a major hurricane with a storm surge should NOT be available to rent. We were lied to and ripped off. How hard up are you as a human to lie for a few bucks?  We will not rest until we have a full refund.

name: Kyle Wong
title: I have been an avid user of Expedia and now this.
text: I have been an avid user of Expedia in the past 6-7 years. I booked stays on Expedia for a trip coming up soon and it directed me to VRBO. As I have used AirBnB in the past, I figured it was the same. I booked 2 months in advance for my trip. 3 days before I was slated to leave for my 16 day trip, they cancelled my reservation. The VRBO owner stated that VRBO cancelled due to an unsafe living environment because of fire extinguisher issues. This was an amazing villa and we were excited. VRBO refunded me the money but this did not solve the problem I was about to have.Their customer service (Manar being the associate on the phone with me) tried her best to find me another place but for my asks and what we had booked, seemed like there wasn't anything that met our expectations as a family of 4. I had to push her hard to get me on the phone with her Supervisor - Menna. She said that they will open up an investigation and it will be resolved in the next 3 days.I was leaving in 3 days! I then asked her, if the investigation did not solve my problem and they could not find a place that we were happy with, what then? She essentially agreed with me that I would be stuck without a place. I just said thank you to her and said I will look elsewhere then. No effort in trying to provide great customer service.Now this isn't a comment on Menna or Manar - I know they were just trying to do their jobs but speaks volumes as to the lack of care VRBO/Expedia has for keeping your business.I am now scrambling to find a hotel instead so this does not happen to us. For such a large organization, how could you tell me 3 days before I am leaving, that my stay is cancelled. I am going to use Google from now on for my trips or Airbnb.

title: VRBO has terrible customer service for…
text: VRBO has terrible customer service for their hosts. I was given an unmerited bad review by a customer and when I asked VRBO, what can I do, they said you have to get the customer to take the review away. After talking with the customer, she took her time to call VRBO and ask for her review to be removed. VRBO assured me the review would never be posted because of this and then they posted it anyway. I’ve called six times to try to resolve this situation and every time they assure me they will “expedite it” and nothing is done. They’ve told me each  time they had either taken it off or were taking it off and never did it. I’ve made six phone calls and the last one to the customer service rep Jordan , I was pretty upset because he said he would “elevate” the situation which I’ve been told for the last five weeks. When I asked himwhy I should trust him when they’d been lying to me for a month, he told me he wasn’t going to help me because I cut him off and hung up on me. Obviously, a bad review can wreck your ability to get future rents, and since the renter was nice enough to realize she had been hasty and asked them to remove it and VRBO still did nothing about it, they clearly don’t care about their customers or their hosts. Customers are getting pickier and pickier about everything and will give you a bad review if a battery dies in the channel changer so I need to know that VRBO is on my side and I don’t feel that way at all. I feel helpless and we are seriously debating on wether or not we should just give up and put our listing on Airbnb where we’ve gotten better customer service . title: Violation of Book with Confidence Policy
text: I booked a 4-bedroom house 4 months in advance of my trip. 48 hours before the trip, the property manager messaged to cancel the reservation because he did not have the proper rental permit. They first gave me $2,000 in OneKey Points. However, zero properties in the area accepted OneKeyPoints as a method of payment (completely fake money). I escalated, and was told I could re-book a similar property up to 150% of the cancelled reservation. They could not help me re-book, so I had to do it myself. The only equivalent property I could find 48 hours out was $200 more, had half of the amenities of the other property, cost $700 to heat the pool, and a less desirable location for us. VRBO is now contesting that they owe me $200. This was a gross violation of their Book with Confidence policy, and a terrible consumer experience.

name: Wayne Zabel

text: Filthy property and absolutely no effort to remedy the situation.  Included black and pink mold, dust, overgrown vines growing across the stairwell to the backyard patio.
