name: Mushtaq Ahmed
title: Terrible experience
text: Terrible experience. Will never book again with this scam company

name: J Crawford
title: VRBO not paying us
text: First, let me just say that we have rented through VRBO several times and I’ve always had very pleasant And favorable experiences.But the negative score I’m giving now happens to be as owners of a shore property that we rent through VRBO.The problem was not initially VRBO‘s fault but the resolution over probably six months has proven impossible because of VRBO.Our property has rented through VRBO going back ten months and we have still not received a dollar from them. So we will be ending our relationship with them as property owners.I’m writing this with the hope that someone from Vrbo might actually see this and correct this problem.The initial problem had to do with our W9 and the property being an LLC. Their tax department caught that it was a LLC property and they asked for the LLC documentation. When we submitted the LLC registration paperwork which we received from the federal government the Feds had accidentally omitted the last of four digits of the LLC address (330 instead of 3300). Even our attorney who filed the paperwork did not catch that. Neither did we.Our attorney quickly sent a letter to the feds asking them to correct this and we include that back to Vrbo asking if they could then forward us our withheld money. No response. Approx four months ago, we received the LLC filing paperwork from the Federal government with the correct LLC address.Once again, we forwarded this on to VRBO asking if they could NOW pay us for rentals that have gone back now ten months. Still no response from VRBO.My wife and I together have called nine or 10 times and have submitted the email request to them for dispersement of our money 7-8 times.   But even after a thread of emails back-and-forth with VRBO to resolve this, then the emails back to us just stop.So we have been emailing them and calling them. You can never just be transferred to a supervisor. You have to tell the whole series of events to an entry level agent. They have to place you on hold and come back after verifying and reverifyinh and ask you a few more questions two or three times but eventually about 50 minutes later, you get a supervisor.Most recently the supervisor from the Philippines when she came on the phone with me I asked her that if we got disconnected if she could take my cell phone number and return my call. She assured me that she would. She verified my number. Then Within 20 seconds the call was dropped. She never returned the call to me.Each phone call probably ends up being an hour and a half for us.We have probably invested 30 hours into this and have never been paid by VRBO for any of our rentals.As I stated, in the beginning, the initial problem was not caused by Vrbo. But as with any large corporation with many layers, if there is just one glitch, in our electronic world and the resolution capabilities of larger corporations, it’s very hard to remedy situations.Going forward, we will likely still rent as renters with VRBO. But we will be withdrawing as property owners.

name: Charles XYZ
title: Booked a hotel in Venice
text: Booked a hotel in Venice. When we arrived, hotel says there are no more rooms, and canceled our reservation. Left us hanging in the streets at night looking for any available hotel rooms, which there weren't much selections.

name: TAMMY CARTER
title: PAOLI INDIANA HISTORIC LIBRARY
text: We rented the historic library in Paoli Indiana.  The “host” was terrible and the property was a joke. The French door was unlocked when we arrived, we locked it but it was so rickety it could be pushed/pulled in, the bathroom had a moldy shower curtain and peeling paint.  I booked 5 days and stayed 1 because I feared for my safety, I could not shower for fear of catching some germs from the horse through tub that you had to step up on a step ladder to step down into, bad for safety. The building looks abandoned and the key is kept outside under a rock.  The lady that owns it lives in Alaska and was disrespectful and rude when I told her how unhappy I was and that I was leaving early. For 1 night I had to pay $260 because she said Vrbo had to give me the remaining money back when come to find out it was her. Both her and Vrbo are a joke, I will never do it again.

name: AJ
title: Not to be trusted
text: Not to be trusted! Recently stayed at villa San Marino near Alvor, Portugal and unfortunately I left behind my son’s wallets in a drawer. I contacted the rep as soon as we got to the airport and realised. They kindly said they would arrange postage which I paid for, but when the wallets arrived, the money that had been in them was gone. When challenged, they just blamed the postal service for stealing it.The villa was lovely, a little shabby round the edges but still enjoyable. We had issues with the electric gates which they said they would send someone to fix but they never turned up - it was just luck if we got in and out! The external blinds also didn’t work on living room and bedroom doors but when we raised it, they simply said that they wouldn’t be able to find anyone to fix it so we would just have to leave them down and not use those doors.Would not trust again.

name: VUC
title: Rubbish Dartmouth rental -Avoid
text: We spent one week at this VRBO rental, The First Officer's Quarters in Dartmouth and wish we had never seen or heard of the place. It was misrepresented in terms of the property and its facilities and the owners eventually just ignored or disregarded my complaints. The property was covered front and back with scaffolding so we suffered noise from 7.30 onwards. It was claimed to have a dishwasher, an office, a balcony and a “garden” when it did not. The building is old but the apartment is a poor quality conversion with 30% of it being a modern flat roofed extension. It has no old world charm or *History meeting convenience” at all. It smells of damp is overwhelming and there is an ineffective dehumidifier. There is a severe noise problem every night between midnight and 2am. There is no dining area, fireplace, or basic equipment as advertised.  Finding the house was not easy because of a lack of signage and gaining entry was difficult. The hall was dirty with debris from outside as well as other rubbish being left and not removed during our stay. The pre-arrival cleaning was poor leaving a dirty floor, hob, work surfaces, window ledges, lamps, and other surfaces. Additional cleans did not happen. The corner of the bathroom that has a mini sink is laughable. I am of average height and build but it is impossible to brush one’s teeth, shave, wash etc without hitting the heated radiator (which you have to keep on the deal with the damp) or the wall or spilling water on the floor. We are forced to use the sink in the kitchen. There was noise from the apartment upstairs everyday. We think this is caused by children as it ceased after 8pm. If children are not allowed in this let why does at least one other apartment admit them? The host imposed a derisory compensation via GUESTHOO after a lengthy exchange of emails which only added insult to injury. We did not agree the compensation and he failed to answer my further communications. If you want to enjoy your holiday find another property do not book via W Asbury! Dartmouth and the South Hams is a wonderful area but this let will only detract from your holiday experience.Their response below offers nothing new. I have been through every stage and they did not resolve anything.

name: Stuart P
title: Useless at dealing with a serious…
text: Useless at dealing with a serious problem.Took no responsibility for providing a villa beside a building site.It is just a platform to book through. It does not offer any support. Just takes their cut and says sorry not our problem.

name: andy johnson
title: Do not trust this company with your…
text: Do not trust this company with your money! Still awaiting refund of my “fully refundable deposit. The property owner blames VRBO , VRBO blames the property owner - each repeatedly telling me to take it up with the owner. Neither offering resolution - both a wall of silence. Do not expect there to be bedding or towels at the property you are visiting - even if there is nothing on the website to suggest this will be the case ( it was for me) Do not be surprised if your arrival instructions arrive late - after you have left home and reveal for the first time that you need to pay € 2000 cash deposit on arrival - even if that was not mentioned on the website - and when for safeties sake you pay on a credit card to VRBO do not be surprised when you have to wrestle with the host to get some of your money back but are left losing 10% to VRBO. name: Nancy Broyles
title: I booked a trip to Hawaii for a group…
text: I booked a trip to Hawaii for a group of 6. It was confirmed and I paid the deposit. A few days later, I asked to add two more days. name: KenM
title: Blue Skies* Riverside Middlesborough
text: Booked to stay in what was called a tranquil holiday let.  Not knowing much about the area we saw the pictures and it looked reasonable and clean.However on arrival it was found to have and overgrown front and back garden full of weeds, litter and cigarette butts. The dishes and pans provided were dirty, the windows had not been cleaned in ages.  A rudimentary wipe over was all that had been done prior to our arrival.We complained and managed to have someone hack the lawns and clean the windows, the hob stayed dirty we cleaned this, the hair in the upstairs basin plughole remained, there was no means to clean bathrooms as no cleaning products or cloths provided.The area is littered with thrown away take-a-way food and wrappers . Located close to a motorway so constant traffic noise.  Luckily we couldn't get out fast enough in the mornings.  Only stayed here as previous booking by same agency stated owners had over booked and did not bother to inform us until we contacted them.If you like to holiday on what seems a dirty unkempt council estate then fine, sorry maybe I'm a snob but this is definitely not a holiday home

name: Tracy H
title: St Martin Pelican Key
text: We recently booked a villa in St Martin through Vrbo.  I had no issues with the reservation or payment.We arrived in St Martin on a Saturday.  It was a long travel day and very hot.  Addresses are a little hard to read, but we finally found the villa.  If you are driving up the hill its easier to back in, if you are coming from the other way its easier to drive straight in.  The roads there aren’t all paved like we are used to in the USA.  There are a lot of potholes.  There were some at the entrance to the villa and one of our cars got a flat tire.  Michael offered to have someone fix it, but the car rental agency came out and gave us a different car.When we got inside it was really hot.  The air conditioners had not been turned on prior to our arrival.  The normal hostess on the island was not there and her family member was supposed to come over to start them, but got called in to work.  We were really cranky by this point in the heat.  The master bathroom was like a sauna.  My husband’s head was soaked with sweat after using the bathroom.  We ended up taking showers in the other bathroom instead.The master bathroom has a steam shower.  My husband could not fit in it and had to use the other shower.  It was hard to get cold water and the bathroom itself was so hot.  There isn’t any air vents in there and it was too hot to try to open any windows.  The lady that came over found a small fan that we put in there, but it didn’t help all that much.  She also found me a stool because I am so short I couldn’t get up on the bed, lol.  The switches for some of the lights in the master are behind the headboard.  I did have a hard time getting to them with my t-rex arms.  Yep, really short woman and a really tall man.The tub in the master is only a tub, the jacuzzi doesn’t work.  I wouldn’t have been able to go in there anyway.  It was just too hot for me.The master bedroom is very nice.  They have rolling down shutters that are awesome and it’s a great view.  We left them closed most of the time to keep our room cool.  The first night we were laying in bed and I turned over to go to sleep and heard a big “crack”.  I looked under the bed and a piece had broken.  My husband is a big guy.  I am not tiny either.  We didn’t want to sleep in there that night because we didn’t want the bed to break more if we turned over in the night.  We slept on the couch.  It wasn’t overly comfortable, but once the bed was fixed it was great for me.  I liked it better than my bed at home and we have a tempur-pedic.Michael sent someone the next day to fix the bed and the potholes in the driveway.  We had a little bit of a language barrier, but we figured it out and it was all fixed.The next day I went to make breakfast and the stove would not turn on and the light above the dining table kept flickering.  Michael sent someone out and they started the gas for the stove and tried to fix the light.There is a pool guy that comes to clean, but we didn’t see them and there are no pool floats or noodles for the pool so you will have to bring some or buy them on the island.  We did see a place that had noodles for $5 each.The island had some kind of power issue and in some sections that lasted for hours.  He has a generator that kept the power on the whole time.  We didn’t experience any black outs and that was fantastic!  Without it I think our vacation would have been terrible.The outdoor patio in the back is beautiful.   A large set up for the whole family and more.  It was nice to sit outside and just look at the ocean.  We also got to see some of the cruise ships come in.  The view of the ocean is fantastic!  It’s so beautiful.  I loved sitting on the patio when it rained too.  I could read and listen to the weather.  Loved it.After we were there for a few days we noticed that many places do not have air conditioning, so if you are not used to that get prepared.  That made it even nicer to go back to the villa for some cool air.The TV set up is pretty cool.  They have all the apps and surround sound.  We watched Family Feud while we played Scattagories.  (we brought our own games)We didn’t have any issues with the other rooms.  If you like it cooler take the room in the back.  The air comes right down onto the bed.  We never had any coolers freeze up like some of the other reviews.  There isn’t a pool table even though its in the pictures.  Be sure to read the description too.It is very private.  We hardly even saw anyone on the roads to get there.  The trash isn’t too far, but its down a hill, maybe 3 houses away, but I had to come back up the hill to get back.  My asthma didn’t like it and I had to take a break.  We drove the trash down there after that.I loved loved loved the kitchen.  I would love that huge cooktop.  I am jealous. I also had to use the step stool in there because I could only reach the bottom shelf on the cabinets.  HAHA!!After a few days the whole place was cooler. Overall we had a good time and no issues with Vrbo.

name: Shay Art
title: Disappointing Customer Service Experience – No Resolution for Uncomfortable Stay
text: I booked a $2,000/week rental through VRBO that turned out to have no air conditioning, which made the house stuffy and uncomfortable. When I reached out to VRBO for help, they simply referred me back to the owner, who refused to speak with me and stated she would not issue a refund under any circumstances. VRBO did nothing to resolve the situation because they said the owner didn’t list AC as an amenity, leaving me frustrated and dissatisfied. It’s very disappointing that VRBO does not ensure basic comfort or better support for renters in these situations. I expected more from such a large platform.

name: Mrs. ANGELA ASOMANING
title: We stayed at a property in les sables…
text: We stayed at a property in les sables vignier on isle de l'oron. The weather was exceptionally cold for September, even campers were leaving to go home. There were instructions in the welcome pack on how to use the heating. It was by a remote control, but it failed to work. My husband tried to turn the boiler on by just pressing the on button, but still this did not work. We had to sleep in our clothes. Lack of extra throws in the house to keep warm, we are both nearly 70 yrs old.The house was very uncomfortable. No guest comforts, tiny, lumpy pillows. Plastic mattress cover, crinkly and cold. We had to take our own bedding covers.There was no Wfi. Garden was full of weeds, no flowers.Now the host is charging us 300euros for oressing the on button on his boiler! Claiming we broke it!My husband has previously installed central heating systems and knows what he is doing.I feel in view of my negative review on the property, this charge is in retaliation.I have received several nasty, sarcastic emails since, from the owner.The site VRBO is just going to take the 300euros from my account, from my bank card l used to pay for the holiday.I have tried complaining to them but to no avail.

name: Sunny Nunan
title: Vrbo has 100k+ ONE STAR REVIEWS and now our family knows why
text: First, I am the CEO of a company and I travel all over the US for work, and the world. I am not an idiot. I know how to book travel. I've used Vrbo once several years ago and no issue. I frequently use Airbnb and we have NEVER had an issue. This experience however, with Vrbo, is both shocking and disgraceful.Vrbo is a well known brand. And not a new player. I would never have THOUGHT I NEEDED TO LOOK AT REVIEWS (they are owned by Expedia FFS!!!) before doing business with this company but after this experience, I am now aware of the well over 100,000 1 star reviews on Google Reviews, Trustpilot, Consumer Affairs etc. that have now convinced me that they make a decision every day they go to work, to screw their customers.The very simple story is this. We booked a house for vacation over Christmas for our family and friends, the nightly amount was listed clearly, we paid the amount and VRBO TOOK OUR PAYMENT. We booked our airfare, rental cars, started looking at lift tickets only to get a message that "the booking meant to have a 10% discount but it was a 100% discount in error." so now we owe $7,500 for a very basic house. First of all, that is NOT TRUE. There was no "discount" anywhere on the listing, just the nightly rate. While the amount looked like a good deal, it was a tad below other homes in the area but there was NOTHING that would have raised a red flag that we were getting something - a VERY BASIC house for $7,500 in SANDPOINT IDAHO.It looks as if the homeowner is new to Vrbo so likely their mistake. And I understand mistakes happen. But it's how you handle them that makes all the difference and the homeowners response was to lie and Vrbo was right there justifying it and NOT taking care of us in light of the expenses we incurred after booking so we could get airfare as low as possible by booking right away.My experience with their reps who are very hard to understand was riddled with repeated attempts to justify their unwillingness to protect the customer and then asking me for proof that our card was charged which of course they could see that on the back end. They tried to say that because they refunded us they are off the hook AFTER WE PURCHASED AIRFARE. If the booking is not confirmed then why are they charging our card?I asked repeatedly to talk with Managers, they refused. One desk after another with people with no authority to DO THE RIGHT THING.None of this is ok. The hundreds of thousands of customers that Vrbo has SCREWED deserve better. Reddit is also full of nightmare stories like ours.Beyond disgusted. DO NOT BOOK VRBO. Read the reviews. You will be stunned.

name: Edward Awonaike
title: Highly Unprofessional VRBO STR platform…
text: VRBO is a short-term rental platform serving as a broker between Hosts and Travelers. VRBO collected commisions and placed a guest "Cecilia Ceira" to our property in Dallas.The guest checked in and decided to host an unauthorized party and event on our property despite these activities being prohibited on the VRBO platform and our Rental Agreement. The guest, "Cecilia Ceira" brought unauthorized guests to the house to host an all-night party that was a significant disruption to our neighbors. VRBO was notified and they call the guests to reduce the activities. The guests then proceeded to dispute the charges claiming they did not stay at the residence despite mountains of evidence on the VRBO inbox chatting platform and deducted this money from my checking account. Hosts should never have to bear the brunt of dubious clients/guests that should have been vetted by VRBO.VRBO staff should review their internal system for information about stays before distracting hosts. I have placed numerous calls to VRBO to have them review their own documentation and refund my money but the staff are so unprofessional and highly incompetent.The guest even texted about forgetting stuff at my house prior to now disputing and filing a chargeback to their credit card.Hosts on VRBO should note that VRBO is only in the business to collect commissions and will not step inThis is very unfair to VRBO hosts.Will be considering my options and do not recommend VRBO to any hostsRegards,Edward

name: Steve
title: Beware of Revenge! (and inflated reviews)
text: Remember when eBay was full of “revenge reviews”? It appears VRBO have learnt nothing from eBay’s experience.The one star here is for the agent who dealt with me. She did her best, but VRBO seem to have a self-limiting response to what they are willing to do when there’s an issue.I think you should always judge a company on what happens when things go wrong. That’s the test of how good they are.In this case, it’s a fail. Ungraded.Basically, on holiday the house next door to where we were staying turned into a building site.(In Dolus d’Oleron, France, in case you were wondering. Private heated pool. Easy to find.)We collected all the evidence; videos, photographs, sound files, and crucially, text exchanges with the owner of the property where we were staying.It was clear from that communication that the property owner didn’t much care about our holiday. It was that failure to communicate adequately that led me to leave a mediocre review of the property on VRBO. Within an hour (!) of my review going live I received notification that the owner had left an equally mediocre review of me as a holidaymaker, visible to other owners.Naturally I complained to VRBO, tooled up with all the evidence.VRBO said I needed to “negotiate with the owner” regarding a change to the reviews and that they couldn’t alter or remove reviews no matter what evidence was provided.In other words, “If you lie in your review, he’ll tell the truth in his.”I refused, but pound to a penny other holidaymakers cave in and leave more favourable reviews than the property and owner deserve.So, beware of that when you’re reading reviews on VRBO. You may be reading only the cream of reviews, while other less favourable, but more honest, reviews have been removed or edited.VRBO charge you about 15% on top of rental. For that they host a decent, (if at times confusing), website but hit a problem, you’re stuffed. You’re on your own regardless of any evidence you’ve collected, or indeed provided to VRBO.This experience has left me wondering if that “security” of booking through VRBO instead of booking the same property independently, has any substantial value.I say “wondering”.I really mean, I’m now convinced it hasn’t.It's November 26th. My review here was posted in September. VRBO have just posted their comment saying it's being escalated. It was "escalated" in September. Draw your own conclusions.

name: Dean Salmon
title: Booked a holiday to Lanzarote this…
text: Booked a holiday to Lanzarote this August. See a review on the villa I booked a week before paying my final balance to to the owner. The review said that there was cctv cameras within the house. This obviously raised alarms with myself with having young girls and my wife. I asked VRBO what is their policy on this. They confirmed that it breaks VRBO's surveillance policy if they were installed. The owner replied to a message I sent and confirmed all were taken down. So I arrived at the house and had a good look round. Me and the wife couldn't see any and thought the owner was true tobhis word. 3 days in we found a camera discreetly in a position out of eyeline. I covered it for the remaining part of the holiday. Then once home, I complained about it to VRBO. I sent photos and a video showing the camera on line to VRBO. They accepted that this was in the property and that it broke their surveillance policy. However I asked for the owner to be penalised and reported for this. But VRBO offered me a small compensation for my ordeal. I said I want this owner removed from VRBO and a full refund. They said its down to the owners discretion to refund me. So I said to VRBO that they are basically accepting that a property they are advertising on their platform could be owned and used for paedophilia activity. The response I got was "were sorry" but they are still advertising this property on their platform. So be aware all! This company will not protect you or your family!

name: Kevin Reynolds
title: DO NOT HOST THROUGH VRBO , AIRBNB ARE FAR SUPERIOR
text: I am a Vrbo host , I have 3 properties on Vrbo, however due to their non existent customer service, I am taking all my properties off Vrbo and will concentrate on AIRBNB, a much better company to deal with, I suggest anyone who is thinking of hosting through Vrbo to use AIRBNB, a reliable company who actually care about their hosts

name: Henry
title: Bunch of crooks
text: The host allowed me to cancel a reservation after the deadline, but then Vrbo wouldn’t refund the payment, even though I had not stayed in the host’s home and the host had received none of the money. Called Vrbo twice and they said they would refund me but never did. Bunch of crooks, keeping money that’s not theirs.

name: John Vaughn
title: Stellar host given NO considerations
text: We have been a stellar host for VRBO for over 8 years with no issues. We decided to move booking platforms and had a few challenges during our transition. While this was being corrected a booking came through for a date that was already booked. I didn't realize until I reviewed my calendar for upcoming bookings. Fortunately I caught this one shortly after it booked and was 4 months in advance of the reservation. I reached out to the guest and apologized that there was an error but the date was not available for their stay. We both agreed and I cancelled the booking. 2 months later I get a $595 cancellation fee from VRBO. We since then have called 3 times asking for a waiver on this fee due to the accidental booking during our switchover to the new platform and our issue free loyal customer status. They refused! Eight years of having a clean and high producing property they would not waive this fee. In fact, since this dragged on past 30 days they threatened to suspend my listing until we paid the fee. This is very disappointing, enough to where I will encourage my guests to use other sites when booking our houses.

name: david smith
title: was told apartment was un available 2…
text: was told apartment was un available 2 hours before i was leaving for the airport was given another apartment when i complained was fobbed of with an excuse that it was a better apartment which it was not its no surprise given the amount of negative reviews on here

name: Melanie
title: Vrbo must train agents to blow you off and lie about it
text: Vrbo's website didn't show the reservation I had made through them for an apartment.  So when I went to cancel the apartment, in plenty of time for a refund, I couldn't find it.  I called the hotel to cancel, and they said I had to cancel through Vrbo.  I must have called Vrbo 10 or 15 times and talked with just as many people.  No one could help me, and most didn't put our conversation in the records to help the next agent.  The last agent I talked to said he was forwarding my case to their special cancellation department and someone would be calling me.  Ha!  A month later.  No call and I'm 500 euros out of pocket.

name: Craig Woodward
title: Vrbo rejected my feedback as it did not…
text: Vrbo rejected my feedback as it did not meet their policy because I detailed how the property owner insisted I paid them an extra 210 euros when i arrived which wasnt detailed on the booking. I was then told I coudnt amend my feedback as they had taken so long to review it it was now too long.Vbro are reviewing feedback and rejecting anything negative so property owners do not have reflective feedback against them.Would never book another property through them!! Customer service is completely unhelpful!!

name: Cheryl
title: Let down
text: We booked our villa in Orlando Florida a couple of months before our travel in September 2024. The first we knew the host had cancelled was when we got a text from the bank to advise us of our refund! Bearing in mind we were supposed to be arriving in less than 48 hours.Following the text, we then received an automated email from VRBO to confirm our refund had been processed.VRBO have not had the courtesy to make direct contact with us, fortunately we were able to book somewhere else with such short notice and for a similar price. If this had been in the busy summer period, I doubt it would have worked out.If I had cancelled with less than 48 hours before arrival I would lose my money.I have a contract with VRBO and they should have sorted this out for us instead of washing their hands of it.I will think more carefully about booking with them in the future.

name: Sarper
title: Our booking on vrbo got cancelled by…
text: Our booking on vrbo got cancelled by the host a couple of hours before our arrival, although we booked 1.5 months before. After calling vrbo customer service for 7 times and arguing with them, they offered us to pay us about 50 Euros more, if the newly booked place on that day is more expensive than the originally booked one. What they did not want to understand is, that accommodations are much more expensive, if you book them on the same day. So we had to pay much more  for the new booking than the originally booked one. Getting only 50 Euros from vrbo is nothing but funny. So do not use this platform! They have a terrible customer service

name: Sean Maley
title: Booked and there was an error with the…

It isn't recognised.Vrbo reservation ID: HA-2NCSSLThe bank has returned the shortfall.No help from vrbo.

name: Jazz M
title: VRBO should be avoided at all cost
text: VRBO should be avoided at all cost! If you EVER have a dispute about a property you stayed at VRBO ALWAYS sides with the HOST! Just STAY AWAY from VRBO and you will not relive my nightmares!

name: Sheshu Kale
title: I recently took a cultural immersion…
text: I recently took a cultural immersion tour, and it was a huge disappointment. The guide lacked any real knowledge about it.

name: Dianne Brooks
title: Never again!!
text: We haven't even had our holiday yet,  but my dealings with their customer service has been horrendous!! I would advise anyone to stay away from this shambles

name: Suzie He
title: Terrible service, still waiting for my deposit.
text: We booked two nights apartment in London through Vrbo, we paid the rental along with damage deposit on Vrbo website. When we arrived, the house was super dirty on the first sight. The drive way and front were covered by lots of rubbish and one sofa bed. We were not allowed to let in the property as well, because the host said they didn’t receive our deposit. So we showed them a screenshot of our payment details. Finally we got in, the boiler was not working, the washing machine was filthy covered by hair and moles. We have no choice to stay there as it was too late. One month later, I thought I should receive my deposit back, but I did not. I contacted the host and Vrbo several times asking for it, it’s been nearly two months and the host still kept asking me some silly questions like providing my booking details which I have provided a month ago.  And Vrbo kept saying they will update the case, and referred me to a property manager. I don’t understand why it is so hard  for people to do such easy thing. The payment is very clearly there, I paid the booking with deposit. Vrbo team is helpless. I will never ever suggest anyone to use them.

name: M.Freitas
title: VRBO keeps your deposit ($1500) for two…
text: VRBO keeps your deposit ($1500) for two weeks after departure.  The host rated us 5 star and all is fine.  VRBO is floating and used client money for profit.  Think about all the thousands of deposits they are earning interest on.

name: Joanne C
title: VRBO doesn't refund for hurricanes or medical emergencies
text: We had booked an VRBO for New Orleans from 11-16 Sep 2024.  I sent an email 2 days before because some of our family members flights were canceled due to Hurricane Francine forecasts showing it was supposed to hit the same time we were supposed to check in.  My husband also came down with a bad case of Covid.  I know the house is w/o power for the past 2 days as I have a brother that lives down there. However, we were told we couldn't get our money back.  From now on we just plan on booking hotel rooms since I know that they will allow cancellations up to 24 hours before.

name: Janice o'malley
title: 85 TATES AVENUE, BELFAST
text: We arrived in Belfast today still waiting for access details to rental apartment at 85 Tates AvenueBT9 7BS managed to phone a mobile 07772 528355 Andy who said he’d phone back. No phone back then suspiciously phone just rang out!! Then had an email saying money refunded😱 imagine our horror to have nowhere to stay. Looking at previous reviews this is quite a common occurance and should be stopped forthwith DO NOT BOOK THIS PROPERTY and owner should be sued for breach of contract!!!

name: Libby Morgan
title: I booked an apartment in Malaga, then cancelled it
text: I booked an apartment in Malaga,   which had a 100% refund policy if cancelled before Oct 9th 2024.I realised the apartment wasn't suitable a day after booking so cancelled it, 5tth  Sep 2023.Only response was a message from host in Spanish,  no translate facility on Vrbo site!I contacted Vrbo on 10th Sep as had heard absolutely nothing re cancellation. name: Aisling Cullen
title: Terrible experience
text: Terrible experience, no booking transparency. Unlike air bnb, you are not provided with contact details of the host. You can only message them through the pathetic contact form which they are under no obligation to respond to. Their help function is utterly useless, and they disable the option of replying to their two-bit bot when it thinks it has solved your issue. DO NOT USE, it is a sham service run by useless AI.

name: Iain Campbell
title: Unbelievable
text: Cannot believe we have been asked to review our holiday by VRBO which never actually happened. Booked apartment in January then in March VRBO advised us to contact our credit card company to claim our money back >£3500 as the booking was cancelled. Sadly VRBO appeared unable to act on our behalf and the only information they had was that the property had been falsely advertised by them and we could no longer stay there. Phone calls to VRBO were unhelpful-fortunately Barclays Bank did refund the full cost of our stay-no idea what would have happened if had booked with debit card and another bank. Very disappointed after booking through VRBO that they seemed unable to help. They had obviously not checked out the property prior to advertising on their website-it was new to their website it said and therefore no customer reviews. Never book a property with no previous reviews. I will never book another VRBO holiday. And now an email asking for a review of our trip despite the fact it was cancelled . What is going on!!!And they have returned my review from VRBO site saying can’t be submitted with no actual reason why-I have told the truth!

name: Ray MacMillan
title: VRBO STOLE $717.63 FROM US
text: VRBO STOLE $717.63 FROM USIn June of this year my wife booked a nice place at 119 Ironwood Cove, Pass Christian, MS 39571, USA using VRBO. The total price shown on the VRBO WEBSITE was $2304. My wife took a screen shot so she could show the rest of the family what we’re paying for. One payment was taken off our credit card, when the second payment came through they had taken an extra $ and the total was now $3,021.63, they over charged my credit card $717.63. My wife finally got a human on the phone to VRBO and was told to contact the home owner/manager. My wife wrote the house owner/manager and the house owner says "No, that is the correct price". My wife then says no it’s not and I can send you proof that you have upped the price after I booked it. The owner/manager says she would send my wife her email address to verify but she never did send her email and would never answer the phone from my wife. SCAMMER I THOUGHT. My wife has screen shots of both prices, before and after.I told my wife that it is VRBO that should be concerned and standing up for the customer so she started calling VRBO and spending sometimes over an hour on hold just to be told a supervisor will call her back. The very last day before my wife was flying to Gulfport Mississippi to meet up with all the family a fellow from VRBO calls and has my wife again send the screen shots and all the info she collected. This guy talked and talked and talked and then said that the screen shots could have been manipulated and since it is within 24 hours of staying at the house the rules say that they can’t refund or cancel but he would refund $322 which is the service fee. My wife asked me and I mistakenly said we want all that they have stolen from us and he said take it or leave it. I told him I’m going to get my peace of mind from writing reviews telling the truth about VRBO and the scammer at 119 Ironwood Cove, Pass Christian, MS 39571 on the waterfront in Mississippi.****  I wanted to make sure this is the correct property and SURPRISE SURPRISE it is no longer on VRBO. Man oh man what a bunch of scammers, VRBO INCLUDED.

name: Paul Margand
title: Casa Marcuya
text: I give the property 0 stars if that was possible.We had many problems with the house. The electrics were unsafe and we had many electric shocks and the electric tripped on a regular basis. The plumbing also needs some upgrades so that the showers do not run hot and cold continuously. The beds all need to be replaced. There was a roof terrace but the access was unsafe so completely unusable. We were aware that the air con was not available in the bedrooms and had requested fans prior to our arrival. One was initially provided and after many days we finally had 3 but had to go out and purchase the last fan needed ourselves. Pool developed algae and was unusable for 2 days of our stay. Finally, our deposit was also not returned even though the owner promised he transferred it to my account.

name: Pat Mullan
title: Don’t hold your breath for a refund
text: “When you pay through Vrbo, we protect your rental payment against fraud. If your payment ends up in the hands of someone other than the host, we'll pay you bAck.”It took us  4 months to finally get a refund after a fraudulent host made off with the money we paid for a villa in Greece that belonged to someone else.  Had to threaten legal action before they finally stumped up

name: suzanne farley
title: Villa Dorothy Blanes.
text: Villa Dorothy Blanes.This Villa was very basic and although it had 10 beds as advertised we had to pay for the bed linen!! The whole villa felt grubby and not well cleaned or maintained. Listed of items not supplied:Kettle, air con, fire extinguisher or smoke alarms, emergency contact numbers, how to use equipment and light/shutter switches (these were all in one!). No bath mates and bath screens leaked so water soaked the floors. Only 6 sunloungers, only 9 dining chairs. The lounge suites had seen better days. The house in need of deep a clean. There should also be more information about mobility access, as house is only accessed by stairs and the villa is on a steep hill leading to the promenade. Finally, the kitchen is poorly equipped if you wished to cook there rather than eating all the time.Definitely will not be going back.

name: Dawn Brown
title: Villa Dorothy not recommended
text: Villa Dorothy, Blanes.10 ladies, all 58 years + returned home villa Dorothy today, very disappointed. Our findings....1. Had to pay extortionate price for bed linen and towels were chargeable as well, this was for booking through VRBO/Club Villamar, yet other booking sites they were included.2. No aircon3. No kettle4. No safe5. No evidence of smoke alarms or fire extinguisher6. No hairdryers7. No instructions for appliance, lights and shutter use, no emergency contact numbers or local information8. Two of the bedrooms have no mirrors9. Not enough sunbeds, only 6 made available for 10 people10. BBQ too dirty to use11. Many doors, cupboards, drawers and handles need attention.12. Not enough hot water13. No mention of the villa being situated at the top of a very steep hill. Mentioning the villa is not at street level is not good enough! Had any member of our party had mobility issues this would have been a major problem!14. Overall the villa is dirty and in need of a deep clean, ie sticky shelves, slimy tiles and dirt and debris under the beds to name a few.In brief; villa Dorothy is basic, tired and dirty, we would not recommend a atay here to anyone. I hope viewers find these comments helpful and the owners do take note.

name: Sara Squires
title: We are a party of 10 ladies
text: We are a party of 10 ladies, all 58+ yrs. We stayed at Villa Dorothy in Blanes, Spain. Our list of issues that need addressing are as follows, bearing in mind the villa is advertised as sleeping 10 people.Only 6 plastic pool loungers, no mattresses for themNo kettleNo patio furniture for balcony and only 4 chairs for the poolside tableDirty unuseable BBQA €15 charge per person for bed linen!!Only one very flat pillow per bedNo visible fire extinguisherNo information booklet regarding emergency numbers etcNo bath matsLimited hot water for all the showersAC units installed but unavailable for use and no freestanding fansNo hairdryersNo mirrors in some of the bedroomsNo instructions for tv, coffee machine etcGenerally not very cleanThis property is woefully inadequate for 10 people and needs a complete face lift

name: Sergey
title: faulse advertisement, no help from VRBO
text: We rented a property that was advertised as breakfast included. The host left for 3 people for 7 days 1 liter of juice and milk, a bag of cookies and called it breakfast. The VRBO deemed it as a minor issue and refused to help and provide a partial refund for the money that I had to spend extra for breakfasts. Bad business, do not trust their guarantee. In the reply VRBO advised to contact the customer service, but I already did, they are useless. They do not know what they are talking about.

name: A Smith
title: Not all sunshine -more blues.
text: We stayed at a villa in Albufeira, Portugal. On arrival we were told of a leak in one of the bathrooms. There was a hole in the ceiling. We were told it was safe to use, but during the night the ceiling fell down.This was the bathroom our grandchildren were using as it was closest to their bedroom. Luckily no one was hurt.Sonja the manager did promptly arrange for a temporary repair. We had builders ask us if we wanted them to repair it. As it would take 2 days they could only do a temporary job. We then had to clean up after them.We were given conflicting accounts of who was to blame for allowing us to use it. No one came to look at itwe had to take a photo and send it on.There were other issues this being the main one.Vrbo have done nothing about it. I was told we would get a full refund. Then told the owner had changed his mind because he didn't like our review. Totally unacceptable and would never use them again. There is no comeback if the property has problems. And reviews can't be trusted.

name: Daniel
title: VRBO is not good listing service
text: Well, I am disappointed with my experience listing a property with VRBO. Despite providing my permit number and following all their guidelines, my property has remained unlisted for a month with no clear explanation. My permit number is accepted by other services but not by VRBO.I received numerous emails stating that my listing was inactive, and I spent significant time on chat and phone support, only to be put on hold repeatedly. Although I was assured by agents that the issues were being resolved, nothing changed. Having lack of progress and support, I have decided to close my account with VRBO. I would not recommend their services based on my experience.Update!As you can see, I wrote this review on September 8, but received a response below, claiming that they supposedly didn’t receive any information from me or are even waiting for it on December 4.  96 days later. Do you think they proved to be a good service?

name: Kings
title: These guys are scammers!
text: These guys are scammers!! Especially if you are a host, you will not get your payout! Your payout will remain in pending transactions till it will be cancelled by Vrbo…. Also their taxes and charges are ludicrous!!!

name: hannah Khanna
title: Terrible terrible terrible company. No customer service help and no support when things go wrong!!!!!
text: The worst customer service I have ever experienced!!!!!!!I recently went on a family holiday with my family of 5 to Greece and booked a villa with VRBO for my stay there. Just before we were due to fly out the host of our villa contacted us saying there was a water problem and she had to cancel our booking. We contacted VRBO several times to discuss our options and nobody bothered to contact us back. Luckily the host of the cancelled villa was very nice and managed to locate us two separate villas for us to stay in for the duration of our stay so we arranged this without involving VRBO as we couldn’t get hold of anyone!!!! We flew to Greece two days later and on arrival there we had lots of missed calls from the host of the cancelled villa saying that VRBO had been in touch and had told her to cancel the two villas as it wasn’t through their site so that is what she did. This meant we had arrived in Zante with 3 kids and nowhere to stay…….. stressed doesn’t begin to explain how it was!! Luckily the lady was really lovely and helped us and between us we managed to rebook the two cancelled villa separate of VRBO and we were able to stay in those two villas.Meanwhile we still couldn’t get hold of VRBO and we had spent a huge amount of money with them. We had called, emailed etc and heard nothing.VRBO eventually called us back 5 days into our holiday and just asked if we had managed to sort some accomodation out. I couldn’t believe we were treated like this after spending a huge amount of money £3000 + on the original villa and if it hadn’t been for the lovely host who used the money we had paid her to secure the other villas we would of been on the street.I have since arrived back and contacted VRBO to complain and it took ages for anyone to come back to me at all and after many many email and online messages I have managed to get through to management and they have offered me the tiniest amounts of compensation which is not even worth taking and no explanation at all for how we were treated and no apology!!!!It’s a joke of a company I have no idea how they are even able to run a company when their customer service is as bad as it is.DO NOT BOOK WITH VRBO ………..

name: Mikey Villy
title: Absolutely terrible experience
text: Absolutely terrible experience. I wish I never booked from VRBO. Never has I any issues with AIRbnb. VRBO is a joke! They never reply to Emails. I had a very serious issue with mirror almost falling on my 2 year old son, that we barely saved. Also, undisclosed Cameras on property and I never received my deposit back (although host claims she refunded fully).Do NOT book anything with VRBO

name: Rebekah
title: I booked a night away and the host…
text: I booked a night away and the host emailed me straight away and told me they couldn't host us. Therefore the trip was cancelled, this was 10 days ago and I am yet to receive the refund still! The host is very unprofessional and vrbo customer services just fob you and and don’t care at all. I have no other option but to escalate this to consumer rights and the ombudsman now. I wish I’d read the reviews on vrbo before I booked the trip

name: Stan Lewandowski
title: Ratings are not what they are....they are lower.
text: I rented a house thru VRBO.  The property was listed a 10 rating.  That's the reason I picked it.  When we got there the house looked like someone was living there.  Food in the refrigerator and pantry open and unopened.  Clothes in the closet. Dirt on the floors.  Crumbs on the counter and tables.  Burnt out light bulbs.  Registers were dirty.  Went to use the vacuum and it was broke.  Tried to contact the host with no luck.  VRBO was contacted and they were unable to do so also.  Next day the host contacted me and stated I need to go stay somewhere else.  Refunded half of the cleaning fee to me. Wrote a negative review that was never posted by VRBO.  Contacted VRBO to find out where it was.  I was told by VRBO the Host has the right to take down negative reviews.  Posted a 2nd one .  Bottom line ratings of properties mean nothing on VRBO because they can be skewed. Go with old faithful when renting a property.....WORD OF MOUTH.

name: James
title: From the perspective of a small agency
text: If you are on their "professional" hosting package they will charge you 10% on "offline bookings" which means people that have seen your property and then found it elsewhere.You won't have any warning that this is about to happen, and in all cases because of the way they calculate their commission, they will earn more money from these "offline" bookings than you will as an agency. It's unbelievable greed and they deserve the terrible reviews on this platform.

name: Katie Robins
title: VRBO treat hosts appallingly
text: VRBO treat hosts appallingly. The algorithms block weeks which are free in the calendar and the only way to clear them is by calling. The USA….  and I  received a phone bill for £120 for something which is their issue… OUTRAGEOUS

name: Rick Selah
title: VRBO is simply AWFUL
text: Worst customer service ever, and their renter vetting is non-existent. VRBO still has not paid me for a rental of my lake house from TWO MONTHS AGO, and they simply keep passing the buck to the next lackey who does NOTHING. You can only talk with customer service in India, they can't and won't do anything, and no one from US support or billing or chat will ever respond to pay what they owe me.  On top of this royal PITA, every month there's another "guest" scammer wanting to rent my place for 3 weeks, but needs to pay with a "company check"--there's no picture, and no history, yet when I notify "support" that its a scammer they do NOTHING.
