Laughable how out of touch they are.

name: Michele Baldesi
title: Misleading and unfair practices to…
text: Misleading and unfair practices to force landlords to switch to flexi subscription, they provide misleading information, so they will increase profits, will be reported to trading standards

name: A Ronsley
title: Terrible
text: Terrible! Do not book through this company.We recently booked a chalet in Cornwall... completely falsely advertised. We was told by the owner thete was a swimming pool, jacuzzi, sauna, resturant and evening entertainment. All of which had been shut down for over a year.Vrbo have been useless in resolving the issues. Requested call backs from management. Guess what they never call back. On the telephone we are given excuses and left feeling unsupported. Absolutely no empathy for the customer or pride in their service. DiSGUSTING!We are taking legal action through trading standards as vrbo have been no support or help at all!

name: Rebecca Fleming
title: Use Airbnb instead- their pricing is…
text: Use Airbnb instead- their pricing is more transparent and their communication is more succinct. This was our first time renting with Vrbo. The rental was great but I received over 15 emails from Vrbo- a lot of repeat info. Then we get a surprise charge for using vrbo to book, talking to an agent they claim that if I log into the account vrbo set up for me (I did not request nor set up) then there would be an explanation of the charge. Never received a receipt or any communication to expect the charge. Save yourself the headache and use Airbnb instead!

name: Cyberdude
title: False advertising
text: We wanted a house for our crew for one night for a convention that we were working.  Advertised prices showed around $230 per night, however once they finished adding on all of the ridiculous fees (including a stupid host fee that was more than the nightly cost), the price ended up being $750.  Tell me how do these people honestly think that $520 in fees is appropriate to add to a place that is advertised to be $230 per night??!   This is false advertising.

name: David Stults
title: As an owner
text: As an owner, the boundaries VRBO sets up to preclude you from speaking to a real person is shameful.  But if you are tenacious and get through, then you have the challenge of talking to someone offshore with broken English.  I won't bore you with the details, but twice in the last year the VRBO support staff proved incapable of even the most basic tasks.  So frustrating.

name: Bryony Chawner
title: Awful awful company
text: Awful awful company, allow you to book a villa that is not even available and then do nothing to fix the fact that you now have no accommodation booked for your trip and everything is sold out due to it being a busy period. All customer service agents are useless and just fob you off.

name: Joao
title: VRBO didn’t refund!!
text: I have made a booking with Vrbo and spent £1200 for a holidays in Sicily, at my arrival the apartment have not been available, the apartment has been under refurbishment.Vrbo has not make any arrangements to sort out the problem and also didn’t refund me the spent money of £1200 !!

name: Stephen G.
title: An Unsafe and Fire Hazard Listing
text: Apartment Address:4220 Rue Frontenac, Montréal, QC H2H 2M3, CanadaI rented this apartment for a family vacation through VRBO. Upon arrival w found that the apartment was not as described. No outside pictures are in the listing showing access/stairs and doors.DEFICIENCIES:1. It has no main access other than the unsafe metal stares on the side of the building. Meaning that incase of a fire, we will be stuck.2. The apartment is on the 2nd floor above a refrigeration warehouse and potentially other hazardous materials. Risk of fire and chemical spillage/leakageOwner refuses to refund me. Had paid $1,814.57 Even after I contacted him and tried to resolve this. He remains adamant that I don't qualify for my refundContacted the City to evaluate if this qualifies as a dwelling place.

name: mr. sportivo
title: We were hosts. Not anymore though.
text: We are hosts, a guest tried blackmailing us into giving a refund. We wouldn't, he left vindictive and untrue feedback. Vrbo would do nothing about it despite us having a 4 year track record of 5 star feedback. We removed our listing's from Vrbo.

name: Arwyn Smalley
title: Greedy host, terrible customer service with VRBO
text: Last September I booked an accommodation for the following March for a conference I was attending. Three days before the conference the host cancelled my reservation and claimed they had double-booked the accommodation. For context, this was a really big conference, and accommodation prices had gone up significantly between when I booked in September and the week before the conference. So sure, the host probably double booked because he could make more money than what my rental would have been. But there's no possible way there was an existing booking before mine. He should have honored whoever booked first. Expedia promised that VRBO/Expedia would refund me the difference between the original booking and the new booking, and would help me with rebooking. They didn't help me with rebooking. They sent me a long list of items I would need to make the claim. Some of them required that I wait until after my credit card statement came back after the travel. The day after they sent me the list they closed the claim "since I hadn't replied". I called them up again and they said no big deal, once I had all the things collected to just reply to the e-mail and it would reactivate it. This was not the case. When I sent the e-mail with all the pieces of evidence, I received an auto-reply that said "This e-mail is not monitored." So I got on the chat helpline and got a person, sent in all the information to them again. Was promised they would work on my case. Two weeks later I am on the help line again because no word. The agent on the chat line assures me (as the previous one did) that they are "escalating my case" to the people who will be working on it, and who will "reach out to me soon". Pretty soon my claims period will end, so this sounds like delay tactics. What a disappointment.

name: Eve Sukhnandan
title: Don’t waste your money
text: Vrbo’s system for feedback prevents you sharing your view.After a really rubbish experience at one of their villas I tried to contact them with a complaint - you can’t contact them directly - you have to publish publicly.Try to do that, and regardless of the carefully worded, non inflammatory or rude views, you are blocked.Great model, until you have a problem and then they are nowhere to be seen.Incorrectly described and marketed villa which led to an awful holiday.Not ok.

name: Mr M
title: Host not been paid nearly £1,000 by…
text: Sadly can’t give a zero star review. We have not been paid nearly £1,000 by VRBO for a guests visit. Their system, unlike AirBNB, allows guests to turn up who haven’t paid for their trip. Spent 2 hours on web chat but they didn’t give us any call reference, couldn’t put any notes on our account. Told an expert team would look into it and email us back but couldn’t copy the email they sent to the guest to see if he had paid.Now told its up to host to monitor if guest has paid before they arrive. Useless platform, do not use.

name: John Raban
title: VRBO charging 10% Booking fee to Holiday Makers using their online booking
text: Just booked a VRBO villa in Hilton Head. The owner charged me a booking fee of 5% which I expected. However I checked my bank account and VRBO charged me the customer a 10% booking fee also. I assume VRBO is also collecting fees from the owner. The VRBO booking fee is a surprise and unjustified. I will not be using VRBO again. Absolute disgrace.

name: John White
title: VRBO Does Not Care About Host
text: I contacted VRBO customer service yesterday asking for a review of my property to be removed for violation of policy. I was ignored for multiple weeks despite following up several times.  I was eventually contacted by Katrina who attempted to intimidate me by stating that it would be against federal law to remove the review.  When I pointed out that she was incorrect, I was told that further emails to support would be ignored.

name: TWeede
title: Cameras inside and out…creepy owner and so stressful!
text: Our last stay was stressful, disappointing and not what we have ever experienced with VRBO. I had sent in a neighborly dispute and never heard anything back. The VRBO owner had cameras not only outside the home but inside and only verified by photos he sent to us. Exterior cameras based on VRBO rules are for safety and not to track the comings and goings of guests. This host tracked and miscounted how many people were in the home and charged us extra fees. He ruined our family time together for our nephews’s wedding with an unacceptable number of calls, emails, texts. This owner was creepy and not an honest person…renter be ware of VRBO and the home owner. Because of how VRBO handled this situation, taking down our honest review to boost the owner’s rating, and not responding back to us, we will now book directly with homeowners and management companies.

name: ezra
title: VRBO and Host scammed us
text: VRBO and Host scammed us. We paid and when we showed up it was nothing like we were promised.Left immediately. Called VRBO, told it will be sent to a special team. 6 weeks later, No refund, no response.Update September 11Customer service lied, they have not sent me any emails or done anything.

name: Gareth
title: Avoid vrbo if you'd like a stress-free trip
text: Never used vrbo before. Host ghosted us two weeks before the trip, but Vrbo insisted that we allow them up until the time of the booking to respond. When we showed up, the host was nowhere to be found.Vrbo promised to find us alternative accommodation, then never called me back, leaving us entirely without a place to stay.Once the trip was over, I was promised a refund. That took two more calls to arrange, but did eventually show up.Slow, ineffectual customer help, and generally a terrible service all round. Nice work Vrbo!

name: sine nomine
title: VRBO is my last resort…
text: VRBO is my last resort vacation planning.  #1 reason is that VRBO prevents direct communication with the host and restrict it to filtered messages through their platform only.  This a huge impediment for international travel.  #2 checkin information is available only 3 days before arrival, which is a problem while traveling internationally.  If there is an issue with your booking, yes it does happen, you lost valuable time in being able to address it. #3 when booking failures happen, yes they do, VRBO leaves it to you and the host to resolve.  I also used to be a host and hated VRBO heavy handed relationship.  I hope VRBO would only broker booking and step out of the way because they lack the commitment to either the host or the traveler and consequences can be very high.  Please allow direct communication choices to suit host-guest circumstances NOT VRBO massaging.

name: Jon Smith
title: Atrocious experience
text: Atrocious experience. Impossible people to deal with when things go wrong. Basically ruined our holiday by refusing to accept the host had not replied to our multiple comms. Had to find alt accommodation on the day. Abysmal company-avoid!!!

name: Lizzy
title: False advertising.
text: Under the trades description act and false advertising our accommodation  was not as advertised and should receive a refund from VRBO.  On top of this the daily occurrence  of dog poo in what was described as our 'private' area was unacceptable. Having given our hosts a bad review they thought it was acceptable to do 'Tit for tat' and give us a totally unfounded and dishonest review.

name: Aaron Boyle
title: Cancelled my reservation for me and 4…
text: Cancelled my reservation for me and 4 adultwa two weeks prior to when we were supposed to go on vacation!Customer service is awful! No resolution.Now I have 5 adults with time booked off of work and no where to go!Saddest part is VRBO or Expedia will do nothing to help us!

name: Macca
title: Avoid - Stress! Places booked and paid for were not available. Twice!
text: First thing to know is Expedia, vrbo, ebookers and more are all under the same brand and owned by Expedia.We booked some accommodation near Malaga in late July early august for a 10-night stay, we actually found the pace on Expedia and booked it, were really pleased with the look of the place and the accommodation, we paid and swiftly got the confirmation from VRBO (one of Expedia brands)As our holiday grew closer we realised we had not received any accommodation checking details  and so rang up Expedia, they did some looking around and told us to immediately book something else as they could not contact the host and the host had not logged into the platform for some time, they said they would give us some extra money towards the cost of the new booking.  As this was getting very close to our flying date so we had a look on their site(s) and found another lovely place on ebookers, so we booked that and paid again, we have now paid nearly £4500 to the Expedia group of brands. Again, we didn’t receive any accommodation check in info but as it was a Sunday (we were due to fly the next day Monday) we though we would get the details on route to Malaga.Long story short we did not receive the new details and spent 2 hours on the phone to VRBO in Malaga airport, the agents have other ways to contact the host of the accommodation that you do not, we found out that  for some reason un-know to us that the place was indeed not available AGAIN!, they transfer you to many people and keep telling you that they are there to help, and you have to explain your predicament again every time you’re passed on. They ask you if you have seen anywhere else, you’d like to stay but that’s very difficult when you’re on the phone to them with no other way to look on the site.They seem to be helpful at first, but it’s just smoke and mirrors. They ask if you want to pursue self-relocation and if you yes you will get an immediate email saying you have been refunded and then you’re officially dumped.With 2 kids and my partners in the airport for hours without anywhere to stay was pretty stressful, we had to go and collect the hire car and drive off and park on the streets and then spend more hours looking for a place in high season, not easy and very stressful, we managed to find a place for one nigh in Malaga so we could get our heads down.Ultimately, we did find a nice place on another platform that we could actually go and stay at, we did loose a day of our holiday and had some serious stress leading up to and during those first few days, we noticed it had a negative effect on our kids metal well-being the  stress must have propagated across from us, as they were very unsettle for a few days, we felt totally abandoned by Expedia / VRBO / Ebookers.No compensation was offered, or an apology afterwards.If a place is not available (we never heard why they weren’t) why does it let you book  and pay for them?Avoid

name: Desmond Ahern
title: Very poor rental property
text: Very poor rental property, would not recommendAugust 2024There was no onsite/off road parking. You park together with other cars on the road near to property. The front of the property was grossly overgrown and the rear garden was overgrown with a table and 2 chairs which were sited on the very uneven grass area unusable.The inside of property was furnished with quite a few cobwebs and small moths flying around. Contacted sykes to refund cleaning fee because of this. But had no reply.The house to the left of property was in a very rundown state, with adjoining fence falling down and filthy curtains.We were concerned the place looks like a squat and my wife felt very insecure while here.We booked for 3 nights. BUT left after just 1 night. Sykes,booking.com and vrbn should monitor these rentals and check that they are upto spec as we found this a very dissapointing experience.

name: Barbara Graham
title: DON’T USE Vrbo. So stressful!!
text: DON’T USE Vrbo! So stressful!!I have just had the most stressful experience with them. I booked a house in Edinburgh for 3 nights for the festival. The hosts phone was switched off. Left several messages but they never replied.Managed to get a phone number for the customer service.  Rang many times but they refused to discuss anything till after our check in at 3.00pm had passed.We were left stranded without accommodation.spent over an hour on the phone with John who was in the Philippines! He’d no idea how expensive and difficult it is to get accommodation in Edinburgh during the festival.Three of us ended up in student accommodation for one night and spent most of the following morning trying to find alternative accommodation.So stressful.Don’t believe what they tell you regarding compensation. There are too many clauses and you will have no chance! Hence the revue I’ve posted.Such a stressful waste of time dealing with Vrbo.

name: Rosemarie P.
title: Very slow and incompetent
text: I'm a host. Recently, I've encountered two issues. First, a guest cancelled but had to wait weeks for a refund, during which time, my calendar was still blocked for those dates, meaning I couldn't get bookings.Now, I noticed my payout for a stay was less than it should be and after contacting customer service, I have now been waiting   for 3 weeks for a solution to the problem.

name: Sam Juon
title: It All Feels Like a Scam
text: I booked a property for eight people to stay in for two nights to celebrate my birthday.Prior to my booking the host was very helpful and responsive, however as soon as I'd paid they stopped replying and became unresponsive.Three days before I was due to check-in I had still not heard from them and I had not received any access information for the property which raised alarm bells.I spoke to Vrbo support and they kept telling me not to worry, they gave me the hosts' contact information but I still could not get through. Two days before check-in I had still not heard from the host so I again asked Vrbo to check. Vrbo called them directly and could not get through.Vrbo's advice was to wait until the check in time and go to the property to see if the host was there. As soon as the check-in time was surpassed Vrbo promised to put me through to a "dedicated team" who would give me a full refund, plus an additional 50% for the stress and hassle of finding another property on such short notice. They also promised assistance in finding another property.All these promises were completely false. There was absolutely no support after the check-in date, I had to just book another property using Air BnB (a perfect and seamless process, lovely property, should've used them instead) and pay for it out of my own pocket.I have had to keep phoning Vrbo support to check on the status of my refund. It's been four-weeks since the booking date now and I am yet to receive any money back, any of the compensation promised, any written confirmation of the refund, any proactive support at all.Every time I call Vrbo support I get the distinct impression they are just trying to palm me off and appease me without committing anything in writing or providing any helpful information on the status of my refund. They regularly leave me on hold for long periods of time or just say that I need to speak to a different department. One support agent genuinely said to me "don't call us back, we'll call you".  Lol.I have finally got an email address (apparently) for their  reimbursement department so I sent them a message to initiate a formal written complaints process, however I am yet to hear anything back. I am not holding my breath.To summarise; this has been a truly woeful experience where I have paid for a service which has not been provided and there has been no effort made to reimburse or reassure me. Vrbo's customer support is incredibly unhelpful and the whole thing feels like a scam.0/10 would not recommend.

name: Joanne gayden
title: please be careful what you book .
text: please be careful what you book .I booked a break for  me and children and the  day before I contacted the  host for details of arrival as I'd not heard anything .I was advised by Vrbo the booking needed to be cancelled ,the host could no longer honor the booking .less than 24 hrs before we arrive and over a bank holiday weekend we are left with no holiday .we had booked activities to do on this holiday . The children are upset .when you've worked hard all year and in need of a break it's distressing to find out you're not going to get one .I would not use this site again

name: Bill Bob
title: One of the worst companies I have had…
text: One of the worst companies I have had to deal with going from company to company, never again.Not like me to book something without looking at reviews first.

name: Peter Riley
title: Shocking Customer Service and inability to handle a clear SCAM booking.
text: I booked accommodation for Wales for last weekend. I had no response from the host after multiple calls, emails and escalations to VRBO.After getting nowhere with VRBO, I then started to investigate the property as I suspected it was a scam. I managed to find the exact same property on Airbnb under a different name. After messaging the verified host on Airbnb they confirmed it was a scam on VRBO.After informing VRBO of this information, they not only refused to cancel and refund my order until the time it expired, but refused to take the advert down.This left me with one day to book accommodation for my holiday.I still have no updates on my refund or an ETA after multiple calls, messages and emails to VRBO leaving me currently £1500 out of pocket. I have had to contact my credit card in order to take care of this.I have concerns on how they verify their properties and also how they keep customers up to date and handle these scenarios. If I had not carried out this research, I would of travelled around 5 hours to find out I was scammed... what about customers who book from overseas and have this same problem?I will not be using VRBO again and I recommend you do not either.Poor customer service, poor verification, lack of action taken and still waiting for a refund...

name: Caroline Butler
title: If I could give it a zero I would AVOID
text: If I could give it a zero, I would. Avoid.This was the worst check in experience we have ever had at Meir Smartflats, AntwerpPoorly sinposted apartments down dead end roadNo check in email sent as promised 24 hrs before hand - arrived to find we couldn’t get inHad to park illegally for over an hour whilst trying to speak to someone at Vrbo/smartflats to let us in the apartmentBeing told by Vrbo our booking didn’t existWaiting for over 30 minutes to be hung up on by Vrbo then not called backLuckily heard back from Smartflats with check in details whilst waitingVrbo advert listed parking available - smart flat confirmed there was not parkingHad to pay for our own parking elsewhere, having to leave our 3 children in the flat in a foreign city to take our bags up over 50 steps whilst we found parking .This is extremely unacceptable. I will not be using Vrbo again and recommend anyone else to book elsewhere. This is not how to care for customers.

name: Me
title: Vrbo's agent (host) cancelled…
text: Vrbo's agent (host) cancelled reservation - for which full payment had been made - and denied any refund. Their 'customer service' department was totally useless.

name: Rhett Baldwin
title: Their customer service is virtually…
text: Their customer service is virtually non-existent.  I sent a question about where to find traveler reviews and got a bot that responded "I am unable to help you with that." Nothing else.  Nothing in FAQ, nothing.  AirBnb is sooooo much better than these clowns.

name: Phyllis Hines
title: Worst rental ever
text: We rented Cozy Beach House Indian Shores for 4 days. Upon arrival, we were given the wrong keycode. When we did enter the home, we soon realized this was a mistake. The description never mentioned inside stairs nor did the online  pictures show them. Two of our family members are handicapped & cannot do stairs. All bedrooms were on the 2nd floor. The house was dirty so I spent the 1st of 4 days cleaning. The 2nd day was spent at the hospital with my husband who was having chemo. Early on the 3rd day I contacted the owner & told him we would have to leave because the house had too many issues.  The clincher was  the roaches. Aside from being dirty, our biggest issue was the stairs. My daughter in law wears leg braces & stairs were impossible for her. My husband has Parkinsons, so he could not climb stairs either. When I voiced our concerns to the host, he told me if we were out by 10 am, he would refund the 2 nights So we left before 10 & rented a place on one level which was very clean & cost W-A-Y less.The refund promised is over $700. The host decided not to keep his word & would not give us our promised refund.In conclusion, this turned out to be the worst vacation rental we have ever encountered. This place is awful. PLEASE look elsewhere. We certainly wish we would have.

name: inge staes
title: Never again!
text: In the winter of 2023 we booked and payed an appartment with VRBO. 2 days before travelling we find out that the owner does not work with VRBO!. 2 days we tried to call or reached VRBO. 1 hour before our check-in we got someone on the Phone with a lousy solution.  If we didnt call them ourselve we got no solution.We spent a lot of time, stress and money on this... never again!

name: Gail
title: Dishonest Business Practices
text: We reserved a vacation home many months in advance and paid in full. 8 days before our trip I got a form email from Vacasa (although the reservations was made through VRBO) saying the reservation had been cancelled because EITHER the owner is selling the home or sold the home. I called, was put on hold for 30 minutes and then disconected. I called back and the representative said "What do you want me to do?" To add insult to injury , although VRBO cancelled my paid-in-full reservation (not me) they have not refunded my $2200!  I will NEVER use VRBO again because they do not stand behind their actions.

name: Diane
title: RIP OFF Company .
text: This company should be struck off from trading .They owe me £890 for a cancelled accommodation. They promised me a reimbursement and i’m still waiting  6 weeks later .No offer of compensation or anything . Avoid at all costs .I have to go legal now and have the bank involved. Trueku shocking and disgusting.

name: Mikie A
title: Does not care about their customers.
text: I booked with Vrbo with our accommodation for Croatia. When I arrived the host suddenly messaged me stating 'they are unable to accommodate me due to their illness'. I then spoke to Vrbo customer service and I got helped at the beginning upon going to the hotel they rebooked me it got cancelled and after that I was left with no accommodation and upon calling them again they then stated they are unable to help me and put the phone down on me whilst abroad with no accommodation. At this point this was around 10pm with no help  nor care about our situation.

name: Dèbora
title: Ladrones
text: Ladrones! La dueña de la casa nos canceló la reserva el mismo día. VRBO dijo que nos devolvería el dinero y nada! Ni casa ni dinero. Fue el uno de Junio. Ladrones!😡😡😡😡😡😡😡Scammers! The owner of the house cancelled the reservation the same day. Vrbo told us that they would refund our money. That was on June 1st and, so far, nothing at all! We are left without a house and without money. Scammers!  Reserva: HA-XW9L6K

name: J Med
title: Browsed this site and then started…
text: Browsed this site and then started getting emails requesting payment for “booking”. Became absolute pain, will never use them again.

name: Tia C
title: No Support, avoid booking with Vrbo
text: We reserved a home (basement suite) on Vrbo to stay in Calgary, Canada for 7 nights, on arriving at the property, it wasn't the cleanest, but that was the least of our concerns, the noise from the above house was unbearable, its like they were constantly dragging furniture around, we firstly contact the host about the noise and he did not respond, after a few hours, we decided to leave as the noise did not stop, we messaged the host via Vrbo to state we left and would appreciate a refund, long story short the host was not forth coming at all  . I contacted Vrbo who stated they wanted evidence at the time I did not think about recording the noise, so I contacted the host again and said we will come back to record the noise, he did not respond I advised Vrbo since I have paid for the week and no refund has been offered I will go back ( but need to be sure the host has not changed the lock pass code, as his not responding to me) Vrbo did not acknowledge this and said they have escalated my case and someone will be in touch soon, I have contacted Vrbo numerous times and keep getting told the same thing, Vrbo is waiting to talk to the host first, yet the host has not responded to Vrbo?? It has been 7 WEEKS  NOW and I get told the same thing, waiting to talk to host and the case is with the esculated team. What has been esculated, 7 weeks and no response???? as a company this is VERY POOR, 5 working days is more then enough time to provide a response,  the host told me in verbo message he contacted vrbo ans Vrbo is saying have not spoken to host.If the host is not responding, Vrbo SHOULD deal with the matter and refund the money.This is unacceptable, having to stay at hotels and have not received a response from Vrbo or refund for this apartment has cost me greatly.What is the point of escalating my case to a team in Vrbo if 7 weeks later I am still waiting and worst of all, not even contacted by Vrbo.

name: steve draper
title: The place is disgusting and would not…
text: When we got here I contacted customer support straightaway to report there was no towels, no sheets anywhere or pillows we are here with 4 kids The place is disgusting and would not let a rat live here and VRBO just promise to help and do nothing in spite of sending photos etc, it’s a case of we have the money we are not bothered so I’m here with my wife who has mental health issues and 4 Grandchildren ages of 1, 4, 10 and 11 and an arrogant agent on the phone after being put on hold again and again for 1 hour and 45 minutes said your case is closed it’s only minor issues I said what all the food left in the pans etc I also sent photos as evidence also the bathrooms are disgusting I also sent photos of them including the toilet brush full of s##t the roof terrace door we have to keep closed so the smaller children can’t access the terrace because there is an hole at the end and the kids can get straight on the roof but VRBO are not bothered because the collect their fees wether or not your children fall off the roof I had to threaten to squat in the villa before they sent the pool cleaner so I will never use VRBO again

name: Cheryl Aday
title: VRBO's Customer Service Is THE WORST!
text: I have been a host on VRBO for approx. 7 years. They use to have excellent customer service until they were bought out. They kicked me off their platform for no reason. I have hundreds of 5 star reviews and VRBO just decided to delete me from their platform. I have made over a dozen phone calls, spent hours on hold and got the complete run around from their customer service department trying to get my property back on their platform. VRBO has turned into a joke...I have decided to stop using them and will continue with Airbnb where they offer superb customer service.

name: Rose
title: VRBO  = Modern Robber
text: VRBO is absolutely horrible. People should always look for options to cut the "middle man". If ppl go after this as a rule, then companies like VRBO, airbnb and the variations of would not have a platform. I booked a place at around 12am last night, made the payment in the morning after host approved at around 9am then by 11am had to cancel for personal matters that came up. The host did a partial refund and kept $400 and VRBO kept $278, the rest were refunded. To keep $678 for no service just bc I canceled 2 hours is not only unacceptable but, unethical and a testament that people "rob" people in bright daylight and hide behind policies for no reason. No business should have more leverage than their client. Business and government serve people not the other way around.

name: Joel Pascol
title: It's very difficult to publish a…
text: It's very difficult to publish a property, after you publish the house they block it and stay for days telling you that you have to confirm the right location. I contacted support several times and they still couldn't resolve it. headache

name: Mindi Coulter
title: Sounds like I’m not alone
text: Sounds like I’m not alone. Now on my 7th phone call. Asked for a refund for a cancelled booking 13 days ago. Still waiting….

name: Paul Bradford
title: We went as a family of 6 to Villa Lucie…
text: We went as a family of 6 to Villa Lucie in Cilipi and we had an amazing time! The Villa was simply stunning and everything you needed and the owner Lucie was so helpful and the meet and greet was exceptional! Lucie couldn’t do enough to ensure our experience was outstanding! We shall definitely return.

name: Alastair Phillips-Meiklejon
title: Left my family abandoned, with no accommodation and not a single thing done to resolve the situation
text: This review follows my wife calling me in tears after trying to check in to accommodation booked through VRBO. As it transpires, the vendor of the property doesn’t exist, neither does the property - but VRBO do not check this. You could advertise a chalet on the moon with them, and they would happily take their commission without so much as a phone call.Speaking of phone calls, there have been over 100 of them with nobody taking any responsibility or offering any resolution. Many apologies and promises to resolve the situation, but of course nothing has been done. You won’t see any response to this review, and I doubt you will ever see any. It’s a faceless company that offers dreams, but ends up selling you a nightmare.

name: Lee
title: Trying to make a claim
text: Trying to make a claim using their insurance company.  Absolute joke. Website doesn't work. Keep the money and I'll book elsewhere in future.

name: Claire Peters
title: Confirm any booking with the Venue NOT with Vrbo.
text: On 21/7/24 I booked a 2 night stay for myself & my husband at a self catering luxury lodge with private hot tub in Warminster for 16/17 Aug 24. Confirmation email was received and cost paid in full. The link gives the option of leaving a message for the Vrbo host which I duly did, but I did not get any response from him. On 13/8/24 I received 2 emails to confirm the trip and given the booking details.  We then spent 4 hours travelling to the venue, stopping off in Warminster to purchase some food/supplies for our break.  Upon arrival at 4.45pm, we contacted the number provided on the reception kiosk and spoke to the 'host of the lodge' who gave us directions to the lodge.  Upon arrival at our lodge, we found someone else was already in occupation. I called the 'host' again, who looked at her bookings and was told the third party booking company 'Vrbo' hadn't made or confirmed the booking with her, she had no other lodges available and that I would need to speak to Vrbo. I appreciate this situation was out of her hands, but she was very unhelpful and really wasn't interested in the situation we found ourselves in.  I then called Vrbo... The first man I spoke to took the details of the matter, put me on hold for 5 minutes then cut me off.  2nd call I spoke to a lady, explained the whole situation again and asked her not to cut me off like the previous call handler did.  She then made a call to the 'lodge host' who re-confirmed that she had no accommodation available. The Vrbo call handler asked if we wanted her to source alternative accommodation for us! We politely refused the offer and asked for a refund, and we would source our own accommodation for the 2 nights. We then got transferred to another call handler in the refunds department - we had to go through the whole situation for a third time...  We did get a confirmation email that a refund had been requested which will take 5-7 days. The call lasted over 50 minutes.  We then had to find other accommodation outside the area, and wasted over £30 on food & drink that we could not use/keep as we didn't travel with a fridge or hob! Not impressed with Vrbo and will never use them again. You have been warned.

name: ScottCad
title: Unscrupulous hosts and complicit in soliciting extra charges
text: I should have read the many other reviews before booking. They allow unscrupulous owners to freely take extra charges from your payments details with no evidence. Host, after leaving us a 5 star review, accused us of taking at least half of his dirty laundry on our tour of Florida. Clearly a mistake but their property manager and then hidden. Or just a way to solicit extra funds. Support useless. Pretend to help. Get you to jump though hoops only to reject your claim and side with the host that is paying them fees and therefore complicit in their criminal activity.Re VRBO reply. There was no evidence or resolution provided. Had little doubt that they would rule in favour of the one lining their pockets.  Based on no evidence of any proper investigation and no sight of any evidence, I am not sure how VRBO can suggest that a resolution was provided. They didn't even respond to my last request.

name: Chris Buxton
title: Didn’t even have the same number of…
text: Didn’t even have the same number of bedrooms as advertised! Fraudulent! Customer service embarrassingly bad.

name: Cathy Mccafferty
title: I booked and paid for 2 nights
text: I booked and paid for 2 nights, and then to be told that the dates was not available and I would receive a refund, never ever received my refund. Give up trying in the end.! Never use this site again. I also have the messages / evidence of this.

name: Susanne Schmidt
title: Lady Willow Rose narrow boat booking…
text: Lady Willow Rose narrow boat booking was a dissappointing and annoying situation due to  changed location, no driving possibilities and rude / ignored communication.No service contact, no complaining reaction, no refunding,thoughcancellation/ refunding was accepted by the owner A. ...but nothing has happened ever since...

name: Rachel Blacklock
title: Waste of time complaining as they’re useless…
text: We had previously booked a family holiday on Vrbo, all went well and did not have to contact them on our stay.However on our recent holiday we had no notification from the owner that the resort was under construction. We never knew about the construction site till we arrived and there was a note in the table, saying it would all be okay, but when we went to get food it effected the whole strip. If you want to eat and drink on a building site then it would have been fine but we wanted a holiday not a building site and had to rent a car to go to other resorts. We contacted Vrbo and they appeared helpful during the conversation but did not get back to me. I contacted them again, lovely on the phone, empathetic, “that shouldn’t have happened and you’ve paid for cover”, then heard nothing. Contacted again and the women spoke about receiving a refund which took me by surprise, but again heard nothing. Eventually I got an email asking for photos of the villa and so I responded that the issue was the resort, they again sent the email asking about the villa, again explained it was the resort. Then heard nothing at all. Waste of a phone calls, waste of time, will just book via someone else in the future.To add to the poor experience, when sending an honest review of the villa, the host has then wrote an awful personal attack on my character back (when despite the issues I’d been complimentary re their villa) and it’s just there with no ability for me to challenge.

name: Matt Cusick
title: Vrbo stole my money
text: The vrbo website denied my booking.  But behind the scenes they charged my credit card for the booking.  By the time I realized this happened I couldn't cancel, it was too late, the vrbo support was useless and robotic in their resolve.  I lost the credit card dispute over a 3 month period.  I have filed complaints across the board.  Lost all the money.  Complete fraud.

name: T Meyer
title: Sadly, not a good option since being bought out by Booking.com
text: We previously had a listing on VRBO before they were bought out and it was great. We tried listing a new listing recently. The calendar wouldn't sync with other vacation rental calendars, causing a double booking. VRBO fined us $50 for their error and put us on a restricted status listing due to their error. Tried contacting customer service by phone and online chat four times. Got hung up on all four times and we were not rude at all, just trying to solve the problem. We are now removing our listing from VRBO. We don't have time for this. There are much better sites for finding vacation rentals, particularly Air BnB. Don't choose Booking.com. That's who bought VRBO and ruined it.

name: nicola
title: stayed in a filthy/dated villa booked…
text: stayed in a filthy/dated villa booked via VRBO, Villa Ramos Uno, Puerto Calero, Lanzarote, little help at all from VBRO, will not be using them again.

name: CMN
title: Headaches with Refunds
text: On May 26, 2024 my husband booked a 6-day trip for a resort in Hawaii. Then next day, we found out VRBO couldn't add days, so we canceled the reservation and made other arrangements. The resort returned our whole deposit on May 28, but not VRBO.  Over two months and six phone calls later, each with a polite VRBO Support Team member who said s/he had to refer our information up to a higher level team, we gave up. On July 22, I contacted people from the Chase credit card used for the booking, and they were able to convince VBRO to return the $521 fee back. Ironically, the date of the transaction on our July statement is recorded as 5/28/24.

name: MZ
title: The Worse Customer Serve I Have Ever Had
text: I don't want to have to retell my story as I have done it multiple times during my 5 hours of phone calls trying to resolve my issues. I even contacted the executive team to try and resolve it. Unfortunately they only responded that they would look at it and haven't done so. My vacation was ruined. I was left scrabbling myself to get accommodations as my family looked on. The owner of the company cancelled 4 hours prior to check-in and VRBO did very little to help. In fact I wish they had just told me I was on my own from the beginning. The process of dealing with them has been painful. Never again!

name: Roddy W
title: Inaccurate description / poor support from Vrbo
text: We booked a villa for seven nights in Provence. On arrival we were told that the swimming pool had an issue - the water had turned green, cloudy and wasn't usable during our stay due to potentially dangerous bacteria.This was very upsetting considering it's the main reason people will book the villa and they could have informed us before our arrival. The solution we were offered was the location to a public swimming pool.We contacted the owner who turned out to be very unfriendly and not sympathetic. We left the villa after 2 nights meaning we lost the remainder of the holiday.We contacted Vrbo for support - they said it was the owners discretion if he should return any of the rental cost. The customer services have not replied / ignored emails.A very upsetting experience and it seems to be a common trend with other reviews on trust pilot for Vrbo's customer support.

name: Margot Mifflin
title: Used to be fine, now terrible
text: They were great for years when all went well, but this year, the first time I had a problem with a house, they took the info, promised a call-back and I never heard from them again by phone or after follow up emails with the complaint #. Their web site is horrible (it's impossible to find either a house you rented or how much you paid for it, even under "account" or "my trips". I had to call to get this basic info.)  And they approved the posting of a house that was incomplete (no photos of kitchen or moldy bathrooms) and inaccurate (a non-existent hot tub was listed).

name: Robert Aiken
title: Villas at meadow view
text: Villas at meadow view, Show Low AzReserved a first floor unit in Show Low. .Wanted Three night stay but settled for two because they only had a two night available.Then when I arrived at the site they said I reserved a Second floor unit.I called before reserving because I can not walk the long staircase to the second floor and now after I made other reservations they changed their story and offered me what I originally wanted.  Too late.Unfortunately the apartment the rented me was too cold and the thermostats was not working.  In addition the fan AC was on high.  Very uncomfortable, add a lumpy mattress and we could not sleep.  Left the next morning at 5am.  Spoiled vacation.  The apartment  has an interesting floor plan and with better maintenance wound be a good place to stay.

name: Ahmed
title: The worst experience i ever had when i…
text: The worst experience i ever had when i decided to reserve on expedia, the apartment owner refuse the reservation and let me with my family on the street then i called the customer service they told me it's vrbo reservation and you must contact them after many calls for a three hours they told me sorry the owner will cancel the reservation and you will be refunded. I resreved in another place for a triple price. I contact a lawyer to sue expedia. Any help will be appreciated. I have all the documents. ahmedbeik2 at gmail

name: LefAna
title: They didn’t send our reservation to the…
text: They didn’t send our reservation to the host. For 8 hours I was in the streets trying to find a solution!!!  Finally after so many calls, the only thing that they did was to tell me that I will get my money  back!

name: Gary
title: WARNING!!! DO NOT USE!
text: WARNING!!!! Do not use this company at all. Booked a property and received confirmation of property being booked. Spoke to customer services to confirm check in and they were going to chase. Booked flights and drove to property. Was early so rang host to which was answered by a stunned host that did not have any information of the booking and has not used VRBO for over 10 years?? refund was issued and we were stranded in Spain with no accommodation (a young family of 4). Spent over 10 hours of first day of holiday on numerous calls with VRBO. Refund issued and could take up to 7-15days for refund? so stranded in Spain with no money and place to stay. VRBO booked a hotel for us for 3 days and after that it was up to us to find alternative arrangements bearing in mind refund may not be in our account until due back? No cooking facilities in hotel, in 2 sperate rooms for stay, all inclusive but we were room only with food and drink prices being very expensive (no money within budget for this) completely ruined holiday with stress of finding alternative accommodation and finding funds to use. No support from any of the customer service personnel and their attitudes were a complete disgrace towards us as customers. Told that I could not speak to anybody higher and put on hold numerous times throughout over 20hrs of calls. Then to be told they would just keep putting me on hold??? Stranded in Spain with nothing thanks to VRBO. we as a family are completely appalled by this disgrace of a company.No inconvenience support or funds to help with food during hotel stay.

name: Sylvia Bowman
title: When they say you'll receive a FULL REFUND if cancelled before such a date....that isn't true!!!
text: I booked 2 homes On Hilton Head Island for October in July. I had until beginning of August to cancel for 100% FULL REFUND. I cancelled July 22 and July 23. I had to contact both of the Vacation Rentals properties to get back my refund. I lost a total of $609.57. Clearly this is NOT a full refund. I have used VRBO for many years. I will NOT, and I mean NOT ever use them again!!!!!

name: Nebi
title: The worst service that I got so far
text: The worst service that I got so far. Host requested extra money after I completed the booking and paid the all cost. Support said "we need to negotiate with the host" and also redirected me to the host for negotiation.

name: Akira Ueno
title: VRBO cancelled our reservation less than 24 hours before our arrival
text: VRBO cancelled our reservation at 9:30pm on the night before our flight to San Francisco and less than 24 hours before we were scheduled to arrive at the house.  VRBO lied about the reason for the cancellation as being due to "Natural disaster or property damage".  We talked to the host and confirmed that that was not true.  Talked or chatted with 3 different VRBO customer support people.  First person put me on hold to "consult with supervisor" and then after 30 minutes on hold, the connection was dropped with no call back even though I left a call back number.  Second person says there were no supervisors available to handle my complaint.  Third person says he put in an escalation request and that I should here a response soon.  Of course, no one from VRBO ever followed up with us.  Spent the morning of the flight booking multiple, expensive hotel rooms far from the person we were visiting. The only thing VRBO did right was a prompt refund of cost of the rental.  Otherwise, the experience was awful.

name: Jon Anderson
title: Vrbo’s / Host left us without accommodation.
text: Booked weekend accommodation and paid at the time of booking and balance when requested. Contacted the host 3 days prior break as instructed by Vrbo, Host Paul. replied and cancelled reservation, host stated “These dates had been booked by another guest before your booking. Not sure why Vrbo has these dates open, but unfortunately we won’t be able to host you”. We contacted vrbo’s helpline who said they would get their booking team to help us to make alternative arrangements. We are still waiting for Vrbo despite regular attempts to contact them. The departure date has been and gone! Vrbo did not bother to find us other accommodation and left us high and dry. Vrbo said if the host had double booked they would fine him and remove him from the platform for 7 days only. Please be aware as it seems Vrbo are accepting payment for properties that are not available. Or the host is double booking his property. We have posted this to try to warn people of these issues to avoid people being disappointed by poor processes. Vrbo made no attempt to help us yet were quick to take and keep our money, it appears we may have been refunded. However this ruined the weekend and we then had to book another accommodation via another platform no where near where we planned to go. Poor show and extremely poor customer service and no intent to help.

name: Ahmad
title: One of the worst companies out there
text: My booking was cancelled 2 days before by VRBO. I was told I need to rebook through them which I tried but couldn't find anything so short notice. I still have not recv'd a refund for my holiday despite numerous calls and emails. One of the worst companies I have ever come across. Please stay away from this site.

name: ALFREDO VALERO
title: Vrbo: worst customer service ever
text: We were overcharged when making the payment. After 10 days calling Vrbo everyday, wasting a lot of time, Vrbo was unable to get in touch with the owner to know why they had overcharged us. Unbelievable but true. A lot of of ("we understand your request, we are working on it") but no answer in 10 days. They even told me that it was me who had to get in touch with the apartment owner. They passed their incompetence and lack of control on to me!. Nevertheless I tried many times, but the owner never answered: telephone, email, whatsapp,…never answered!. Unbelievable but true…When my complaint was finally scaled to an English speaking (poor English, btw) responsible "in our headquarters", she was extremely unpolite...and ended up hanging up!!!. Unbelievable but true. Vrbo has no control on their property owners and the customer service could be done by any amateur IA software. Never again!.

name: Paul Nicholas
title: Host not been paid
text: As a host I am in a similar position as the poster below.  I am still waiting for payment 14 days after being told my money would be in my account.   Have wasted 8 hours on the phone and have been told that this matter is being resolved 3 times and that the case has been escalated as high priority.  Please think before listing your property with this company!!!   It would appear that the only way to get payment from VRBO is to take them to Court

name: Clare Ashton
title: VRBO said my booking was cancelled.the day before arrival
text: The host hadn't sent check in details the day they should, so I rang VRBO and they told me booking was cancelled as the final payment had been declined. I sent them proof of payment and they emailed back saying 'thanks for your proof that you have paid but you really havent'!!. In the end the booking was ok and we had a lovely stay but the stress of being told it was cancelled the day before would definitely put me off using VRBO again

name: Adam Powell
title: Still not been paid
text: Vrbo took the money when the guests booked then hung onto it. I've contacted customer services three times already and each time I've been told my case has been passed to their specialists, that all my details, tax forms etc are in order and I'll just have to wait.My guests were lovely and I enjoy meeting people, normally via Airbnb. If I eventually get paid I will delete my listing and continue just using my Rustic Bulgarian village experience on Airbnb.If I could give zero stars for service I would.

name: Melanie Gallie
title: I usually don’t bother with negative…
text: I usually don’t bother with negative reviews but as Vrbo have let us down to such an extent, I see no other option. I wish I had seen all the other negative reviews before booking through them.We went on holiday to Mexico and had lots of issues with the property we were staying at. Luckily the property owner herself was very understanding and helpful and agreed for us to leave early but Vrbo refused and we ended up being charged twice. When we returned home and received the refund, Vrbo even deducted £150 off for processing the refund. All in all they made in excess of £1,000 from us but not being helpful in any way.Customer service is unresponsive. Didn’t call back within the promised time and every time we did get through we had to go through the same argument again. One agent agreed we should receive a refund and the next agent completely refused. Having to deal with a company like that while on holiday and trying to relax was extremely stressful and I hope people read this and decide not to use Vrbo - ever!

name: Grant Goold
title: Had my confirmation in hand
text: Had my confirmation in hand. Arrived on site (2-hour drive) in Park City Utah, only to find out the place was double booked.  VRBO promised to help and never contacted me back after a promise to do something.. Eventually drove back home.  Now more than 2 weeks later, and after several hours on the phone trying to speak to Angle (account supervisor), they refuse to return my calls. VRBO rejected my review of the entire event. I am out 4 hours of drive time, gas, and events with friends. They even sent me an email demanding payment after they screwed up.  VRBOpromised multiple times to take care of it and are now refusing to even be professional and return my calls.  They even gave me a "case number" No big deal. I think I have shared my story with 4 customer reps who must hear the entire store "before they can contact a supervisor" Please do not use VRBO as they will not admit to their mistakes, make it right, and refuse to take care of the guest.  Worst customer service I have ever experienced in my six decades of life!!!!

name: Shellie- Ann Sawyers
title: VRBO does not support its clients
text: If I could give this site a million zeros I sure would!I’m convinced that VRBOs credit has gone down, and their customer service my good is the worst! They don’t help you in any case, and expect you to do the grungy work to get your money back!I was in a bad situation and decided to end my lease and rent a bro property for a month until I can figure out my situation, the property was at 1620 Islington , listed as 1bedroom with no mention of sharing space with other occupants.Once the payment went through I reached out to the host asap to confirm reservation. All seemed well until he told me that he won’t give me the code until the day I checked in, now my suspicions up.Day comes to check in ready to go, he gives me the code and then tells me I’m sharing the property with 2 other men. As a female I will never share a place with people I don’t know, especially males that was not mentioned in the vrbo post.I advanced my concern and told him I like to cancel as he lied about the property. After him trying to get me to cancel, I reached out to vrbo support and had told them about the lies this host posted in order to get money.With messaging back and fourth between the host and vrbo sad support service, with no resolution other than vrbo refunding me their service fee and them dicking me around saying they reached out to the host and policy applies.Not sure how a policy can apply, when they saw the ad, and took it down themselves. So if you can take down the rental property you can’t do much better in seeking clients refund back on a scammed property.I finally reach out to my bank after the allotted time and initiated a charge back, provided all information of communication to my bank.As they did their investigation, they provided me with provisional credit to cover what was taken, that’s includes the refundable fee, which I still never got back.Now a month later Roman Bodnarchuk, made a méchant claim providing a receipt, what the receipt you receive after someone purchases something  laughable! This triggered a reverse of my claim on a property I didn’t stay at; like once finding out you’ll be staying with 2 other people which was not mentioned on the vrbo ad would you still go? I for sure would not, he has done this before and I have my information to present! He has messed up my account and I fear he will keep messing up my account! With this charge back, back and forth. Vrbo has no say as they have become MUTE!I’m taking this back to the bank and will be reaching out to the other people who have fell victim to this MONSTER! And reporting him to the BBB!Vrbo needs to do muuuuuch better to refund people back,  and not have their clients have to run through hoops to get their money back! Especially if you’re dealing with a scammer!I hope there will be a class action on vrbo, because it seems that a lot of the reviews are negative!!!!Vrbo needs to be shut down! And Roman the cops are coming for you!

name: Raquel Vidal
title: The worst customer service experience I have had
text: The worst customer service experience I have had and I will not be renewing my subscription next year. Technical issue with a booking on my account that I logged two weeks ago still not resolved. Told several times by the customer service team that it would be escalated, only to find out each time I called to chase, that it had not been escalated. All this while they keep the client's deposit. Unhappy client, unhappy host.

name: nono lerobot
title: Robbery agency
text: I have booked one room and the host contacted me to cancel because VRBO used to not pay him on time... He didn't wanted to deal with them anymore. I have sent the discussion between the host and me to VRBO. Try to explain several times to 3 different departments but none of them was able to provide me guarantee for a reimbursement.

name: Robert Wright
title: As  a host I have to say that Vrbo are…crap
text: As  a host I have to say that Vrbo are one of the worst companies that I have ever dealt with.My listing is for a property in Barbados which they have shown on the map as some 8/10 miles inland rather than just 5 minutes to the beach in St James, which is obviously deterring visitors who do not want to travel half an hour to the beach. My attempts to have the location corrected have so far taken two phone calls each of more than an hour and still nothing has been resolved.Th second agent that I spoke to, based in Egypt, had never even heard of Barbados!!

name: jim
title: Rented a property in Northampton for 5…
text: Rented a property in Northampton for 5 people / bedding for 4 people / I pot and a pan/ lack of utensils/ 4 bath towels and 2 hand towels/ first bathroom handle on the tap was broken and the shower didn’t work / second bathroom no plug for sink fan and light won’t switch off / balcony door very hard to lock / password for Netflix with held / Maintenance man appears and said he would be back to fix things never seen him again / the smell of the drains / have texted them all this still waiting for a reply probably turn up with the maintenance man

name: Sinead Thompson
title: Should be a zero stars option
text: Should be a zero stars option. Booked accommodation through this site for an upcoming holiday. Our booking was cancelled by the "host" 3 weeks prior to our stay with no reason given. We asked for a refund on the £300 plus we paid on booking and were refused! Please don't book through this company, avoid at all costs. Scammers!

name: Vren
title: Do not use VRBO.. absolutely atrocious!
text: We booked an apartment in Aix Les Bains for 4 nights in July. The property details stated, parking onsite and beach location and balcony! 🤣🤣 We were at least 15-20 mins from the lake side and there was definitely NO onsite parking! You are supposed to contact the owner first if there’s an issue, which we did. They confirmed there was no onsite parking!! And it wasn’t a beach location 😕 So completely false property details! We initially dealt with the property management company, who eventually cut communication with us. Due to mobility issues we were not able to stay there! We couldn’t find any alternative accommodation locally and had to drive to another town 50mins away! I contacted Vrbo and spoke to a lovely gentleman who apologised profusely, he tried to contact the owner and then told us he had put the phone down on him! He promised a full refund and also offered to pay for our first night hotel in Grenoble! Great we thought… then nothing…?! Numerous emails from us went unanswered and our phone calls to Vrbo were clearly designed to frustrate, delay and deny customer satisfaction at all costs! Being put on hold for 45mins numerous times and getting cut off was a frequent occurrence! They then reneged on the original offer and refused our refund! Last week now back in UK I made it my mission to deal with VRBO once and for all. 3hrs and 48mins later I finally got the refund! It was a dirty fight tbh but I refused to lose! I had to threaten legal action before I got to speak to a supervisor even! I did not get any other compensation or the first night in the alternative accommodation, but to be honest the stress wasn’t worth it! I know it won’t happen to us in future because I will never use VRBO ever again. Keep spreading the word about this despicable company and their abysmal customer service! Do not use, you have been warned!!

name: y l
title: Charged when cancelling
text: I booked a place for the summer and was requested to pay up front. The trip was cancelled and as a result I cancelled my reservation. When the cancellation was processed i was charged for both the original charge and the returned amount a 3% exchange fee. Airbnb does not charge those fees and returns the full amount paid.

name: Alastair
title: Won't remove false adverts or publish reviews
text: Stayed at a property through vrbo. Mostly fine, except parking was not available as advertised.Vrbo have not published the review or removed the false advertising despite this being raised with them multiple times. Customer service will not do anything.As any advert on the site could be false and only positive reviews seem to be published, there is no way of knowing what you are booking. Will not use again.

name: Gite Florence
title: I am a host who has also had enough of…
text: I am a host who has also had enough of VRBO/Abritel.  I had a lot of problems when I first tried to advertise my accommodation,  From it not showing on searches on their site, which is still hit and miss and ongoing problems with uploading photos and what I can and can't write..... recently I have an issue which I can relate to many of the customer reviews about cancellations but from a host perspective.  I  use the vrbo app to manage my property and bookings. I had blocked all of August as I had bookings through other websites, then out of the blue I get an immediate booking for 3 nights in August! I check my ap, all is blocked, so how can this happen?  For some reason I thought I'll do a Google search for vrbos site and log in that way. To my dismay there was a blank calendar with full availability and now this poor persons booking. Unfortunately I had to immediately cancel the booking and confirm a full refund, apologising profusely for vrbos mistake.  Now a week later I get an automated email saying my site is suspended because of marketplace violation!  Enraged I look to contact vrbo, the waste of time chat bot doesn't like what I'm referring to so cuts me off, there is no email address to complain to and I'm certainly not paying to phone them from France to the UK..  I don't know what's going on but something stinks on host and travellers perspective.. steer clear, a lot of rival booking agents are much better... I have now cancelled my account with all vrbo sites.

name: Dan L
title: clear cut fraud
text: We paid Vrbo to rent a property in France. We arrived at the destination and found the property was owner occupied, not for rent at all. The person that placed the advert no longer owned the property and had sold it to new owners. We had to find emergency accommodation, lost £1,200 on the initial "rental" and had to pay out £2,600 + £600 for the emergency accommodation.  Vrbo have been evasive and lacking in moral integrity. They DO NOT perform background checks; a simple google search revealed that the fraudulent host had a long history of financial problems and court judgements. BEWARE WHEN USING VRBO. YOU WILL BE TAKING A HUGE RISK. They also are refusing a refund.

name: MSO
title: I cannot recommend Vrbo based on our…
text: I cannot recommend Vrbo based on our experience.We booked and paid for a holiday apartment through Vrbo - that aspect was fine, however trying to get our damage deposit back has been horrific and still not successful.  We left the apartment in perfect condition, exactly following the instructions from the host.  They continue to send generic texts saying they have instructed their bank but we have not received the refund.Trying to follow-up effectively with Vrbo for support in the event of an issue is a nightmare - multiple calls going through the same generic questions, no effective resolution or way forward, and in the latest case being placed on hold for 30 minutes before the call was cut off.I am left wishing we had never booked with Vrbo.

name: Richard Darcy
title: Apartment in Lestartit Spain
text: We booked an Apartment in Lestartit spain through VRBO.The apartment had a horrific smell throughout, preventing us from eating and spending any time inside the apartment.After notifying the letting agent and sending several messages through this site it took  the company 5 days to take any action.Really really disappointed with the whole service.

name: PMH
title: Property amenities not correct don't believe the listings
text: We booked a property on vbro but when we arrived the pool had restricted use. There was no mention of this on the property listing on vbro. We would not have booked had we known. Vbro didn't care when we complained and did nothing to make the property change their listing. We will not use vbro again.

name: Hannah
title: Never ever use this website
text: Absolutely awful customer service. We turned up to our booking to find out the host’s phone number was registered to a number in Brazil that was disconnected. We were left in the lurch with absolutely no help from customer services, no alternative options offered and only refunded 5 days after. Absolutely dreadful company, no apologies, no communication and multiple hours spent on the phone going round in circles. Our trip away was ruined and the worst thing is that the accommodation is still available to book online!

name: Marilyn Herman
title: Vrbo invite you to pre-approve…
text: Vrbo invite you to pre-approve bookings, but then don't pass on any discounts you've set up. So they've lost me a booking because - while I was trying to sort this out with Vrbo - the person wishing to book found another place.  You get nowhere trying to speak to their representatives.

name: Deb Judway
title: No help,12 days notice vaca canceled!
text: With only 12 days notice our vacation was canceled via the email that I found in my junk email 3 days prior to check in. So this would be Monday July 29th. We were supposed to check in at the property on Thursday,August 1, 2024) No one from VRBO phoned to let us know that the owner had cancelled the reservation. (how are they allowed to cancel only 12 days prior? Shouldn’t it be more like 30 to 60 days? What is VRBO policy to protect their customers from this sort of thing?) The CT owner (or host Carol Bona) did not even phone or text to ensure that I got the cancellation message! We booked this property at the start of March 2024. And I had just contacted and them on July 15th (2days) before the cancellation on July 17, 2024. I only found out about it as I was trying to show our rental to a coworker. When I couldn’t bring up the property or photos and noticed that the reservation status showed canceled. I made a desperate attempt to try to reach to the host Carol Bona to let her know that I hadn’t canceled and in the mean time and I tried to connect with Vrbo. I couldn’t even find a phone number or an email. But since they were associated with Hotels.com, I reached out to them for help on their Internet chat. Hotels.com let me know that the money was refunded and they gave me the phone number for Vrbo. (Vrbo United States 877-228-3145 or 877-202-4291 Outside the US 1-512-782-0805) I was on hold with them for almost 30 minutes (while at work and being totally freaked out ) and then they hung up on me.  When I get out of work 2:30 pm I was able to look for the cancellation notice and finally it in my junk email, and the cancellation was due to the owners death ( He lived at other property in Florida, or the Caribbean, I forget specifically where the other property was)  But why didn’t they honor the reservation? why are they allowed to just cancel at any time? Not just mine, but there were others reservations, after mine. This property was booked into September.Anyway, I also called Vrbo back, the Rep said they would expedite the matter. However No one called by 5:30pm so I called again, I was assured that the Expedite team would call me back, that they were researching properties & would call when they had the available properties that would match my reservation. I replied to the rep that it was in the middle of summer & and I was due to check in on Thursday (August 1,2024) with family. This would be an impossible and he assured me that they had access to properties that I couldn’t view on their website. So I waited and in the meantime, I researched  a Plan B for ourselves. No one from VRBO ever called us back. It was a complete line of BS just to get off the phone. Thursday came and went not a soul from VRBO called me. It’s now Monday, August 5th and no one has called to apologize or anything. We specifically rented the property in West Suffield Connecticut, because it was the in between point for our family and friends and because it had a pool with a large space as we were going to host a gathering for about 30 to 40 people. The host and owner knew this and we’re excited that someone was going to host a party there.  I even went and viewed the property in person to make sure that it was fine. They did refund our money but that doesn’t make up for the loss of time and effort, the scrambling to find to find another place to hold the party, and notifying all the guest of a new location.  We purchased items for the party, 2 large patio umbrellas & stands so that we would have shade around pool, an ice serving table and other items not to mention the invitations that were sent out. I will do my best to discourage everyone I know & meet to NOT use VRBO. They are a fraudulent reservation service.

name: Emily Burrows
title: I would even give one star!!
text: I would even give one star!!! But I had to.  Booked an apartment in Spain which we worked hard to save for.  Got here and not the apartment we booked. name: Steve Quinton
title: Do not use Vrbo
text: Booked an aparthotel in Spain. My wife set up a Vrbo account, booked Hotel and paid all the money. A couple weeks later my wife tried to log into account and check what percentage we had paid. name: Robert
title: DO NOT USE VRBO.
text: DO NOT USE VRBO.I booked a 7 bedroom house in France for my wife myself our 3 kids and spouses and 6 grandkids 15 months ago at a cost of nearly 6 grand. Absolutely disgusting and I hope everybody reads this and doesn't book anything with them. BEWARE OF THIS COMPANY.I ONLY GAVE THEM 1 STAR AS THERE IS NOT A LOWER SCORE TO GIVE

name: Bryan Welker
title: I was caught in the Global IT outage on…
text: I was caught in the Global IT outage on July 19th. I live in Colorado and the VRBO we rented was in Atlanta. Due to the flights getting canceled we were unable to fly.
