name: Joanna Bullock
title: Booked an expensive house very quirky
text: Booked an expensive house very quirky, the owners changed the bedroom situation after I paid and didn't warn us only noticed due to looking at photos before we went, the beds in the bedroom we were using changed from double to single so had to go along with it but single beds were awful & didn't get one good night sleep, complaint to VRBO who we pay for the holiday but when u complain it's back to the owners who of course IGNORE u as u r complaining, VRBO just pass the book!!! Put bad feedback on the holiday place and that has been ignored and not issued, then had owner feedback who childishly had the nerve to leave us 1 star and VRBO still don't care, also had lots of other things wrong dont think VRBO check properties before advertising them. Pls do not ever use this company as dont care once paid!! Stick to bigger famous companies as no one I know has ever heard of VRBO!!!!

name: Mike Smith
title: Processes designed to ensure you don't get refunds owed.
text: After finding out after turning up on the booked date that the apartment booked had been removed from their platform, Vrbo's customer service informed me that I could book alternative accomodation, either on their platform or through a number of provided hotel booking websites, up to a cost of approximately £200 more than my original booking.Having done this, I submitted a claim through their requested email channels with all the requested documentation and evidence of the hotel I had booked.Despite twice chasing this and being told the refund was indeed being processed, I phoned again on 22nd July to be informed that I hadn't provided my ID and thus my refund request hadn't gone anywhere... despite them not originally asking for ID where the replacement booking was made off their platform.I was told at this point that my case was now to be processed and had been escalated and prioritised. When I asked how long this would now be and what the SLA for such a prioritised case was, I was told that the department handling the case does not provide timelines as "this would upset customers if they did not hit the agreed dates"(!).Despite being ensured that my case had been escalated and that I would absolutely be receiving an email to confirm it was being dealt with, I rang and chased again today on 6th August.  After nearly an hour on hold to various agents, the agent from the Resolutions team told me the course of action now was to do exactly what his colleague from the same team had done, that he would send an email to Guarantee team and that they would prioritise it accordingly.  Once again I was told, despite it being 11 days since initially being escalated to that team that no timeframes could be provided and that I would have to wait indefinitely before finding out whether my refund was to be processed or not.  When I challenged this again saying this is exactly what I was told last time, I was told to check my email as the information I needed was there and that the agent was going to "politely end the call". He hung up on me as I explained that I was looking at my email inbox and nothing had been sent to me.I have been left in no doubt that Vrbo's processes are specifically designed to frustrate and confuse to discourage customers from following up on any owed money from the company.I don't suspect I will ever see the roughly £150 Vrbo still owes me at this point.Company are crooks.

name: Ezzy
title: Taking them to court.
text: Absolute rubbish.. we booked a place in March and travelling in August today.. found out the host has no idea about the booking.. they have been absolutely terrible helping with relocating us within the list of villas they have.. they have no help at all.. we are flying today and have no place to stay.. we are going to court first thing tomorrow! Lawyers are involved already..

name: Chris Saul
title: A week in Jullouville
text: We booked a week in Jullouville. During the 5th day a forced burglary took place and apart from damage to the property certain valuable items of jewellery were stolen from my wife’s suitcase. The local police arrived promptly and undertook a thorough investigation. The owner eventually arrived and assured us that her insurance ( mandatory in Vrbo’s own contract ) would cover our loss. This turned out to be false as the owner had NOT complied to this clause and so we brought this to the attention of management within VRBO , spending hours on the telephone etc. We were given a refund for our visit but nothing  for the value of items of stolen jewellery which were over several thousands of pounds! My wife was deeply upset as some of the items were part of an inheritance from her deceased mother. Apparently the owner deliberately ignored any further communication from VRBO as she realised that she had broken her contract as she only had insurance cover for her own property. Needless to say we shall never use Vrbo again and please take this as a warning for other potential users.

name: Jeanette Marshall
title: I would not rent with Vrbo again after cancellation 3weeks prior to booking
text: I would not rent with Vrbo again after having my booking for a family weekend away on August bank holiday (which I booked back in January) cancelled three weeks prior to our arrival date. The host cancelled  stating the reason as 'allowing someone else to book her property out and them having double booked it'  This was under the company criteria 'Natural Disaster or Flood'.We were refunded but received no help from the Vrbo advisor on my first call to find a similar property with them (neigh on impossible so to close to the bank holiday date anyway). After speaking to their line manager I received an email offering a much larger (and £500 more expensive property) and then a reimbursement offer in form of email to find a property on Vrbo of which Vrbo would stand the difference between original and any property up to £1000.  However again there were no properties with Vrbo available for the dates & requirements we had originally booked and this offer had to be used through them or Expedia with an expiry date of 6months. We were therefore had no choice to book with an alternative site at more cost and will be very unlikely to use their offer within the given timescale as our family budget does not allow for it.I shall neither be booking with Vrbo again or be  recommending Vrbo to family and friends!

name: Uncle Man
title: Beware of scammed from fake host
text: Came to the accomodation just to be told by owner the booking was nulled because the reservation was made through fake host listing called customer service the promised to compensate the inconvenience fees told to walk in to another motel and get reimbursed three weeks later after provided all neceasary documents been told by vrbo guarantee team not entitled because of these reasons stated by themDuring our review, we found that the first property owner provided a full refund of the original reservation. name: Lori Leach
title: I wish I could give this company zero…
text: I wish I could give this company zero reviews because they don’t deserve any. I hosted with them for several months and then a customer left me a review that was based on an amenity that my property was listed to not have. name: Legolas
title: DO NOT USE - Confirmed accommodation just cancelled
text: Booked a holiday in Deal near Dover. Had to abort my holiday in transit because neither VRBO nor TravelNest (property management) company could contact the host to give me access instructions. They take no responsibility, no alternatives provided, just a refund and a sorry not my responsibility attitude. DO NOT TRUST them. Wasted my time and money and holiday for my family was cancelled

name: Joel
title: Horrid customer service resolve
text: Prior to this trip, vrbo has been my trustworthy site to go to. As the saying goes, you never know how someone or a business is until they fail and then you see their true colors. Being human we all make mistakes, but to not own up to or correct when a site is improperly listed. When a property location in Orlando Florida is without AC in July with temps above 100 degrees. When the landlord of the location faults you because you arrived early and promises that the failed AC of the building which was out for 3+ days will magically be back on at my sites arrival time of 4pm (being told this at 2pm the same day) which never occurred. Failure of the front door to close and lock properly. At the end of the day, the sites general manager provided verbal evidence with his letterhead email. Despite all the above and having never stayed on site and having booked a hotel elsewhere impromptu, it's now a month later and still no resolve, no reimbursement.  VRBO demands I show picture proof. The VRBO property listing individual spitefully listed my reservation as used and even had the odacity to ask me to leave a review of his site to give him 5 stars even in the absence of having stayed at his location and all the turmoil. For VRBO to allow for all of this and to lack adequate customer service skills. Having made a dozen calls and about 10 hours of phone calls lost, very very doubtful I'll ever see any of my $500 back for my stay. Be very aware...IF YOU INCUR ANY PROBLEMS, VRBO ONLY ONLY ONLY CARES TO KEEP YOUR MONEY. PLEASE BE ASSURED OF THIS. I will never use VRBO again (15 years as a customer down the drain VRBO!).

name: Max
title: Fleas in our bed, Vrbo: "not a significant health issue" and no compensation offered
text: We booked a trip in Paris and woke up with painful and itchy bites all over our body. Under the bed sheets were huge black stains, bug husks and live wriggling flea larvae. The mattress was completely infested with fleas and had bitten us in the night. There is a cat at the property and usually sleeps in the main bed, so it's safe to assume that it is responsible for the flea infestation.We immediately called Vrbo who said it was our responsibility to contact the host to resolve it. The owner was not responsive to the issue and Vrbo have not offered any form of compensation. My case was escalated to the health and safety team who deemed the issue "not significant" enough. This is completely outrageous, considering that fleas spread diseases to humans and were the cause of the Black Plague.I was unable to get in contact with a CS supervisor and was promised a callback within 24hrs, but unsurprisingly, have not been contacted three days later.The property we booked was rated 9.2 from 35 reviews, so we were not expecting the flat to be as dirty and smelly as we found it. The whole place reeked of cigarette smoke, the cabinets were filled with half empty cracker boxes and the fridge was full of expired food. Vrbo are a terrible and irresponsible company who do not care one bit about the experience of their customers or the quality of the properties they advertise.

name: Steve
title: Never Again

name: Edisa Skocic

This experience was highly distressing and unprofessional.I strongly advise against renting this property. The lack of professionalism and communication was unacceptable. I will be seeking legal action due to the severe inconvenience and stress caused. I would not recommend Vrbo to anyone!!!!

name: Dj

name: Taylor
title: Be very careful of the reviews you read…
text: Be very careful of the reviews you read on their villa's.  It appears they delete the one's that are not good.  When they are asked about it they said my review broke their privacy rules - I read their privacy rules and it did not and when I asked if I could resubmit I was told it was too late.  Reviews of properties are what help us make our decisions on where to book our holidays.  The reviews on Vrbo website have no integrity if they are deleting the bad ones.

name: Boris Bos
title: Check your payments
text: I've hosted on  VRBO  for over 2 years now,  I get a lot less bookings on VRBO than on Airbnb. VRBO's cut is a lot bigger and you have to keep on checking your pay-outs closely because they don't pay out what they say they pay out. VRBO's website is buggy and support is awful and an absolute waste of time.  They ask for unnecessary attachment, but do not allow to send attachments. You have to keep on sending them a message every few seconds or so otherwise they disconnect the chat session. Also my experience with Airbnb customers is a lot better than with VRBO.

name: Lê Chiem
title: Never use VrBO
text: Never use VrBO. Worst nightmare to deal with customer service. Property listings are inaccurate.I booked for July 11-15. 2 days before my travelling, host moved dates to Jul16-19. I told them the dates didn’t work for me and beside having trouble to find alternate solution, host didn’t reimbursed 100%, saying that I am cancelling. Call VRBO support, after explaining many time the issue, the customers support said that they trying to convince the owner to reimburse 100% but owner doesn’t agreed. And that’s it, they cannot do anything about it!

name: Larry Lynn
title: Violated ADA laws. Ocean Ave with…
text: I booked a condo on Ocean Ave with Walter Franks as the Host, on April 24, 2024 to stay August 1 to August 4, 2024, and recently extended the stay for an extra day. On July 31, in the am, I received a call from a woman telling me she would be sending me videos with instructions to access the property, and asked about the weight of my service dog. At 8:57pm I received the texts but did not reply. The address did not match the address that I booked. I called back the day of my departure August 1, at 9:30 am and questioned the address. She told me that my dog was too big for the Ocean Avenue property and that she "upgraded" me to the new property. The old property was a top floor penthouse suite with the balcony overlooking the Santa Monica Pier directly across the street. The new propery was almost 5 miles north in Pacific Palisades, inland. I told her this was unnaceptable, and that if I could not stay in the Ocean View suite, I wanted a full refund. She told me she would refund the money.The thing is, I originally messaged Walter Franks (the host) and told him that I was bringing my service dog. I told this lady as well as messaging Walter Franks, that they are in direct violation of the ADA act. The lady told me that the dog was too big for the original unit. I do not understand that since the Ocean Ave ad claims it can accommodate 4 adults. My dog weighs 47 pounds. I filed a formal ADA complaint with the US Attorney Generals office. This is outragerous! VRBO needs to re-educate the property owners. I was all packed to go!!Date of experience: August 01, 2024

name: Mary Motyka
title: BEWARE
text: We reserved the house through VRBO. When we arrived, the unit had no working AC and no working bath. We contacted Housepitality LLC and were promised they would fix it. After 14 messages in 24 hours nothing had been done and we moved to a hotel. The host refuses to refund our fees even after we quoted their own contract clause back to them. "A missed cleaning that the Company cannot fix in six hours is a major issue. So is any issue that renders the property unlivable, unsafe, or otherwise is so major that the Company cannot fix in six hours. If space is available we will offer the Guest a free relocation to an equivalent or better property. The Guest is also entitled to a 100% refund instead of another property." VRBO refuses to assist because apparently leaving the premises, even if for your own safety and welfare, is a violation of their “trust policy.” Be aware that even though VRBO allows contractors to use their platform and they charge you a service fee, you will get no assistance from them at all.  I provided ample evidence and spent hours on the phone with their representatives.  We have filed a dispute with our credit card for what is clearly a breach of contract but have yet to receive any relief.

name: RED
title: ALMANCIL - ALGARVE
text: Alojamento n.º 1922439a.It's in Almancil, Algarve.The house was not clean, AC not working at 50% of the rooms.Review made, but not posted. I looks like censorship to me.Complaint made to Vrbo. No answer, whatsoever.Case 130025965.This company cannot be trusted.

name: Sara Gil
title: Don't trust what the customer service tells you

name: Jason Barkla
title: Useless Service - Do Not List Your Property
text: Hosted short-stay tenants using Vrbo. Firstly booking only showed 4 adults, when we asked guests they had 4 children coming as well. We were OK with children but did not have 8 beds. Vrbo knew of the number of guests but told me they do not count the children in their booking info sen to us.Personally prepared the house before day of arrival, very clean (we had potential buyers inspecting). Tenants left a mess, dirt stains on cushions, carpet and walls, food stains on furniture, floor, deck and cushions (which they tried to hide by flipping over). Vrbo assured us they would withdraw review if false. Tenants gave "1 star" review and made false and exaggerated claims about property without proof. Contacted Vrbo to have it withdrawn and they refused saying it had passed their internal review process and was final.All contact with Vrbo had to go through live-chat which was slow and in some cases dropped out with Vrbo rep not getting back in touch.We have withdrawn the property from market due to frustration of this experience.

name: GL
title: For once trust the reivews do not use!

name: Esther Oturu

name: Miguel Pardo
title: Extremely Disappointed - False Damage Claims
text: I recently rented this holiday home for a peaceful getaway, but my experience was far from pleasant. name: Lucy Rooney

name: Rosalia Tranchina-Percey

title: NEVER again

name: R.A.H.Greenly
title: Terrible App
text: TheVRBO App is probably the worst I have come across. It is totally user UNFRIENDLY and takes hours to get anything done.

name: Martin
title: We paid a huge amount of money for a 5…
text: We paid a huge amount of money for a 5 week let in Spain. name: Catherine Halwick
title: Terrible terrible terrible
text: Terrible terrible terrible. Never got the code the morning of check in as the email stated. Had no place to stay after flying 1200 miles to our destination. title: Review ignored.

name: Annabelle
title: Smartly inaccurate listing and €500 stolen
text: I booked an accommodation in Les Contamines (France) labelled as an individual Chalet (Cabin) and it’s actually an apartment on the top floor of the owners' chalet, not the whole property.Indeed, the title of the listing states "Chalet Les Trolles", which means Cabin in French (and not apartment or condo), and the main photo also shows the chalet in its entirety. The main commercial appeal of the ad (title + main photo) is therefore clearly aimed at an individual chalet. There's no doubt about it and the ad is cleverly inaccurate. It is true that the body of the text further on reads that it's an apartment, but honestly, I was magnificently baffled by this maneuver and now simply feel trapped.I book regularly with Vrbo and am also in regular contact with your accounting team regarding taxes, but I have never felt this regarding a booking. As a result, when I realised it, 17 days before the 1st day of rental, I was forced to cancel and look for other properties in the area, so at the last minute, and with children. It was not very pleasant at all.I therefore requested a FULL refund of my 1st instalment INCLUSIVE of the service fee, so a total of 769.40€. The fact that the listing was, and still is, cleverly inaccurate is Vrbo’s responsibility and the hosts’, not mine, and in this precise case, it would be not fair in any way for guests to pay for that. The listing’s title should state « Apartment in Chalet Les Trolles » at the very least, if not « Half-a-Chalet », and show one of the rooms of the apartment as the main picture. This is basic business rules: controversial target picture and title.As today, on top of having hung up on me after I refused a ridiculous 100$ compensation fee in order for me to drop the case, Vrbo has categorically refused to reimburse me the full amount and let the hosts refund me only half of my 1st instalment. This represents only a third of my total payment. Worst, the decision to reimburse me the rest — so, the other half of my 1st instalment AND Vrbo’s own service fees as well — is in the sole hands of the hosts! Vrbo is showing how tributary they are to their owners! Which service fees am I paying for? I’ll tell you: Bad service! I should not only be reimbursed the service fees with no question whatsoever, but also be compensated for this total mess.What is the power of Vrbo? Inexistant. Why is it that the hosts have such a mainmise on Vrbo’s functioning? This is outrageous and so unprofessional compared to other providers like AirBnb and Vacasa who all reply within 24hrs for certain, when Vrbo keeps promising to call you back (4 times for this sole case!) and never does.As today, I still wait for a fair solving as this cannot be treated as a simple cancellation for personal reasons, but for reasons that directly address (1) a smart inaccuracy whose responsibility cannot legally be inputted on me — indeed, I have never ever edited this listing — and (2) a serious unprofessional business management.

name: Kathy Nelson
title: Buyer beware story:
text: Buyer beware story:Here is what we got renting from VRBO and no help fixing it or getting our money back. When we went in on Saturday, the unit was at 76, there was feces on the side of the toilet and the floors were so dirty that we couldn’t walk without shoes, and broken acrylic fingernails in the carpet. I cleaned what I could, didn’t complain, and gave the unit until the next morning to cold down. It didn’t. We contacted the host who called an A/C repairman. He did nothing so the temperature continued to climb. At this point, we contacted him again and VRBO to let them know the situation. The A/C guy comes back, tells us he has to order a part…it will be out a few days. Before we can contact the host to get a refund to leave, we find out that we have a roach infestation. I let the host know all of this and that we want our money back to leave or try to find somewhere else. He refuses, tells me I’m lying because his unit is always perfect in cleanliness, & that we should be patient and kind enough to wait it out for the A/C to be fixed. (It’s now 82-86 at all times in the unit.) The bug guy comes, and laughs when we tell him what had happened and informs us that this unit has had multiple issues with roaches. By Thursday, we have given up and start packing to go home because the roaches are everywhere, and the A/C won’t be fixed now until at least Saturday. VRBO won’t help. They will only make him give us back 50% of the stay despite the fact that their guarantee specifically states if you don’t have A/C for more than two days that they will correct the situation…they also won’t return their fees. Don’t use VRBO!!!!!This property is Unit D15 of Sand Dwellers I at 447 E Second St., Ocean Isle Beach, NC 28469.

Have to go through everything all over again and spend 15 minutes while they check out the case. They refuse to give me a case #, a manager, a better contact  they absolutly refuse.  Each time my case is being fast tracked and escalated up.

name: Sue
title: House on the lake we rented last week…
text: House on the lake we rented last week was outstanding, very clean and organized, and exactly as shown in the pix.  The nightly rate was fair, but the amount we had to pay for fees was almost half of the total rate, including the service fee that VRBO charged.  The cleaning fee was definitely too high. Damage protection was mandatory, and we feel that it should be an optional charge, or at least refunded considering we did no damage.  And, the fees were also charged state tax...that is just not right!  I should have been diligent before making the reservations almost a year ago, at which time I would have NOT made them.  No longer will be going through VRBO due to the exorbitant fees!

name: Annette Schlinghoff
title: As host
text: As host, have for the first time rented through VRBO.  The client has been in the property for 3 weeks without receiving payment - VRBO say payment has been made and keep sending us in a loop without resolving the issue.  Their customer service is terrible.  The payment has not yet been received.

name: Rachel Martens
title: Vrbo Owner
text: Vrbo OwnerWas an vrbo owner, zero owner support. Customer canceled booking the day of arrival due to medical emergency. I Never received payment, the Customer never received refund. despite multiple emails send on both mine and the customers end. We never got an response. I suggest using Airbnb.

name: Adrian Yates
title: No refund despite booking terms said I was entitled to one
text: Booked a week in Corralejo 28th January 2025 unfortunately had to cancel on 16th June 2024 booking conditions said free cancellation and refund if cancelled before 19th November 2024 with refund within 5 days despite several telephone calls to the host and VRBO it is now the 14th July a full month on and still no refund I will never use this website again. Think carefully before you book

name: Sarah
title: I gave 1 star as thats the least amount i could give. I think thats generous
text: I gave 1 star as thats the least amount i can give. My experience of this company has been quite unbelievable really and not something ive experienced to this point in my life from a company who have been round a long time.I paid a host via Vrbo £691 for a 4 day stay in San Roque, Spain for me and my child as a golf trip. 4 days before i was due to travel i still did not recieve any contact from the owner about what number his property was and how i access it, so i did a few live chats with Vrbo, and they also tried a few 3 way calls to the owner who just didn't respond. I was assured at this point that i shouldn't worry, as if the owner didn't make contact soon then vrbo would switch my accommodation, which unfortunately they did not do, despite them telling me that their specialist team would contact me. After numerous calls and live chats, the upshot was they were prepared to let me travel to Spain, with my child and not know where or if we were staying anywhere.Ultimately, i had to find an air b and b when i got to Gibraltar airport and pay another £891 to stay near the area i had originally booked through vrbo. To this point, even though they have said i will get a refund, i have had to chase them for it. They are quite simply the worst travel broker out there, and their customer service has to be experienced to be believed. Please do yourself a favour and do not go near vrbo.

name: _Amxrie
title: DO NOT RENT!
text: This is my first night here, and I'm already dealing with roaches! The kitchen is completely infested with German cockroaches, and I’m hesitant to unpack, cook, or place ANYTHING in this kitchen. Shoot anywhere in this house actually because if they’re in one spot, trust they’re roaming elsewhere. It’s very unpleasant and unsanitary and not enough raid provided to resolve this issue. It’s sad I’m out here buying supplies for roaches, should be ashamed. The old, rusted vents and uncovered light fixtures are just inviting them in. the roaches are having a field day up there. Update: took a shower and no hot water. It’s a nightmare!7/13/24: correspondence after informing the host of our concerns. I guess we should look for a true 4 or 5 star hotel because clearly they think roaches are acceptable living conditions. Told on the phone we would be provided a full refund, but because there is only 2 roaches in the video submitted its doesn’t suffice anymore and we were kicked out immediately instead of them hearing my concern and fixing things. Very argumentative, it’s not my fault you’re falsely advertising. Looking at the reviews now and looks like roaches been a problem. Not the first person to complain about roaches in the kitchen.DO NOT RENT HERE!!! NOT WORTH A DIME if we’re being talked to like we have no common sense

name: Jason Malham
title: VRBO allows personal attacks & lies in their reviews.
text: After being long-time AirBNB users, we gave VRBO a try. We rented a place in London and when we left I let the homeowner know they had an ant problem but never intended to leave a bad review or anything. Just letting them know. Even though the owner ACKNOWLEDGED they have an ant problem, they left a hateful review with personal attacks on our character and VRBO is actually letting the review stay online. They even have a record of our correspondence proving this owner told 3 or 4 lies about us in their review. But VRBO says they have to leave it because it "meets their guidelines". If personal attacks and verifiable lies "meet your guidelines", you should not be business. We'll return to using AirBNB.

name: Joe
title: Was the worst experience at an Airbnb.
text: Was the worst experience at an Airbnb.My family and I were in town for my Nana's celebration of life and was looking for somewhere we could be comfortable for the weekend.Sleeps 12, accommodates 10, she said we could have 8 but wants to charge us for additional people after our 8 people.She said pet friendly 2 pets. There was no option to input pets when booking.We only had 2 small dogs, she says she has video proof inside the house of 3 animals. Which isn't true, and concerning if she has cameras inside the house.All of the information that is listed in the ad is misleading. From the beginning we were over charged, and the communication was horrible.It says there is A/C but there is not! We spent hours trying to get cold air to blow, because the host wouldnt answer us, just to find out there isnt even an air conditioning unit on the property so we spent the weekend getting heat stroke because it is middle of summer and couldn't even cool down in the comfort of our Airbnb,we had to go spend our own money purchasing 3 fans to have some air flow during our stay.Some people need A/C during the summer because of health issues, and wouldn't book a place without it.And to have no option but to leave the 2 small dogs behind in a hot house with no air conditioning, with 2 fans blowing on them, ice in their water to stay cool and our own t-shirts soaked with cold water to help them cool down for the day while we went to my Nana's celebration of life was really disappointing.The ad states all the amenities included.There was no toilet paper (had to go buy our own), there was not enough towels for the amount of guests they knew would be staying there, not enough hand towels or face towels.We were left with 2 travel size bottles of 2 in 1 shampoo/body wash and a USED bar of body soap. No hair dryer like ad stated, no bidet like ad stated.The safety features says host hasn't indicated whether there is a carbon monoxide detector and to bring our own!As well as host hasn't indicated whether there was even a working smoke detector.The cupboards were all empty when we were told it was a fully equipped kitchen, so for the amount of people we had we couldn't even cook meals and had to spend more money to order food for everyone each day.We had nothing but a small pot and strainer to cook with. The container they had with coffee grinds in was moldy and looked like dog food.The ad says it has an outdoor oasis, with a spacious patio and bbq area, ad says the ourdoor space is perfect for al fresco dining and relaxation. The backyard was unmaintained, tall uncut half dead grass, unsafe steps to walk down, no patio area or bbq.We were told we had a 12pm checkout only to be threatened with cops if we didn't leave the property at 11. Cops showed up when we were clearly packing up to leave by our 12pm checkout, we showed them the information we were given and we were not in the wrong.The host showed up with the cops and sat outside in their vehicle to watch us for an hour while we packed up our vehicles and cleaned up behind us, and then sped away as we left.We were told additional guests would be $200, The host is now trying to charge us an extra $2700 fee ontop of the $1250 we already paid for having 2 additional guests. Which now they have switched and said the $2700 fee is for washer & dryer repair, when we didn't even use the washer or dryer. There wasn't even laundry detergent or enough towels to have to use the wash to begin with. And her message said that the washer dryer was in great working condition before we left.This has been absolutely unacceptable and unprofessional and I wouldn't wish it on anyone else trying to stay here!Really disappointing to be scammed like this while coming from out of town to grieve with my family.We have all the proof and receipts to back all of our complaints.

name: Cara Jennings

name: Paladin
title: AVOID VRBO
text: The allow a property to be listed and rented out with all of the below, and do not care to compensate the customer, or remove the property from rent, or have the owner correct the below:Washer, dryer, fridge, dishwasher, air filter, sink, and shower/ tub drains are all filthy. Fridge & dishwasher had discoloration & bad smells coming out of it. Washer & dryer have scaling and hair stuck all over them inside. Air filter completely coated with dust. Shower/ tub drains had hair in them. Dust & dirty hand/ finger prints scattered all around the walls & furniture. Misc. damage all over the walls, cabinets, counters, baseboards, pretty much on everything. The misc. damage could be overlooked, but it should be disclosed in the listing. Cutting board had crumbs on it. Drawers had misc. debris in them. A window was replaced or modified at some point and it appears to be leaking and has black mold all around it. The drywalling around it is poorly done, possibly not painted, and the corner beads are cracked. Electrical blank cover plates were partially covered by baseboards, voids in tiles around old shower fixtures that do not work, electrical cover plates modified or missing-- all building code violations. The voids around the shower had slugs coming in. A skylight is cracked, a window is cracked. There is a cable for the beam above the dining room table that is not screwed in, just hanging from the rafters. It is a great location, and a charming property, it is just not maintained or cleaned properly. This property should not be listed for rent anywhere until the shoddy construction is corrected, and is professionally maintained & cleaned.AVOID VRBO, use other rental agencies that actually value their customers and have good quality control for the property owners.

name: Lyndall
title: Rented this property for one month
text: Rented this property for one month. The house was ok, a bit grubby in places and very tired furnishings. Felt it needed a good spring clean. When I followed it up I was told it’s normal practice as an end of lease bond! I had not authorised or been told that this would occur. I was advised they held it for 5 days after the end of the booking. It’s the 6th day and I have t had any confirmation it has been credited back to my credit card. title: Refusal to refund

title: Very bad experience
text: We have rented a number of times over the years and it’s gone very well.  Hosts have been very responsive.Recently we rented a condo in Steamboat Springs.  It was in disrepair and dirty. We were not going to spend our vacation that way,  They took no responsibility for the condition.  At the very least we should have had cleaning fees returned to us.  We will not rent if there isn’t a direct link to host.

name: Rob
title: I am a host
text: I am a host. VRBO notified me of fraud on my account, but had already sent my payment to that account. This was April 2024. Eight times I called and each time it was being "escalated" (the word they are taught to use to make it sound important. When things go right, you don't need customer service. But when you need them, they are useless. Absolutely useless and I hate them so much.

name: Ryan Ertrachter
title: Absolutely awful customer service
text: Absolutely awful customer service. Could write an essay on how bad. Thankfully my credit card company could help out in regards to a reimbursement for a property that was double booked.

name: Pat Sadler
title: VRBO Scam/Fraud do not use.
text: VRBO Scam/Fraud do not use.We booked 3 nights in a lovely cottage in Sheringham Norfolk, 4 months before we went on June 21st 2024.Just before our holiday, we were sent the address!I checked on Google earth, and was shocked, it was a 3 story block of flats and ours was on the top floor, definitely NOT what we had booked.I spoke to customer service for 90 minutes, who is out of touch with the so called host and did not help.I contacted the host by text, with my issues of disappointment and shock etc. I received a cancellation, and a full refund. I had paid on Visa.We then had to find other accommodation, 2 days before our trip.It ruined the holiday that we were looking forward to, in a cute cottage.

name: Vicki Z
title: Closed my Case and Didn't Tell Me
text: If something goes wrong, VRBO washes their hands of the issue. We rented a not cleaned/maintained house and left early due to the situation. If you want a refund, talk to the owner directly." I'm now waiting for them to email me an official notice that the case was closed and why. Obviously this is not satisfactory as the owner is the person who did not care enough to maintain the property originally. We will not be using VRBO ever again.

text: Although I paid a substantial amount for 9 nights in Chania, Crete, at Koukouras Apartments and Hotel, I had an extremely unpleasant experience. name: Gavin Gam
title: VRBO house in valle Escondido, boquette Panama
text: Review Title: Unreasonable Host and Unresponsive VRBO - Avoid at All Costs!Rating: ★☆☆☆☆My recent stay at a house in Boquete, Panama, booked through VRBO, was a complete disaster. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that the host was unreasonable and unaccommodating, and VRBO did nothing to address our concerns.Firstly, we were charged for dishwashing tablets, of which there were only two in the house. It’s absurd to expect guests to purchase their own cleaning supplies for a short stay. Additionally, we were unaware that we needed to top up the toilet paper ourselves, an expectation that was never communicated to us.The house experienced significant flooding during our stay, causing water damage and making parts of the property unusable. Despite this, we were charged extra for cleaning. This is completely unfair considering the flood was due to natural causes and not our fault.After our stay, I was only refunded $6 from my deposit. The host charged us for every little thing, including extra cleaning, broken wine glasses, and incidental damages that were out of our control due to the flooding and power outages caused by a major storm.To add insult to injury, VRBO has not published my review on their platform, preventing me from warning future guests about this terrible experience. It's clear that VRBO is more interested in protecting bad hosts than ensuring a good experience for their users.I strongly advise against booking this property or using VRBO for your travel needs. The lack of support and unreasonable charges have left a very sour taste, and I want others to be aware of how poorly we were treated.

name: Becca P

name: Rebecca
title: We booked a 4 night stay in Sevierville…
text: We booked a 4 night stay in Sevierville TN through host dan kiv who misrepresented his property. he stated mountain view-false, park view-false, new rustic cabin-false, it's an old house that is dirty and unkept. the yard has large holes along the porch you could easily twist an ankle. listing photos do not match the actual property. host refused to refund us any funds to us. beware of his properties in Sevierville TN and Orlando KY. host reslists  properties to hide negative reviews of his properties.

name: DRB
title: i'm sorry but this is no where as good…
text: i'm sorry but this is no where as good as airbnb. Functionality is not there. There are so many glitches and it needs a proper UX Designer to look at this, get a UI designer to design it and a coder to deliver.

name: customer
title: They cancelled my booking last minute!
text: I booked a cottage for 4 nights. I hour before checkin, i receive a phone call. The lady on the phone , the first thing she says “can you confirm your Name?”A phone call from an unknown number asking me to confirm my name!After push and pull, they informed me that they cancelled my booking. No explanation. I asked for a refund and that was it . I am waiting for the refund…

name: WMEight
title: Maison Horrible
text: Do not book with Vrbo! It's not worth the hassle.Booked a property near Paris. Expected a high end property, but the property condition was so poor we did not stay. Vrbo did pay for a hotel for 2 nights but have ignored requests for a refund for the rest of our stay despite clear photo evidence. On arrival, was presented with the following. Many of which are health and safety issues:1) Interior walls with pealing paint, mould, fungus and damp. Smell of damp.2) Filthy rotting and corroded window frames3) No proper curtains or blinds on windows4) Sofas with pealing disintegrated covers5) A master bedroom bed with a pallet as a base6) Exposed electrical cables in several locations7) Light switches that didn't work8) Loose door handles9) A sauna which did not work - electrical wiring left exposed10) Non functioning bidet with seized up taps11) Leaking radiator with bowl underneath12) Utility room filthy and full of junk13) Shabby exterior - dirty walls overgrown with plants and weeds14) Internal photos on vrbo do not match the current property state inside.15) External views do not match the photos on the vrbo website. Some photos are of a stately home nearby, not the actual property - very misleading.16) Entrance hall was being used as a pottery workshop  - cluttered17) Cupboards in rooms packed with clothes - no room for a paying guest to put their clothes.18) Filthy toilet seat with pealing paint and water damage.Vrbo removed our review from their website. There are 2 clearly fake positive reviews there which are highly misleadingProperty is still being advertised for letting despite all of the issues.Update July 2024:We have yet to receive a refund from vrbo despite the property owner initially promising to refund the booking. Vrbo have ignored phone calls and messages.

name: Katie Gilliam
title: Scam owner and Vrbo no action
text: The worst customer service. We booked a house and the house owner asked to cancel the reservation and pay directly outside of VRBO. Then asked us to meet in different locations to pay indirectly. We contacted Vrbo to get our money back as we did not feel safe and this seemed like a scam since the owner told us to meet for keys and then provided us a key code.  Not to mention the owner was contacting us outside of Vrbo. Vrbo stated the case has been escalated and investigated. We could not speak with a supervisor because of “availability” and was told the case would take 24 hours to resolve. We had to call back 6 times and reconfirm details each time. One agent told us “to give it time” even though we are supposed to check in the following day. Finally we spoke to a supervisor and still no resolution

name: Jason Goodrich
title: Host here
text: Host here, the VRBO platform works ok to drive traffic and bookings... however their customer service and resolution is a disaster!   There is zero accountability and follow up with their agents.   I have been patiently waiting over 30 days and continuously calling to follow up on an issue that remains unresolved... good luck

name: Lisa Alston
title: Horrible customer service
text: Had an issue with a rental the host did everything she could to help. Vrbo still refuses to help. I had to rent a hotel and incurred a lot in extra costs. Vrbo does not respond told me to keep waiting in a house where the temperature inside was almost 100 degrees. They say your stay is guaranteed to be comfortable. Yet they make no effort to help.

name: bobby stathakopoulos
title: Wow what can I say. They left us stranded in a Heat Wave.
text: Wow what can I say. I had 2 non-responsive hosts on the same trip! We were a family of 5 traveling from the US to Greece and got stranded in a heat wave with nowhere to go. VRBO does absolutely zero vetting of the property owners and makes no apologies for it, I know firsthand. They fed me a company line of there are millions of properties they list and cannot vet most of them. I can agree with that somewhat. But once VRBO sends out a booking confirmation and receives payment, to me they take responsibility for the confirmation. I understand most of this is automated. They could just as easily send the property owner an email stating they have a rental potential and for them to confirm the property is available prior to accepting payment and providing a booking confirmation to the renter. Horrible company and horrible service. Stay away at all costs.

name: Justine Kane
title: I don’t even know where to start
text: I don’t even know where to start.I booked a trip thru Vrbo in February 2024 for July 3rd 2024- July 7th 2024. We booked in plenty of enough time & found the home with all the things we needed. We were happy. I’ve reached out to the host several times since Feb. and was nervous I wasn’t getting any response. Therefore, I have called Vrbo more times then I can count and was assisted by so many different agents and supervisors that told me we are “safe and covered by Vrbo if this host falls thru” That Vrbo would “relocate us at the time of check in if we were outside of the property with no code or word from the host to get in” I wasn’t letting that happen. There was no way I was showing up with luggage to a place I almost knew we wouldn’t be able to get into with no where to go from there. It took phone call after phone call, agents and supervisors have hung up on me after hours of waiting on hold and getting no resolution to this issue. Finally, my fiance took over and wasn’t the calmest he could be. Which is to be understood. THEN someone helped, BARELY. I had spoken with Jonna the supervisor & she refunded us the money & gave us 2,046 towards another house to rebook. Which wasn’t enough for the holiday weekend. We had to settle for the only thing they had left. A home in a location we didn’t want. We should be in a mansion on the beach after what I had to go thru. Vrbo will be hearing more from me. This is only the beginning of my case.

name: Katie
title: Dreadful! Do not expect a response from a Supervisor!!
text: If I could give zero stars for VRBO I would! Our complaint was escalated to a supervisor 24 hours after arriving in the USA at our ‘Magical Getaway’ for 11 nights, but nearly 8 weeks since our complaint began we have still not had a promised phone call within the 24hours we were advised. Refund given by the host of the property due to issues with our private pool not working but £400+ of fees charged by VRBO still sat in their bank account whilst we are out of pocket. I will of course update this review should we ever receive a resolution but not holding my breath almost 8weeks down the line. We had to book an alternative property to move to after only 2 days into our holiday, unfortunately through the same platform as we were desperate and needed to move out quickly, so VRBO have had the booking fees for the replacement property too! Our replacement villa was beautiful 🤩 so much so we have booked for next year. VRBO get your customer service sorted and get the supervisors to do the job they are paid to do! Refund the fees and commission you have charged us for a booking that did not materialise 😡

name: Monica Schuerkamp
title: Took all my money
text: I booked a place in Nanaimo Canada and had to cancel and did so within 20minutes. The owner where I was renting said I had to contact VRBO which was difficult to find. Anyway they would not accept my cancellation even though the booking was 7 weeks away and the unit could easily have been rebooked. Basically they took my money and rebooked to make twice the money. They have a no cancellation policy but don’t allow a given time. This should not be allowed. They basically stole my money and no matter how much I tried to reach out they did not respond. I do not recommend using VRBO. Also theirs location map was way off.

name: Janet
title: I am currently on the 'helpline' to…
text: I am currently on the 'helpline' to VRBO (India it would seem) to sort out why my booking for next year has increased in price (it would seem they have an inventive currency converter - not that I expected for one minute that my holiday in France, booked from the UK and shown in GBP would suddenly appear as USD!).So as I sit here wasting my life - having already martyred some to their on line 'help'- I thought it an opportunity to do something worthwhile and warn others DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO DO NOT USE VRBO

name: Carla Delaurier
title: We stayed at 182 Evabsmeade Close in…
text: We stayed at 182 Evansmeade Close in Calgary. False advertising. No hot tub, the beds were clean but that was all. Upstairs tenant screamed and yelled day and night. The toddler cried insesently.  We called child protective services.I went upstairs at 1:10am to tell them to stop. Their home was disgustingly filthy. The odor of dirty diapers in our unit was so bad. Vrbo .....never again.

name: reginald marcotte
title: We were screwed by a renter with dirty…
text: We were screwed by a renter with dirty bedding, trash still in the garbage, nats, and a non-working door lock. No refunds or assistance "post stay"

name: Gloria
title: I flew down to enjoy my family for the…
text: I flew down to enjoy my family for the first time in five years. It was an absolutely beautiful home with great space to accommodate my family until we got there and we all tried to enjoy a family movie but felt completely miserable with how warm the house was and when trying to lower the air we were unable to do to the thermostat having a lock on it that we were unable to access. We were all headed out the door to spend the day at the water park the day before our check out when a woman coming to clean the home showed up to the house…she said she thought we had check-out today, we then told her our check-out was for Sunday which was the following day and that was that … then I immediately was contacted by the owner of the home. The host stated we needed to get out of her f****** house and that she was going to bring her posse to remove us. I was shocked, I told her I rented the house from the 27-30th. She then said she changed the days of the rental 2 days before I flew in when I booked over a month in advance. I never acknowledged this!! I have my original receipt that shows I booked the correct day and even the police said I have every right to stay but after being threatened by the host and her posse, I gathered all my grandkids and left. This was supposed to be an amazing family vacation with my grandkids that turned into a nightmare. This host is very unprofessional. I would not recommend this place please beware she will change your booking dates.   I found out Vrbo rent it to two people.

name: Tom
title: VRBO is a waste of time
text: After trying to list my property on VRBO website they forced the local language on me even that I don't live there permanently. That made it rather impossible for me to list my property within a reasonable time frame. It's so hard to translate every word and sentence while filling complicated forms and answering complex questions regarding property renting in a language that you do not speak or write. Once I tried to send a message to VRBO support, their system showed an error being unable to receive my inquiry. I do not recommend VRBO to anyone unless you have got time to waste.

name: Janette Evans
title: Shocking company
text: Booked a property in France last year.  Sent the owner a message 2 days before we were due to leave asking about access etc. got a message back a day before saying he sold the property last year !  Firstly VRBO said they would find me an alternative within an hour.  Hours passed so called again. Next advisor said I shouldn’t have been told that!  I had to find my own the night before. We did this  and  the new booking was dearer.  Was told I would get the difference refunded within 5 days.  It’s now 28 days. Every time I call I get told it’s been escalated and they can’t take calls.  Not one email off this so called team.  If VRBO have a book with confidence guarantee and say they will refund up to 150% why would it need investigating.   It should be a straight refund of the difference.   Will never use them again

name: V W
title: Cockroach infested villa
text: I really don’t know where to start writing this review as the property was so wrong on many levels.So here we go, we arrived quite late in the evening and was looking forward to nice relaxing week away, but as soon as we opened the door any hope of this was soon shattered.The property was infested with cockroaches and the owner was well aware of this as traps are all over the place and also spray, once we got over the initial shock and caught as many as we could we weighed up our options and had a look around the property which only left 1 option and that was to leave and this was  not only down to the cockroaches it was down to the fact the property was also filthy, the bedding was yellow with sweat stains and the place is really run down, I’ve seen better on banged up abroad.Once we left we called VRBO who offered no assistance at all so we called every hotel in the area, but they was all full so we ended up sleeping in the car as by then it was 2am, we spent the entire next day sort out alternative accommodation which has involved moving 2 more time so not ideal.The owner id come back to us the next day and refunded the money minus the booking administration fee which VRBO have kept so I only lost £125.00, but the property should be let out and the owner confirmed it was fumigated a few days before we arrived, but it obviously did not work and does not excuse how dirty and tired the property is plus the traps look old in my opinionI personally will never use VRBO again and this experience has left me exhausted

name: Nicole Bayram
title: How vrbo ruined my family’s long weekend
text: We booked a 2 night stay at a cottage in Ontario though vrbo. A day before our check in we contacted the host to ask if we can do a late check-out. When we reached out the host told us that they can’t host us and our reservation request “landed in their spam folder” therefore they didn’t see it. It was less then 24 hours before the booking so naturally I panicked and called vrbo. The customer representative told me that he will have the “rebooking team” contact me through email with a new property with the same amenities. This is where the lies started. Everyone that works there is a complete liar, and their job is literally to lie to you over and over. After a few hours of no contact I called them again, I explained to them that I had kids and they were looking forward to a weekend getaway and I was worried we weren’t going to be able to find a place( it was Canada Day long weekend) once again the the customer service rep said not to worry and they will get us a new property to stay in. This process repeated itself about 4 times I talked to 4 different people they all told me the same thing. I talked to an online representative who also gave me the same story. It was now 8pm on Friday night and I made my last plea to another representative, I told him to please just tell me if they can’t help me and I will promptly book another cottage myself for the weekend. This representative told me just to wait until tomorrow morning and everything will be resolved, he continued to say that there is a department called “traveler care team” that take care of bookings on the spot but the issue has to be dealt with the day of your booking, therefore I had to wait until Saturday which was the next day. I trusted him and the 4 other representatives that assured me we will have a cottage for the weekend. The next morning upon not receiving any emails I called the call center ones again, after 45 minutes on hold I got a hold of the “traveler care team” and they told me they can’t book me a place because their site doesn’t allow same day bookings!!! I explained to the rep that I was on the phone dealing with this issue for 7 hours the previous day and everyone I talked to told me that you will be able to give me a place and she simply said “I’m sorry you were given misinformation, I’m giving you the correct one now” So everyone I talked to KNEW that I wasn’t going to get a cottage they simply stalled. The worst part is now I can’t book anything and my family just has to stay home. The care agent told me she can give us a hotel for ONE night, the hotel was a in city hotel with no lake in sight, the cottage we booked was a lake front. I obviously declined. I can’t believe this company is training their agents to lie to you over and over. Why couldn’t they be honest and just tell me to find another place ? Do not book from this site.

name: Shad Deering
title: We booked a VRBO for our son's wedding…
text: We booked a VRBO for our son's wedding but when we showed up the house was dirty and did nothave all of the amenities listed online.We immediately contacted the owner and said we would not be able to stay there. It was incrediblychallenging because nearly every hotel was sold out for that weekend but we eventually found aplace.We offered to pay for the first night but requested a refund and the owner said that others had notcomplained and refused. Contacted VRBO by chat and then they directed me to a phone line. Ispoke with the agent, sent photos of the issues and was told they would work on it and get backwith me. It has been over a week and every time I connect with VRBO they say they are working on itbut refuse to provide a timeline, explain the process or what steps are involved. This is over a $1500issue and VRBO continues to just say we need to wait and won't/can't explain anything.My assumption was that reading their site, VRBO would be responsible for making sure that rentalswere consistent with their descriptions but they do not seem to offer any protection or follow up.It has been more than two weeks and when I called them all they said was that everything is at the discretion of the owner.  I tried to explain that wasn’t consistent with their website statements but at this point I think I am just out the money.

name: Ash
title: Absolute SCAM
text: Absolute SCAM! Booked a property in Portugal on Expedia.co.uk. Got a confirmation from Expedia that the property had been booked and money was taken off of my bank card. Next day I get an email from VRBO saying my booking has been cancelled as the host had overbooked those dates and my money will be refunded. I was charged GBP 641 and refunded GBP 598. Bank says speak to VRBO, VRBO says they can't do anything. So essentially I've lost around GBP 50 for nothing and they won't refund even though I wasn't the one who cancelled. ABSOLUTE SCAM, never booking on Expedia again and filing a complaint.

name: KJ
title: VRBO’s customer service platform is…
text: VRBO’s customer service platform is horrendous. It is difficult to navigate and unresponsive. We got absolutely nowhere with the person we spoke with on the phone and have received no acknowledgment of receiving the complaint forms we submitted. They take little to no responsibility for monitoring their rentals. Use Airbnb instead. They immediately responded to and resolved our complaint. It is apparent that as long as VRBO continues to make money, customer service is NOT a priority.

name: Debra Hutchins
title: So we stayed at a rental Host name…
text: So we stayed at a rental Host name Stephanie Simpson, Bristol New Hampshire, first off false advertising, the Host actually lives downstairs, window broken, covered with plastic, dead bugs everywhere and I actually had to clean above all beds because of bugs. Also she invaded our space by barging in. Very unprofessional. Stairs to entrance Hazzard, almost fell on more than one occasion. She also was threatening us. This was one of the most disappointing vacation I've ever had.If want to use rental be sure ur going to bed by 10,also a curefew from 10 pm to 7am. I'm on vacation not supposed to feel locked down. Would not recommend, area for house Very treacherous.

name: Chris Doyle
title: Cancel for no reason
text: Booked and paid with a confirmed booking.We then booked and paid for flights / etc only for the owner to cancel for no reason.The refund is less than what I paid plus all the bank charges on top.Do not use this site

name: Dave
title: Property not as advertised
text: Property not as advertised. Rotting food and garbage on back patio, old Q-tips on floor (not to mention dirt, food scraps, garbage and ANTS everywhere). Advised host it was disgusting and not acceptable to us and that we were locking and leaving. Had to make alternate arrangements at a very high cost. Host refused refund. Vrbo Customer Support not helpful despite us sending pictures and our communications with the host. Complete fail. Will NEVER use Vrbo/Expedia again. Have had wonderful experiences with AirBnB across Canada.

name: Chris Bell
title: Dreadfully misleading site
text: Yesterday booked a property in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain "Loft in the center with free parking area" (actually called "Bamboo" but not noted on the Vrbo site). Booking for 2 days in September was confirmed by Vrbo, full payment was taken. Today got a message saying that the booking was cancelled as the host, Jorge, only accepted bookings of 3 days or more. Why wasn't this on the Vrbo site? Why did Vrbo accept the booking? Why did Vrbo take full payment, only to refund it the next day. I suggest people are very careful when using thiis booking "system"

name: Graig Owens
title: Ethically Reprehensible Company
text: Rented a house outside Tacoma for 3 days, and upon check-in we found a ton of issues with the property (misrepresented property condition and furniture, water damage to the flooring, grass was 3.5 feet tall, no trash can liners available) along with several unsanitary conditions (urine and feces still in the toilet, sheets unwashed and stinky with pubic hair on them, and no laundry detergent to clean them, full garbage bags piled high in the garage, etc.) VRBO and the property host were contacted several times and were only willing to refund 1/3 of the cleaning fee ($50) and essentially stole the remainder of the balance (nearly $600). We were forced to leave 3 hours after we got there due to the extreme health hazard and make other accommodations. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!

name: karen
title: Very bad experience
text: We rented a place in Sint Maarten through VRBO and it was disgusting. Very dirty, plaster falling down off walls, holes in floor, filthy carpets, stained sheets, brown stained light switch plates, torn curtains, broken blinds... I could go on. The owner would only agree to give us a small, partial refund if we agreed not to post a negative review on VRBO. VRBO was unwilling to help, saying that they do not get in the middle of owner and tenant disputes. In addition, there was no upstairs bathroom, but the listing said "Villa Leone is ideal for two couples, offering two separate baths and a door that separates the upstairs bedroom/bath from the lower living area." There was a bath at the bottom of the stairs, but we don't consider that an "upstairs bedroom/bath" VRBO disagreed and said it could be interpreted as a bath that was meant for the upstairs guests. Yikes. VRBO finally refunded their service fee (we spent many hours or chat and then phone, and sending VRBO 50+ photos), but we were out a couple of thousand dollars on the rental. (We left immediately and rented another place via AirBnB.) No more VRBO for us. Ever.

name: Stephen H Hector
title: Disastrous
text: I’ve never used this platform before and it’s fair to say I won’t in future. It’s an absolute disaster. Property cancelled three days before I due to arrive with my partner, mum in law and three young kids, unresponsive host, issues processing cancellation and refunds in order to book another place, most of which are now booked resulting in me having to pay loads more money for a last min replacement. Half the places are not available despite dates appearing so on the site etc. Update. Got a 'partial refund'. Absolutely lost for words

name: Ivelisse Villafane
title: VRBO is a scam!
text: June 2024 - I reserved an apartment for a month but never got the check-in information. I called VRBO, and they advised me to contact the owner. The owner was surprised I could reserve the apartment on the VRBO website because it was already rented for the next two months. I called VRBO again, and they called the owner to find out it was a calendar communication mistake on their side. The owner agreed to refund me the entire amount due to the inconvenience, and the partial refund was received within four days. However, VRBO is not reversing their fees because I supposedly canceled the reservation (which is not true!). I am short $890 worth of fees, calling them every single day and getting different answers daily. Stay away from VRBO; they only want to get your money and are unwilling to help us when they, VRBO, make a mistake. I will not stop until I get my money back!

name: Titled Nmn
title: Fraud company alongside Expedia
text: This is the worst company you can ever use to book your stay.  These people along with Expedia should be investigated for fraud.I booked a place through them. The host, started messaging me to cancel my booking and pay in cash. I went to Vrbo to complain and say I am worried about my safety. I in trun cancelled my booking. Vrbo have refused to give me a full refund and told me to approcg the host for a refund. The same person who has made me fearful. Avoid this company please.

name: Deborah Vezina
title: In May 2024 I Booked a house for 6 days…
text: In May 2024 I Booked a house for 6 days for the end of June 2024. Paid for up front. For my granddaughter and  family  2 adults 3 children Traveling from out of country for a wedding. Got exact address on confirmation email. Email also said no refunds. Discovered it was in a bad part of the city.  We took a 3 hour drive to go and see the place, yard was over grown in weed and windows were very dirty. There seemed to be very good security so we thought ok we can work with this.Raised my concerns to host and vrbo Never replied to any of my messages.  When it came time for check in info not a word from anyone supposed to provide 24 hrs. before. We never heard a word from host so I contacted vrbo, was on phone with them 2 times over 4 hours. Then all of a sudden get a cancellation notice in my email.  Now I have hours to find something for a family of 5. Hotels are all booked due to functions in city.  What a nightmare NEVER AGAIN Still waiting on my refund.

name: Sarah
title: Useless SCAM
text: Not helpful, completely a scam to make more money. Payment not gone through but confirmed booking now making it impossible to make payment - guarantee they will go through claims to get more money! SCAM Will never use again

name: Helene Vagenheim
title: I am a hostess on this website and have…
text: I am a hostess on this website and have been for 6 years. The service is getting more and more expensive and customer service is getting worse. It's actually impossible to work with these people as half of the time, they don't even understand how their own system functions. Unreal!I paid for my annual subscription but was unable to get any bookings due to an information they didn't have. Potential clients could not reach me because my account was blocked but one from the company ever contacted me to tell me so.On the opposite side, when we get an issue with a client and require help, the company is simply not interested in assisting.

name: LEE
title: LEFT STRANDED WITH NO ACCOMMODATION
text: Rented an apartment in Glasgow from VRBO. I did not receive information how to access the property. I called the host - no answer, VRBO - told me they would call the owner and call me back - they didn’t. Wasted half my time calling them. Stranded with no accommodation. Had to pay premium rate for a last minute hotel room and I have NOT received a refund. Don’t use them. Absolutely awful.

name: Jason Schexnayder
title: Vrbo is a joke. Book with other companies.
text: If I could leave a 0-star review I would.I booked a smaller rental property in Seal Harbor, Maine. However, a family member asked to join our trip after I booked the rental property leading to the need for a larger place. I booked the larger place first before canceling the initial booking. I made it clear to the Vrbo agent that I wanted the smaller, original booking canceled. However, the agent canceled the larger, more recent booking I made.When trying to re-book the place I wanted for the trip, it was $500 more expensive. When on the phone with Vrbo, I told them we shouldn't be responsible for paying more when Vrbo canceled the wrong property. Also, I needed something booked quickly because our trip is in October and bookings fill up quickly around Acadia NP during this time. I was on the phone for over 4 hours total over the last 24 hours and spoke to multiple people (3 agents and 2 "supervisors").Last night, I was told a re-booking team would call me or email me that night and re-book the rental at the original price. Surprise, surprise...I received no call or email. When following up this morning, I was told to by Leslie, a "supervisor", to wait 2-3 hours for her call back as she was going to "investigate it personally". She called back about 1.5 hours later only to tell me the issue had been "escalated" and the re-booking team, and a supervisor named Jeff (who I'd spoken to before), were going to call me back with a resolution. Ummm, that's what I've been told multiple times and thought you were taking care of. I finally told Leslie, the other supervisor, that I was going to book with a different company and I expected some sort of compensation (which I doubt will occur). Vrbo customer service is a joke. I'll continue to book through other companies.

name: Bill V
title: 11 day rental and no support from VRBO. Told to email documents, when I attempted to send & confirm email, support would only tell me to call. Tough to send supporting docuemnts via phone
text: Have issues with a 11 day rental in Curacao. VRBO chat sent an email for me to provide docuemntation, of which I have plenty. Tried to confirm the email and all they want to do is have me call. Basically they are giving me a run around. Worse customer service experience ever. The rental is horrible and neither the host or VRBO is very interested in correcting. Would caution anyone from using them. Have pictures, video and chat transcripts for confirmation to my disatisfaction and the expensive lesson I have learned.

name: Melissa Rucker
title: The owner lived in the home below
text: The owner lived in the home below. He was very accommodating and easy to get hold of if we needed him. The price was very good for the area (Hercules, Ca)

name: Michaele
title: Horrible Customer Service
text: We are hosts and have listed our three properties on VRBO for ten years.  Getting a problem resolved via customer service has turned into a nightmare the last couple of years.  One property was unlisted without reason or notification a couple of months ago.  VRBO double booked on dates that had an Airbnb booking.  Our calendars are synched with Airbnb.  It was clear looking at our calendar that there was already an Airbnb reservation.  VRBO continues to want to collect a $277.50 cancellation fee, even though they made the mistake.  We have spent hours going around and around with customer service with these issues.  Customer service has hung up on us.  We have spent three hours so far trying to clear up this double booking issue.  VRBO is a terrible company to do business with.

name: Cindy N Tim Hammers
title: Avoid
text: I rented a cottage on VRBO. Summit Cabin rentals put up cameras and didn't list that in the listing breaching VRBO rules. I didn't receive check in information until 5:03 and check in time was 4:00. It was not pet friendly as listed. I asked to be moved to another cabin that was pet friendly and was denied. I was over talked, bullied, and manager was rude! We had to rent another cabin from Hearthside cabins which I highly recommend!

name: Amy
title: I was scammed and after calling 3 times…

name: Ariel
title: VRBO's book with confidence policy is Joke and a sham
text: VRBO's Book with confidence policy is a joke.I booked a VRBO through Expedia for June 14, 2024 at Cas Pueblito in Vieques, PR. The booking was created and confirmed on June 11, 2024. Once the listing was confirmed I booked airline tickets, ferry tickets, car rentals and Kayak tours. Less than 24 hours before check in on June 13th, the owner decided to cancel my reservation because it was "double booked" and issued a refund for the VRBO, however, the re-booking team did nothing to help find me another place, they simply told me I had to find my own lodging and gave me a budget that was $300 below anything available in the area. As you would expect trying to book something withing 24hrs....everything was already booked up. They also declined to give me a credit for future stays. I lost over $1500 because of this.I was stranded in Puerto Rico without a place to stay with my wife and 3 kids. If I would've tried to cancel the reservation myself for any reason It would've not been refunded. But they can cancel the day before with no penalty!This is by far the worst customer service experience I've had with any business. I wouldn't not suggest doing business with them, because when things go wrong VRBO will leave you hanging abroad like they did to me and my family.

title: As a host
text: As a host. I am truly disappointed at the customer service I received using this platform. I have been with Airbnb for over 6 years and have had no problems with payout or the website but  thought I’d try another a try. I should have ran for the hills when i felt the website and dashboard was so un-userfriendly but I stuck it out. Received a booking. App told me to add bank details. Tried to on several occasions but it will not allow me. Called CS and have been for 3.5months. Being told the case has been escalated over and over again. The guests came and went. I did not want to cancel the booking and ruin a family’s holiday. So I went ahead and let this booking stand. I have since been on the phone for over 40mins each time speaking to a manager Marie who assured me because she will personally deal with this situation that it will be deal with. 6 days later I am speaking g to CS again. Who cannot do anything. I now realise that they have obviously stolen my money as I am not getting anywhere. $557 be careful be very careful with this platform. They are scammers thief’s for not wanting to pay me out by other methods that they refuse to do due to this “IT” problem not being resolved.

name: Fiona
title: Did Expedia invent VRBO to scam customers?
text: We booked an apartment for July. Back in March we contacted VRBO to change our booking. This involved three lengthy phone calls, two of which terminated for no reason. The third operator told me only the host could alter the booking. Since the host was not answering the mobile, operator said she would email the host and I should get confirmation about the change in 48 hours. No confirmation. I send text messages and called the host’s mobile number shown on expedia. Not a word in reply. Thought may be this just takes time. Waited till today (15th June). Contacted VRBO on their chat support, ABIHSHEK M, who told me that only Expedia could help me. I said I needed to complain to his supervisor. He told me that the supervisor will call me in two hours. No call received. Meanwhile I called VRBO and went through the same laborious process of explaining what I needed to change. Same answer as before: that email will be sent to host and I should hear from host. I asked to speak to supervisor, this time, someone else came to the phone, but still same answer, “it all depends on the host”, “we will email the host”. They wouldn’t give me the host’s email, “not company policy”. In the end, I cancelled the booking. It seems VRBO is happy for us to cancel, and not interested in facilitating a change to our booking. There is no accountability, the host is not obliged to respond, they charged us the full price at the time of booking, and it will take up to 7 business days to get a refund. Shocking customer service, and zero protection for the customer. I will avoid anything to do with VRBO in future.

name: Anne Mott
title: OMG where do I start… do not book…
text: OMG where do I start… do not book through them! They took our money months and months before we were to go on vacation… days before we were to leave, we tried to confirm with VRBO, they said we had the reservation, but we felt we needed to call the “host” and they couldn’t find us anywhere. VRBO was making us fly to our destination, which was going to be late And then let them know when we get there that there isn’t a vacancy and then they would either refund our money or possibly try to find another place… we were begging them to let us find another … After making many random calls to VRBO again and again they told us it was policy that we had to get there first so they wanted us to fly from NY to Key West without a reservation to tell them we didn’t have one and then find a place.(do you know how hard it is to find a place on Key West last minute during prime time) We went ahead and booked another place as a back up way far away from where we wanted to stay, knowing we could lose our money. Eventually emailed us between flights telling us that we were right and that now we needed to prove that we paid them. All on my statement and yes it was VRBO not a scam! They did refund our money but all this caused us great anxiety, especially since we had also booked for another couple, all four of us could’ve been without a place.
