name: Meredith Goss
title: The absolute worst customer service
text: I have never had such an awful experience as I did with this property, and I will never book through VRBO again now that I have experienced what passes for customer support with them.The listing does not make clear that there is NO bathroom, or even a sink, in the guest room. The room could actually be described as more of a shed, and certainly not a "cabana." The bathroom is in the main house next to the shed. The host (John) sent a message through VRBO with the code to get into the main house, but none of my attempts to use it when I arrived were successful, so I had no access to the bathroom. I got to the property at 9:30pm, and when I couldn't get into the house, I attempted to contact John first through VRBO messaging, then by texting his direct number, then by calling his direct number, and then by ringing the doorbell on the main house. I received no response that evening. In the morning I knocked on the door and was let in by some person who wasn't the host, and when I explained that the code wasn't working, she said she had trouble with it the previous night as well.After twelve hours had passed with no response whatsoever from John, I contacted VRBO customer support. The agent told me they would try to contact John and let him know I was trying to reach him. I told the agent that I no longer wanted to stay on the property due to the host's lack of responsiveness to a major issue with the booking. The agent said that he had "escalated" my case to the "specialized team" who would contact me about the issue. However, he had no idea when the "team" would contact me. He said several times "not to worry" so I believed that VRBO would assist me in obtaining a refund. He did not say anything about VRBO's rebooking policy. I removed my belongings from the shed and found another place to stay where I wasn't locked out of the bathroom facilities.After John finally sent me an email saying he had received a message from VRBO saying that I was trying to get hold of him, I sent a message to him through VRBO detailing my experience and pointing out that he failed to respond to me for over twelve hours. He replied by basically calling me a liar and saying that it was my fault for not using the keypad on the main house correctly.I received an email from the "specialized team" THREE DAYS LATER stating that I was not eligible for a refund. I called customer support and got the run-around from the agent. She said that if the property was unsatisfactory, I would have to get rebooked in a different listing by VRBO or I would forfeit my payment. The agent I originally dealt with had said NOTHING about this requirement, and it made no sense anyway because by the time the "specialized team" actually got back to me, my booking would have already ended.I am shocked and infuriated by the treatment I have received from the host and VRBO customer support. It appears that they are completely uninterested in helping me or demanding any kind of accountability from the hosts who list on their platform.

name: Kuko
title: The worst experience ever!!!
text: Over a month before our trip, we booked a Marriott condo near Palm Springs, CA. Since we have children, we chose a condo with several pools. I don't want everyone who reads this review to have the same experience, so I advise you to never use this company. Also, the host 〝STR Timeshares, LLC” this small company in Florida owns Marriott timeshare rooms across the US, but if you make a reservation through the Vrbo, BE REALLY CAREFUL if this company is the host!!They don’t care about customer but only cares about their own profits!!

name: Jessica Lamar
title: Nightmare: Charged for a home I didn't stay in
text: It has been a nightmare trying to get a refund for a VRBO property that I didn't stay in. Upon arrival to the rental property on March 23rd to check in, the property was not in the best condition. So, I called customer service to cancel and file a complaint. They told me to send pictures and send the house details. After doing so, they agreed with me regarding the home condition and they told me to check into a nearby hotel because they were unable to find an available VRBO home at the moment. They said I would receive the hotel reimbursement AND a reservation refund to use for a new VRBO home that they would place us in. We spent two days going from one hotel to the next waiting for them to inform us of the new VRBO home. When they didn't place us in a new home, we decided to end our spring break vacation early and went home. Now, 76 days later, I am still fighting for a reservation refund. As of yesterday, 76 days later, a VRBO representative informed me that on their end, their system shows I never canceled. Apparently, calling customer service and speaking to the home Host regarding the condition of the home on the day of arrival did not constitute as a cancellation. So, I was supposed to cancel a different way. I still don't know what that different way is but I'm assuming I needed to cancel through the app.  No one told me that when I called. In my mind, I canceled directly with them by speaking to a representative who said I would get a refund, and I have the email to prove they said that. They said that email meant reimbursement for the hotels. I did receive a reimbursement but I thought it was the reservation refund because the reimbursement amount was the same exact amount I paid for the rental home. I was told I would receive a refund, I thought the reimbursement I received was the reservation refund. After calling several times since March to get the update on the hotel reimbursement, finally 76 days later a VRBO representative informed me I was not getting a refund for the reservation because the system shows I did not cancel. He said the reimbursement I received was the hotel reimbursement and not the reservation refund. Apparently, cancelling by talking to a VRBO representative and by talking to the home Host does not make it a cancellation. Why didn't the representative or the Host tell me despite this extenuating circumstance, talking to them and filing a report claim did not warrant a cancellation? Honestly, I still dont know what would have been considered a cancellation. When I spoke to the Host on the day of checkin regarding my my displeasure, he apologized and proceeded to give me excuses saying others have stayed there and liked it.  So, now VRBO wants me to work something out with the Host. Really? 76 days later? If he didnt give me a refund after we talked on the day of checkin, what makes them think he's going to give me a refund now 76 days later?! Clearly, I have to take other measures to get a refund. I have so much written proof that I didn't stay there but their system says otherwise. I'm very upset and disappointed. Do not book with VRBO! Never again will I do that. During this process I have spoken to several customer representatives and still no results. They are unorganized, tell you conflicted information, no one knows what they're talking about and their system is apparently flawed.

title: SCAM: DO NOT USE VRBO
text: Recently, we were contacted by VRBO offering an apartment in Italy with a link directly to the apartment and location.After performing a longer search on this particular apartment, we found the original website and contacted the official owners directly on the apartment rental. They were sorry to inform us that their apartment was never for long-term rental as VRBO presented it to us.VRBO is a SCAM and do not engage with their company!

name: brian
title: I booked a condo through VRBO
text: I booked a condo through VRBO.  They charged me a 10% fee and just handed me off to a rental company who completed the reservation.  Two days before I am to leave I get an e mail that the unit is not available.  Left scrambling to find another place on Maui.

name: L Fraga
title: Fed up with the false advertising
text: I am so fed up with the false advertising of properties and prices published!  I've used VRBO for many years and loved it AT FIRST.  Now they list the "total fees" which used to include just a VRBO fee and now includes a "host fee" and sometimes includes a cleaning fee.  So they add on more fees so that the total you see isn't the total you pay. So they falsely draw you in to see properties you think you can afford or want to pay, but then when you go to check out, the fees are higher.Then even though you get a confirmation you aren't really confirmed because a second property management company has their own set of rental agreements you have to be sure to sign and submit before you are REALLY confirmed.Just so fed up with all this.  Guess I'll start trying another site.  Hope they're not all doing this.

name: Jamie Voight
title: Warning
text: Warning! VRBO will not look out for your best interest and will side with property owner, even with pictures and evidence. They intentionally leave off bad reviews and will refuse to return fraudulent fees that have been charged to your card. I strongly recommend going through another booking sire besides VRBO and Booking.com

name: Libba Z
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
text: Where to start? The “house” was filthy—moldy food left in the oven, mold in the shower….much more but those health issues were of utmost concern. Vrbo didn’t care.  Told me they’d call me to help. They did not. Told me they’d email me, they did not. Refused to get us out of this health hazard. Abominable and shameful.

name: Kevin Holloway
title: Vrbo technical fault with my listing…
text: Vrbo technical fault with my listing still not resolved after a month. No bookings no communication with my guests possible. Customer support has no internal contact with their technical team other than sending emails to them. They have no idea when the problem will be solved. Advice was to move to AirBnB!

name: John O
title: Awful customer service
text: Booked accomodation, showed up and was given different accomodation that was filthy so went elsewhere. Vrbo didn’t want to hear about it and issued no refund. My first and last time using Vrbo

name: Karen Dornauf
title: Terrible Experience
text: Booked a week in Italy with Vrbo in February 2023. Cancellation policy was 100% refund. Cancelled last week and spent 4 days with virtual customer support. Finally chatted with “people.” Told the same story to 4 people. In the end asked the host to help me. Got my refund but was $189.00 short. The host confirmed she had refunded my full deposit to Vrbo. So I got a What’s App number to call from Google search.  They apologised for the underpayment and would refund the difference. I had to download Remilty app, fill in my details including my credit card and they would do the refund immediately. I believed it was a SCAM and would not do it. Better to only lose $189.00.  I will never book with Vrbo again. There is no customer support. They have deleted my booking so I can’t follow up with them.I will be taking up the refund with my credit card provider. I have screenshots of everything.

name: K P
title: Intentionally and systematically miscalculating cost
text: I tried booking my vacation stay in the US with VBRO. But I feel I should refrain from doing so.VBRO is intentionally misleading customers and miscalculating prices.Why?I) Links from other sites (e.g. Holiday Homes, HomesToGo, all the other sites they aquired) show reasonable prices. When arriving at the vbro site (redirect), the price is usually higher!II) Reason: VBRO intentially miscalculates multi-night stays.Example: Rate for Night1: 100$, Rate for Night 2: 200$ (could be more expensive weekend or similar).With VBRO, booking only Night 1 alone: 100$, booking only Night 2 alone: 200$... but booking these 2 nights in one, price will be calculated as 400$ (why not 300$??).Total rip-off - and don't tell me this happens by accident.You can easily check this on their website by yourself.I have tried contacting their support about the matter, no reply.

name: schwanyclause
title: Used their service as a host
text: Used their service as a host: terrible service! I had a sync and a review before accepting feature. VRBO switch my account to instant book. Got a guest after 2 years listed with them. Had to cancel and they charged me a cancelation fee! Customer service can barely speak english! I unlisted my 9 listings with them. They continue to send me invoices! Stay away far away! Update: I received a reply and it sent me to the same thread that denied me. Stay far away! It is now April 5th 2025 and they are still sending me invoices!

name: David
title: Bees living in walls and no refund
text: Upon arrival, bees were found living in the walls. Called the mortified owner who was great in trying to find me another place. Ultimately, we went to a hotel. The owner and I worked for nearly a week trying to get a refund processed. Dozens of calls and finally told a refund would happen. When it did happen, it was a partial refund with no explanation of where the remaining refund. The owner even told me this would never happen with ABB although I think they are both pretty bad on things likes this. Finally got al but $200 back from my canceled booking and the host says she can't get VRBO to remedy it. I believe here, not VRBO. I will never book with them again. Still don't have my refund. Visa is working on the dispute. AVOID VRBO!

name: KA
title: AVOID…
text: AVOID IF YOU DON'T WANT THEM TO RUIN YOUR HOLIDAY. just got a fraud property that doesn't exist, got stranded for 7 hours, got a call from someone pretending to be them after my booking asking for my bank details. Stuck in holiday town with nowhere to stay. Further, they won't help, have stayed on the phone for many hours, trying to get through to someone. They keep saying wait till "check-in" time to help you. After check-in time to a NONEXISTENT PROPERTY, they won't pick up the phone.Another agent had the nerve to tell me: the booking is between you & the host, so you're not gonna get any refund from us"!!! I told them you are advertising for them & it's your problem you're selling a scam!Do NOT TRUST THEM WHATSOEVER

name: Dr. Gabriella F. Buttarazzi Um
title: Offering deceitful property listings when they know they are deceitful
text: A scam company. The host lied through her teeth on the listing for the property Barbados Chi Centre (Saint Michael, Barbados), and when I eventually said (after day 4 of 24 days) that I wanted to leave and receive a refund she refused. The host, Christy L'Angel Preece) who couldn't be a better fit for this company, even updated the listing on day 4 of my stay to avoid consequence from VRBO when I called them (and I called them 11 times in the first week of my stay but they did absolutely nothing). They are an exploitative company that take money upfront from guests and refuse to be culpable in any way. The customer service line is an absolute joke: you can get through 24/7 sure, but there is never anything valuable to be had for the sometimes 2 hour calls! I've spoken to countless people and provided the same evidence over and over again, and nothing has been done and I doubt ever will be done. And they are still hosting the listing filled with lies! Disgraceful.

name: Niels B
title: Extremely disappointed with the VRBO… be sure to have a plan B
text: Extremely disappointed with the VRBO team!Last weekend we booked a cottage north of Stockholm. On arrival, the host refused to let us in and wanted to cancel the booking.  We called VRBO, but the only help we got was a service mail promising a partial reimbursement if we on our own could manage to find another accommodation.  Of this requested reimbursement we have seen nothing of yet. Not even as much as a confirmation that the request/email has been received by an VRBO agent. What is even worse, there seem to be no consequences for the host at all. You can still book this accommodation.  How VRBO can justify this business model is beyond my comprehension? SO to any other customer planning to book on VRBO.com be aware, that should anything go wrong you are on your own... and you better have a plan B for your holiday, because VRBO.com team is of no use at all.

name: Mike Gruppo
title: VRBO is a middle man. Huge Service Fee
text: Many of the listings on VRBO are already controlled by a property management company.  We booked a cabin and noticed that all of our correspondence was with a company called Tahoe Getaways.  When I checked my credit card, the total was correct, but there were TWO charges.  $1711 to Tahoe Getaways and $216 to VRBO.  I didn't realize that the "Service Fee" was strickly for VRBO.I went to the Tahoe Getways sight and could have book the cabin from them WITHOUT the $216 VRBO charge.  VRBO may be entitled to a fee for being the middleman, but this seem excessive.

name: Adele
title: VRBO were of no support
text: VRBO were of no support. They took ky money upon booking but did not help when the host totally ignored all my contacts to agree check in. Money gone. Had to book elsewhere as the host sent an automated check in a few hours beforehand. The host was uncontactable. Phone number provided by VRBO was a full box voicemail number. They are v professional

name: Melissa Mayhew
title: Agree 100%

I changed my reservation within the free cancellation period and the host sent me back the nightly rental fee for the nights I removed from the reservation but VRBO will not adjust the taxes and fees. name: Alvaro Toledo
title: As a host this has been a horrible…
text: As a host this has been a horrible experience. We were charged $200 for something that wasn’t our fault. We are not using this platform again. Here’s what happened:We tried to synch the Airbnb calendar with that of Vrbo to try to prevent a double booking. However, afterwards a there was a booking through Vrbo on a date that we already had a booking through Airbnb. Obviously we had to cancel within minutes of the Vrbo booking. Then Vrbo charges us $200 for the cancellation. This would have been the first booking through Vrbo, so now we are $200 under.We spent a while on their chat and then half an hour on the phone with their customer service. The rep said management won’t do anything about this. We have been Airbnb super hosts for years, but we so regret giving Vrbo a try.

name: history channel
title: My word of warning - Vrbo stored C/C details and blames hosts, and viceversa
text: My word of warning: Vrbo and hosts blame each other for problems, plus it seems that Vrbo stored my credit card details even after I cancelled a reservation.MY EXPERIENCE: In January, I booked a B&B for May and paid a deposit. The confirmation emails from Vrbo and host showed different ref numbers, so I was confused. However, the host confirmed independently that it was all genuine. When I had to cancel a few days later, cancellation was confirmed in a Vrbo virtual chat and by the host and deposit was refunded a few days later. Earlier this month (May) however, I got an email confirming my booking and sending instructions for the stay! I emailed the host on the Vrbo site and she confirmed that the booking had been cancelled, but Vrbo debited the balance on my credit card two days later (evidently they had kept my details anyway!). It took another 5 days for a refund to come through, as they treated as a new cancellation. Vrbo bounces responsibility to the hosts and viceversa. Bottom line is, I was out of pocket for more than £1k for 5 days and exceeded my monthly limit, so will have to pay a penalty.

name: Punter
title: Stay away from VRBO
text: Stay away from VRBO. They cannot resolve simple issues. Me and my partner saved up for a weekend away. We decided to switch apartments because a refund was guaranteed if cancelled within the allocated time. Something went wrong with their tech and we didn’t receive our refund. More than 5 MONTHS later and a huge company like VRBO still haven’t refunded us and are actually trying to get us to resolve it by contacting several different people, asking for personal documents and details. It was only £150. Not a huge amount for such a big company. Check out reviews on trust pilot and you will see how many negative experiences people have had.

name: DianneH
title: This is going to cover my last two…
text: This is going to cover my last two experiences since they occurred in a short time span.  Since VRBO and Expedia (and Homeaway?) combined I've experienced a lot of 'hiccups' to put it mildly.My husband and booked a home in New Zealand many months in advance and, per usual, the final details are not sent until close to the arrival date.We did not receive any information in a timely manner. I kept messaging the owners as that final day approached and was not receiving any response. We were operating on blind faith at this point when we landed at the airport and I was left wondering if the place even existed because of the total lack of communication. I also figured there would be hotels available as a failsafe. After we arrived at the airport and were being driven to the town where the home was supposedly located (it was!) it was only through patience that I was able to get in touch with a real person at Expedia/VRBO after being cut off chat several times.  A lady on the other end was able to contact the hosts and get the information needed for us to proceed.I found out the next day that messages were being throttled by VRBO so they can screen communications. Over the course of several days the messages that the owners were trying to send me were finally allowed to pass muster with the Vrbo communication guardian gods and I could finally see that the owners had trying to reach out but Vrbo failed to forward those communications.My second incident is less stressful but still aggravating.  We needed to cancel a reservation (booked for late June) more than a month and a half out on a property.  Vrbo says that it is not possible but that I can change the dates if that works.  A date change actually does work. Vrbo instructed me to contact the owner to make that request - I did.  Twice.  I waited nearly two weeks to hear back but I've heard nothing back.I'm left wondering if the host is the bad guy or if Vrbo/Expedia has just gone to seed since their merger.  Vrbo is not working as a conduit between renters and hosts. They are certainly are not working to resolve issues on the customers' side which leads me to think the worst of them.My disgust of TA/Expedia/Vrbo and all their iterations (including Trivago, Hotels, Orbitz, Hotwire, +many more) has convinced to focus more on my frequent flyer points and less on finding a bargain through this monopoly.

name: Dorothee Bryman
title: Property sold 2 months before our arrival
text: To make a long story short:  we booked a condo in Rancho Mirage (CA desert) in May 2023 for a stay in May 2024 for a month.  The owner sold the property in March 2024 - he did not notify VRBO or us (according to policy he should have sent us a refund of our first payment ).  Since neither VRBO or we knew about the sale, our second payment also ended up with the owner Nick Sangret.  He lied to VRBO as to why we wanted a full refund.  VRBO was impossible to contact as others have stated.  We are working through American Express for a hopeful refund.  Since Expedia bought VRBO/Homeaway it has become another of the corporate monsters!

name: Mircea Tamas
title: Horrible experience
text: Horrible experience, paid £800 for a house , the next day they cancelled my booking, tried to get in touch over the phone for 1, 5hours and no luck , still waiting for a refund....stay awayDate of experience: 21 May 2024

name: Theresa H
title: I booked a vacation for July 2024 in…
text: Update! June 29, 2024Still NO refund.Still going back and forth.They changed telephone numbers and email addresses.I booked a vacation for July 2024 in January and was told I had until June 2024 to cancel to receive FULL refund.  The vacation is through VRBO using JURNY, one of their partners.  The booking is paid in full. In early April I found that my roommate is unable to attend. One of the numbers has been disconnected and the other rings with no answer. I have also gone on both websites, sent messages, spoke in their respective chat sites and still no call back, no text back, no email back but most importantly No Refund.

name: Sharon Stern
title: Actual total not in search results
text: It is impossible to search based on price. The total quoted in search does not include all the add ons which greatly varies from place to place (host fee, cleaning fee, etc). And also I don't accept refundable deposit policy because that can also be a dispute to get returned.

name: Leo
title: Vrbo is a company that has been dishonest
text: Vrbo is a company that has been dishonest with the public and its customers in a way that even Air BnB has not. My first, and only, time using VRBO was a disaster. After hearing so many commercials about how VRBO is "entire stay only with no host on-premises" they allow people to post rooms without fully acknowledging the fact that it's NOT the whole home. When I arrived at the location at 3pm check-in time, the host had not given us any information on how to enter the home. No code, no hidden key, nothing. It wasn't until a couple hours later that they contacted us with any check in info. The first problem was the look of the place, it was suspicious at best and there was a dog inside barking very aggressively at the window. The dog wasn't mentioned in the listing either... I never even made it inside the house before I was in my car leaving. My partner arrived later after getting off work and there were 4 cars in the driveway. There were 5 people and a dog living in the residence and the host said that the rental was for one room only. (Even if I had wanted a single room, why would they keep the dog on premises a secret???).After contacting VRBO customer service, they acknowledged they "whole home no host" policy but we were told that they couldn't give us a refund. Why? I have no idea. They then told us to request a refund from the host because Yea Sure, the person that hid information about the property is sure to do the right thing and give us a refund. Of course the host refused to give a refund.When I asked why VRBO wouldn't honor the "no host" policy they didn't have an answer for me. If a contractor for any other company was blatantly ignoring company policies like this, they would likely be fired immediately. But, I guess, VRBO is happy to turn a blind eye to it as long as they get their cut of the money. Check the VRBO Reddit and you'll see YEARS of complaints about similar issues- hundreds of dollars lost by people who just want to take a vacation but were victimized by their hosts and brushed off by this awful company.

name: Lisa Liapakis
title: The absolute most humiliating…
text: The absolute most humiliating experience in my life that VRBO participated in and allowed to happen. VRBO allows racism hosts to post in their platform that can kick you out in the middle of your reservation making up any false accusation they want and VRBO does not require host to provide proof. They just allow the host to show up any time during your stay with no notice or warning and kick you for some made up violation. In our case that fake allegation was related to the color of some the guests skin.

name: Sam H
title: Total Dumpster Fire
text: On May 8, 2024 I booked a 2 bedroom apartment in Brooklyn for a 31 day stay. The cost of the stay was over $5800. A lot of money, but much less than a hotel. I arrived as scheduled on May 18, 2024, and found the entire apartment building was under construction.I called VRBO customer support and explained the situation and provided pictures. Customer service was apologetic, and they promised that the rebooking team would call back within 15 minutes to reschedule my stay. Since VRBO has a "Book with Confidence Guarantee", I was not worried.The rebooking team never called me. Ever.Over the next few days, I called VRBO dozens of times. In total, I was on hold for over six hours. I was hung up on several times. No customer service representative could contact the rebooking team.I later learned that the rebooking team doesn't exist!VRBO has endless levels of non-existent customer service teams, including the "Rebooking Team", the "Guarantee Team", the "Specialized Department", and the "Executive Customer Relations Team". None of these teams have phone numbers or specific email addresses, and last names are never provided to avoid traceability (also, I really doubt the India-based call center folks really have names like Steve and Jessica anyway...)One of the call center workers was kind enough to tell me that there is no way for a VRBO customer service representative to contact any of these teams. They cannot be called on the phone. First-tier customer service personnel can ONLY email them and tell the customer that they'll be called within 24 hours. However, the call to the customer never happens - because the teams don't exist.I only got a call from VRBO when I blew up social media, called and emailed VRBO and Expedia executives directly, sent VRBO screen captures of my conversations with NYC NBC Channel 4, and threatened to call police.The Book with Confidence Guarantee is WORTHLESS.I was booked into a property that was completely closed for construction.The guarantee states:We may offer to rebook the Protected Traveler at another property advertised on a HomeAway Site, if a substantially similar property is available for the same period and under a new reservation.VRBO DOESN'T DO THIS. SIMILAR PROPERTIES EXISTED AND VRBO REFUSED TO REBOOK ME.They do not work to find you another property. All they do is tell you to find another one, book it yourself, and then wait for the refund for your original property. They assume everyone has funds to book another property.Imagine saving for your vacation, and then having to book another stay at the last second at a higher price.VRBO IS SIMPLY A BOOKING PLATFORM. ALL THEY DO IS PUBLISH LISTINGS AND PROCESS PAYMENTS. AFTER THAT THERE IS NO CUSTOMER SUPPORT AND THE GUARANTEE IS NOT HONORED.DO NOT BOOK WITH VRBO. They don't care about you.I only got my refund when I called and emailed every VRBO executive I could find.

name: PG
title: SCAM COMPANY
text: If I could give 1/2 a star, I would! The VRBO company is shady as heck! I hid the profile of my property because it was not available for rent. Next though I know I am 7000 miles away on a military deployment and I get a notification that someone is at my door needing to get in with a code. Someone booked my property. Obviously my property was not available so I informed the individual and cancel the reservation. VRBO then charged me a fee of $170 because I canceled the reservation. THE PROPERTY WAS NOT AVAILABLE! No one should have been able to reserve it. This is on VRBO and their system. When I called to explain the matter the individual on the other end just talked in circles and would not do anything about the fee. VRBO is a scam! Be careful with what you do with them. Document all your dealings with them in case they try to charge you a large fee!

name: Roya Blevins
title: Hot and sweaty in Arizona
text: Rented a house in AZ for five nights. Paid hundreds of dollars. They provided the code to the house 40 minutes late despite the fact we asked for early (2 hours) check in. Outside temperature was above 100 degrees and when we enter the house it showed 88 degrees. We tried to change the temperature to lower it and waited hour and half. When it didn’t change, contacted the host who is in another state. He wanted pictures of thermostat which we provided several times till 8:00pm. When he wasn’t helping I contacted Vrbo and the hold and transferring took another 2 hours. By 10:00pm no one tried to help and we had a sleepless night with 3 showers till morning. I contacted the host and Vrbo several times. I asked for refund for previous night and wanting to know if the host was going to send someone to fix the air conditioning. We had to spend from 9:00am till 5:00pm in the mall and different stores to keep cool. Both the host and Vrbo refused to talk about refunding us to be able to rent another place!!! We just check the house again at 5:00pm and still the inside is 82 degrees!! We don’t know what to do. My husband is 70 years old with Parkinson’s disease and I’m 64 years old with Fibromyalgia and arthritis. These people are heartless and don’t care!!! Be AWARE!! Hot and sweaty in Arizona!! Never again we book anything with this company.

name: sandra schulthies

name: S. Florance

text: DO NOT USE VRBO!  SCAM! I have spent hours trying to get a refund after a host cancelled our reservation.  It has been weeks and no resolution. The customer service is THE worst!  It's such a labyrinth.  Stick with Airbnb.

name: Becky Ellis
title: Terrible company
text: This review is not about a specific property, although it does relate to that. name: KenJayLee
title: If I could leave negative stars for…
text: If I could leave negative stars for vrbo, I would.I booked a place two weeks ago through VRBO.  Last week on 5/8/2024 was the date of my check-in.I reached out to the owner as agreed. 5 MILES away from the destination, the owner backed out of the reservation.I had drove over 11 hours - 700+ miles from NC to IL. With the exception of my daughter I knew no one in the town. The owner said that the previous occupants extended their stay. After I told them this was unacceptable and they only told me after I reached out, the owner of the property became unresponsive.Enter VRBO and the worst customer service ever. I was hung up on multiple times that day. VRBO tried to contact the owner themselves they were unresponsive to them as well. I was told that they would book me a room and take care of it. I was transferred to a travel associate. After multiple calls, hangups and the like they told me "it will be best to book your own stay, and get reimbursed."I did as I was supposed to do. I had receipts from the owner cancelling on me, I had the calls where VRBO has hung up, and was told about the price guarantee. Nothing for a week.I get an email from a VRBO rep saying that I was unresponsive, and they were going to close my case! title: We stayed at a VRBO in Montreal in the…
text: We stayed at a VRBO in Montreal in the summer of 2021 with my two daughters (then 1 and 3 and I was pregnant) and my husband. The listing said there was street parking but there was none to be found. When we walked in we noticed ongoing construction in the back which the owner said would be done 'shortly'. There was a door with a standing mirror in front of it and as we were looking around the place we thought maybe that door was a closet. Turns out it led to a basement with an OPEN ROOM TO THE OUTSIDE right as you got to the basement. There was no wall. There was no lock between the door I thought was a closet and this open wall. Anyone could walk in. There was also one AC unit in the living room and not in the rest of the place so it was absolutely boiling and one of the windows was broken. In the middle of the night the alarm went off (we turned it on because with an open wall we were very concerned) and I tried to contact the owner and no one called me back or came. We left after one night feeling extremely unsafe given that my kids are also mobile and could easily get up in the middle of the night and walk OUTSIDE since there was no wall. I called VRBO and they told me we would get a refund, no problem. And to leave since it was deemed unsafe after I sent video. I have since contacted them something like 20 times and I keep being transferred or I'm told it's an active case no problem. One time they connected me with the owner who told me I was irresponsible if my kids opened a door and WALKED OUT INTO THE OPEN and that a key to the closet door was available but not in the property. He also said that the alarm did not go off and I was not telling the truth. That was about it. Nothing. I reached out to VRBO recently and they said this had been too long ago and nothing they could do. Scam. Never ever staying with them again and we advise everyone not to.

title: VRBO's "guarantee" is worthless…
text: VRBO's "guarantee" is basically worthless. We rented a house in Yucca Valley for the weekend as we were attending a wedding. The manager didn't give me a phone number to contact them with and didn't respond to messages on VRBO. There were a variety of problems that made this a bad rental, all of which the management should have been aware of prior to our stay. Including an inoperable shower, thermostat that didn't work so no AC or heat, sharp thorns in the house where they ask you not too wear shoes etc.. When I contacted the manager via VRBO they never responded. When I contacted VRBO about the problems they told me I should have gone through the manager or contacted VRBO during our stay which was only two nights. Since I was waiting for a response from the management I didn't contact VRBO in time and their "guarantee" requires you to contact them during the stay. It's a catch 22 which forces users to be very aggressive with managers and owners in order to protect themselves. I couldn't spend the whole weekend fighting over this as I was in the wedding and had responsibilities. I have used VRBO many times and at least 50% of the rentals have problems. There is no quality control on the rentals and since I put an honest review up, the owners have given me a negative review as a renter. This is stacked against the renter. name: Susan Ancliffe
title: Book direct with the owner !
text: I am an owner and as such I would advise people to book direct as the fees charged by VRBO and all the booking sites are adding nearly 20pct on top of the rental price that the owner normally charges. This type of fee represents an additional 500-600 Euro fee to pay  for a one week holiday.Look for hints within the advert and search for the owner online, FB or Linkedin are good places to start.Today VRBO have charged me an extra 60 Euro from what was agreed when I accepted a guest booking, they have not told me why and the online help was useless. Even telling me that they could not see my house online!In the particular reservation that I am referring to, the  guest has paid 350 Euro in VRBO fees, I have paid a fee of 120 Euro and then VRBO have charged me 87 Euro in payment processing fees (which anyone in business will know is a totally ridiculous amount). On top of this guests might not be aware, that upon making the reservation VRBO keep all the money paid by the guest, including the damage deposit in their own VRBO account, only releasing the rental part after the stay has started.There are lots of FB groups where owners are advertising directly, look for the fully legal and licensed properties and save yourself a lot of money.I hope that helps.

name: Amy
title: Absolutely Horrendous Customer Service
text: While booking a house, a month out from my trip, I accidentally mistyped my own email. Obviously, this resulted in never getting an email confirmation for the booking. Less than a week after booking and being charged, I called VRBO. With the credit card information and the reservation confirmation, the first representative was able to confirm that the email was wrong, and forward me a confirmation to my correct email.Fast forward to several days before the vacation, and I call back as I've not gotten any further details. Same thing - confirmed my information through reservation confirmation number et al. That representative sent my personal, correct email to the host snd dent me an email invite so I could "join" the trip. The host did email me but advised she'd rather communicate through VRBO, and since I had access to the trip now I said of course. She advised she would send an message through VRBO with the security code to the house the morning of our rental.When that morning came, I drove myself, my husband, and my mother to the rental house. About 3-4 hours.I check VRBO and there is no message from the host - nor that i can see ... because, I realize, I'm only invited to the trip. Only the host can see messages.I call VRBO. This time they tell me they can't access any information without the email that the reservation was made under. I tell them I don't know that email, as I put in the wrong email and have no idea what email it was. They ask for my correct email, which I provide, and they tell me there's no reservation under that email. I tell them I know that, and advise i can give them the reservation number. They tell me that will do no good without the email.Around and around.I say, "so how am I supposed to access this house I rented and paid for if you can't give me the access code?" They advise me I can wait 24-48 hours for my email to be updated.I've only rented this house for two nights and I'm certainly not sleeping in my car in the driveway to the house I paid for. They tell me there is no other option.I hang up and call back.Next person gives me a hard time, but eventually asks me lots of questions to confirm I am the reservation holder. At one point she asks, "and where are you going? Florida? California ...?" I provide her the street address of the rental. The one I am parked in front of. She is FLABBERGASTED and says, "how do you know the address?!"..........I say because as I've been telling you, and the previous person, I've had the internal messages emailed to me twice - including the confirmation with the address.She begrudgingly gave me the security code, but not before pointing out to me that this is all my fault for mistyping my email address.......... don't rent from VRBO.

text: I made a reservation on March 5. On April 5, I requested a cancellation. I received an email from "vacasa" stating my cancellation had been accepted. title: Here is a frustrated review of VRBO…
text: Here is a frustrated review of VRBO from the perspective of a host who had a very poor experience trying to get set up on the platform:What a complete waste of time! I spent hours of my evening trying in vain to get set up as a host on VRBO, only to realize their platform is entirely incompatible with my guest house business model.From the very start, it was an exercise in frustration. There was zero upfront information or clarity about what types of properties VRBO actually supports. The terms and conditions aren't even available until you're deep into the registration process.It quickly became apparent that VRBO is designed solely for renting out entire properties - they have no functionality for listing individual rooms like a bed and breakfast. But I had no way to determine that ahead of time.The onboarding process was a nightmare. I was forced to go through the entire listing setup rigmarole, wasting huge amounts of time inputting details for my non-compatible property. There was no option to cancel or exit the registration partway through once I realized VRBO wasn't a fit.By the time I finally finished the unnecessarily convoluted process, I had a useless "Property ID" and listing that I immediately hid and archived. But even then, I couldn't simply delete my account and walk away.I spent over 2 hours fruitlessly chatting with support, getting nowhere. They insisted there was no way to just close the account I had been forced to create. I had to call in the next day and waste even more time arguing with someone to finally get my account shut down.Between the lack of transparency, the incompatible business model, and the inability to simply abandon the registration when I realized VRBO wasn't right for me, the entire experience was a gigantic headache. I wouldn't wish that kind of run-around on anyone. Steer clear of VRBO unless you have an entire property to rent out.Here's an addition to the review addressing the potential GDPR compliance issue with VRBO's account deletion process:As a final insult, I have serious doubts whether VRBO's convoluted account closure process is even GDPR compliant. Under the General Data Protection Regulation, companies are required to allow users to easily withdraw consent and request deletion of their personal data.But despite the hours I spent pleading with their support staff, VRBO stubbornly refused to simply delete the account and associated personal information I had been forced to provide during the registration fiasco. I ultimately had to make a second call the following day just to get someone to finally shut down my account.For a major platform like VRBO to make withdrawing consent and deleting one's data such an arduous, multi-step battle is potentially a violation of GDPR privacy rights. At the very least, it's a shockingly user-unfriendly practice that no company should embrace in this day and age.Between the non-transparency, the lack of support for anything other than entire property rentals, and the borderline hostile data practices, I simply cannot recommend anyone waste their time with the VRBO platform. They've got a long way to go when it comes to respecting privacy rights and serving hosts with non-traditional rental models.

Arrived, property was awful  missing and broken furniture. Raised and broken floorboards in master bedroom, filthy dirty cooker. Hair hanging from ceiling fan, crusted dried food on sofa. Dirty walls, flooring, cracked tiles but more importantly no smoke alarms, fire extinguisher and couldn’t see a landline phone. We didn’t stay and informed property agent straight away, asked if they had alternative…no they didn’t.  For smell they did provide a can of fe breeze.  After we left they offered deep clean but that should have been done before we arrived but still didn’t address health and safety. Communicated with vrbo, and informed strict no refund policy. They passed the buck to property agent stating they would not refund booking fee unless agent refunded property fee. Agent states refund paid but it wasn’t, then offered 30% per night but declined stating I wanted FULL refund. Agent said he had to re-hash with owner and we haven’t heard since. We provided all evidence to vrbo and to agent but vrbo have stated as per there terms no refund and if I contact them again I will be ignored and that I need to deal with agent or payment card company.  I have done the latter but why should customers have to go this route.  An owner can cancel yr booking to suit themselves but god forbid the customer has to leave because of reasons stated…no refund then! It ruined what should have been a reunion holiday.   We are 3 pensioners one who is registered disabled veteran.  Since this happened I have found reviews as far back as 2022 that support what we said, yet after every bad review there are two reviews stating cleanliness etc a 10. Rubbish as far as I’m concerned.  Property agent said perhaps our expectations were too high..NO we just wanted what was advertised and one of the bathrooms wasn’t even in the property.  Vrbo continue to list this apartment.  They know the issues but they are all content to keep peoples money.  Turns out we were not the first to leave because of the state of it.  I would NEVER use vrbo again. We are seasoned travellers and this is the worst place we have ever booked and response is appalling.  What’s even more upsetting is the realisation that other people will fall into the same predicament if they book this property. Like others have said, communication is good until there is a problem then it is dire and yr batting yr head against a brick wall. people save hard for holidays and this is what happens. In todays climate it’s disgraceful!!!

name: Michael Frisby

text: Booked a 5 BR, 3 bath house in Portland, TX for a weekend stay for 8 people through VRBO. When we got to the house we discovered that only the master BR, kitchen and living room had lights. name: RM
title: Booked a house for 10 people for a 30th…
text: Booked a house for 10 people for a 30th birthday, to be told ON THE DAY it had been double booked. No help from VRBO in sourcing alternate option. Do not use.

name: jim hayes
title: Beware of VRBO listings!
text: The listing and pictures were very misleading. We spoke with VRBO and were told to speak with owner who agreed to refund us 20% of the funds he received. name: monica Geyer
title: We had to cancel due to my 92-year-old…
text: We had to cancel due to my 92-year-old dad's health.  I tried to put in a claim with VRBO's Global Alliance Assistance partner and they NEVER responded after MULTIPLE tries.  The VRBO folks were very nice, but zero helpful.  DO NOT USE.

name: Melissa Cherry
title: VRBO will try to scam you
text: I tried to make a reservation in Guerneville, CA for May 18th and the app glitched or something and made it for May 19th instead. No problem, I'll just cancel it, well the booking never showed up on my account (the app) so I go back to it and there's a message that says "booking not available at this time" so I thought well it didn't book and that's why I can't see it on my account. Wrong. The booking rate was charged to PayPal and subsequently pulled from my bank account. I did get an email saying my reservation was confirmed, but clicking on the link took me to the app still showing no booking. I contacted the host (who is probably a scammer as well) who told me it wasn't her problem and there's nothing she could do to help. So I contacted VRBO and upon recounting my tale told me I could cancel but it would cost me a 50% penalty. Oh I should say this fun little bit of thievery took place the very next day after the booking error. I of course argued with them about the penalty but they told me the host had set up that rule. I reached out to the host again and she literally refused to cancel and told me that it was VRBO that was ripping me off and not her. I personally believe they were colluding to rip me off. So in summary, the app glitched and booked me on the wrong night and then the charged me a 50% penalty for canceling the next day which was a whole month before the reservation by the way. I would pay triple the amount with another service before I would ever give VRBO another cent. They basically robbed me of a couple hundred bucks and I'm so lucky that I was only trying to book one night.

name: Gina W
title: Awful experience with a host on VRBO
text: Awful experience with a host on VRBO. Her name is Sabrina Montemerani and she owns a rental company in Florida. We rented a property for 6 nights through VRBO in Lauderdale by the Sea. Unfortunately, the original place we booked and paid for ($553.33 a night) had a flood and we were notified at the airport less than an hour before take off. She offered us a place but it did not have a pool and was not on the water. But since we were ready to board we said yes. The replacement place was listed at $250.00 a night. So we directly messaged Sabrina and asked her if we would receive the difference per night to which she responded yes. Well, that was a lie because she only refunded us $235.00 total. The difference should have been $619.98. When I wrote to her requesting details about how she came up with that amount she ghosted me. VRBO was NO help. So now I have to dispute the charges with my credit card. I will never use VRBO again. As of 4/11/24 the host has made up some lie about the rental fee on VRBO being incorrect and that is why they cannot give me what I am owed. You can’t make this stuff up! Anyway, she is now giving me $200.00 more, but still not the full amount. Meanwhile, I have reached out to VRBO a second time and along with sending them everything in writing and pictures to document the correspondence back and forth with the host the VRBO representative actually listened to my concerns and I am waiting to see what they determine. Keeping my fingers crossed that VRBO does the right thing.

name: Mick McClain
title: Will NEVER! use Vrbo again!

text: I paid in pounds sterling for a house in London from my British bank. My payment was converted to dollars by VRBO and my British bank charged me almost 500 in fees for the conversion. I contacted VRBO twice to ask them to reimburse the fee, but both times they denied making the conversion. This is why I gave them a one star rating.VRBO's reply is disingenuous. The price was displayed in pounds, I paid in pounds, and the owner was reimbursed by VRBO in pounds. There was NO reason to convert the payment to dollars and back to pounds. That cost me nearly 500 pounds. VRBO should reimburse me.

name: Patrick
title: Customer Support Gets You Nowhere...
text: TL;DR - I tried to book a holiday weekend for my family of 5 a few weeks in advance.  The initial booking went just fine, but the following day my reservation was automaticaly canceled.  After many tries, and repeated contact with support, I was never able to make the booking.VRBO support process retains zero information about your previous contact.  They do not escalate problems, and seemingly do not care if these problems lead to losing your booking.Longer Story:After the automatic cancelation, I contacted the host, who had no idea why, so I simply tried to rebook it.  Nope.  Generic error message, no details why it happened.  On my own, I tried every trouble-shooting trick I could think of:  different payment, different web browser, different device, etc.Nothing worked, so I called support. I had to call 5-6 times before they escalated my issue to tech support, completing the SAME troubleshooting steps (most of which I had already done myself) each time.  I'm told that they will reach out by the end of the day.  Nope!The next time I called, I demanded to speak to a supervisor.  30 minutes later, he comes on the line to tell me that the issue was on their end and that it had been referred to the developers. name: Daniel
title: Useless client support that will not help you against deceiver owner
text: When arriving to the property with my guests I was informed that my arrival was not informed to the check-in personnel, even if my booking had been made and paid months in advance. As a result the apartment was not cleaned and the previous guests had left it very dirty. This a more than awkward situation since I had guests with me and I had a paid a cleaning fee upfront within the stay price.Result: (i) the owner does not even answer me since the day of my arrival and (ii) VRBO client support team does not provide any valid solution, solely excusing themselves that it should have been myself contacting them earlier. You should only use VBRO if you aim to have a troubled vacation and issued that will not be solved afterwards. Definitely not recommended.

name: StatsMaven
title: Watch out VRBO & Host keep unavailable listing on web site
text: 3/22/24 Yesterday morning: Spent 35 minutes getting VRBO system to accept my "Reservation Request" including its obtaining my validated credit card information.  At 12:49 p.m., "Your request has been sent: look for a response within 24 hours. In the meantime, keep track of your booking status in My Trips."Approximately 24 hours later, REJECTED.  Took a SCREEN IMAGE photo of the listing still showing available.  Spent hour getting through to Call Center and spent lengthy time on telephone.  Call Center could not find a reason except that the HOST Lauren Dembeck may have failed to indicate availability, YET the listing yesterday and today, 3/23/24, still shows available.  at 14:16 Host stated she received a booking TODAY 3/23/24 and booked it and now has taken the listing down.SEE ALSO MADDIEB’s review of VRBO and delayed bookings with resulting paying for two.

name: Deanna
title: UNETHICAL & DECEITFUL
text: The WORST experience dealing with this company after the fact of renting a property.  4 of us rented a home in Siesta Key, Florida. First issue was I was requested to pay a 'cleaning fee' of $250, 2 days before my arrival which was NOT listed/discussed/mentioned in the rental agreement or listing. I called VRBO to explain this was not mentioned and they basically blew me off as nothing they can do about it. We get to our rental which was supposed to have a hot tub per the listing, it did not. All over the home were sticky notes of instructions/orders/rules etc., which was absolutely bizarre. We had to contact the homeowner to adjust the 'locked' thermostat because it was controlled by her remotely, just to mention a few gripes. I return home and leave my HONEST review on the property which VRBO did NOT post because I 'violated their guidelines' because I mentioned the cleaning fee in the review and 'negative' comments. I called VRBO requesting an explanation for leaving my perfectly honest review. I literally was transferred 6 different times to people that barely spoke any English, over 90 minutes on the phone!! They never posted my review and I was unable to edit it to repost it to 'their liking'. This company is a complete scam and unethical. Never again!!

name: Alec Inglis
title: We had an disaster rental
text: We had an disaster rental. The rented property had NO electricity or VERY limited electricity for 9 days at 1000$ a day. That also meant no water or toilets.VRBO systems are not contactable without internet and their NA numbers cut off for 86% of the world. The local agents and host would not respond..leaving, on the first, night roaming the streets trying to find emergency accommodation.We were told that would be a single night at a house we did NOT choose and that ended up to be for the duration of our stay. That house also lost electricity on the second to last day.On our return, VRBO were no help. Hard to contact if you are not IN the USA. A frightening experienceBEWARE

name: Jimmy  Onoufriou
title: Villa for 2025 being advertised fraudulently
text: I tried to book a villa for 2025. The advert claims that the villa is available for the dates chosen. When i tried to book the villa I was told by the owner that the price quoted is incorrect and the property will be relisted "next week" but the price will be nearly 5 TIMES the price originally quoted. I have advised VRBO about the false representation and they have advised me that they will investigate but WILL NOT let me know of the outcome!Today, some 2 weeks later, the owner is still advertising his property at the original WRONG price.Either the site is being overrun by unscrupulous owners or VRBO is aiding and abetting them, as I have now seen several other villas advertised on the site for a fraction of the price that is being advertised on competitors' sites.I am now too scared to book anything with them and will stick to the sites I know best and can trust!

name: Tyler Webster
title: STOLEN $800 Watch
text: I left an $800 watch at my VRBO. No chance it wasnt there. I got no reply from VRBO. After finally getting in contact with them after 3 weeks, they proceed to tell me they only hold onto items for 2 weeks. So basically an employee stole it. Vrbo is not clear on contact info and you cant directly contact the location owner. The person helping me is super rude basically telling me to go kick rocks. You think after gettinga standard charge of 200 dollars for cleaning fees that they wouldnt steal your stuff. Im extremely upset. I had a reward system with vrbo, was my go to booking app. Never again. BEWARE

name: Maddieb
title: Don’t trust VRBO with your money
text: I’ve used VRBO successfully in the past, but my recent dismal and costly experience using them last month to find a vacation property in Mérida, Mexico convinced me to never visit their website again.  They offer zero support if their end user gets ripped off by an unscrupulous property owner who first said my booking dates were available. So I gave them my payment info.  They immediately responded that those dates weren’t available after all. So I booked a different property.  The next day the first  host emailed me a confirmation for the original dates. When I explained I had made a different reservation, they said they weren’t refunding my payment because it was too late to cancel even though the check-in date was still over 3 weeks away. I got stuck paying over $700 for a property I never used. Don’t trust VRBO…they’ll ruin your vacation.

name: Scott N
title: I wish I could give zero stars
text: I wish I could give zero stars. I had a renter cancel on me a week before my vacation, and not only did VRBO not help me get my money back, but they fought me the entire way. After many hours on the phone and countless emails, I got back $1k of the $5k I spent. Airbnb certainly isn’t perfect, but at least they never stole from me.

name: Rach G
title: Terrible website!
text: Terrible website!! I used to love Vrbo or home away as it was previously. But the websites terrible, can't get rates far in advance ie looking to book an orlando trip for 18 months time calendar's are greyed out email hosts and they say its vrbo website doing it etc etc, nightmare!! Also fees they add seem to have increased, If you find a nice property on vrbo find out if you can book direct woth owners do your homework and it will be much cheaper!!!

name: Customer
title: Scammers. Avoid
text: We booked and paid for an apartment in Bath through Vrbo two months in advance. When it came to receiving information on how to access the property, no information was shared and our host was unreachable on the phone number provided by the company. Text messages were ignored, the phone went straight to voicemail and the voicemail box was full. After attempting to get information on how to access the property for 2 days, including while we were already in transit to Bath, we had to contact Vrbo customer service through the chat. We were provided with 3 or 4 different phone numbers to call customer service and none of them worked. After several attempts we finally received a working phone number through the chat. Vrbo attempted to call the host, but also unable to and they had no access information to the property. We were told they will cancel the accommodation and we can self-lodge. Meaning we needed to book somewhere on the day of our travel where prices have gone up considerably. They could not provide us with alternative lodging, refund our money (our case had to be transferred and approved by a different team) and we would have been on our own booking accommodation elsewhere at last minute prices. They repeatedly refused to help and provide any form of compensation. It is Vrbo's responsibility to use reliable hosts and ensure they have the right access information to their properties. This was not the case here. We were left in the lurch and ended up having to book a hotel and spending more money. The host ended up sending the access information last minute so we were then left with two paid for bookings and of course no refund from Vrbo. Absolutely horrible experience which caused stress and caused us spending a lot of money. Will not book ever again as you never know whether you will actually have accommodation or not. Avoid these scammers.

name: JH
title: Poor access to customer service agents
text: Only way to speak to a customer service agent from the UK is to call a US number. I recently had an issue I couldn’t resolve with a host or website resources and had to make a 20 minute call that cost £80.

name: G White

Tried to book a 3 bed house in ingleton 5th to 7th July for £785 and they lost it for me. Extremely disappointed with their service  the owner of the property should get rid of them

title: Do not book with this company we had a…
text: Do not book with this company we had a weekend break booked for 7 people and two dogs the afternoon before we were due to go my daughter fReceived an email to say that the property was not available when she questioned why we were told that the person that we were renting from didnt own the property anymore .How can this happen when we had booked and paid for it.Vrbo said we will do all we can to help then offered us a hotel with dogs they then said we could book another property with extra cost and they would pay the difference we were unable to find anything in the area we wanted so asked for a refund which we got my daughter asked for compensation and was told they dont offer that .The company are a complete joke 7 people that had booked time off work looking forward to a birthday celebration and all left feeling very unhappy

name: GURMEET DHALIWAL
title: Vrbo ruined my anniversary!!!
text: Vrbo ruined my anniversary!!!We were travelling to Thailand for our anniversary and two hours before our flight from Bangkok was to Phuket our villa was cancelled by the host leaving us no where to go when we landed after an hours flight. We contacted Vrbo who couldn’t get a hold of the host either and said they would put us up in a hotel for 3 days. We were put up in a hotel whilst they sourced another alternative villa for us and we also ask for our money back from the host (who was now blanking all our messages). Two days in and we were told to pay for another villa via any of their sites (Vrbo, Hotels.com or Expedia) and they would give us back the difference so we booked another villa with them (leaving us out of pocket £1500). We went to the second villa address to find there was no villa at all. We contacted Vrbo again who told us to pay for another villa and they would refund us for this one and put us back in a hotel. By this time the trust was gone and we ended up using Air BnB who were brillant. We got all our money back in bribs and drabs but it ruined all our trip. We were out there for two weeks and spent all our time trying to sort these issues out. We lost all our money for all the activities we pre booked. I contacted Vrbo to compensate me for the lost time and ruined holiday but was told they don’t have a compensation scheme. Good way to get out of ruining an important holiday for us!!!!

name: Frederico Giaconia
title: Wife and I rented an expensive cabin
text: Wife and I rented an expensive cabin.  Seemed overpriced but we wanted secluded weekend getaway and we're looking for a place that was pet friendly.2 days before our arrival we get a "welcome guide" and said no pets.  We contacted the property owner and they said oh yes pets are welcome but there is a $50 per pet fee, this is not a deposit.  There was nothing in the listing that stated this, there was also nothing during the booking process.We contacted VRBO and they don't do crap but contact the property owner said they would make note of it and contact the owner to discuss.Owner is shaking us down for extra money for a secluded cabin for $200 a nite, $90 "cleaning fees", booking fees has only 2 bed 1 bath.  Ridiculous!We found the place pretty quickly.  I guess I should have read the property reviews and reviews about VRBO.  NEVER AGAIN!

name: Karly Siddens
title: Cancellation Policy
text: My booked property has a non-refundable cancelation policy and due to a winter storm advisory deemed by the national weather service we are unable to safely get to our property. I had every intention of making it to our trip but have had to cancel 24 hours prior to my stay. I think based on an emergency cancellation VRBO should ensure we get our money back. Furthermore, I let the property management know that I felt this was inconsiderate and greedy and received this response "Calling us greedy and inconsiderate is not a good way to get a refund if by chance the unit does rent back out". I think these policies should be updated for an emergency, last minute cancellation that travel would honestly put me in danger.

They offshore their call centers and the people at the call centers don't want to help you and then when you try to post a review about what happened they block it and they won't let you talk about it so I hope VRBO go out of business I really do. name: Reef W
title: Nightmare - Never Ever Again
text: One of the worst experiences I’ve ever had as a customer. Vrbo does not hold the property owners accountable to the descriptions they put on their property. The owner offered a refund for misleading us but then went MIA. Vrbo said there was nothing they could do because they couldn’t contact the property owner themselves, as he was ignoring Vrbo as well. The crazy part is they didn’t have any issues taking and keeping my ~$2,000. Completely fraudulent if you ask me. name: GREGORY TRAHAR
title: The last 2 bookings I had have been a…
text: The last 2 bookings I had have been a disaster. Both bookings were cancelled shortly before travel after they had been booked many months and confirmed.One of the bookings even advertised again for the same dates at an increased rate after cancelling me.The company had both full payments for months in their accounts earning interest, while I lost money through currency exchange rates when they were recredited to my credit card.Customer Services were of no help

name: Mark
title: Worst customer service in Canada by a…
text: Worst customer service in Canada by a country mile!!!! They were absolutely no help whatsoever when the owner did not reply to my OR VRBO requests for information  about how to access the apartment we rented.  After a number of attempts by their online portal with numerous platitude responses i was asked to phone a number where i spoke to their worker who assured me that she would escalate things to their solutions team and promised that they would connect with me the following day at the airport and of course they DIDNT !!! name: Malago Motor Company
