text: Do Not book through these...Falsely advertised a property...Refunded by the owner but these kept their fees when promised a full refund...Ignored my emails and messages...Shocking customer service...Don't waste your time or money!!!!

name: Lynn Lubieniecki
title: VRBO DOESN'T CARE ABOUT THEIR CUSTOMERS!!
text: I booked with Vrbo for the first time on January 7, 2024 for a weekend away skiing with my family in February.  Host double booked me and didn't advise me.  I just happened to call Vrbo a week before my vacation and they told me my reservation was cancelled.  By that time, there was no where left to book.  I was devastated.   Vrbo offered no compensation whatsoever.  Luckily AirBnB assisted me.  I will definitely be using AirBnB again NOT Vrbo.

name: Lana
title: If I could give VRBO negative review I…
text: If I could give VRBO negative review I would!  It’s utter disaster that they are in business after the way they deal with costumers that book through them! I will make it short but basically the listing I booked and the address given did not reflect the pictures. Prior to arriving to the property I contacted VRBO and expressed my concerns about signing the service agreement with the management company. I told them I didn’t feel comfortable or protected based on what I have seen from photos on Google vs actual photos that I used to book the property. Being 7 months pregnant and traveling with 2 kids I specifically asked if 2 SUVs could fit in the garage. I was told yes (I have  confirmation of that conversation). Non of the car could fit it’s too low. The only option is to park on the street where car has to be moved every 2 hours! Second issue is the potent smell of thd  house that smells like gas leak or something, making me feel so unsafe. I called VRBO and explained my concerns to hear that they would have a manager call me! I told them I have kids, I don’t know what to do, whether to unpack or not. I have heard nothing still…..it’s been over 5 hours! Very irresponsible and uncaring of VRBO!!!!! Never again will I use them!!!!

name: DB
title: Don’t use VRBO!  Horrible experience!
text: Horrible!  I will never book with VRBO again!  In mid-February  2024, I booked a two-bed apartment in San Diego for two couples.   I inquired on the VRBO platform about the parking situation in mid-February.  The host did not respond to me or the subsequent inquiry by a VRBO agent about parking.The listing stated the host would contact me about entry three days before check-in He never did, nor did he respond to my inquiries on the VRBO platform, or by telephone call (VRBO gave me his number).  At least six VRBO Agents unsuccessfully tried to contact him by phone and email three days and two days before check-in.Because the other couple was flying in from out of town and we were driving hundreds of miles to the apartment, VRBO’s response that “if you show up and you can’t get in,  we will help you rebook that evening” was absolutely inadequate and bad business policy.I was therefore on the hook for the entire payment of the booking.  I was told if I canceled, I would not get a refund.The host then went onto the listing and removed the verbiage that stated he would contact me three days before check-in.  He then canceled the listing after I and two other agents again unsuccessfully tried to contact him.I have lost all confidence in VRBO. Obviously,  they did not vet the host.  Their lack of responsibility for enforcing check-in policies, and the requirement that I had to show up at 4 pm to an unknown location (I had the address but not the apartment number) in order to get rebooked or a refund is shocking and appalling.It was an infuriating experience that took hours of my time.  I will NEVER use VRBO again.

name: Karen Pringle
title: Booked a chalet in Borovets
text: Booked a chalet in Borovets, tried contacting the host numerous times via the App and by phone to arrange check in without success, Vrbo said they tried to contact them too with no response and told me to wait until the day before then call Vrbo. Tried calling numerous times - an automated message said ‘goodbye’ each time then cut off, had to make a call and book a hotel as we were travelling with 3 young children in less than 12 hours and since then I have had no response to various attempts to obtain a refund, the customer services e-mail I was previously using no longer accepts e-mails, the virtual assistant is no use, I’ve sent an e-mail and a letter and no reply, they seem to be making themselves as uncontactable as possible! If anyone from Vrbo reads this and even cares please give me an e-mail address to progress this!!

name: Stranded guest
title: I wish I could rate a zero
text: I wish I could rate a zero. Your confidence guarantee is no guarantee at all.  Beware of this company and their parent company Expedia.  They don't care about their customers at all.  I wish I had went to Trust Pilot before I booked with VRBO for my parents.  I would have clearly known to not use them.The process for when a host cancels last minute is awful.  VRBO profits by issue a fine of half the cost of the rental and then turning around and failing to service the stranded guest!VRBO under their guarantee was asking my parents to book a new rental at a higher cost (approximately $3,000 more than their original rental) that was sub par to what they originally rented.  They were asking them to spend this before receiving their refund for the canceled property.   VRBO said you will “possibly” or “should” get the amount reiumbursed that was more than the original amount. They did put them in a hotel for a few nights but then stopped responding and left my parents stranded with no resolution to their case.  When reaching out to customer service  for help.  They said they couldn’t help only the Rebooking team could.  When you asked to be tranferred to the rebooting team they say they can’t, email them.  When you remind them you have been, they haven’t redponded, and your parents are stranded - they respond with sorry all I can do is put a note in your case.  They didn’t care that my parents were stranded.You would think saying unacceptable get me a manager would surely get you the help you need, right? Wrong, they won’t even respond.I requested a manager 4 times.  I was told all 4 times someone would be in touch with me. The first call I was on hold for 37 minutes waiting.  I got hung up on - nobody called me back.  The second one - she told me she was getting a manager, then chatting with a manager, and then when I requested to speak with the manager she just kept talking and was refusing saying they can not do anything for me only rebooking could.  I again repeated they aren't getting back with me and my parents are stranded.  She said they should get a hotel room.  I finally had to hang up after 55 more minutes because I was getting anywhere.  I then got on chat to request and document my request for a manager.  They said a manager would be back with me but it could take over 24 hours.   It's been over 24 hours nobody has called.   I then finally got outreach from the the rebooking team memeber who was supposed to be helping me.  She said she was off for 2 days and her team should have been back with me after I called and emailed.  I explained at this point my parents are so upset they have headed home since nobody was communicating with us.   I asked for a manager again she said she would let her manager know and have her call me. I never got a manager only an email stating leadership has reviewed my case.  Someone will be in touch with a goodwill reimbursement of $500.  It also said, “Your case has been thoroughly reviewed and approved by our Leadership Team, and the reimbursement amount isn't negotiable.”I then re-email asking if they are refusing to have a manager call me.  They respond that a manager will call me later that day.  That was yesterday of course, I never received the call.  What do you think the chances are I will get a call from the manager today?  I plan to email executive leadership.  What do you think the chances are that they will respond?And as far as the $500 that only added further insult.  The fine to the owner who canceled will be almost $6000.  The accommodations they provided were $1,800 so adding the $500 means they had expenses of $2,300.   That still left them with over $3,000 so as I see it VRBO strategy is to ignore and frustrate their customers to profit $3,000.My parents well they were left with $500 to cover their car expenses of $2,000 and hotel expenses of over $500.  On topOf that you imagine how disappointing as a new retire it was that your month-long dream vacation was ruined and that the special times you had planned with your 19-year-old granddaughter who was living in the area for pilot school weren’t going to happen.And for me I probably spent at least 16 hours helping them on phone calls, emails, researching etc. only to have no real resolution!Zero stars!

name: Corrie Crane
title: Host cancelled a week before check in
text: I booked a stay in October for my daughter's wedding in March. Then a week before we leave the host cancelled my reservation. I contacted VRBO to file a complaint but was told since they refunded me I couldn't file a complaint. I have a week to find a new place to stay.

name: Lynne Slipper
title: Be aware that Vrbo is not ABTA…
text: Be aware that Vrbo is not ABTA regulated so there is no one you can contract should it all go wrong. They also have no way you can leave a review.  You can leave a review of the property you stayed in but you can not say anything about the company who you did the booking through.They have very keen and enthusiastic staff, however the problems come from their a circular complaints system.  Each complaint is dealt with by whoever is on duty.  I have now had at least 8 members of staff who have run out of option  s so they just put the phone down.  You ring again, you go through a same process and they will never let you get back t the previous person. Sometimes an email comes that’s bears no relation to what you talked about or the problem you are trying to solve.  You try to respond to the email however the response time for reply’s is very short, them the email link closes down.  No body after over 15 hours of phone calls can solve the problem. You occasionally get a supervisor email you, however it’s obvious they have not read the information and they never back to you if you email them back .  Just get one member of staff to follow through on each complaint and it will save everybody’s time and energy. Still no solution in sight.Trustpilot allows you to amend your review of the company replies to your review as below. So my heart is full of hope as three more contacts with owner and supervisors had not had any outcome as nobody reads the f**"king notes and evidence. I have a new route in great. Not great same old route. You can see how polite they are, but they just need to do their job. Still no progress.

name: Tamsin
title: EASY TO LOOSE MONEY ON BOOKING NOT PAID FOR
text: COULD HAVE LOST MONEY ON BOOKING NOT PAID FORTHROUGH VRBO.I'm a Vrbo host and my guest paid a small deposit for their stay ( from which Vrbo deducted a large fee of £90).BUT then Vrbo didn't make sure the guests paid the second part of the fee before they checked in for their holiday in my cottage.It was not easily visible that the guest had not paid for their holiday in my cottage. It's only as I look through my bank statements today I discovered I had only received £103.38 for 3 guests to stay in my 2 bedroom boutique cottage between Christmas and New Year.VRBO failed to send me a clear WARNING message to tell me the guests had not paid before they checked in, so I unwittingly checked the guests in and they were able to stay in my cottage without paying.I am worried about being badly out of pocket as I have had to pay for logs for the wood-burner, utilities including heating, laundry and for my cleaner.Vrbo took £90 for this booking, but unlike Airbnb didn't warn me clearly when the guest hadn't paid.I phoned the Vrbo Helpline today and it took 25 minutes before the person I spoke to was able to establish that the guest hadn't paid.As a busy host, I'm more concerned about providing a great stay for my guests, and would hope that Vrbo would  take care that the bookings, and ensure guests have paid before they arrive.Vrbo advertise host insurance but it dosen't seem to cover this situation.Thankfully the guest now paid ( it was an honest oversight on their part) but it's left me uncomfortable about hosting through Vrbo.I believe Vrbo could improve their communication with hosts when a guest hasn't paid the second part of their fee.I'd like them to send out a very clear warning signal

name: Ron Hefley
title: VRBO literally rented us a home WITHOUT UTILITIES
text: VRBO literally rented a vacation property to my wife and I WITHOUT UTILITIES. We arrived around 4pm after a full day of travel - we notified VRBO and the Property Manager as soon as we checked in and realized nothing worked. VRBO's property issue policy is to give the Property Manager 5 hours to resolve any issue before taking any next steps. After 5 hour wait, at 900pm after a full day of travel, my wife and I were told by VRBO they would reimburse us our money and that we should just go get a hotel. Problem was we brought our dog with us (which is why we were using a VRBO property) and there were no available hotels that late at night that would accept animals. We were left stranded with NO OPTIONS. VRBO Service Representatives were completely rude and did not care at all to help place us in another property; I would have of course paid the difference if more (we weren't trying to get anything for free, we just wanted to figure out a solution). Property Manager couldn't help - VRBO would not place us in another property - after an entire day of travel, we turned around and spent the entire night travelling back home because we had no place to stay. Vacation was terminated, ruined and my vacation days for 2024 were lost. THANKS VRBO, I WILL NEVER USE YOUR SERVICE AGAIN FOR ANY REASON AND HIGHLY RECOMMEND OTHERS CONSIDER ALTERNATE PROPERTY PROVIDERS.  VRBO really should screen their properties, a home without utilities should not be listed as available on their site.

name: Bella
title: DO NOT BOOK WITH VRBO
text: Wish I had read these reviews before booking with VRBO. Ruined 2 days of my holiday. We booked a boat-el in Florida. When we arrived it was uninhabitable (mould, dusty, smelly, broken, exposed wiring, etc). We spent an hour on phone with VRBO support (at great expense) trying to ascertain what to do. In the end, we were advised to book other accommodation at our own expense and they would probably reimburse it. It was short notice on a Friday/Saturday night in a tourist hot spot. So we booked one night at a cheap motel. About an hour after we completed that phone call (now 11pm) we had an email saying we would only be eligible for a refund if we booked through the Expedia/VRBO network - bit blooming late!The next day, we had an email saying we could book another hotel up to 2X value of original accommodation. Then claim it back via a case.When I got back from holiday I submitted the case. But the email bounced back saying standard support@vrbo email doesn't accept emails anymore.So I contacted support via chat. Long painful conversation with long waits, she said she would send me an email to get case moving again. All super unclear.A week later, and nothing has happened, so I get back in touch. Turns out they have closed my case without refunding me. So I ask why and apparently for "quality reasons" they can't leave case open for many days. You can't make this stuff up. Quality for who?! Because it is certainly not their customers.No accommodation. No apology. No refund. No customer service. No s**** given!Maybe one day I'll get a refund, but it'll be a cold day in hell before I book a trip with VRBO again.

title: Terrible Booking Experience - Never Again
text: Booked accomodation via Vrbo as part of a trip for my wife's birthday present.Shortly after booking, it was cancelled (refund generated) by the property owner who messaged me to say the property was closed/may not be available for a year and that she had reported this to Vrbo and spent time with them to ensure it would not be available for booking. I complained to VRBO about this stating I would expect a £100 voucher by way of recompense, but they got back to me saying I'd be getting precisely nothing, nil, nada.The first time I tried to complain was verbally, but the agent didn't seem to be able to relay the complaint properly, so she generated an email template for me to put it in writing. Whatever the content was did not work on my phone so I responded to the email. When I rang back to check on progress they said they had no record of it!!Even if they didn't agree with issuing me £100 voucher, youd've thought there would have been a gesture of good-will made given the terrible customer experience, but nothing.I won't be going anywhere near this company again.

title: RENTAL CANCELLATION
text: I booked a house thru VRBO. One month before the move-in date, the real estate agency that was renting the house canceled. The owner had decided to sell. Now, this was not the fault of Vrbo. I felt that they should have taken some responsibility, and helped us.

name: Shania A
title: DO NOT USE VRBO EVER
text: We were scheduled to stay in your Auburn location.  However, upon arrival we noticed that there was the smell of cat urine.  Upon entering the living room, we noticed that someone had left their pillow on the couch.  Upon further inspection we found an empty water bottle on the back side of the couch.  This prompted my wife to inspect further.  She then found trash shoved in between the cushions of the couch which then led to her finding two more empty water bottles and a toy under the couch.  The refrigerator had a brick holding up what we assumed to be the door of the refrigerator.  We then decided to inspect the restrooms which had one hand towel in a tray on the counter and what looked like a used towel clumsily folded on the edge of the bathtub.  The linen closet was filthy and had a comforter on the top shelf that looked to have been used and sloppily folded and shoved back into the space.  There was dirt on the two other shelves and random string on the bottom shelf.  The trash was stashed outside in an encloser.  I have contacted VRBO in reference to these issues. We provided pictures to substantiate our claims.  Once the rep recieved the pictures he apologized and proceeded to explain to me that a supervisor would be contacting me shortly.  Once the supervisor returned my call.  She explained that she did see the pictures and she apologized for the fact that we had driven 5+ hours to this location only to have to find other accommadations.  The supervisor went on to say that they could not provide a refund because we would have to speak to the person whom we booked with and that the problem did not violate VRBO's policy.  I explained to her that explained to much as to why the property was in the condition it was in.  Trash in the front yard, large pile of random trash strewn throught the the front of the house.Response to VRBO’s response:It must be nice to allow individuals to “sign up on your platform” and then claim ignorance as to the all but stellar accommadation. Why would a host feel led or compelled to have a space clean, free of pet odor, trash and someone’s bed pillow on the couch in the living room and not to mention no clean towels, except used ones available upon arrival. What was even more disingenuous is the that that when I spoke with a rep from VRBO it was shared that the property would be flagged to ensure other people would not be able to book due to the problems with this property. However when I checked the listing was still available for innocent people to become victims of losing money. But I guess that’s not your concern so as long as you receive your monthly stipend from a host. If you are going to market yourself as one of the top providers for guest to use. Please research “other” platforms and actually follow their lead. VRBO is definitely not a platform we will ever use in the future!  I would rather stay home!

name: MJ
title: Customer service is a nightmare
text: Customer service agents are unfriendly and entirely uninterested in helping people who are having difficulties contacting their hosts. I cancelled a reservation 7 months in advance (which had a 100% refund for cancellation prior to 1 month before stay). After a couple of weeks, I had not received the refund for my >1k deposit, and the host had not replied to my emails or phone messages.I described the situation to a customer service agent over the phone, and she told me that she would submit a case, and the case management team would contact me. I asked when I should expect to hear from them, and she said "I don't know." I asked whether I should expect to hear from them within a week, and she said "I don't know." I asked her if I could have a contact phone number or email address for the case management department, and she said "they do not have a phone number or an email address." I asked her if she could contact them for me to ask what the timeline would be, and she said "she has no way to communicate with the case management team." I asked if I could speak to her manager. She said that "she has no way to contact her manager." I asked her if I could have contact information for her, in case I needed to follow up later. She told me that she was not allowed to provide any contact information.I have had bad experiences with customer service before, but this is the worst. Is it really possible that Vrbo call center operators have no way to contact their managers, and no way to contact the case report department? And no way to establish any timeline whatsoever for case resolution?Luckily, after weeks of calling and emailing, I was finally able to get in touch with my host, who issued the refund, thankfully. If she had not done this, I have zero confidence that vrbo would have resolved the situation for me. And I see more evidence for this prediction when I look at other reviews of vrbo on Trustpilot. This would be a great place for scammers, since vrbo does not seem to hold hosts or guests accountable. They "file cases," and refuse to follow up with you or give you a way to follow up on or track your "case."

name: Ray Brown
title: Nice house (duplex) clean
text: Nice house (duplex) clean, nice neighborhoodThis will be somewhat of a different review.  Overall the house (duplex) is very clean and nicely decorated.  Close to downtown and great restaurants.  The outdoor area is very nice. Screened pool with hot tub and outdoor shower.  Also a nice dining area on the patio.  Owner Roy was very responsive during our stay.  Any questions were answered promptly.  During our stay a cold front moved through the area making swimming in the pool only for the very hardy.  We spent almost all of our time in the hot tub.  The outdoor lights are really cool and it was very relaxing.The problem?  On the last day of our stay I woke up feeling horrible.  Thought I might have caught the flu.  Fortunately the airport is only 10 minutes away.  Flew home and my symptoms were getting worse by the hour.  Tried for the next week to loose the flu bug to no avail.  Ended up in the emergency room and after a battery of test admitted to intensive care.  I was diagnosed with Legionnaire’s Disease.  Had a very severe case of pneumonia.  Spent 6days in hospital, 4 in intensive care.  Doctors kept asking where we were and what we did.  Turns out the Legionella bacteria loves hot tubs and will thrive if not properly drained and cleaned.  My hospital bill was $36,000.  My out of pocket is $6000.After diagnosis, I immediately let the owner know so steps could be taken to insure others safety.  Never heard a word back.  Contacted VRBO explained everything and was basically told thanks for letting us know.We will not be using VRBO again and I have contacted an attorney who specializes in this type of litigation.  Sad it’s come to this.

name: april hubal
title: If you are considering listing your…
text: If you are considering listing your property on VRBO, you may want to explore Airbnb and other similar sites instead of VRBO. For the most part, it appears that VRBO implements many of Airbnb's best practices. Airbnb strives to expand its business and does so to be fair not only to guests but also to hosts. I recently encountered a situation where a guest never mentioned any problems whatsoever; we exchanged texts at least 10 times a day. I even attempted to assist her in bringing a dog back from the islands. However, she later left me a scathing review because my neighbor's unit flooded. As a precaution, I asked her if my property manager could check on the home. She was friendly and more than willing. Then, two months later, just before Christmas, she gave me a horrific review and demanded a complete refund of $3,000 USD. Hmm, that seems odd. Instead of seeing through this situation, VRBO would rather see my small business ruined. Similar incidents have occurred on Airbnb, and Airbnb was more than gracious in removing the retaliatory review. I just hope VRBO can follow suit one day. Until then, I recommend going with Airbnb; they are much better at finding easy solutions.

name: Kirk P. Mansfield
title: PLEASE BE AWARE OF VRBO
text: PLEASE BE AWARE OF VRBO! Traditionally, I would not post something like this, but I think it's important for everyone to be aware of the policies of VRBO. I have used their services for many, many years with great success. Recently, I was scammed with a rental (the house was misrepresented, contained mold, and was being foreclosed on). We contacted VBRO immediately and requested to be moved, but they blew us off. We didn't have anywhere else to go because the island was booked up. After the fact, we dealt with VRBO's legal department, demanding a refund and the removal of the rental from their site so that others do not experience what we went through. They REFUSED, claiming "there isn't anything we can do." We involved a building inspector, a health inspector, the police, and took the homeowner to court. (The homeowner didn't show up to court because she's a professional scam artist and there is very little we can do.) When I went to write a review on the VRBO website, I was shocked to learn there are thousands and thousands of others who have been scammed and VRBO does NOT take any accountability.PLEASE BE AWARE BEFORE YOU USE THAT SITE!!

name: Jas sum Jas
title: The Dark Side of Customer Service in…
text: The Dark Side of Customer Service in Travel Booking Platforms Expedia Group VRBO HomeAwayIn a time where customer experience should reign supreme, my recent encounter with Expedia and VRBO showcased a concerning reality in the travel industry.I used Expedia Group's platform for a booking, only to discover that it was routed through VRBO HomeAway, a platform I hadn't encountered before. Cue the chaos:🔍 Attempting to contact the property for a simple query on parking became a wild goose chase as Expedia Group redirected me to VRBO HomeAway, which offered solely a U.S. contact number.📞 Upon reaching out to the property through VRBO HomeAway's provided number, I was met with a shocking revelation – the property didn't exist, nor had it ever existed. Cue my disbelief and frustration.📵 Despite over 37 attempts to contact VRBO HomeAway, reporting the non-existent property, and even using industry terms to convey the severity of the situation, my concerns fell on deaf ears.💸 This ordeal cost me over 200 euros in phone bills and two full days of persistent efforts, culminating in an alternate accommodation 60 km away from my intended destination, well past the check-in time.The lack of accountability, empathy, and professionalism during this entire ordeal left me baffled. Is this the new standard in customer service? Agents seemingly aware of the issue but unwilling to rectify it, or a breakdown in training and protocols?This experience raises concerns about the way customers are treated and the efficacy of communication channels within these platforms. We deserve better. It's crucial for companies to prioritize customer service and accountability, ensuring seamless experiences rather than distressing debacles.

name: Sandy Segal
title: Vrbo and Expedia properties for rent
text: This property was listed by Vrbo, and by Vrbo’s owner, Expedia, as a luxury studio just off Exmouth Market (London) with onsite parking.There was no onsite parking.  There was only parking in the street, for an extra charge.The property can in no way be classed as luxury.  The toilet opened directly on to the kitchen, and the door did not close fully.  There was no washbasin in the toilet, and the taps in the kitchen did not work.  We were expected to wash our hands with bottled water.The heating stopped working, the kettle, rain shower, TV and various other appliances didn’t work.  The induction hobs had to be unlocked by the owner.  The bed and sofa could not be used at the same time, and the only seating consisted of uncomfortable garden chairs.  The general finish was cheap.  There were holes in the walls, peeling paint, and the shower smelled of drains.  It looked like a storeroom that had been converted (badly) into a flat.It was a hardship staying here, and we left and found a hotel.  The owner has refunded most, but not all, of the fee, but Vrbo and Expedia have done nothing to refund their fees, despite our complaints.  In fact, apart from requesting photos, we have not heard from them.We would not recommend these companies.  They are not even worth one star, but there is no facility to give them no stars.  We have been unable to write a review on the Vrbo site for this property, which only had 5 and 4 star reviews. We now wonder if they are genuine.UPDATEVrbo got in touch after the response below and said that they were refunding their fee.  But nothing has been received and they don’t answer emails.  They only did anything because of the bad review on Trustpilot, and they still have the property listed, even though it does not comply with health regulations.  An environmental health officer is trying to inspect.  I will not change my review.

name: James McDonald
title: Expedia's Vrbo slips up on Tenerife staycation banana skin
text: If you have ever felt a sense of foreboding about things that could go horribly wrong on your planned and paid holiday, then we are in good company. Suffering from SAD and wanting to get some winter sun with quietude  on a budget, away from the tourist masses,  I made a hard and  potentially remorseful decision to swop my lifetime of loyalty to airbnb  and  grab a week of hot  winter sun in the south of Tenerife, using Expedia's Vrbo. This was my first time booking with Expedia and with Vrbo. My decision to use Vrbo was budgetary and quietude.it's hard to know how to rate my recent experience after booking and paying with Vrbo for the  low cost studio apartment in South Tenerife. I have given a one star, but here's my conundrum, Vrbo caused me the most massive personal stress and totally screwed up my holiday simply because someone did not do their  due diligence when choosing to partner with the  host / owner of the property. But then almost  redeemed themselves by refunding me fairly, and by having an excellent customer service team to try and clean up the mess.I just want to say that I first noticed  the studio on the Trip Adviser website, and it looked ideal for me but was above my budget, so I went online with Vrbo to book the same studio apartment. It was unusual to find there were no images of the interior or of the exterior of the property, Vrbo had in fact put on their site  three photos,  of which two photo were of random pine trees and another of a seascape. The lure for me to book with Vrbo was purely the cost. Should this have been a red flag?  YesAnyway, here's my experience, I leave you to judge how many stars I should rate Expedia, but before I do here are some points to bear in mind. I am of pensionable age and my reason to go to South Tenerife  was simple, get warm sunshine and quietude. I was holidaying on my own and I have never visited Tenerife before.After a long and very crowded 'sardine in a tin' flight experience with British  Airway from Gatwick  who by the way took my money for a exit row ( £35 ) but actually had none available for any of the sixpassengers who had all booked and paid. We were confused and a bit peed off. Exit seats, where werre they? but hey that's a story for another day.I arrived in Tenerife around 6 pm, by the time I had cleared immigration and picked up my hired car from Sixth    ( please don't tell me they are owned by Expedia) because they were super efficient with great customer service. It was dark by the time I set off for my studio apartment near Adeje, about 4 kilometes from the sea, up the steep mountainside.Driving in the dark, on the 'other'  side of the road, I was hungry, stressed and tired after travelling 15 hours,  all I wanted was to get a shower, some food and hit the sack.When I arrived outside the street where the apartment was located,  it was 8.30 pm, pitch dark and there was no one around,  to meet and greet. So I called the host on my cell phone. He answered speaking broken English. He said to me, quote, 'what are you doing outside the house', please go away ' !! He said to me that he had to call Expedia and told me to stay on the cell phone. I waited for 25 minutes but he never returned.So, now what?  here I  was in my car, abandoned. So I called an  Expedia customer service number and got a bloke working in the Carribean. He was was very helpful and after another hour on the cell phone he  found me a room in budget apart-hotel in  Playa des Americas - my worse nightmare - to stay one night. Expedia said that once they talked to host, I could return to my studio apartment. But here's the problem, .The rest of the holiday was not much of a a holiday. I never did get to stay in my  studio flat in the hills, I never did get quietude, or a chance to cook for myself ( with my allergies ). But what I did get was hot sun, and 5 days complementary room most of the time in a huge, busy family hotel with hundreds of kids jumping around having fun. Oh, and Vrbo refunded the cost of my original booking in full.Expedia get  stars for their invaluable  customer service agents, they refunded my money and gave me complementary rooms that in realty  were not very suitable for me for 5 nights, ( no cooking facilities, very noisy ) but they could not get any stars for the stress and anxiety I endured of a holiday that was not a holiday. How could Expedia / Vrbo  allow such a cock up and get my booking so wrong?  who does the due diligence and who is accountable?  I suggest that customers avoid paying for 	Property ID11308647 on the expedia website in Los Menores , Adeje.Now, about that exit seat I paid for on British Airways that did not exist.

title: Vrbo is your way to problems
text: Want to have peace of mind? Never book your vacations with VRBO.This review is not even about the QUALITY of the Service by Vrbo- which is awful- but about the KIND of Service provided . Unlike other companies like Airbnb or Hotels,com or Booking.com or Agoda , VRBO does not assume any task related to the booking :It is the property owner that will charge your Credit Card -increasing the chances of problems-and if you have to cancel your reservation you go  straight into a nightmare : Unlike with other companies that you can cancel online on their website in seconds  with just 2 clicks , with Vrbo you have to personally contact the owner of the rental unit or leave a message to the owner that you want to cancel. If the owner acknowledge receiving the message or if not If you are lucky and you can personally contact the owner and if he or she will answer to your request then you will be waiting for days to see your cancellation on the Vrbo website . What it takes seconds with other companies it takes days and stress with VRBO  What I find on the verge of dishonesty is that Vrbo does not even inform you before you book a property about  the kind of service they will provide or better to say the kind of service that they WILL NOT PROVIDE

name: Al
title: Terrible customer service
text: I received an email suggesting a security concern on a booking I made. Naturally this made me very worried so I contacted the host and received no reply so I contacted customer service via the live chat facility. How rude and unhelpful they were. Seemed to have no concern for my predicament at all, were extremely slow in replying, very rude/curt replies and didn’t really answer my question. Terrible experience I would not like to repeat!

name: Lone Le Vay
title: Website issues
text: I am trying to search for properties on the website but it only seems to let me select a single night. I tried slecting the start date and the calender closes instantly with an end date the next day. When I select the end date it selects that date as a start date and the following day as end date. I tried holding shift key but that doesn't work either.

name: Sue
title: Last minute cancellation by host and no refund
text: We had a confirmed reservation from VRBO starting Dec 30.  One hour before arrival the host told us that there was a glitch in the VRBO site and that he never confirmed the reservation. We paid almost $2000. We have made over 29 phone calls and written over 30 emails. When we do get a response it is that they are “escalating the situation to get a resolution” and then we never hear from them again. It is now three weeks later and we are still waiting on our refund.  VRBO is not trust worthy or reliable.  Customer service is not helpful.

name: kesoras
title: Two of my listings are restricted for…
text: Two of my listings are restricted for the past month and nobody could tell me why. I was trying for a month by calling and chatting with the live agents, but uppon accessing my account they could not find anything wrong so they "escalated" my case to the proper department. Those exact words I might have heard them more than 20 times from different agents who in the end had most of them had nor the knowledge, nor the mood to help (with a couple of exceptions). After a about 20 days and around 15 calls and chat attempts, I started asking for a supervisor or someone that could tell me what was wrong and how I could fix it. Every time I had to wait more that 40 minutes on hold. The first time the told me that someone would call me back in an hour and we would be able to fix the problem as he was from the correct department. Of course nobody called. I called them back and after a few tries I managed to speak with a supervisor called Alysia ( I am not really sure if that was the case) who reassured we would have at least an answer to my problem in a day as she personally escalated my case to the correct department, and she would follow with a phone call to inform me. Of course nothing again. From then on, again the same script started that my case was escalated, but no supervisor was ever available to speak to me.The problem still continues and I am still waiting for a call back.Keep in mind I have ben with Vrbo sine it was Homeaway in 2004

name: Lisa Holley
title: No refund after taking my money even though the requested date wasn't available.
text: I attempted to book a residence with hosts Brendan and Tara Hawkins in Las Vegas for the Super Bowl. I was very specific on TWO separate emails requesting dates Feb. 8-12, 2024.  After taking my $1600.00 deposit, they changed the dates to the following weekend. I don't need to be there on any other dates and they're (the hosts) refusing to refund my money.Per VRBO:"To summarize, I have been able to provide you details about your reservation. In this case the host informed they didn't have available the dates originally requested, and they sent you a pre-approval offering different dates. At this moment the refunds must be discuss directly with your host." Not only have I lost money; it's too late for me to make other accommodations for this once in a life time experience!***Don't trust Brendan and Tara Hawkins (Las Vegas) or VRBO to honor any contract! Who randomly changes dates and expects their client to succumb to their supply and demand needs.

name: Gerry Mossink
title: Don't use Vrbo if you like secure bookings
text: I booked a holiday in nerja Spain, paid the 2 bed apartment paid and got insurance and received booking confirmation. The place was available and all was good. I then booked our flight and rented a car for our 10day stay.  However the next day , the owner decided that he wanted to use the place during the time I booked and cancelled my booking.  My wife and I are not the youngest anymore and this created an enormous amount of stress and hassle.  Having to cancel booking , cancel insurance, hoping I get money back.  Its only that the property management were attentive and found me another place to stay.  This was my first attempt on vrbo and I would not recommend it for older or elderly people who like secure bookings.

name: Anthony Rose
title: Left us with nowhere to stay
text: Left us with nowhere to stay. Host was unresponsive and Vrbo was worse. Everytime we called put us on hold then hung up. No replies to emails. Customer service people have no authority to solve issues. 3 days later still no resolution or refund. Awful experience.

name: Jackie Jones
title: !!!DON'T USE VRBO!!
text: !!!DON'T USE VRBO!!! We booked a Villa for 12 x members of family and paid the deposit last year. Following us finding a negative review for a double booking on a villa, we then discovered our Villa had a duplicate advert (different host), all the pictures were the same but in different order and the 2nd advert had a Villa name with availability (original advert showed it was booked by us).  We tried to tell our host (Novotel) by the VRBO message on the VRBO app, and contacted VRBO direct this year (2024).  We still have had no response from either, so had to cancel and lose out deposit.  They're shocking. I wouldn't risk turning up to your holiday home to find it already occupied - please read previous reviews.   I will be reporting this to

name: Ade
title: Ignore complaint emails
text: Rented a property in France at the beginning of December. The property had no hot water. Rang for advice, told we couldn't move as no properties available, yet the site showed loads.Raised an official complaint but they have failed to respond to emails.Seems they just want to take your money.Will never use again.

name: Peter
title: Avoid booking via VRBO
text: Avoid booking via VRBO.  I have tried to book a holiday home in France over 10 days and with 3 different payment cards.  Their payment system is faulty for some reason and the poor customer agents that you eventually get to speak to (I have spoken to three different) are unable to explain or resolve.  I have just finally managed to pay over the phone with the third customer agent - only to then find out that I was charged in US dollars and not £ Pounds.  Now requested a refund and had to rebook in the right currency (at my cost!).  Only then to find out that I cannot rebook because now the dates are not available!  If I was a home owner, I would certainly never advertise my holiday home via VRBO.

name: Joseph Coker
title: Great place for scammer guests terrible for earnest hosts
text: 9 years experience hosting short term rentals, very familiar with the good and bad of it.  VRBO sucks.  Their website is from the 90's, their support is EXTREMELY tedious to engage with, and their gotchas are peppered throughout in ways that make them untrustworthy.  Example, to communicate with support chat, you need your email, your name, your number, the unique listing number that they generate for you, the unique guest reservation code that they generate for you, a code that they send to text that you have to read back, security is all well and good but this is a 5 minute process, and all this must be entered if you get transferred too.  Btw, if you steer away from the chat window for 5 minutes, it will auto close, even if the reason you haven't responded to them is because you are waiting on them to respond to a question.  their support team is VERY poorly trained, and quite often just looking up answers on their own and clearly do not have any recall of policy themselves.  Worst of all, we had a guest smoke out our entire house.  We sent a request for a smoking fee, the guest now has the option to pay it.  Ask yourself, is the kind of guest that smokes in others homes going to pay it. When i asked vrbo what would happen if they didn't pay it LITERALLY NO ONE KNEW THE ANSWER.  I had to bully my way to speaking to a manager.  I later discovered that you have to enable a type of insurance on the platform, it doesn't come standard, and it doesn't alert you if you don't.  This is incredibly irresponsible on their part.  Btw, this insurance, which the guest must pay starts at $59 a booking and only covers $1500 in damage.  This is the worst of both worlds.  The insurance coverage cost adds to the already industry highest fees that consumers pay, the amount of damage it covers is paltry compared to other platforms, and the whole experienced has left me with zero respect for their entire business.  Going to work harder starting my own booking platform because they do not deserve my business.

name: Steven HabHankin
title: OWNERS AVOID
text: As an owner I would advise any potential owners that would like to rent their vacation rental to stay well clear from VRBO. Customer service is shocking. Been waiting for over a month to get my property back online due to no fault of my own. Constantly getting fobbed off each time I make contact. There are far superior Holiday Rental Portals out there. AVOID VRBO AT ALL COSTS.  Completely useless.

name: KY in NE
title: Good but No Receipt for Expense Report
text: In general, my experiences have been positive. My only complaint is that it's not easy to get a receipt if you need to expense it for work. In my opinion, you should be able to download a .pdf similar to the one you can get for the service fee. Instead, VRBO makes you contact the host for a receipt (or they will make contact on your behalf). After spending way too much time trying to find a receipt and contacting customer service to learn there isn't one, I ended up taking a screen shot.

name: Morten
title: Very bad service.
text: Really no service from this cartoon called Vrbo.No e-mail to write to.Try the auto phone joke.Then call the "24/7" service phone, where they dont really want to help you.I have been on winter holiday and prepaid 200Euro for cleaning and on the way home we are charged 100Euro more for cleaning by the idiot Sarah Kuhn  from Markeryd who streals my money.Case nr 122683382.I tried to contact Sarah and Vrbo but they dont give a damn.They stole my money!!!Never use Vrbo they are criminals.

name: Catherine Lewis
title: No to Vrbo!
text: There are other rental companies available now -- not just Vrbo and Homeaway - so use them instead!!! I asked to please postpone (not cancel) our stay due to my needing a back injection. Homeaway/Cocoonr/Vrbo told me I had to cancel. It was 5 days before our trip. Plenty of time. I emailed a copy of my doctor's note and medical forms from the hospital. They still refused to refund my money. See below for other options!  Look at CnTraveller and internationalrentalnews

name: Michelle
title: Vrbo does not disclose there fees to…
text: Vrbo does not disclose there fees to the consumer before you book a rental.I cancelled my booking for a rental within 24 hours of booking.Not only did they not refund my full amount they kept 100 of it as an account fee they claim a full refund will be return given the cancellation timelines. Also they charge you a service fee at a percentage of what the total rental will be.They do not disclose this information, they are deceitful in not telling the consumer this up front.I will never you this rental site again and I have communicated and shared this information on all social media platform.

name: Jens Hartmann
title: It is not possible to change or cancel af bookin
text: It is not possible to change or cancel a booking online, as they otherwise promise you can. The link to be clicked is not active. In two cases, I have experienced that it is only through the lessor of the accommodation that it has been possible to cancel or change a booking.I have also tried to chat and call but can't get in touch with anyone. Therefore, do not use VRBO

name: Epifania
title: They don’t post a true negative review
text: They don’t post a true negative review. They made me write the review twice I eliminated the info they requested but they didn’t post it. It was  On 7/2023 recently 01/2024 i received another email requesting to write the review again. The property I rented was posted with parking for 1 car when I got there no parking and the property was not clean these 2 things were the ones I expressed but they didn’t like. It is not fair they did post the owner one who rated me 4/5 stars because I complained about parking. Don’t we have rights at Vrbo?

name: Hawaii Travellers
title: Sewage overflow, no plumbing
text: Cannot flush the toilet because it causes the sewage to back up into the shower. Have to use the showers and bathrooms at the pool because the plumbing is all backed up in the unit. This is disgusting and we've been dealing with it a few days now. Finally got a plumber in today, but it's still not fixed. Best case the plumber can come back tomorrow, worst case the plumber will take 5 days to return. VRBO and owner are being very slow to respond and uncooperative. We are having to spend so much time on our vacation trying to contact people and get help to deal with this awful issue, when we should be here to relax. This is a nightmare.

name: Olga
title: Stay away
text: This was my first and the last time using Vrbo.I booked an apartment for Christmas in Sal, Cape Verde and received a confirmation.But when I turned up at the property was told there is no reservation under my name and host didn’t receive money either.Spent 15min on the phone to Vrbo after which got an email from them that the property will refund me.One month later still nothing.On top of inconvenience caused I have to chase my own money.

name: MRS MICHELLE LEVITT
title: Website is rubbish and owners often do not update or respond to requests to book
text: I have been using Vrbo for years but it has gone seriously downhill since Covid. Owners don’t bother replying to requests to book, the site keeps crashing. I even had a property cancel on me less than 2 weeks before departure. Admittedly, I have had some lovely holidays in the past but the booking process has become a nightmare I dread every year. The advertised prices suddenly get increased when the owners know you are interested and none of them seem to keep their calendars updated. I can contact dozens of properties before I get just one positive response. Frustrating. They used to be so much better. Time I moved on

name: Pete Wulf
title: As an owner, Vrbo is hopeless, useless assistance
text: I listed my property on Stayz, what a disaster, they copied it from Airbnb, they have nothing like the service of Airbnb, you cannot automatically block out days for cleaning etc like Airbnb, their chat team are absolutely useless, their app doesn't even allow for my to list my phone number, says it is not valid, their agents during chats expect you to call the USA, they uplisted my property on Expedia with all incorrect information, told them false advertising, they didn't care, when I asked for a local number, they continue to give me Vrbo's number and they cannot help with Expedia or they give me a USA number that I have to callThe reservation process is useless, they cancelled bookings without consulting me, so I feel for travellers,They don't provide any protection unless you include this in the original booking, and if you do, then the guest has to fork out $1000s as part of their depositI have one booking and as soon as that is done, cancelling subscription, you spend far too much time wasted with their chat team for a booking

name: Amy lennard gmelin
title: Had 3 out of 4 VRBO bookings cancelled—…
text: Had 3 out of 4 VRBO bookings cancelled— one on the same day as the reservation and the other 2 within one week of the reservation. Know in advance that just because VRBO confirms the booking after you pay does not mean that it cannot be canceled at any time.

name: Ron and Kim Schindler
title: Do not advertise your vacation rental…
text: Do not advertise your vacation rental through VRBO. They were once a good company but since Expedia Group purchased them the customer service is horrible. They allow guests to post reviews complaining about expectations for hot tubs, shampoos not supplied, and coffee not supplied when none of those items are listed as included in the rental. VRBO allows guests to coerce owners by threatening bad reviews unless money is returned. Guests are allowed to sneak extra guests into the unit, and then when there are not enough beds, complain in the review.  Customer service reps hang up and disconnect chat sessions.  You are better off advertising your rental on your own.

name: Gigi
title: Texas to Philly DISASTER!!!!!
text: After traveling from Texas to Philadelphia, on the day of reservation, I called the contact number listed at the time allowed to check-in (4 pm), the contact person/owner said that they had rented it to someone else.  I had already been on VRBO website and texted the contact person plenty of time before arrival with no response but I assumed that things would be ok because VRBO should be a respectable company to fulfill my reservation.  Alas, this did not happen.  I called VRBO that moment and spoke to a nice guy who I literally could not understand because of his super low voice (clearly not someone who should be manning the phones) and he said that they would reimburse me the money I paid for the rental or they could try to get me to a different place.  I paid for a location in downtown Philadelphia!  Luckily there were no significant events happening and my wife was able to rent us a hotel with not even close to the charm of the place that we were supposed to get!  How could a company of this reputation allow something like this to happen!?!?  My opinion is that they care about the long term money that they can get from the owner of the property more than the people traveling.  If they cared about the traveler, then the owner should pay significant penalties to the person who made the reservation.  If a traveler cancels the day of reservation, they forfeit the whole amount usually!!!  Well, I should be awarded the whole amount of the reservation because they canceled not even beforehand!!!

name: KmanWoo
title: VRBO IS A SCAM
text: This is a scam company. They do not honor their Book with Confidence Guarantee. I rented an apartment for three months in Vero Beach Florida. $11,000 for 90 days..Filthy apartment, open food, milk, numerous 3/4 empty condiments in the refrigerator. Used personal bathroom items in the bathroom drawers and medicine cabinet. Disgusting, layer of sticky filth on the handrails to upstairs. No space for my clothes, closets and dressers full of owners clothes. I’m here for three months, am I supposed to live out of my suitcase? I cleaned everything, moved clothes, cleaned bathrooms. VRBO charges me $983 (part of the $11,000..) They won’t refund me anything. I call to file a complaint, I get a different person everytime who ends the conversation with “I’ll turn this over to our team and get back to you” No one gets back to you. Call again, get someone different, explain everything again. Right now, VRBO was supposed to contact me yesterday regarding my request for some type of refund or reimbursement.. no contact from them. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.Response is irrelevant.. it’s a link to a homepage that doesn’t solve anything.. Further proof from VRBO they lie right to your face.DON’t Use VRBO…

name: Isabelle P
title: SCAM website - do not book your holiday on here.
text: SCAM website. During the booking process it didn't indicate at any stage that I was being charged in USD!I reside in Australia, was booking an Australian property, with Australian contact details and at no point anywhere on their homepage or in a pop-up did it ask me to confirm my region/currency. It didn't show the currency before the dollar sign on the website or in my booking confirmation email. Completely misleading! Avoid this website!!I have raised this issue with Vrbo who say that their currency defaults to USD as their head office resides in the United States, however this does not matter! They need to be transparent with customers on the currency being charged.I have raised with the ACCC and continue to dispute the situation with Vrbo.Vrbo caused me a lot of stress while pregnant on a holiday over Christmas and NYE, which was meant to be relaxing. I have never had an experience like this with any other booking platform so will never book on Vrbo again.

name: Rebekah Low
title: Vrbo makes booking without your permission
text: First time signing up for Vrbo and I asked a host a question about their property. I was simply enquiring and was not in a position to be confirming a booking. 1 minute later I received an email from Vrbo requesting payment for my 'booking'. Trying to connect with someone to sort the issue on live chat was exhausting, I was told there was nothing they could do if the host 'pre-approves' the booking. I am now left concerned I will have to pay for a property I was not in a position to book, and left wishing I never looked on Vrbo. I will definitely never be using this company again.

name: Guy Campanile
title: Do not use this company they will leave…
text: Do not use this company they will leave you stranded at the last minute with no accommodation. They took full payment for an apartment and then cancelled the booking on the day we arrived in Phuket leaving us out of pocket until they processed a refund and with nowhere to stay.We had to find a hotel on the busiest holiday period which was very difficult.their customer service is useless, slow and cumbersome. They  never called back to arrange alternate accommodation only replied through email. We then booked a second apartment/condo through another company E bookers only to find out later that they are the same company as Vrbo. They again took our money and agin cancelled the booking on the day of check in leaving us without a place to stay. I complained to customer service but they just passed it over to their rebooking department who only reply through email offering a refund.Do NOT use these companies they are unreliable!!!!I thank Vrbo for their response and acknowledge that I have now been refunded but they still did not address the issues that I raised.Their companies on each occasion left me to arrange accommodation by myself not appreciating the dilemma that left me with nowhere to stay at the last possible moment. They NEVER called back after promising to do so and only ever responded to email which is slow and cumbersome.They have completely spoiled our vacation and caused undue stress to myself and my wife.

name: Etoyi George
title: VRBO horrible experience with this…
text: VRBO horrible experience with this company and they will not refund our money after they sent us a email saying they would. Long story short the home owner cancelled our reservation the day we should have been staying. VRBO told us to book another home approx the same amount. We did that now they will not refund our money from the first reservation we booked.

name: David Rogers
title: Disgrace!
text: I've waited until now to give Vrbo and the owner of our rented property to do the right and honest thing in response to our complaints.Neither Vrbo nor the owner of the house we rented over Christmas have any intention of Doing The Right Thing.This was a very special time for the family as one of the family has a terminal illness.  We were looking forward to a Special and Inviting venue for the 23-27th Dec. to be with the close family of 15 people.The price of the rental was eye watering !Instead of Special and Inviting it was frankly an unkempt, dirty, uncomfortable and poorly equipped house. A disgrace! My wife who had arranged the event was in tears within minutes of entering the property. Previous posts on Trustpilot have stated the state of the place and lack of furniture, cutlery, plates, lightbulbs, broken and inadequate door furniture and denial of use of outbuildings.  The place had a feeling of it being purposely rundown in preparation for selling on to a developer - I could be wrong, but that was my clear impression.To add insult to injury, my wife who has put a negative review on Vrbo , had this removed. Whereas, the owners negative reviews of us as guests was inaccurate and insulting.Where are Vrbo in all this? Worse than Absent without Leave. Full of ridiculous regulations, made up on the hoof. Impossible to deal with or get any sense out of.The same goes for the so called host.They don't give a .....This is a serious situation in which Vrbo and hostare close to  a claim of misrepresentation of a product.Overcharging for an inadequate and unsafe property.An ignorance of good practice and terrible customer care.As Vrbo or the 'host' has not satisfied us in response to our genuine complaints we are now considering legal and media avenues.Vrbo are a disgrace. DO NOT BOOK WITH THEM.

name: Martine
title: Poor support for hosts
text: Not very easy and clear to find the online help in the site.I m a host and currently travelling with very limited wifi accessI ve missed out on booking requests because VRBO doesn t send hosts an email warning them to check, you have to specifically look in your VRBO app. Would be so much easier if everything went through emails (like Airbnb)I ll apparently also have a bad answering time rating because of this.When I finally got through a chat, explaining I don t have roaming or a SIM card for this country the agent told me to go and buy one to avoid problems.After talking to someone using hotel phone I received an email telling me I shouldkeep my listing hidden during times when I m  unable to manage bookings, avoiding new bookings during my travels. What a terrible idea! I ve had no problem responding to my Airbnb requests.They also told me I should check with my email provider(when they don’t send emails😞🤔)…really? I have checked my junk/spam etc… nothing thereWas also told the wifi may not have been good enough for me to receive their emails…had no problem receiving all my other emails, including Airbnb communicationNOT HAPPY

name: Gareth
title: Complete Scam - Stay safe and avoid
text: My wife booked an apartment for 3 adults in Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico for 7 nights (including New Years Eve). Things didn't go well. Before the check in date the host did not respond to our requests for the location of the apartment or any other messages despite us paying months ago.We arrived late at night in Tulum after an 11 hour flight and over a 2 hour drive to find the host had still not responded forcing us to drive around for hours looking for the accomodation - completely unsafe and immoral! VRBO did not help us at all in this matter and we were forced to pay for a hotel in the early hours of the morning. The next day we found the location of the apartment by ourselves (via a lot of internet searching). The people running the apartment complex had no knowledge of our host or booking forcing us to book new accomodation for the rest of the trip -  a tricky task as NYE was soon approaching. VRBO did not find us accomodation or assist in any positive manner.Please stay safe and avoid this company. We were forced to search the backroads of Tulum in the early hours of the morning searching for our apartment. To allow this to happen is dangerous, irresponsible and insulting to paying customers.My wife is still waiting for a refund.

name: Elaine Powell
title: A thilthy accomodation
text: On arrival we noticed some blinds and bathrooms area were not as clean as should be.. messaged owner who apologised .next morning had a good look at the property.cooker kitchen utensils were thilthy.there was no way we would cook our Christmas dinner in that kitchen.fire extinguisher was rusty and no indication of annual checks. Other areas dirty. Rusty radiator.no hot water for bath  or washing up. No information pack. Messaged owner again that morning.christmas eve.she could do nothing as lives out of UK . No one local to address issues.told her leaving that day .and expected full refund of fees .also email VRBO some exchange emails but now closed the exchange.to date. Two weeks later.stil only part refund no offer of compensation for our experience.in such poor accommodation.never again use VRBO .property called Bloomfield in Trevone Cornwall

name: Mrs P
title: Awful treatment by this company
text: Awful treatment by this company. The property host denied having any business with Vrbo. Vrbo took full payment for the property months ago and trying to get answers and a refund from them is impossible. They’ve been reviewing my case for over 5 days. I need to desperately sort out alternative accommodation and visas. DO NOT USE VRBO

name: Margaret McCrea
title: Provided with the wrong address for our… and unhelpful host
text: Provided with the wrong address for our accommodation. Had to stay in a hotel for the night which we will probably have to pay for on top of the payment for our apartment which has been prepaid.. The apartment is Le Giroll in La Clusaz. Then we have been expected to pay for bed linen and towels which are not in the apartment. The host is very unhelpful. We cannot be expected to pay for bed linen and towels.

name: Howard
title: VRBO Customer Care example from owner
text: I'm a small, one-unit short-term rental owner.I have had a listing on VRBO for 7 years. Recently, there was a disaster near the location of our listing, but it did not impact our listing. However, VRBO chose to incorrectly display that our listing was potentially impacted when it wasn't at all.Worse, as people cancelled bookings, VRBO offered no help to defend our refund policy.Worse, when local government asked us to briefly pause new bookings, and the pause function at the VRBO website didn't work (error), we had to reject bookings.Rejecting bookings is bad in the VRBO algorithm and they can curate this for exceptional circumstances, but VRBO chose to ignore these circumstances and allow their algorithm to punish our decision to follow the government request.Consequently, VRBO quickly went from winning 90% of our business to 30% and still falling.

name: Emma
title: Scam listing - refused refund
text: I booked an apartment and messaged host for check in info and didn’t get a response. Used the phone number provided and got though to someone who had never heard of Vbro and wasn’t the host. Was left with no check in / access info. Informed them immediately and asked for a refund. Been fighting for DAYS getting nowhere, going round in circles and just being fobbed off. Had to dispute the payment with my bank to get the money back. I would NEVER use them again!

name: Rosie
title: I booked a house online through the…
text: I booked a house online through the vrbo website, 2 weeks later (2 days before arrival) I got a call from vrbo saying the property was no longer available but she would help me to find an alternative house to stay in. She then questioned me on my budget and plans profusely which left me feeling severely uncomfortable as well as being inconvenient as this was a work trip. However after promising to send over the information for alternative properties which she failed to do, so I had to make a follow up phone call asking for her to send this information over which she promised to do that same day but for some reason failed to ever send over.Very disappointed and ended up booking through another site with no problems.

name: Penelope Arber
title: A badly run company
text: Two from our family Christmas holiday have already given excellent and truthful accounts of our experience renting from Vrbo. We are a close, loving family and because of that we’re able to celebrate together. Nothing was going to get in the way of our time together especially as a greatly loved member of our family is terminally ill.As for the property it’s self my family members have gone into detail about the low standard of fixtures, fittings and general lack of care at the property. Was not worth the money paid. A shame as it has the potential to be beautiful if the owner cared at all!! The feedback my family member wrote was taken down, which is disgusting, the owner then wrote a pack of lies about my family member. So I wonder if Vrbo see the properties they advertise and meet with the owners to check if they want their name and property associated with their company? I am appalled and annoyed with Vrbo at their complete lack of care and consideration toward us as their customers. name: N Redpath
title: I will never use ASAP Tickets again
text: I've used ASAP Tickets for several years for my groups, and used to have fairly good experiences. Last year the airlines canceled a flight for 9 people and it took me many phone calls and emails over more than a month to get a solution from Customer Service. The airlines couldn't help me because ASAP "owns" the ticket until it's used (upon check-in or departure, when the airlines takes over). That's one problem. The other is that their Customer Service is the worst I've ever experienced in many years, both personally and running a business. I was never able to speak to a supervisor or manager. I've asked countless times by email and my request was just ignored. When I finally got someone on the phone, three different agents said there are no managers available to speak to by phone, nor can the CS agents ask for a manager's assistance.Now this year is much worse. I nearly went elsewhere, but was contacted by one of the sales agents who promised her honesty, reliability, and support throughout the process and our travel. She said she COULD contact her manager to intervene if necessary. I believed her, and could almost always understand her accent, so we started booking with her. I got my ticket first, and the other members of the group (10 at that time) would quickly book through this agent to ensure they got my exact itinerary (but could pay with their own credit card). Well, she wasn't available when she said she would be, and the passengers started panicking after a day and a half. So I called the main phone line and asked for another agent who could help. The one who answered promised all the same things - he said he would personally take excellent care of our group. I provided my tickets to use as a template, but he booked the wrong flight for 5 other people! The others in the group trusted him - and me - to book the correct tickets, but they were frazzled by the long online payment process and in their confusion all five of them accepted the online itinerary. ASAP is disavowing all responsibility, and I felt obligated to fix this for my friends, at a cost of $2680+, which I couldn't afford. To make matters even worse, instead of booking a new single flight for the one leg that was incorrect, the agent charged us a change fee AND the cost of another flight. If he had been helpful or competent, he would have suggested the $150 fix (per person) rather than $447 per person!Now I've found that there's a new wrinkle - we are double-booked, because this agent said to "just ignore" the incorrect leg of the round-trip ticket and use the new one-way ticket. I've only just learned that if the airlines sees that you have two flights, they will cancel BOTH and you'll be stranded.I haven't even brought up the fact that one woman was just diagnosed with cancer and she and her husband had to cancel. She also is battling the ticket cost for her insurance claim (which she shouldn't have to do at a time like this). The agent had promised that the ASAP travel protection was FREE as part of a promotion, so she should accept their protection to get a better ticket price. But when she needed to get an invoice from ASAP for her claim, ASAP deducted the price of the insurance, and claims that her ticket cost much less than she actually paid. So she is screwed.When repeatedly contacting CS with an issue, they claim to investigate, then come back with a statement that when reviewing the phone conversation logs they found that the agent did nothing wrong. I have asked for an audio clip, but get no response. Today I've been on hold for more than an hour today, and my calls keep getting dropped.It appears that many agents at ASAP are not only incompetent, but also dishonest. It must be the pay structure. They probably get paid on commission and get extra when they "sell up" with travel protection products. , and I will never, ever, use ASAP Tickets again.Please reconsider before using ASAP, especially for expensive international flights.

title: BEWARE! DO NOT BOOK! Misleading Protection Plan, Unauthorized Charges, and Rude Staff
text: UPDATE: I’ve already emailed ASAPTickets with all the booking details. So if they reply here asking me to “contact them with my reference number,” it's just copy-paste PR — not real help. I’ve filed disputes with my credit card providers and complaints with consumer protection agencies.ASAPTickets misleads customers and then hides behind vague terms. I paid CAD $1,615.74 for their “Full Protection Plan”, which advertised “Change and Cancel for Any Reason” and “no agency fees.” That turned out to be false. I was later told I could only use one benefit, and was charged CAD $765 — far more than the CAD $240 I was quoted. I never authorized that charge, and my e-ticket wasn’t even sent until three days later.Their “Lowest Fare Guarantee” is also fake. I found cheaper fares with better baggage allowance, and they still refused to match. Their “family and children discounts”? Also never offered, even though I was clearly booking for kids.Customer service is the worst part. Placido was rude and dismissive. Apaar interrogated me and added to the stress instead of solving anything. I was bounced between 7 agents, all giving different answers, and none offering real help.Look carefully at their 5-star reviews. Most of them have no “Verified Reviewer” badge, and some even follow patterns that suggest they’re fake. Now check Yelp — their rating is awful, with more honest 1-star reviews and zero 5-star experiences. That should tell you everything you need to know.This company relies on pressure tactics, hidden terms, and inconsistent service. Don’t fall for the glossy ads and fake guarantees.

name: Kaliman
title: SubjectUrgent Travel Mishap and Concerns Regarding Agent Honesty
text: I am writing to share a concerning experience I had recently with ASAP Travel that has led me to question the reliability and honesty of some of your agents.My initial booking with Agent Stench was satisfactory. However, my subsequent attempt to book an urgent flight from the US to the Philippines due to a family emergency resulted in a deeply disappointing interaction with another agent, Hinso.When I explained the urgent nature of my travel (attending a funeral), Hinso immediately questioned my own search efforts and inquired about previous quotes. I informed him that I had found a price of $2900 for two people and was hoping ASAP Travel could offer something even more competitive, given the promotional emails I regularly receive.Instead of focusing on my needs, Hinso quickly stated he found a fare for "$2500+." When I expressed interest, nearly providing my credit card information, I clarified if this price was for two travelers. To my dismay, Hinso informed me that the quoted price was for a single, one-way ticket.When I pointed out that I had already found a round-trip fare for two at $3100 online, Hinso responded with disbelief, demanding, "I don't believe you. Send me the link so I can confirm it." I provided the link, and he was subsequently speechless.Based on this interaction and its outcome, I am left with serious concerns about the integrity of some ASAP Travel agents. While ASAP Travel may indeed offer potential savings, it appears that certain agents may prioritize maximizing their sales over genuinely assisting customers, even those in vulnerable situations. The attempt to quote a significantly inflated price for a one-way ticket, after I clearly stated my needs and existing quote, feels like a blatant attempt to take advantage of my urgent travel requirements.This experience has led me to believe that relying on ASAP Travel may ultimately lead to paying significantly more. As a result, I will no longer be using ASAP Travel for my future travel needs.

And trying to resolve anything with their customer service was a nightmare – evasive, unhelpful, and at times downright disrespectful.What’s even more disturbing is how many suspiciously positive reviews they have on Trustpilot. After what I went through, it’s hard to believe those are genuine.If I can stop even one person from making the mistake I made by booking with this company, I’ll feel like I’ve done my job. Save yourself the financial and emotional stress – book directly with the airline or a reputable travel agency instead.
