text: Upon check-in, only one room had been booked. After about an hour of going back-and-forth with the front desk, I paid for a second room for one night. Although it was all taken care of in the morning and great value confirmed that two room should have been booked it was a very stressful start to my vacation, which also happened to be my birthday

name: Richard Hutchison
title: The beauty of the cities we visited
text: The beauty of the cities we visited.  GVV chose beautiful hotels in each city. An added day in each city would have been great!

name: Tim J
title: Fabulous Trip
text: This was the first time we have ever done a trip or tour like this - through an agency with preplanned locations, hotels, and sites included - and it was incredible!  Everything was perfect…the amount of time spent at different locations, the beautiful hotels, and scenic tours were all great.  I can’t recommend this trip enough!  Thank you for an incredible vacation!

name: Mandi
title: Had a great experience
text: Had a great experience. All was taken care of and was a smooth process. The layout was great and we had a fantastic time in Ireland!

name: Anne Huddle
title: Suggestions for improvement
text: For a week long trip, we wish you'd started the tour in Rome instead of adding an extra flight to begin the week in Venice. It made the start of the trip really difficult and set a poor tone for only a week long trip. I would have rather had that extra travel time at the end for the journey home to better utilize our time for the week.Popapartment is a poor choice. The beds and pillows are the most uncomfortable that I have ever experienced, and I'm a backpacker that spends a lot of time sleeping on the ground. Breakfast wasn't included since it had a kitchen, but that style of accommodation doesn't make sense for a 2 night stay. The staff was nice, but getting there from the train station was really questionable safety-wise. Same issue in respect to the neighborhood for the Rome location - B&B Roma Tuscolana.I'd also wish we'd had control of the train timings. Instead of 10:30 AM trains, something ~12:00 would have made more sense. This would have allowed us to maximize the sightseeing in one location that morning before moving to the next. It would also allow our arrival time to fall in step with check in at the next location.

name: Jean Raison
title: Exactly What Tuscany Is
text: You hit it out of the park!  The Villa Casagrande Hotel and Spa was amazing. The history behind the villa was unbelievable. The pizza making class that was included was given by a wonderful woman named Julia. She alone was worth the trip. We made several personal size pizzas alone with focaccia, bruschetta and biscotti. We had so much fun. Spoiler alert, she also did our winery tour and tasting which was outstanding. Car rental was fast and easy. Location was perfect. The towns of Figline Valdarno was lovely.

name: William Hall Means
title: Great Value is a great value.
text: Quality air, hotel, and tours.  Everything promised was more than delivered at a great price. I've experienced two wonderful trips with Great Value and look forward to many more.

name: Jeliene
title: I'm pleasantly surprised
text: I wasn't sure how this would go since this is my first experience with great value vacations. I'm happy to say that it was great and I will definitely use them again. No issues with flights, accommodations, tour. It was an amazing trip to Iceland!

name: Cindy Bryant
title: Great Source for Travel...only wish…
text: Great Source for Travel...only wish they have given more time between flight connections. Will definitely use them again!

name: Leah Marie Boetger
title: Great value and easy to work with
text: Great value and easy to work with

name: Kay Nikookary
title: Good but annoying details - would book better myself
text: Easy to buy, not so convenient when you are there. Can't contact by phone, the itenieries are cut the trip short and they are NOT convenient or useful. Hotels well outside of city center requiring bus/train/taxi that adds to cost and takes time away from vacation and makes visiting inconvenient. My hotels were 30 min from city centers, so 1 hour back and forth, was not convenient to stop at hotel mid day or evening ro rest or change clothes for evening activities. And the hotels were 4 star but worn down and did not feel like 4 stars. MY train between countries was inconveniently booked- first was at 10am which meant I wake up early, pack and leave the city a whole day early. The second one was at 3pm, but on a Sunday when the entire city was closed and nothing was open, so I stayed in town, but other than restaurants, not much to do....just not thoughtful or expertise provided. My flight home was 7am, so one more day cut short, and again had to wake up at 4am to make an international flight at 7am and get to airport early....

name: RobertB
title: I land trip to view Nothern Lights
text: As indicated. Perhaps a few more hotel and travel options.

name: Susan Ballard
title: Great hotel location
text: The hotel was in a great location and staff were nice. There was lots of restaurants and activities easily accessible. Play airline was ok. I didn't like the fact you had to pay for bags, they didn't serve anything free, no free or ability to pay wifi and no tv for 6 hour flight. But the overall trip was amazing and was a great deal and happy we went.

name: Liz
title: Paris City Vacation
text: In March 2025, my husband and I went on the 6-night Paris City Vacation with upgrade option. Flight accommodations went smoothly. Hotel-Hilton Garden Inn Paris La Villette was further from major attractions than expected, but there was nearby access to the metro which made getting around the city quite easy. Wish there was more of an itinerary for this trip and/or more assistance with planning excursions since we had never been to Paris before. However, I suppose by selecting this option it was a blank slate to plan as we wished.  Overall, flight and hotel with breakfast accommodations were nice. By selecting the upgraded trip option we went on a Toot bus tour and went to a lovely wine and cheese tasting. In order to plan the rest of our excursions we utilized the Get Your Guide App. Would recommend planning trips through GVV. This was our second trip with GVV and we enjoyed our Paris adventure!

name: Jen Hutchinson
title: Amazing Vacation Experience
text: Everything was organized and well communicated making for a flawless and awesome trip!  Hotels were all very nice and everything was accurately described by Great Value Vacations.

name: PaulRyan
title: Great Vacay!
text: Awesome experience, the only issue was one of the transfers. We emailed them and they took action right away. Hotels had good locations too. Would highly recommend.

name: Ashley
title: Everything about our Ireland trip was flawless!
text: Everything about our trip was flawless! Easy to find reservations, check into hotels, pick up rental car. Only complaint is that some of the hotels were a bit farther out from the city than implied (Galway COUNTY vs. Galway CITY) but got to see beautiful parts of the countryside we probably wouldn't have otherwise!

name: Kelley Lillard Mitchell
title: A wonderful trip
text: A wonderful trip! Great Value  Vacations were spot on! We never had a glitch! We will definitely book with Great Value again!

name: Desilva
title: Great Value Vacations live upto its…
text: Great Value Vacations live upto its name!The hotel was good. The room was clean and the staff extremely helpful.The tours were great. They were well organized and coordinated.We had an incredible experience

name: Robert
title: Construction is going on next door to the Grandi hotel.
text: The Grandi hotel we stayed at had construction going on next door. And,it was on the very end of the hotel that we had our room. The noise woke us up every morning! The staff was very nice and helped us with our excursions. The tours we went on were very interesting.

name: D
title: The flights were great but we didn’t…
text: The flights were great but we didn’t like that they were changed to a different airport.  Orig Dulles changed to bwi.  Hotel was great and had free parking.  Breakfast in the morning and a laundry room that was free.

name: Rebecca Fradley Peterson
title: Castles were the favorite
text: We loved the castle hotels! Would love a more castle experience in all our hotel venues. Historical places make the stay much more of a cultural experience.

name: Diane M Paine
title: Hotel Fron Reception (young female
text: Hotel Fron Reception (young female, day shift with dark hair) was very unfriendly and unasistive.  Two gentleman on afternoon and evenings went above and beyond.Concerning - upon return from Northern Lights tour (1:30am) tour guide and bus driver dropped off tour participants at one bus stop for  Bus Stop 1,2,and 3 making them walk across lanes of traffic and not where they were picked up in the middle of the night.Tours were good, schedulers for your trips worked hard to find and meet our trip needs.I just referred your trip services to another traveler in the last 2 days.

name: Matthew Dale canoles
title: Ireland
text: Seamless travelEasy hotel check insRental car was greatAttractions didn’t disappoint

name: Marcia McChesney
title: I will not trust Great Value Vacations ever again.
text: The problem was with the hotel room in London.  It was called Zedwell Underground.  The room was uncomfortably small.  There was no where to open your suitcase to see your clothing except the bed. So then it had to be closed if you wanted to go to bed.  Or to even sit, since it was the only place to sit. The "double" bed was just a bit larger than a twin, and basically it was ON THE floor. No where to hang clothes, no lighting, no where to set a glass of water.  Impossible to get in and out of the bed in the middle of the night because it was AGAINST A WALL.  We spent 5 hours searching for another hotel.  And we paid for all of it with our own money.  When we went to tell the desk clerk we were sorry but we couldn't stay there, he was not at all surprised. YOUR name is on this trip, Great Value Vacations.  I will never trust you again.  Not such a great value.

name: D Lingard
title: Great Value Vacations to Ireland - 3rd Time
text: This was our 3rd package to Ireland through Great Value Vacations. It did not disappoint. Even as we had delay and cancellation issues with the airline carriers, GVV was right there to assist us.We will DEFINITELY use GVV for our future travels.

name: Mark
title: Porto and Lisbon
text: Porto and Lisbon!  But in our Porto hotel, HF Tuela Porto, my wife's Kindle was stolen, when we went down for breakfast.  We told the hotel and left our email, but never heard anything from them.  Use the safe!!!We thoroughly enjoyed Casa de Music Hotel in Lisbon.  Very funky.The one wish is that both hotels were closer to the cities center.

name: Scott Hughes
title: Exciting, three-country adventure
text: We enjoyed the experience of visiting 3 countries in 6 days. It was an exciting adventure.

name: Kenneth Leon Thompson
title: Not as advertised
text: First of all GVV sold a package using PLAY airlines.  This airline treated us so rudely (we are seniors) by denying our baggage saying we had to return to the PLAY ticket counter or book another flight.  We finally managed to shove everything in a duffle bag that could be manipulated into their bins for carry-on luggage.  On top of that they charged us $140 per bag.  When we got to Iceland the hotel was good but the promised trip to see the Northern LIghts kept getting cancelled.  We ultimately had to venture out on our own to see them.  I am not sure we will ever use GVV again.  They say they are not responsible for the way things go however they do sell the product and are therefore liable in my book.

name: Art C
title: Tuscany was amazing every day in every…
text: Tuscany was amazing every day in every direction. Rome not so good. Hotel was nice but we were in a very congested area. Bumper to bumper traffic. Literally. Could hardly go anywhere. We have been to Rome before and didn’t have this problem.

name: Pamela Dailey
title: Northern Lights, Iceland.
text: Travel on Play Air is truly basic, basic.  Not even water or coffee absent a fee.Hotel was right in the center of town which was clean, friendly and super convenient.We had a successful sighting of Northern Lights and got several beautiful photos.Iceland is an expensive Country to visit in comparison.   Cost are truly out of sight.

name: Danielle CHRISTINA Carone
title: The hotels were all great especially great and all of the people were very nice and accomodating.
text: The hotels were all great especially the River Lee in Cork, my favorite of them all. Loved the tour of the Ring of Kerry. The first day of train travel had a kink in it because you cannot get a ticket from a voucher on a Sunday or any holiday since the booth is closed.  Thank goodness they still let us on the train.  Taking the train was a little stressful the first day because we had never taken trains in Europe before, and it was hard maneuvering the luggage and trying to find seats that weren't already reserved so it was a little stressful. We tried to get there earlier the next time to try and get reserved seats however it still wasn't early enough.  Once we got used to the system, it was a little better.

name: Kevin O'Brien
title: Great customer service
text: This was our first guided tour through GVV, we had a great time. But I want to single out one thing. On our last full day we were headed for Avila when we heard that a flood emergency there meant that our plans for the last night would not work out. We contacted GVV, and within a few hours we had an alternate hotel worked out. I know GVV can't control the weather, but their customer service was A-1 on this occasion!

name: Susan F
title: Fantastic experience
text: What a fantastic experience! Our Portugal package included all transfers which reduced the stress of traveling. The hotels were centrally located making it so easy to walk to everywhere we wanted to go. Great hotels with great staff! This was my second packed with Great Value Vacations and I can't wait to book my next vacation with them.

name: Maureen
title: Thank you
text: Thank you! We had a wonderful time. Loved the London hotel location. The Paris location was not that great but could be worst I think. The time for flights and rail transfers were perfect but expect no downtime or long layovers. Bring snacks, won’t have time to eat between flights. Quick response from agent when needing help prior to trip.

name: Mark Sapp
title: Scotland 2025
text: We're repeat GVV world travelers; each new adventure they have arranged for us over the years has been top notch! The boutique hotels in both Edinburgh and Glasgow were delightful and were perfectly situated in city center locales within safe, convenient walking distance to many key sites and restaurants. The two full day tours with Rabbie's (with expert guides Kevin in Edinburgh & John in Glasgow) couldn't have been better; we not only visited all of the GVV-advertised locations, we learned more than a bit about Scotland's fascinating history (including numerous great 'Scottish back stories'). Thanks again GVV for yet another wonderful opportunity to make more new memories in faraway places!

name: Jessica D
title: Hotel was great and flights were nice
text: Hotel was great and flights were nice. But I'm still trying to reach someone about the northern lights tour. Weather did not cooperate with us, so the tour didn't happen. Hoping we can get a refund on it.

name: Yubiri Reina
title: We had an amazing time with this…
text: We had an amazing time with this package. The hotel very comfortable and very nice people too, the location is very convenient to go out to eat and they offer tours and options if you don’t have any reservations or plans. The country it is just incredible and beautiful,

Thanks for nothing. And as a former travel agent I know MANY travelers and I WILL tell them all to never work with your company!

name: MELANIE ABIGAIL WEXLER
title: Great trip
text: Great trip, tickets and accommodations were perfect. Was worried that the price was too good to be true, but it was a great experience all around. Loved Paris!

name: Daniel Durbin
title: This was a really good vacation
text: This was a really good vacation. Unfortunately, when we arrived at our first stay, we learned that our room at the 5-star resort had been flooded and we were then rebooked into a 4-star sister property in the same area. The sister property was really quite nice but somewhat less impressive than the original.Our second stay was at a different 5-star castle hotel/resort which was fabulous, certainly deserving of all 5 stars.We did experience an issue with the rental car which was included with the booking. The check engine light came on while driving on the 2nd day of our 8 day trip. The local auto service agency was unable to ID the problem, but the owners manual indicated that we could continue driving the car which we did without a problem. Also, the GPS which the rental car agency provided quit working during the trip so we had to turn on our US cell phones and pay $12/day in order to have navigation. The rental car company has promised a refund of the $104 upcharge for the GPS.Lastly, the baggage reclaim in Miami took over 1.5 hours. Other than a lost bag, the worst I have ever experienced. Someone with an air tag in their bag said that over an hour after landing their bag was still on the plane.Obviously, all of these issues are beyond GVV's control, so I will continue to use their platform as it provides good value for the money.All told, it was a good experience with a couple of hiccups.

name: Brad Higbee
title: Customer Service was not any help
text: Once we got to Ireland the trip was amazing. However, the flights getting there was a major pain. Because of the flight issues we lost a full day of this beautiful country. GVV would not give any assistance on changing flights or any compensation for the car rental or hotel that we lost that day. The excuse was that GVV had already paid for these things and they could not compensate any of these costs. Since flight were canceled the day of travel the travel insurance was not valid. We had to fix everything ourself. GVV has great destination ideas but they do not take care of their customers if airlines don’t hold up their end of the vacation itinerary. Ireland was amazing but GVV was not.

name: Maureen Ann Parker
title: Wasn’t until I paid that I was notified…
text: Wasn’t until I paid that I was notified of the airlines (Play) that I will never take again. Wasn’t aware breakfast wasn’t included until arrival at first hotel. Also had to pay to park at two hotels which wasn’t advertised. The location of the hotels, some you were not able to walk into town, some were long drives to get to (4 hours)Would prefer to have all information upfront before booking.Let me tell you, we had a great time and always make the best out of all situations and the price for the trip was unbeatable!

name: Mr Frederick Haas

name: Jared & Syawn Hopkins
title: We had an amazing vacation

name: Kelsey M-M
title: This was a phenomenal vacation to…
text: This was a phenomenal vacation to Scotland! A week was not enough, but definitely gives incentive to want to go back. The bed and breakfasts we got to choose were lovely. The people we encountered were friendly and accomdating.The only hiccup we had was the flight out there. We were given only a 55 minute layover in Munich to catch our next flight to Edinburgh. Of course, we experienced a delay in leaving and had only 30 minutes to run through a large airport to our next gate. My tip would be pay attention to the flight times and plan for the worst. We got really lucky!

name: Robert
title: We had a good time.  Devil in the details.
text: What we liked:  Hotel and location.  Jet Blue was surprisingly good.  Tour to Sky Lagoon  dry good.  Booking with your contact Tina - very good. Price for the tour - solid.What could improve:  1. we booked a bus “from airport terminal to hotel”. Well … thats actually almost the case.  It was two buses with a transfer at the BSI main station. Given it was raining … not great when we had to walk to the other bus. And the drop off was an 4 minute walk to our hotel NOT at the hotel.  2. The Northern Lights excursion was a one hour drive. Then 400 people standing in a parking lot.  1.5 hrs of standing with no sighting.  1 hour drive back. Not great.  Much better experience in Alaska.Lastly … as far as your team that answers the phone.  Tina greats 5 stars.  The other two people… well let’s just say I can’t tell you many times (5-7?) I’d ask a question and the response was “I don’t know.  we are not travel agents”.And it would be very good to start adding more details to the excursion vouchers.  Like an email contact.

name: David
title: Budapest, Vienna and Prague Adventure
text: Overall we enjoyed the trip.  Transportation went smoothly though it would be beneficial for suggestions on transportation between hotels and airports or train stations.  Train station addresses would also be beneficial.  Train ticket translations to English would be helpful---ie: car number vs wagon and seat vs foreign word for it.  Hotel in Vienna left a bit to be desired---it was clean but offered limited amenities.  Location of all hotels in relation to mass transportation was excellent. Some direction on how to obtain underground and tram tickets would be helpful including single use and multiple day tickets and a reminder that multiple use tickets must be validated and how to do that would be helpful.  Thank you for making this adventure possible at a reasonable rate,David and Betty

name: Janneane Michelle Warmack
title: Everything went smoothly and exceeded our expectations
text: This was a great company to book with! The airline was amazing. We got to the hotel 3 hours early and were able to check in with no problem. Our Northern light tour was great and the company even went out of their way to take us back to our hotel afterwards. I will definitely book another vacation with great value vacations very soon

name: Candy W
title: Great Value
text: The price was great, GVV was good to work with when there was a change, and the package was a great value (which was airfare to & from Iceland, hotel and northern lights excursion). Three nights wasn’t long enough to see and do all that Iceland has! Play Airline had ala carte everything, but clean and new. BWI and KEF were easy to navigate. The hotel was in a perfect location to restaurants and shopping and the Northern Lights excursion was spectacular - "Very Lucky" is what even the staff said! We would use GVV again!

name: Randy Gordon Russell
title: Classic Portugal trip with GVV is a Classic
text: This is our 3rd trip with GVV and I would rate it with 5 stars. We did have a last minute flight cancelation problem because of a work strike In Germany and GVV stepped up and rebooked our flights. I have always worried about hotel and airport and train station transfers and it seems as though the companies that GVV works with are very professional and very responsible.

name: cristy

name: Patrick Lavery

name: TrishABQ
title: I loved this one!
text: I loved this one!!  I met several other people, mostly singles who booked thru GVV while there and we went on several excursions together.  The flights were well scheduled, good layover times, the hotels were fairly close (within a 10 minute walk) to city centers without being in the middle of it and the trains (with instructions that helped lots!!) were at good times.This is my second trip with GVV and so far, my experiences have been quite positive.   I also found that scheduling an extra day in each place gave me time to enjoy each spot and not feeling too hurried. I'll have to see what I book next.

name: Julia
title: Responsive
text: You were very responsive when we had a concern. The hotel you booked was very comfortable and had a good breakfast.

name: Gee Sully
title: Different but enjoyed the history
text: Tour:Magic of Southern Italy: Rome, Sicily, Calabria & SorrentoMy 2nd trip with GVV. My first was a tour of Dubai.Pros:-covered alot of ground in the 8 days of touring.-tour guides were extremely knowledgeable-hotel stays got better as we went deeper into Sicily. All hotel employees were very welcomingCons:-no time to sightsee while being guided. Ex: tour guides gave us outside view of many spaces, but if we wanted to explore inside it'd be after the 2hr tour was over, meaning doubling back, spending $ on taxis to get back to hotel. Trailing off on your own wasn't "happily accepted" among the chaperone-time was cut during one of our tours because the bus driver had to leave. That made for an unhappy group and alot of wasted downtime on many days-no time to shop... in the towns that weren't bustling (Ex: Scilla- a zillion steps), we had a ton of time to do nothing but walk around. If you opt out of certain tours you will have time to shop and explore the town on your own, but do your research.-no time to enjoy breakfast. If breakfast starts at 7 and you have to leave the hotel with luggage at 730 you feel rushed. Be prepared to wake up early.Useful notes:-be prepared to spend an upwards of $200+ pp to explore Mount Etna and tour the Amalfi coast by private chaperone vs the included drive by of the coast. These are not included in price...the Amalfi coast private tour tickets ($107pp in March) must be purchased on your own, with research. Ensure you pack properly for Mount Etna-there are taxes placed on purchases, but some places honor the duty free law. You'll have to personally ask each shop if they do this. Fill out the paperwork and recoup your taxes at Rome Airport. I found out about this (from a couple on same tour) on the last day of my trip and could've saved a ton of $ had I known prior.-2 dinners were included on my tour. And the places we were taken to for lunch/dinner on our own was a fixed menu. Do extensive research on your own to ensure you have time to enjoy a lunch/dinner you like while also carving out time to do a little shopping.I hope this helps you. Happy trails!

name: Connie R

name: Bronwyn

name: Chris
title: We had a fantastic time with Great…
text: We had a fantastic time with Great Value Vacations! The overall experience was well-organized, and we enjoyed the planned activities and excursions. Communication leading up to the trip was lacking.Additionally, while most of the accommodations were great, a couple of the hotels did not meet the standard we expected. The description of one of the hotel locations was also a bit misleading, as it was farther from the city center than anticipated, which made exploring less convenient.Despite these issues, we truly enjoyed our trip and appreciate the effort that went into planning it. With a few adjustments, this could easily become a five-star experience. We would still consider booking with them again!

text: My son and I had a wonderful vacation in Italy.  Our length of stay was remarkable for his spring break.  Italy was beautiful, and setting our own pace and visiting sites independently was awesome!  We also did some shopping at the designer mall in Rome.

name: Jmill
title: Won't be using this agency again
text: I have used Great Value Vacations four times now, and unfortunately this last trip was the final straw for me. I have encountered minor issues on each trip (no help when flights were cancelled on a previous trip) but was willing to look past them since the trips were affordable, or so I thought at the time. On this most recent trip, I had to reach out 13 times to address an issue with my flight, and was repeatedly told it wasn't possible to make changes. However, each time I called the airline directly, they confirmed it was entirely possible to make the changes I was requesting, but since a travel agency booked the flight, the agency would have to request the changes. I shared that information with GVV and they repeatedly told me it wasn't possible.  GVV said their "air team" reached out but was unable to make the changes. This process took months to complete, and I had to follow-up multiple times when my emails went unanswered by GVV for days or weeks at a time. I forwarded those responses to the airline who finally took pity on me and allowed me to make the changes myself, for hundreds of dollars less than what GVV told me the changes would cost, if they had allowed me to make them. Overall, I felt disrespected and ignored by GVV, and I now know it would have been more affordable (hotel rates would have been cheaper if I had booked directly) and far less stressful if I had booked the trip myself. I will not be using this agency again.

name: Tessica Brewer
title: One of the best vacations I’ve ever…
text: One of the best vacations I’ve ever had. I was a little skeptical of the price being so reasonable and that everything was booked and taken care of within 24 hours of booking….but my husband and I could not have been more thrilled. I will be using GVV for many vacations to come.Now for some of the more detailed part, we did the castle tour in Ireland, the first 2 were authentic castles, the 3rd was a nice hotel in an area with castles to tour and the final was a hotel that looked like a castle that has been built on the ruins of a castle. I do suggest highly to get the insurance through great value because if you read the fine print, the rental company can hold up to $2700 if something happens and you wreck the car there without insurance. I also enjoyed the activities that were suggested that you can purchase through them. And last, but not least, I could not have done this trip without the payment plan that was offered with a company they work with. title: Possible Scam?
text: Would love to write this review of your response! Thank you for your response. However, as your history reflects, no accountability has been taken. Rather than addressing the core concerns, the blame has been shifted elsewhere. While I appreciate the clarification, I want to reiterate my concerns regarding the handling of this situation.First, while the travel credit may not have originally been in my name, your team allowed the transfer, which means my family was granted the right to use it. The repeated extensions, while appreciated, do not change the fact that we were unable to complete the booking due to issues beyond our control—including website difficulties and difficulty reaching customer service at critical times. I understand your stance, but our experience does not align with the seamless process you describe.Regarding the customer service availability, my husband’s call may have been made late on the final day, but that was due to previous unsuccessful attempts to resolve the matter. We did not wait until the last minute by choice—we were met with obstacles throughout the process.As for reviews, I respect your perspective, but the reality is that multiple customers have expressed similar frustrations. A glance at Yelp shows that your “1-star” reviews significantly outweigh your “4-star” reviews and nearly match your “5-star” ratings. High-rated reviews do not negate valid concerns from those who had negative experiences. Transparency is essential, and I encourage your team to view this feedback as an opportunity to improve customer service and resolution processes.Ultimately, my goal has never been to make inaccurate statements but to seek a fair and reasonable resolution. Given the circumstances, I ask that you reconsider extending the travel credit once more or offering an alternative resolution. I hope this conversation can lead to a more customer-focused approach moving forward.

title: For our 30th wedding anniversary
text: For our 30th wedding anniversary, we booked a trip to Ireland through GVV, and it turned out to be a memorable adventure of 8 days. The flights and accommodations they arranged were excellent overall. That said, the airline seats could’ve been more comfortable, especially given the long transatlantic flight—something to consider for anyone planning a similar journey. Our package was thoughtfully curated, including stays at five distinct hotels, guided tours, and a car rental, which together offered a fantastic way to explore Ireland’s rich landscapes and culture.The weather was a classic Irish mix: chilly with bursts of rain and occasional sunshine, but it only added to the charm of the experience. We were captivated by the country’s highlights—crumbling castles steeped in history, the breathtaking Cliffs of Moher, and the cozy, lively pubs that welcomed us with open arms. Each hotel we stayed at boasted friendly, attentive staff who made us feel right at home. Among them, the Rose Hotel Spa stood out as our favorite for its exceptional comfort and ambiance, while the Redcastle Hotel Spa in Donegal won us over with its stunning views that perfectly framed Ireland’s rugged beauty.Overall, GVV delivered a seamless and delightful way to celebrate such a milestone. We’d recommend it to anyone eager to discover Ireland’s magic—just pack a good raincoat and maybe a cushion for the flight!

title: Unbelievably Thought-out and Incredible
text: It is difficult to prioritize travel when costs add up to infeasible amounts and hidden fees/undisclosed necessities arise throughout the process. When I looked at booking a trip through GVV I spent more time ensuring that the site/deals weren't a scam than I did planning any part of the trip. I just didn't see how such a comprehensive, amazing package could cost less than plane tickets alone usually do for a trip like this. I looked at hotel prices, voucher costs, car rental, and every other included item, trying to find something that would come back to bite me later on the trip; it didn't exist.I just got back yesterday from a week in Ireland, where I got to take a layover to Denmark, and I spent less than $1,500 on plane tickets, car rental, way nicer hotel rooms than I would ever have ventured to book myself, activities every single day, and everything planned to the most minute detail. Follow their suggestions and you are bound to have the vacation of a lifetime at an amazing price! I bought extra insurance, because I wanted to be sure I didn't spend 10X as much if something went awry - but without that I could have easily done the trip for closer to $1,200!

He told us we could be waiting longer until more could join so we had no choice but to pay extra for a “private”van that was filthy and smelled awful.On our return we paid $108 to upgrade our shared transport again so we could sleep an extra 1 1/2 hours.  Our “private” van came a half hour early (and an hour later than the shared van expected arrival) and so we were rushed anyway.  On our way to the airport the van picked up others and when calling Nexus they told us that the private van came but we were a no show and they would not refund us.  Also, the driver who picked us up did not confirm names, private/shared service and just took a picture of our reservation email.  We assumed it was private being no one else was in the van and they arrived an hour later than the shared van pickup time. In my phone conversation with Nexus I was not going to argue with them while we were on our way to the airport and with others in the van.This was an awful experience, super shady/deceitful and I am still waiting for a reply regarding a refund.Can GV assist with this please?

name: Leslie Lynch
title: Overall Worth It
text: The air travel only gets 3 stars. Too much time waiting in JFK and Atlanta when I know there are many nonstop flights available. On the return trip we actually flew over DC (our destination city) to get to Atlanta. Great prepaying for airport transfers. Took the stress out of finding our way and both drivers were friendly, neatly dressed and their cars were very clean. The hotel in Madrid (Sercotel Gran Conde) was pretty far away from the center of tourist attractions but it did have a Metro close by. The hotel was nice but we had some plumbing issues and it was hot. The  hotel in Barcelona (H10 Cubik) was excellent-perfect location, great breakfast, helpful staff. Julia Travel tours did a great job showing us around the cities. Would have preferred the Madrid tour on Day 1 (not 2) as shown on itinerary. Already saw much of the tour highlights on our own by then.

title: Second GVV Trip
text: This will be our second trip using GVV. We went to Ireland in 2022 while Covid restrictions were still in place on our return to the U.S. and it went very well. The cost for that trip and this one to Scotland is very good value and the flexibility of options is also nice. You can upgrade the car rental with ease, choose a preferred hotel and also upgrade air travel.

title: Do not book 2 Island trip, logistical nightmare

Logistically, it was not a relaxing or pleasant experience.

name: Dianne griffin
title: Great Value Vacation To French Rivieria With Flight Delay From The US
text: Just returned home from an 8 day trip to the French Rivieria. This is the 5th trip I have taken with Great Value Vacations. They have all been amazing--lovely hotels, transfers from airport/train station to hotels, any included bus tours, etc. No issues every encountered until this trip to the French Riveria. My trip included a rental car to pick up when we arrived in Nice (from the US). Our first flight from Jacksonville was delayed due to weather in Washington DC where we were connecting which made us miss our connection to Nice via Brussels. I called Great Value and asked the agent answering the phone to please let the car rental company in Nice and hotel know that we would be delayed and now not arrive until that evening (originally due in at mid-day). The agent told me she would do it. When we arrived in Nice and went to Enterprise, the agent informed us the reservation had been cancelled due to "no show". They hold the reservation for 2 hours but since they had not received any information about our delay, the reservation was cancelled and no cars were available. It wasn't possible to call GV on my phone (not working internationally) I emailed the emergency contact # and then contacted my son through What's App. I never heard back from GVV emergency contact My son was able to speak with GVV and was told there was nothing they could do about getting us another car. They are to refund the cost of the car via check but haven't received it yet (my son was told it would take 10 days). I am upset that the agent didn't follow through--not with the company. When we reached the hotel (by Uber) the hotel informed us they also had not be notified but still had our room.

name: James
title: Smooth traveling and fun experiences!
text: The plans worked well for my wife and me and the hotels and the rental-car and the guide-services, we had a splendid time and no-problems!  Even the possible problems worked themselves out: our departure flight (from JFK-to-MAD) was suddenly cancelled but we were early at the airport and quickly were boarded to an earlier departure from JFK that was even better than our initially assigned flight!  Communication to GVV was difficult during our arrival to MAD because we didn't know who to call if anything went-wrong (and we did have a problem at our arrival airport in knowing how to meet the Transfer person, but we took a taxi and it worked out ok).The tour-guide-driver in Madrid was flexible and easy to communicate with as he drove us around the major sights of the city and provided information about anything we wanted.The tour-guide-walking in Cordoba-Alhambra was super and easy to communicate with, and met us conveniently at our hotel in Cordoba to begin the tour by taxi and to see us safely to our hotel afterwards.The self-guided tour in Granada was ok but the advance-information about it was weak: we were expecting a little hotel on the narrow streets of downtown but it turned out to be one of the largest hotels on the biggest outdoor plaza in town, and 5-star-accommodation too!The hotel in Malaga was beautiful and modern and even had its own easy parking.  We saw a Flamenco show and ate traditional meals and shopped for souvenirs, usually taking taxi or Uber to get around but sometimes walking to see the Mediterranean beach and the old historical area of town.  We drove our one-way rental car to the receiving depot at the Malaga airport and easily got shuttled to our departure gate.  All the hotels were at least 4-star and were very comfortable and reasonably quiet--and vehicle parking was closeby and about $20/night.

title: Great Experience in Iceland

When the desk opened, they printed vouchers for the round trip.

name: Karen Strumar
title: Hotel Caribe by Faranda Grand in Cartagena, Columbia
text: The hotel you booked for us in Cartagena, Hotel Caribe By Faranda Grand, it was the worse hotel we had ever stayed.  The room has a lot of molds in the bathroom, the drainage in the shower didn't flow into the drains, accumulated the water in the shower while we were taking shower, the floor was very dusty/dirty, and at least we didn't hear water dripping noise from the A/C (the first room they checked us in had this issue). The water piping constantly made a "pop"sound when we flushed the toilet, or the upstairs room flushed the toilet.  The sound installation is very bad. We can hear our neighbors talking or when people walked and talked on the hallway.  The night before we left the city, we purposely made an effort to speak with the front desk about our early picked up to the airport, and requested for the ToGo breakfast, I told them one of us is allergy to cheese/yogurt and make sure the sandwich they prepared for us has no cheese in it. Guess what? They don't care. I got a ham and cheese sandwich with yogurt. I ended up giving it to the hotel doorman. This is definitely not a 4 or 5-star hotel as your agency said or advertised. They are a 1-star hotel, if there is a zero star rating. I would have given the. ZERO star rating. To book us in this kind of hotel, we should be entitled to a refund of our room fee or some credits back to our credit card. Totally miss advertising or misleading the rating of this hotel to us.Your agency should look into booking this hotel for your future travelers so it won't affect your travel agency reputation.

The rooms were fine but it did seem wasteful.While outside the control of Great Value, I do believe you should caution drivers that the roads to some of the more remote locations were nearly impassible at spots. name: D. Lloyd
title: Our travel experience was very good
text: Our travel experience was very good. My only criticism was the hotel choice for the upgraded option. It was very far from town, realistically too far to walk crossing major roads with no sidewalks, round abouts, etc. Taxis are very expensive. I wish there had been a note from GVV concerning the average taxi fare into the center of town, approximately $ 20 one way, from the chosen hotel (The Natura). I would not have paid for this upgraded hotel on the edge of town if I had known taxi fares were so high. Also, the transportation options for the excursions were not very clear. All excursions leave from the main bus terminal, which is NOT in the center of town. Transportation TO/ FROM YOUR hotel is needed IN ADDITION to the chosen excursion. However, even this is confusing, since some pick ups are at chosen hotels, while others are from local bus stops near hotels. This is a major flaw in the information presented and a clear description needs to be provided after a package is purchased. It took being on the ground and being walked through the steps to understand how the excursions work.

text: Christmas Journey. When we bought our vacation for 4 from San Antonio to Las Vegas, we had to fly through Phoenix. Instead we rented a car from Phoenix, drove to Las Vegas, and American Airlines canceled our return home flight because we did not take their next day flight out of Phoenix. It was a nightmare. Anyway, it was not the fault of Great Value Vacations, but I would caution folks to ask about flying other than economy. It may cost more, but when an airline crew does not show up, at least you have a better likelihood of getting a full refund. Getting insurance might also be a good idea if flying if it allows for a full refund for any reason (if there is such an animal). I know we will not be flying American Airlines again.

name: Gregory Calvin
title: The emergency form will result in no action from this rinky dink company. Don't wast your time filling it out.
text: We purchased a driving through Ireland Value Vacation.  We encountered a once in a decade show storm on the day we were traveling from Limerick to Cork.  The storm was so bad that we were stranded for over an hour on the drive because of accidents and vehicles not able to move and these were on National roads in Ireland.  Our Hotel destination for the night was not in the town of Cork but another hour and 20 minute drive in good conditions on rural roads that are barely wide enough to hold two cars side by side.  The Hotel was in a seaside town in the middle of nowhere and we quickly realized driving from Limerick to Cork that we would be in danger driving in this snow storm on the rural roads.  At 12:30 pm Ireland time (7:30 am New York time) we contacted The Great Value Vacation's Emergency department by filling out a form online asking to have our seaside rural hotel reservation be canceled for the night and rebooked in the Downtown of Cork since we could make it on the larger roads to the town of Cork safely.  No phone number is provided for Emergencies, only an online form in which we attached a photo of the driving conditions at 12:30 pm on the major roads.  The emergency page states that they do not open till 9:00 am New York time and that solutions could take up to 3 hours to solve.  The Great Value Vacation's office would not open till 12:30 pm New York time and did have a phone number to call.  We received no response in the three hours after 9:00 am New York time (now 5:00pm Ireland time). At 12:30 pm New York time we called the phone number for the office that opened.  The woman that answered said she would put in a second emergency ticket and would get back to us.  Another hour and a half went by with no response so we called back again and reached a second man in the office.  He was very willing to help but said he could not give us a number to the emergency department or he would lose his job and that he saw online the extreme weather conditions in Ireland and confirmed everything we were telling him and he would escalate this to everyone in the company.  It is now 7pm Ireland time and driving to the rural seaside hotel in the dark with iced over roads not plowed would be a death sentence.  There was no way me and my two children were going to make this drive.  After another hour of no response from anyone at Great Value Vacations, we book a room online in minutes on our own at a Residence Inn for $170 Euro.  My daughter has Titanium status with Marriott BonVoy so the front desk upgraded us to a one bedroom suite so the three of us could have a bed.  Please note that we had two rooms in every hotel of this vacation booked by Great Value Vacations and we were only asking for one room in downtown Cork for one night from the emergency team.  So now at 3:30 pm New York time (8:30 pm Ireland time, 8 hours after filling out the emergency form and 6.5 hours after the emergency department opens and 3 hours after the office opened and a half hour after we booked our own room we finally got a return call.  The woman said we can do nothing for you.  Asked if we had purchased travel insurance and that it takes them days to book rooms and even if they wanted to book a room it would not be for that night.  Granted it took us about 5 minutes to book a room ourselves online.  I said if that is the reality why were we not contacted at 9:05 am New York time when the emergency department opens and informed of this.  Her answer was shocking.  "Well we really don't staff the emergency department at that time.  We wait till the office opens to have staff available."  I then asked why didn't you tell us at 12:35 pm New York time when we called and talked to a live agent that you could do nothing for us or at 2:00 pm New York time when we called back and spoke to another live agent?  Her response was no response other than we cannot help you in your emergency and your should have purchased travel insurance.  Another shocking response because I am not and Idiot.  What she was really telling me is that there is no emergency that falls under our responsibility and that the form is just a farce to make you think we really do have an emergency department but any emergency that would cost us money or require us to act on your behalf falls under the stock answer that you should have purchased travel Insurance and leave our rinky dink company out of it because we cannot have someone on staff at the hours we claim our fake emergency department opens and will respond within three hours.  If you think I am being excessive just read their website and tell me I'm not right.It even took them three hours after their office opened and we talked to two agents to make one phone call and contact us and say tough luck we cannot help you.Your customer service is nonexistent and a JOKE.  I would never recommend this company to anyone.

text: This was our first trip to Europe and our first experience with GVV. We had a rental car. I would not recommend a rental car. We upgraded to a bigger vehicle, and it was still too small. We were not told there would be a fee to return the car at another airport, as this was part of the package- fly into Rome/ out of Venice. We upgraded our trip to include breakfast and activities with the Go City pass. We did the Rome Explorer Pass, a pizza-making class in Tuscany, and a walking tour of Venice. Our Go City Pass was not activated in enough time to make the required reservations for several activities we would have liked to do. The pizza-making class was canceled, and we were not told until we arrived for the tour. I would not pay for the upgrade with GVV and just book yourself when you got to the attraction you want to see/do. Our accommodations in Hotel Villa Mercede  and Villa Pace Park Hotel Bolognese were nice. Our accommodations at Fattoria degli Usignoli were horrible. The rooms were not clean. The beds were extremely hard. You could not control the heat in the rooms, and it was very hot. We ended up having to open the windows and woke every morning smelling like smoke. The information on GVV's website about the resort was grossly inaccurate. Check in at all three hotels was pretty easy; however, we had issues with our breakfast upgrade at Fattoria degli Usignoli. We were told GVV did not indicate we paid for breakfast, so we didn't get breakfast our first day. They later said we did have breakfast, but they didn't offer any compensation for not having breakfast the first morning.

name: Krystal G
title: Better coordination needed with local travel agency
text: I went to Panama with my best friend. The trip was nice and the hotels were top of the line. But Great value needs to do better coordination with the local travel company Panamazing. My friend arrived from another city so her pickup destination was at another terminal which caused delay in the pickup. Our male driver left me at the airport in a foreign country because he was more focused on his schedule then my personal well-being. I never travel random airport taxis due to the safety risk, even in my homeland. Thankfully, I spotted him talking to another coworker at that next terminal and I had to beg her to take me to the airport. Imagine if she said no, due to space limits in her vehicle.  Thank God for that sweetheart lady name Olga. Things types of mixups are not expected when you paid for an airport transfer.

name: Patricia Nurse
title: Hotel was perfect for going to Broadway…
text: Hotel was perfect for going to Broadway shows!   Great breakfast buffet.   Truly enjoyed our trip!

name: Firestar and Company
title: My doc at the ermency wouldn't let me fly.  And  I take image to your opening question

name: K. White
title: Everything ran so smoothly
text: Everything ran so smoothly, it look all the stress out of an international trip with kids! The shuttle from the airport was a breeze, each of the hotels were lovely, and the rental car was perfect. Having Great Value manage and book all of those details was a major lift of stress off my shoulders and I couldn’t recommend them more!

name: Hunter
title: Poor Customer Service & Deceptive Travel Protection Plan
text: EDIT: we’ve been working with the GVV travel agent, Kerrie, and she’s been so kind a patient with us. She was able to help us get travel credit so we can rebook our vacation and has completely turned around our experience. Thank you SO much!——————We were hit with a snowstorm and, unfortunately, are unable to travel. My husband and I contacted GVV, the hotel, and the airlines on 1/6, 1/7, & 1/8 to move our trip to different dates (current travel was booked for 1/9). There are 2 misleading events that we'd like to discuss with GVV:- One, when booking our trip 9 months ago, we were offered the Travel Protection Plan, which we accepted and paid for. There was only one option to select at the time of booking. When we went to review our Travel Protection Plan to see what our options were due to this circumstance that is out of our control, it turns out there is a separate travel protection plan for cancellations, and we currently only had a travel protection plan for events that occur during the trip. How would we know that there are more travel protection plan options if we were only provided with one option up-front?- Two, when we contacted GVV on 1/6, we were within our hotel cancelation period, but GVV refused to move our travel dates or help us at all with our reservation. When we contacted the hotel the next morning, we found out that we missed the hotel cancelation window by 1 day. GVV could have helped us but refused to do so. On 1/8, we were able to work with the hotel to get our reservation canceled, but GVV refused to refund us even though they have our money and the hotel is not charging them for the reservation.We just want to be able to rebook our vacation, not a refund. This shouldn't be too much to ask, especially since the hotel canceled the reservation and gave GVV the money back.

name: Terry
title: Turks and Caico's Trip
text: Good communication and follow up.

name: Monica Garcia Guzman
title: I location of the hotel was excellent
text: I location of the hotel was excellent! It is walking distance to and in the middle of the major attractions. The breakfast was amazing too. Prague is definitely a beautiful place that often gets missed! 10/10 recommend!

name: Amellia Redig
title: Didn't get original flight
text: Didn't get original flight.  No credits

name: Stephen John Kley
title: We have traveled with Great Value Vacations and were very impressed with the itinerary with the exception of this current trip.
text: We have traveled with Great Value Vacations on several times including: Iceland, Ireland, and the Greek Island Hopper. All were wonderful experiences and we highly recommended Great Value Vacations to family and friends. In previous trips, all transportation had been provided. On this last trip our vouchers were written in German, which caused problems from the outset. In addition, on this trip the transportation from the hotels to the train stations and the train stations to the hotels were not provided.  This caused some stress we were not anticipated as well as additional costs for taxis.  The original hotels were changed from the first itinerary.  Each of the hotels were very nice, but the location of the one in Vienna caused us to walk a long way and find the tour bus.  We thoroughly enjoyed the whole trip, and we were glad we are frequent travelers to avoid most of the confusion with transportation. Overall, the trip was great.

name: Angelina Golio
title: Amazing Trip to Malta!
text: This was our 4th trip with Great Value and we had an amazing time in Malta! The country was beautiful, our hotel was lovely and the included tours were fantastic. We were able to learn so much about the rich history and culture of the Maltese people. I would recommend this trip to anyone!

name: Kavya Kumar
title: SA trip
text: The overall tour was well planned out but you do get to the airports pretty early so it’s a lot of downtime there.Also for a trip over the holidays it wasn’t very well communicated how many things would be closed. We had a tour scheduled for 1/1 and didn’t get a voucher for it. I had to call several times to understand why it wasn’t and it was because of the holiday which made sense but I didn’t get told that until I reached out: then I asked if the tour could be rescheduled to another day we had fully free which it did but half the things we went to see that day were closed and wish that was better communicated to us.

name: Carl Trinidad Lomboy
title: Xmas markets
text: As with our prior trip to Greece 6 months ago with this company, the itinerary given ahead of time with regards to hotel you were staying did not match the actual hotel you got assigned to.  It was almost a bait and switch as the new assigned hotel seemed to be of lesser quality or further away from the action than what they offered.  It would have been helpful to offer a tutorial on how to travel by trains through Europe rather than letting you flounder for yourself in non-english speaking countries.  No explanation of the train tickets in German.   Free breakfasts were great as the buffets were enough to get you to dinner.  Again, if you market it as a Christmas market trip, it would have been nice to get recommendations of which market to go to as Berlin had over 150 markets and the company just lets you figure it out on your own.  Transfers were not included on this trip to and from hotels and all the railway stations.  Probably a better trip for a younger and more flexible crowd.

name: Cynthia Eisenhower
title: Everything was more than expected, except Heathrow and British Airways personnel
text: Everything was more than expected, EXCEPT security at Heathrow in London. We missed our flight to Venice because 6 Security agents stood around rather than check our bags. We waited one hour while none of them worked, there were 6 other traveler's that also missed their flight. British Airways would not help us, we had to stay in London overnight which cost an additional hotel room and a lost $327 for a tour of Venice.

name: Allen C.
title: The quality worth the price paid and more!
text: My family enjoyed the trip with the suggested itinerary! Everything was as described with the hotels. There is no hidden surprises! The quality matches the price we paid! We’ll use them again in the near future!

name: Samantha B
title: Hotels not near attractions!
text: Getting to visit 3 cities was an amazing experience. Please know that if you book this trip the hotels are centered about the train stations and are not near the city centers. If you plan to book excursions and visit major attractions, they are 30-45 minutes away. We were not completely comfortable with all of the public transportation so we had to take taxis for several early morning experiences. Hotels chosen were good and accommodating.

name: Sarah J
title: The trip itself was good
text: The trip itself was good. The time of year made it too busy for our liking. Train ride was overpacked with luggage and people. No room for ours so had to put it on our laps.

name: Rob Bell
title: Christmas Market Tour
text: We just returned from our independent trip to Germany and Austria. It was GREAT. The hotels that were chosen for us were amazing! Well situated and very nice! They were not elegant, but very nice!! The only piece we were missing was the method to get from locations to/from the trains. We used Uber and it worked very well. The Hop on/off bus tours were a long way from the hotels but again, between walking and Uber, we figured it out.

name: Paradise
title: This is our 5th time traveling with GVV…
text: This is our 5th time traveling with GVV and we are always amazed at how incredible these trips are curated: from cultural excursions, 5 star hotels to round trip airport transportation. We are already looking forward to our next trip with GVV and we recommend this site to all of our friends and family.

name: Joel Saucedo
title: Flawless on GVV side
text: Even though it was outside the busy season and a few places were closed, I would still recommend going back around this time. It was such a wonder experience and the weather wasn’t too bad. Each city/hotel had a different feel to it and everything on GVVs side worked perfectly. It was our 2nd time using GVV for a week long trip outside the US and I would definitely use them again. Looking forward to the next adventure they take us on!If you’re renting a car, I’d recommend not using Enterprise, apparently I am blacklisted(I don’t think I’ve rented from them in over 10 years) but there was nothing they could do to help me and it almost derailed the whole vacation. Thankfully Budget Rental next door saved the day rented me a car with no issue whatsoever.Edit to respond to GVV:Yes I understood that the Enterprise situation was out of your control. I forgot to add that I did email GVV support the same day and I received a refund for the rental car portion of the cost, no hassle at all on GVVs side.Great adventures setup and great customer service on top of that, I’d recommend anyone use Great Value Vacation!

name: Thomas Gregory Moore
title: Eastern Europe Christmas Wonderland
text: Our trip ran like a European train, on schedule and efficient! Our flights from and to Boston were great. Nice service on Lufthansa and Swiss Air. Budapest, Vienna and Prague were very welcoming cities. We visited amazing Christmas Markets, churches, castles and museums. The train between cities was a great way to see the countryside. All 3 hotels were excellent. Very comfortable rooms and scrumptious breakfasts. Convenient to public transportation and city centers. We got more than our money’s worth on this fabulous trip!

name: Mary from Jersey
title: Christmas Market Were Delightful
text: We selected this Berlin-Munich 6 nights package because we wanted to visit Christmas markets in Germany with our friends. Everything about this trip was great. The hotels were very nice and both had fantastic breakfasts. My only wish was that our flight home didn't require a 4am trip to the airport; but that was a small price to pay for an amazing trip.

name: Ingrid
title: Italy: Rome, Florence and Tuscany... and more...
text: We've used GVV a few times now and have nothing but awesome things to say. My husband and I do not like to go on trips where you are taken to certain places and have a guide. We like to do our own thing and wander around at leisure and visit what we really want to see and this is why we choose Great Value Vacations. They will set up our hotel stays, our car rental, flights or railroad travel and we don't have to worry about these things because they take care of all these little details which if done without knowing how things work in other countries can become a hassle. We trust GVV to get them done the right way and our trips have been wonderful.

name: Lauren Henderson
title: 3rd time using great value!
text: This is our 3rd time using Great Value Vacations— the booking process is easy and very user-friendly with tons of destinations to choose from! We will definitely continue to use this vacation company for future trips!!

name: D. Post
title: Flight and hotel
text: Easy experience.  Loved our accommodations

name: Richard Infield
title: Richard Infield review - Azores trip
text: I received what I was told was the coupons in the week before departure, but did not receive the coupons for the tour or details of where and when to meet for the tour which you had booked as part of the trip. When I called GVV to get these details I was told that I would not need the coupon and they did not know the details of the tour. I pushed back strongly on this and ultimately did get a coupon with details of the tour, but feel like you guys should have included those details - and the coupon - in the original packet sent to me. Other (future) travellers might not be as persistent as me and would have been left high and dry in San Miguel and missed the tour; it could have picked me up at the hotel but that pickup was not arranged so I had to walk in to town for the pickup (about 1 mile).A couple of other things:1. The hotel is fine but it is about a mile out of the center of town. I had no problem walking in and back from town all the time but others may not be as happy to do so.2. The incoming flight arrives early - at around 7am local. The checkout time for the hotel is 12 noon, and even in low season I did not get my room until 1:45PM, having arrived at the hotel at around 8am. This having had around 4 hours of sleep on the flight (it's a 5-6 hour flight that leaves after 10pm). I think others might find this delay in getting a room more than annoying, so I recommend some arrangement with the hotel to try to have rooms available earlier if possible. To be clear, I travelled in low season and the hotel was mostly empty but I still did not get my room for close to 6 hours after arrival.

name: Brian Cohen
title: We just love Great Value Vacations
text: We just love Great Value Vacations. This is our second trip with GVV. The entire trip was so well  planned . Travelling can be stressful but GVV makes it easy. The hotels were beautiful, locations close to the attractions but not in the center which provided peac away from the crowds. and breakfast was provided. The tours were well planned out at the beginning of each city, the transportation of trains, planes and transfers were easy to navigate. Communication is a top priority with GVV. We had a trip of a lifetime to Venice, Florence and Rome. We went to Ireland 2 years ago with GVV and it was a fabulous trip. We recommend them to everyone.

name: Margaret Ann Greeley
title: Itinerary and Travel documents were…
text: Itinerary and Travel documents were very helpful, however, I was not aware that we were flying Air France rather than Delta. It made quite a difference and I would avoid Air France if I knew.Hotels were as described, small but comfortable.  The Ibis in Paris, though small, had more amenities than the 4 star London hotel (and the small bar was closed 2 of 3 days we were there).   Overall it was a great trip!

name: kathy
title: Connecting flights were poor shortened vacation
text: All good except for the 6 hours I spent at Paris Airport because Air France flight was late coming in and that left less than 40 minutes to traverse airport thru two separate lines of check in. I missed connecting flight and NO effort was made to help the connecting flight passengers. They all missed the next flight. I would not use Delta if they are using Air France. Upshot is  I lost whole daytime day to explore Budapest which was regretable.

name: Lawrence S
title: Costa Rica 360
text: We thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of our trip.  Accomodations were great.  Adventure tours were terrific.  The hotels, transfers, drivers, tour guides - everything on our itinerary was on time and problem free.

name: David Wilson
title: Very good trip and flights
text: Very good trip and flights. Only thing to do better is location of hotel. Our hotel was great but 1/2 mile walk to Tram each day. More in city selection if you have the choice. Otherwise Amsterdam was great trip

name: MICHAEL
title: All in all it was a great experience
text: All in all it was a great experience. The travel (planes and train) was seamless. The hotels were great. Our only complaint is that the hotel in Munich was a bit out of the way from sites in the historic center of town. Overall it was a good experience. Our travel dates were 12/5 - 12/12 2024

name: Jessica Lynne Merson
title: This trip was great
text: This trip was great. Hotel accommodations were perfect as they were nice hotels in great locations. Train tickets were at good times and reserved seats were great. All around Great Value did a wonderful job as always.

name: Mary Ann Hupp
title: Greatwas a wonderful experience- no…
text: It was a wonderful experience- no problem with the flights or hotelI plan to use GVV in the future

name: Lauren
title: Very easy and affordable vacation

name: Neil H
title: Very poor communication
