Hours  to call them are very limited for an international company.  We did the leg work to get the airlines to refund but $ goes to travel agent and they are not helping us.  They have our refund- a black hole.  All other costs a total loss.  Not our first trip with them its our 5th but this was the second trip we had to get help.  October the resort informed us they never received payment eventually it was resolved but we had to agree to allow a substantial hold on the credit card.  Still no communication.  Maybe honest reviews will help others.Update:  Know that not everyone can come up with that kind of money on the spot.  However, we feel much better that someone from the travel agency  is reading the reviews.  Will update with progress!  Thank you.12/22/24 no word on our refund from airlines but Airline confirms This company ilhas had it for weeks?

name: MARKEISIA SHENAE VENETT
title: Great Value Hilton Hawaiian Village
text: I booked a trip with this company for a Hilton Hawaiian Village Getaway, through Groupon. The trip is advertised as five days, you are only there for three. In my opinion this tour is a tourist trap, the moment I stepped out of my taxi I was surrounded by malls, shpping centers, and jewelry stores. The beach is very small and not the " jaw-dropping nature reserves, majestic canyons, and bright blue seas. Enjoy a luxurious hotel stay on the widest stretch of beach in Waikiki" that the description claims to be. It is a hotel and shopping center, with a small beach in the back. Additionally, the hotel charged me the full-price resort fee instead of the discounted rate as advertised. I was overcharged for this trip, the advertising is false, and I will not book another tour with Great Value Vacations again, they are anything but great value.

name: Domenic A Carito
title: The bag fee was $160.00 per bag each…
text: The bag fee was $160.00 per bag each way. This was not mentioned.

name: RUTH V BROWN
title: The TRIP WAS AMAZING
text: I think the venice and florence hotels were amazing.  Location and convince to rail system was excellent.  The Rome hotel was a no for me.  As two single women we didn't feel the Location was safe or convenient.  We ended up booking another room at a hotel in the city.  Flights there were great and you thoroughly kept me up to date.  Other than the hotel in Rome this was an amazing trip and I would recommend 100%. Besides the place we booked in Rome was only 253 so we felt this was a solid deal all around even with the extra we spent.  Will Def use again

name: Judy C Lucz
title: Hotels are hard to get to, and not close to city centers. Lots of time, effort and money to get to and from them.
text: The trip was well organized, and everything went to plan. However, it was stressful to have only 1 day in each city, and hotels were far away from the sites. I would not do this again and choose a longer trip.

name: Stephen Flannery
title: Their name says it all
text: Recently returned from a five day trip to Iceland booked through Great Value Vacations. The trip was easy to book online and all correspondence and paperwork was handled through my dashboard on their website, all the flight info, hotel, tour and transfer vouches were available to be printed also. There were no hidden cost and everything advertised was delivered with no problems. I had priced the tip myself separately and the price from GVV was quite a bit lower. I will definitely plan on using them again in the future.

name: Julie ONeill
title: Great Value Vacations provided an excellent vacation at a great price.
text: Great Value Vacations provided an excellent vacation at a really great price.  This is the first time we’ve used Great Value Vacations and we will definitely use them again.  Our flights were exceptional, our hotels were well placed near public transportation and very comfortable, and our trains to each locations were good.The only issue we had was trains between cities.  On our train between Budapest and Vienna it appeared we had seats in a specific car but that car did not exist.  We sat in the dining car instead which was fine.  On our train from Vienna to Prague we did not have seats - so we went to the train station the day before and bought our own seats which worked out well.All in all, we had a great vacation.  I highly recommend Great Value Vacations.

name: Shiva Khoshkhou
title: Great trip but if the hotel has A…
text: Great trip but if the hotel has A resort fee make sure if the vacation plan has prepaid that amount in your payment and you don't get double charged and at  the hotel again too.

name: Rose Gulbranson
title: Our booking experience was seamless
text: Our booking experience was seamless. We had great communication and direction leading up to and during our trip. The transfer service was good and we intend to use them for another trip in the future. Great value for our experience.

name: William Durwood Royal
title: Escape to Wonder Land
text: THE entire trip was pleasant and everything was smooth as silk. The hotels were excellent and our rooms had much better views than we expected. All of our rooms had ocean views except the Hilton Doubletree in Honolulu which was several blocks off the coast. The Hilton at Waikoloa was absolutely an amazing resort. Our favorite by far of the three hotels we visited.

name: Rosa
title: The flight's were horrible waste of…
text: The flight's were horrible waste of time at the airports.Six and seven hours between flights is just too much!

name: John Sayers
title: Great with a Couple Caveats
text: Very much enjoyed the hotels, the schedule, and the booked tour. Only two major problems:Train Ticket. We never received actual tickets on the website for our train trip from Budapest to Vienna, and had to purchase them onsite. The only thing we received was a paper voucher, which the charming clerk at the Prague station characterized in this way: "This paper, to us, is trash." We did receive tickets on the website for our Vienna to Prague leg of the trip.On the flight home, there was only a 1-hour layover between the flight from Prague to Frankfort and the flight from Frankfort to IAD. If you've never been to the Frankfort airport, this amount is 100% insufficient, as the passport lines and the distance to the outgoing international gates (nearly a mile from our incoming gate) made it entirely unfeasible. Didn't help that the incoming flight was late and they took an inordinate time to deplane us and get us to the terminal. We ended up staying the night in Frankfort and getting a (tight) seat on the next day's Lufthansa flight.We'd like a refund of the Budapest to Prague train ticket cost, and strongly recommend that you either expand the layover time in Frankfort (a really rotten airport) or avoid the airport entirely when possible. (NOTE: The incoming layover in Zurich was fine.)Thanks.

name: Jeanne Rene Fridson
title: Germany is such a beautiful country and…
text: Germany is such a beautiful country and the Germans are very welcoming.  The roads are awesome. No potholes with very clear signage and easy to follow.  One issue is that some towns/cities are pedestrian only and some research needed to figure out where you can park and where the best and closest places are to park nearest your hotel. A major issue is that you get an electric vehicle which is really not doable for the Romantic Germany since you are covering many kilometers.  Look into an upgrade which is well worth the additional fee.

name: Tony B
title: Another really fun trip from GVV
text: Another really fun trip from GVV. We did the Best of Northern England trip and it was a lot of fun. Everything was perfect, no issues, except, this is a driving trip and three of the four hotels charged extra for parking AND did not guarantee parking is available at the hotel. We had to use offsite parking at one of them. That's my only recommendation for improving this trip - include hotel parking.

name: Cristen Adair Taylor
title: Bucket List Trip Complete
text: Our trip began in Helsinki - there is a great Christmas market.  The red city bus tour is interesting, and you learn a lot about the city which is great for an overview.  We had 1 day in Helsinki before the train to Rovaniemi. I do not recommend the overnight train.It stops almost every hour, and you stay in your sleeper cabin for the entire ride except for the restaurant car.Our tour guide Alain in Rovaniemi was amazing.  He is very knowledgeable and offered great suggestions for excursions and restaurants. The Artic Restaurant was phenomenal.  Make sure you get reservations.  Nili was recommended but very difficult to get reservations.Lapland is beautiful - very picturesque.  This was a trip on my bucket list.  Unfortunately, we did not see northern lights, but we did see polar stratospheric clouds which were spectacular.

name: Patience Muth
title: Great purchase. Don’t wait to decide. Price will increase.
text: It was great to buy an all in one. However specifics on car rental, transports, or Lyfts would’ve been a bit more informative. We opted to rent a car to go on our own time. We missed the included luau, lei making, ukulele instruction, because there was so many things to do. It was worth the purchase to buy when I had planned it, the cost was half the price a week away from the trip with flights and the same resort but that’s usually what will happen, better to spend safely than wait and have no availability. This option made it safe to get everything together with lots of information that comforted me to know it was a good choice.

name: CARY S
title: Great travel package and spot on with…
text: Great travel package and spot on with everything we expected!

name: Sandra Hennigar
title: All of the hotels were really far from…
text: All of the hotels were really far from attractions and sight seeing! The hotel in Rome was in the worst area and extremely far from everything we wanted to see and a great distance from the train station and the airport! The plane coming from jfk to London was late and caused us to miss our plane to Venice  losing a day in Venice and spending 8 hours in London airport. Then train from Florence to Rome was late  causing additional time loss in Rome not to mention that just about everything in Rome is closed on Sundays so not really much of day in Rome the location of the hotel was terrible with graffiti all over the surrounding buildings. This will be my first and last trip I book with great value! Was really disappointed!

name: Regan Kendal
title: Our 2nd time in Ireland with GVV!
text: This was our 2nd time going to Ireland with GVV, and again, they were great!  (Our first trip, we both got pneumonia, and spent most of our time in hotel beds!)  Everywhere we went, whether hotels or attractions, our vouchers were accepted with no issues!  On this trip, we upgraded our hotels to be more 'in town' than the last trip, and we were pleasantly surprised that we rarely needed to drive to anything!  Kilkenny, Cork, and Killarney are all walkable towns, with easy access to restaurants, shops, castles, and lovely views!  Galway and Dublin were 'big cities' to us, so it was very easy to Uber our way around!  Every hotel we stayed at had a lovely restaurant on site, and excellent and very helpful staff!  Our rental car was new, beautiful, and had all the bells and whistles, more than I'm used to!  Make sure you know how to turn off the driver-assist before you start driving!  lol  The bus tour of the Ring of Kerry is a full day, about 5-6 hours, and wonderful in every way!  Our driver was very informative, friendly, and we stopped at a great little restaurant for lunch, with many stops for pictures, as well!  The Cliffs of Moher were magnificent!  The trail along the cliff walk was closed due to rockslides and such, but that didn't ruin anything; it's such a beautiful place!  The Guinness Storeroom tour was very informative, and the displays are really well done!  Lots of history of the making, the town, the people, etc!  Lovely!  The Blarney Castle tour was my only negative of the whole trip!  My husband loved it!  But I believe there should be a giant sign at the bottom that says 'If you are afraid of heights, you should probably not go up!'  The railing on the top of the castle is just a pipe!  And it's all you have to hold on to as you walk all the way around 3 sides of the castle!  And it's 5-6 stories up!  And once you start the climb up the very narrow spiral stone staircase, there is no turning back!  You are committed!  Anyone with a fear of heights...this is a complete nightmare!  You've been warned!!  lol  But the grounds and gardens at the castle are excellent, and beautiful, and I recall our 1st trip during spring, and everything was in glorious bloom!  So stay on the ground if you don't like heights!!  Everything else about our Ireland trip was wonderful, including the flights.  We took Iceland Air for the first time, and they were very good!  Plenty of room in coach!  And lastly, everywhere you go in Ireland...get the dessert!  They really know how to make good desserts!  Eton Mess and Sticky Toffee Pudding...amazing!  And the brownies!  And the ice cream...made with the milk from those excellent butter-making cows!  The best!!!  It was a great trip!  Thanks GVV!

name: Gregory Troy
title: All hotel accommodations were excellent…
text: All hotel accommodations were excellent and I. Great locations for sight seeing. Everything went smoothly. Had a wonderful trip!

name: Matthew C Dorney
title: It was decent value
text: It was decent value, but a few more bargains would have helped. Maybe a luau voucher.

name: Rachael Mackie
title: This was not our best experience
text: This was not our best experience. We booked as one party but 2 groups of 4. Our reservations were tied together but none of our train tickets lined up. When we asked for help to put all of us on the same trains we were told it would be another $600-800. When I replied that was unacceptable and we were traveling together as a family, we never got another response back. I was able to book train tickets to get us together on my own at my own expense for $160.Second, we had a set of hotel rooms not get reserved. When we called GVV for help, we were told to call their booking agent for help. When we pushed back that they should call, we were told they would and then they never called us back (or never left a message if I was out of service area). Thankfully the hotel was helpful in getting us into our rooms.Last, our flight home had 2 long layovers which made our travel day super long - about 27 hours. When you book you don't get to see the flight details, that may have changed our mind.2 stars due to customer experience. The hotel rooms were decent.

name: MARTHA LEON
title: We really enjoy our trip to Ireland…
text: We really enjoy our trip to Ireland with the family. The hotels were comfortable and well selected. We enjoy all the activities included in the package. The highlight Guinness storehouse.

name: Cynthia Anne Cobb
title: No issues
text: No issues. Trip went smoothly.

name: Jo Jamieson TTEE Ferreira Fami
title: Please research the airline and hotel options before you purchase a "deal:.
text: Included airfare was on an airline that did not allow seat assignments until day of flight.Hotel was so far from airport that transportation was super expensive or required a car rental.  Parking at hotel was very expensive.  If one did not have a car, the reviews for hotel food were very expensive and not very good.We just ate the overall cost and cancelled the trip - it would have cost another $1000 at least - no bargain.We did book an alternate flite option to go, but requested Great Value (via email) to cancel the initial flite, but keep the return flite - as we know that if we did not take the initial flite - the airline would cancel the entire flite.  We did not have flite/ticket info - so that we could contact the airline directly. We never got a response from GV.

name: Jada Watson
title: This was a trip to remember
text: This was a trip to remember! Everyone was professional and nice and exactly where they needed to be on time! The car service was top notch! The hotels were Great , the staff for each hotel was stellar! We had the best time and the best experience !

name: Karla
title: Beware! Would never recommend.
text: Great value was able to find a new flight after ours was unexpectedly cancelled. We were so relieved, however upon arriving at the airport we discovered that they did not fully complete the booking process so we were unable to obtain our boarding passes. We had to make several phone calls to the airline and almost missed our flight. And I should mention that I was never able to reach someone at Great Value, despite reaching out several different ways. They do not have a 24/7 help line for emergencies and I would never recommend this company.

name: Jone Corrales
title: When your name is misspelled
text: I had booked a trip to Greece for my friend and me with Great Value Vacations. We had an enjoyable time in Greece and were overall very pleased with the arrangements Great Value Vacations made with Tour Greece, the travel company that coordinated the travel in Greece. That said, my last name had been misspelled in the itinerary details and it cause confusion during transfers and at the hotels. Furthermore, Greece Tour made an unexplainable assumption of my gender and thought that my friend and I were a couple. In addition, we had specifically requested a double occupancy room but had to make special arrangements upon arrival at the hotels because no one had been aware that we had requested a double occupancy room. Overall, everyone was helpful in accommodating us, and we enjoyed our trip.

name: JJ
title: Destination services were not prompt and caused people to miss their flight
text: This was my second trip to Cabo with great value vacations. Overall, it was a good trip. The one thing that could greatly be improved on is destinations services. I made it back to my flight on time, but most people that were in the van with me, did not make it back on time. Pick up time with Destination Services was supposed to be 11:10 AM and we didn’t depart the hotel until close to 11:40 AM Destination Services didn’t seem to care about their great delay in getting everyone back to the airport. It was a very busy Saturday with holiday traffic Destination Services need to take into consideration how important promptnes is.

name: J ANDERSON
title: Christmas Markets!
text: GVV makes it easy, one price includes airfare, good hotels and train transportation between cities. It’s a no-brainer.  I then used Viator to book my excursions. Overall a great experience start to finish.

name: Holly Cortez
title: Caution About The Airlines Booked
text: I would give Malta Airlines a zero if it was available. Flew to Malta on September 9th,2024 and they lost my luggage for 11 days. After I returned home my luggage showed up broken apart in pieces. It cost us about 450 euros to buy clothes, bathing suits, luggage and have laundry done during the entire trip. We were told they had found my luggage on day two.Great Value Attempted to help and got nowhere. They were also frustrated with the lack of service.

name: M G
title: MG vacation
text: I will definitely use great value vacations service again. Everything is well coordinated from start to finish.

name: Wilson McKee
title: Not a good hotel in Venice
text: Not a good hotel in Venice. Smelled bad, very small room & poor bathroom. Good rooms in Rome & Florence. We had a poor flight schedule getting home. You would not honor our request for a better flight. Outrageous that we had to Pay $170 to check a bag in Naples airport. We would not book your service again.

name: Rodies Ulcena
title: I liked the hotels in the package
text: I liked the hotels in the package. They were clean, safe and located close to transport and eateries. Now, did not like the fact that the company was not too informative about the product.  Every time I needed info, it would take a couple of days to get answers.Reps were rude and short too me. And every add one that I asked help with was always quoted more money than what is online.  Try to use the insurance that they sell with the package!!! I have no intention of using them again.

name: Benjamin Conner Dowden
title: Great experience!
text: It was great knowing everything was taken care of as far as our rooms, and travel tickets. I thoroughly enjoyed the 2 hotels that were picked, however I did not enjoy the views we had. We had back alleyways for both rooms we booked. Aside from that, it was great. I would recommend that if the flight info changes that they inform you that your vouchers change and you may need to update them. Very happy with everything, and our experience. Would recommend to friends.

name: CAROL
title: I liked the price
text: I liked the price.   Hotels were clean but out of the way.  One hotel did not include breakfast.

name: Hazel P Palaski
title: Working with the company was great
text: Working with the company was great. Received all of the booking information in a timely manner. Amazing deal.

name: Toni Higgins Moriarty
title: My experience with Great Value Vacations
text: The hotels were awesome and close to different locations.  My flights were great but traveled with other people.  Our times on the rails and flights were not coordinated even though we all had the same dates and locations we were traveling out of.  Your office stated that was because we booked at different times.  However, my flights were changed for the better in September 2024 which was totally not connected to my booking date. I also had to pay an additional 150 for rail tickets to be with my companions at the same time.  I was not going to travel by myself on the rail and would be a longer time frame from visiting each country.  We lost a half a day the first day in Budapest due to flights.

name: Alicia Divico
title: 2nd trip
text: This is our second trip through Great Value, and again, we loved it! Thank you for the work you do!

name: Melissa D
title: Overall exceptional value
text: All 3 hotels were very nice and convenient to places of interest to visit. The overall value for flights, trains, and hotels is exceptional. The only comment is that the train times for the last destination should have allowed us to arrive at the new destination earlier or that our flight leaving was later we only had one full day in the arguably the best city of the three included in this trip.

name: Annamarie Elizabeth Smeden
title: Iceland and the northern lights tour
text: It was very easy to follow the plan and use the vouchers if you have google maps.  We enjoyed Iceland very much!

name: Bullock
title: Belize and some
text: GV provided phenomenal package in regard to the trip. Able to fly out of Houston, 2 and 1/2 hours tops to Belize City, with a 10-minute single jet engine ride to San Pedro. The hotel was great, sunbreeze. It's right off the beach and it's right in the heart of downtown and away where you have access to restaurants, transportation to get around, and the airport is literally across the street of walking distance when you land. So proximity it's great. The only thing that I would knock this trip for is I never got my confirmation for the flight whereas I had to contact United airlines for them to get my seat and travel arrangements together. I had to pay a fee only to be reimbursed and the excursion was not included for me and my wife. We are seeking reimbursement from PURE CENTRAL AMERICA but overall a great experience.

name: Joste Savi
title: Sorrento and Rome Experience
text: I have mixed feelings with this package. It was good, but it could have been better.I got the package with TAP airlines connecting through LIS, but after considering the drive to Castellammare di Stabia from FCH. I decided to change the flight to a direct flight with ITA. I contacted Great Value Vacations before the 24 hours marked, and the lady helped me do it without hesitation. THANK YOU!!My girl and I took the direct flight with ITA, and I must say, great staff, good food, beer, wine, snacks, but the plane unfortunately was on the older side, but it did a great job taking us to our destination.We landed at FCO; passport control was a breeze.  We collected our luggage without problem, and then we walked to the rental car counter (Enterprise).  The lady was helpful as well with the paperwork; then we went to pick the car up, and they gave us a FIAT Panda.  Spacious car, and great horsepower considering the terrain.Here is where I say, the package could have been better.Why? Because the long drive (3:30 hours) after a transatlantic flight is hard.  In my opinion the first leg should have been Rome instead of the 3+ hours’ drive to Castellammare di Stabia.By the time we reached Castellammare di Stabia we were exhausted.  The Hotel was better than expected. Towers Hotel Stabia Sorrento Coast in Castellammare di Stabia (towershotelsorrento.com) was a good hotel.The hotel was located 5 minutes away (Driving) from the Ferry Terminal where we took the ferry to Capri. You must contact (customercare @ nlg.it) the ferry company ( NLG » Official website ) because in the website it said that they operated until 11/3rd/2024 but when I inquired I was told the have extended the connection to Castellammare di Stabia until 11/17th/2024.The hotel in Rome is a little far, but that is why the car was included in the package. Grand Hotel Fleming was a nice hotel with a great staff.  You must go and shop around the hotel, the prices are way lower around the hotel than other parts of the city.My only complaint about this package is the one I mentioned before, it should have been Rome first instead of the Amalfi coast, but other than that I have no complaints at all.Thank you, Great Value Vacations, for another excellent vacation.  Looking forward to another opportunity to have a new adventure with one of your packages.

name: Timothy
title: It was short and sweet
text: It was short and sweet. We could have booked directly with airline and hotel for better savings.

name: Timothy Raymond Kelly
title: Hotel was the perfect location
text: The vacation was well planned and our hotel was perfectly placed to allow us to get to all the sights we wanted to see. We had a great time in Nice and can’t wait to go again!

name: Robert Vandy
title: The vacation was a great price and the…
text: The vacation was a great price and the hotels were very nice. Would definitely use Great Value Vacations again!

name: Philip Dean Drost
title: Great price for our trip to Ireland
text: Great price for our trip to Ireland. Everything was smooth with no surprises. Excellent hotels, rental car and prearranged entrance to castles and parks. Way better than we expected.

name: Mark
title: You delivered on everything that was…

name: Michelle  Whitaker

name: EW

name: philip igneri
title: They listened and provided best remedies
text: They listened and provided great remedies

name: Joseph Thomas Sorbello
title: GVV always does an outstanding job!
text: GVV always does an outstanding job of planning amazing vacations with wonderful support teams when you arrive in a country.  I’ve used them for years and will continue to do so.  My recent trip to India and Nepal was memorable.

name: Blinded by the light
title: Truly a “great value”
text: The package we purchased Ireland Castles and was a “great value” and included our airfare all lodging and car rental.The castle properties (Lough Rynn Castle and Cabra Castle) and hotel (The Grafton)  in Dublin were fantastic. The hotel in Ennis (Hotel Woodstock) was serviceable. The Dunboyne Castle Hotel and Spa (just outside of Dublin) was a bit of a misnomer, it is a hotel attached to a large old mansion with a couple of quaint rooms the rest were converted to meeting rooms. And while the hotel was modern, it was very loud, even in the spa.The booking itself was easy and we had no issues with our reservations for lodging g or car rental. However, it was a bit tricky navigating seat assignments for our flights (Arr Lingus and Alaska Air) and took some effort on our part to book, including several calls to Asr Lingus. After settling that, we had an easy and enjoyable trip.We ended getting updated on our car (at no cost) from an economy automatic to a midsize SUV automatic. Highly recommend purchasing the insurance plan for piece of mind. Also paid €10 to have the car delivered to us at our Dublin hotel and paid extra for the toll tag. All in all a wonderful trip. Highly recommend.

name: Willy Chang
title: Disappointed because all they do is…
text: Disappointed because all they do is make hotel reservations

name: Katherine
title: Everything goes well but if the…
text: Everything goes well but if the information for the train were given more in advance it could be more helpful in order to plan the day accordingly in advance. Also the booking code for the airplane tickets were incorrect I have to spend almost and hour on the phone for assistance on correct information since customer service couldn’t get nobody at the airport to help…finally she could provide me correct booking so I can proceed with my check in.

name: T. Finstad
title: The Budapest-Vienna-Prague trip was…
text: The Budapest-Vienna-Prague trip was great.  The hotel in Budapest was nice, but I would have preferred a location closer to city center.  Other than that all of the hotels included in my package were excellent.My only complaint is the lack of information concerning train transfers.  I had never been on a train for travel and was unaware the tickets for train transfers from country to country included in our package did not include seat reservations and there was not any information provided in the vacation packet concerning this either.  Standing for 3+ hours from Vienna to Prague was not enjoyable.  I would recommend an improvement in adding this communication to the trip documents.

name: Molly Ann Villucci
title: Great Trip Price, Lots of Fun!
text: Everything from flights to train to hotel accommodations ran very smoothly.  Really liked the hotels in Venice and Rome but the PopArtment Hotel in Florence leaves something to be desired!  It needs massive renovation.  There were pieces of the kitchen cabinet cover peeling off, floor was dirty, and there was only heat so it was very stuffy in the room and no windows to open.  Overall Great Value Vacations offered a great trip price and were very helpful whenever I called.  We had a great time on the trip!  I would book with them again.

name: CC
title: Terrible travel times
text: While long lay overs make for cheaper flights they waste valuable vacation time.  The flight timers and train times were not very desirable and wasted too much time.  Also, the inability to upgrade train seats was disappointing.

name: Kerry H.
title: This is our 3rd trip using Great Value…
text: This is our 3rd trip using Great Value Vacations and we really like them! Super easy to book, great communication provided with easy to follow itineraries and excellent value.This was the 2nd time we went to Ireland and the hotels selected were fantastic especially The Old Ground Hotel in Ennis, The International Hotel in Killarney and The Newpark Hotel in Kilkenny. The Maldron Kevin Street in Dublin was nothing special and would have preferred less days there (3 days in Dublin is not needed would rather have had more time in Ennis  but Ireland is such an amazing place to visit it was worth it). Highly suggest GVV!

name: Deborah Ann Donahue Sandoval
title: Best of all three
text: This was a great taste of all three countries. Budapest hotel was beautiful and had robes and slippers . Vienna was wonderful and Christmas markets were the best. Wish we had more time in Prague and the hotel was good not great room was stuffy and small window and noisy. The staff at all the hotels were great and the food in all three places was excellent.

name: kkpaking
title: I am disappointed in our last trip to…
text: I am disappointed in our last trip to Puerto Rico.  For the price that I paid I should have received an excursion or something. This was my 35th year anniversary.  The Grand Hyatt was expensive and far away from all the things to do and see in Puerto Rico which cost us hundreds of dollar extra to go see.

name: Sheila
title: This is the second Great Value Vacation…
text: This is the second Great Value Vacation I have taken, and this is one did not disappoint either.  I can recommend the Ireland (self-drive) and the Affordable Budapest, Vienna, Prague by rail.

name: Marcel McCrea
title: Fantastic Islandic Vacation!
text: My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our Iceland vacation package we got through Great Value!

name: Jose Julian
title: The Hotel in the Toscana was far away…
text: The Hotel in the Toscana was far away from Florence, and the room was very cold,we stayed there just for one night.  We had to find another Hotel in the City the cost was 541 euros. We returned the car 3 days before and they found  a little scratch on the rim that I wasn't responsible for. They charged my credit card 190 euros due to the scratch that I made clear that I wasn't responsible for.

name: Randy Alan Wilson
title: Details should be included about the…
text: Details should be included about the airline offered in your packages. Prices for luggage to and from. Food prices during flights. Seat purchases prices to and from airport to airport. We landed at 5:30 am Iceland time and was up for many hours getting there only to get to our Hotel and not having a room. Had to sleep in the lobby for hours and then pay for early check in. This was poor planning on your end.

name: Karin Boss
title: The Flights
text: The Flights, the Hotels, the Trains, everything went perfect.

name: Sara
title: Great trip- low key itinerary
text: Car was great, Some of the hotels were really amazing. We had a great time.

name: Charles C Chang
title: Everything 11/15/24
text: Everything

name: Maureen Welby Bush
title: Another great trip from GVV
text: I have always been impressed with my GVV packages and this trip exceeded my expectations. Because of a hotel strike at our destination we needed to change our hotel and GVV proactively secured a new hotel with a great location. Everything went off without a hitch! Can’t wait for my next trip in March!

name: Ginger W
title: The whole experience was beyond our…
text: The whole experience was beyond our expectations!  We had a delay and when we called there was no issues with our reservations.The locations were exactly as advertised and we had no issues checking in to any of them.I will most certainly be booking more vacations!

name: Au Smith
title: Happy customer!
text: Super deal and smooth experience. Will use Great Value Vacations again.

name: Fabness
title: Fantastic trip
text: Fantastic trip, everything was nicely setup, center hotel plaza is perfectly located in the ‘center’ of town-a block and a half from bus stop #1 and you can walk to many attractive locations.

name: Stephanie Nicole Johnson
title: Great Value Vacations never…
text: Great Value Vacations never disappoints!! What a wonderful trip! So thankful to have found this website!

name: Patricia
title: Great Value
text: Great Value!What an amazing trip for the price. We originally booked the trip just my husband and I. We were talking about the booking with our friends and they decided to join us. Then both sets of parents decided they wanted to join for that price. So it was 8 of us to Ireland.It was definitely a fast paced trip. We could have doubled the length of the trip and still missed things to see. But we were able to drive over 1300 miles and see tons! The distance between the hotels dictated how fast we needed to travel. Instead of 2 nights in Tralee, I would have preferred 1 in Killarney and 1 in Tralee. But that's the only change I would have made! Highly recommend this trip!

name: PENNY KERKSTRA
title: Trip was good value, but Customer Service lacked
text: My response to GVV response below... I looked back at all my emails and the only email I received from GVV was on Aug 5 and was an auto response with a inquiry number.  Response said "Please expect a more personal response to your inquiry in approximately 5 – 7 business days. Please do not submit your inquiry more than once." There was *not* a quote for an add-on included in said email.  And I never received the expected 'more personal response'.  Sorry, not hard to "miss" an email that doesn't exist.Original Review:  We booked a promo trip to Iceland with an upgrade option through GVV.  Because we were arriving at 4a and the included hotel didn't have a check-in until that afternoon, I attempted to email GVV and ask if there was a possibility of an add-on so we would not need to change rooms.  I received an auto email back stating they would get back within a couple of business days if I was not currently on my trip, which I wasn't.  Crickets...I *never* heard back from them, no follow up or anything.  I booked my own room via Expedia and the hotel was gracious enough to work with me upon arrival so we didn't have to change rooms.The vacation package was nice, we enjoyed the trip.  But we booked all our tours with other vendors, not GVV.So I give them three stars, the value of the package was good...but I'm certainly NOT impressed with their Customer Service.  Probably would not book with them again.

name: Barbara
title: Smooth & Seamless

name: Gina Giachetti
title: Serranto in the winter time!

The tour arranged in the trip was not very good at all, it was off the beaten path and they tried to change the date and time and when we arrived we waited 20 minutes and the tour was only 5 minutes long. Very dissapointing!

name: Glenn Robert Hall
title: Overall the trip was a fantasic…
text: Overall the trip was a fantasic experience. The Towers hotel on the Serento coast was great with beautiful views and nice staff. However the hotel in Rome could have been better. Very difficult to find parking and had issues with cleanliness and a/c control.

name: Andrew  Robinson
title: Do better with your locations for hotels. Cheaper to do it yourself.
text: Venice would have been better if our package wasn't changed after we bought it. You moved us too the town Mestre and we weren't able to enjoy Venice for the time we originally were promised. The hotel you chose us was in a bad part of twon and reeked of cigarettes. Florence was great and the hotel was perfect and perfectly located to everything. Rome was ok, but the hotel was super far away from everything and we were not given breakfast as promised.

name: KENNEY
title: Everything turned out great for us
text: Everything turned out great for us! The package was a great deal, the flights and hotels alone were worth the money. The hotels were all very nice and in convenient locations. We had issues with our trains, but that was a local issue. We would definitely recommend using Great Value Vacations; this was our 3rd time using them!

name: Kelly Megan Jaramillo
title: Wonderful Experience!!
text: From the moment we stepped into the airport to leave until we landed back home, EVERYTHING (flight, rental, and 4 hotel locations) Great Value Vacations booked for us on the Ireland Countryside and Castles tour went so smoothly. We will definitely look to book future vacations with them. This was our first out of country experience and we could not be more impressed with how easy it was. Be prepared it is a lot of driving, but if you are used to driving a few hours at a time you get used to it and it's well worth it.

name: Jessica Renee Miller
title: Great Value + Great Deals= Awesome Vacation
text: I have used Great Value Vacations multiple times, traveling to Ireland and Iceland. Both trips were wonderful experiences and planned well. I enjoy seeing the deals they offer and dreaming of my next destination. I like that I can customize my portfolio and they will send options specific to my next dream destination and tips for successful travels. I highly recommend this site. Traveling is more affordable than people realize, but the memories I’ve made are truly priceless. Watch for the flash deals-especially. The couples deals around February (Valentine’s Day) were really great, but they are usually running a deal regularly. If you have an open mind and a flexible passport, you may end up in some pretty spectacular places. Safe travels!

name: Rachel Ann McCarty
title: Read the details

name: Sarah

name: Shyiam

name: Michael Brown
title: We enjoyed our vacation and saved so…

name: Michael John Sanford

name: Sara

name: William Mills

name: Kathy K
title: Everything went just as planned

name: Angela Dye
title: Charm of Southern Italy
text: Charm of Southern Italy: Rome, Sicily, Calabria & Sorrento (9 days)We have traveled internationally but this was our first guided tour. The days were planned, including guided tours and also some free time. Accommodations were as expected without any surprises. Our host/tour guide, Dimitri, was so pleasant, witty and full of information. There were a couple of full days traveling on the bus, but we had a lot of ground to cover to see different areas of Sicily and Southern Italy. I recommend doing a private tour of the Amalfi Coast instead of staying with the group. We had to forfeit the guided tour of Sorrento to do this but it was so worth it. Choosing a November tour was perfect to avoid peak crowds. We found plenty of stores, shops, restaurants etc. still open. I would definitely recommend this tour and company.

name: William Frederick Heubner
title: Mostly a good travel experience
text: The hotels in our package, in Lisbon, Coimbra and Porto, were excellent.  Each included breakfast and the breakfasts were waaaaaay better than the "continental breakfast" you get in the US.  The flights were economy class, which was OK.  We have a couple of issues about our package with Great Value Vacations:1.  We found out the hard way that your passport needs to have an expiration date of 3 months later than the dates of travel.  It sure would be worthwhile to warn your travelers of this requirement.  Other destinations in the world require 6 months.  Luckily, I was able to get a passport in a day in Seattle, but it meant a separate layover on our trip from Anchorage.2. Our Portugal package to three cities included flight, lodging and rental car.  Our rental car was useless in all three cities, as driving was nearly impossible and public transportation in each city is great. name: Mrs G
title: 8 night, Dublin, Cork & Killarney by Rail package review
text: We booked the 8 night, Dublin, Cork & Killarney by Rail package on-line with Great Value Vacations. We enjoyed our trip tremendously, and everything went off without a hitch. Here are some things I think might help others before booking this same trip:Rail passes for Irish Rail:  For our trip, we traveled by train from Dublin to Cork, Cork to Killarney, Killarney back to Dublin. Great Value Vacations gave us 3 vouchers, **which you must print off and take to the station** to redeem for your Standard Class One Way Tickets. It says on the vouchers to go to the ticket window at each departing station (i.e. Dublin, Cork & Killarney) and hand these vouchers over for actual train tickets. But many of the reviews I read said that the Cork and Killarney ticket stations were closed on the days they were there, so they were over a barrel.  So, we tried to redeem the vouchers ahead of time, on-line, but you can't do this; you must go to the ticket office in person.  So on our first day in Dublin, we went to the Heuston train station and redeemed all of our vouchers for all of the train tickets. *Just be sure to look at the train schedules before you go, so you can tell the agent what time you want to depart each location. * This worked out perfectly because we noticed that the ticket office in Cork was closed Saturday at 9 AM and it took a lot of the worrying out!Hotels: We stayed at hotels that came with standard with the package. Below are the hotels we got and all of these hotels treated us spectacularly! They ALL tried very hard to get us into our rooms as soon as possible if not immediately upon arrival! And all of the hotels came with breakfast included:Ashling Hotel in Dublin: Take a taxi/Uber from the airport. Appx. $30 each way, 20 min ride. Hotel is directly across from Heuston train station.  There are several restaurants in the immediate hotel area (i.e. Nancy's Hands) and the hotel restaurant was very good.River Lee Hotel in Cork: appx. 20 min from the train station. You can walk to the hotel but taking a taxi/Uber is much easier. Appx. $15 each way. Consider taking a day trip via Irish Rail to Cobh. It is a short 20 min ride, and you can walk everywhere. We visited the Titanic Museum (reservations recommended), Spike Island, Lusitania monument, Heritage Center, Cobh Museum, St. Ann's Church, etc. We had lunch at the Commodore Hotel - very good and reasonable.International Hotel in Killarney: Appx. 6 min walk from train station. Beautiful older property located in in the village so you could walk everywhere. Only slight downside is that the hotel is located directly next to a pub and the patrons party loud and hard until closing at 2:30 AM. I think all of the hotels in Killarney are in the same boat as there are pubs everywhere. Just be prepared and take ear plugs. The bar and restaurant are fantastic, and they knock themselves out to take care of you. The Ring of Kerry tour which came standard with our trip was excellent and is a full day bus ride with many stops. The hop on/hop off bus of Killarney National Park was worth the small fee and be prepared to walk ALOT.  It is worth noting that you will need to make breakfast reservations for this hotel.  They emailed us appx. 3 days before we left Chicago asking us what times we wanted which was nice.  The other two hotels you could just walk into breakfast anytime.  Breakfast at all three hotels were fantastic.Flight: You have the ability to "upgrade" your flights to/from your destination on the Great Value Vacation website instead of taking the prechosen flight they initially offer. This gives you the flexibility to decide what airline, departure times, class (i.e. first, coach) you want. We opted to "upgrade" because we wanted to take a direct flight from Chicago to Dublin via American Airlines & Aer Lingus and have the ability to see what seats are available and select where we wanted to sit on the plane.  However, because Great Value Vacations does the actual booking of the flight for you, you can't make changes or pick your own seats directly with the airline. Instead, you have to go through Great Value Vacations to do this this. This is something I immensely disliked, but don't know how to work around this issue.Regardless, we had a wonderful, once of a life-time vacation. We hope you enjoy your vacation as much as we did ours!

And on our return, we were delayed departing Dublin, missed our connection Heathrow to LAX and we’re unable to get rebooked (without a great additional charge) for four days. It was inconvenient and hard to understand.

name: Judy Smitherman Robinson
title: Well worth it!
text: This was the best trip I have ever taken. Every day was amazing. I didn’t have any problems and all ran so smoothly. The accommodations were the best! My hotels were in city central where I could walk to most historic sites I wanted to see. My tours were so fun and I got to see everything on my bucket list.

name: Thomas James Bronder
title: Great getaway
text: All accommodations were as stated with no hassles. Car pickup and drop off was easyAny the resort accommodation were excellent.

name: Gayle D
title: I was skeptical to book a "package" but…
text: I was skeptical to book a "package" but my sister in law had a great trip to Costa Rica last year so we took a chance.Our holiday was AMAZING!!! We did upgrade the hotels and stayed in spa resorts and castles - totally unexpected and we were treated so well!  We also added an extra day for 9 nights, and as we wanted to have seat assignments in advance paid a bit more to fly Aer Lingus - totally worth it.Upgraded the size of the car, and to an automatic transmission as there were 4 of us (only complaint as we traveled as a party of 4 and is that we would have thought a credit towards upgrade was warranted).  Be aware even upgrades are very small compared to US vehicles.The drive from Wicklow to Killarney was very long, and we would have appreciated a break half way (i.e. a stay in perhaps Cashel/Tipperary), so if you do that itinerary be prepared.Most of the hotels charged extra for breakfast (between 17-25 euros.)No blips at all.  Great Value sent vouchers but other than booking numbers for the flights every hotel was waiting for us with just our names and most checked us in early.One of our best vacations ever and we will book again!!

name: Catalina Van Abel
title: Another great vacation with Great Value…
text: Another great vacation with Great Value Vacations! There is no other vacation site for my family and I. You guys make booking a vacation easy and affordable. We went to Ireland and it was a fun, memorable and adventure filled time!

name: Susan Lee Mullen
title: everything went very smoothly and the…

name: RICHARD LEON

text: GVV did an amazing job. I’m thankful for their great service, I called customer service and they handled any issues.

Gili-T was very nice and laid back. Nice to be on the north side of the island with a little less bustle but close enough to the town for easy bike access. We wired two temple tours for our time in Bali. Recommend!

name: David Clifford Cloud

I would suggest upgrading flights from Frontier as they charged for everything adding Little over$400 for the trip. We will definitely upgrade carriers next time. Overall the trip was very good trip for the cost!  GVB did a very good job with arrangements. .

name: Joseph M.

Hit almost all the places we wanted to see.  We were also able to visit the Perlan with the open 1/2 day we had.  The the transfers and travel was handled perfectly and Play Airlines was quite good and a value travel option.

name: JP

Hotel Natura was clean, staff was very nice. Northern lights was cancelled, but was easily rescheduled. No complaints, very happy overall. I look forward to my next Great Value Vacation.

name: Laura Marie Kelly
title: Our trip to London and Paris was…
text: Our trip to London and Paris was perfect! The hotels were close to subways, flights, and train accommodations were great! Highly recommend!

name: Marianne Weitzel
title: This company stole our money when it…
text: This company stole our money when it became impossible to travel due to the pandemic. Like hundreds of other that trusted them, they only offered a credit good for a year when if was impossible to know when travel would be safe again. Do not trust this company. They are charlatans who have no regard for honesty or their customers.It would have been great if I had been notified of the "supposed" extension!

name: Jeri Fleschert
title: Venice, Florence and Rome
text: Staying in Venice would have been nice vs Mastre.  However, the hotel there was very nice had a bar and restaurant on the premises.  There was a nice restaurant directly across and down the street, close location to the bus and train station.The hotel in Florence was pretty far from where the statue of David was. Not very close to shops and restaurants. Our room was infested with mosquitoes and when we told the front desk about it, they promptly gave us a small device to plug into the wall that was supposed to deter mosquitoes, so they were well aware of the problems since they had those devices on hand.The hotel in Rome was OK. It was quite a walk from the train station, especially when you were pulling luggage. It would’ve been a further walk if we would’ve used the metro/subway and it was not close to any of the historical places we wanted to visit.  To get from the hotel to the Colosseum or to the Sistine Chapel was quite a taxi ride and when you’re looking at senior citizens we’re not real comfortable with always using the train or the subway system to get there. It was even further to go to the Trevi fountain or the Spanish steps. Providing a hotel closer to the historical areas of Rome, I think is a much needed change.

name: Margaret E Croney
title: London, Paris, and Rome
text: This whirlwind week in London, Paris and Rome was a fantastic vacation. Transportation was pretty good.  We had to call for pick up times twice.  And I would have liked to have seen transportation provided to and from the Train station leaving London to Paris. The Hop on Hop off bus does not run as frequently as advertised so one often has to take the subway or a taxi to desired locations.On the plus side, the hotel accommodations were good. And the breakfasts provided in London and Paris were excellent. None provided in Rome.I would definitely use Great Value Vacations again.This is my second time using them.

name: Yunhao Zhang
title: A connection flight was cancelled and…
text: A connection flight was cancelled and we were stuck in the airport for more than 12 hours. It was after midnight when we finally arrived at the hotel.  The hotel in Budapest is far away from the city center, we toke taxi to see attractions.

name: BRIAN A TATUM
title: This tour is sold onto another company (Grey Line) which might not be for you

I was not that impressed with the standard of their coaches (No USB's or USB's didn't work.  Lights didn't work and they didn't look that clean.  For Dubai I guess I would have expected better. So my hotel which was quite remote and had nothing around it was mainly the first pick up point and last drop off which, with Dubai traffic, added an hour to each end of the tour each day.  I thought I was signing on for a group tour not a bunch of individual daily ones.  Having said this I still enjoyed most of the individual tours Grey line were very communicative via Whats App (SO make sure you have that before you go).  So tbh I am not sure if I am reviewing GVV or Grey Line here

Youcould walk but everything inPortugal is uphill.The hotel in Lisbon, the Lisbon Plaza, is an elegant comfortable hotel alsowith a great breakfast. This hotel in around the corner from Liberty Ave. their 5th Ave. It's about 4 long blocks south of Pombal Square where the Grayline tour buses start out. Their Metro, subway, is easy to use.Aireuropa is a disorganized airline. They can't figure out how to board people and takeout on time.I highly recommend the overall tour.

title: Awesome travel agency and outstanding…
text: Awesome travel agency and outstanding customer service. What I got for what I paid for is crazy; round trip tickets, hotels (one was upgraded to 5 star with no extra cost), and train tickets. The trip was legit worth more than the money spent. The only issue I had was one train ticket did not have seat reservations and we were forced out of our seats twice by passengers getting on later stops and the trains had no way to know what seats were reserved. If your trip has traveling via train, make sure to ask for specific seat reservations. I’ll be using Great Value Vacations again!

name: Joseph William Palombi
title: Disappointment in Paris
text: We arrived at our hotel in Paris.  We had two rooms booked.  One for my wife and I, and one for my daughter.  Both my wife and daughter have significant medical issues that could possibly require immediate care.When we arrived, the hotel informed us that they had a tech issue and were not able to issue us room keys.  They told us that it should be resolved in an hour and to go out to dinner and it would be fixed when we got back.  It was not fixed.  The worker told us that they would have to just escort us upstairs and into our room every time we needed to get into them.  Being that both my wife and daughter have the medical needs that they do, we ended up having to share a room.In the event that my daughter had a medical episode, I would have been notified by the program we have on our phone, but I would not be able to get into her room.  I would have had to run down 6 flights of stairs, get to the desk, then get them to get me back up to floor 6.  The same would have been the issue if my wife had a medical issue and we were not in the same room.On numerous occasions, there was a more than 15 minute wait in the lobby to get an employee to get us into our rooms.  This was unacceptable in the event of an emergency.  So we ended up having to share a room for more than 2 nights.  I attempted to contact great value vacations customer service as soon as I found out it was an issue.  They provided no assistance to us.We have traveled with this travel agency in the past and had great experiences.  This past experience and their lack of compassion and empathy is making me question on whether or not I should utilize them again.  We paid for two rooms for the trip, and was only able to use one of them for more than two nights.  We have not been provided any credit or refund despite not being able to use what we paid for, and not being provided any assistance during our travel.

name: Larry Allen Lain
title: Great Trip No problems, no stress

name: Mehrdad Hassani
title: Unforgettable Portugal Experience with Great Value Vacations!
text: The itinerary was well-planned! The accommodations were comfortable and conveniently located. One suggestion I have is to include transportation to and from the airport in the package. This added convenience would make the travel experience even more seamless and stress-free. Overall, I highly recommend Great Value Vacations for anyone looking to explore the beauty of Portugal!

name: Melissa W
title: This was a great deal…
text: This was a great deal (hotels/car/airfare) and they came through on everything.  We were happy campers!

name: J Bishop
title: Great vacation, provided you don't mind driving
text: This vacation was great for us, but I don't mind the driving.  For the itinerary we had, the minimum total distance you'll travel between hotels is approx 1200 KM (@ 750 miles).  For our trip, we toured heavily and put over 1400 miles on the car.  The scenery was spectacular, but the locals and pubs in each town are what made our trip so wonderful!  The hotels were good to great, with the exception of two.  More on that below.For the flights, make sure you have enough time in between for connections.  We were due to have a connection both ways through Heathrow, and there was less than 90 mins to go through customs and security, which is nowhere near enough time.  The gate agent actually changed our outgoing flight because of this.Last, I would say if you can get a driving package where you have at least 2 nights minimum at each stop, it would be better.  6 hotels in 8 nights is a LOT of packing and unpacking.  Plus you're driving to the hotel one day and leaving the next, so there is little if any time to enjoy the area.  Hotel reviews below:Hoban Hotel, Kilkenny - Good hotel, quiet, comfy beds.  Great location for shopping or getting to downtown.  Food at restaurant just ok.  Service is so so. 3 StarsRose Hotel, Tralee - BEAUTIFUL hotel, modern, cozy, comfortable beds, close to downtown.  Restaurant and bar are nice.  4.5 starsLady Gregory Hotel, Gort - Hotel is plagued with issues.  Lobby and restaurant are lovely.  Food is fine.  Room was on top floor, was old and outdated, and was VERY warm.  We could never get it cooled down.  Opened the window but with the security lights in the parking lot, it was far too bright to keep the drapes open.  Beds were so so.  Toilet wouldn't flush, shower basin drained slowly and teetered on overflowing.  Had to turn off several times during shower.  Would not return and in my opinion, this hotel should be removed entirely from the vacation packages. 1.5 StarsEllison Hotel, Castlebar, Co. Mayo - Really loved this hotel!  Excellent location for walking around, shopping, dining.  Right across the street from a Tesco.  Staff super friendly.  The area doesn't get many tourists, so there is an unfiltered experience of the area.  Wished we could've stayed a couple nights.  Room very comfortable, beds were nice.  Parking was in the adjacent garage, and the hotel validated so it was free. 4.5 starsRedcastle Hotel, Co. Donegal - This is an upscale hotel, nicely appointed.  Had a luxurious room, wonderful bathroom, comfortable bed.  The headboard of our bed was against the wall adjacent to the hallway outside.  It was a very thin wall and we could hear people walking.  Dining and drink were a premium price, but we found nearby Boathouse Restaurant and the town of Moville to be very welcoming.  4 StarsMaldron Hotel Newcross, Dublin - The hotel presents well enough.  There are a lot of traveling workers and what seems like short-term residents staying here.  They didn't bother us but there are what appear to be some somewhat sketchy people staying here.  There is an Aldi and gas station across the street, and a few restaurants in the area.  The Italian place is good.  The bed was ok, although it had a hell of a dip in it.  Backs up to the highway so if you plan to open the window, expect road noise.  Drinks at the hotel are slightly higher, but they are charging 23% VAT as well, which was the only place on our trip that did so.  The parking lot is gated, having to pull a ticket when entering.  The girl at the desk validated it when checking in but on checkout, I was told I owed 10 Euro for parking.  I disputed but ultimately had to pay.  For dining, I can understand.  But for patronizing the hotel, I think this is ridiculous.  It wasn't close to the airport either although having an early morning flight, it only took about 23 mins to get there by highway.  We didn't have any traffic.  During rush hour, this would be a 45 min drive. Would not return.  2 Stars

name: James David Mohr
title: We enjoyed our 8 days in Porto and…
text: We enjoyed our 8 days in Porto and Lisbon.  Although we joked about staying in an exotic Portuguese hotel named Holiday Inn Express we found both of our hotels to be top notch and the people at the desk very helpful.  We were also glad to have breakfast provided, even including the famous Pasteis de Nata.  This time we were also glad to just use train transportation instead of a car.  It worked out well.

Hop on Hop Off Bus was a perfect way to get the lay of the land and then stop and explore.  One issue with transport that customer service promptly took care of.  Would highly recommend GVV.

name: Kristen
title: Everything about our experience was…
text: Everything about our experience was perfect. I had no issues or complaints with any part of our reservation process. Everything was seamless. The communication was outstanding. I had to contact GVV once prior to my trip and they were easy to reach and able to help me promptly. Other than that, the entire trip was incredible. They organized everything is such a meticulous way. From the flights, to the hotel accommodations, to the hotel transfers, boat and horse transfers. Everything was incredible. I could not have asked for a better experience. For each part of the trip, I was contacted the night before with the appropriate contact #s for the individuals coordinating each piece of it. I always knew who to contact. I never felt stranded. They was easy to reach and on top of everything. Even in areas where I had no service or wifi, they were better than you can imagine with communication including their third party partners. We never had to wait or encounter issues. The hotel accommodations were excellent. Very comfortable and clean. Wonderful staff. I would give 10 stars and I would highly recommend.

name: Colleen
title: Poor airline reservations in Europe
text: We have traveled to Ireland twice and were pleased with their Great Value packages.However, we recently used Great Value to book a trip to London, Paris and Rome and we were frustrated with their airline reservations both over the ocean and within Europe along with the Eurostar reservation from London to Paris.  We selected seat upgrades to Priority Economy Plus, but we're not able to get seat assignments as American Airlines support told us "other travel agencies had holds on all the seats, so we needed to check for seats everyday as "some might  open up".  My wife checked everyday for available seats for weeks with no seats available. Finally, a couple weeks before traveling over we got two seats together, but not coming home.  My wife continued to call every day for two seats together from Rome home and finally in the last week before travel we had two seats together.With that said, our flight from Paris had transportation picking us up for our flight at 2 am as the flight was so early.  That meant that we would have to go to bed really early and miss a wonderful evening in Paris and also be tired for our first day in Rome.  Unfortunately, for us to change to a somewhat later flight that morning cost us an additional fees!  The terrible flight Great Value booked, cost us additional fees, plus time on the phone with them trying to get a reasonable time for a flight.  Same was true with the reservation that Great Value had us booked on the Eurostar.  We would have to miss our last night in London, so we had to pay MORE additional fees for a later departure from London to Paris.When we traveled to Ireland previously, the hotels booked by GV were exceptional, so we assumed the hotels on or recent trip booked by GV would be of similar quality and convenient location to the sights.  However, the hotels in London, Paris and Rome were not up to the caliber we experienced previously with GV bookings.  They were all quite small and very far from any of the sights, requiring costly taxi fare to and from the sights every day.We will think twice about booking with Great Value for any of our future trips that we are currently researching.

name: guest from USA
title: Italy on a buget
text: Our flight was on time and we had no issues from Chicago or back to Chicago .All our train tickets were running on time and did not have a problem. The luggage on the train was a bit tight. We had to lift the bags above our heads and not enough room. Some people had larger bags and they were sitting with them. I would suggest people bring medium size bags not large.  The other problem was there was no air conditioning in any of the hotels we stayed at, also no screens on windows, and no tissues in room. The rooms were clean and the people were friendly and helpful. The Rome hotel was B&B was out of the city and taxi's were expensive. I would have preferred to pay a little more and be closer to the public transportation. Venice Hotel was probably the easiest to navigate from Mestre to Venice. We had a wonderful time.  I will order euros from my bank for pocket money( the exchange charges were high.)

name: SusieO
title: Recommended to us by friends
text: Recommended to us by friends, we decided to take a chance on GVV. We chose the Lisbon City Stay, for 5 nights. While what we did in Lisbon was our responsibility, GVV made getting there and back pretty hassle-free. text: I was a globe trotter in the 1980s and 90s, but have only flown domestically since the 9/11 attack on NYC. I was never informed that passengers on international flights are expected 3 hours prior to take-off. I arrived at the time when the last passenger had just boarded the plane and a Philippine airlines woman told me that I could not board the plane as I was not at the check-in counter a full 3 hours prior to take-off. They had just loaded the person in front of me and I had only 1 medium size suitcase and 1 medium size carry-on bag. It would have taken them apx. 2 to 3 minutes to check my bags and have me board the plane, but one of the Philippine airlines personnel was playing the arrogant "I am powerful, I can prevent you from reaching your destination" game. She actually laughed at me as I begged her to allow me to board the plane as my fiancé would be expecting me to arrive at her destination so that we could get married. The PAL (Philippine Air Lines) agent was extremely abusive and disrespectful and just couldn't get enough joy from me losing my seat on that flight.I purchased my ticket through a travel agency, SkyLux, and now I have been told by numerous people that a traveler should never buy their tickets from travel agents or agencies as they have no power to correct any discrepancies. I did contact the SkyLux agent who sold me the ticket and he was outraged by what happened. He promised to get me satisfaction, but days later I don't even receive phone calls or emails from him indicating what the status of my complaint is. DO NOT PURCHASE YOUR TICKETS FROM TRAVEL AGENTS OR AGENCIES. If I had purchased directly from PAL, then I might have had redress, but now nothing. It was an expensive flight (more than $5,000 with long term parking, etc,) and now I am living in a motel in Seattle waiting for a response from the travel who guaranteed that he would get me satisfaction.Why would a company make their customers sit and wait for an extra hour at the airport before taking-off when those passengers will be forced to sit for many hours during a flight to the other side of the world? I have a very bad back with a medical history of 3 lumbar surgeries and even with those surgeries I cannot sit for more than an hour without experiencing severe low back pain and these uncaring clowns want me and other passengers with medical conditions to sit for longer periods which are unnecessary. And for clarification, my low back injuries occurred while fighting America's enemies while in the USA armed forces. The Philippines are dependent on the USA's military to keep China (and other countries) from over-running the Philippine government and making them part of China or Russia or whom ever conquers the Philippines without the USA to defend them.I will not only never fly PAL, but I will never use a travel agency again.

title: Being repeatedly harassed despite telling SkyLux I don’t wish to proceed
text: I checked out Trustpilot before requesting a quote from SkyLux - balance was overwhelmingly positive so figured I’d give them a try. I was requesting a multi city business class flight from the US to Australia/NZ. I was unable to complete the task on my laptop as New York was not available in the drop down for the return leg of the multi city route. I requested the quote on my phone. I was lured in with the promise of a really low fare which turned out not to be real. I then was sent offers for the wrong dates/wrong cities. I pointed out there were errors and provided SkyLux with a chance to provide an accurate quote. I am certain I entered the correct information but mistakes can happen in systems, maybe something autocorrected, who knows - not the end of the world. Mistakes continued. Additionally they didn’t offer a single fare that was any better that what I could find myself online. I wouldn’t be opposed to using an agent for the same fare I was finding online but I couldn’t trust someone who made so many errors with the booking of a flight costing $7k - $10k+. I advised I wished to be removed from their database and would not be proceeding.I am continuing to be harassed by phone and email by SkyLux agents despite repeatedly telling them to leave me alone and not contact me again. Bonus: the quotes they’re currently sending are for economy which was never part of my considerations, I was only interested in business class.I can’t speak to how good they are if you go forward with them but a business that harasses potential customers with emails and phone calls despite being consistently told the customer does not wish to engage their services is not one I can recommend. After a quick glance at my emails, I’ve been contacted by 7 different agents by email (Albert V, Billy N, Stella, Carol G, Barbie A, Freya A, Salvador) with 2 emails just this morning (April 5). I first told SkyLux I didn’t want to proceed on March 20th.  Provide your contact info to this business at your own risk.Edit 21-April: The SkyLux team reached out to assure me my information would be removed. I’ve still been receiving a lot of contacts, mainly email but also phone (most recent 19-April from Estelle B, on 12-April I received 8 emails in one day from Albert V). Appreciate SkyLux reaching out and trying to resolve but still appalled at how they conduct their business as this should have been simple.

title: Really enjoyed getting to bypass the…
text: Really enjoyed getting to bypass the lines in most places. Taking the Riverboat Cruise in Paris was amazing. Tour guides were very knowledgeable and did their best to keep us informed.Breakfast and dinner was less than ideal most of the time. Wish their was items we could choose from. Since we are paying for these meals in the cost of the trip it was really disappointing to not have good meals. Or what seemed to be the cheapest meals there were. On top of this there was no real time on lunch to really go explore food options. Having this be my first trip to Europe I was really disappointed in 90% of the food. Most of the time we were stuck in areas that were not air conditioned and very warm. Also, we were only allowed water unless we wanted to pay extra. Again since food is paid for in the cost of the trip we should have been allowed a drink of our choice.Also, I wasn't very happy with the hotel choices with the exception of the hotel in Paris. There was no air conditioning allowed in the hotels making for an uncomfortable sleeping arrangements.There wasn't enough time to truly have some free time to explore or just take in what we were seeing. Everything was rushed. Including walking. The pace should be slower so people don't feel like they are running a race. I expected there to be a lot of walking but what I didn't expect was to have to walk 10 minutes or more to get back to the buses. I don't understand why they could drop us off close to our venue but not pick us up close to our venue.Overall, it was a great trip. Got to see and do a lot but just not enough time to explore and see a bit of the culture and shop. There should be 2 1/2 hours at lunch to get to eat somewhere good and explore. An hour and a half isn't long enough.I really did enjoy our tour guides Charles and Mike by the end of the trip it felt like one big family!Thank you.

name: Jennifer Shinn
title: Thoughtfully Planned, Student-Centered Travel Experiences That Inspire
text: Traveling with EF Tours has been a truly rewarding experience for both my students and myself as a Group Leader. What stands out most is the level of organization, care, and thoughtful planning that goes into every part of the trip — from the pre-departure support to the on-the-ground experience. EF makes what could be an overwhelming process feel manageable and even fun, especially for busy educators like me.The professionalism and knowledge of our Tour Director and local guides brought the destinations to life in ways that went far beyond what students would experience as ordinary tourists. I also appreciated the variety in the itinerary — major cities, charming small towns, and incredible optional excursions that added unforgettable moments to our trip, like dining in the Tuscan countryside and visiting one of Italy’s oldest hilltop towns.EF also excels in their support behind the scenes. My Experience Specialist, Johanna, did a great job at keeping me organized, answering my many questions, and even going out of her way to help us add an extra chaperone last minute. That kind of service makes a huge difference for educators juggling a lot of responsibilities.If I had one piece of constructive feedback, it would be to continue finding ways to support first-time Group Leaders with clearer expectations during fast-paced moments on tour — but overall, EF has built an impressive system that balances structure with flexibility, and I’m so grateful for the experience.We’ve already sold out our next tour to Greece for 2026 and are excited to plan for 2027.
