name: Penny
title: Horrible then great experiences.
text: My 2nd and 3rd experiences were wonderful but my first experience cost me $6,500. in repairs and replacements . The couple broke one of two gas fire places which cost $400 to repair; used $500 in gas for the 3 weeks they were at my place- this was in addition to using the electric furnace; permanently “ borrowed” an electric alarm clock and a paring knife; and also “borrowed “ my sterling silver which had 14 place settings ( $400 x 14 =$6000.) and 6 serving pieces worth $600. They said they would replace the missing items- which they never did. I thought perhaps my memory tricked me and I didn’t hide the sterling silver where I thought I did, but hours of searching have not located the missing sterling silver pieces.I tried to contact Trusted Housesitters but they didn’t reply. My homeowners insurance only covers  stolen items if I can prove there was a break in. So far, the first house sit cost me over $7,000.00.My next 2 experiences were wonderful.

name: Maureen
title: I’ve been using TrustedHousesitters for…
text: I’ve been using TrustedHousesitters for 3 years and have found it to be generally a great experience.The sitters all seem terrific and have looked after our pets well. The house has also been kept in immaculate condition.The app is generally very good and intuitive to use. One issue I had was when I had to cancel a sit at the last minute, due to a cyclone. I communicated directly with the sitter and apologised for the late cancellation (which they understood given we were on watch to evacuate). So we were all good but I couldn’t cancel the sit in the app. I lodged a support request and didn’t hear back. Unfortunately, as I’d cancelled the sitter, other people kept trying to request to sit. I had to go back to each person and explain what was going on. Adding stress to an already stressful situation wasn’t ideal. The app eventually deleted the sit. So, great service and great app but some feedback in urgent situations would make it even better.

name: Mel
title: Reliable and Trustworthy Sitters

title: TrustedHousesitters will change your life!
text: This was our first experience with TrustedHousesitters. It was perfect. We got five people interested in sitting for us within an hour of posting our listing. name: Isa
title: Be Weary
text: I found out after giving a 5-star review to my housesitters that my dog had consumed an entire bag of pears without me being notified. He could have died or been hospitalized and I found out in their review for me. Being understandably upset, I reached out to the support team and was told that this did not violate any of the policies set forth by the company. I am so upset that these sitters can continue sitting with zero reprimand or notification to future owners that they are a health and safety risk to the platform. Be aware that your sitters can have five-star reviews coinciding with shady history NOT shared by the company.

name: Claudio Raiola
title: TrustedHouseSitters the "Trusted Petsit Solution"
text: I have been using platform since May 2022. I have over 50 Pet Sit across EUROPE and Australia spanning from two nights to 90 days.The platform is a fantastic way for those who are wanting to live the Pet Sit lifestyle whether it be a occasionally semi regularly or some on a full-time basis.It is the best to travel and live like a local whilst having a pleasure of booking after a range of Domestic and leave it on some instances rural animals.The platform is secure and the information is verified reliable as are the reviews submitted by both Pet Sit and Pet owner which is the basis of assessment for future Pet Sit and Pet Sitters when choosing the next member.There are other performances that exist especially in the form of Facebook groups which I highly discourage anyone to use because none of Facebook groups have the due diligence of both Petsit and Pet as part of the application process along with the secure reviews of both parties and the background system and trust them to support.Anyone who considers to select a pet sitter to come into their private world of their private home whilst they leave their home and their beloved animal of a random unidentifiable unverifiable person who chooses to create their own Facebook profile is a kin to walking out to your footpath waiting for the first person to walk past walking a dog and handing them your house keys as you head off on your travel journey.THS is the only platform I will use and the only one I will recommend.

name: Geoffrey

name: Lauri

name: Suzanne

It's a great service for the home-owners / cat-parents, knowing that their cat isn't getting stressed in a kennel-type environment.I'm seeing some places I've never been to and I love being a temporary cat-parent: the only hard part so far is leaving!The sits have given me a couple of months of breathing space while I keep an eye on the housing market locally, so it's a great win-win.

title: Great Platform for People Looking for Pet/House Sitters
text: We've had an awesome experience with Trusted Housesitters - we have had three different sits in our house over two years and each has been awesome. Each sitter was highly professional, thoughtful, loving, engaged, took great care of our house (and we took great care of them as well). We were highy skeptical coming in but the platform was highly recommended by two senior business executive colleagues to we gave it a try. Could be where we live or the time of year but for each sit, we had so many people apply for the sit; we interviewed 5-10 for each and would have been happy with any of 5 different people for each sit - so as someone looking for a sitter, great options of great people. We chose a premium membership (with background check and bonding) and we only interviewed people who had been background checked to take out any risk there. The platform takes time to set up the first time - but it's HIGHLY worthwhile to do it correctly and to be thorough - giving FULL information to potential sitters makes a huge difference in their ability to be prepared and in their self selection - last thing you want is someone who ends up being a bad fit last minute. Took us a dozen interviews the first time and a couple of sits to figure out the characteristics we were looking for that made for a successful sit in our case and we got a whole lot better at screening for them but the beauty of the platform, at least for us, is there were so many applicants we could always find what we were looking for. The platform has virtually all the information we could want and that we would want have applicants to have while we are away. We have our own set of info that seems to be a little less "word" and to the point than the basic Welcome Guide but we've learned to make both work well together. All in all, we've had a great experience and look forward to using them again soon.

I love that no money is exchanged between parties, but all parties need to pay a subscription and have relevant background checks to participate. We’ve used this service three times in the last 12 months and couldn’t recommend it enough!

name: Mike f
title: Trustedhouseitters could do more
text: Trustedhousesitters could do more to be honest.Our first sit was a place with single pane windows, with holes in the frames, and, a wasp issue.Granted, it's not their issue, however they should be making checks (perhaps even requested a video walkthrough) of a house.There were no blinds or curtains in any of the bathrooms at all, this caused anxiety.Trusted housesitters left it up to me to sort out, instead of taking the reigns, only offering to let them know if we don't want to sit there, so they could arrange an alternative one.We also have a family member in hospital, however all trusted housesitters did was say we have an obligation to do an agreed sit.It seems that the mid tier membership, doesn't really do anything in terms of support, which is a great shame.We also had a cat that literally took chunks out of us biting, and, scratching. AGAIN, although there was a first aid kit listed in the welcome pack, there was none there... Only a box with some plasters in it.I really feel that more thorough checks are needed, not to mention cover for petsitters (who seem to be an expendable asset), because the only medical cover that exists, is for pets, and, the property petsitters stay in, NOT fire the petsitters.This really needs to change.

name: Jerry
title: Delighted First Trusted Housesitters Experience
text: We just completed our first experience having a dog sitter, and we were glad that it was through Trusted Housesitters. The annual fee was reasonable, especially when you consider how expensive it is to hire a dog sitter for two weeks. The website and app were extremely easy to use. Listing your pet-sitting opportunity reminded me of listing a house - with taking photos of your (cleaned and decluttered) home and describing your pet. And once you receive responses from potential sitters, it was very helpful to be able to read their past reviews before making a selection. It was nice to know that they had all been background checked. The app allows you to communicate with your sitters before and during the stay. All in all, we were very pleased with our experience with Trusted Housesitters!

name: Laura
title: A very successful first experience.
text: This was my first time using Trusted Housesitters as our usual sitters were not available. I found the process very easy & straightforward & I liked how it all worked. We found a lovely sitter & have had a very successful first sit & experience for our sassy cat, Sasha. I’d definitely return if I needed another sit.

name: Starlight Farm
title: what a relief!!
text: We have to travel with our work and living in Switzerland with 4 dogs the thought of having to put them in kennels seems both financially impossible and unkind. We have also relied on friends to come and housesit but this isnt always practical. We stumbled upon trustedhousesitters and havent looked back. Our first sitter was for 3 weeks and she did a lovely job and very reassuring process throughout with the platform.

name: Patricia Rifat
title: We’ve used this service multiple times…
text: We’ve used this service multiple times in the past 2 years, and it has been truly life changing and allowed us to really enjoy our time away. All our sitters were truly amazing, reliable and would not mind having again. The pet care (2 dogs and a seahorse aquarium) has been superb, home minding was exceptional. Highly recommended this organisation.

name: Consumer
title: Great app great website
text: Great app great website, amazing concept. Had amazing experiences with both hosts and pets :))

name: Carrie
title: A Resounding Win for Pet Lovers and Travelers Alike
text: Joining Trusted Housesitters in late 2022 was one of the best decisions we’ve made. At the time, we were searching for dedicated sitters to care for our two senior dogs while we went on two pet-free trips. Thanks to the platform, we connected with exceptional sitters who provided attentive care for our beloved dogs and meticulous oversight of our home.When the time came to renew our membership, life had changed—both of our senior dogs had sadly passed. While we deeply missed the companionship of pets, we weren’t ready to adopt again. Instead, we decided to "flip" our membership, stepping into the role of sitters. Since then, there has been no turning back.Being Trusted Housesitters has been an incredible adventure. Not only do we have the privilege of showering love and care on others’ pets, but we also get to explore amazing locations. To date, we’ve completed 12 housesits and have 7 more lined up this year, including two international sits. Along the way, we’ve added some unique experiences to our repertoire—caring for raccoons, desert tortoises, goats, and koi fish.For anyone who enjoys traveling, Trusted Housesitters is a resounding win. It’s a truly enriching way to connect, care, and explore.

name: Jackie Baker
title: Excellent, our 2nd time
text: This is the 2nd time we have used Trusted House Sitters for our furries.  I can highly recommend them.

name: Polly A
title: Peace of Mind
text: It is always stressful to seek out strangers to watch fur babies and your home. Goes against every "stranger danger" rule we grew up with!!We love the fact that everyone on THS is background checked and we can interview people via zoom to find the best fit.  We have loved every one of our sitters. More importantly, so has our dog.Our level of membership (which covers kennel fees if a sitter cancels) gives peace of mind too. We also love the fact that our fur baby stays at home in a routine he knows.

name: jacquie heathcote
title: Lucky us ! Another lovely sitter!
text: Another excellent sitter experience which is a great relief. To know that your home and pet are safe in the hands of an honest and competent person makes it so much easier to go away. We are feeling very confident about TH and will continue to use the service and tell all our friends about it. One comment I would make is that it is not easy to tell TH that you have been recommended by a friend when you apply. I did get retrospective  recognition when my daughter joined up for this latest holiday...thank you! However another friend recently joined on my express recommendation and she said there was no way to get this recorded when she applied....Maybe this could be looked at?

name: Sara
title: Game changing pet care
text: We've had a couple of really excellent pet/ house sitters, thanks to Trusted Housesitters. There's no way we would go back to boarding our dog now. This way is great for us, and hopefully for the sitters too! It is so reassuring to know that not only are the pets well cared for, fed, walked...but also that someone is in the house while we're away. We won't hesitate to use this service in the future and recommend it to others.

name: Heather Stewart
title: Reassurance with one's choice
text: I have found that everyone we have has pet sit for us have gone above and beyond expectations. It's been so reassuring that the people coming into one's home are trustworthy and kind.

name: Tina
title: Happy Travelers!
text: This app makes it so easy to find sitters. I love that you interview prior to the sit and that some sitters are willing to come a day early to acclimate the transition, not only for them, but also for the pets. The guides that you fill out fir the site are thorough and helpful to the sitters. This was our first time using this app, but I will definitely be using it in future travels.

name: Joni
title: Trusted Housesitters has been a life changer for us!
text: Trusted Housesitters has been a life changing experience for us!  We're both retired and our pooch is the center of our lives.  Paying a pet sitter has been SO expensive and prohibitive for us to travel for more than a few days at a time.  Friends of ours used THI a few times and told us of their incredibly positive experiences.  We decided to give it a try, first time for 5 days then we took another 3 week trip.  Both sitters were amazing!!   What a wonderful concept!

name: Leore Ben-Chorin
title: Life Changing Company
text: I have been using THS for almost a year and it has completely changed my life. I am now a global pet sitter for a very low yearly fee. Travelling in hotels and Airbnbs is a thing of the past now! I highly recommend this app for entrepreneurial, easy-going, pet-loving individuals!

name: Emma Sparkles
title: I got 1 great weekend sit and plenty of sitter ghosting for £190!
text: One star for the very lovely pair that came to sit my dogs.NO STARS for the set up. The sitters are not to be trusted, they are only vetted by previous clients. They are soooo unreliable. It is a big deal to leave your home and pets with strangers. Even if you've managed to chat with them first. I was naiive to think this would work and paid alot of money for the privilege!This site is definitely aimed at the sitters getting a free holiday in your much loved home.If you sign up and question ANYTHING, take up the 14 day money back guarantee.

name: Trish
title: I have now used Trusted House sitters…
text: I have now used Trusted House sitters twice and both times been so impressed at how seamless the experience is. The benefit of having a company in place  as back up for both hosts and sitters is fantastic. Reviewing also keeps everyone on their toes and makes sure everyone is doing what is required. It is very hard to choose the sitter as they are all so qualified and fantastic so it can be quite a process. The quality of this site and app is also very easy to navigate, and I am not particularly technologically minded so the benchmark is quite low. Its easy and efficient as well as logical with great updates and notifications as you go.

name: Lisa Barrell
title: TrustedHousesitters is a genius service and wonderful asset to any pet owner.
text: I joined Trusted Housesitters fairly recently with a view to having a sitter for a two weeks over Easter.The process of registration and creating a profile were very thorough but easy to do and within minutes of my sit going live, I had 5 offers from sitters.Going through the profiles was easy as was the selection of a sitter, who has just completed the sit this week.Normally I would not be comfortable with having a stranger in my home for so long especially with a very young kitten, but the sitter had wonderful reviews and a strong profile so I felt perfectly comfortable about using her. The opportunity to interview prospective sitters before selecting was appreciated though in the end, we went with the first sitter to respond.As the first sit went very well, I am very happy with the whole process and think TrustedHousesitters is a genius service and wonderful asset to any pet owner.I would highly recommend TrustedHousesitters to anyone considering it.

name: Frances Hopcraft
title: We just completed our first house sit…
text: We just completed our first house sit in the stunning region of Umbria in Italy looking after a big sweet dog and 2 kittens. We had a pool and sauna and stunning views of medieval hilltop villages. Our hosts were easy to communicate with while they were away to make sure we the dogs needs were met. Excellent experience

name: JoAnne Brooks
title: This website works!
text: This website works!I did a house/pet sit in the village my great grandparents were married in 1853!!All possible because of the website.It all worked beautifully and I am thankful to have joined.Sign up today for your adventure!!

name: Christina Cino
title: First international sit completed!
text: I’ve been a member of TrustedHousesitters for over two years and truly love the concept behind this service. It’s an amazing platform that creates mutually beneficial opportunities for pet lovers and homeowners alike. I’ve promoted it widely to friends and family because I believe in what it offers.That said, it’s been a bit of a challenge for someone like me, who doesn’t have a completely flexible schedule. Coordinating dates, travel, and logistics for sits—especially internationally—takes time and careful planning. I’ve found that many homeowners are hesitant to accept applications from sitters who aren’t local, which makes it difficult to book sits outside of my region. While I’ve applied to several international sits, I’ve received only a few responses and just one acceptance.That one acceptance, however, was a wonderful experience. I was thrilled to finally complete an international sit in the UK this year. The homeowner took a chance on me despite not being able to meet in person beforehand, and everything went beautifully.So while I still love TrustedHousesitters and appreciate what it offers, I haven’t been able to benefit from it as often as I’d hoped, which sometimes makes me question whether I should continue the membership. Still, I remain hopeful that with time and persistence, more doors will open.

name: Lilian Maclennan
title: Our home and pets were host to really…
text: Our home and pets were host to really wonderful first time sitters. They really did their homework and made sure our pets were looked after  in the best way. We got regular updates and pictures and arrived home to a warm welcome and happy pets.It is such a comfort to know that everything is left in such responsible and capable caring hands. Trusted Housesitters are the perfect solution for us.

name: Virginia Sainz-Rasines
title: A perfect experience – highly recommended
text: For me, this kind of arrangement is ideal. It allows me to enjoy super comfortable accommodation with everything I need, plus the company of pets – which are essential in my life. Taking care of them adds a special meaning to my journey and makes it so much warmer and more fulfilling.On a practical level, the value is amazing. What you’d normally spend on just a couple of nights in a hotel can give you a whole year of accommodation in places you dream of visiting. I highly recommend it – it’s a beautiful, affordable, and enriching way to travel.

name: customer
title: Not So Trusted Housesitters
text: Trusted Housesitters has been quite a disappointing experience. As a first time member, I naturally found myself in uncharted waters. I needed guidance, but most importantly I needed someone to talk to. There has been no one. For all their advertising and accreditation, I have found them quite lacking. I cannot believe that a global entity with such reach, their customer service is non existent, their app is really confusing and hard to navigate with a lot of duplication of questions you are expected to answer. Their bot is only programmed to answer scripted questions which makes the experience of finding a suitable sitter very stressful, especially when you have already booked your holiday with the expectation that finding a sitter will be a mere formality. Not so in my experience. My suggestion would be a very thorough upgrade of the app and a customer service centre with a live phone number manned by humans. As things stand, I would very much shy away from recommending them as a rock solid service and I am rethinking my renewal with them.

name: Customer
title: Love being a sitter 💕
text: I’ve been using TrustedHousesitters as a sitter for a year and a half now, and I’ve had nothing but good experiences with them. The app is super easy to use, and all the people and animals I’ve met through sitting have been fantastic. I’ve never had a negative experience with any pets or home owners, so can’t speak to that!

name: Morgan Leigh
title: I've been using the app for a year now…

I've had nothing but positive experiences using the app and have met some amazing and lovely people along the way! I'd highly recommend it for anyone who likes to travel but is holding back due to being a pet owner!

name: Laura Reilly
title: A great way to travel and see new places
text: I have been housesitting on Trusted Housesitters for almost two years now and it's been a great experience. I've been able to travel around my home country and internationally and stay in beautiful homes. I've met some lovely families and pets and can't recommend it enough!

name: Pat Pratley
title: Great Experience Wlused three pet/house sitters…
text: We have used three pet/house sitters and have been delighted with each of these experiences. The notion of letting strangers into our home would normally be anathema. However we have felt really comfortable with Trusted Housesitters guarantee. Nice people, interesting stories. And each time we have found our sitters to be delightful and we have loved their reason for taking on the challenge/ potential disappointment of an unknown destination.Thank you House sitters for enabling this mutually beneficial arrangement.

name: Kappa
title: Sadly I am leaving this community after…
text: Sadly I am leaving this community after seven years due to the following reasons :1: it's a constant hit and miss (our last sitters from Barcelona Judith and Marc were a tragic miss)2: membership fees have skyrocketed3: there is no real benefit to being a long time member as customer service does not differentiate between active members and newbies4: the general quality of the sitters is very random - - few  actually care to petsit. Many are just looking for free lodging.5: the good ol' days when it was a positive and supportive tight knit community are over. 👋 (I used to give 5 stars! See my first review)Glad to have stayed in touch with the best, only two, but definitely top notch.Note : the Barcelona sitters were the last straw for us as it seems harder than ever to discern between those who are honest petsitters and those who will tell you what you want to hear just so they can use your house to set up a travel office.  They manipulate to get the sit and then accuse you of mistreating them when you call them on their game. These people should not be petsitters!Time to check out their competitors!

name: Vin
title: A reliable place to find a pet sitter
text: Trusted House Sitters is a reliable site and we have been happy with all our sitters. Not only do they take care of the background checks and vet their applicants, the site is easy to navigate and communication between sitters and hosts is clear and straightforward. They offer a valuable place to find reliable caregivers for our most beloved family members.

name: Toni Turiak Nance
title: Quality pet care in your own home!
text: When I first heard about Trusted Housesitters, my initial thought was it sounded too good to be true. I was somewhat apprehensive about having someone I did not know in my home taking care of my four-legged family member. However, any doubts I had initially have totally been expelled! Our first sit, for a seven-night stay, has taken place and it could not have been a better experience for us and our pet! Our sitter was dependable, took great care of our dog, and left my house spotless.

name: Don
title: Highly recommended!
text: Trusted House Sitters was easy to set up, easy to use and gave us a number of great candidates for our first sit.  The couple we chose were excellent.  I highly recommend the site to everyone looking for great house sitting while away.

name: Alan Zube
title: THS has made retirement fun!
text: We have taking advantage of THS to travel around the UK and USA. The process is simple. Well worth the money you save in lodging, but the biggest perk for us is being around and caring for the pets. Being retired, we want to travel as much as possible, so having our own pet would be logistically difficult. With THS we can travel and grandparent pets all over the world.

name: Elizabeth
title: We have had lovely sitters who have…
text: We have had lovely sitters who have kept in touch with us  letting us know how our pet was whilst we were away which is so reassuring. Came back to a happy pet and clean house. we would not go away without a sitter as our pet is old so it gives us freedom.

You must need to book months in advance for any summer sits because there are 1 or 0 in all of the countries I've looked at in Europe and Latin America, and it's just April now. I won't get into some of the problems or expectations of homeowners and their pets (some are fantastic, but many make you wonder why they don't seek out a professional service). Please read the Reddit thread for this website before buying and you might change your mind.

name: Elizabeth

name: Kiwis Fly the Coop NZ
title: THS website and App is the best tool for house sitting
text: We have been with THS for quite a few years and have used them for our HS all around the world.  I love the prompts that come through, which reminds me to request info, check the dates, and write reviews.  This also prompts the pet owners to do the same.  Communication is key, and we find that all the tools THS have in place assists with this.

name: André Thérien
title: Cleanliness of the place

name: Lenore McDonald Gunst
title: So far so good!
text: So far so good!  We have had very satisfactory experience with Trusted Housesitters and frequently recommend the service to family, friends and acquaintances we make while we travel.  We travel for 3-4 weeks at a time, 2-3 times a year.  Trusted Housesitters have been reliable, friendly and loving with our dogs, and also are interesting people!  It took an effort to initially list our home and write up our pet info. Our sitters love the detailed instructions, photos and info about everything from appliances to local restaurants in our house manual.  Our friends are surprised that no money is exchanged. That's where the "Trusted" comes in - the network provides members a means to confidently find a match for a mutual interest and need, and it works beautifully.  Sure, some sitters outshine others; but overall everyone we've selected has met our expectations and fulfilled their responsibilities responsibly and enthusiastically.  We are fans since joining in 2022.

name: Dorinda Lugo
title: Such a horrible experience
text: Such a horrible experience. Kay, my sitter, never read my welcome guide as evidenced by the fact that she never followed any of my instructions, she smoked marijuana inside and outside of my house, she never changed the litter box, she parked in the driveway when I told her not to, etc. But worse of all, two days into my international trip, she purposely let my cat outside stating to a neighbor that one of my cats was “not happy and so she let it out side” even after I told her several times different ways that both my cats were indoor cats only. (if my cat was not happy it was because I was not home and Kay was there as I’m sure my cat did not like K because she had bad vibes. So much for her supposedly good reviews as I’m sure they were all lies.) My cat has not returned, and I am absolutely livid.To add more fuel to the fire Trustedhousesitters has not taken any responsibility whatsoever in getting her off the roster or firing her. They didn’t want to do anything because I canceled the contract since I wanted her out of my house within the first week of the two weeks I was out of town after she let my cat escape.What company would keep an employee on when they have violated specific instructions from the homeowner, lost an animal that the sitter was supposed to be responsible for and continue to keep the employee on to risk another horrible situation for another homeowner? If I could provide less than one star, I would because this is a horrible company, and Kay was a horrible sitter as well as a horrible person as she never even apologized nor took responsibility for her actions or lack of. Never again. I hope you all get what you deserve. Trustedhousesitters is not to be trusted as they don’t vet their own sitters.

name: Dean

name: Thayana Cabral

name: Rachel
title: Amazing experiences with trustedhousesitters

title: Finally Standing in My Power After a Decade with Trusted Housesitters
text: I’ve been with Trusted Housesitters for over a decade, completing 20 sits across multiple countries since 2014. My experiences were even featured in the Daily Mail, so I feel confident sharing this: it’s time for a reality check on how the platform values its sitters.We pay a membership fee to offer unpaid labour. That alone raises ethical questions. Many of us aren’t on extended holidays - we’re caring for animals with complex needs, often in unfamiliar environments, having paid for our own travel. The assumption that we’re just “lucky” to stay in someone’s home misses the mark. When the experience involves aggressive dogs, feral cats, filthy homes, or restrictions like not being able to leave the dog alone for more than an hour a day, it’s not a holiday. It’s work - and often, emotionally and physically draining work at that.I’ve been misled or placed in difficult situations more times than I can count:•	Owners downplaying or hiding serious behavioural issues (e.g., aggression toward other dogs, misbehaviour on the lead, refusal to listen).•	Being in a state of hypervigilance on walks for up to two weeks due to aggressive pets.•	One owner not disclosing that their dog was partially paralysed, meaning I could only walk him for 20 minutes instead of the promised two hours.•	Cleaning up regular bowel accidents and being expected to bathe and groom the dog each time - none of which was mentioned beforehand.•	Being placed in filthy homes with poor hygiene standards.•	Living with practically feral cats who would jump in my face and in the food while I ate, literally being allowed to put their paws in the food by the owners.•	Being expected to sleep on an uncomfortable couch rather than a proper bed.•	Restrictions like not leaving the pet alone for more than one hour a day, making it impossible to enjoy the location or rest.Many sitters still tolerate this dynamic because of the allure of travel. But after 10 years of doing this properly - multiple walks, stimulation, affection, outings, and responsibility - I’ve come to a clear conclusion: sitters should be paid.There may be students or retirees happy to do it for free. But quality, experienced, reliable pet care should not come without compensation. We offer enormous value, and it’s time Trusted Housesitters acknowledges that - not just with a badge or a review, but with fair treatment, transparency, and ideally, payment options.This review isn’t bitter - it’s empowered. I now stand in my worth, and I hope other sitters do, too.

title: TrustedHousesitters: A "Tamper-Proof" Policy That Only Applies When Convenient
text: Thinking about joining TrustedHousesitters? Be warned. It’s a case of enforcing platform rules, which they are refusing to do. Instead of handling this properly, they are pretending the issue doesn’t exist.A Company That Never Admits Its MistakesThe truth is, they prioritize their image over fairness.They refuse to correct injustices and, worst of all, they provide no legal alternatives or formal complaint mechanisms.Warning to Future MembersIf you ever receive a false or unfair review that violates TrustedHousesitters' policies, DO NOT expect help.The company will not review your case fairly, will ignore you, and will hide behind meaningless excuses to avoid taking action.If this is how they treat their paying members, what does that say about their true priorities?Think twice before trusting this platform.

name: Kristine Malnaca
title: Here's a review based on our feedback
text: Here's a review based on our feedback**TrustedHousesitters: A Lifeline for Pet Owners, But With Caveats**TrustedHousesitters has been a fantastic resource for finding affordable and caring pet sitters in Dublin. The platform's premise of connecting pet owners with individuals willing to exchange house-sitting for accommodation is brilliant, especially in a city with notoriously high hotel prices.  We've had some truly excellent experiences with responsible sitters who prioritized our pets' well-being above all else.  The peace of mind knowing our furry friends are in good hands while we're away is invaluable.However, there's a growing trend that needs addressing.  We've encountered a few sitters who seem more interested in a cheap overnight stay in a comfortable home than genuine pet care.  Requests for favors unrelated to pet or house sitting, and an overall lack of focus on our animals, have left us feeling uneasy. While the platform offers a cost-effective alternative to traditional pet care, it's crucial to remember the primary focus should be on the animals and the home, not a budget-friendly vacation.Despite these occasional hiccups, the platform's price point and the availability of genuinely caring sitters make it a worthwhile option for pet owners.  It's essential to thoroughly vet potential sitters, communicate expectations clearly, and prioritize those who demonstrate a genuine love for animals.  With careful selection, TrustedHousesitters can be a fantastic way to ensure your pets are happy and well-cared for while you're away.

name: Leah Rempel
title: It Doesn't Get Better Than This!
text: Trustedhousesitters is such a stand-up organization. Now that we are not only house sitters, but have also joined the ranks of allowing our precious doggie to be taken care of, we are more in love with Trusted Housesitters than ever! Every experience, including customer service, has been stellar. We will be subscribers for life! What a great way to be able to take a vacation!

name: GaleL
title: Total lack of effective customer support
text: We have had many happy and successful sits from Trusted house sitters.  However, I am having serious issues with them, because I wrote to them with a really difficult problem. They have not responded in any helpful way, only an update for my request. I have real issues with companies that do not have a telephone contact and were this a company I was buying  product from I would not buy anything because of the inability to contact customer services in case of a difficulty. I also find their website dreadful and so unuser friendly. The app is better but not brilliant. Come on THS and get a proper customer support system where we can talk to someone.

name: Sitter
title: A Mutually Beneficial Exchange
text: THS is a great way to connect with people for a mutually beneficial trade. Sitters take care of pets and stay in places that might not have been on their radar. Owners save so much hosting a sitter. Using it for travel is great, but it's also fun to sit in your local area as a staycation.

name: Charlie Ryrie
title: Absolutely brilliant organisation
text: Absolutely brilliant organisation, so good to have something based on trust that works so well. My sitters could not have been better, it was a fantastic experience and it was easy to organise through Trusted Housesitters.

name: Lowell Kim
title: No brainer subscription renewal
text: My subscription renewal coming up next month is a no brain-er -- I love this service.  I've had 7 sits from 6 different sitters over the past 11 months, and they've all gone better than I could have expected.  I was definitely nervous (having a stranger stay in my home and one of my cats really feared humans) the first time I used it, but reading through the reviews of potential sitters eased my concerns and everything has gone great!  I've "met" some really nice people, and I think having different cat-caring people stay with my cats has really helped my scared-y cat get more comfortable with people.All the sitters I've had have communicated well and have taken good care of my home and kitties.  In a couple cases I worried my cats may like the sitter better than me!o)I haven't had a need to interact with the company at all, but the way the website and app prepare you for the sits is excellent: enough guidance but not too much.  I have experienced a little frustration with the messaging portion of the app (I kept losing long messages before I sent them), but I just agree with my sitter to communicate via regular text messages or WhatsApp, and all has been great.I don't recommend many services to my friends, but I have recommended THS to many of them.

name: ABR
title: Beware
text: Beware - they will make you jump through hoop after hoop, having to go back and take more and more photos of your house before they are satisfied.My husband and I both work long hours and have small children. Having to tidy the house just to take more and more photos has been time consuming and incredibly frustrating as a set of almost identical shots are on Rightmove - but I'm not allowed to use them.I have an awful feeling we'll end up getting no interest and then I'll have wasted hours of my time doing this.

name: Janet Wilkinson
title: So impressed!
text: I’m so impressed with the Trusted House Sitters App, it’s so easy to use & so much helpful information & tips to really make it simple.We really love to travel & explore new places & we have a great love for pets, so this has been such a great experience for us.

name: Danielle Longano
title: The ease and amount of information was…
text: The ease and amount of information was so helpful.  Staying and caring for someone's home and pets was intimate and TrustedHousesitters made it so simple and fun.

name: Becky
title: Amazing way to travel, meet new animals and of course people!
text: I am absolutely loving this community/ app so far! I love to travel, and I adore animals - so this is the perfect mix for me to allow me to do so. It is a brilliant idea and I have been telling all my friends about it. Such a wholesome community and app. Well done xxx I will continue using this long into the future all over the world <3

name: Corinne Titus
title: This site was beyond my expectations
text: This site was beyond my expectations!  My sitter was incredible and took exceptional care of my home and pet family.  This was my first time using the site and they were very helpful and help me organize my first sitter.  Looking forward to my next stress free trip!

name: Carol
title: Very impressed
text: I've had some really lovely sitters over the past nearly 3 years. The last housesitter has been twice, and it's wonderful to be totally relaxed about leaving my dogs with her.TH has  been much more useful than I'd dared hope, and I have recommended it to several of my friends.

name: Joy Motl
title: Excellent sitter
text: I am just ecstatic with the quality of sitters I have had. We have had at least 10 in the past year and a half and I cannot believe how one surpasses the other. They’ve all been so good. I am pleased with Trusted HouseSitters.I will be traveling several more times this year and I’ve already secured my sits. So grateful!!

name: Rebecca
title: Love this app!
text: I love this app and think it is such a great concept! I have a daft dog who is chilled in his own home but not great in kennels. We have used TrustedHousesitter on many occasions and always found lovely sitters who have taken excellent care of both the dog and home!

name: Deara Person
title: Hello Experienced Sitters & Newbies,
text: Hello Experienced Sitters & Newbies,This site is the bomb! There are great opportunities to travel to places you would like to visit. I have been a THS member for three years and althotugh I don't sit, but a few times a year. As substitute teacher, wife, mother, and pet owner myself. I don't have a lot of spare time. However, when I do find the time to housesit I throughly enjoy meeting the families. As a pet parent myself I understand the importance of leaving my fur babies with someone who will focus on my cat and dog. THS is a fanatastic app. and I plan to be involved for a longtime.Dee

name: Elizabeth Leeming
title: Easy website to navigate
text: The website was easy to navigate and find out the correct information.

name: Laurie Glover
title: Trusted Housesitters is the best!
text: We had our second sit on Trusted Housesitters and once again had a fabulous experience.  We can't say enough good things about the opportunity to travel and meet the people using this service and caring for their wonderful pets.  The reviews on individual sits help us to choose locations and we haven't been let down.  Most of all we LOVE the sweet pets we're getting to meet and interact with!  Being a cat lover from childhood it's so fun to get to know the different personalities and fun quirks of the cats we've met and we look forward to many more opportunities to do so.  We highly recommend Trusted Housesitters and are so thankful that a friend told us about it last year.  We have total confidence in this amazing provision to travel and provide a service that's beneficial for both parties!

name: Sheila Widergren
title: Excellent company that makes the entire…
text: Excellent company that makes the entire process effortless. A very exciting way to see new places and not have to stay in cramped hotel rooms or pay excessive fees on rental sites. Perfect experienc.

name: Hayley Braxton
title: Awesome concept!
text: We love trusted house sitters! What a great way to see the world, hang out with some cool pups and a big bonus is free accommodation. We’ve had nothing but positive experiences and highly recommend to others!

name: Angela
title: It’s a win win for both parties!
text: So with trepidation we used Trusted Housesitters for the first time and we are now converts! Having someone look after your dog in your own home is seriously something to consider. Our Housesitter kept in regular contact with us so it was stress free.  Will certainly use them again!

name: Margaret
title: TrustedHouseSitters has been a godsend
text: I have used TrustedHouseSitters for seven years and have learned to always read all the reviews of the applicants. And my experiences have been excellent. It's been a godsend when we take our annual month trip to South America. We have family down there and I don't worry at all when I am away. I get updates from the sitter, videos, photos. Each sitter has been not only wonderful, but they have all become friends. This is an excellent organization, brilliant concept. It's a win-win.

name: Anita Kaiser
title: I've been using trusted house sitter…
text: I've been using trusted house sitter for about a year now and have had some incredible experiences.  Each animal I get to meet has been a total delight.  Since I am often far from friends and family having these snuggly friends to hang with has made a world of difference in the way I have thrived this year.  This summer I will be sitting in the UK (both England and Scotland) and am excited to continue on with these adventures.

name: Carla Appel
title: Trusted Housesitters Rocks
text: Trusted Housesitters is a great platform for either finding care for your home and pet(s) or looking to take care of other's home and pet(s). There's a whole subculture of people here finding ways to travel and live life differently. I've been both a housesitter and had housesitters come to my home. Each experience has been safe and trustworthy. I've met so many great people and amazing floofs over the years. I can highly recommend.

name: Jessica McNamee
title: Brilliant and useful community idea, but the app lets it down
text: The idea and the community is fantastic- we've used it lots of times and will continue to do so. We meet very interesting people and the profile / review system means we are able to connect with people who will take good care of our home.Two big issues that I think let it down:1. The app itself is very much below par and most of the time just terrible- lots of glitches, random log offs, pages that don't load and you have to go back and forth between pages trying to encourage it to reload. I don't think I've ever had a seamless encounter using the app no matter how quick the task is I'm trying to do. Sitters have said the same to me and this often leads to owners and sitters taking their chats off of the app into other communication routes because the app is too painful to use.2. No route for escalating poor sitters- we've only had one of these of our c20 sits, most sitters are brilliant. But for the one sitter we had that we felt very uncomfortable about, there was no obvious way to escalate this beyond leaving a review for other owners to see- there should be a more formal route owners can take.

name: Gary Bruce
title: We have used Trusted House Sitters…
text: We have used Trusted House Sitters three times now and will continue to do so because every time we realize how happy Arya, our papillon, has been with her new friends!  On top of that our home has always been in good hands and we have regular communications so that we know everything is going well!  This has allowed us to travel like we want without feeling aweful about putting our loving pet in a kennel for weeks at a time.  It is the way to go for those with pets that still like to travel and I would highly recommend Trusted House Sitters!

name: Monica
title: Life changing!
text: Joining Trusted Housesitters has made such a difference to my life and my children. I’m a single parent and live travelling and of course financially it can be more challenging, so to be able to stay in exchange to look after pets is just the most wonderful idea! My kids and I love animals and it makes our time away so much more special. You get to meet such wonderful, warm people as well as cute pets! My daughter would like a cat so she gets her cat fix whenever there’s a cat on a sit and my son loves running with dogs and throwing balls for them (our dog doesn’t chase balls, or run much!)We love our adventures and always have loads of searches so we can find the next experience to plan and look forward to. Amazing idea and app. Thanks so much THS for making travel so accessible and fun for us 🩷

name: PJ
title: A long weekend in Paris..... for rugby supporting and fun!
text: Once again we have gone away happy in the knowledge that an animal loving stranger has come into our home and looked after our pets as we would.  This organisation has revolutionised our lives and allowed us to travel so much more than we otherwise would have.  For us the words TRUSTED is so crucial.  And that TRUST works both ways.  We are honest about our home and the animals and perhaps we are lucky as our dogs and cat are not needy and are pretty relaxed as long as shown affection and fed and walked as they'd normally expect.

name: Gretchen
title: We have used TrustedHousesitters…
text: We have used TrustedHousesitters several times and I feel like each time we've hit the jackpot.Most recently we had a couple who not only took care of our cats but spent hours working in our yard because they were experienced gardeners and enjoyed being outside.  I know you can't expect that every time but wow...The website makes it easy to connect with people you'd be comfortable sharing  your home and pets with.I recommended it to our son and he ended up joining as a sitter and has had some great sits across the country.Well worth the investment!

name: EVA NOTARIO - MONDIAL RELAY
title: The best!
text: If you enjoy traveling, meeting people, discovering new places, and, above all, if you're an animal lover, the TrustedHousesitters platform offers you the chance to experience all of this. I highly recommend it for its safety, trust, professionalism, and the variety of services it offers.

name: Somer
title: PLease have extensive experience watching dogs before you become a sitter
text: I love that you can post your dates and interview sitters before hand, we have had a few great sitters and a few horrible sitters regardless of interviewing the sitters. We have had our dogs put in dangerous situations by 2 different sitters and did not really receive a resolve/help from the company. We have had to utilize the cancellation assistance twice from two sitters that cancelled, and it was a pretty easy process in providing the info for boarding fee assistance due to last minute sitter cancellations. And again, we have had a few amazing sitters that were really worth having the app due to the love our pups got, along with the money saved. We have the combo account where we can also house sit, and we like having that option. We have done one local house sit and the pups were amazing and the couple was as well.

name: Anne C
title: Great experience
text: Great experience using the platform to book international sits.

name: Alexandra Paul
title: Another Fantastic Sit
text: I've just had another brilliant sit from a fantastic couple, such animal lovers, genuine, kind, sociable and interesting.  If possible I ask them to stay the night before I travel to ensure that they get to know my dogs first.  And I get to know them.  I have met so many lovely people through this site and have always had positive experiences.  My dogs are so lucky to be able to stay at home when we're away and with people who walk and play with them and look after my home.

name: Liz
title: I was so pleasantly surprised.
text: I didnt have a clue about how to get onto the site. I didnt know if I wanted to use the site. BUT I have used it for the first time. I was very happy with the process which 'held my hand' as I got into the site. I was delighted with the first sitters. Thanks so much

name: Matthew
title: First time pet parents
text: Our first time leaving our cats with a sitter, and it was a fantastic experience! He sent videos every few days, and also notes. We felt totally comfortable having him in our home with our pets, and when we returned it was as if we never left: it was clean and tidy and he even left us a fresh salad in the fridge, and left some wine and crackers with exotic spreads. Trusted Housesitters is a great concept!

name: Jamie Macleod
title: Marvellous idea
text: Marvellous idea, works incredibly well, have used Trusted HouseSitters for years, absolutely no problems and a life saver.

name: Rosie
title: Such a clever idea!
text: We have now been pet/house sitters with THS for 19 months and in this time carried out many amazing sits in the UK and internationally. As a result of our very successful journey we have become complete advocates of this incredibly innovative website and witnessed the clever connection between host and sitters. We continue to recommend the service of THS to friends and family, who like ourselves have now joined. In all of our 20 plus sits, we have rarely experienced any issues and the hosts that we question have said similar. So if you are in need of care for your lovely pets within their own home, or like ourselves, seeking a wonderful journey of having a close connection to pets and enjoying areas that you may never have experienced, do sign up to Trusted House Sitters. It’s a safe site, where no money exchanges hands, sitters are vetted and with help of public reviews, it makes it a very transparent site. Here’s to our next year of sitting for lovely pets, homes and hosts!

name: Nicolette Linton
title: We've used the Trusted Housesitters…very happy with Trusted Housesitters
text: We've used the Trusted Housesitters service a number of times and have only good things to say. Our sitters have been kind and attentive to our 11-year-old dog, and have always looked after our home well. I totally recommend this app!!

name: Russell Luyt

name: Caroline Sweeney

Would definitely recommend for anyone wanting pets well looked after whilst they enjoy a holiday.

name: Gwen
title: Trusted Housesitters fabulous…
text: Trusted Housesitters has been fabulous to use, with an easy well designed app, and excellent petsitters to date. This is now how we travel.

name: Andrea Nelson

Now I can rest assured that someone is watching everything and taking care of it. Totally puts your mind at ease.My sitters have been reliable, adult, self reliant, great with my cat and house. I couldn't be happier with my experiences. Highly recommend Trusted House sitters.

name: Dawn

name: David Rogers

text: We’ve used Trusted Housesitters three times in the last 12 months. Every sitter has been perfect, both for our cat and our property. Won’t be going anywhere else in the future and have certainly given the catteries the big shove.

name: customer
title: Having a house sitter is so much better…
text: Having a house sitter is so much better (and cheaper) than sending ones dogs to Kennels. I have tried both now, and am certain that the little four legged ones were far happier to be in their own home. Some friends are doubtful about having a stranger living in their house, especially with regard to damage and theft, but I expect that all your sitters have been well vetted in advance, and their presence might even be a deterrent to would-be burglars.

name: Sally
title: Trusted Housesitters provides the solution
text: Trusted Housesitters provides the solution to the most stressful problem - how to ensure home and much loved pets are cared for when we are away - and for Sitters, how to experience the wider world without the expense of hotels or rentals.To date we have never had a bad experience with housesitters - it is a simple procedure to sign up, provide details of home and pets, and offer house-sitting dates - the fee for services provided is reasonable.The selection process for a Sitter may look daunting, but in the end the "right" Sitter will emerge and a good relationship is forged. We have never had a negative experience with any Housesitters - in fact our dogs love the new friends and company - and we hope, in return, the Housesitters are able to gain a positive experience living in a new part of the world in a comfortable home.

name: Patricia A Torza

text: We found a couple that exceeded our needs and we thank Trusted House sitters for taking them on :)

The sitters I have had through THS have been far better than the ones that I was paying for years to come and take care of my dogs....Do yourself a favor and sign up for THS right away.

name: VICKI

text: Highly recommend Trusted House sitters. We had a great experience and are glad we found the service for long term sitters to care for our home and cat while away.

name: Niamh O'Sullivan

I did not have any experience with pets before joining the app but I quickly grew in confidence and now I have done a lot of solo travelling and seen some amazing places all whilst gaining more experience with pets! It’s a no brainer!

name: Priya True Colours
title: Over £400 of loses
text: Not to trust! You have to have a minimum $1000 worth of damages to be able to make a claim and also pay $250 excess for this! That’s only if you own insurance doesn’t cover you for these loses. So what are you paying a website called “trusted house sitters” for exactly?! We were unfortunate to have 2 ladies stay at our house with their golden doodles this feb. They drank over £200 worth of alcolhol. They didn’t want to hide it either as they left 7 empty bottles in the same cupboard and 3 were gone. Whiskey, vodka and brandy all in a week! They hadn’t bothered to clean up after the dogs in the garden as we had to pick up 2 big shopping bags worth of poo! Our dog mostly poos on walks so was he even taken for walks each day? Our gas and electric bill was £60 more then when another sitter came the following week and when we are usually at home. We told them not to touch the thermostat as it’s left on timer but they could use the heater blankets and small electric heaters. They changed the thermostat to manual and left it near a cold window. They were also told to be considerate with usage around the house as bills are so expensive atm. We told them they are welcome to food and drinks in the kitchen and they took this to the excess! So much food was gone we didn’t even have ketchup when we got back :( We were still away when they were due to leave and another sitter was coming so my mum came to the hand over. I asked about the house and she said everything seemed okay but she wouldn’t have thought to check all the cupboards and garden and as ur wasn’t her house she wouldn’t have knowing if anything was missing. Especially when bottles were left and not binned makes it seem everything where it’s meant to be. So they put a review on for us and I did the same as everything seemed to have gone okay. But we were shocked to what we’re come home to and it’s been a really upsetting time for us knowing so people have smcome into our home and treated it with so much disrespect. How knows how my dog was treated and what he’d seen in the 7 days they stayed. Trusted house sitters won’t let us change the review nor will they compensate us for any losses. Trustee house sitters say toy can trust them but you clearly can’t. Read all the small print before signing up! Hopefully no else has to go through what we have.In regards to your reply below this was posted after you already told me there’s nothing you can do besides make a formal complaint. How is this going to compensate or help me??

name: Jan
title: A perfect alternative to boarding
text: A perfect alternative to having to board your pet. People are well vetted and in my experience, 100% reliable. We had an excellent sitter who deserves an AAA+. Would definitely recommend.

name: Isabelle

name: CAROLINE AQUEN

name: Trisha

name: Customer
title: Can highly recommend!
text: Can highly recommend!! It's always tricky leaving your house and beloved pets when you go away, and this provided the perfect solution for us. The site is easy to navigate and plenty of help to find how to do things. We found the most perfect housesitter - she was reliable and sent regular updates on our three kitty Brides of Dracula, who were clearly having the best time with her - enjoying games and cuddles. We returned to a spic and span house and very happy cats (possibly a bit disappointed that their lovely new friend was going). But the site is well organised and you feel that you have good support. Five stars!

name: Doreen B.
title: Taking a much needed vacation from the FARM
text: I was talking to a friend about the need to find a pet sitter for our farm animals and luckily several days later it popped up in my Facebook feed.  It was something I didn't know anything about.  I took the time to visit their website, read the reviews, and decided to join because I needed a vacation after a five year break from travelling (because of starting a small farm).  I found the most perfect couple to stay on our farm for 7 days.  They were a retired couple that grew up on farms and also into adulthood had their own farm so they were very familiar with farm animals and doing chores.  Thank you TrustedHousesitters for your much needed service!  We had a positive experience in March 2025 and we're looking forward to making plans for next year's trip already!

name: Sondra Fireling
title: Pleasantly Surprised! Our new go-to.
text: We've used Trusted Housesitter a few times now and it's one of the best solutions we've found for going out of town. We have a cat and a dog so finding one person to care for both while keeping our house in good standing is a great option. Plus, having it be a flat annual fee means it pays for itself within one trip. The platform is easy to use and the candidates are top-notch - way better than I expected before getting started! This is our go-to whenever we go out of town now, for sure.

name: David F
title: One word, fantastic... amazing... inexpensive... super people...
text: I have used this service for over a year.I have had many sits from one day to one month. Each one has been amazing. The sitters are truly pet people and it is obvious the second they come through the door. I have recommended this program to friends and family and the feedback is the same. It is amazing for my dog to be able to stay at home while I have to travel.  Absolutely amazing value and provide peace of mind while on the road.Most recent experience is the same as all of them to date.  Super!

name: Emma Jones
title: They charge £130 a year for you to be treated like a slave
text: They charge £130 a year. The majority of their clients treat you like slaves and then negatively review you for it. We cleaned thoroughly, looked after pets as our own, carer for plants, bought cards, then the entitled sitters give less than good reviews.One recent house was completely disgusting. Dusty. Dirty. No sheets out. No towels. The place was a scrapyard. I cleaned it all up including the plants and she said she would not recommend is. As a sitter, I would advise against these entitled bunch of people. You go above and beyond and get no thanks.THS Always side with owners who did some awful things.I will be going into more detail and taking this further.We have one lovely frequent sitter who we will be in constant contact with and who appreciate our work.There is no complaints department.

name: Jan
title: Many great experiences as both sitters and homeowners!
text: We've been with THS for many years, and have had mostly wonderful experiences as house-sitters and as homeowners. I've turned my sister and niece onto THS and they're enjoying THS as both sitters and homeowners.Now, I will take issue with THS saying, "free retreat worldwide."  IT IS NOT A RETREAT! On retreats, I don't have work obligations to keep a home secure and pets cared for and fed. So, please, think about this as an exchange of services for lodging, not a free retreat!

name: Uta Hardy
title: This was our first time and we will do it again.

But then we received several very promising requests from people who wanted to stay ion out house.It took as some time to decide and communicate with the potential sitters.We are very happy with the decision we made and I already recommended the service to a neighbor, who inquired about the nice Lady who lived in our house.

name: Susan

title: Highly recommended!
text: My experience with TrustedHousesitters as a Housesitter has been amazing! I've done 4 sits since signing up 5 months ago, and have another 6 sits secured for the next 4 months. So far we've been the loveliest pets and owners (based in UK).What I find important when applying for sits are:(a) to look through photos carefully(b) read through reviews of the house and pets(c) check type of pets and "responsibility" to ensure you're able to care for the pets (for example, I usually don't apply for housesits with big dogs as I am not confident in walking them)(d) get on a video call with house owner for a chat(e) apply for more sits to have higher chance of securing one(f) take time to introduce yourself to the home owner and explain why you'd like to housesit when applying for one(g) keep owners updated daily during the seat and keep the house clean to gather good reviews - it will help with future sits!

name: Shelley
title: Trustedhousesitters shouldn't be trusted
text: If it was just because I had a bad experience with a dog sitter I wouldn't put in this review. But it's the way Trustedhousesitters handled my complaint.I've used trustedhousesitters for 6 years. I had excellent experiences. 5 star ratings on both sides, excellent communication back-and-forth. My Welcome Guide full of  instructions on everything. Pictures of the outside of my house, each room the dog sitter will be using. Any special instructions on my dogs or anything in the house. My dogs medications, garbage days....My last dog sitter was a nightmare. I posted on trustedhousesitters, the days and times of my flights. So when my dog sitter applied for it, she knew exactly the days and times she was needed.  It stated that my dogs we're not left more than two hours at a time in the Welcome Guide plus in messages. And in a zoom call.But the day before our trip, she inform me that she wouldn't be showing up until one pm. She didn't want to leave home so early. Our flight was at 10 am and I left the house at 8:30 am. Leaving my dogs for more than four and a half hours. On her departure, she left at 3 pm, our flight arrival was 9:30 pm. Leaving my dogs  for 6 plus hours. Her reason was she didn't want to drive home in the dark. I had to find someone to come and let them out and sit with them for a while.No updates, photos or videos during my trip. I had to reach out to her during my trip.On our arrival home our 2 senior short-haired miniature dachshunds where exhausted. They slept all day all night for 2 days. Then we found out a few days later from 3 separate neighbours that she had locked them outside in minus cold temperatures. They have never been left outside. They always have access to get back in. Our backyard has no shelter or a warm area. The neighbours said they barked hysterically. That they sounded stressed.My one dog before I left on my trip was full of energy. Chasing her ball. Eating enthusiastically. On my return from my trip she was mopey, a clingy dog, following me from room to room. And not getting up in the morning to eat. I took her to my vet. From her behaviour my vet said it was due to stress.I put in a complaint with Trustedhousesitters. I did have proof of no contact during my trip and I had my neighbours as proof but Trustedhousesitters won't use 3rd parties.Or my vet report. Or my word on the major change in my dogs behaviour.The investigation concluded and she received a warning and her profile will be monitored. A slap on the wrist for abusing dogs.And the fact that they don't step in on the reviews. She gave me a rating of 3 because my dogs had bad behaviour because they barked throughout the day. And barked at night. They were barking throughout the day because they were locked outside in freezing cold weather.I gave her a 3 rating as well because of no updates, photos or videos. And for arriving 4 1/2 hours late and leaving 6 hours early. I wrote the review before I heard from my neighbours. I would have given her an one star. And warned others looking at her profile that she shouldn't be caring for pets.Then after she received the concluding decision of the investigation she wrote a review on me. Stating that the THS had launched an investigation on me and that I wasn't honest and had left a malicious review of her. And that she was found at no fault and that they had fully complied with THS code of conduct. And that my conduct was unethical and untrustworthy. I was thinking did you receive a different email about the investigation then me? WTH!Trustedhousesitters never tampers with members reviews. But the day I reported this the review she had given me it was taken down. It was a 100% lie and THS obviously knew it or they wouldn't have taken it down. I asked how they handled it. They did nothing. She is still up and running with Trustedhousesitters.Trustedhousesitters allows people on their site to lie. Allows people to abuse animals. Allows people that can't comply to the schedule that they applied for. And THS thinks that's okay.I haven't and won't be renewing my membership. Shame on Trustedhousesitters. They need to change their policies.As you can see from THS reply they are always very polite and respectful. But being polite and respectful doesn't mean that my investigation was taken seriously. On the concluding email on the investigation it didn't breakdown any details on their decisions. I even emailed back to ask and got a vague answer.Like I said you can be a Trustedhousesitters member and be a liar and abuse the pets you are caring for. I had my 3 seperate neighbours witness my dogs locked outside in freezing cold temperatures. But THS won't take that as proof. How else was I suppose to prove it. I would have needed surveillance cameras scanning my backyard and a camera facing my house from the backyard to prove she closed the door on my dogs.

title: TrustedHousesitters is truly beautiful
text: The concept of TrustedHousesitters is truly beautiful—creating mutually beneficial cultural exchanges between homeowners and pet sitters. It allows homeowners to find caring sitters for their homes and pets while giving sitters an immersive pet care experience in various locations around the world. I've been using TrustedHousesitters for the past 8 years and have noticed significant improvements in their user interface and app functionality. The platform is more intuitive now, making it easier to navigate listings and communicate with homeowners.However, their "5 application limit" policy creates unnecessary stress and competition among sitters. This artificial scarcity means you have to submit your application without truly taking time in curating a personalized application or spending much time researching the destination since the application could close any second. It can feel like a high-stakes game rather than a collaborative community.This system often leads to sitters frantically competing for opportunities rather than focusing on finding the right match. A more balanced approach would better serve both sitters and homeowners.Overall, I have had nothing but positive experiences, wonderful exchanges around the globe, and met incredibly hospitable and amazing homeowners. name: Chris Nicholls
title: Overpriced, Unreliable, and Unfair Refund Policy
text: Overpriced, Unreliable, and Unfair Refund PolicyI signed up for TrustedHousesitters based on their Money Back Promise, which states that if no sitter applies within 14 days, I would be eligible for a refund. Unfortunately, my experience has proven that this so-called “guarantee” is misleading and ultimately worthless.Despite posting my listing well in advance, I received zero applications within the promised timeframe. By the time someone did apply, it was too late—just two days before we were due to go on holiday. At that point, we had already been forced to make alternative arrangements at extra cost.When I requested my refund as per their policy, they refused—claiming that because an application eventually arrived (after the deadline), I had “received the service.” This completely ignores their own guarantee and fails to acknowledge the stress and extra expense caused by their unreliable system.For a service that costs £149, I would expect much better. The reality is, you’re paying for uncertainty, with no guarantee of actually getting a sitter in time. If no one applies, they take zero responsibility and still keep your money. It’s a clever way to ensure they never actually have to honor their so-called “promise.”I would strongly advise against wasting your money on this service unless you’re comfortable gambling with your pet’s care and your holiday plans. There are far better and more reliable ways to find a sitter.Of course, I expect TrustedHousesitters to respond with something like, “We can’t control when sitters apply,” or “It’s up to the community to engage,” but the reality is, they make bold promises to get people to sign up and then refuse refunds when they don’t deliver. Avoid!

name: Joe McRyley
title: There are better choices out there, their premium membership is a scam...
text: This is probably my third time editing this post as Trusted Housesitters policies keep putting up more roadblocks to avoid paying out on a claim.After following all the conditions below and having them put a 30 day time period on filing the claim, they are now refusing to pay for accommodations because the pet I was to be sitting wasn't a dog or a cat...If you're set on purchasing a membership with TH, whatever you do do not buy anything above their basic membership as you will find it is a total waste of money and your time. Like most insurance companies there are so many conditions in their policy to make sure they don't have to pay out. This last claim was worth well over $1000 US after their deductible had been taken out.To say that I'm outraged and then again that I'm not surprised is an understatement. Please consider this as a stern warning as not all sits involve dogs or cats and on that note, all pet owners should be outraged that their policies will not cover their loved ones...Trusted Housesitters customer support is a nightmare to deal with plain and simple. Using their website on the computer for saved searches is totally useless as you have to manually search each location on a daily basis rather than have them email you new listings for each location.After spending months and months, dealing with their customer support, I came to realize that they themselves do not understand how their system works, and as a result, they kept extending my membership to somehow try to appease my disappointment. At one point, their system worked very well, but now it is broken and they refused to try to fix it. They will try to get you to use their app on your phone and that is something that I'm not going to do when a computer is much easier to work with.If you favourite a sit, you would think it would be possible to send you an email when a sitting opportunity opens up with them? This isn't even an option...To make things even worse, they still owe me for an insurance claim from almost 2 years ago worth close to $1500. If for some strange reason, they decide to pay out a claim they will send you payment in a wire transfer and the fees involved on both and are deducted from your payment. I only wish there was a way to pay for a membership with a wire transfer and have part of the payment deducted as a result of fees, wouldn't that be fair?The first question they will ask you is their first line of defense, you have to notify them within 24 hours of a cancellation in order to be able to start the reimbursement process. If you fail that test, your SOL right out of the box. Imagine buying their premium membership and expecting them to cover accommodations for a cancelled Sit only to find out that they have a $150 deductible on a $1500 max per membership year and the accommodations have to be within 20 miles/32 km of the cancelled Sit. Their policy is filled with if's, might be denied and at the discretion of our partners who managed their insurance program. Like all insurance companies it comes down to their bottom line and has nothing to do with customer satisfaction.Whatever you do only buy the basic membership as phone support is nonexistent and their insurance program is a total nightmare to deal with.I've spent hours and hours online TEXTING with numerous tech-support reps with no resolution to be offered.I'm sure their response will be that they are very sorry they could not fix the issue and to speak to their Tech Support to resolve the problem... Total BS.They gave me a huge discount in order to renew my membership and for that I am grateful to be able to leave this detailed review.There are better choices, and you should think very strongly about joining their community...

title: Unethical Company with No Homeowner Standards/checks.
text: I've done over 40 pet sits with over half on THS, receiving 5 stars for every one but 1 and I've met some lovely people and pets, but I won't use the THS platform any more. I complained about a really horrible sit and later the host's false review and the company refused to do anything even after they said they would "escalate it." I've had hosts lie about their address being in two towns away from where they actually are. One admitted they wouldn't get sitters if they said where they actually lived...and 3 hosts lied about their pet needs and behaviors apologizing when I met them and had started that their pets were dangerous with strangers or had bowel issues. So they don't seem to check the hosts at all and once you're there you're stuck because a kind person isn't going to bail on an animal. I made all of those positive experiences because the pets were lovely and actually most just had issues due to their owners...but it's ridiculous they don't even check host addresses or care needs. And for THS to not care about the hardworking caring sitters who are their bread and butter is awful.I have heard terrible owner experiences as well but from a sitter perspective I wouldn't recommend them because they have no protection in place for the sitter at all. Many of the sits should be paid- not trade- for the work involved, so better to sign up with a paid sitting platform especially over the holidays.
