name: Cassy Chauvin
title: FRAUDULENT PRACTICES
text: DO NOT RENT FROM RV SHARE. We were VERY mislead by the RVshare listing that we rented. The tires that were on the back of the RV, were not only BALD - two of them completely blew (and I mean SHREDDED) 1 hour into our trip. We were left on the side of the highway (US 16 - which is a minimum MPH of 70 with tractor trailers blowing by every 2-3 minutes), from 10:45 p.m. until 5:45 the next morning. WE had to pay out of pocket, $1600 to have the two tires replaced that should have been replaced prior to our trip, and have not been reimbursed by either the owner or RV Share. Not only was our safety completely jeopardized, but we were not able to get ahold of the "24/7" roadside assistance that RV share claims to have. After calling the number on their website, 6 times, waiting on a hold tone line for 30 minutes EACH and every time, the call would end and hang up on us. THIS IS FALSE ADVERTISEMENT AND FRAUDULENT. They left PAYING customers in an extremely dangerous and potentially fatal situation, and they have STILL not made this right. We spent $1560 on the RV, plus $1600 on the two tires that should have been replaced PRIOR to our trip. We lost an entire day spent sitting along the side of a dangerous highway, while waiting for someone to come and fix our tire.Also, this RV was overall a complete disappointment. The advertisement claims it sleeps 8, however the owners screwed in the table settee that is supposed to fold down into a bed, (and FAILED TO LET US KNOW prior) rendering that space completely useless. This is false advertisement. On TOP of that, the entire side bump out motor (that had "two" sleeping areas) did not even function. We had to manually push the entire slider out, so that our space was usable for sleep. It took all members of our group, to open the slider, and all of us to close the slider from the outside in on our final day. The bathrooms were dirty and looked like they had not been cleaned in years - dust and dirt and general grime. The master bathroom overhead window/vent was completely falling apart and unable to be closed, letting in bugs constantly. The doors on the master bedroom didn't even close, because they were off the rails. Not only has RV Share not provided us with a reimbursement for the money and fees that we paid for out of pocket, they don't respond to emails, they provide you with a claims specialist that does not help either and says that they are surprised that someone from their team has not yet reached out, and then goes MIA. RV Share is a complete waste of your time. You are going to be sadly mislead on any RV that you rent. This is our second time, and LAST time renting from RVShare, as BOTH experiences were completely misleading and there is no quality assurance on the RVs they are comfortable and COMPLIANT renting to paying customer.

Second, it was supposed to sleep 10, but it truly only slept about 6, and we had rented it precisely because it slept 10. We NEEDED it to sleep 10 people, so that was extremely deceptive. When we confronted the RV share representative with this fact, he claimed that these upright recliners could sleep 2. These recliners only reclined partially rather than fully flat, so there is no way in which most people could actually sleep in such an upright position. Also, there is no way that it even comfortably slept even 8 adults. Maybe it could comfortably sleep 6 adults, but even that would be stretching it. The first night, we couldn't even get the table/bed to work properly, so it only slept about 5. Third, the insurance and fees were a total racket - way expensive! Fourth, the bathroom stunk. text: I rented a motorhome from RVShare.  Price was decent, but the insurance was really high even for the highest deductible price.  Insuring it with my own insurance company wasn't an option. The motorhome owner seemed very nice.  The motorhome was pretty nice.  My trip was fine except when I got to my destination, my brother noticed there was a flat tire on the inside dual tire.  He also said the other tires were in horrible condition from sun and weather exposure.  He was upset at the owner for sending me with them in that condition.  I wasn't used to driving something tall and I brushed up against tree branches.  That damaged the awning and paint finish.  My brother said for the awning to fall apart the way it did, it like the tires had to have been already in horrible condition due to sun and weather damage.  The 24 hour roadside service person agreed with his conclusion.  I spent a half a day in the tire shop.  I returned the RV.  The seemingly nice owner fraudulently charged me with generator hour overage which I absolutely did not use it more than a couple hours.  I disputed the overages.  RVShare withdrew the $1000 (which added to the $500 security deposit is the $1500 deductible) plus the $200+ overages from my bank account without notice as soon as damage and overages we're reported and before the dispute or insurance adjustment even had a chance to get started.  It is impossible to talk to anyone at RV share who is located in the USA.  Their international customer service people are helpful before the trip, but can't do anything for you afterward.  I contested the withdrawals and the overdraft charges with VISA.  VISA ruled in my favor and refunded my money, but now I can't get a hold of anyone to solve payment of the damages.  RVShare has non-existent customer service after the sale, bad business practices of withdrawing money from bank accounts prematurely, and absolutely no communication.

text: Everything was great until the van started to have engine problems. It became clear that I should not continue to drive it for fear of causing massive damage to the engine.So I pulled off the road and called you. I was told a tow truck would be there in an hour. Then when the hour passed I called him. He told me he was on his way but he never got an email, text or phone call that gave him that guarantee. Then I got a message that a different tow company was coming in an hour. Then after the hour passed I got another text that the ETA was another hour. Every phone call to RV Share was disturbing. I had to repeat the information. After waiting 5 hours I told the first guy to come and I would pay if you didn’t. So, I sat on the side of the road in the heat for 5 hours when it could have been no more than an hour. It made me have to drive 2.5 hours in the dark, which I really avoid doing. You lied saying the first person didn’t answer his phone. Every time I called him he answered immediately and I saw him answer every call that came in.

title: Use at your own risk
text: We rented with RVShare for a 2 week trip. Our RV was dirty, faulty and had many issues, and unfortunately on the last day the RV's wheel jammed up and we could not move the vehicle. RV Share were only able to get us a tow truck after 6 HOURS of waiting (we were stalled only 30 mins from the greater San Francisco area). Our tow truck driver mentioned they often avoid working with RVShare due to their poor reputation in the area, hence it was difficult securing a driver who would take on their case. Furthermore, after 2 weeks of waiting we found out we are COMPLETELY liable for the damages, despite not being provided any evidence from the vehicle inspection or paperwork. Their mandatory insurance is bogus and they'll pin anything they can against you.Please use our experience as a warning, do not book with this company.

text: Horrible insurance policy. We rented a trailer for one weekend with the intention to use the dining table as a bed. As my husband was putting our 3 month old daughter down for a nap on the dining table bed it collapsed under him and my daughter. My daughter could have been seriously hurt. We understood we had to pay for the table and when looking up the cost it ran about $100-$150 for a new table. The insurance company (Digisure) charged us $500!!!!!!!! Did not give us any info where they got that number from and did not even let us dispute the charge. Will NEVER again use RV share.

name: Miranda
title: Ruined Trip
text: We received a camper with a broken water pump. While trying to get that sorted, we attempted to open the awning as water from the ac was trapped in there, the awning rolled about a foot or two and then stopped. The owner did not help us with our experience. He stated that we told him we didn't need the water heater, so he didn't mention that it wouldn't work, but the pump should. We DID need the water heater and ABSOLUTELY needed the water pump for our trip.  After 14 hours of trying to work with RV Share and the owner, the owner stopped responding to RV Share, we were expected to wait to hear back from them. The entire time the owner used our private phone numbers to berate us and spam call us while ignoring RV Share's inquiry for clearing up the issues. The security deposit plus additional charges were taken out of our account without receipt or notice. We were late to the Friday night pre-wedding event and had many disappointed and frustrated relatives waiting on us, for us to show up with a camper that doesn't even have running water for our older relatives. The owner falsified the drop off information (gas tank level, miles driven, etc.) and didn't provide any evidence of overages, but was able to charge us far beyond any reasonable compensation. This whole experience was a scam.

title: Good Luck! My trip got cancelled 12 hours before my departure
text: RV Share has the worst business model I have experienced to date. If you plan on making any plans with advanced notice, do not plan on RV share to make this a stress free experience. Of the three times I have used RV share service, I have experienced 2 last minute cancellations by the owner less than 24 hours before my departure date. The first time the owner shared that they had car troubles 3 days before I was scheduled to leave, but on the day of my departure told me the resolved the issue and I can rent again. By that time I had already booked an alternative RV (older, run down), and the only one available with short notice. The second time the RV was cancelled because the owner wanted documentation of all of my personal information- license with address, insurance information the address of the location I was staying with confirmed payment receipt. When I called RV share for advise on sharing personal information, they told me not to share any of this information as they collect and vet through their agency. The owner did not like the information RV share had advised and cancelled our reservation.When I called customer support, they did not find me an RV, they did not offer compensation on the money I would loose if I cancelled my reservation, or the difference of more expensive RVs that were available to rent. They did not offer any verbal agreement of holding their partners accountable to community by suspending their account because they did not comply with the community agreement.Through sheer luck I was able to find an RV on my own accord and continue with my scheduled plans ( a year in advance). However, I will now always tell my networks- who always ask about my trips – that I will be looking for a different RV renter service.There is no accountability held for owners joining this community. Air BNB has a great business model of mutual accountability of both the owner and the renter. If owners break the community norms, they are held accountable. If you run a business, you need to make sure the client is always taken care of. RV share does not follow this practice.I will say I am lucky I was able to rent from people who follow through - no problems yet. BUT I have no confidence in RV share as a business model.Good luck if you choose this service, I hope you don't get any last minute cancellations with no support in making sure your trip is a success.

name: Pure Joy Outdoors
title: Great website, but takes much longer than expected to reserve an RV
text: RV Share makes almost all of the information the renter needs very clear and easy to find as long as everything goes according to plan. However, the RV Share/Insurance company interface is a different story. If you are denied insurance, you will never know why unless you call an RV Share agent and ask. I spoke with FOUR agents to get the problem resolved. They were all very nice, but unrealistically optimistic. The problem was created by a mere TYPO! I hit one key incorrectly for my birth date, which made it inconsistent with my driver's license. WOW! What a mess. FOUR agents to get it resolved. Agents said I needed to call the insurance company directly to resolve it and gave me the phone # to call. Except the insurance company is CLOSED on the day the agents told me to call. One agent told me, "the insurance company MIGHT call you within the next two hours." No one called me. As I mentioned, the 4th call to an RV Share agent resolved the problem, less than 24 hours before my rental was scheduled to begin. This was just a little too close for my comfort.This was my 3rd or 4th attempt to secure an RV for my dates. TWICE, I requested an "Instant Rental" (that's the lightening bolt symbol) only to find the owners backed out in the middle of my process to secure their rental as they had failed to update their online calendar and their RV's were not actually available. title: Absolute poor service
text: Absolute poor service this company gives. Located in California near LAX (Manager Alisha and others) rude classless company to deal with.  They gave than 48 hours notice to let us know that because we did not prepay for our rental they will have no vehicle available when arriving. Forcing us to re-rent last minute.  Never use this company anywhere at all.  Horrible company.   Can’t make this garbage up. It’s like the Sienfeld skit.

name: Anand Gm
title: DO NOT RENT FROM THIS COMPANY!!!
text: The minute we arrived at Airport Van Rental on June 13th, to pick up our pre-booked van, our vacation plans screeched to a halt.  There was no one there.  We lugged our belongings from our rental car, expecting a quick handover, only to be met with a deserted office and a sinking feeling in my stomach.  Then came the email - the one containing crucial locker access instructions, buried in my spam folder!  Finally, after wrestling with a rusty key and locating the van, after transferring our luggage from our rental car to this van our relief was short-lived.  The engine coughed, sputtered, and died.   Two hours crawling around in the hot Las Vegas sun, with a screaming toddler in tow, trying to contact a company that didn't seem to exist, pushed us to the edge. The road side assistance that we had taken did not work either. We called the number on the back if the key for hours and only heard music.Defeated, we piled back into our friend's car, our dream vacation itinerary replaced by the nightmare of scrambling for extra hotel rooms and a looming Airbnb cancellation fee. We ended up booking 3 rooms in Las Vegas for the night, cancelled our Airbnb at the destination and made a Royal mess of the plans for our rest of our vacation. From that day onwards till date I have been trying to contact the manger of this amazing organization but no one responds. DO NOT RENT FROM THIS COMPANY. They appear cheap but they are not worth the hassle.

name: Amir Malik
title: The worst service i have experienced
text: The worst service i have experienced. It is contactless facility in Phoenix. Finding the van was hassle at 1st, They never returned me my $200 deposit stating that gas tank was empty. This was not true.The Van was half tank when i took it & pictures were sent too.I filled the tank to same level before returning. They said that their agent says that tank was empty which i know is a lie.Stay away from these scammers

name: Jensen Marshall
title: DO NOT RENT FROM THIS PLACE
text: DO NOT RENT FROM THIS PLACE! Please save yourself the time & headache & spend a little bit more & rent from a regular car rental place. They take forever to pick you up from LAX. Then they bring you to the back of the four points Sheraton hotel to get your car. The same person that’s checking you is the same person running out there to get your vehicle. I paid for my reservation ahead of time on Priceline & when I checked in, the lady told me that they DO NOT rent without the additional $13.71 supplemental liability insurance. Even though my insurance covers rental cars. Mind you I did not rent a 12 or 15 person van. When I booked those before, I was told about my insurance not covering those transport vehicles. This time I only got a regular dodge minivan, and I was still charged an additional $68.55 for the SLI. What am I supposed to do when I’ve been waiting all this time to pick up my rental car, decline it & allow them to cancel my car reservation that was already paid for? It is the biggest scam & I should’ve read these reviews before renting from them. I have absolutely learned my lesson & will never rent from them again. I’m still disputing this extra charge with AVR. Do yourself a favor & rent with someone else who won’t scam you! Also the van was not cleaned at all. DO NOT RENT!

name: lacie tran
title: Horrible and dangerous experience
text: Horrible experience! I really wish I would have read reviews before booking via Kayak.First it took over a hour for the shuttle from the airport. Apparently they offer this service via the hotel the rental location is located in. Tried calling numerous times and no answer. Finally talked to someone who said 10 minutes, took another 40. Once we got there the car they gave us was dirty and had scratches and dings all over it. Check with your insurance company that they cover rentals. Because we were unsure we felt pressured to purchase theirs for additional $100.As soon as my husband started driving the car he told me it didn’t feel correct. We drove for about a hour, the car definitely was in need of serious repair. It was actually endangering our lives as it would not respond when you stepped on gas, and then would surge fast.Of course no answer on the way phone lines. We went all the back almost 1.5 hours at this point due to traffic. They really were not concerned,and only because we insisted on a new rental, they gave us one. Also acted like it was a big favor because upgraded. The new one was fine, although also dirty and damaged. The entire 9 day trip I felt unsettled if something was to happen what would we do. I wanted to return one day early, but of course was never able to talk to anyone. When we did return it, the lady didn’tWant to come out and inspect the car with us.We refused to leave until they did as we didn’t want to be charged for the damage that was already there. HORRIBLE company that had no issue putting our lives in danger, never apologized either

name: john myers
title: Never Rent from AVR Van Rental
text: Almost a month later still waiting on a refund from a van I canceled over a week early. The two vans we did get one didn’t have AC and the other shook so bad it was hard to drive. Get getting the run around in a refund.

name: Richard Bradley
title: Service was terrible
text: Service was terrible. Vehicle was dirty and the agent that helped me was very nasty. Ghetto!!!!

name: Bob
title: Fraudulent business practices
text: I prepaid for a van rental from AVR on 4/12/24 through Priceline online. At the same time I was paying for the van online, I also purchased the insurance that was offered. On 4/15/24 when I attempted to pick up the van, I was told that the insurance I purchased through Priceline was not valid and that I would need to purchase "their" insurance for $55/day. I told the agent that I did not want the insurance and that the contract did not state anywhere that I needed their specific insurance. When I asked her to show me in the contract where it stated that, she then changed her story indicating it was a Nevada law. I know this is not true. Since I had already prepaid for the van, I was told by the agent that I couldn't cancel and would lose my money if I didn't purchase their insurance because they would not give me the van until I had paid for their insurance. When I asked to speak to a manager I was told that I couldn't talk to anyone else. After nearly hour I finally gave in and gave her my credit card. I was charged $592.63 for a 7-day rental which is much more than the original $55 I was originally told. I never received any documentation indicating what was covered, etc. The business practices of Airport Van Rental are fraudulent, but it leaves the renter with no choice but to pay the fees.

name: Raphael Leib
title: THIS COMPANY IS NOT TRUSTWORTHY
text: This company is among the worst I have ever dealt with!  I booked and paid for a van rental on March 19 for pickup on April 6. On March 29, I received a one-line email saying "Thank you [my name], your rental has been successfully cancelled." After an hour of calling anyone I could find (they do not make it easy to reach a human!), I was finally told by one of their agents that they had overbooked their vans and had to cancel my reservation, and that I would be refunded the $827.19 I had paid.It is now April 17 and I still have not received my refund. I called their customer service line and after another very long wait, I spoke with someone who claimed my refund had supposedly been issued on April 12. No explanation as to why it took them 2 weeks to do this, assuming they really did it at all. I never received any confirmation of the refund, nor does my credit card statement indicate that the money was refunded. I have filed a formal complaint with my credit card company and hope they can resolve the matter.  This company has already caused me a massive inconvenience; here's hoping it doesn't become a costly one, as well.

name: Aaron Lang
title: Horrible
text: Horrible.  This is by far the worst experience I have ever had at renting a vehicle.   We are trying to transport kids/parents for a robotics competition and have us picking up at the wrong location.    They dont have a van where we are flying into and they won't refund our money!

name: EJ Johnson
title: AVOID - AVOID - AVOID
text: I booked and paid for a 7-passenger minivan a month before I arrived. They told me they would reach out to me with specific directions a few days before I arrived. Never heard from them. On the morning of my flight to LAX, I finally called myself to determine how their process works. It was at THAT time they told me that they had no minivans, but they would put me in a 15 passenger full-sized van.  I didn't want a full size van, but I had no choice since I was already at the airport.  Maybe not a huge deal to drive a bus, but then they charged me MORE for the rental, and also INSISTED I had to buy special insurance because I was now driving a 'commercial vehicle'.  What an absolute scam!  They lied over and over to me, while being disgustingly rude while doing so.  Never EVER will I again even think of going back, and I'll share my experience with everyone and anyone!  Rent somewhere else if you wish to work with an honest, polite, and less expensive rental company!

name: Rufaro
title: I didn't like the long process to get…
text: I didn't like the long process to get the vehicle. I also didn't like the fact that the rental car did not come with a license plate on the car. Tried to get the company to get me a license plate but they did not. Only emailed me a paper. Especially in Atlanta, not having a license plate restricted us from parking in several areas of the city. I also didn't like all the additional fees that I was not made aware of until it was time to check the car out. Had to pay an extra $400-500 dollars without my prior knowledge. Having initially payed for the rental on Priceline, the original price compared to the price after the ridiculous amount of fees was astonishing.  Also didn't like the return process. Had to drop the car off in an Airport garage and just leave the keys and ticket inside. Did not feel comfortable leaving the car unattended like that and not being sure if they were going to be able to find and retrieve the car in a timely manner.

name: Scott Ames-Messinger
title: CANCELED A PREPAID BOOKING A WEEK BEFORE OUR TRIP
text: A WEEK before our trip to Austin, Texas, Airport Van Rental CANCELED OUR VAN that WE HAD PREPAID.When I called, I was told they'd call back and they never did. Later, I called back and was on hold for 40 minutes. The next day, I called back and was directed to someone who was not the manager. This person refused to transfer me to the manager, Tupou Fifita.They did not try to secure another van. They did not move a van from another location. They did not connect us with another rental agency. They did *absolutely nothing* to try to fix things.We have 9 people and all the airport cars have been sold out in Austin for 2 MONTHS. There's simply not other airport options. I have no idea how our trip will continue given how incompetent and unhelpful they are.

name: Heather Nolan
title: TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE - DO NOT USE!
text: Terrible customer service.  Impossible to reach an actual person.  Hours of operation are not clear.  I do not recommend this company.The details:  Our connecting flight was delayed which made us a day late for our rental.  I tried calling the company to make sure we would still have our rental the following morning when we were due to arrive.  I left a voicemail since there wasn't anyone to answer the phone.  The next morning, I called first thing and also received the option to leave a message.  Since I had done that the night before, I opted to send an email to make sure we had something in writing.  At this point I was getting nervous that we wouldn't have a vehicle upon arrival.  I called back a few times and was advised by the recording that there was "1" caller ahead of us.  Finally, I thought - I would have a chance to speak with a real person and explain our situation and  hopefully confirm our rental.  After 55 minutes of holding (I have the screen shots!) I finally decided to rent with a different company.  We paid much more than we needed to but we were stuck at that point.  After a 10 day family vacation I forgot about the experience until we got home and I was catching up on emails and found the confirmation from them.  There was never a call back or a return email from my attempts to reach them over 10 days ago. All that to say - I can not recommend this company.  If I ever hear from them and there is an explanation to all of this madness, I am willing to update my review at that time.

name: Angy Customer
title: The most horrible experience ever
text: Car reserved was not ready. Had to wait an hour. Finally offered us a car that was less than adequate. We were threatened by the manager and told to sit down and if we didn't like it we would have to wait another hour for them to clean out another car. Worse company I have ever dealt with.  No customer service at this place and dishonest.  Took two hours to get a car.

name: MC
title: BEWARE!!!! I am out $700!
text: Unfortunately, at this point, I would leave a negative star review if that was an option.  November, I reserved two vans for LV. Next day I received an email confirmation for LA. After no return emails, I called and spoke to "customer service". They said they can change the reservation after checking with the LV office.  I asked if I would get an email confirming that the reservation was successfully changed. She said their system can't provide that confirmation, but she could "email me a screen shot of the confirmation when it is approved." NADA!  Long story short, after 6 weeks of multiple calls on a weekly basis only one reservation has been refunded.  Noone can seem to tell me why I am not being refunded for the second van.  "I see it has been flagged for an escalated response." "I should hear something within 48 hours." NADA.  Noone can forward me to accounting so I asked who to contact. I was given the name and number for a Marcus. I have left two VM and NADA and NADA!  The lack of professionalism and customer service is astonishing!  I am guessing after this review; it will seal the deal that they will rob me of close to $700!

name: Shahidah Nicole
title: If I could give 0
text: If I could give 0, I would. We prepaid for a 15 passenger van to help transport 13 people for a trip to Grand Canyon that we has been planning for almost a year. We were all meeting at the rental spot since we flew in from all over the country only to find out they the van we prepaid was not available. We were basically being told oh well as 13 of us stood there stranded. We had an airbnb in Utah so not uber-able (they orig offered Uber). After going back and forth, them threatening to call the police if we didn’t leave, then found a van. The so called manager left the employee there after threatening us, past their 4pm closing time, never to be seen again and said she didn’t get paid enough for this. We just needed transportation. The van they found was super raggedy with holes in the seat, wires hanging from the console, holes in the armrest, door not aligned so it required an outside person to slam to close it, stains on the seats, and finally sounding like it was gonna cut off at every light. We were desperate so we had to take it. It was getting late and a holiday weekend. NEVER AGAIN!!

So now I have to file a charge back. I suspect they do it on purpose. "Support" is very ignorant.

name: Carol Hill
title: Never rent anything from AVR Van…
text: FYI never ever rent a van from AVR Van Rental. I will be disputing this charge with my credit card company.I learned my lesson never rent a van from a less reputable company such as AVR!  Rent from Capps Van Rental.

name: Wiam Bitar
title: Very bad customer service

name: Pete
title: Closes at 4pm at an airport?
text: I only have experience with the Las Vegas AVR.When booking online they don't mention their hours are 10am to 4pm every day! Was told there was a charge for after-hours. name: Denise Davis
title: FAR FROM THE TRUTH
text: First and foremeost, I thank God that we did reach our destination and returned safely as well.  However, I reserved a 15 passenger van and was told that it would be a new van.  Upon arrival to the pickup location, we were greeted by the most rude individuals.  It was approximately 3 PM and they kept telling us they were closing soon.  The van they chose was a 10 passenger, NOT NEW and looked like it had been through a war zone. WE LOVE  TO COME TO  LAS VEGAS !!! Definitely coming back.

name: Lisa Monreal
title: I wish ZERO stars could happen
text: I wish ZERO stars could happen. This place is the absolute worst. I rented an SUV one week prior to my trip. I got to the airport and there is no sign for them to stand by to get picked up. I called about 10 times and got a voicemail with a mailbox that was full before I got someone to answer the phone. When I finally spoke to someone she informed me that they only have 12 passenger vans left even though I had a reservation for an SUV. I attempted to call every other place and ended up calling about 10 different places that were all sold out. I attempted to call back and again it took about 30 minutes of calling over and over again. Finally they tell me that someone will be there in 10 minutes to pick me up. I waited 45 minutes before calling back again and still no one was there. I was then put on hold for a while and then I was told that they are all sold out of everything and cannot help me. So I was stuck at the Denver airport with no car and had to take an Uber that cost me $200 to get to my hotel. This place is terrible and I hope no one ever rents from them. They had zero people skills and even the customer service was rude and told me - well they didn’t charge you - oh well thank you for not charging me. I have never been more disgusted by a business in my life

name: Customer
title: Pay Less but expect less
text: The car was beat up on the inside and the outside. The car drove like a golf cart, which isn't ideal for a mountain vacation. I was very upset when the employee sold me a toll pass, which I believed I needed, and then once out on the roads the tolls were all closed. I was quoted $12/day for the toll pass and was charged $13.50/day. Biggest issue was when returning the car. They have very clear instruction on how to drop the car off after hours, however you are unable to follow the instructions. There is a phone number to call and the mailbox was full. You are suppose to leave the parking space and section on the voicemail, but the spaces are not marked. So I left a rental car, unlocked, with keys in it, at a park n fly which was scary as the policy states that any damage occurred to the vehicle while parked after hours was my responsibility.

name: Catherine Knox
title: They deserve ZERO stars.
text: They deserve ZERO stars.I book travel for a football team through our company, and try to get large vans whenever possible.  I booked three 12-passenger vans six days ahead of travel time.  While the agent (Alexander) seemed helpful, he had a thick accent and was difficult to understand, so I did as much of the transaction as possible in an online live chat that I got sent to my email in order to be able to verify details.There were a few times where the agent seemed impatient with my questions, in fact even said 'look at conversation above, I already told you,' but I put that down to English perhaps not being his first language.I paid a $1 deposit to hold the vans and then had them email me the paperwork to pay for all three up front on my credit card, which I did.Over the next few days, I tried to contact the company several ways, including email (no response),  online chat (sometimes no response, other times a response but not very helpful), and phone calls (mostly no answer, once the hard-to-understand Alexander who assured me everything was in order and acted impatient with me for asking questions, and once an EXTREMELY RUDE woman who said she was 'only an office person, I can't help you' and when I said that I understood, and nicely requested to speak to a manager about my concerns, she said 'yeah, I'll have them call you,' and HUNG UP ON ME without getting my name or number).Today, the day my team is flying in and is due to pick up the rental vans, I received a call from a woman named Keisha (who sounds suspiciously like the rude woman from yesterday only in a better mood) who told me she's sorry but they overbooked so they are putting my group on STANDBY!!!  I am appalled at this horrible customer service and told her to cancel our contracts and refund all payments immediately.  This has been one of the worst companies I have ever dealt with in any capacity.  I cannot say enough about how much stress and extra work this has created, trying to shuffle things around and now get vehicles rented at the last minute from other sources. My team is still on their flight and I haven't even been able to inform them of this nonsense yet because I am too busy trying to find other rentals.DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.  AVR is TERRIBLE.

title: I will never rent from AVR again
text: Where do I start??  I rented an AVR van in Houston to take a trip with my family.  When I arrived at the location on the scheduled pick up time the van was dirty inside and out.  The employee told me he needed to clean it inside.  After a 45 minute wait outside, he asked me if I wanted him to wash the outside.  I told him I would take care of it at home before my trip.  We confirmed weekly rates, free mileage etc.  When I returned the van, I delivered it clean inside and out without damage.  The employee told me that there would be approximately $1,000 additional mileage charge because I lived in Houston and the free mileage was only if you lived out of town.  This was never told to me or agreed to prior to me renting.      He told me I could dispute it with customer service and that he would leave the ticket open.  I finally got customer service on the phone, had to dispute the whole thing with them and my credit card company.  They had also falsely represented that I turned the van in 4 days after I did.  We finally settled on payment 2 months later after many emails and phone calls.  Today, nearly 6 months later I received a call that they are making a broken windshield claim against me.  That raggedy van has probably been rented a hundred times since I returned it and now this.I will never rent from that run down old place again. title: Rent anywhere else BUT here!
text: Rented a van a month ahead of time for a family trip to Denver. Our flight was late but we noticed shuttles for all other companies running every 5 to 10 mins. Never saw one from AVR. title: BEWARE.  Horrible experience!
text: BEWARE! This was the absolute worst experience ever. We had reserved a 15 passenger van for Dallas/Fort Worth from Aug 11-16. Then we were hit with a "commercial insurance" fee which more than doubled the price we were originally quoted.  We got the van and left with part of our party and the other part of our party arriving on a later flight.  When we went to pick up the second half of our party is when we realized that the 12 passenger van had an entire row of seats missing and it was 5:30pm and there was no one available to fix the situation.  We had to cram everyone in the vehicle like sardines and drive over an hour to our destination for the week.  We literally payed over $1,000 for 5 days for a van that held 8 passengers.  Then, when we went to return the van, we called ahead to make sure we would be given a shuttle back to the airport.  We were assured that we would be.  When we got there, there was 1 person working and a room full of mad customers, none of which were given a shuttle and we had to find our own uber and spend another $20 just to get back to the airport, and almost missed the flight.  It was not only horrible service, but horrible customer service and a complete rip off.  I would avoid renting from this place at ALL COST!  If I could give this company less than 1 star I would do it.  I feel we should be re-reimbursed at least partially, because we in no way received the services we paid for or were promised in our contract.

name: Shawn Cunningham
title: NEVER...EVER...AGAIN!!! Spend the extra money!!!
text: If I could give them no stars in Los Angeles I would!!! This was by far one of the most hacked experiences I have ever endured with my wife and 2 kids in the middle of the night!!! First off, when we got to LAX we had to call to get instructions on how to get to the rental office...no big deal, but I called and they said one of the drivers would be there to get us in their van. First red flag was the fact that we were told we had to go to the top level, where non of the other rental companies are, and look for “CL Parking”...we could find “CL Parking”. So I called again and was told “it’s over by the hotel and parking lot pick up”. Went over to that area, still couldn’t find “CL Parking”. We walked up and down the level, talk to an officer and asked them where it was, and they told us that rental car company pickups are all on the same level and we needed to go back downstairs. So all 4 us wheeling our bags around went back down to the lower level AGAIN!!! Couldn’t find “CL Parking”!!! I called a 3rd time and asked what EXACTLY am I looking for, because it’s been over an hour since our plane landed and we first contacted them. The person put me on hold and said and when they came back said we should have someone there in about 15 minutes or so...it’s a white passenger van that said “CL Parking” on it. One would think that the van would be clearly marked, right?? So we were looking and looking and waiting and waiting and finally about a half an hour later a white passenger van with small lettering near the bottom! The driver, Arthur, was extremely nice and very helpful. He took us to the van rental office and dropped us off.  This place was sketchy at best!!! It was really poorly lit with paper signs taped up telling us where we needed to go. There was one other passenger with us upon pickup at the airport and she had to leave the rest of her party at the airport to get dropped off at the rental office. They only wanted to pick up the drivers and leave the rest of their party at the airport...not gonna happen in my case!!! I’m not leaving my wife and children alone at LAX while I hop in a van and leave them alone for god knows how long!!! When we finally made it inside the office, it was no better...uncomfortable was the first feeling that came to mind, but we waited, and waited, and waited in line for our turn, which seemed excessive because there were more people working there than there was customers!!! Maybe about another half hour later the woman in front of me, that was by herself, spoke up and said “excuse me guys, I have a reservation” to which the gentleman who was clearly in charge told her that “he’s busy and would deal with her when he was done”!!! At that point, I looked at my wife and said that’s it, I’m done, I’ll call an Uber and go somewhere else. So while I was standing in line I cancelled my reservation online, on my phone. As we starting walking out the guy in charge said “what’s the matter, where are you going?” And I then informed him that I cancelled my reservation online. He could have cared less. He said “oh” and went on doing whatever he was doing. When we got outside the driver that had picked us up at the airport was pulling back in with more passengers, so I asked him where the closest rental car place was, or how to get back to the airport. He was very apologetic about the situation and told us that he had to run back to LAX and would bring us back and drop us off so we could get set up with a different rental car company. He started putting our stuff in the back of the van and the “guy in charge” came outside and asked what I was doing. I told him I was trying to rent a car, at which point he snapped at me about canceling my reservation. As we stood in a shady part of some random neighborhood with my wife and 2 kids in the middle of the night after having dealt with the situation since hours earlier. I lost it on the guy!!! We got in a screaming match in the parking lot. Long story short...Don’t!!

name: Lynn Culhane
title: LAX Airport Van Rental Review
text: If you want an extremely dissatisfying experience, fraught with unprofessional employees, this is the place for you. I reserved 182 days in advance. After an arduous journey to even get to the rental place (involving 2 different shuttles and standing in a parking lot, out in the heat, with all of our luggage, to catch the second shuttle), I entered the Airport Van Rental (AVR) building, only to be greeted by at least 4 other disgruntled parties who did not look impressed, as they were waiting for their own van rentals (which were late).I was informed by the employee who assisted me, that I would not like any of her answers (at least she was honest- that I appreciated). She said there are no vans available right now, but you will get "something" sometime today. Thank goodness for vagueness.  I reserved a 15 passenger van, only to be greeted by a 12 passenger van. Unfortunately, the group I was travelling with were ALL afraid to conquer LA driving, or else I would have abandoned AVR and would have gone elsewhere to rent two regular sized vehicles. However, I was far braver and had no choice but to rent a larger passenger van from AVR! I would even have brought an absolute stranger with our group and rented two 8 passenger SUV's to avoid this place (hind sight is 20/20).  It gets better, continuing reading...The VAN arrived two hours late and don't forget the wrong one, not the 15 passenger we had reserved. However, we were told that AVR could not give us a time when a 15 passenger would be available, so we relented and accepted the 12 passenger (which we received no discount for a smaller van rental). Now, due to the extra time it took to shuttle to AVR and the LONG wait to rent the van, I got to waste time in rush hour, yeah!Upon entering the VAN, the olfactory senses were walloped by wafting urine and sweat. All seats were cloth and soiled. I immediately asked for air fresheners… what I received was a lite mist of some crappy spray that lasted until I reached the first corner. Well, at least I got to shop, along the way to our destination, for air fresheners at TARGET (we don't have target in Canada anymore, so I enjoyed being able to shop there and erect a forest of Pine Trees in the van). If you closed your eyes real tight you'd swear you were in a real forest somewhere nice, definitely NOT this lousy land barge that wreaks of other humans odors.Fast forward to day four, when I used the windshield wipers to clear dirt off the window at night, as the glare was awful. The driver’s side wiper was ruined and didn't remove anything. It only spread the dirt around, making it difficult to see. Now I had the pleasure of finding a gas station, to properly clean the window, at least I got to Ace Venture my way there to avoid striking objects. One would think that AVR would check all lights, fluids and wipers as all have to do with safety. Not this place.At the end of the trip, I followed the directions given to me, and dropped the VAN off at the adjacent building CL (parking), as it was early in the morning. I asked for a receipt and the attendant stated he didn't have any and that I would receive an email soon, confirming that I had dropped the VAN off. This is an important fact to remember.Almost 48 hours later, I get a call that sounds like this, verbatim, " When are you gonna bring our Van back?” I said, "I dropped it off Saturday.” The employee reiterated where is our VAN, when are you gonna drop if off? I said I am in Canada and I don't have your van. We will look into it and get back to you. ….Click the phone is hung up. This was a conversation that lacked any form of etiquette. I REALLY appreciated this person calling me at 23:10 hours on a Sunday evening. This made me worry all night that I got duped at the airport and someone actually stole the van. Never did get a call back from them.I then called the General Manager the next day, Mr. Batchelor. I told him about all of my concerns and he asked “where is our VAN?” At this point it became painfully obvious, this business has no form of inventory control, professionalism, common courtesy, they are void of core competencies associated with success, professionalism and interpersonal dynamics. Mr. Bachelor ended the conversation stating he would get back to me, he never did. I am assuming they located their van.At a bare minimum I would have expected AVR to reimburse me for the pine forest I purchased, to mask the odor of the urine express. Instead, Mr. Batchelor had a battery of excuses to address all the concerns I had. I also advised him that I had a discount card that was not honored, silent response to this as well.It pains me to rate AVR a star. I think a moon would be more appropriate. I truly hope someone other than the General Manager reads this review and develops a strategic plan for this location. The plan should include professional development across all domains. If the General Manager reads it conduct a SWOT analysis of you and your team. I am sure you will find something to work on. If you’ve done a SWOT do another one the first one didn’t work.Overall, I would avoid this place at ALL costs, unless you want to author a review like this.

name: Mindi Hall
title: Service severely lacking at this location!!
text: I am severely upset with the service at the Portland location! The service I received at that location was a horrible way to start my vacation with my children. I was traveling from South Carolina to Portland, OR with my seven children (ages 2 – 14), by myself for 3 weeks. I rented a van from AVR to accommodate my family during our vacation based on online reviews and price. It was not inexpensive (over $2,000). When I booked the van I was under the impression that the van rental office was located at the Portland airport.A few days prior to my departure to Portland, I found out different, when the Portland office contacted me to let me know their airport shuttle was not running. As a lone parent with seven kids, I was very concerned about how I would be getting to the rental location. The location told me they could provide me with one Lyft ride. I was very upset because it is not possible to take all my kids and myself in a single Lyft and I was not willing to leave some of my children at the airport or have them ride with a stranger to the rental location…my whole family needed to go to the van location at one time.I called the 1-800 customer service number for AVR to try and resolve this issue. They assured me that the location could get two Lyft drivers at the same time. I arranged with a family member to meet me at PDX to help me with my kids and make sure they were not riding alone with a stranger. When I arrived at PDX I called the van location to arrange transportation to pick up my rental van. They were adamant that they could only summons one Lyft driver at a time and that I would have to leave half my kids at the airport and then they could summons another Lyft driver or I could pay for another Lyft myself. I asked if they could use the van I was renting to come get me and my kids and was told that was absolutely not possible. They did not care about my situation and were unwilling to help me at all! I am grateful I had a family member meet me at PDX and could help me and was able to order another Lyft and ride with half my kids.When I got to the rental location, I was told that AVR would take off the cost of the Lyft ride to the rental location, but not the $4.00 tip. Are you kidding me!?!?! I was not supposed to tip the driver who had to take a longer time due to my having car seats, luggage, etc? I am not that kind of person. Apparently, AVR (at least the Portland location) is that type of company. Furthermore, when I asked how I would be able to get back to the airport, I was told they would be able to drop me and my kids off in the van I had rented. Why couldn’t they do that to pick us up?!All the miscommunication and horrible service on AVR’s part got my vacation off to a very rough start. Had I known that the customer service was so poor at the Portland location I would have rented from another company. I am so disgusted that this company did not care about me or my family, at all!

title: Disappointed...
text: Unfortunately, I had quite a negative experience with AVR. The vehicle I rented died while inside the Rocky Mountain National Park!! I never received that call. I have since called and left a voicemail, and days later still haven't received a call back to address my concerns. I had this vehicle for just over 30 hours and paid over $400. Now it is nearly a week later and I haven't received the communication I was told I would receive from management the next day, nor have I received a response to the voicemail I left when I never heard from them. text: This was our 2nd time renting from AVR. Despite the numerous bad reviews online we had a positive experience the first time and decided to rent from them again. I called and spoke to Maria, the station manager, who repeatedly restated their cleaning policy. I asked to speak to her supervisor and was told Steve, the General Manager, would call me back. He did not call so I called and asked to speak to him. I was told he was gone for the day & was reconnected to Maria. She told me there were pictures of the animal hair and she would email them to me. Maria reassured me she would make sure my concerns were taken care of before she left for the day.I have not received any communication from Maria or Steve since my last phone call. It seems AVR keeps their rental rates low then charges fees upon return to make a profit. What a dishonest business practice. I would recommend you rent from another company even if their rates are higher.

text: The worst customer service I have seen in decades.The lies upfront to your face, the tricks to get more money from the customer, the lack of trust...I was appalled that I was told that my international insurance would not be accepted so I had to purchase theirs. For this I had to call my insurance provider, put them on the line with the person at the car rental for them to be convinced... wow, really.A lie up front and then making it as hard as they could for me to get away without buying their overpriced insurance...One thing I am sure is that I will never go back there.Oh, and note: ACE and AVR are the exact same thing, so switching to the other one won't do you any good.Please be advised that you will have to pay extra for:- full insurance- liability insurance- fuelOne of their tricks is to ask you if you want to pay for refueling at the end of the trip. If you say no, then they pick a van which has little fuel left in the tank. But instead of the normal car rental companies that let you return empty if it was nearly empty, they here tell you to bring it back at 1/8th full (basically 1 bar above empty) because that''s the current amount of fuel in the tank.  They do this because they know that there is no way anyone could guess correctly how much fuel to put in to hit that exact 1/8th, so people will always over-refuel, and the company will take that for free.There is so much scamming, animosity and bad intentions in that place that it makes me sad

name: Richard
title: They look fair but feel foul
text: During my rental period I became ill and required hospitalization with cellulitis and MRSA (aka "staff infection) of both legs below the knee and was on antibiotic IV's for the the next 5 days. Because the van was due back a day before my scheduled release which was far from certain anyway, I asked a friend to return the vehicle for me. It was a trip of less than 2 miles from my home to the AVR location.To show his appreciation for renting his vehicle for almost a month the station manager there, a fellow named Michael, noted that the driver was not authorized to drive the car and reported me to the corporate office for that offense.In his expression of gratitude and appreciation for my repeat business Michael saw fit to help put me on a DNR list.  I'll get this rectified but I want others to know about this manager and his attitude toward those who repeatedly use AVR's services and products and try to build a relationship with them..At well run consistently growing companies with great reputations both with the public who become their customers and with the public who benefit from their activities as a corportate fellow citizen employees are generally elevated to managerial positions because in part they exericise good judgment and excellent customer relationship skills that are required to build lasting positive relationships that wins repeat business and create goodwill in the cummunity where they reside since all corporations whether they mean to or not are partners building a better community.I wonder what criteria AVR use's to recruit retain and reward a guy like Michael. It doesn't feel like any of the foregoing.I've been in sales for years and my goal was always to create in the client a "wow" moment.  That  is when the client says "wow" in serendipitous reponse to unexpectedly great service especially if it overcomes the negative consequences of trying to do the right thing or a honest attempt to do that. Activities of this nature strenghten the relationship you are creating with the customer. My reaction to Michael's activity was "you're (expletive deleted) kidding me right"?Truly AVR must have other more worthy goals in mind then the forementioned.  Where do they find such highminded folks like Michael?  Do they seek to acquire brigands or good people of honor with strong moral compasses?  It feels like the former.Beware this location. They smile at you just before they thrust the dagger in your back.

title: Bait and Switch.
text: Bait and Switch.. Buyer Beware. My contract agreement and reservation confirmation states UNLIMITED MILES. I booked a couple months in advance, however at arrival the person informed me it was NOT unlimited miles.  Being the Friday before Spring Break, there were no other rentals available at other companies. There were 3 other people in line with the same issue.  The van was dirty, one seat had orange stains and one seat buckle was missing the holding receptacle, so now we have enough seats and NOT enough seat belts. I had to end up bringing my personal vehicle in addition to the van rental on vacation to keep everyone safe. Upon return of the vehicle, I asked ( and videoed) me asking for a copy of my SIGNED rental agreement. After consulting with an attorney that specializes in Consumer Protection Laws, I was advised to get a copy.  The attendant refused to give me a copy of the signed agreement and threatened to call the police.  I have everything on video. I could not believe they would hold me to these terms and NOT EVEN give me a copy of the agreement that i signed?? So many ethical issues here, I hear a Class Action Lawsuit down the road for this company.   Lesson Learned. Never Again. Save yourself the money and the trouble and book with a more ethical company. I wish I could post a picture of my rental confirmation that shows the big green check mark next to the all caps UNLIMITED MILES indicated. #SoWrong Rated5stars so  it would show up on their website. They only post the five and four stars. I believe in full disclosure !

name: Randi
title: Pick up and vehicle were great, return was a mess with POOR customer service
text: The pick up process was easy and the folks were friendly, we did have to wait a bit for the shuttle from the airport, but that's ok as we did not have anything on the agenda for the remainder of the day.  The drop off experience, however, was less than satisfactory.  Due to an early flight we needed to utilize the after hours option, we were there only 1 hour before regular business hours so there was no one there to do a walk around and finalize the rental fro us.  A couple of days later when we received the final settlement of the bill we noticed we were charged a $100 cleaning/smoking fee.  NONE of us smoked in the vehicle or would have even thought about it as we are not smokers. Addi tonally I was 6 months pregnant at the time and traveling with my 6 year old child and family including my mom who is a 2x breast cancer survivor. We are NOT smokers.  We went around and around for almost 2 weeks with the Long Beach airport locations and even corporate customer service, before the ridiculous and accusatory fee was refunded.  There was a slight smell to the vehicle upon pick up, but it was one of a cleaning solution and ABSOLUTELY DID NOT resemble the smell of smoke what so ever, as I would not under any circumstances have accepted the vehicle if that were the case.  Overall the experience was very good up to that point, the van was spacious, comfortable, and suited out needs perfectly for the trip.  However, as previously stated the return process and customer service received from the Long Beach Airport drop off site was a nightmare.

name: Sarah
title: consider yourselves WARNED!!!!!
text: Upon arriving at the Denver airport with my infant and toddler, we drug all 400 of our bags out to the curb, as instructed. Waited about 10 min in the Denver winter weather (15°) for a van to show up and say, sorry, they were full, but another van would be along shortly. We watch the rotation of the other cans come and go three times. Thirty minutes later, a shuttle arrived to take us to the off airport location.. by this point my kids were both screaming and we were ready to get out of the cold.We were supposed to have had a 7 passenger suburban, or similar reserved. They said, they didn’t actually have any of those right then, so they gave us. 5 passenger SUV instead. We were traveling with 3 adults and 2 children in car seats. My husband is 6’4” WITH our ski equipment. The registration person told us, if we wanted to upgrade, it would be an additional $350!! That was more than we reserved the entire week for.. so my husband and I did our best to squeeze in all the luggage and seats. I ended up riding the entire 6 hour drive to the ski resort with my legs curled up at my chest, crammed between two car seats.The morning we were supposed to leave, there was a huge winter storm that blew in, shutting down the interstates for almost a day. We finally were able to leave that night. We had called and let them know of the situation at the time, but when we arrived, they charged extra for being late!!!!I will NEVER use them again. No matter how great of a deal it seems, they will end up tripling your cost by the end. Don’t do it!!!

title: Horrible experience
text: Horrible experience! It took almost two hours from the time I called for the shuttle until I drove away in the rental.  The first issue we ran into was that the company called us an Uber/Lift to pick us up from the airport, which made us feel obligated to tip the driver. I had called ahead and asked about the additional driver policy and was told there was no charge for up to 4 drivers. When I arrived I was told I would be charged extra just to have one extra driver and that he had to ability to adjust that rate.  I explained that I called, showed the agent the call on my phone, but he refused to fix it until I basically demanded he call a manager, whom confirmed their policy had changed and that I should not be charged. The agent then adjusted the rate. Then on the contract I was given the rates did not match the Expedia agreement I had. The agent once again said he could not tell me why and that that was the rate. Once again I asked for a manager, he then gave me a phone number to call the manager who was located in a different office. After holding forever, someone else in their office spoke with me and I emailed them a copy of my Expedia agreement. She said she would receive it and call me back. We sat there waiting, finally I went back to the counter and asked what was going on and he told me she had called him and told him to adjust it, that there was an error in their system and I was being charged a duplicate tax. Horrible horrible customer service. Never again! Stay away!

He had me sign the paperwork then we went to inspect the vehicle so I could be on my way. The vehicle appeared to be in good shape from the outside. When I loaded my bag into the trunk of the midsize SUV, I noticed they had done a poor job of airing out the vehicle which still had the faint smell of cigarette smoke looming. I rolled the windows down and started on my road trip. Two hours into the road trip I decided to check the paperwork and found that they had put down limited mileage. I immediately called them and told them that the website I had reserved it on said unlimited mileage. Their argument was that it is only unlimited if you have proof of a plain ticket. This was not mentioned anywhere on the website I reserved the vehicle on.  Not only were they  unaccommodating, but they were unapologetic for the way they had misrepresented free mileage on the website I made the reservation on. After discussing things with them I figured out that with the overage fees from the additional mileage I was planning on driving my total was going to be over twice as much. title: Awful experience with Wisecars
text: I had an awful experience with Wisecars where the customer service was also extremely unhelpful. First, they screwed up my booking, where I had selected to collect the car from Heathrow and return at St Pancras. When I received the booking voucher 48 hours before the trip, I was surprised the returning location was changed to Heathrow. When I called in, the customer service just shared he wasn't able to change the booking and asked whether I wanted to cancel the booking. I had to call Enterprise to change the return location myself. The second surprise was upon car collection where Enterprise was pushing to take up their insurance as they would claim against me if anything happened and I would have to claim myself with Wisecars, which was not mentioned upfront during the booking process. The insurance coverage was also not sufficient for car's value. Although their policy stated I could cancel the insurance coverage any time up till collection, they didn't honor it when I called in to cancel the insurance coverage. I haven't received the refund up till today. In then end i had to pay an additional 560 pounds to Enterprise for their insurance coverage, premium rental location fee & VATe.Rachel's response was "Any additional insurance requirements from the supplier can be found in the terms and conditions that are accepted during the booking process. We always encourage customers to review these details to ensure they meet their needs before completing a reservation." If Wisecars is genuine on providing a good & trustworthy service, all these important details should be stated clearly in booking process when they are selling various types of insurance package to allow a customer to make an informed decision as the customer will not be well versed with the details of the arrangement between Wisecars and the car rental company. There is no way for a customer to know that the insurance coverage is not sufficient for the car's value although the customer is buying the comprehensive package as the car model is not fix upon booking and the customer will also not be aware that the insurance package is not from car rental's insurance company.It was an extremely bad experience, and I will recommend anyone to avoid renting through Wisecars in order not to have a bad experience at the start of your holiday.

title: Misleading practices and had to fight for refund – Extremely Disappointed
text: I recently booked a rental car through Wisecars and had an extremely negative experience. The provider listed on my voucher was CarQ Rent a Car, but upon arrival to the site on November 22, 2024, I was redirected to Miami Life Cars, a company infamous for scamming customers (verified by numerous negative Yelp reviews). Had I known the actual provider’s name, I would never have accepted this booking.Despite providing all required documentation, including my third-party liability (TPL) coverage through Progressive Insurance, the rental company refused to honor the booking unless I purchased their own TPL coverage. I even went the extra mile by contacting Progressive twice, and their agents confirmed to the front desk person that my insurance was valid and transferable to the rental car. The rental company still rejected it, making the booking impossible to use.I contacted Wisecars on the spot to report the issue and request a refund. They promised to investigate and follow up by November 23. After not receiving an update, I wrote to them again on November 25 to request the refund. They finally contacted me on November 28, denying the refund request, and calling this event a “no-show”, even though the rental provider’s behavior was completely unreasonable and contrary to the agreement.Wisecars misrepresented the rental provider, failed to resolve the issue, and refused to take responsibility for their partner’s predatory practices. This experience has left me deeply frustrated, and I strongly caution others against booking through Wisecars. They do not stand behind their bookings or protect their customers from dishonest practices by their partners.Choose another platform if you value transparency, accountability, and peace of mind.UPDATE: After posting negative reviews with my experience on several sites, Wisecars contacted me & will refund the money for the booking. They then repeatedly requested I remove these negative reviews, as they had "resolved the issue from their side". I'm thus updating this review. Overall, the experience was still extremely negative, as it left us scrambling to find an expensive rental car last-minute during Thanksgiving week & then having to fight to get the refund that should have been at the very least inmediately offered.They also went ahead and flagged this review as containing defamatory content after I added the update, even though everything in it is accurate.

text: If it were possible to give zero stars I would, as this is a company that does not honour its bookings and is to be avoided at all costs.I made a booking on 27th July 2024 for Geneva airport, where I planned to rent a car for a week in January 2025. I was quoted a price of £212 from Wisecars, and paid the cost in full.On 6th September ‘24, I received an email from Wisecars out of the blue, stating that Dollar/Thrifty was «currently experiencing challenges with vehicle availability» and that «we could not find a suitable alternative for you. However, we encourage you to try picking up the car as planned, as availability may be restored by the time of your arrival. » The email went on to say «If vehicles become available when you arrive, please inquire with the counter staff. If for any reason you cannot use your existing reservation with the voucher, you may make a new reservation directly with them.»It was clearly ludicrous advice to suggest just turning up in Geneva airport and hoping for the best.Having rented vehicles from Geneva multiple times in the past, it was utterly implausible that there were no vehicles available for a booking made 6 months in advance, or that this could be forecast 4 months before the pickup date.  This was backed up by the fact that I could use a different agent to book exactly the same class of car, on exactly the same dates, but at a higher price than had been agreed with Wisecars.  It was therefore obvious that Wisecars was trying to renege on the booking contract, so I emailed them twice over the following week to challenge this.  It took 4 and 3 days respectively for them to come back with any response, but when they did, it was the same implausible story. This time, however, the problem was being blamed on a completely different rental company from before (Hertz!!).I asked Wisecars to refund my money on 16th September ‘24 and at the time of posting this review on 28th September, the money has still not been repaid to my credit card.  As a frequent traveler, I’ve rented countless vehicles from countless different booking agents, but NEVER has this ever happened.Wisecars just cannot be trusted to honour a booking and I will never use them again.  Turns out Wisecars are nothing more than Wiseguys.UPDATE POSTED 30TH SEPTEMBER 2024, 17.54hrs GMT.      Despite Rachel’s response today, and her assurances that the refund should now be in my account, despite Wisecars’ claim that it was processed on 19th September, THE REFUND REMAINS UNPAID.  How much more unreliable can this company possibly be??UPDATE POSTED 1ST OCTOBER 2024. Thank you Rachel.  I have sent you a screenshot from my credit card account, obtained today, which proves that the refund was only applied to my account on 30th September, a full 14 days after it was requested.The matter is now closed.

text: DO NOT BOOK CAR RENTALS WITH WISECARS. After a recent trip to CO, I'm still trying to understand this scammy business. I booked a rental with Wisecars and received TWO EMAILS that say this: "amount due now - 198.38. Amount due at pick-up $95.14" Total $293.52." Then (OF COURSE) at Thrifty Rental Cars at Denver Airport, we receive a rental agreement that says "Total estimated charges: $365.80." And then after our trip, we received an "updated receipt" that says: "Total amount due: $312.84" for a grand out of pocket total of $511.22. A BIG difference from "total: $293.52," right? BEWARE that there's no accounting for the first amount you'll pay (for us, $198.38), for which you receive a "voucher" that the actual rental car company (for us Thrifty) has NO idea about. We turned down extra insurance and made sure the car (unlimited miles) was gassed up before its return. It's true what they say, if it sounds too good to be true, it probably is. STAY AWAY!

name: Emily Silk
title: DO NOT FLY WIZZ AIR
text: DO NOT FLY WIZZ AIR. I wish I could give them zero stars. They clearly do not care about their customers and have predatory policies that are meant to squeeze every last cent out of you rather than provide good customer service. I understand that you get what you pay for here but that is no reason to have a no refunds policy no matter the circumstance. I had a flight credit left over from a previous flight that I had to cancel (I have never flown Wizz Air before this but the price was right until my unforeseen circumstances made led to my cancelation). I went on the app to book a new flight with my credits before they expired and as I was booking my flight I got an error message. I realized I was short a few credits and that I didn't have a credit card added to my account to cover it. So I added a credit card made sure the credits box was still checked and hit next and was charged THE FULL AMOUNT for the flight. I called Wizz Air to try to rectify the situation and I was told that Wizz Air has a no refunds policy without a hefty cancelation fee (even though I had booked a flex fare). When I told them it was an app issue they accused me of lying and saying they had no proof that I was intending to use the credits and thus there was nothing that could be done. I told them that if they refunded me I would be happy to stay on the phone and rebook that flight immediately to prove that I wanted to book the flight with credits. Instead of trying to find a solution with me I was refused the opportunity to speak to a manager, I was spoken over with scripted lines that did not address my concern, and then I was hung up on. Wizz air claims to be a completely digital platform but you cannot be if your app fails and there is no recourse when that happens. I ended up having to pay the cancelation fee (which was almost half the cost of the ticket) because at this point I would rather lose money that fly with an airline that treats its customers like this. So the price is never right here. Save your time and your sanity and book with Ryan Air, Easy Jet, or any other airline.

name: Nathan
title: They may appear cheap but they really aren't
text: We booked a holiday to Turkey through a 3rd party website and Wizz was the company flying us over there. On this 3rd party website it said we were aloud an onboard small luggage bag and a rucksack. When we arrived at the airport it turns out that they only allow a rucksack and you have to pay extra for the small suitcase which they call "priority" which at this point, was too late to do on their app and I ended up paying £113 to store 2 small suitcases in the baggage hold as we were already there and already had the 2 small suitcases. Bearing in mind i had already paid an extra 80 odd quid to take a large 20kg suitcase with me. So after finally sorting this out and getting on the plane it would seem that the cleaners took a day off as the floor was littered with crumbs and bits of this and that from the previous flight. Ok, its a cheap airline, im not expecting the Ritz. About 30 mins to an hour into the flight the food trolley comes out but by the time it had served about 10 people and got to me, oh what do you know, theyve got no sandwhiches left. Surely they would have thought ahead and stocked up on all items that are being advertised on the menu so there is enough food for everyone right? Turns out, no they dont stock up regularly. Its also worth mentioning that every other airline Ive flown with allow you to choose your own seats for free once the 24 hour check in window opens but that is not the case with Wizz, ohh no. Even when the check in opens you still have to pay to reserve any of the available seats or you will just have to sit where they randomly assign you to sit even though on the flight, everyone just gets up and sits where they want regardless. Anyway, we get to Turkey and i immediatly buy "priority" tickets on the app for the return flight which comes to a further 43 quid for the 2 suitcases as that is far cheaper than the £113 ive just had to pay at the airport, although still a piss take considering all this was originally advertised to me as included (fair enough, on the 3rd party website, not Wizz's). So on the way back to England, i dont know if this is because i paid priority or not but the woman at the lugge desk tells me i can put my small suitcases in the baggage hold for free if i want. Well ive already paid an additional 43 quid to take them on board with me so no, your alright ill do what ive already paid to do thanks. Once again, plane has crumbs and bits all over the floor and what do you know, still no sandwhiches on board. If you dont mind surving on pringles and nuts for 4 hours then this is the flight for you but i would like something a bit more substantial to be honest. So in summary: YES, they will get you there but youll likely have to pay for many hidden extras along the way and dont expect there to be much to eat on the plane because the flight 2 days ago have already eaten everything.

name: Madalina Verdes
title: Wizz Air’s 24-Hour Cancellation Policy is misleading
text: Wizz Air’s 24-Hour Cancellation Policy Is Misleading - I Ended Up Paying Twice for One FlightI’ve been flying with Wizz Air more than 15 times a year, and when you count the tickets I book for my family, it’s over 20 flights annually. I know the system, I respect their policies, but this time Wizz Air let me down completely.I accidentally reversed the departure and arrival cities on a booking and realized the mistake within just a few hours. I tried to cancel or change it immediately, and I was shocked.Their system only offered 334 RON back out of 1,620 RON. They kept over 95% of the ticket value. Their so-called “24-hour cancellation policy” is misleading and doesn’t protect honest mistakes.I had no choice but to pay a change fee of 848 RON, plus a fare difference, which brought me to paying almost double the cost of a normal ticket. I paid nearly the same amount again just to fly the route I originally meant to book.I contacted customer service, explained the situation, emphasized my loyalty, but they didn’t care. It felt like talking to a wall. I understand that the employees in customer support can only do so much and need to be backed by the right internal policies and clauses. But that’s exactly the issue: the company gives them no room to support loyal passengers, even when it’s clearly a minor and honest mistake.Wizz Air’s rules show zero flexibility or goodwill, even for frequent flyers. It’s not just about this one mistake, it’s about how a company treats its loyal customers when something small goes wrong.So be warned: Wizz Air will charge you for your ticket twice if you make a mistake, even if you notice it immediately. And they won’t care how many times you fly with them. There’s no loyalty. No fairness. Just profit.
