title: Very bad delay handling
text: Our Yerevan - Sofia flight was delayed for 5 hours, and waiting outside and inside the plane was very unpleasant. We were waiting at the gate for 3 hours and got 5 euro food vouchers (duly noted, that was a nice gesture). And then they started boarding but the plane was not ready at all. We were standing in line outside the plane for about 30 minutes watching the plane being cleaned and refuelled. Nobody explained anything, it was announced that the crew was going to be changed and we waited for the new crew to arrive for about 1.5 hours. The plane was very dirty, pieces of trash in the isle, the personnel was quite rude and the overall atmosphere not nice at all. Flight attendants were discussing the fact that in such "developing" countries as Armenia people don't have their voice and don't mind bad service (unlike Italians who always claim their rights in such situations). I had a “pleasure” of sitting next to flight attendants and listening to their chat. It was rather rude and unprofessional, I think. I understand that the new crew was brought to this plane against their will and they made an extra effort to make this flight happen, I thank them for that. But they could do a much better job at making this terrible experience more comfortable.There were many old people on board who didn’t understand what was going on and suffered from stress and delay. They tried to ask crew members questions but nobody spoke their language (Bulgarian speaking crew was substituted with Italian) and no attempts were made to translate or explain the situation to calm them down.I paid 200+ euro for this 2,5-hour flight and it was awful service for this money. This shouldn't happen in a decent air company, even low-cost one. Apologies are not enough, compensations are in place. It was my second flight with Wizzair and I was already starting to think it was OK based on the first flight, but was completely disappointed. In the future, I would prefer connecting flights of other companies rather than direct flights by Wizzair. Especially given the prices which are not low-cost at all! Shame on you people.

At the airport, I also had a travel document issued by the federal police as a passport replacement. The police said that there would be no problems with this. name: Steen Hanson
title: The WizzAir Scam
text: Cheap airlines have ways to regain the loss they may have suffered. In the case of WizzAir, the scam goes like this: When ordering the ticket, you are given a code you must use when checking in electronically 24 h before departure. A couple of days before departure the airline changes the flight information – in our case the departure time is not altered, but the arrival time at the destination is changed by five minutes! But on my way back I had to pay 80€ extra for my hand luggage even though I had already paid an additional fee when I booked my flight.As far as I'm concerned I had a free carry on bag and a trolley bag which was exactly the size shown on my boarding pass (55x40x23 cm) but the flight attendant at the gate didn’t care at all about the fact that I had already paid to be allowed to take the trolley with me. I couldn't believe it, in the end it cost me 130€ to take the trolley with me, it would be cheaper to send a package via post!

name: Maria Oinak
title: I don't use these airlines anymore
text: I don't use these airlines anymore. A few months ago my morning flight was delayed by 4 hours. I specifically rented a hotel near the airport to go there at night and then had to sit in the airport for another 4 hours.But that's okay, you know what you're getting into when you take low-cost carriers. But then I had a more interesting situation. I bought tickets for myself and two friends from Poland to Spain and on the second day I got a text message that the flight was cancelled. It took me a month to get my money back, as they first refunded for two people, and only after repeated appeals to support for the third person. Don't use Wizzair!

name: Tashvin Jugnarain
title: Poor in flight experience
text: The air hostess never served me any refreshments or food on the plane. She was serving other passengers and I kept looking at her but she never acknowledged me and never asked me If I wanted to buy something. I was in the aisle seat, so she could clearly see that I was looking at her. Instead, she served the other 2 passengers who were beside me. She clearly purposefully ignored me. I will call this a clear racist behaviour.I complained to the chief cabin crew. He listened to my complaint but he never got the air hostess to apologise.I wrote a complaint to Wizzair and this is what they replied:Dear customer,Thank you for your reply.Your complaint has been escalated to the relevant department.Internal company processes and decisions are business secrets and cannot be distributed or shared .If you have any further questions, please contact us again.Kind regards,Insert nameCUSTOMER SERVICE DEPARTMENT | Wizz Air Hungary Ltd.

name: DATS
title: Great experience.
text: I booked a return flight from London Gatwick to Venice Marco Polo and I am satisfied because they were both on time and reasonably priced (maybe because of the scheduled departure). Their app works perfectly and I had no issue completing the check-in.While onboarding, I have seen passengers being charged because of oversized luggage or bringing 2 bags (when you are not allowed to anyway) but generally the cabin crew were always polite and professional.I will use this airline in future should they keep this standard.

name: Dr Sundar Srikanth
title: Such a horrible airlines charges exorbitantly for spelling issues
text: This company needs to be shutdown immediately as they are charging exorbitantly for a spelling correction in the ticket,  making people stand for hours in queue for boarding even before the flight is in gate,  very unresponsive employees

title: First and LAST TIME we use WizzAir...
text: First and LAST TIME we use WizzAir...THEY ARE NOT AS CHEAP AS THEY APPEAR...THEY ARE NOT AS CHEAP AS THEY APPEAR...We booked LGW to AGP, as a couple... needed 1x hold bag while EasyJet make you buy 2x. So our thinking is they deliberately seperate you in a booking IF your don't pay extra to sit together...THEY ARE NOT AS CHEAP AS THEY APPEAR...THEY ARE NOT AS CHEAP AS THEY APPEAR...

name: Leo B.

text: I just talked to the call center (25 minutes) about a problem with the registration of my account and they just told me, that I should try it again and check, if I put in some wrong information. Everything is correct and working, but I don't get any confirmation code. She could not help me and hung up.

name: Bryony Bethell
title: Terrible air stewardesses on the flight…
text: Terrible air stewardesses on the flight from Budapest to Nice. Charmless. Making people put their ( compliant) bags in the tiny racks in an attempt to be able to charge them. Insisting on checking my neighbour through a second time after he passed the bag test. Avoid.

name: Valdis Beikmanis
title: Why to print a Boarding Pass?
text: Missed my flight from Istanbul Airport because of an unnecessary rule of getting a physical Boarding Pass from a counter. Internet is not working there, nobody knows where Wizzair is as they hire a representative who is not responsible for anything. Got myself same day replacement ticket from Sabiha Airport with Pegasus for a cheaper price. There is no need for paper Boarding Pass when you fly with Pegasus! Complaint procedure with Wizzair is complicated and unclear and wouldn’t get me anywhere. Wizzair used to move your flight date during Covid, so that’s my second disappointment. Will never use again.

name: Karan
title: My Disastrous Experience with Wizz Air
text: Where do I even begin with Wizz Air? My recent experience with this airline was nothing short of a nightmare. From the moment we arrived at the airport, it was clear that customer service was not a priority for them. The staff were unprofessional, rude, and seemed completely disinterested in assisting passengers.To make matters worse, any attempts to seek help or clarification from customer service were met with incompetence and dismissiveness. It was as if they were trained to evade responsibility and brush off genuine concerns.Overall, my experience with Wizz Air was a complete disaster. I strongly advise against anyone choosing this airline for their travels. The combination of subpar facilities, unhelpful staff, and a complete disregard for customer satisfaction makes Wizz Air the worst airline I have ever had the misfortune of flying with.

name: MissLondon MakeUp

text: They say it is cheap but luggage price is absolutely ridiculous and it is better at the total cost to have a better flight. It is not worth it to travel far with them.

name: ANONYMOUS
title: British passport holders and getting the boarding pass stamped with Wizz
text: Website said to get boarding pass (BP) stamped for non EU passenger( so after online check-in, BP needs to be printed as the digital one on a mobile phone cannot be physically stamped.) Which means that after Brexit, British passport holders are non EU passengers.So I went an hour earlier to Gatwick, asked for Wizz staff at their check-in counter to stamp the BP. They looked at me blankly and said that it does not apply to British passport holders! So why not clarify that on your website Wizzair? A lot of my time was wasted looking up advice regarding this and going to the airport early.On the plane the service was like any other budget airline so I didn't expect much as the ticket without any add-ons was cheap. But a lady sitting next to me asked about 30 mins after take-off if she could sit with her husband on  the row behind us. He was the only one on a row of three seats with two empty seats whereas we were in a row of three fully occupied seats. The Wizzair staff was abrupt and informed the lady that she needs to pay £20 if she wants to sit together with her husband. She obviously refused. Throughout the whole flight,her husband sat behind us on his own with two empty seats next to him and we sat three in a row. Very poor customer service Wizz. I appreciate that if anything goes wrong eg there is an emergency etc you need to know who was sitting where but other airlines are ok about passengers swopping seats. In fact on the same flight you yourself (Wizz staff) asked a very large man to sit by himself on the row where there was an emergency exit door and you told him that he may be asked to move if the need arises. He was fine about that but you couldn't let the lady sitting next to me move her seat which are randomly given. There is such a thing as being accomodating and giving a good service which is appreciated by the customers but Wizz make up the rules as and when they fancy.For a start, please make it clear on your website that British passport holdlers do not need their BP stamped before boarding. As for moving to an empty seat the lady was disgusted with the staff's attitude and quite rightly refused to pay the extra £20. Suffice to say that I won't be flying with Wizz again and doubt if the lady next to me would either.

name: ambuj pathak
title: Horrible airlines - stealing Ninjas
text: Horrible airline.I arrived at airport 3.5 hours early and stood for check in. I am told to come again when 2 hours are remaining. When returned back, I am 'extorted' 45 gbp each passenger stating that because I haven't checked yet, they will not allow me to onboard unless I pay the amount. When I said I can't do online, I am informed flight overbooked n you have to pay or loose flight - Total lie as I can see seats vacant in the flight. I have to pay n wondering how many other passengers are duped and arm-twisted like this.Website and app are extremely confusing and made in a way to extort money from you at each stage. Never again in my life I will use this airlines.They may look cheap but no, the intention is to ruin your vacation and extort money where you are least expecting and in worst possible way.What can explain more that none of the staff member at airport say that they are from wizz air or even the checkin bag.Seen several grunting passengers who were rudely ill-treated and for minor over weight were forced to pay high cash while on boarding.

name: Marva Salmon
title: Never travel with Wizzair!
text: Dissatisfied with the service provided by Wizzair their poor service led to a series of unfortunate events and additional costs that could have been avoided with proper communication. Firstly, we were in contact with Rayman from their team, who assured us that upgrading to priority would cost £32 per person. However, upon calling back to finalize this upgrade, we were informed of an unexpected additional CCTF charge of £13, which was not previously disclosed. This lack of transparency is unacceptable and has resulted in unexpected expenses.Furthermore, we were advised by Alex, another representative from Wizz, that having a passport with less than six months of validity would simply require a discussion with immigration authorities. Contrary to this advice, upon our arrival at Luton airport's front desk, we were informed that entry could be denied. This discrepancy in information caused us a two-hour delay as the front desk staff had to contact Turkish authorities for clarification. To our dismay, upon arrival in Turkey, we were fined £135 due to the passport having only four months of validity left.This was particularly distressing and anxiety-inducing for my sister, as we had been assured by Wizz that there would be no additional fees. The miscommunication of such critical information has not only caused emotional distress but also financial strain. We believe that Wizz has a responsibility to provide accurate and complete information to its customers.The miscommunications we experienced are serious oversights that have significantly impacted our travel experience

God I hope I will never have to use them again.

text: I went from dubai to bucharest and i got delayed 3 hours with one stop that wasent announce. After i got home i watch on fly tracker. They say the flight takes 5 hours but EVERY flight has at least 2 hours delayed. If you go to dubai just fly with other company.

title: I mistakly cancelled my booking and I…
text: I mistakly cancelled my booking and I lost €157, since they take 60€ cancellation fee and I lost it all since they won't do anything. BIG SCAM COMPANY. Never booking with WizzAir again. Freaking SCAM.

name: Sofia Peressotti
title: ABSOLUTE SCAM AND CUSTOMER SERVICE…
text: ABSOLUTE SCAM AND CUSTOMER SERVICE HANGS UP ON ME. Outbound: 30 PEOPLE in overbooking with 1 free seat. No hotel or food voucher, just an absolutely cumbersome process (still havent managed). Inbound: the website crashed 5 times in a row and gives me all sorts of errors. I could't add my own phone number to my booking and I had to start this extremely cumbersome process 5 times. On top of this, the website explicitely says I have 0 checked in bags so I buy one, to then find out I paid for this twice (44 EUR each). I call customer service to ask for a refund and they hung up on me in the middle of a sentence. The second time they say they do not care and that I could have read the T&C more carefully. The whole service is a scam to trick you into paying more. Terrible service all across the board, avoid at all costs. Airlines should stop exploit clients.

name: Sanja Molloy
title: Urgent Revision of seat allocation
text: I am always wondering how the seats are allocated if the passengers with special assistance are sitting with 2 people in their row. At the same time, some rows are  completely empty or  with one passenger only. It is so insensitive. In my opinion, the staff needs further training in establishing the needs and accommodating their passengers. That goes under an umbrella  a good customer service.

name: Dmitry
title: Beware of Misleading Credit Policies and Poor Communication
text: I recently faced a troubling issue with Wizz Air that I feel compelled to share. After purchasing a refundable ticket, I had to cancel due to a change in plans. Opting for a refund, I was given a credit to my Wizz Air account. Here’s where things went downhill.Firstly, the credit issued expired just three months later — a crucial detail that was not clearly communicated when I accepted the refund. I only discovered this when I tried to use the credit for a new booking, only to find it had vanished from my account.Moreover, I received no specific notification about the expiration date, despite being bombarded with promotional emails from Wizz Air. This lack of direct communication feels not just negligent but deceptive.Even more frustrating is the fact that this credit included taxes and airport fees for services that were never rendered. The retention of these funds by Wizz Air raises serious questions about their business ethics and compliance with EU consumer rights.I have tried resolving this issue through their customer service, only to be met with responses that reiterate their policy without addressing the core issues of transparency and fairness.For anyone considering Wizz Air, I advise you to tread carefully and double-check all terms, especially regarding refunds and credits. The lack of transparency and fair handling in my case has been disheartening and costly.

name: N.M.D
title: Wizzair purposely makes the check-in procedure unclear in order to make money
text: The managers/owners are making a massive mistake by running the company in such way that customers come out of the experience feeling scammed by Wizzair. We arrived at the Luton airport with a printed travel itinerary as the info about the check-in procedure was hidden in the bottom of the email in very small letters. We were charged £40 each for boarding passes at the airport.Now, wiser from the first flight, I checked in online (7 days before the return flight as the check-in showed open) and could not finalise the check in procedure without paying for seats for us!!!! If this is not trying to scam travellers into buying cheap flights and then being purposely unclear about the instructions about the check-in procedure, I do not know what is. I am gravely disappointed.

title: Delays
text: Hi all,I had a ticket for 13:55 from Gatwick to Istanbul on 18.04.2024. On my way to the airport, I received an email saying your flight has been delayed for 55 minutes. What they told me was shocking.Even if there is a delay, I have to be there on time, pass the gate, get on the plane and wait. I asked if there is 3 hours delay, then what? They gave me the same answer, you have to pass the gate on time. That is the most ridicillous thing I have ever heard.Let's imagine that rule makes sense, why you are acknogledging me about the delay in the first place? name: Mrs Lesley Dormer
title: Never fly with Wizz air
text: Paid for extra leg room seats. Boarding pass changed at last minute to standard leg room seats with no apology or reason. Tried explaining husband tall & cloustrophobic so needs extra room but no help given. Flight was delayed & queues for chick in were massive.

name: Adelina
title: Awful experience, high prices
text: There are a few low cost airlines in Europe, where you get what you pay for: small luggage, no food on board, pay extra for slightly bigger luggage, but their prices are actually low cost. And service is decent. But Wizzair in my experience is the most unprofessional and stressful of them all. The booking process is super complicated, there are so many steps, pop ups, add-ons that it takes at least half an hour to do a booking. It's so distracting and stressful to navigate. On my last flight they cancelled my return flight without giving any reason and rebooked me to a date that really wasn't doable. We got instructions on how to change but it didn't work. To reach Customer support costs a fortune/high surcharge, which can end up costing 20-30 euros at best. They should at least provide support when customers end up with cancelled/rebooked flights with no fault of their own. I couldnt find any way to get a refund in money, like serious companies would provide, to be able to gain access to that the best bet is wizz credits. When you pay 800 euros for tickets the last thing you want is company credits. I never understood how to actually get the money refunded.The staff on both trips were a bit unfriendly, their English was hardly understandable. At the airport people were visibly upset with the airline, I get taking the frustration on staff is not nice, but if someone would like to call to make a complaint you need to pay the surcharge so there's not much space for that.

STAFF KEEP LOOKING FOR PROBLEMS AND WANT TO CHARGE YOU FOR EVERYTHING AND ARGUE WITH YOU. Awful awful awful awful disgusting!!

name: Vanessza
title: Wizzair will lose your stuff and not pay
text: In 2023 February, on our return flight from Budapest to Edinburgh, WizzAir lost our sports equipment. At the airport we filed the necessary documents with the airport and the airline. Wizzair, kept sending us the same generic email to provide more evidence even though we had, many times. In addition, our complaint kept disappearing from their website, as if the dispute had been resolved. Finally, I took my issue to AviationADR, in the hopes they will see my problem, and finally be able to get an answer - and compensation - from WizzAir. The process was quite long, but very hassle free. I submitted all the evidence I had (claims, screenshots, emails) at the end of the summer. We finally got the well deserved compensation today. We are extremely happy and thankful, that finally someone managed to squeeze an answer (and money) out of the airline. Highly recommend using them if Wizzair doesn’t answer your claim!! But most importantly, Wizzair don’t use luggage tracking, so they actually have zero clue where you luggage is at any time during its journey. Don’t take hold luggage or sports equipment with them!!

name: Jan
title: These ratings should have 0 (zero) as…
text: These ratings should have 0 (zero) as an option. Because that’s exactly what Wizzair deserves. I just recently had my first and last EVER trip with them. It was horrendously bad! Had NEVER EVER had a flight like this before. Wizzair’s understanding of customer care was absolutely appalling!! They never listened or made NO attempt to understand what the customer was saying. The cabin manager and one flight attendant were unbelievably unprofessional and childish yet somewhat so condescending in their communication style that it was just comical. It felt as if the management had placed a few kids from a kindergarten for a role play. What a pity!

name: Eva Huml
title: Never know if or when you'll fly
text: I used to fly wizz air a lot because they had a bunch of destinations from Vienna, but over the last two years their reliability has collapsed. You never know if the flight you book will actually take place and if so, if the schedule will be vaguely the same as what you booked. Examples from the last few months:1.Flight Vienna-Varna Sept. 23: cancelled in August2.Flight Vienna Barcelona December 23: schedule so significantly changed that I couldn't fly3. Flight Vienna Barcelona January 24: schedule so significantly changed that I couldn't fly4. Flight Vienna to Bilbao February 24- schedule changes by a few hours, info email terribly misleading not making the cancellation option visible, so I flew5. Flight Vienna to Bilbao March 24: flight changes by a few hours6. Flight Vienna to Burgas April 24: cancelled7. Flight Vienna to Burgas May 24: cancelled8. Flight Vienna to Barcelona May 24: flight postponed by 6 hours, so I'm practically losing a whole dayOverall, in the last year I have virtually not had a flight that they didn't cancel or reschedule.

name: Maria C.
title: Low Cost? NO.
text: I bought a return ticket with Wizzair. When checking in online I upgraded my seats, for which I paid €58. When trying to complete my check in, the message "flight overpaid" appears, as the system did not assumed thee payment of the extra amount as a seat upgrade. They didn't let me check in online. At Lisbon airport, they verified the error and checked me in, free of charge, saying that the problem had been resolved. In Budapest, when I try to check in online, the same message appears and I am not allowed to check in online. I called customer support, (a added value number) to the number indicated on the website for Portugal, and it says it doesn't work. I went to the airport, where there is no company office (but they say they´re the biggest hungarian air line company). name: Renata from London
title: Unreliable in handling cancellation through its own fault
text: Wizz changed the time of my flight to very late in the day, which meant I couldnt take it. In their email, they provided for an option of refunding 100% of my money if I cancel. I did, and requested it; it was meant to happen via Wizz Credits "allowing up to two weeks". Wizz will try to sway you into receiving Wizz Credits rather than money by promising 120% of the fare, but I turned it down. In any case, do not trust Wizz's promises! A month and a half later, I discovered the money was not converted from the credits. I used some when booking another flight, then lodged a complaint - a painful, long-winded process. The first time, I was rejected, with incorrect justification (the case handler would not understand that the cancellation was not due to me, but due to Wizz's disruptive flight change). I got nowhere. As they closed the case, I lodged the complaint again. I would have received the money this time, if I didnt spend some of the credits already. Lessons: 1. Do watch Wizz like a hawk, they try not to deliver on their promises! 2. If you get nowhere with your complaint, let them close it down and open a new one, hoping for a slighly more competent claim handler. 3. If Wizz fail to transfer the temporary Wizz Credits to your credit card as money, do not spend them but complain till they do.

title: Terrorized by Rodents
text: I am posting my review here because Vacasa did not post it on their site.  Our vacation reservation was in May 2025.  When we arrived, the grounds were lovely with lilies and other wild flowers lining the walkway in a secluded neighborhood.  The ocean view radiated a serene atmosphere.  Upon entering the rental, it appeared to be clean with the exception of the window blinds and closet bifold doors.  They had “caked-on” grime.  The shelves weren’t as bad, but still dusty.  However, the kitchen and bathroom sinks and showers were clean.  There were no screens on the windows in the upstairs rooms or living room and kitchen so we weren’t able to air the house out without bugs flying in.  We didn’t realize before renting that it was a three-story home and you had to climb steep stairs either way to get to a bedroom.  It’s an old house and could use some TLC.  Unfortunately, our stay became a nightmare beginning with the first evening.  We noticed after the fact that in 2016, another vacationer wrote a review about how they could hear mice scratching behind the walls. Well, as eyewitnesses there in 2025, the mice were liberated and found their way through the walls. The first night at 11:00 pm, as I was relaxing on one of the couches, I saw a mouse run into the living room.  It saw me and turned around and ran back into the entryway.  I immediately contacted Vacasa that night and they sent pest control out the following day.  The pest control person set some traps in the house and caught two.  We thought we were good to go, but then again around 11:30 pm the next evening while coming out of the downstairs bathroom getting ready to call it a night, I saw a robust mouse run down the stairs heading straight for me.  Looked like it was traveling at lightning speed, almost in flight. Apparently, this was its routine and neither it nor I was expecting to see each other. As it landed, I scared it, it scared me and I saw it make a hard skid in time to slide under the door track right before it could touch my foot. It was quite creepy and traumatizing, sending my bp soaring. I contacted Vacasa, but they offered no solutions.  We are two seniors and it was a 4-hour drive home. Needless to say, we were stuck and didn’t get much sleep.   We left our vacation early.  Vacasa did not check in with us at any time to see if we were okay, offer a partial refund, nothing. The one positive thing is the pest control person. He was very supportive and even gave us his personal number to contact him at any time if we saw another mouse.  Unfortunately, whatever charm the rental first held was ruined by the rodent problem. One would hope Vacasa would at least offer a discount or something for our negative experience.  The price wasn’t cheap.  Since the incident happened, and through many inquiries on our part, Vacasa has still not responded.  We’ve lost complete confidence in renting from Vacasa.

title: Vacasa has its positives and negatives
text: Vacasa has its positives and negatives.  Positive is they were very easy to get ahold of when our code to get in our unit was not working.    A new code was sent and we were able to access our unit.   The unit was very clean and we enjoyed our stay!      The negative with Vacasa was their lack of flexibility.    Our daughter was graduating college which is why we booked this home.    Her pinning ceremony was on the day we checked in, 5/2 and it started at 4 pm.    Check in time was at 4 pm.   We asked for an accommodation, early check in, for an hour earlier as we have a dog that could not be taken to the pinning ceremony.    We were told no - the HOA had rules about early check in, which, after staying there I question if there was a HOA at all.     I asked about renting the day before (5/1) and was told I could do that.   The cost was way more than the advertised price on the website - by more than $100.00.   I questioned the higher price and I was told it was due to a cleaning fee.  I told them they didn't have to clean more than once as we would be staying the whole weekend and I was already paying the cleaning fee.    I was told that was the price although the gentleman I was speaking with understood my frustration with the duplicate fees.      I opted to speak with my husband before booking the extra day and got back to Vacasa that very evening via email letting them know I wanted to book the extra day.    I was emailed back that the extra night was no longer available.      I continued to check the website periodically and noted that the unit was advertised as available all the way up through 5/1.    I can only surmise that because I questioned the fees when I first inquired about the extra day, I was blocked from getting the extra day even though I said I would pay the extra fees.     Everything did work out.   I was able to accommodate my dog while we were at our daughter's pinning ceremony.   But it did leave a bad taste in my mouth.  It felt like because I questioned the extra cleaning fees, I was blocked from renting the obviously available home one extra day which would have been additional money to the homeowner of this lovely home as well as Vacasa.

text: We thoroughly enjoyed this older home during our 8 day stay. With two floors, our family of 6 had lots of room, and we enjoyed the private pool and dock. Our 8 year old had a lot of fun in the pool, but the older kids didn’t spend much time in it because of its small size and shallow depth. The pool and grounds were well maintained. Water pressure in the house fluctuated quite a bit, but was adequate for showering, and we never ran out of hot water. The WiFi wasn’t great, and often my laptop worked better when it was paired to my phone, which had a 2 bar cellular connection. We lost utility power for over an hour one night, but weathered the situation without difficulty. It would have been nice to have had candles available, but they were provided the next day. Our Vacasa concierge Gineli was very helpful in addressing our many questions, and had good tour recommendations. We loved being on Ambergris Caye, with its natural beauty and quaintness, and the fun of driving a golf cart all over the island. Our stay at View the Blue house fit in well with the rest of the experience. Its minor deficiencies were negligible, and we really appreciated the privacy that it afforded us. I would highly recommend this Vacasa rental.

text: I am writing to file a formal and urgent complaint regarding my current stay at a Vacasa-managed property in Orange Beach, Alabama.Before booking, I contacted Vacasa directly to confirm that the outdoor pool at the property would be open during our stay. I was explicitly told that it would be. This was a critical factor in choosing this condo, as I have stayed here before and booked it specifically for the pool— my small children prefer the pool to the Gulf, and it plays a major role in our vacation experience.We arrived six days ago and were shocked to find out that the pool has been closed for two years. I was misled by your team, and it’s clear now that I was given false information. To say this has disrupted our vacation is an understatement — it has completely altered our plans, frustrated my children, and caused significant disappointment for our family.Since our arrival, I have been in constant communication with Vacasa. Over the past six days, I have received nothing but vague reassurances and empty promises that someone would “follow up.” To this day, I am still waiting. Not only was I lied to before booking, but now my ongoing concerns are being ignored. This is more than poor customer service — it’s gross negligence and a failure to uphold basic accountability to your guests.I have documented proof, including screenshots of the communication, where I asked about the pool and was told it would be open. I am more than willing to share those as part of this complaint.I am requesting a timely and sincere response to this matter, along with an appropriate resolution and explanation. I believe Vacasa has a responsibility to provide accurate information and to address guest concerns with integrity and care. I hope this situation can be handled professionally and fairly, and I welcome the opportunity to share the documentation of our communication to assist in resolving this issue.Edit: to your reply: it is no longer about the pool but your lack of getting back to me and misleading me about the pool. Please take responsibility for YOUR actions not that the pool was closed.

text: We recently stayed at Stirling Shores condo 315. The unit was clean, and we enjoyed the beautiful pool area and convenient beach access. The hall bathroom sink has visible cracks, and the master bathroom’s sink drain wasn’t functioning properly. We also noticed the microwave’s interior was badly discolored, which made us hesitant to use it.We reached out to the property manager, who kindly offered to send maintenance, though the timing wasn’t ideal during our trip. It seemed like the repairs would require more time than a quick fix.One concerning incident was returning from the beach to find the front door partially open, apparently due to maintenance work that was done while we were out. While nothing was missing, the lack of notice made us uncomfortable.The location and views are great, and with some attention to these maintenance items, this condo could offer a really enjoyable stay. name: LB
title: Stone Wall Mountain - Eureka Springs, AR - JUST SAY NO
text: To say we were disappointed would be an understatement. We had 7 people staying here and everyone was super excited after seeing the pictures etc. of the property. Once we got there and began to bring our things in all that excitement went right out the door when everyone in different parts of the house began seeing things such as multiple holes in the walls, broken chairs, a broken table (with a TV on it no less I might add), broken tile in many different spots (with sharp edges), broken window, missing or broken knobs on the appliances, the back door frame falling down due to wood rot, a nice hole in the front porch roof due to wood rot, the back door handle loose/broke, a “hot” tub with a tarp that looked like it may have been on it but when we arrived we found the tarp in the yard and the “hot” tub was 78 degrees…… and just the overall dirtiness of the place in general.Everyone got a good laugh out of the Vacasa Door hanger we found that stated “This Home has been cleaned to Vacasa Premium Clean standards by our professional local home care team” If this is truly the case then they either hired “blind” cleaning people or Vacasa seriously needs to reevaluate their “Premium Clean Standards” as nothing about the house was clean. The were dead bugs that we cleaned up in many areas around the house on the floor and window seals, spider webs throughout, something that was spilled on the kitchen counter that was sticky, crumbs and food on the couches in the living room, a bathtub that looked like it had hair and mold around the jets, a grill that was flat out disgusting and took us a good 25 mins to clean it before we even wanted to use it to cook on…..basically things that if they had truly cleaned this place there is absolutely no way you would have missed this stuff.We took pictures of many of the items we saw after we checked in and texted them to the Vacasa number only to be told that the “local team” would reach out to us shortly and that they had created a ticket to have the issues taken care of “right away”. We never heard back from anyone locally and they also asked if it was ok for maintenance to enter the home when nobody is there and we told them that was fine. I will add we never heard a word back from Vacasa about the issues reported or from anyone local for our stay so I am not holding out much hope that they will actually address most of this stuff.The sad part about this is the fact that the house has a lot of character, and I feel it could really be a nice place to stay and relax but it truly needs some TLC before it should be rented out again. Numerous items either need to be fixed/repaired or thrown out, I mean come on the dining room table has a chair in plain view where the arm was completely broken by a previous guest and it has a nice screw sticking out of it, the TV is sitting crooked on a table with a broken leg that if you move it away from the couch I am certain it would fall, there is tile in multiple locations with broken and missing pieces including one by the shower that actually has sharp edges and we had to cover it with a towel as we were concerned someone would slice their foot open getting out of the shower.  Numerous holes in the walls, a broken window etc. etc. You get the point…..I am sure this review will not really get much done at the property as it looks like many of these issues have been like this for quite some time…..we even found notes from previous guests complaining about many of these issues quite some time ago yet they obviously were never addressed and/or fixed. The “Manager” responses on previous reviews state that they have taken many of the same things I mention here into account and brought it up with the local operations manager, yet the issues are still here so obviously they don’t care to fix these items. (Here’s an idea…..maybe find a new operations manager?!?!) They also comically state that “We are dedicated to maintaining our homes to the highest standards, and your feedback plays a crucial role in helping us identify areas for improvement“ yet again, nothing looks to have changed with many of these items and from the sounds of it this home has been in need of some TLC and repair for quite some time.I would highly recommend anyone looking to come to Eureka Springs and stay at this property to look elsewhere until Vacasa and ownership seriously investigate fixing things and cleaning this property up.P.S. this same review was sent to Vacasa but they have yet to post it. I find it funny they can respond here within a day, but I posted to their site 3 weeks ago and they have yet to post the review. They also state the same thing over and over in their responses.  "They take the concerns very seriously and the review has been shared with the property manager to address all issues reported"....yet many others have reported the same issues, and they are still not fixed.

name: Biggie G
title: A Deeply Disappointing Stay
text: A Deeply Disappointing Stay – Proceed With CautionWhat was meant to be a meaningful, celebratory weekend for our family turned into a series of frustrations that left us feeling ignored, disrespected, and thoroughly disheartened. I wouldn’t recommend this property to anyone—especially not when there are far better-run hotels and Airbnbs in the area that actually care about their guests’ experience.1. Inflexible and Unaccommodating Staff:We had requested an early check-in, as our daughters were flying in from opposite coasts for a rare and precious family reunion to celebrate both my husband’s and my daughter’s boyfriend’s birthdays. Given that we were also required to check out four hours earlier than usual, we hoped for even the smallest gesture of flexibility. Instead, we were met with robotic, unsympathetic rigidity. No effort was made to work with us or even acknowledge the nature of our request. It felt cold, impersonal, and frankly out of touch with the spirit of hospitality.2. Misleading Listing – No Central Air Conditioning:The listing makes no mention of the fact that the home lacks central air conditioning. In a region known for warm weather, this is a basic amenity guests reasonably expect—especially when the price point suggests a level of comfort and convenience that simply wasn’t delivered. This omission is deceptive at worst, negligent at best.3. Power Outage – Zero Support or Contingency Plan:Midway through our stay, we experienced a power outage that lasted close to six hours. We were left without lights, appliances, functioning bathrooms, or any kind of communication or guidance from the property managers. There was no offer to assist, no resources shared—just silence. For guests paying premium prices, being left to navigate a blackout with no support is unacceptable.4. Appalling Customer Service and Disrespectful Communication:Adding insult to injury, my father received an email from a member of the administrative team that was riddled with typos, poorly formatted, and dripping with condescension. Rather than address our concerns with professionalism and respect, the tone was dismissive and patronizing. It was as though they forgot they were in the hospitality industry altogether.Final Verdict:This was by far the most disappointing vacation rental experience we’ve encountered—and we travel often. The combination of misrepresented amenities, poor communication, inflexible policies, and outright disrespect is inexcusable. If you’re considering staying here, I strongly encourage you to look at one of the many hotels or other Airbnbs in the area. You will almost certainly receive better service, clearer communication, and a more hospitable environment elsewhere. This property simply isn’t worth the headache.

text: This trip was important to us for personal reasons. The purpose of this special 5-day stay was to get away, forget the issues we are facing and relax. Unfortunately, the shower pressure on the old fashion shower curtain in the master bathroom caused water to shoot onto the floor which was quite slippery. When Cathy came out of the shower she fell, hurting her knees. There was quite a bit traffic noise on the main road, even heard in the master bedroom which was facing the water. More annoying was multiple days when there were workers on the outside of the building one floor beneath us drilling and hammering - repairing the window of another unit. When I came down to the office on the second floor, while very nice, they told me that unit was not in their realm of responsibility. text: We worked with Vacasa as vendors during the New Year period and cleaned 20 homes in just 3 days in Government Camp to help them manage the holiday rush. We even reached out to Crista Kaplis, their GM at Mt. Hood, but the communication trail went cold.They do not answer, do not respond, and clearly have no urgency or accountability when it comes to paying the people who actually keep their operations running.If you’re a vendor thinking of working with Vacasa — think twice. text: We had a reservation at The Lanai King - Windsor at Westside in Orlando, managed by VACASA, checked in on March 25, 2025. They told us a tech would come out and check it out. At around 5:30 pm a tech came out and told us that the ac had no fixing that he would call the property manager to have us relocated.About an hour goes by and we hear NOTHING, we called again and were told another tech was coming out toCheck out the ac at around 7:50 pm.Our hands were tied, we had not had dinner, we had two small children and 4 teens, we were not going to leave the house with our belonging there so we waited for the second tech to show up. The tech showed up at around 7:30pm and told us that the ac had no fixing. name: Dhruv Patel
title: BED BUGS! Amazing stay turned horrible with extremely disappointing corporate support!
text: It started with a seemingly normal stay in Mammoth Lakes, CA (Meadow Ridge 37 (VRBO Property # 2451906)): easy check-in, property well-maintained, no issues! Everything you’d expect from a corporate conglomerate of VRBO and Vacasa Property Management. We arrived on Wednesday and stayed till Sunday for a ski weekend.On Friday morning, some folks in our group started noticing hives and rashes on their bodies. We just figured it was environmental - maybe brushing up against some pine, maybe pollen, or something they ate. Everyone was itchy and took plenty of OTC meds, but limited help.On Sunday morning, we proceeded to start the check-out process and discovered bed bugs under one of the mattresses!! We squished a few of them and noticed blood coming out of them - which was our rudimentary validation of what caused the hives….they were indeed bed bug bites.We called VRBO and Vacasa and were told that we can evacuate the property and the local team would come check on the situation and give us a call to discuss next steps.It’s been over a week at this point. Limited to no communication from Vacasa, VRBO threw up their hands and said it wasn’t their problem, and now we’ve been punted off to 2 different companies (Sedgwick and Rental Guardian)….with little to no actual communication or response.Honestly, we’re just looking for a little courtesy in letting us know how to navigate this situation and playing fairly given a lot of inconvenience, very likely bed bug infestation in our clothes and homes, and really bad daily medical issues. It seems as though Vacasa and VRBO are not interested in taking this situation seriously and really dropping the ball, in addition to blatantly breaking their respective terms and conditions - which articulate “clean and safe” stays and properties.I’m hoping this post will get someone’s attention that can help work through our situation. To date, the only people we’re aware of that are involved are the Assistant Manager for Vacasa in Mammoth Lakes) and Qualified Manager, CA license #2B88261 who is part of Sedgwick Claims Management Services, Inc., CA license #2549023).

name: Adam Mott
title: Vacasa - False Advertisement
text: We booked Sunflower Unit 111 in Steamboat Springs for our winter vacation. We chose this unit because of its slope side location and the Vacasa Shuttle Service that was advertised as being included. Prior to booking we confirmed the shuttle service was in fact included, and we confirmed again prior to making our final payment. Having stayed in Steamboat with Vacasa the year before, we knew how important the shuttle was with 2 toddlers. With a rental car not an option for us Floridians because of the snowy roads, Ubers not an option because of the lack of car seats, and the city bus not a great option because more often than not it requires long walks from the closest bus stop to our actual destination as well as wait times for the bus alongside busy roads in the snowy freezing elements - there isn’t a reasonable alternative to the shuttle when traveling with small children. That is why the shuttle was so important to us and our 10 day vacation, and one of the main reasons we booked this unit at this elevated price. When we arrived, we contacted the shuttle so we could go get groceries, and we were informed that the shuttle service was no longer offered. We called Vacasa customer service and requested to speak with a local manager to try and find a fair solution. We shared screenshots of our text and email communications with Vacasa that clearly documented the service as included. We were told multiple times, via multiple follow up calls that we would be contacted by someone local, but that never happened. We called and emailed each day, for the first 3 days of our stay, until it was evident there was not going to be a fair resolution. Vacasa did email us on the 4th or 5th day of our stay to inform us that they were going to credit us $180 for the inconvenience, and as a result, they were closing out the complaint. As a result of Vacasa’s handling of this we were forced to find private transportation, and my wife and I had to split up to take Ubers for grocery runs etc., and use the City bus when appropriate as a family. The cost of the private transportation and Uber rides were over 10x the credit that we received. We would have never booked this rental had the shuttle service been accurately advertised, and had the reservation agents not confirmed its inclusion. At over $1,000 per night, we could have stayed at many other accommodations with this service. We’ve stayed with Vacasa 6+ times over the last few years, and this experience was the reason we will not stay with Vacasa again.

Finally, they sent me a page to review the place and when I submitted my negative review, they didn't post the text of my review; they did post there were 4 reviews (only the text of the 3 better reviews were posted!) I wonder how many negative reviews are removed which is VERY misleading to the public! Update: The 50% off is NOT sufficient. Keep in mind they offered 50% because I "abandoned the property (I left because of the condition of the place). Remember, they stated a representative would be there in an hour (we waited 3 hours and no one came). Vacasa did not provide a clean place to stay. title: Avoid Vacasa – Terrible Customer Service and Misleading Listings
text: We recently rented a home in Colorado through VRBO, but it was managed by Vacasa, and we had an absolutely awful experience. An unexpected snowstorm made it impossible to reach the property on our check-in night, so we found alternative accommodations. When we reached out to Vacasa, they assured us the driveway would be plowed that night. The next morning, we arrived to find the driveway completely untouched, buried under more than 9 inches of snow.Vacasa then told us that with a proper 4x4 vehicle, we could access the home—something that was not mentioned in the VRBO listing. Buried in the fine print of an email sent days before check-in, they included this requirement, but even with a 4x4 vehicle, the property was inaccessible. Their solution? Park at the top of the hill and walk down. This was completely unrealistic, as there was no safe parking, and we were traveling with elderly family members (ages 82 and 81). Asking them to navigate an unplowed hill in the snow would have been reckless.The customer service was shockingly unhelpful. Instead of finding a reasonable solution, they refused to take responsibility, claiming they have no control over what is posted on VRBO—an absolutely absurd excuse. This is a classic bait and switch.We ended up securing alternative, safe accommodations outside of Vacasa, and we will never book with them again. If you're considering renting through them, don't. If you're a homeowner thinking about listing with them, think twice—they do not care about guests and provide little to no support when issues arise. Terrible experience, terrible company.

They rent whatever ,With no standards at all . or inspections of rentals. and.. No real compensation for the property management issues.. Never again w Vacasa.

name: John & Carol

name: Michael

name: Mary Mons
title: Vacasa reviews ARE moderated!!

name: chrys romig

title: Great house

name: Jan Bruce
title: Great house in Sarasota Florida
text: We rent every year in January to get away from the snow and ice. We love Bradenton/Sarasota area. Our first rental sold. The second place Vacasa put us in was damaged by the hurricanes. Since we bought the insurance, they found a house in Sarasota for us. The Pink Palace was well equipped to meet all of our needs. It was clean and beds were very comfortable.   The location perfect. The few problems we had with internet and grill were taken care of immediately. We will continue to use Vacasa from now on.

name: Margette
title: The accommodations we're very clean and…
text: The accommodations we're very clean and one minute walk from the beach.

name: Mary
title: Vacasa was so easy to work with
text: Vacasa was so easy to work with.  The staff was great. We had fantastic shuttle service. The condo was clean and just like it was pictured.  The kitchen well stocked. Very nicely decorated. Very close to the slopes. Definitely would stay here again.

name: John Wittneben
title: Renting our ski lodge at Copper Mtn. with Vacasa
text: Process of securing and renting our ski lodge was simple and seamless. The people at Vacasa know their clientele and made the experience painless. We had a great room less than 150 feet from American Eagle lift at Copper Mountain in Colorado where we had one of the best ski trips ever (I've been skiing Copper since 1990).

name: ganesh venkatesan
title: Ruined our vacation plans
text: The front door of the unit would not lock either from inside or from outside,ans by the time a fix was performed we had to checkout. It ruined all our plans.Vacasa was not responsive and made promises that did not materialize.Update: The conformation number for our stay is 33H65C9X. We sent a note to Vacasa as we were leaving the property but Vacasa has not contacted us with any remediation yet. Now on posting to trustPilot that act as if they are concerned. Very frustrating!

name: lauren dawson
title: So Vacasa did "okay" taking care of us…
text: So Vacasa did "okay" taking care of us in Steamboat Springs. What was not okay was the hot tub which was advertized did not work the entire time and I booked the place specifically because of the hot tub. Also our fireplace took 4 phone calls and 2 maintenance guys and 3 days to fix only by half way through our stay. When I asked for a refund since the 2 main reasons I chose the place were not functioning, they awarded me something, $118.00, but this was a tiny fraction of the cost of the place. It was not at all an amount that felt compensatory for what was missing or broken during our stay.

name: Christine Marie
title: Large, lovely, spacious house
text: Loved the spaciousnes, big, beautiful house! Very clean with great communication with Vacasa when needed. 4 of the 7 bedrooms had private baths which was really great. However, the beds are very squeaky. Just rolling over in bed at night was noisy. Appeared to be worn out mattress boxes. All the full beds we used were that way. We didn’t use the twins, so don’t know about those. I relayed this to the super nice house manager, and he said he’d look into that!Our main complaint was that the pool and hot tub didn’t get very warm. We stayed in January which is of course in the winter,  but we paid for heat ahead of time so expected a nice warm pool and spa.  2 days before we left, it was finally warmish enough to get in. During the summer in Florida, it would be perfect, in the winter, not so much. After seeing my review about this, the super nice house manager gave me a sufficient refund! So accommodating, and very much appreciated!This house is in a great location. Gated, quiet community. Again, we were there in the winter, might be more lively or crowded in the summer.Beautiful area. Not far from all the Disney attractions which we were not there for so did not go to. Very nice resort clubhouse pool and hot tub. Would stay here again, just possibly would not pay to heat the pool/hot tub at the house in the winter, we would just maybe go to the clubhouse and pay to use theirs; it’s one small fee for your whole group for your entire stay, so a great deal. The lazy river is not heated, though. I would recommend they consider investing in that.Bottom line, we had a wonderful time and highly recommend staying here!

name: scoutmamaaol.com
title: Condo #D209
text: Our condo, D209, was clean, exactly as pictured and we could actually see the ocean from our deck.  Communication left nothing to be desired.  Even texted a question and got the answer within 5 minutes.  Their rules insure quiet, relaxing and private experience.  Just walk out of the complex and across the street to perfect sunsets on the beach.

name: Rune Haug
title: Vacasa is easy to deal with it
text: Vacasa is easy to deal with it. They are responsive and their information is accurate. Have used them multiple times for ski trips in Colorado.

name: Conrad Fisher

text: Second time Vacasa have asked for a review - I haven’t changed my view as following my last review they commented to say they would investigate and come back to me…and true to form they haven’t.

name: torfin auga
title: Cozy and convenient
text: Comfortable, quiet, well-stocked, clean.  Loved the sense of privacy in the midst of dense development and the short walk to the beach.

name: Art
title: January 2025 @ Kiahuna Plantation
text: January 2025 @ Kiahuna Plantation - Unit 420We opened the windows the minute we got there and didn't close them till we left 3 weeks later. Spectacular weather during the day with quiet, cool nights ideal for a good night's sleep. We spent most of our time on Kiahuna Beach right in front of the property. We ate several meals at the Cabana and splurged a few times at Red Salt both just steps away. The room was well appointed, the dark wood floor and Old Hawaiian interior design soothing to the eyes after a day in the bright Hawaiian sun. The shaded lanai was a great place to relax too. Comfortable bed and a brand new refrigerator! We can not wait to return. 5 stars!

name: Andy
title: Dismal Customer Service
text: Arrived on Sunday. Notified them Monday of issues (poor water pressure, microwave doesn't work, TV defective, no coffee maker). They said numerous times they were working on it. Finally came friday with coffee maker and fixed the water pressure. Absolutely terrible customer service. WILL NEVER stay at a Vancasa property again

name: Sandy Morton
title: Amazing house
text: Amazing house! On the beach, private pool, very well stocked kitchen with anything you need. We loved everything about this house!! It’s convenient location but out of the hustle and bustle of condos. We were here during the snow but it was perfect for us!

name: Diana
