text: Great house and location. Exactly as advertised

name: Anthony Wilson
title: Christie Club 315
text: Place was great, staff was great, super close to village, true ski in/out.  Shuttle to take you where you need to go.  Awesome place

name: Paul Duke
title: Great stay in Princeville
text: Property was exactly as advertised and would highly recommend it.  Entire house and(including kitchen) was very well stocked and maintained.  Top level is a great place to relax and enjoy ocean view.

name: Jey
title: Close to village but not close enough to walk.   Can find another nice place.
text: We stayed with kids and was skiing on a long weekend.  Asked for one hour extra, for checkout and they denied for no reason.  Stated checkout was 10am, we asked 11am, and was denied.We asked if we can park the car in driveway until 2pm (next checkin is 4pm anyway) and was denied.  No reasonable conversation at all!Finally those who slept in the bunk bed got rashes all over the body after we got back home!

name: Candy Puma
title: Small but clean and all we needed
text: Small but clean and all we needed.  Great Location easy to walk to everywhere you want to go.

name: Debra Vanderwerf
title: Blue Horizon 705 is amazing!
text: Blue Horizon 705 is a beautiful clean safe quiet condo with amazing views and amenities!  Only 25 minutes from Puerto Vallarta and 6 minutes from Boca de Tomatlan, where you can catch the water taxi to Yelapa.  We highly recommend having a rental car.

name: retired in baja
title: This cabin is perfect perfect perfect
text: This cabin my husband, Siberian husky and I tried for our every two month R&R (I am a full time live in caretaker for my 90yo parents) we tried was incredible for the SECOND TIME!It was so perfect both times we’ve booked with tgus cabin three more times this year.The layout and size PERFECT. People in charge of day to rag ifAnything breaks or is needed we’re fabulous, ez to reach and immediately in our case solved our issue.The sanctuary downstairs for me and the dog, uber one food delivery, scenic forest and extremely low car traffic for walking Shaman (the road dead ends so no through way) is a must and is perceived.Internet and cell fast…uber one food delivery fast and efficientSmart tv  (YouTube, Netflix etc) AND LIVE TV all offered and work perfectIsolated enough, awsome game room, ez trash cans area outside, perfect little accessories such as shampoo,Detergent, soap etc..Cannot say enough good things!!!!

name: JiminDC
title: Lukewarm experience…
text: My husband and I spent four nights here with another couple over MLK weekend. The house is very new and spacious and overall met our needs.  We did have a few issues, however.  The water filter and ice maker on the refrigerator were not working - we had to buy bottled water and ice.  There was only one trash bag for the kitchen trash can, and there were no paper towels at all, although we had about twelve rolls of toilet paper.  Our bed had thin sheets and no mattress pad, and the bath towels were also thin. It seems at the price were were paying, we would have had better amenities.

name: Sherri Seggie
title: Family Stay
text: Beds very comfortable, open space to visit with family and all we needed was there for our stay.Thank you!

name: Carol Dickens Roberts
title: We enjoyed the house
text: We enjoyed the house, and was very happy it is pet friendly, love the small fenced yard for the dogs. Clean and well kept. The one thing we would like to see addressed is either a grab handle attached to the house to make it easier for a handicapped person to get up the steps to the deck, or a rail. If that is done, we would stay here again. Otherwise, it is to hard for my husband to get up the steps. Thank you.

name: Ernie Lewis
title: We had an amazing time
text: We had an amazing time! You can’t get any closer to the water, in the home was beautifully appointed. We will be back again!

name: Mike & Family
title: Okemo Winterplace Weekend
text: My families stay at Okemo Winterplace was fun and easy. Everything in the rental was as advertised, clean and comfortable. Ease of access to skiing was perfect as we could put on our skis right next to the ski/pole locker. Firewood being provided was a bonus as we burned each night we were there. Early check in was provided to us free of charge. We will be back for sure!

name: K Henderson
title: I am not happy with VACASA
text: I am not happy with VACASA. Couldn't get into our house with the code that I was given until after 10 min on the phone they gave me a completely different number. I had a major sewage issue and could not reach the local person or anyone else. I still don't know the issue was.

name: Jenna Slootmaker
title: The unit was comfortable but…
text: The unit was comfortable, but we had several issues. First off, someone was parked in our garage spot (which was very difficult to park in because of the location in the garage and very tight space).  We eventually ran into the person and kindly asked them to move. We never received a call back from “local management,” to address the problem. It was in the negatives outside, so we really wanted to park indoors.  Secondly, the code given to enter the unit did not work, so Vacasa gave us the code for the entire building to enter the unit, and that did not feel secure. Thirdly the stove kept tripping the breaker when cooking. Additionally, normal cooking kept making the fire alarm go off, which was loud and frustrating. Finally, the fire place made a loud noise, so we kept it off. We only got one call back about the stove, and it was 7 hours after we alerted Vacasa.  We will not rent this unit again until we know these issues have been resolved.

name: Melissa Hughes
title: Great stay, beautiful view
text: The property offered stunning views and incredibly comfortable beds, making for a truly relaxing stay. The host was exceptionally responsive and went above and beyond by mailing back a forgotten item free of charge. I highly recommend this place for both the hospitality and the overall experience.

name: NY
title: Close to the mountain
text: House is close to the mountain and it’s a very large. Overall we loved the stay but sleeping situation requires creativity when sharing with other family as the rooms have different size and no of beds.

name: Chambers Family
title: Peaceful Vacation
text: My family and I had a very quiet and peaceful vacation. Thank you so much.

name: steve pond
title: Terrible experience, false info in rental posting, zero help from Vacasa
text: Electronic lock would not work. We stood in the freezing cold for over 10 minutes while we tried to talk the Vacasa rep into giving us the manual combination.  This was at the emergency number that was provided for instant communication, but obviously the representatives were not on or near the site.We arrived after a snowstorm, but the 30 steps up to the home had not been cleared or lit to allow for safe passage. We asked the emergency reps why the steps were not cleared and were unsafe, and they could not answer, stating that we would have to ask the folks in the local office.Ad said the home was “ski in/ski out” and we were very disappointed to find that it was not. We had to drive up and down the mountain, as we could have done with a much cheaper rental.  Very misleading and false advertising. Vacasa says ski and ski out which means you are next to the slopes, it does not apply in this situation as you cannot ski across the road and between the other houses that are actually skiing/ski out. They have signs that say that people cannot cut through because they are private. Therefore, there is no access, thus they are not “skiing/ski” homesSomeone else was parked in our single designated parking space for two days in a row. We could not park there so we contacted the emergency number. Had a long text conversation with representatives who would not call for a tow company, kept referring our concern to the “local office” (which closed on Friday and would not reopen until Tuesday), and told us we could not call for a tow truck ourselves. The emergency reps were not helpful at all.We also tried to contact the local office multiple times as well, but no one would call us back and they have no one responding for emergency or urgent needs. We continue to call back Vacasa’s emergency  support line and they said the local office was aware and would respond directly. We waited out for 48 hours for responses to multiple calls to the emergency lineWe then left a day early, as Vacasa couldn't guarantee we would have a parking spot at the unit we rented on top of the mountain, the emergency number representative told us to just drive into town, park at the grocery store parking lot and then figure out how to get back up.One of the emergencyrepresentatives told us to contact the Sugar Mountain staff because it was an official sugar Mountain no parking sign, but the person we were directed to contact responded and later emailed and told us they no longer worked thereVacasa said they would give no refunds or reimbursement and that there was no guarantee it was a ski in/ski out rental (but acknowledged that their site said it was) and also that there was no guarantee of parking, even though the site said it had one reserved space. They told me that if parking was not available, we needed to go a mile into town, park at the grocery store and find our own way back.My Vacasa experience was horrible, they continue to have lies about amenities and location of the house on the ad, and refuse to help. We still have not received a call from anyone 5 days later.Vacasa has repeatedly said they have no refund policy even though they did not deliver anything close to the experience promised.  It’s a shame that they can just lie and fail to support the safety and access of their customers and withhold money by hiding behind excuse after excuse.

name: Frances Pizzella
title: Nice comfy place ,unfortunately I hurt…
text: Nice comfy place ,unfortunately I hurt my knee so we had to leave a day earlyUnable to get to the bed shelf were I left jewelry , I asked my boyfriend he forgotI inquired but nothing found 😢Wasn't getting  a refund for the last nite but thought my jewelry would be returned , sentimental

name: monica johnson
title: Absolutely perfect
text: Absolutely perfect! Location, hosts, amenities, can’t beat this wonderful little house. So comfortable and a great kitchen! We loved it and did indeed shed a few tears leaving!

name: Renee
title: Absolutely loved the location!
text: Absolutely loved the location!! Close to everything, beach (one block away), restaurants galore, everything you need to enjoy your stay within walking distance. The efficiency was well equipped, clean and so nice not to carry keys around (code entrance for both building and room door). Quiet place with beautiful view of water from balcony. I think it would be nice to have a dresser but we made it work. Would definitely return!

name: Nikki Mann
title: Perfect stay
text: The room was very clean and comfortable, everything we needed in the kitchen. We have been coming here for decades so a few things could use some tlc but not enough to stay away!!  The view is amazing and good prices

name: Emily Shaw
title: I’ve stayed at 2 Vacasa managed…
text: I’ve stayed at 2 Vacasa managed properties, both to ski so they weren’t cheap but it seems Vacasa is. They skimp on everything. Bring your own paper towel, toilet paper, towels. Last property they left 4 tiny towels for 3 nights for a 6 person condo and told me they would not bring more and that was a “starter pack” and I would need to do laundry. I have rentals and if my property management company did this to my guests I would be livid.Edit: They eventually brought some more towels, a huge trash bag of them. It was so odd to have to text fight for them and I had only asked for 2. Why not just leave 6 towels for 6 people? It seems they skimp on very basic things. Who would think to bring extra linens on a weekend getaway or have to do towel laundry. I also just felt bad about it. I didn't want to have to argue, and I guess I could have dealt with it, but for the price per night it seemed so reasonable.

name: Sharon Cummings
title: The house was beautifully furnished
text: The house was beautifully furnished and spacious .there were  just a few small things that needed TLC..outdoor grill needed cleaning, floors needed a good mopping and if there was a hot tub, nowhere to be found.

name: Sofia Balme
title: I had a very nice and efficient stay…
text: I had a very nice and efficient stay with Vacasa and VRBO combo during my ski week!  The place was clean, check-in was easy, the staff at the resort were very helpful and the Vacasa team were able to book me another day without all the fees.  Only issue I have is the inflexible check-out time or for fees if you want it.  I soetimes need an extra hour or two and don't want to have to pay for another nights stay for only one more hour.

name: Mary
title: Girls weekend
text: Views can’t be beat!  Sits directly over the shops overlooking the break wall.   Overall a very great weekend girls trip and apartment was older but mostly what was expected.  Oven was out but there was a very good sized counter top one that fit 2 large pizzas, lounge chair by window is very loved and should probably be replaced, screen door to porch was broken (got open but would not shut) but these were very minor issuesThere is MOLD issues that need to be addressed. Skylight roof in the upstairs had a previous leak which appears to be repaired but caused some water mold issues that are just painted over ☹️

name: Terry Ekl
title: This is a very good ski condo
text: This is a very good ski condo.  The beds were comfortable and the unit was very clean when we arrive.  The management company was extremely easy to work with.  The only downside was parking.  The unit has one spot and it is next to impossible to find a place to park a second vehicle.

name: Evan Overton
title: Gross
text: Gross. Unclean. Poop flecks on the toilet. Food residue and smell in the fridge. Carpet was disguesting with gooey things ground into it. absolutely disgusting.I have already been on touch with Vacasa during the trip and 10 different emails since and they have not even come close to fixing this disgusting experience. They said they have done all they can do after refunding our cleaning fee. Total cop out. So they can enjoy this review.

name: Unhappy
title: Terrible
text: Terrible. Very poor service for Owners. Beware.

name: Robert Clement
title: Wonderful home with every detail taken…
text: Wonderful home with every detail taken care of.  Very clean.  We had a wonderful stay and highly recommend this home.

name: Terri Kingery-Leskovec
title: Quaint and cozy
text: Quaint and cozy, just wish the chairs were more comfortable, or there was a small couch  !! My little dog loved the gated pathway to run around in !! We would definitely stay there again, thank you for the hospitality  !!  😀

name: Scott Duvall
title: non-ADA compliant company
text: What I did not like about this experience was the parking that I was under the impression I would have parking on the property that I was staying in I come to find out my parking was at a different property 10 blocks away which made it inconvenient being that I am disabled and I observed the parking situation at my property and there was plenty of parking available at all times which made no sense to not allow a disabled customer to to park in a handicap spot at the facility that I rented If I would have known this information up front I would have found a different property to stay at  who will be turning this over to the Americans with disabilities to look into this matter with your company. And I did tell the receptionist at the desk about my situation and she acted as though it was nothing and nothing she could do.

name: Nikki
title: It’s all about location
text: For 7 years now once or twice a year we go to the beach to celebrate my husband’s birthday. His request we stay on the beach in Rockaway Beach ( Manhattan Beach ) big floor to ceiling windows beautiful view of the ocean.  I recommend staying on the 3rd or 2nd floor. (The units are just larger) only once did we ever have an issue with our room. We made a phone call and they moved us to a different unit.  We love staying here. It’s our little home away from home.

name: Anthony
title: Dulany at the Gondola is a great location but do not book Condo 306
text: We’re a family of 5 and this was our 3rd visit to Steamboat and Dulany at the Gondola. Previous stays were in 2 bedroom apartments/condos. Dulany is in a fantastic location for ski in/out. I understand that Christmas/New Year week warrants peak season pricing – and we certainly paid a premium. The check-in process provided by Mogul Ski World and Vacasa is woeful. We had to wait outside the condo for more than 90 minutes after check-in time (check-in time is insanely late at 5pm).What I wasn’t prepared for was the shockingly disappointing presentation of Apartment 306. It presents in what looks like original condition with little to no money being reinvested by the owner despite the unbelievably high rate they charge visitors to stay.-	No working vacuum cleaner-	Disgusting washing up brushes provided-	No pantry space (kitchen cupboards filled with “stuff’)-	Cooking equipment not fit for use (knives, pots/pans should be trashed)-	Heat lamps in bathroom not working-	Ceiling leaking for several days-	Garbage bin cracked and leaked over the floor-	Laundry – doors removed and not replaced, very noisy-	Bedroom wardrobe – doors removed.Do not stay in this apartment/condo – we have been completely ripped off and disappointed with the service agents – Mogul Ski World (mogulski.com.au)  and Vacasa (vacasa.com). Do not use either of these agents.

name: Andrei Matveev
title: Nice unit, poor management
text: We stayed for one night as a group of 4 and we liked the unit. Layout is great, plenty of space for everything. We especially liked the proximity to the village and ski lift. There were some minor issues with unit (broken chair, dirty/sticky table cover, some not very cleaned dishes and coffee maker, etc), but we were fine with it.There is a gas fireplace, but we were not able to turn it on. When we asked support team about it, they were confused and didn't know how to do that (asked us to search for a remote, to try playing with the pilot/heat settings, etc). Ultimately they said somebody will contact us and/or come and help us with that, but nobody came or contacted us.There is ski locker assigned to this unit. It is open and we could use it. When we asked about ski locker, we just got answer "no lockers listed", we kept asking questions and the only answer was "none listed". Apparently we were not supposed to use that.After the booking we received email with shuttle passes, with no explanations how to use that. There was a link in the email, but it is outdated and leads to nowhere. When we called, a nice lady explained how it works and provided a proper link.Overall we liked a unit, but a management team is hit and miss.

name: Billie Williams
title: THIS RENTAL NEEDS TO BE SHUT DOWN-Entire condo in Miramar Beach, Florida 6 guests1 bedroom4 beds1.5 baths. and property manager fired.
text: UPDATE nothing has still not been done other than refund partislly. still remted a mold invested place out the next day. told i would get a phone call over 4 days1-Unlawful Eviction with Insufficient NoticeOn [1-1-2025], we were informed that we were required to vacate the property with less than two hours notice, under the threat of being charged for the entire stay. This abrupt demand, given our serious safety and health concerns, caused undue stress. It was particularly distressing as we were already dealing with ongoing issues in the apartment, and no suitable arrangements or support were provided for our forced relocation days later when it should have been offered immediately.2-Health and Safety HazardsThe property presented significant health risks due to The rental not being cleaned before arrival. Stains and bodily fluids covering the. Rental. Mainly the couch and the living room., black mold in the shower. Despite an attempt to break in and clean it while we were away, on New Year’s Eve from 8 pm 12-21-2024 and returned around 3.30 AM 1-1-2025 the mold remains a dangerous issue that requires professional remediation by a mold specialist. The continued listing of the property, while it contains such hazards, is deeply concerning, and I am surprised to find that the booking was still active and booked for the same day despite these unresolved issues. I am also still experiencing physical symptoms of illness related to my stay in the apartment.3-Break-In and Unauthorized AccessWe discovered that someone entered the apartment without our permission during our absence, raising serious safety and privacy concerns. I also stated over the phone communication that I would not like anyone entering my booking during my stay because of my medication and other expensive items I have in some rental. When I requested proof of who accessed the apartment, such as video footage or confirmation that it was us entering with our access code, I was told to seek legal representation. This response, coupled with the unauthorized entry, is both unacceptable and deeply troubling, especially considering the lack of secure locks to prevent such intrusions.4-Emotional Distress and Mental Health ImpactAs a 100% disabled American veteran with medical conditions such as PTSD, anxiety, depression, and borderline personality disorder, the failure to address these concerns has caused severe emotional distress. The lack of empathy and response to my repeated explanations about how the situation was affecting my mental health was, frankly, distressing. The mental toll this situation has taken on me has been profound, and I have struggled to cope with the ongoing anxiety caused by the unaddressed health hazards, break-ins, and lack of assistance.And now, since booked through Airbnb,VaCasa and Airbnb, will not talk to me to come to a resolution. They are both saying I need a legal team And we'll only speak between their legal team and mine. which to me just seems like something wrong was done on their part and they don't want to own up to it. Because if nothing wrong was done on my part, why would I need a legal team? to go up against two of the biggest rental companies If nothing was done wrong,?

name: Ann Ezell
title: We recently had the pleasure of…
text: We recently had the pleasure of spending Christmas at White Caps (901) in Orange Beach. The room was very clean and tastefully decorated (no clutter). The furniture was comfortable, and we enjoyed having a large dining table. The views from the balcony were stunning! AJ (security) was very helpful. Thank you, Vacasa, for helping us with our reservations and always being available to help if we had any questions. We couldn't have asked for a better trip.

name: Jan
title: Vacasa Homeowners Beware!
text: Think twice before signing an agreement to allow Vacasa to rent out your home or summer home!  Of the things that have been maddeningly frustrating are their communications and not following up on things agreed on.  Vacasa seems to be under-staffed at all levels - local, state and national out of Portland Oregon, a world away from our Michigan property. When pricing defaulted to ‘dyamic’ pricing, it was far below what we agreed on as our minimum nightly or weekly charge.  We have ‘no pet’ policy in place, and the first two weeks of the summer had guests show up with dogs!   We were told Vacasa would designate where guests were to park.  Instead, they parked all over our yard and lawn area. Cleaning between guests was quick (about an hour for multiple buildings) and not always complete.   In the positive column, cleaning was always finished on time and the linens provided (Homeowner pays for them) were nice quality.  We have terminated with Vacasa.

name: Rodrigo Manera
title: Great New Year’s vacation!
text: We had a great experience, starting with the booking and ending with a great condo that is very nice decorated and well maintained! We really enjoyed our New Year’s vacation at Suntide III Condo 504!!!!

name: Staci Cruse
title: The amenities were amazing
text: The amenities were amazing, hot tub, jacuzzi and the fireplace. The cabin was exceptionally clean when we arrived. Loved the Dove shampoo, conditioner and soap that was available. The only issue we had was the heat was off when we arrived. It was 37 degrees outside and 47 degrees in the cabin. text: We booked a nice place right on the beach in Florida, through a booking site using Vacasa as their host. The price looked reasonable as well. They offered us other properties and "offered to cover the difference in cost", but these other places were nowhere near the beach. In the meantime, we reserved a place through a more reputable booking site, as we had very limited time. We were then contacted by the booking company, who was supposed to issue the refund. Then they offered us several different options, some of which were on the beach - but didn't offer to cover the cost difference compared to our original booking. This didn't matter anyway since we already booked another non-refundable condo. We took the refund which we had originally decided upon, losing over $50 due to our currency exchange rate. We also had to spend hundreds more on our new reservation compared to the original that was cancelled on us. The customer care team didn't seem to care about any of this. Between Vacasa and the booking company, this whole experience was a disaster. Steer clear of dealing with Vacasa.

My claim was denied. Vacasa could have chosen to reinstate my trip when I contacted them and the property was still available, but I was told “there was nothing they could do” because I had already canceled. I see they have now rented the property to someone new, so Vacasa made twice as much money off my misfortune. I assume they pocketed over $600 in fees I paid for things like cleaning and pets because I didn’t actually stay so there was no need to use that money for services rendered. I thought I was being courteous by canceling as early as possible to allow the property owners to rent it out because I had bought the insurance. If I knew this was going to happen, I would have never canceled. I would have been better off getting sick and canceling at the last minute, although it appears you need to be on your deathbed with a doctor’s note for even that to be a reason Vacasa’s travel insurance will reimburse you. I recommend avoiding Vacasa and renting through VRBO so you can deal with the actual property owner.

title: We recently stayed at 728 Passover Ln. in Key West
text: We recently stayed at your property at 728 Passover Ln. in Key West, and I want to commend you on maintaining such a beautiful and clean property. It was clear that much thought goes into ensuring a great guest experience.However, I feel compelled to share an issue that impacted our stay. During our visit, the neighboring property was undergoing roof construction. Starting early each morning around 7:30 AM, there was loud pounding and sawing, and significant amounts of sawdust ended up covering the pool area, furniture, and the pool itself. Unfortunately, this made the pool unusable during our stay. The construction continued late into Thursday evening, leaving us with only Friday morning—the day of our checkout at 10 AM—to potentially use the pool.We specifically chose this property for its pool, and even paid for it to be heated, which I understand incurs an additional charge. It was disappointing not to be able to enjoy this key amenity during our stay. While I realize that construction on neighboring properties is outside your control, I feel this should have been disclosed to us before booking, as it might have influenced our decision.If this is your property, I’d kindly suggest implementing a policy to inform future guests about any known disruptions like this. If it’s not your property, I was hoping for more than just an apology when I raised the issue during our stay—perhaps a gesture of consideration or accommodation to reflect the inconvenience.I don’t want to sound unreasonable, and I greatly value Vacasa’s typically reliable services. This was simply an unfortunate situation, and I hope this feedback helps improve communication and guest experiences in the future. Despite this, I’d still consider booking through Vacasa for future trips to Key West.

text: The cabin was wonderful and have nothing bad to say about the owners of the cabin we stayed it. It was clean and relaxing.What went wrong is with VACASA. Our porch light was also out. I had asked for someone to come replace it when they brought our new clean towels. No one ever showed up to fix the porch light. They have a garage can with no lid on it and the raccoons got into the trash and had ripped up the previous people's trash and one bag of our trash. It was all over the porch. With no porch light it also doesn't detere them from coming up around the hot tub area. Please replace the outside trash can so wildlife can't get into it and fix the lighting issue. An ambulance was also lost and could find their correct place to get to in order to help. They had to pull into our driveway and ask what number we were.Then the day of check out we were supposed to have late check out until 2pm. I had received an email on the day of our check in stating that we could purchase late check out. I entered my credit card info in and it stated congratulations you have late check out. The housekeeper showed up at 10:30am and had no idea we were supposed to be there until 2pm. I decided to call VACASA  to find out what was going on and they told me that I did not have late check out and that they didn't take the money from me. They refused to even work with us. So thankfully we had most of everything packed up and the house was clean even though we had to pay 80 dollars for a cleaning fee! We were out of the house within 15 minutes.Those things just didn't make our stay completely relaxing. It was our 12 year anniversary. I have stayed at Whaleshead Resort many many times before they switched to VACASA and I have never had any trouble before.I would go back once VACASA learns to start communicating with their clients and the housekeeper better.

title: VACASA’s Reckless Disregard for Client Safety – Avoid Them!
text: VACASA is a property management company here in Costa Rica. If you are looking to rent a vacation home/property, avoid them at all costs. This is coming from someone that has lived in CR full-time since 2005 rents weekend gateaways at least once or twice a month (hey have to get out of the city with the kids ;-)We had a harrowing experience with VACASA and their representative, Marcelo Fuentes, who is based in Chile and clearly has no grasp of the dangers we’re facing here in Costa Rica. We booked a stay on the Pacific Coast for November 16-18, right as the Costa Rican government declared a Red Alert—the highest level possible—due to relentless, dangerous storms. There have been road closures, evacuations, even fatalities, with officials urging everyone to stay away for safety.When we reached out to VACASA to explain that we couldn’t safely travel due to these extreme conditions, Marcelo dismissed our concerns and cited “policy.” He even said they would only reconsider if the property became “uninhabitable,” ignoring that government advisories already declared it unsafe to travel to the entire region.Their stance is shockingly irresponsible. For the sake of keeping a few dollars, they’re willing to put clients in danger, completely ignoring official evacuation warnings. We’re actually building a property in the area and had considered VACASA for future stays and management, but after this, there’s absolutely no chance. They’ve lost a client and a potential partner—and I hope others take note.For property owners considering VACASA, beware. Their callous disregard for client safety will reflect on you, too, hurting your rentals and reputation. There are plenty of other companies that prioritize customer care and basic decency—qualities VACASA clearly lacks. Avoid them, and choose a company that will treat you and your guests with respect and common sense.

title: My family planned a trip to Nashville
text: My family planned a trip to Nashville, TN from 11/08/24-11/11/24. We booked a vacation home through Vacasa and it was paid in full, we received the confirmation, and then got the entry code to the home. Approximately two hours before our arrival I received a message that the home was no longer available. We had 3 small children in the car and were meeting other family there as well. We were traveling for 6 hours. When speaking to a representative on the phone I was told they had an alternate property and we should look at it online and let them know if we wanted to reserve it. The property was unacceptable (it looked run down) and it did not have enough bedrooms!  We were told that was our only other option. A refund would be issued but it would take 5-10 business days to return the money to my account. We didn’t have additional funds to afford to rent a different vacation home! We had to ask a relative to book a different home for us at the last minute in order to have a place to stay. That was a huge deal in itself.We simply could not believe Vacasa canceled our vacation home just two hours prior to our arrival!  They told us it was because the property had been SOLD.  The experience was very, very stressful to say the least.  We will never use Vacasa again.

text: I had a pleasant stay in this lovely home during the Lone Star Rally in Galveston, but there were a few issues that impacted our experience.First, the owner’s instruction book mentioned that the subfloor had recently been replaced. However, there were several areas where the floor felt dangerously soft, particularly in the kitchen and dining area. It often felt unstable, as if we might fall through, which made us uneasy when walking or sitting in these spaces. The flooring appeared to be separating and lifting, which was concerning.Additionally, we encountered significant construction noise from the neighboring property. For much of our stay, we were unable to fully enjoy the beautiful patio view because the noise made it difficult to relax or even have a conversation.Lastly, only three sets of towels were provided for our group of four, so we had to make an extra trip to purchase an additional set.Thank you for your attention to these issues, as they are worth addressing to improve future guests’ experiences.

name: Thilo
title: There is no future between us and Vacasa.
text: Thilo S.; GermanyOne star is already too muchReason:1.I rented a cottage in Holmes Beach, Fl.  from Vacasa from October 10, 2024 to November 2, 2024. After Hurricane Helene made landfall on September 26, 2024, we wrote to Vacasa several times and asked if the cottage was OK and if we could vacation on Anna Maria Island. I did not receive any clear answers from Vacasa.Although the Anna Maria Island authorities had closed the island to tourists, Vacasa informed me by email on October 3, 2024 that the cottage was almost ready and we could move into the house. (Tourists were not allowed to enter the island again until October 25, 2024.)In an email dated October 2, 2024, I again asked Vacasa for help and a suggestion for another vacation home in a safe area. I stated in the email, "...I can't wait any longer for your response as our planned vacation starts in 8 days. The distance from Germany to Anna Maria Island is 4900 miles and we can't make this trip with a small child without a vacation address."After receiving no response from Vacasa again in the next few days, we called Vacasa 2 times and suggested another vacation home in Naples, Florida, which we then booked. Once again, we were lacking service and help from Vacasa.2.Even though Hurricane Milton was in Florida before making landfall, there was no customer service from Vacasa and there was no customer service after making landfall.On 10/8/24, I emailed Vacasa to ask if the rented home in Naples was undamaged after Hurricane Milton passed through. Response from Vacasa on 12/24/10"Thank you for reaching out to us. I understand your concerns regarding the hurricane. To date, we have not received any reports indicating that the property has been impacted by the hurricane. We will update you as we receive new information about the property."We have not received any further communication from Vacasa. Vacasa simply failed us as a service provider and did not provide any service whatsoever. As a result, my family and I (4 adults and 1 child) have been in great emotional distress and despair, for which Vacasa is responsible.

The grill worked perfectlty (not the case with many other rentals we have had!) and we enjoyed making meals on it and in the kitchen. We did not use the casita but that's a cool option for extra guests (sofa pull-out). Expect to wait a few minutes for warm or hot water to start to flow but a small price to pay for such a unique property and location. Wi-fi worked well and tvs are streaming only with your own sign-ins. Less than 10 mins from a large grocery store but you will feel like you are far away from civilization. There is a cool trail through the desert accessed just south of the property great for running, walking, biking. Lots of wildlife, birds, and amazing night-sky watching awaits you here. text: My partner & I stayed in this condo for 3 weeks in September-October. The whole unit is tiled for ease of cleaning, the furniture is comfortable and ample for two couples. The layout of the unit provides areas for people to have alone time. Upon arrival, the unit was exceptionally clean. We did reach out to Vacasa to have some minor repairs (burnt out lights, bbq not working, patio door hard to open, shower curtain needed replacement), they were extremely quick to respond to our call and arranged repairs to be completed within 1 hour to 3 days.DECK: is a highlight of this rental due to its fabulous views, its size, the covered area and the personal pool. The pool was extremely clean and well maintained. You can see and hear the ocean & beach from the deck. They provide two loungers & a table that can seat 6-7 people. One drawback is that you can hear other units when they are outside on the deck and that by mid afternoon, there isn’t any shade. It would be nice to have an umbrella that could be moved around.KITCHEN: is small but has all of the utensils, pots, oven, toaster, blender, kettle, microwave, fridge and cooktop to make meals. The quality of these items are on the low side, but they work. Vacasa provided dish soap & small scrubby to wash dishes, 3 dishwasher pods, 3 garbage bags, one paper towel roll. There are enough dishes, glasses, cutlery for five -six settings but you will be running the dishwasher each day, sometimes twice. There aren’t any spices provided or other food basics.AIR CONDITIONING/ FANS: there are 5 air conditioning units and ceiling fans in the common areas and one in each bedroom. These units are highly efficient and keep the unit very comfortable.Extra services: Nitta Condo security service offered 20 liters of water that they would deliver to the unit for 45 pesos.Vacasa has a cleaning service (for $45 US). We used this service on 3 occasions and were highly impressed with this service.Our assigned Vacasa manager (Ricardo) was outstanding as he responded to our questions and concerns that arose during our stay. He had excellent  communication skills and was knowledgeable of the Condo complex as well as the surrounding area.   Ricardo immensely improved our visit here through his professional assistance and excellent referrals to activities, restaurants and interesting locations to visit.  Thank you Ricardo.Suggest Improvements1. More dishes & cutlery and replace the pots and pans as the Teflon was scratched and pitted2. Replace the faucets in the bathrooms and kitchen could be updated (they worked)3. Replace the shower heads as they sprayed water in several directions.4. Update the  light switches in the unit as they were confusing to operate.5. Replace the halogen light bulbs with led light bulbs6.  Provide laundry facilities in the unit or building (there is a dedicated space for machines) As we stayed for 3 weeks it was highly inconvenient to go to a laundromat 3 km away.7. name: Jamie Cooper
title: !!!BEWARE OF BOOKING!!!
text: !!!BEWARE OF BOOKING!!!In March, our family booked a FL vacation home with Vacasa so that twelve of us could stay together and attend a memorial in Oct. at my late aunt’s favorite park nearby.A few days before our reservation, we contacted Vacasa to confirm that the property was still available, as Hurricane Milton had recently passed through the area. Vacasa assured us everything was fine, responding:"We hope you are having a great day. We apologize for any frustration or delay in responding. Our local team is working to ensure the property is available and any damage has been addressed. Your reservation remains active, and we will notify you if there are any changes before your arrival. If you haven't been contacted by us, your reservation is good to go. We appreciate your understanding in this situation." — Jeric B, Vacasa.comWith their confirmation, our family—traveling from as far as Massachusetts—arrived on schedule. The property looked great, and we unpacked, enjoying the beach and pool while waiting for the rest of our group to arrive. By 6:30 pm, as we prepared for our 7:00 pm dinner reservation, a car pulled into the driveway. The pair inside asked if we could confirm if this was their rental address. To our surprise, they had a reservation for the same house, on the same dates. They had booked just three weeks earlier, while we had reserved back in March.Concerned, the couple called the property owners, who informed them they were on their way to resolve the situation. At this point, we assumed we were in the clear, given our earlier booking. Unfortunately, we were wrong.When the owners arrived, they informed us that they had terminated their contract with Vacasa months ago and that all bookings should have been transferred to other properties. They told us we needed to vacate the home immediately, as their guests were due to check in. We had paid over $4,000 for our stay, from Thursday to Sunday, and this explanation made no sense to us.We called Vacasa, who said they would "look into it" and call us back. Meanwhile, the owners, who were rude and unapologetic, parked in the driveway next door, preparing to flip the property for their guests.With four small children under seven extremely upset and a family memorial weekend at stake, we asked them to provide proof of ownership or a contract termination with Vacasa. They scoffed at our request, leaving us feeling like we were victims of a scam.Four of our family members went ahead to try and hold our dinner reservation, while the rest of us stayed behind, frantically calling Vacasa for answers. Vacasa finally admitted that the owners no longer had a contract with them and promised to refund our payment within three days. They also sent us a list of alternative properties, but we chose not to book with Vacasa again.To add insult to injury, the day after we were forced to relocate, I searched for the property on Vacasa’s website—and found it listed as a "new listing."After researching, it appears this behavior is typical of Vacasa, and we are considering legal action. They may be liable for misleading us about the property's availability and for knowingly failing to terminate their contractual relationship with the homeowner in a timely manner.

This isn't feasible with the limited time I have to take off of work and with the baby in the car.  I have pleaded with them to give me a refund but they maintain that because of the dates of the booking, their policy is that there are no refunds.  But of course they were happy to cancel my booking for me so they can re-book with someone else.They were not willing to make an exception to their refund policy for a NATURAL DISASTER and IMPASSABLE ROADS.  What about folks who live in the impacted area that can't be taking vacations because their homes no longer exist?  Do they not get refunds either?  How greedy and disgusting.The Great Smoky Mountain Railroad waived their cancelation fees for the tickets I had purchased because of the natural disaster.  I appreciate them!

name: George Tedesco
title: Everything was PERFECT
text: Beautifully furnished and very comfortable accommodations.  It felt like home to us. Loved the quiet setting while still being conveniently located to major roads.  During our stay it had rained one day and this gave us the time to relax and enjoy playing some games in the loft game room.  We have been coming to the White Mountains for many years and by far this is one of the best houses we have ever had the opportunity to rent. We will definitely keep this property in mind for future White Mountain vacations. Thank you for making our vacation a wonderful memory.

name: Randall Kepley
title: The house was very roomy with a large…
text: The house was very roomy with a large fenced in yard.  We loved the big Back porch with rocking chairs and old shade trees.  The fenced yard is great for pets and small children.  Location is in the middle of the island so everything seems close.

name: Cheryl White
title: We had a great time in Destin
text: We had a great time in Destin, which was already one of our favorite Florida destinations.  The unit was exactly as advertised:  clean, well stocked, and roomy.  The only thing  I would have done would have been to tell us where the washer/dryer units were.  We couldn't find them anywhere.  Finally on the sixth day of our stay we bumped into somebody who told us they are in a closet on the balcony.  As someone who has lived her whole life in the midwest, it would NEVER have occurred to me to look there!  Will definitely consider returning.  The beach is private and five minutes walk across the road, the pool is virtually unoccupied much of the time, and there are delightful restaurants walking distance away.  Very family friendly, too.  We loved it.

name: Kendra Morales

name: Haley Moyer
title: House was in terrible condition and we were refused any refund for broken amenities.
text: The house that we stayed in was riddled with mold, it was filthy, many items in the house were broken including a burner on the stove, the spindles on the banister around the stairs were falling out when lightly touched, and the grill was so disgusting that it started a grease fire when we tried to cook dinner. The hot tub was broken and reported to Vacasa by the pool maintenance company at the time of our check in. We had called Vacasa upon checking in, and complained about the cleanliness and they sent an emergency crew. The cleaners told us they had not done a deep clean on the house in TWO YEARS, And basically all they could do for us to try to Disinfect what they could.After checking out, we immediately called to report some of the bigger issues at the house. Thinking that they couldn’t be fixed during our stay, considering it was water and mold damage and larger problems than would take more than a few minutes to fix, we would call and report them so at least they would be fixed for the future. We asked for some money to be refunded, considering the state of the home, both in lack of cleanliness and in safety, and Vacasa said they would not refund us anything because we did not report the issues while we were at the house. Even though we called IMMEDIATELY upon our departure to explain the issues. They also refused to give us any refund on the broken hot tub, even though it was reported by the pool maintenance company when we arrived at the home for our stay. As of now, I would not recommend staying in a Vacasa rental home to anyone. They clearly do not care about anything other than taking your money.The I have been in contact with the local  Vacasa team numerous times, and they state that because I did not call to mention the mold and safety hazards during our stay, that they will not refund any money. And even though the hot tub was broken before our arrival, and the maintenance team put a ticket in, it never got fixed during our stay and they will not give us any money back for the inconvenience. The photos on the listing based on the home that we got, were two different things. There were dead bugs stuck on walls/doors, the latch to the pool area door was broken, there were moldy items in the kitchen cabinets, trash rom previous guests in various places. This list truly goes on and on. I have many photos of the state of the home to show that it was not clean and or safe.

name: Paolo Resteghini
title: Terrible experience, avoid Vacasa properties
text: We were scheduled to stay at a Vacasa-managed property from the 3rd to the 13th of October. In the weeks leading up to our trip, we expressed serious concerns about potential hurricanes in the area, especially as Hurricane Helene had just passed, and reports were coming in about three more hurricanes forming. With two young children under three, we were understandably worried for their safety.Despite our repeated requests to reschedule, Vacasa refused any flexibility, offering no options for date changes, cancellations, or refunds. They told us our only option was to cancel and forfeit the full amount we had paid. I pleaded with them, explaining that we had a young family and didn’t want to put our children in danger, but they remained completely unsympathetic.I also asked several times for contact details of a manager or property manager to confirm the state of the property post-Hurricane Helene. We wanted to know whether it was safe, but this request was flatly denied as well.Reluctantly, we arrived on the 3rd, only to hear that Hurricane Milton was becoming a real threat. We made the decision to evacuate as soon as Florida issued the evacuation order. Vacasa only informed us of the need to evacuate a day later. Had we waited for their guidance, we wouldn’t have been able to leave in time and ensure our family’s safety.After cutting our trip short and returning home within three days, I contacted Vacasa for a refund of the days we were unable to stay due to the mandatory evacuation. Their response? No refunds, as it was “not within their policy.”I am utterly appalled by how unprofessional and unsympathetic Vacasa has been throughout this ordeal. They were more than happy to risk the safety of my family rather than allow us to reschedule our dates. I will never book a property managed by Vacasa again, and I would advise others to avoid them at all costs. They clearly have no regard for the well-being of their guests.

name: Arni
title: Unexpected visitors and frustrating customer service
text: My husband and I rented a really nice place in Westport, WA; the entire place is spacious and comfortable. The location was perfect for watching boats come and go. I loved the place but disliked the unprofessional communication the day before we checked out. Be aware that unexpected visitors may interrupt your stay, and the notice from Vacasa will be short.We rented a place for 4 nights to take a break from work and have a calm and relaxing stay. Our stay was great, until the day before checking out. We were never informed that our stay would be interrupted by visitors.We were lounging around, watching a film in our sleepwear when I received a text from Vacasa and had the following conversation:VACASA: Hi Vacasa. We have a bed being delivered to the home and they will be there in the next hour. If you have any questions, please reply to the text with Guest Services or call 8005440300ME: Wait. Do you mean I have to leave the vacation rental? How long will it take? Which bed is being replaced and where do I put my stuff in the meantime?VACASA: ONLY A BED WILL BE PLACED IN TH E HOME, WE ARE NOTIFYING THAT SOMEONE WILL COME OVER TO THE HOME AND DELIVERME: Yes I got that part. I just wasn’t told ahead of time that someone would be bringing a bed during our stay.VACASA: oh ok we just received the updateME: I’m still confused. Is this for the upstairs rental? I’m asking because I don’t know where the bed is going to go since both bedrooms already have a bed.VACASA: Its for your rentalI stopped texting after this because their responses were very vague and I assume they didn’t want to bother explaining. What kind of business responds like this?What they failed to understand, before responding in caps and vague replies, is when someone is paying to stay in one of their rental units, they need to be informed of any possible interruptions during their stay, beforehand. You can't just surprise them with a 20-minute notice and expect them to know everything that was discussed between Vacasa and the homeowners. Our vacation went from a quiet, tranquil stay to an anxiety-ridden scramble to get dressed before this unexpected drop-in. I was trying to find out more information so that we could move our luggage and clothes out of the room that was going to have the bed placed if that was the case. However, the replies were either rude (all caps) or vague, making communication with them extremely frustrating.Eventually, the situation I was trying to avoid happened. The deliverers showed up much earlier than an hour (approximately 20-25 minutes) and needed us to move our luggage from the second bedroom so that they could place another mattress on top of the bed. It was not only embarrassing that they saw our dirty clothes but this is what I was hoping to do ahead of time if Vacasa had provided me with more information rather than short, vague responses.The rental had two bedrooms and each bedroom already had a bed with a mattress. There was also an extra folding bed in the master bedroom closet. This is why I was confused as to why they were bringing another bed. I wanted to make sure it was for our rental. Then we came to find out it was a mattress (not a bed) that was going to be placed on top of the other mattress on the bed in the second bedroom. This information would've been helpful if Vacasa had told us this but their responses told me they did not want to bother.Everything was going great and the place was headed for a 5-star review until I received the rude, all-caps, response to my concern, followed by vague responses that ruined our tranquil stay due to having to scramble to get dressed and prepare for unexpected visitors. The rest of our stay was no longer tranquil, as it was not easy to go back to the relaxed mood and state we were in before this unexpected interruption.Based on their unprofessional customer service alone, I will not be using Vacasa again. Their careless and rude customer service ruined our tranquil stay. Their refusal to reply with more information that I was trying to get so we could better prepare, told me all I needed to know about their professionalism.Shortly after we checked out, I got an email to review our stay. I posted this same review, and surprise surprise; Vacasa did not post it on the rental's page. The only new reviews they post are the good ones or the ones that are just a rating with no comment so that the rental keeps its 5-star status on their site and customers don't read new negative comments. Very deceiving...

name: Jim Hall
title: Hurricane Helene
text: The property is directly in the middle of Western Carolina which was devastated by Hurricane Helene.  We did not purchase trip insurance.  My bad.  However we had no idea that there would be a 100 year storm that would impact travel.  There are widespread power outages, road closures, and boil water advisories.  Government authorities do not want you travelling there if you are not there to help support the recovery.  Neither Expedia, VRBO or Vacasa thought at all about making exceptions to their policies.  I'm certain the property is very nice as I'm sure the owners are as well.  However my view of the three companies is terrible and i will no longer be using any of them in the future.  I didnt even want a refund - i just wanted to have the grace period extended.  or give me an option to donate the rental fees to the region for recovery.

name: Charles Haskins
title: Vacasa will not refund rental in devastated Western NC
text: Update: I was able to reach a manager and explained the situation and he has offered to rebook 30 days out. I have a week to decide and still pursuing a refund or charge back. I will update the review next week.This review is not related to the property we rented but Vacasa as a company to work with. We have used Vacasa many times with no issues. We have a reservation in the devastated area of Western North Carolina and Vacasa will not refund for this unusual. hurricane situation. Roads are not passable, no electricity, and locals are focused on rebuilding and not tourists. The death toll continues to rise and the response from Vacasa is that is not our problem. I would be okay with rebooking when the town is ready (if) but that has not been offered. We have emailed and spoke to reps and it falls on Deaf ears. I will not use this company again nor can I recommend them. Stick with Hotels or local rental agencies.

name: Ian
title: Unhappy Valley Portland
text: Useless company, really poor accommodation, no help during stay and four weeks later no sign of any compensation.Unfortunately we’d booked a four night stay here at the end of a three week trip round the US.  The photographs looked lovely, the reality less so.As you get out of the car you see a rickety gate, an unmaintained garden, a battered flight of stars where suitcases had been dragged up damaging the leading edge of the treads, a filthy welcome mat and a door which had been repaired at some stage but not repainted.To access the property you had to use a ten digit code in the slage lock.Upon entry a wall of heat hit us, the house faces west and we assumed the afternoon sun hitting the windows was causing this and we needed to close the blinds.  The blinds were all closed with cable ties making it impossible to do anything with them, we contacted the property manager who said they’d get the local team to look into it.  After four days nothing had happened.The interior of the property, particularly the woodwork is tired and in need of redecoration.  There is a notice to remove your shoes once inside which we did.  Walking around barefooted the soles of your feet soon become black as the floors couldn’t have been washed for ages and they also collected hairs which weren’t ours.The waste disposal system on the sink is broken and the water drained very slowly, we were careful not to put any food down the sink.  Putting the dishwasher on the next day saw the sink backing up with waste water and piles of sludge.  We had to use a plunger from the toilet to clear the blockage.As a distraction the power circuit that feeds the kitchen and dining area periodically trips out and you have to press the reset button to re-activate it.By the end of our second full day here we began to realise that although the air conditioning said it was cooling it was just moving air around and the room temperature reached 88 one evening.  We told the property mananger and again nothing happened.  Once the sun had gone down we opened the windows we could (some are close to falling apart) to try and create a thru draft which got the temperature down a few degrees.Other issues – the outside furniture on the lower balcony is old and should be replaced.The property backs on to I-205, a really noisy interstate which means you don’t want to sit outside for long in any event.So a scruffy house, no blinds, no air conditioning, dirty floors, a broken waste disposal for over £200 a night.

name: william  meadows
title: "Meet me at the creek" whittier nc 28789
text: "Meet me at the creek"whittier nc 28789. Cabin is too small to truly be "comfortable" for 4 adults. Couch(only seats two) and dinning chairs are so not comfortable. The layout of the bedrooms(both adjacent to each other and only separated by a "sliding barn type door" that provides virtually no privacy) is awkward at best (having to get to the really small deck through one of these bedrooms)to access the Uncovered "hot tub"(unless you exit the cabin to access the deck from outside(no paved footpath just through the yard/grass.) No light onto deck for "hot tub" access after dark. There was an "odd" odor about the place that was very noticeable upon first entry of the cabin(I suspect it's just due to the age/old construction of the cabin being from the 1940's that was definitely not built with any "actual construction standards"(stacked stone foundation, uneven floors etc.). The lights "swagged" across the front and side porches allows for birds to perch and leave their droppings below on the porch and it's furnishings running along the path the lights follow. Other than in the Kitchen the led lighting throughout the cabin feels "harsh" and not particularly "pleasant" nor does it seem fitting with the "rustic" decor. When both of the "fake" fireplaces are turned on along with their heat settings after a while the circuit breaker "trips and power is lost to both "fireplaces, the TV and the wifi router-all are in different rooms and are tied to this one circuit-seems like too much electrical draw on this one circuit. Hot tub is not covered and totally useless in anything other than "perfect" weather. As it happens we anticipated considerable rain during our stay and brought a 10'x10' collapsible free standing canopy which we eventually managed to "sort of" erect over the hot tub with substantial difficulty due to the small size of the deck the hot tub was on. It turns out that we indeed got copious amounts of rain (aftermath of hurricane Helene) and had we not brought the canopy we wouldn't even have had the benefit of the use of the hot tub at all. The hot tub (when jets are turned on foams up like you're in a soapy "wash tub". The entire layout bedrooms and baths) is strange obviously because of the old structure and the scabbed on addition. Lastly the(open to the elements and uncovered)fire pit area(on a slope)feels like just a quick cheaply thrown together afterthought that in my opinion for just a few $ and a little extra work could have been made much nicer, safer, more practical and enjoyable. As a side note that is not integral to the cabin but was somewhat odd and gave a strange feeling at night was a duke energy LED street light that provided what appeared to be a really "purple" glow that was odd and gave off a somewhat eerie "atmosphere" when attempting to enjoy the cabins out of doors areas(porches and fire-pit mainly)at night. In summary in my opinion this rental had the feel of a cheaply thrown together rental cabin and due to it's location doesn't provide any peace or seclusion. The flowing noise of the creek does mask some of the traffic noise. The appliances are new(washer, dryer, fridge and stove)so that's a plus. Has a mini split for heat/AC but due to cabins layout temps will be substantially different in kitchen and laundry/second half bath. Overall the rental didn't provide the comfort, atmosphere or value we we're hoping for.

name: Doug
title: A deeply disappointing experience
text: I recently had a deeply disappointing experience with Vacasa, Red Fox Den Cabin, and Bookings.com, and I feel compelled to share it to warn others. My family and I were heading to Western NC on September 27, 2024, after Hurricane Helene hit, with the hope of attending a wedding the next day. Little did we know, the aftermath of the storm would create horrifying conditions. Roads were washed out, trees and power lines were down, there was no cell service, and the entire area was without electricity. We were rerouted multiple times, encountering closed roads and unsafe conditions that made reaching the rental impossible.Despite these circumstances, which were clearly beyond our control, Vacasa refused to offer any refund or accommodation. I understand that there's a no-refund policy in place, but I had hoped that under such extraordinary circumstances they would show some compassion and understanding. I reached out to Vacasa, explaining the situation in full detail, but was met with complete apathy. Their customer service representatives were cold and unhelpful, hiding behind their rigid policy without any consideration for the reality we were facing.What’s even more frustrating is that I had initially booked a different cabin through Airbnb, which was canceled by the host due to a power outage. Airbnb promptly issued a refund, demonstrating that they care about their customers' well-being. In contrast, Vacasa did absolutely nothing except keep the $650 I paid for a cabin we couldn’t even access, let alone stay in.I am shocked by the poor customer service Vacasa and Bookings.com have shown, especially during such distressing circumstances. They may have won their dollars this time, but they’ve certainly lost a customer for life. I urge anyone considering renting through Vacasa or staying at Red Fox Den Cabin to think twice before handing over your hard-earned money to a company that clearly does not care about its customers.Do yourself a favor and stick with Airbnb, which has proven to be a class act in comparison.

name: LH
title: Will never use VACASA again…
text: We stayed in a home rented through VACASA in Maine. The place had a broken stove top (2 front burners were broken), lock on one of the doors coming into the house didn’t work, toilet was so loose it rocked when you sat on it, bed didn’t have a mattress cover and box springs were so old and squeaky we had to sleep in separate rooms to avoid waking each other up, roof was a mess and rot all over the outside of the house, outdoor furniture was in desperate need of power washing and sanding. There was a sign on the refrigerator asking us to call if there were any problems. We called and nicely let them know about the stove top and toilet. They supposedly reached out to the owner and we were then told that owner was aware the stove was broken but hadn’t been fixed.  We were not given a heads up. And they said the toilet was supposed to be that way. So, basically we were told too bad. We wrote an unfavorable review when we left several days ago and they never posted the review and never responded to it.

title: Let's Go Buffalo

The elevator is awesome for moving in and out with ease.  We would definitely stay in this house again.  The only suggestion that we would make is to include in the description of the home that sheets and towels are included.....I could have saved so much space when packing.

text: Stay away!!!We just completed our stay and are leaving a very negative, but accurate review. The first item we would like to address is that the vacasa team lied to us. name: Lee Family
title: DO NOT USE VACASSA
text: DO NOT USE VACASSA! Our vacation quickly turned into a nightmare with electrical issues. We had booked a house for 2 nights. Within 2 hours of walking through the door we had notified Vacassa of lack of cleanliness and more importantly significant electrical issues effecting the entire house.There was a strong musky smell of mold present. We observed mildew on the window seals, human and pet hair found in several locations, stains on the bed and a very unkempt yard with grass around 3ft in spots.After running a bath for my 3 year old we went to turn on the bathtub jets which made an odd sound causing half of the building to lose power. Immediately I tried to call Vacassa and ultimately the automated system started a text conversation. During this conversation I was informed that Vacassa created a ticket for their local team to address the issues and coordinate. They asked if a circuit breaker had been tripped, my husband was able to quickly identify all breakers were not tripped and I sent a picture to Vacassa through the text conversation. I asked if it was safe to stay in the home with the electrical issues and was informed “In case is necessary for you to leave the unit the local team will notify you.” We had sent several videos and pictures of the oven showing an error message, lights flickering, the microwave not working, an GFCI outlet triggering making a clicking sound. We asked them how to get it to stop they stated they couldn’t see the video so I sent it via email and requested they confirm receipt. (They never did.) Considering the severity of issues and the fact that it was quickly communicated we assumed someone would be out that night so we just requested  for a call prior to their arrival. By 11:30pm no one had shown up. We ended up sleeping on the couch and pull out not wanting to be in the master bedroom due to the electrical not working in there.Woke up early after a restless night with hardly any sleep and still didn’t hear from anyone by 9:15am so we text communicating we were leaving and not coming back. An hour later we received a call from the local Manager Lauren stating that their normal procedure is to attempt to relocate us so we requested they try to find us another option nearby. She said someone would be reaching out within 30 minutes.An hour after that we received a call back and informed there was an option down the road however it was located in a multi family unit vs we had reserved an entire house and we requested another option if possible that matched more closely to our original booking. 20 minutes later we were informed there was another option available. IT WAS LITERALLY RIGHT NEXT DOOR TO OUR INTIAL RENTAL!! Instead of the restless miserable night we had just endured we could have (potentially) stayed in a home where the electrical issues weren’t so prevalent!!!After taking a short amount of time to process everything we decided we were uncomfortable with stating next door to the house that had all the electrical issues and requested to cancel our remaining night and as well as a full refund.By 2pm we received another call from Lauren who ended up stating there would be no refund at all stating the electric issues were resolved and it was a GFCI outlet causing the issues, everything had been resolved. We requested someone meet us back at the property to show us the issues were resolved, initially she was going to send house keeping out to show it had been cleaned when we requested an electrician we were informed that couldn’t be arranged because there was no one in the county to do so!After the call with her we called back to the relocation team and filed a complaint for the manager Lauren and the property. We were then informed that Vacassa only had record of our initial complaint of cleanliness nothing of the nightmare electrical issues. By 3pm after speaking with Dylan we were informed there would be no refund for the night that we had stayed even though there was no where to cook, no electricity to half the house and we weren’t even comfortable to use the shower/tub. He stated he would send an email confirming and a refund for the second night.It is now 1pm the next day and we have not received an email nor is the partial refund showing. (This review is going to be copied and pasted in multiple locations so that as many people as possible are warned about this nightmare.)

text: Vacasa is a great company to deal with as they answer questions promptly and take care of issues quickly. We will be using them again for many vacations in the years to come.

name: Consumer
title: Nice property
text: We stayed at the this property in Montego Bay and I wish we could have stayed longer. We really enjoyed how spacious the home was. We had 5 adults and 3 children in the house. We found the upstairs master closet to be the perfect room for our baby to sleep in. It was very spacious. There was an additional closet  in the upstairs master for our belongings. I loved the pocket doors In the home as it made the space feel More roomy. All of the bathrooms were nicely updated and all of the bedrooms and bathrooms had ceiling fans. The carpet was very nice and I really enjoyed having the extra space in the loft area upstairs. The front porch furniture was really nice and we spent some time sitting out front in the evening. All the appliances (except the ice maker) worked well. The unit was kept pretty clean except the piles of dust on the baseboards, above the closet doors and in the bathroom ceiling. The shed was stocked well beach chairs, some toys, boogie board and an extra cooler with wheels. I wish the unit would have had a few more games for the adults after the kids went down. The beds were very comfortable. Over all the home was very spacious and comfortable. And we would stay here again.My only complaint other than the dust was that we checked in to our unit at 4:15  and after we started unpacking the maids arrived to clean….. so we had to sit and wait for them to clean before we could unpack all of our belongings. Arriving at 4 pm after driving all day and trying to hurry and unpack and get the kids set up and make dinner before bedtime is already a challenge with kids and having to wait long while they cleaned was inconvenient.

name: Charlene Webb
title: Right on the beach
text: Right on the beach. Loved watching the waves from the balcony. Spacious and having two bathrooms was great. Views from every bedroom.

name: Marie
title: Mountain Peake's The Place To Stay
text: I had originally booked a different house. I didn't look at many places. However the road going to this house had been torn up to put down fiber cableI called Vacasa and they immediately got on the phone with their operations manager and sent me a few houses to change to. Mountain Peake was the closest to our destination.This house was great, I really liked a Scarecrow plaque on the wall and a metal basket made to look like poppies. There was a bear hanging on the steps going upstairs and the light over the dining room table was awesome. It was uh, you'll have to book the house to see that one.We spent about hour interacting with 3 deer in the yard. That was really awesome.I think this house had about everything needed in the kitchen and the rest of the house, especially the fireplace was great.Mountain Peake was a great place to stay!

name: Judy Musser
title: The condo shoreham 3b was great...room…
text: The condo shoreham 3b was great...room enough for 5 women to stay and not kill one another..lolThe views from balcony were awesome...gorgeous sunrise....condo had all the kitchen amenities as home....

name: Rebecca O.
title: Seclusion private drive, wildlife yet close to everythiing.
text: Nice quiet location back in the tall pines. Loved the fire pit for a campfire on the cool nights. Back deck perfect for outdoor grilling and eating outside. Close to everything yet perfect seclusion. Heard deer in the woods in the evenings and morning. We enjoyed the stay.

name: Dotty
title: Harmony House
text: We love this house.  This is our second stay at Harmony House.   It is cute, well equipped and clean.  It is a very short walk to the beach and Bean Point. We will stay here again!

name: Samuel
title: Perfect beach house for a crowd
text: Big comfortable house- lots of beds and baths for our extended family. Short walk to the beach and town- great for our littles and elders. Wonderful dining and living spaces. Would definitely stay here again!

title: Good experience
text: Clean room. Easy access with codes. right on the beach. Only two negatives - One of the elevators would break down about every day, but there were always 2 working. On Wednesday night the fire alarms went off, but didn't stay on. It took a little while until they were silenced. I called the 800 number and only got advice on where to find batteries in the room. I would have preferred a maintenance on call person to handle it and make sure there was no real emergency.

Hoping he gets a bonus for that!We will definitely rent this house again, great location to the bike trails.

The only negative is your door code is 10 digits long & our door would not open by code the entire visit, needing help from the maintenace men several times. Other than that, we loved our stay!

name: Craig Jackson
title: Great vacation home and great location
text: This is a great vacation spot that we will definitely  book again in the future with our family.  Loved the hot tub & firepit in the private spacious backyard.    Plenty of room for the grandkids to play and the outdoor grill was perfect for meals in the evening.  Inside the home is very spacious with plenty of room for family gatherings.  Loved the large bedroom that was perfect for the grandkids to enjoy their own space. It included a wall mounted video game machine and also had its own full kitchen ! The rest of the house was beautifully furnished with a large kitchen , living room and two other bedrooms on the main floor and two large bedrooms, fully equipped laundry room and living area in the lower level.  We had 5 adults and 4 children with plenty of living area.  This home is within walking distance to the lake and all the restaurants and shops in New Buffalo.  Great home , great location !!

name: Sue McGuire

text: Such a cute, comfortable cottage.  Very clean, close to the beach.  Home away from home.  Would definitely stay here again.

Note the condo has a queen, 2 twins in the loft, a futon and a sleep chair plenty of butts in bed spaces for famillies, if needed.

name: Cindy Jones
title: Staying at this location always adds to my travel experience!
text: Staying at this location always adds a plus to our travel experience. The house was clean with only a few areas where additional sweeping would have helped. I loved that the cleaning service left some really cute swan- shaped towels on the beds! The kitchen was well-stocked with necessary small appliances, plates, glasses and utensils. The only downside was that the door wouldn't open with the digital code at first, so we called customer service and was given code to use an alternate key to gain access to the house.  Later, we discovered that you had to press the button at the top of the keypad first and then press the code and listen for a click to open the door. Also, I would recommend that Vacasa includes information about where to pick up the arrival packet in the initial information prior to arrival. Unfortunately, the location to pick up the packet was about a mile and a half down the road from the house. I wish Vacasa's location was on the grounds where the house was located.  All in all, I loved the serenity of the house, the quiet neighborhood and its close proximity to the beach.

name: Jena Turman

name: Bev Wamsley
title: Great location
