Need blackout curtain in the 1st bedroom (corridor light very bright), suggest bringing own dvds as TV is limited, pool truly does close on Labor Day at 5pm.  Unit is lovely, made for a great stay. Che ck in, out was simple. Minutes to the beach, would highly recommend this condo.

name: William
title: Picturesque Mountain and Lake Glenville Views
text: This mountain top retreat provided a fantastic view of Lake Glenville and Onion Falls from the large rear deck. The home was generously stocked with toiletries and paper products. The central location was ideal for hiking, shopping, farmers markets, and dining. We enjoyed the close proximity to visit neighboring towns like Sapphire, Cashiers, and Highlands. The home was comfortable with ample space to stretch out and relax. The WiFi was excellent and allowed us to work remotely as well. The additional smart tv’s in each room was a great bonus for everyone to enjoy some down time. We highly recommend this property and look forward to another stay in the future.

name: GNFA
title: A Private pool can't be beat!
text: This was a nice home with a private pool that made all the difference for a good stay in 95 degree sun. Beautiful weather, but hot and the private pool and patio were great.The home was nice, AC worked well and there was a very nice restaurant and a convenience store within a block.Uber to the Arts District in San Jose was only $3 so it was easy and quick.

name: Lori Lannon

Had the most amazing views and the separate cottage was great for traveling with adult children. And the hot tub after long hikes was amazing.The windows could use screens and the upstairs bedrooms needed fans. They got a little warm during the day and didn’t have screens on the windows. And the water pressure in the showers were pretty bad but at least the shower head was hand held.The town is small and quaint. Lots of breakfast and lunch options for dinner was very scarce. Everything closes pretty early. One day after a long hike we had to drive to McKinleyville to get food. At least it’s only 15 minutes away. Just Wish we would’ve known that the restaurants are closed early. Never less we enjoyed our stay and listening to the waves every night when you went to bed was amazing.

name: Deborah H

title: Perfect midpoint
text: It's a great location to get to Claremont or Newport New Hampshire. It's a perfect 30 minutes to everything. Sometimes pictures can be deceptive but it really is a nice place. There isn't much in Reading. For emergency across the street there is a house that has a side market business with milk eggs vegetables. The appliances were all new, like many New England houses the floors are a little wavy from time so if you're a vertigo person or senior walk with a cane.  Great kitchen, porch. title: Vacasa Canceled 1 Week Out for Labor Day Trip & Bad Customer Service
text: My group had booked a Vacasa property 4 months in advance for a labor day weekend trip. We were notified one week from our trip that our property was no longer available due to the homeowner leaving their network. With it being a week out on a very popular weekend in a small mountain town, the "comparable" properties they were able to offer to relocate us to were in fact, not comparable for our group and sleeping accommodations, which we had booked far in advance for this reason. I had to book a new property on Airbnb that cost more and still was not comparable to what we wanted since we are now one week out on a major holiday weekend. After asking Vacasa to cover the minimal $134 difference for our troubles, no longer being in walking distance from the area we wanted/had planned to be in, and the complete inconvenience/stress/time suck it brought upon my day to resolve this before our trip. After very poor customer service and denying my request to cover the difference from multiple supervisors because they won't pay out a competitor, I will no longer use Vacasa and do not recommend them. While the customer service agents were friendly and I know this is out of their control this is plain bad customer service. I later received a call from Airbnb regarding my refund and new booking, and with out asking, they offered to reimburse me MORE money than the actual difference solely for my troubles of being canceled one week out from my trip, which is GREAT customer service. Bummer to see they are picking up Vacasa's slack and also relayed to Airbnb how unreliable their policies are.

text: We reserved several houses for the course of 6 weeks while our house was being remodeled. We stayed in Pacific City (that house needed a lot of work and actually had very concerning reviews), we stayed at Mt Hood in a beautiful cabin (also with a few problems but we took care of the nails and screws found in the fenced yard and in the driveway ourselves). We currently are staying at a house in Lincoln City and next week we go to Depot Bay for our final stay for 2 weeks. The most frustrating thing is that you will get only two rolls of toilet paper and one extra roll of paper towels. To stay in one of their houses you must plan on going to a local store or bringing these items with you. The dish soap is pretty much useless and does not clean well or cut the grease. The linens on one of the beds at the house in Pacific City were pilled so badly that the bottom sheet should have been thrown away a long time ago. The management did send someone out to assist us with this and a very unsafe deck. At that house they did respond quickly but at another house up at Mt. Hood area they would not come and take care of some problems we had. We just had to deal with it ourselves. So, depending on where you go they may respond to your needs or they may say that it is not their policy to fix your problem. Their policies are not really built for the customer. I get the feeling that they only want you to stay for a few days. Certainly not a vacation for a week or more.

title: Costa Rica Useless communication
text: We booked a rental in Costa Rica through vacasa. 2 days before we were due to arrive, we got an email telling us that place was no longer available and they offered us an alternative that was supposedly better quality at no additional cost.  We read the reviews and saw that a few people mentioned it was tricky to find so I emailed them to ask for more specific instructions.  These were not sent and indeed it was impossible to find the place without instructions.  Once we arrived it turned out that the code to get the key from the lockbox was incorrect and the lockbox wasnt in the location the email said it would be.  Another issue to get sorted.  We stayed for 3 nights and on two of them there were power cuts that lasted for 4 hours plus.  Throughout the stay there were no instructions where to find anything in the house inc matches / lighter which were needed for the BBQ / stove which meant that we couldnt actually cook our planned meals.  Worst of the lot though was that when I tried to feed this back to Vacasa I got no response.  So I left a review of the place we stayed in and it hasnt been posted.  So it means all the reviews must be disingenuous.  The house itself was quite nice but so badly managed by Vacasa.  I have had similar issues with lack of communication before in Mexico and would NEVER use Vacasa again.  I dont know why anyone would list their vacation home with them

title: Scummy company that robs its customers
text: Don't take OurBus if you think there's any chance of you having to cancel your bus. In 2019 I had to cancel a couple tickets for another passenger not being able to go due to a family emergency. Instead of a refund, OurBus gives you credits for future bus rides. Okay, other public transportation services give out full refunds so not ideal, but fine. When the credits were issued to me they stated that their policy was the credits DO NOT ever expire. I figured I'd use their services again in the future and kept tab of my credits.Fast forward to this week. I finally had a reason to take the bus again and went to use my credits. Surprise, surprise-- they were gone. I thought it must have been a mistake in my account and reached out to customer service, only to be told that their policy changed and that credits are only valid for 5 years after being issued. Despite the policy being different when I was given my credits, they refused to grandfather me in or give back any of my $100 worth of credits. Wouldn't even extend the expiration date to 5 years from when the policy changed. Would not budge or work with me at all despite me being a regular customer in the past.So basically I had $100 stolen from me. No services rendered, no refund given, and no credits to be seen. Not sure who was in charge of this terrible policy, but it definitely ensured that I will never ever be using OurBus again. I'd warn others about their scummy policy so they don't leave other customers high and dry.Edited to add: read the company's reply below for exhibit A. Don't be shocked if they suddenly change their new 5 year policy to be even shorter at the end of the 4th year so they can just pocket your money without providing their service. Clearly if I had known OurBus would not honor its policy I would have just filed a chargeback on my card while I could. Buyer beware: there is zero reason to trust this company or its word.

This modification should also be a consideration for a refund.To make matters worse, I had to follow up numerous times to receive confirmation of the itinerary, as well as the bus driver information. Unfortunately, I didn’t receive either until yesterday afternoon, and when I did, the information provided was incorrect. When dispatch told me to contact the driver this morning, I mistakenly called the wrong driver based on the incorrect details. This delay required further follow-up to get the correct driver’s information, adding to the frustration.Given the inconvenience caused and the fact that we did not receive the service we paid for, I am requesting a refund or compensation for the issues we encountered. I hope this matter can be resolved promptly.Please let me know the steps I should take to process this request and how you plan to address the situation. text: Travelling crosstown in Manhattan is a complete cluster these days!! From 34th & 6th, it took 45 mins to get to 12th Ave & 30th. Missed my bus and walked back to 34th between 9th and Dyer to catch the next bus, which was two hours later. THERE IS A NEW POLICY / SYSTEM IN PLACE. OurBus uses multiple Operators. If the next bus is with a different Operator, OurBus must contact them to transfer your ticket. Gone are the days of rocking up to the next bus and getting a seat (if there is space available). As soon as you miss your bus, you must call OurBus customer service so they can transfer your ticket straight away.Tried to board the next bus (…as per usual) and was told that my ticket had to be transferred first 🙆🏾‍♀️🤦🏾‍♀️. I had 3 mins to get the ticket transferred before bus departure. OurBus customer service agent (Aarushi) and the 3 gentleman who work for DC Trails saved the day!! Ticket transfer was completed at the last possible moment and I was able to board thanks to these four people. Very grateful to them 🙏🏾🙏🏾.

title: Do not book tickets through OurBus
text: I booked a bus ticket from Lester Pearson Airport in Toronto to London, ON. At the time when I booked the ticket on OurBus website, it clearly showed the ticket price in Canadian Dollars (C$). Soon after the booking, I received the ticket and Purchase receipt for $31.62 which was in line with the ticket price in C$. However, later when I checked my credit card statement, it showed that I had been charged C$43.78. The next day when I called OurBus customer support, I was told that the amount shown in the Purchase Receipt must have been in US dollars. Incidentally, nowhere in the email from OurBus with the ticket and Purchase Receipt did it state that the amount was in US dollars.When I explained that the ticket price shown on their website was clearly in Canadian dollars (C$), she (the agent) initially agreed to check and come back on this. The next day when I spoke to a different agent, he again insisted that the price on their website was in US dollars.I feel cheated.I would strongly advise the public not to book tickets through OurBus. They are brokers who do not add any value and are dismissive of their customer’s concerns. It would be best to book directly with the Bus Operator’s website.

title: I have been reading a lot of negative feedback…
text: I have been reading a lot of negative feedback here about Cardelmar. But I think people mistake the services of Cardelmar which only is to provide a voucher with a cheaper fare to any rental car company they deal with and an insurance to cover the franchise in case of damages to the vehicle, and the car rental company itself. If I'll be late to pick up the car I assume I have to make contact with the rental car company, their phone number is written in the voucher. By instinct if I'm presented with a company I don't know, I will check the reviews on the internet or rent from the major ones where I know they will be professional. Cardelmar stipulate on their contract that any extra insurance fee from the rental car company can be declined because they cover the insurance part. The one company you need to be careful of is the rental car company itself, and avoid the ones you don't know. I have been using their service for 3 years, 2 times renting a car in the Netherlands, one in Spain and one in Sicily. In Sicily, someone through a ball or kicked the side of the car and left a dent, and driving the awful roads full of holes and bumps of Sicily damaged the tires and the wheels. Well, when we gave the car back, the agent of Locautorent who is the intermediary for Alamo pounced at the wheels first and said they were considerably damaged, it was like he knew right away where the car would be hit. after a useless argument that one would consider it is the normal use of the car in that part of the country, with the dent on the side, they charged me 980€. I was really thinking that if some other car rental company would try to make me pay more than the voucher, Locautorent found the good way to make you pay much more. It was like being cheated and helpless. Back home I called Cardelmar and the lady on the phone said they knew locautorent was known for this practice. She also said I was fully covered with the insurance I took with them and after sending all the appropriate papers, I should get a refund. All of this happened on Sept. 20, 2020. I received an email yesterday saying that everything was OK and I'll get the refund within 21 days. To conclude, to my knowledge Cardelmar are good and competitive, and they do their job providing a better rate than directly with the car rental company. We have to keep in mind small rental companies will try their best to make more money out of you. Sticking to the majors will surely leave you out of trouble even if they are a bit more expensive.

Why? Somebody else did reopened the ticket without email conversation.- He admitted that the administration fee should have not charged to me, but he can't help so I need to send an email (which never replied/gives error, see above)- At this time I got a bit fed up.  I explained the problem again, I was angry, I was firm but I made sure I didn't shout, that was hard. I said maybe it's easier to just claim the insurance via credit card.- He closed the phone call. This guy was helpful.- After several hours, I got my ticket reopened and they asked my IBAN for the reimbursement of admin fee (finally.. at least, almost finally)- So I sent it to them and wait for reply.PS : Guys, if you purchase something too cheap to be true, please use credit card, at least you are entitled to insurance. Thus I had to fill it up on return as I did not think that I would be believed as I dropped it off in Cape Town Airport.Nevertheless the car was OK and gave us no problems

name: May Milton Keynes

text: Very competitively priced, efficient and very easy to deal with. I've booked with them before and have no hesitation in recommending using this excellent company.Collected car from Cape Town airport, all went very smoothly and returned the car three weeks later, Again efficient and smooth.

name: Jeremiah O´Sullivan
title: Pro Car - Partner car company Iceland
text: Pro Car, the partner car company near Keflavik Airport, Iceland were prompt upon arrival, hassle free at the office (i.e. no hard sell re extras) and no issues with return of car, with 24hr service back to airport - would use them again.CarDelMar - helpful website but, alas, no response to any emails prior to departure - made me nervous in case I needed to contact them for anything.

name: Zoran Popovac
title: Will use it again
text: I have used CarDelMar twice in the last 2 months and both times I had no problems whatsoever. Cars were almost new and very reliable. Highly recommend this company.

name: Martin Henneberry
title: Great value
text: The car I picked up in Cape Town airport was an Opel Adam. The roof was white and the rest of the bodywork a dark blue. At first sight I did not like the combination, but it was however a great car to use for three weeks.Six speed manual, aircon, cruise control, one push windows, all at a great price.I got a best of 54 mpg.The one thing I disliked, and I have experienced one before in a Mercedes, was the stop/start operation of the engine when at standstill.The quality of finish on the car was poor, but the overall experience was hard to fault. Really great value at the price, and all the extras I needed too.

name: Harriet Graves
title: Wrong information given.  Very inconvenient results.
text: All the paperwork and the website indicated that our car rental company (Caro) was located within Munich Airport.  We couldn't find the rental desk anywhere.  We had been given a local number in case of problems, but the number was out of date and it took six attempts with expensive calls before we could hear the correct number.  After an hour of frustration a rep drove up in a van.  He had been told we were arriving at 9pm.  We had paperwork to prove the flight number was known and the car rental pickup had been booked for 10am.  We then discovered the rental company were a 10 minute drive away from the airport by van, so had to factor in that inconvenience for an extremely early car drop off at the end of our holiday.  We arrived to find we had missed the van shuttle to the airport and were expected to wait 15 mins in the office before the shuttle came to pick us up; with two kids, and a very early flight; all the reasons why I had booked with a company I believed to be located within the airport.  I will be taking this up with a complaint to CarDelMar.  Caro themselves did everything possible to help us out but CarDelMar were to blame for the debacle.  Unhappy customer indeed.

name: Goeran
title: So far always a good experience!
text: I have rented cars at Cardelmar 6-8 times over the last two years. The car rental involved has been either Europcar or Avis, and I have picked up and returned the car in Munich.My car renting has every time worked out very well! That is of course partly due to the good work of Europcar/Avis, but I am also very satisfied with the services of Cardelmar:**The homepage is easy to use and provides you with useful filter functions. The types of cars I’m looking for are more or less always available, even when booking on short notice. Somehow, prices provided are also reasonably stable.**I’ve so far never had any bad surprise, when picking up the car. A car from the ordered category (or better) has always been there, and there has not been any misunderstanding about the time period of the booking. I never needed to pay any more than the price announced by Cardelmar. (By the way, the attitude from Europcar/Avis staff was so far extremely professional. No attempts to make my rental more difficult/expensive, because I did not book the car directly with them.)**I always choose the “Coverage without excess” insurance. In my experience this insurance from Cardelmar is substantially cheaper than buying it directly from Europcar/Avis.When renting last time I damaged the car by parking clumsily in a narrow parking house. This meant, that I, for the first time, had some use of my insurance. My experience:**Most important: I quickly got the money, which I had to pay to the car rental, back – within a week after providing the receipt to Cardelmar, the money was paid out!**Clear instructions on what I needed to provide to Cardelmar. Staff was efficient and friendly. I called Cardelmar three times, and every time got through very quickly to an attendant (in comparison it was ‘mission impossible’ to call Europcar’s customer service…)**The technical interface (homepage / call center) was less impressive, though. The routine to open a ticket at Cardelmar’s homepage did not work. OK, when calling, a friendly attendant did it manually for me, but it was still a bit annoying. Some links to essential information at the homepage did not work. When calling, the dial-in menu I had to go through before getting connected to the attendant was not logical at all.SUMMARY: I am very satisfied with Cardelmar, and will for sure continue using them! To make a good experience even better, they could improve/correct a few things in the technical interface, though.

name: Jack
title: Easy to deal with & good quality car & service
text: Easy to deal with & good quality car & serviceMy wife & I were completely happy with the cheapest car (A Chevy Spark 1.2) in Cape town for a 9 day visit. The 4 door car took us easily with a pencil golf bag & two suitcases. I would choose a higher capacity car in the Johannesburg area as it is much higher & 1.6 is the minimum capacity needed to be comfortable. Recommended agents

name: Christopher Vincent
title: Very good
text: I read some reviews some with negative feedback,but i have no complaints whatsoever everything was really good,the actual car hire company (autorent) were excellent.

name: Roger Hodges

name: Ian Coates

text: All went well until the car was picked up when we were hit with unnecessary charges for winter tyres, these apparently are compulsory in Switzerland,  the fact I was using the car in France did not seem to be considered. Disappointed.

name: David P
title: Slow queue at airport
text: For the second year running, we had to queue for over half an hour for service at the car-rental desk at Gran Canaria Airport.. even though there were only a handful of people in front of us.. it just seems to take forever to get people sorted.. Once we got served, we were dealt with quickly and efficiently by the Avis staff.. so not sure if its the staff, or more likely just having to wait behind people who have not got themselves properly prepared..  either way, frustrating when you arrive late and just want to get your car and go.  Also, for the second time with Car-Del-Mar, the car we were given was not quite as big as the one we had ordered.. In our last booking, we ordered a "Ford Galaxy or equivalent", and got a Citroen Grand Picasso; this time we ordered a "Citroen Picasso or equivalent", and got a Citroen C4 Aircross.. in both cases, decent enough cars, but not as big as we thought, and, of course, we had ordered the size of car we needed for the people travelling, plus their luggage.  Overall, the value for money was excellent, but I would prefer it if they would be honest about the car you will get.

name: James
title: Failure to refund
text: Don't use.Rental company stole money from my credit card with no reason. Cardelmar agreed to refund. Gave me two weeks to send bank details (I was away) and then closed complaint! Been trying for 4 months to get them to reopen. Terrible after service. Never answer phone and when finally do, just fob you off. Still no repayment from July, now end of November.Avoid.

name: Sam

name: Kate Jarvis
title: Utterly confusing
text: I had made sure to read through the T&Cs that Car del Mar sent me and everything seemed fine. Once I got to Kefilonia Airport to pick up my car from Europcar there was a problem. I had made the mistake of bringing an invalid credit card. So I cancelled my reservation, the reps at Europcar said I should get a refund, and so I have tried to persue this and I've been told that I'm not entitled as I cancelled on the day rather than 24 hours before. The confusing part was that according to Car del Mar's T&Cs I had to study Europcar's T&Cs as well. but they contradict eachother. Car del Mar wanted to charge an underage surcharge, but Europcar didn't. Europcar said I should get a refund, but Car del Mar said I can't. Whose T&Cs should I listen to? If this wasn't bad enough, the customer services for Car del Mar were unhelpful and sounded like they just got out of bed. The website was impossible to navigate and I feel like they have taken my money for a service I didn't use and that they really don't care about keeping me as a customer. Not using them again. Don't reccomend them.

name: Chris Wood
title: Never use Goldcar rental
text: We hired two cars through CarDelMar for a week in Mallorca in October 2015. I have annual excess insurance so didn't purchase further insurance, but we paid an extra €25.68 to cover the excess on my wife's hire. When we arrived in Mallorca we were told that we only had third-party insurance and, to cut a long story short, were told we would have to pay a further €122.48 in insurance in order to cover ourselves fully. On return I contacted CarDelMar and was told that I shouldn't have paid any more, that the excess we had paid them was unrefundable and we 'shouldn't have allowed ourselves to be talked in to paying any more'. OK, that's bad enough, but please, please, please, never hire through Goldcar as they are a complete rip-off and certainly should not be offered by CarDelMar. My biggest complaint is with the hire company, but since the deal was brokered through CarDelMar, I have to leave a poor review for them as they were no help in sorting out my complaint. We had chosen a full to full deal but had to pay €82.66 upfront which we were told we would get back on return.  We dutifully filled the cars up on return but a week later and we have still to receive anything. We've tried contacting the company, but have yet to receive anything from them.

If you try phoning you are left on their premium rate number.Our next step is take action for breach of the Supply and Sales of Goods and Services Act to a small claims court and forward the case to Watchdog and the Consumer Association.

name: T Brown
title: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY - Go direct to the car rental company.
text: Just back from a holiday to Sardinia after using Car del Mar. I stupidly didnt read the reviews before using Car del Mar and just went on the cheapest price on a comparison website. I booked the car 4 days before travelling.Here is a comprehensive list of what went wrong:1. The website didnt work so i couldnt enter my details online.2. When i called up and booked the car, the gentleman on the other end got my email address wrong so i didnt get my confirmation email until  the day of travel when i phoned up to check. I appreciate that this can happen but the mistake wasn't one letter wrong it was a completely wrong email address which given i had spelt it out to the operator twice was disappointing.3. The price quoted on the website was £141, I asked for a sat nav as well which they said was £28 but they said they wouldn't charge me until i got there as they needed to speak to the local team to confirm if they had one. Checking my credit card statement before i left they had charged me £159 (the invoice they sent didn't itemise the costs) so i can only assume they had already included the fee. Once i arrived at the car hire place at the airport, the actual rental company i was renting from said that CardelMar hadnt contacted them about the sat nav. Thankfully they had one spare in the office but they charged me £28 so i paid twice which is fun! (Looking at the other comments and experiences i will try to chase this as a refund but do not hold out any hope!)4. As with some of the earlier posts you will read be very aware that Car del mar is a broker NOT the actual rental car company. What this means is that if you get insurance with Car del mar and had an accident, the local rental company would make you pay them for the damaages and then you would have to claim this back from car del mars insurance. Thankfully i didnt have an accident but if i did i may have ended up having to pay a lot of cash up front and then having to go through a pretty laborious process judging from the other experiences to get my money back much later.  Whilst this fact is in your insurance contract i think it is not very clear at all and if it wasnt for the fact i work in insurance and know what to look for then i wouldnt have spotted it.Because of what i read about the company and its insurance policy i actually bought the rental cars company own insurance (£30) for peace of mind as i didnt fancy being significantly out of pocket.Overall my recommendation would be go direct to the car rental company rather than use this middlemen as they are not good at all.They may come up as the cheapest but i would avoid them if you can afford it.

title: Sicily by Car
text: I rented a car from Palermo airport, this in itself is not a problem, however, after an early morning start and two flights, I found myself in a queue for a bus to take me to the car rental area. The car rental area was under staffed and I had to wait in a queue to sort out the paper work. (in other words, pay for another insurance)A short walk to the car park, I had to wait in yet another queue so that I could be given a car. The staff miserable and unhelpful. The fuel policy with Sicily by car is to take it full and return it full. It was not full when I took it; but I didn't fancy waiting in a queue to try and explain this to someone who is not interested.On returning the vehicle, there was no petrol station near and I ended up taking the car back with exactly the same amount of fuel as I had received it. When the staff member inspected the car, after I waited in a queue, she told me that the car was not full and she will have to charge me 28 eros plus the amount to top up the car. Luckily, I took a picture of the dashboard with the mileage and amount of fuel so she altered her paperwork to reflect this.(I wouldn't be at all surprised if money is taken from my credit card though!)All in all, it all seemed very chaotic and Sicily by car staff could do with some customer service training although i'm sure they are not in the slightest bit interested.

name: Jasper

name: Roberto Scaffardi

All the other car hire companies had much smaller queues and this was by far the longest I have ever waited to collect my hire car.

name: Kevin M
title: No problems, as long as you're realistic - this is a budget company.
text: I was a little wary after seeing some other reviews of Sicilybycar, but my experience at the Florence airport location was very positive. The car was actually slighter better than the one I expected, with no change in price. The staff were polite and spoke excellent English (I wish my Italian was that good).There were some small scratches/dents to the back of the car, but an agent was on hand close by to check these over and amend the contract accordingly - as long as you're sensible and check the car before leaving this shouldn't be an issue. The car ran perfectly throughout my trip.Additionally (as I've seen in other reviews) the car was a bit dirty on pickup, but for about €50-75 cheaper than the competition you'd have to be an idiot to complain about this - just spend €5 and take it through a car wash if you're that finicky!All in all I would recommend Sicilybycar if you're a sensible traveller who's looking for a cheaper option.

name: Ian Douglas
title: Ridiculously long wait for our car!
text: We chose CarDelMar based on price but it was a false economy.Arriving at Brindisi Airport at about 10am in the morning, we joined a queue of people with only one person serving.Finally, someone else joined them but it took a good hour to be served.They then directed us to the cars where somebody would meet us with the keys. Nobody was there for about 20 minutes.Once we got into the car, we realised there was no Sat Nav (which we'd requested). Went back to the office where we were told that they didn't have any. No apologies or anything.The car itself was fine and the return drop off went smoothly but I'd rather pay more in future to a more reputable company.

name: Lynn Evans
title: Beware booking cheaper cars on line!
text: I booked a 7 seater car with full insurance cover (I thought).   On arrival it appeared I only had a 5 seat car booked (the incorrect code was inputted by Car Del Mar).   Fortunately (it was 11.00pm) there was a 7 seat available.   Europcar informed me that the insurance was not full insurance and if did have an accident I would have to pay for everything and then claim the money back.   This is not made clear on the booking form and needs to be in black and white.  Since I was concerned abut the insurance I then had to take further insurance out with Europcar.  The whole experience cost me an additional 521 euros - in retrospect it would have been much cheaper booking direct with the provider.  I am still awaiting reimbursement for Car del Mar who tell me it can take up to five weeks in busy periods.

name: Rebecca, London
title: Uncomplicated Car Hire
text: The booking system was uncomplicated and easy to do on-line.  We had no problem with the car or the returns procedure even though our flight was earlier than their opening times.  Only minor grouch was they are so popular that there was a very long queue for pick up!

name: John Pearson

Thank goodness there was no queue !Car as described but obviously visible damage not marked on paperwork.

text: Started out by having to wait over one and a half hours at the rental desk.Also the car was damaged on receipt and I am being charged for this.Company best avoided.

name: John Romero
title: Poor
text: The first staff member that served me was very unhelpful however his manager then got involved and was very good.  I returned the car yesterday and now it seems I've been hugely overcharged.  I'll call Hertz directly but i have to say Im not surprised.

name: Barksy
title: very easy. polite and punctual service
text: It was difficult to find the mini bus from the airport when we first arrived.  I flagged the bus down in the car park. The guy was helpful and friendly. The car hire centre is 10 mins from airport which isnt clear on first booking page this needs changing. But the car was magic. Clean, in excellent working order and ready to go. Hiper were laid back, spoke good english and didn't try and sell me extras. A quick demo of the car would have been nice as it was a Fiat and dual transmission and it kept talking to me in spanish and had no idea how to change it to english. But was a joy to drive. On drop off it was easy to find and quick to check out. I arrived early and they were happy to help.The minibus arrived in 5 mins and dropped us off right at the airport door.a good experience as I was apprehensive from other reviews id read. Would use again. good job!

name: Tim Oakes
title: Overall good experience, but unresponsive to email inquiries

name: Stephen Williams
title: Holiday

name: Reto Gräflin
title: Flight delay, no car !
text: Car Del Mar has arranged a rental agreement with Gold Car. Unfortunately our flight was overbooked. Only when I was outside the airport, I was able to contact Car Del Mar Hotline, which was only after agreed pick-up time. Car Del Mar refused any assistance. I should have informed them immediately. This is an absolute no go. Never again with Car Del Mar !PS: We've contacted the rental company, they confirmed that it will not be easy to keep the car reserved until tomorrow, but the clerk was talking to his boss who has now managed to hold the car reserved at Palma de Mallorca for us ! That's what I call service, Car Del Mar only takes money, nothing else.

name: Kevin Brown
title: Easy and best value

name: H M Lewis

text: friendly and helpful staff,car good value for price we paid.Only criticism is lack of instructions on line as to where to pick car up from area P4 was not mentioned.

name: Jens Wulsten
title: Dubrovnik
text: Everything was perfect, young, friendly crowd at the counter.

name: Richard Lee
title: Mallorca hire car
text: Overall very good, took out the fully comprehensive insurance, and fuel full to full option, and still a reasonable deal.  Some hassle confirming the level of insurance,  but all ok in the end, and all detailed on web site.  Actual car was from Hiper car in Palma, very good service and new clean car provided, with no hard sell for additional insurance.I would use them again.

name: Dan Hodgson
title: Booking was easy, but car hire company had no record of us!
text: Site seemed cheap and easy to use. However upon arriving at Faro airport, the car hire company AutoRent, had no record of our booking. After a nervous 10 mins, and lots of phone calls it was sorted!Not sure if an issue with Cardelmar or Autorent so 4 stars

name: Christopher Simms
title: Beware the Car Company
text: We booked through CarDelMar who for their part were fine- booking was simple and I was able to contact them easily when the card payment was problematic.However the Car Hire company SICILY BY CAR are complete con artists. When picking up the car (fiat 500) there were two large paint defects which were not marked on the paperwork as already present. We found a worker who said don't worry about them its ok but eventually marked them off as present on the paperwork. It was a very 'its ok no problem attitude'. So we used the car very carefully for the next 6 days which was fine. When returning the car the same worker said there was new damage to the car we had made. A very small 5 cm rubber mark which we believe was probably already there. However he said 'don't worry the insurance will pay for it'.When arriving at the desk the guy said' so you have to sign here and pay 800 euros which you can then claim back off CARDELMAR for the collision/accident you've had! We couldn't believe it we felt that they were trying to con us. So I picked up a cloth and some spray from the bucket on the floor, went back to the car, and removed the rubber mark easily in one minute!We then insisted the desk guy came back to see the 800 euro collision- which wasn't even there. We were then refunded our 800 euros which barely an apology.I seriously think that CARDELMAR should remove this company.CARDELMAR please email me if you wish for any further details.Many ThanksCat Ross & Chris Simms.Please

name: millerista
title: frustrated by being sold insurance I couldn't use, and having the buy a insurance a second time
text: I was not at all impressed by CarDelMar.I arrived a the car hire partner at Heathrow (which isn't actually at Heathrow. Its about a mile outside the main airport. It took me about half an hour to work out how to get to the hire place, and then a further 20 minutes to make the journey) thinking all costs were covered by the fcat I had bought inclusive insurance as part of the package. When I arrived, I was told I needed a credit card to cover the deposit of £1250. I don't have a credit card and was not aware this was required unitl I arrived. I was then advised I could ring up CarDelMar and cancel the insurance part, then taking out insurance with the local partner and avoid the need for a credit card. CarDelMar didn't pick up the phone (I was on hold for over 10 minutes) so I was forced to pay again for new comprehensive insurance from the local provider.Once you arrive at the car hire place and have made plans (my friends mother was waiting at a train station for me to pick them up in my hire car) you are basically a captured market. Faced with walking away, leaving my friends mother at the train station and not being able to arrive at the location for whcih I had booked the car - or pay again - I paid again.I have checked the terms and conditions in the invoice and voucher sent to me my CarDelMar and can find nowhere any reference that rules out the use of visa debit cards as a means of setting down a deposit. There is also no reference to the fact that I could take along cash in its stead.I wouldn't recommend CarDelMar to anyone.

name: Christian
title: Everthing okay!
text: No problems, everything perfect!

name: Eva
title: All great
text: Everything was as expected - we got the car we booked, was in good condition, baby seat was available - everything went smoothly and fine. Would recommend to anyone.

name: Suhail Khan
title: You get what you book !
text: I rent very often and this time it was after quite a while that there were no hidden surprises at the rental desk. My hire was in Bastia, Corsica and the company was Citer which I guess was operated by Enterprise. The pick-up was quick (although I arrived a little earlier than my booking time so had to wait a little before the car was ready but still picked it up earlier than scheduled and had to return it slightly earlier as a result of that - fair enough!).Return was very quick and easy as well ! I will continue to use Car Del Mar for my future bookings and trust the ratings against their hire partners on the booking portal.

name: Mr Gary Wilson
title: No problems
text: Car booked through Car Del Mar with major rental co for much cheaper price than available elsewhere, including direct.  Got a brand new car with zero miles on the clock.  All went smoothly.  Based on this experience I would recommend and will use again.

name: Madeleine White
title: Mostly good
text: The staff were friendly, English speaking and helpful. The car we hired was brand new, so was fine, except that when the window got dusty, we realised there was no water in the windscreen washers, which was a bit poor. Otherwise, they would have got a 5star rating.

name: Nuno

name: Karim
title: Awful Car Hire Partner

When I refused to pay, they held me at their desk until I coughed up the money and then thinking that I didn't understand the language, the man who I was dealing with told the shuttle driver to delay me in taking me to the airport. The driver didn't because he was a decent human being. The man who I had the misfortune of dealing with goes by the name of Victor Silva, and he is absolute scum!

name: Chris Morris
title: impossible to pick up car after hours! no response from Car Del Mar!

Since Ace Car Rentals was not actually at the airport, I needed to get transferred to the Ace Car Rentals site from the airport. The Car Del Mar voucher said to contact Ace in order to find out the location. However, Ace was closed because it was after 6pm. Therefore, I was unable to go to Ace and pick up our car, and was forced to do a last-minute car rental from another agency.I have filed a ticket with Car Del Mar and have also tried contacting them via phone. name: Ian Johnston
title: What more could you ask for..
text: We booked a Ford S-Max, and got a Ford S-max. We always choose zero excess to avoid any painful bills at the end. No problems at the Hertz counter picking up the car, the lady spoke Spanish, English and German, and perhaps a few other languages, so no communication issues.  The car had about 4000km on the clock, so pretty new. A few more horsepowers under the bonnet would have been nice but with the speed limits in Mallorca, it was fast enough. All in all, great price, great service and 5 stars all round.

name: Adam Braunton
title: Not as smooth as it should have been
text: We booked an Alamo rental through Car Del Mar.  The prices are obviously the attraction, and when collecting the vehicle with the pre-paid voucher the Alamo agent who served us commented on what a great deal it was.  Unfortunately he must have processed the order incorrectly, because on returning the vehicle we were additionally charged the full amount for the rental, effectively being charged twice.  Alamo refused to acknowledge that there was ever a voucher, even when I pointed out that the receipt included the words 'CARDELMAR'.  These are problems with the Alamo process and I have reviewed them separately and appropriately.  Alamo being a dead-end, I turned to Car Del Mar to resolve the issue.  In summary:- Car Del Mar operate under European office hours, making contacting them by phone from San Diego difficult.  A 24 hour system or even a recorded message directing me to the online ticketing system would have helped.- The first person I spoke to was unsympathetic, and clearly only interested in directing me to the online ticketing system.  I would have preferred to resolve by speaking to someone, however he was so dismissive and otherwise unhelpful it didn't give me confidence that I would be helped in a timely manner.- The ticketing system is good, but the turnaround for my ticket was slow. I mentioned this on Twitter and Car Del Mar assured me that this was just the high demand at this time of year.  I would have appreciated this expectation-setting when raising the ticket.- The initial response to the ticket was ridiculous - 'Did you present the voucher?'.  I already stated that I had presented the voucher and the the Alamo agent had commented on the deal, besides - how else had I picked up the vehicle?- I did eventually secure a refund for the charge applied by Alamo.So in summary, I would consider using Car Del Mar again but I would assume that the initial vehicle checkout was incorrect and would need triple checking, and much more diligent in checking any receipts from the hire company.  Neither of which should really be necessary.

name: Hannah L
title: Wouldn't use again
text: Not a problem with Car del Mar as such, but they were the booking partner.  On arrival (on delayed flight, 10pm, with 21 month old, and me, pregnant), called car hire company (Auto-rent) only to be told our booking had been cancelled. Replied that it hadn't, and we were there.  Man arrives, then speaks to his boss, says he can give us a car, but only if we pay again. Get to car hire place, i prove to him I've paid, still make me pay again.  In addition, charges us an 'out of hours' collection fee (on booking paperwork, says office is open 24 hours, and there is no out of hours charge - 20 Euros for a 3 min journey).  When I argue with him about this, he offers to take us back to the airport and leave us there.They say it won't be their mistake, but if it is they'll refund. Get a call the next day (which obv i have to pay for), and it is their fault - no further explanation, so they refund.  On returning the car, same man is there, he doesn't even look at me, gets his colleague to deal with me, explaining situation to him.  No apology.  Would NEVER use again.

name: Phillip

When we handed back, a quick walk around the vehicle was all that they did and pointed us to our departure gate.All-in-all the car rental service was first class and we will definitely use again.

name: Page
title: What a SCAM!!
text: We booked a car in Italy because it was CHEAP! We needed it for 4 hours to go from Napoli to Rome. At just under 17 euro, they were 35 euro cheaper than any other company listed through Skyscanner. We did not see our confirmation email (it had been sent to our spam folder) so we called the following day to confirm our reservation and the price. We were given our voucher number and told to go to Locauto in the Naples airport to pick up our car. I specifically asked again about the price I had booked and was told that yes, 16 euro was charged to our card for the rental. We  arrived at Locauto to pick our car up and were charged an additional 87 euro! By the time we were picking up the car, we had little other choice as we needed to make a flight 5 hours later. Locauto said it is Car Del Mar's fault for not properly informing us and we should complain to them. Car Del Mar says we should contact Locauto to complain and that we should have seen a pop up that said the company could charge an additional fee upon pick-up! Of course, we never saw such a pop up...This is a scam for sure and now that we read other reviews, we see that we should have been smart and checked the internet before booking with this company. Renter beware!!!!

name: Cali
title: Bad Baja Experience
text: Arrived Los Cabos airport early Sunday afternoon with a prepaid reservation for an SUV to fit 7 people for a 6 day stay in San Jose del Cabo. Rental car agency (Europcar) that contracted with CarDelMar said they did not have a car for me even though my reservation was guaranteed and prepaid.  They said whoever else rented "the car" had not returned it and they could not contact them.   We were given a car that could only fit 5 of us, with the other 2 being driven by a Europcar employee and we had to pay the toll road fee for the Europcar driver to get all of us to our rental house in San Jose Del Cabo.  Europcar said they would bring our SUV later in the day to the house.  Needless to say we never heard from anyone that Sunday nor the following morning.  We were then told after many phone calls and much difficulty that there still would be no cars until at the earliest Tuesday morning.   Europcar main office informed us they had 15 cars for 34 reservations and we needed to be patient. By now we were 2 days into a short 6 day stay with no room for 7 of us and no other means of transport as all other car agencies were completely booked.  Finally, after many more phone calls, our limited Spanish and Europcar's limited English, we were able to have a van delivered late Monday evening.  The van delivered was the actual Europcar shuttle used to ferry car renters to and from the airport.This was a horrible experience.  After all was said and done we were told 40% of their fleet had been wiped out by Hurricane Odile back in September.  This reservation was made in November when they already knew they did not have enough vehicles to accommodate the reservation.  They should never have accepted the reservation, charged my credit card, and we could have made alternative arrangements and not missed out on two days of vacation.

name: Neil Turner

I would appreciate you commenting on the issues above and sending me your opinion.Despite all the issues, we sincerely hope these experiences will make you improving your services.With kindest regards,D.Babic

text: Great house, great location, great views - awesome pet area!

name: Thomas Cutrera
title: The views were spectacular
text: The views were spectacular. The place was clean. It was a beautiful cabin.

name: Amanda and Trevor
title: Such a nice area to visit
text: Such a nice area to visit! The cabin was clean, peaceful and just what we needed. Very central to Boone, West Jefferson and more. There was a great winery close by and good restaurants. We loved the small river and scenery at the cabin also.

name: Maureen M.
title: Perfect for visiting App State and Boone!
text: This house was perfect for visiting our daughter at App State! It felt like we were way out in the mountains, but we were only 10 minutes from campus. The front and back decks look brand new. The weather was perfect so we really enjoyed sitting outside. We’ll definitely be staying here again!

name: Michael
title: Fantastic Family Vacation
text: Fantastic family trip.  The location was great and convenient to all the ski resorts.  The home is exactly as described and communication was great.  The view of Grandfather Mountain was unobstructed. The fire pit was enjoyed by all. Thank you for sharing your home.  We made some wonderful family memories.  We will definitely be back.

name: Kosar Iris
title: Great location! Between Blowing Rock & Boone.
text: Great communication! Cleanliness was excellent! This was our 2nd stay at Blueberry Hills. Nice and quiet area. Plenty of essentials. We had a good and relaxing time. Great location.

name: Robyn Perlman
title: Another Point of View is an awesome…
text: Another Point of View is an awesome location close to Boone.  The cabin is newer and nice to have separate AC units on all floors.  Loved having a deck on each floor to enjoy the outside mountain air.   Loved having a pool table on bottom level, would be a nice added touch to put a beer/soda fridge on bottom level for the fire pit and pool table.  After arriving and walking around the cabin we realized the floor was filthy.  Our feet were black within minutes.  You could see a layer of dust on the floor in the sun.  Alot of people like to use 2 towels after a shower and we were only offered 1 per person. After showering it would have been nice to have a rug or towel to step on because the floor gets cold and slippery.  The ice machine and water in the fridge didnt work so we relied on having to buy bottled water for our drinking needs.  I know we are in a mountain cabin and everyone’s sleep schedules are different, light filtering curtains would add a nice touch.   A couple throw blankets for the couch would be amazing for the cooler winter days.  But overall was an amazing experience.

name: Steve B
title: The service was responsive and the home…
text: The service was responsive and the home was amazing.

name: Wendy Manos
title: River Roar and Treetops
text: Nice home, comfortable furnishings, good layout, tree top views and that river.  Oh that river.

name: O.Chamb.
title: A free night added to our stay!
text: A free night added on to our stay was terrific! The Camelia condo was updated and its  location near Chetola Lodge made it perfect for a family of six. The staff responded right away at my request for more sheets and towels. Bright snd fresh.

name: ID
title: Great property
text: We had an amazing time at this property—it exceeded our expectations in every way. It was easy to find, immaculately clean, and offered a spectacular view. The home was well stocked with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.A special shoutout to the staff, who went above and beyond when we had a minor issue with the Wi-Fi. It was resolved within a few hours, and their responsiveness really impressed us.We will definitely be back!

name: Terry
title: We had a wonderful experience booking…
text: We had a wonderful experience booking our rental for our son's gradation at App State! Mickey is amazing! She helped me find a convenient location to the school and made sure the home met our expectations. The process was so smooth. Received daily text and reminders before check out! Will definitely book with them again! Thank you all for making us feel at home.

name: Mary B
title: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was great
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was great!  They sent lots of detail about our trip and were quick to help when there was an issue with our key pad for entry with a back up plan built in.

name: Kim G
title: Beautiful mountain home
text: The house is beautiful and the views are spectacular. Very comfortable and accommodating. Plenty of space for a few families to share and be comfortable.

name: LARRY BROOKS
title: Great cabin.
text: The cabin was great, especially the stream off the back porch.  We spent a lot of time listening to the soothing sounds of the e stream.   We will return.

name: Amy Beros
title: It Was All a Dream...is truly a dream!!
text: ​We spent Easter weekend at It Was All a Dream in Eagle's Nest, and let me tell you—it was all a dream! The house is perfect for two families, and we had so much fun that we didn't even leave the neighborhood.​The kids loved the nearby play area, which includes a zipline and is walkable from the house, and the hot tub was a big hit! We grilled out every night, had bonfires with s'mores, played games, and truly relaxed and disconnected from the real world.​What stood out was how the house felt like a true home rather than a typical rental. The kitchen, in particular, was a favorite with everything you need included.Overall, our stay was a perfect blend of relaxation and fun. We couldn't have asked for a better getaway or better hosts!

name: Mcninch Kathleen
title: Great Rental Company
text: Renting through Blue Ridge Rentals is always such a great experience. They have the best staff that is very responsive and helpful. Both houses that we have stayed at have been reasonably priced and include a full kitchen for cooking.

name: Patty C.
title: Communication is great
text: Communication is great! Checked in numerous times to make sure all was going well!

name: Schatz Allison
title: Peaceful zionville haven
text: Easy booking, check in, check out. Place was beautiful and small, just right.Perfect amenities for a small group. Hot tub had some weird stuff in it, but hot tubs are not reliable, so…The decor of this rental was fabulous and blackout curtains! Yes!The only thing I think all rentals could add is a first aid kit, but maybe there’s some reason for not having it. (Benadryl, ibuprofen, bandages, etc.) we’ll be back at some point!

name: Bullin Carolyn
title: Very nice place
text: Was very satisfied and pleased with everything. It was nice,clean and we will probably be looking to stay here again in the future.

name: Jessica
title: We loved the cabin
text: We loved the cabin! We just had some trouble with our code getting in on the first day. We had to call and ask for help. The person we spoke to didn’t have the right code either. My husband ended up trying a random number off and it worked. The rest of our time there was wonderful! The view was gorgeous and my son had a blast playing in the arcade.

name: Brown Kenneth

name: Janice King

text: We’ve rented through blue ridge several times and have always had a very positive experience! They have top notch rentals, and the company is a pleasure to work with.

name: Dennis from Sarasota, FL
title: Bailey’s Creek Lodge is Awesome
text: Bailey’s Creek Lodge is definitely the most incredible vacation rental we have had the pleasure of staying at!  If you are on the fence about renting this house, just do it, you won’t be disappointed!  From the moment you pull up to the front of the house, you realize just how special this house is.  From the perfect location at the top of a mountain with spectacular views from every window, to the beautifully decorated and extremely cozy interior, there is nothing that has not been thought of.   Just 10 minutes from downtown Blowing Rock, you feel like you are in your own private oasis, but can be enjoying the town in just minutes!  Thank you Blue Ridge Rentals for such a lovely stay, we definitely hope to be back soon!

name: Jim
title: Above it All

name: Erin West

The power went out the first day and we called the power company in the manual only to find out it was the wrong power company for that area. The grill was filthy and the outdoor trash had dirty diapers and other trash in it and the bear lock didn't work.

text: Great cabin in a perfect location. Had all of the essentials.

name: Galeana Anita
title: Cozy getaway
text: House is great! Stocked with everything you might need. Great for families! Will be returning in January of next year!

name: Kristen
title: We just stayed at “It Was All a Dream…”…
text: We just stayed at “It Was All a Dream…” in Eagles Nest and the house truly was a dream! It’s a brand new build, with four en suite bedrooms which was perfect for our family. The house is decorated in impeccable taste and is so well equipped with everything you possibly could need during your stay! The back deck is a great gathering place with a hot tub, a table for outdoor dining and a seating area around the fireplace. After a great day of enjoying the Eagles Nest amenities, coming back to “It Was All a Dream” felt like coming home. We can’t wait to visit again!

name: Tanya C.
title: Cozy Cabin
text: This cabin was perfect for an impromptu mountain getaway. It was very clean and cozy. We stay in this area frequently but this was our first time staying in this cabin. It is now one of our favorites! We will be back.

name: Brown James
title: We had a fantastic trip over four…
text: We had a fantastic trip over four nights. Beautiful scenery and our two dogs enjoyed the cabin and walks. Just driving around the community is breathtaking. We lucked out with warm skiing at Sugar and even got fresh snow while there. The views were wonderful! And the mountain community felt alive and fun to explore. Love the fields and play areas as well. Wasn't sure how to start the propane fireplace but the response was immediate.

name: Patty Hughes
title: Family reunion
text: The ease of the whole trip from start to finish was wonderful. I loved getting the updated text messages. The cabin was beautiful and clean. We also enjoyed the girl scout cookies and water. That was a very welcomed surprise.  We would definitely book this cabin again.  It had something for everyone.

name: Blake Grayson
title: Annual Family Vacation
text: My family loves renting through BRMB. It’s easy and convenient. You have the security of knowing the team is there to help if needed. There is a lot of contact between booking and time of stay. The choices of homes are amazing. Being a returning renter you get perks which is just another reason to go through BRMB.

name: customer
title: Fantastic rental company 5 stars…
text: We were so impressed with BRMR from beginning to end. The lines of communication were very informative and available. The property was beautiful and had everything and then some. Loved the area and liked knowing if we had any questions or problems it was as easy as a text away.

title: Had a wonderful time!
text: We enjoyed our stay…condo was well equipped as stated and very cute on the inside. The rental agency let us know several days before the fireplace wasn’t working which was not a big deal as the weather was very mild and fireplace was definitely not needed. Felt like communication was super and even texted us early to let us know the unit was available early on check in. Would definitely rent again!

name: Stempien Heather
title: Highly recommend, based on numerous interactions
text: We've rented with Blue Ridge Mountain a few times and each time the pricing has been reasonable, the process has been easy, and the property has been just as described. On this most recent visit, we wanted to extend, and that was very easy to do as well. We will continue to use them for all of our Carolina visits.

name: Coley Katherine
title: Great Property but No Refund
text: We were very pleased with our decision to visit Eagle's Nest. The house was well stocked, very clean and comfortable. Given the time of year, many amenities were unavailable, but we still enjoyed our visit. Our original reservation was in October and understandably canceled because of the Hurricane, but we were told we would need to rebook the same house within a year, so we did. However, I was disappointed that Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals wouldn't even consider a refund for the unused amount of the credit. We simply lost money for something that was out of our control. For that reason, we will rent through a different company next time.

name: Ashley Shelby
title: Wonderful scenery
text: Loved my stay and how easy it was booking with blue ridge mountain rentals . The place was nice and clean and easily accessible.

name: Welborn family
title: Charming spring break escape
text: Such a charming escape. Our family had a magical week here in early spring enjoying clean, comfy, light-filled rooms; the well-stocked kitchen where things were easy to find; the wrap-around porch with lovely pastoral views; and the yard's fun features, including hammock, swings, and hot tub. My husband and I worked remotely for two days--fast internet (and a great mini-office setup in one of the bedrooms) made that easy, and our kids (5 & 10) stayed occupied with books, games, puzzles, toys, and more while we worked. The weather ranged from snowy to the high 70s during the week we were there, and we were comfortable through it all (and enjoyed roasting marshmallows in the wood-burning fireplace!). This place is well situated--a convenient home base for several fantastic hikes (left notes on a few of our faves in the guest book) and meals at restaurants in the West Jefferson, Boone, and Blowing Rock area. My only regret is that it was too cold (or we were too wimpy?!?) to tube on the New River, within walking distance of the cabin. Solid reason to go back!

name: Brad Childress
title: It was all a dream …
text: The house is a true haven. It’s spacious, beautifully designed, and meticulously maintained, with a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern amenities. The open floor plan provides ample room for everyone to gather and the large windows throughout the house (especially in the living room) invite the outdoors in, so you can enjoy the stunning scenery no matter where you are inside.One of the highlights of our stay was the deck – we spent hours soaking in the fresh mountain air, enjoying coffee in the morning, and watching the stars at night.It’s the perfect house for anyone looking to check out of their normal hustle n bustle and enjoy a Mountain refresh. It’s also less than 5 minutes from Beech mountain for any skiers and snowboarders that want a quick drive to the resort.

name: Mechenes Matthew
title: Great cabin
text: Great cabin! Lots to do inside and out!

name: Jackson Connie
title: Log Cabin Heaven
text: The home that we picked to stay in was absolutely beautiful. Blue Ridge Mtn. Rentals made the whole transaction so easy to complete and they were in constant contact with us the whole time . We will definitely be returning customers .

name: NRaleigh
title: We stayed at the Cozy Cottage…
text: Erin and I stayed at the Cozy Cottage for three days weekend before last.  Overall, we loved it.The location immediately adjacent to Appalachian Ski Mountain was just beautiful, and was fantastic for accessing Boone, Blowing Rock and/or Tweetsie Railroad. We have stayed in many Blue Ridge Rental properties, but this was the easiest from which to base a stay.One small improvement would be a low sign with the house number by the road, or a number on the house to make locating the property easier in the dark for late arrivals.  Yes, we got in late.The Cozy Cottage was just what we needed for a nice couples' getaway.  We did not use the kid's bedroom with its bunkbeds (just two of us).  The rest of the Cottage is nicely done but not overdone.  It has the needed essentials and is comfortable.  The kitchen is bright, clean, and had what we needed.  The living room is comfy, as was the master bedroom.   Just a note, there is not an ensuite bathroom, just a family bath off the hall.  It worked fine for the two of us.  Convenient washer and dryer located in the bathroom as well.  The Wi-Fi works well, as does the large screen Smart TV.  The deck is large and a great place to enjoy the trees and singing birds.  The parking is generous and directly adjacent to the house.  Very convenient.This may not be the flashiest of Blue Ridge Rental properties, nor the one with the most dramatic view, but it is indeed "Cozy" and is a solid value for the money.  We really liked it!

name: Brooks Andrew
title: Accommodating
text: The staff made sure our family vacation went smoothly as possible with a last minute cabin change.

name: Brito James
title: Moose Preserve
text: First off, the communications wtih BRMR was seamless. Everything was communicated flawlessly and their responses to any of my questions were immediate. We even had a bad snow storm one night and we lost power - They were communicating with us about the local power company and stayed in touch with until power was restored (45 min).

name: Shawnda

There was one later in the week but not when we got there.  We rented this cabin before and it was much better in the past.

name: Dupuis Michele
title: Walker’s Ridge
text: We stayed at Walker’s Ridge and, WOW, what an experience. No detail was left out. Well stocked and everything thought of. Great amenities to use (pickle ball, basketball, play ground for kids, etc). Plenty of space with a cute play nook for kids and game room for all to enjoy.

name: Sydney DeVoe
title: We loved our stay at Cornerstone
text: We loved our stay at Cornerstone. Everything is so well thought out. The adjustable mattress bases in the two larger rooms are a huge bonus (we have one at home and never sleep as well on vacation without it…except here), comfy couches, quiet area. No complaints.

name: Peck John
title: Honey Bear Cabin
text: This quiet cabin was an awesome getaway for my wife and I to celebrate our anniversary.  It’s close enough to Jefferson to just make a quick run to the store if you need anything.  I would recommend staying at the Honey Bear Cabin and we will probably stay here again.

name: Britton Amanda
title: Our stay was wonderful
text: Our stay was wonderful! We came for a short family getaway. The views of the mountains were spectacular. The home was beautifully furnished, had plenty of seating and entertainment, a fully supplied kitchen (for cooking utensils), and was immaculately clean. The property was highly responsive and communicative.

We traveled to both towns several times. Would stay again!

name: Daniela De Pietto

name: Bernadette
title: We’ll be back!
text: The home was beautiful, clean and had all of the amenities to enjoy a peaceful. We appreciated how family oriented the space was and how convenient the process of booking was. Also the granola gift was so yummy!

name: Ray Lynda
title: Always happy with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals
text: We’ve used Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals exclusively since 2015 and have always been happy with their service. We typically book twice a year. Response times are fantastic and we’ve always received prompt & professional service. The only cabin rental company we’ll use in the High Country.

name: Daniel Gregory
title: Pros and Cons
text: Pros and ConsPros- Cabin was big, spacious, and had a lot of fun games (i.e. pool and ping pong).- Absolutely loved the deck and hot tub area!- Climate control was responsive and efficient, we've been to some houses where it takes forever to heat up/cool down- Location is perfect between Boone and Blowing Rock- Everyone we spoke to at Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals were incredible helpful, nice and pleasant. We will come back for future rentals just for our experience with the personnel.Cons- I wouldn't expect it to be thoroghly cleaned after every stay, but there was a large amount of dust on the walls in the master bath (especially the toilet area), indicating it and other spots hadn't been touched in a while- The water pressure in the kitchen sink was abysmal, not sure what had happened to it.- The front door doesn't latch so it gets blown open by wind unless the deadbolt is set

All 3 properties have been very well maintained and are exceptionally clean.  The communication has been great with the company.  We no longer look at VRBO when we want to go to NC mountains because the pricing and overall experience has been much better with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals

name: Sharkey Paul
title: Thumbs up

name: Ball David And Ronda
title: The cabin was so nice
text: The cabin was so nice.  It was in a good location to downtown.  The driveway  was too steep even with a AWD.  Thank  you.

name: Johnson Malrie
title: Little to no heat downstairs
text: Little to no heat downstairs, Screw sticking out on downstairs bedroom doorknob caused a cut, Downstairs carpet not vacuumed rubber bands from hair ties everywhere, dishwasher doesn't dry the dishes, Ice maker cutoff doesn't work leaving ice everywhere inside the freezer, washing machine not working, ladybug infestation in main floor near balcony doors, mold under glass top on dining table, Pets were finding food debris in numerous areas in kitchen and living area as well as under dining table, Hair on shower walls in master bath( not ours) and upstairs shower, first phone number on printed instructions for assistance was a random male not associated with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, After hours number had the same recording as the business office number, left message and got a return call saying they would relay our message, no one returned our call, We arrived Friday and placed our calls and a gentleman showed up Sunday without calling while the children were taking their naps. He acknowledged the problems and said someone would call us Monday. We checked out Wednesday morning and never received a call. My wife mopped the mud from the Kitchen floor on Friday night and we swept up all the food debris we could find. The flapper in the master bath sticks open and the toilet periodically ran until you removed the top and physically seated the flapper. The deck gates were broken and would not close with one gate completely off. The morning sun highlighted the cob webs on the ceiling light fixtures. The shuffleboard  is held together with ratchet straps and the Foosball table is broken on one end. The light on the microwave is out so no light for the stovetop while cooking. The dishwasher didn't clean the dishes well and some had to be hand washed. There was pink Goo on the bannister going to the third floor.How would you rate your service??

name: John K
title: Spring Break getaway in Banner Elk
text: Great Spring Break getaway in Banner Elk!   Home was just as described on VRBO. Location was perfect with day trips to Linville Falls, Boone, Blowing Rock, and Valle Crucis. Walking distance for everything in and around Banner Elk. Very clean and well stocked with attentive and helpful staff at Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals! We will definitely be renting from them again!

name: Lappin Kimberly
title: Such a great time in this cabin
text: Such a great time in this cabin. Was so wonderful we could bring our family and or dogs! Putting this cabin on our to go again list!

name: Barnett Melinda
title: CSR’s were friendly and tried to help…
text: CSR’s were friendly and tried to help but no follow ups were ever received. We had no power after the storm last weekend and water pressure was very low. The cabin book gave a number to call for power outage but they required a phone number to report outage which we did not have. I called BRMR three times simply asking for a ETA for power to be restored so we could make a decision on staying or leaving early. Power was out 24 hours. Never received a call back at all. Right after my third call I called BRMR to report power was on. Cabin had no emergency lighting at all and the pots and pans are in great need of replacement and were even dirty.

name: Shawna
title: Weekend at River Ridge

The kitchen is well stocked with all necessities. The fire pit outside is perfect for a serene night by the fire. We will definitely be returning!Consider carefully about bringing more than two people because there is only one bathroom in the house in the master bedroom, which could be a problem if someone has to use the restroom during the night.

text: Awesome cabin, easy to communicate w management company.

name: NW
title: Had trouble at check in
