name: Glinsky Thomas
title: Great weekend with the family with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals
text: Company was great to work with to book our weekend getaway. The property was as described and beautiful. Couple things that could have made it better would be the binder at the home seemed to have very general information regarding the area. Took us a while to find out where the closest grocery store was due to very rural location of the home. Providing us some details ahead of the trip such as "roads are under construction and may be difficult to pass" and that it's best to be prepared with food shopping ahead of your stay would have been extremely helpful. Also, additional details on all the amenities at the house and how to use them would have been great as well. For example: Sonos speakers for outdoor hot tub would not work and there were no instructions on how to connect. No instructions on the steam shower and it's use in the master bedroom. These were all minor but it would have made our stay a 5 star.

name: LB
title: We had the best time!
text: We had the best time! The house was beautiful and the staff recommendations were great.

name: Craig Donovan
title: Do your homework, ask for confirmation of maintenance records.
text: My experience was so poor that as I wrote up my review it went on and on and on.  So I've decided to highlight it simply.Rented Look Out Lodge for two weeks.  On third night had to leave due to CO2 leak that was discovered only after we required them to come and look at furnace because the fire department who responded to our CO2 alarm on second night said "we were here two weeks ago for this".While we were able to complete one week at another less desirable property (with non functioning fireplace and hot tub) BRMR did not refund the entirely of our missing week and required us to pay for the days in their poorly maintained CO2 cabin.I was worried that the effects of Hurricane Helene would be that there would be less activities for my family.  I never imagined (and guess owners don't either) that it would affect the ability of companies like BRMR to maintain their properties and endanger my family.

name: Shannon
title: Extremely disappointing
text: Rented a large house in Banner Elk/Beech Mountain area for about 15 of us. Five days before we were due to arrive we get an email informing us our reservation at been canceled and that we’d be receiving about 1/4 of the money back. We called the company and got it worked out. Upon arrival to the house later that week we found that it had not been cleaned. Multiple trash bags on the floor, beds unmade, bathrooms dirty, etc. We called to let them know and were told our only option would be to move all of us to a different house just for one night until it could be cleaned. It was about 9:30pm at this point with snow rapidly coming down, making the visibility and roads a huge issue. We were also going to ski early the next day, so driving between houses to transfer our things really wasn’t an option. We let them know we were uncomfortable driving and would prefer to clean the house ourselves and instead get a refund for the first night. After lots of back and forth the company agreed. We spent our first night doing hours worth of laundry and cleaning to make the house sanitary enough for us to go to sleep. Luckily some of our group found out soon enough to stop and buy sheets before arriving to the house. The next morning we left to ski and when we came back at the end of the day, the house had been cleaned but the sheets we had bought were gone. The cleaning crew likely mistook our sheets for theirs and took them with them. We let the company know and asked that they be returned but we were told that wouldn’t be possible. We just received word that our “refund” for the first night would only be about $400, which is not equivalent to the full price of the first night. Extremely disappointing experience to say the least, think twice before booking with this rental company.

name: E P
title: Wonderful views
text: Wonderful views, well stocked, and lots of amenities. The game room was nice, along with the fire pit. A good layout for families to spread out as well!

name: Woods Katie
title: House was wonderful and clean as…
text: House was wonderful and clean as always. Although, the kitchen was missing some key items, the trash bags provided were super thin and ripped and it was very cold and the pilot lights wouldn’t stay lit in either of the fireplaces.

name: Robinson Corey
title: Location was brilliant
text: Location was brilliant. The property itself was beautiful and possessed great character.

name: Kurt K.
title: Best In Class
text: BRMR staff are courteous, professional and truly want you to have a great experience in the home you rent. They try to get you in early if possible and are good about responding to questions quickly. The houses are always spotless and the maintenance techs are skilled and glad to answer questions as well.

name: customer
title: Great location and house has all of the…
text: Great location and house has all of the amenities.  Less than ten minutes from Beech Mnt restaurants and ski resort.  Kids(and adults) loved the game room.

name: Anonymous
title: Managing company incredibly quick to…
text: Managing company incredibly quick to respond to issues throughout stay no matter day/time.

name: Tiffani Snow Richard
title: VERY CLEAN
text: We chose a home through Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals as they had the best prices listed for the dates we wanted to stay. They have a variety of homes in all price ranges, and we were able to find the perfect cabin for our girls weekend. They were extremely informative once we booked regarding how to get to the home, check in/out procedures and made sure to provide plenty of warning that the home was AWD access only. We appreciated how clean the house was (I'm talking one of the cleanest rentals I've ever stayed in) and that they provided a binder full of information. We actually used the binder to locate a local pharmacy on the way to our outing at Beech Mtn. One of the guests in our group commented that the labels on the light switches were very helpful. There were more than enough toiletries for 1-2 nights and hot tub towels were provided. The only negative is that when we went to get in the hot tub the first night, the hot tub had no power. We unplugged the hot tub and plugged it into the outlet just above the one that it was plugged into and the hot tub powered right up. Unfortunately, we couldn't use the hot tub that night or all day the next day as it took time to come up from 64 degrees to 100 degrees. We were able to use it late on the 2nd night.  we did reply to an email BRMR regarding the hot tub when they emailed to see how our stay was going, but we never heard back. The string lights on the back porch weren't working either, but we did have the overhead light.

name: Judy Nobles
title: Wonderful cabin
text: Our cabin was very clean and the correspondence from the company was outstanding.  Everything was just as they said it would be.

name: Miller
title: Stay FAR away owners/renters
text: Stay far away from any rental managed by this company. Look out for AIRBNB and VRBO. I truly feel bad for property owners using this management company as they are incredibly negligent in their management, communication, and execution.We rented a home through their company for a weekend in blowing rock and had a disaster of an experience. We arrived at 5pm on a Thursday to no heat or hot water. After several hours of trying to reach their “emergency line” due to a gas smell in the home, I resorted to calling 911. Blue ridge sends their renters to an offshore call center at 5pm on a weekday with no one local to talk to. After we have spent several thousand dollars a night, this is simply inexcusable and poor customer service.Blue ridge was not able to refill the propane until the next day despite their statement saying “within a few hours”As it turns out, blue ridge management had neglected to fill the propane to the home and we had to pack up and leave with two small children in below freezing temps and icy roads. The fire department pointed out that there was no working smoke detector, carbon monoxide detector or working heat, and that the condo was not safe to stay.After repeated calls to blue ridge the next morning, a representative assured me that I would be compensated for the hotel stay we had to purchase since we were displaced by their rental mismanagement.After several back and forth emails with blue ridge representative, “Amy Wright”, I was informed that they had reneged on their promise to compensate. And that a refund of just the amount paid was “fair”.

name: Palacino Stephen
title: Amazing winter view and comfortable…

text: Very unhappy this year

name: Ben
title: Beautifully maintained homes
text: Beautifully maintained homes, very responsive and helpful. Rented with them twice now and will go back again

name: Kolb Meghan
title: Home is beautiful
text: Home is beautiful! Loved waking up in master bedroom looking out at deer walking up the mountain. The kids bunk room is adorable and they loved having their own space downstairs to hang. The upstairs has a great floor plan for entertaining. It’s nice that it close to the main entrance because you can get to town faster.

name: Wendy
title: Having non-emergency issues is ok as long as you have someone help you resolve it.
text: This feedback is only about the customer service. As not every vacation is perfect to a tea, I am impressed on how Blue Ridge Mountain taking a time to review the 8 point issues we had during our stay in one of their properties. They were very welcoming of my feedback and a regular check-in during our stay was conducted.

name: Ryan O
title: Perfect Family Getaway!!!
text: The cabin was so much fun and perfect for our family. It was spotless when we got there and had no issues. We will definitely be back here next year.

name: SB
title: The house is beautiful and has most…
text: The house is beautiful and has most everything you would need. Our only problem was that the driveway is very long and steep and it was covered with so much snow that we couldn’t make it down the driveway in our SUV with 4WD until the second day. It felt like we lost two days of our vacation because of shoveling and salting the driveway and we still couldn’t make it down the driveway. I immediately called the maintenance team when we arrived but they said the didn’t plow driveways. When I called a second time to check again about plowing because we still couldn’t make it down the driveway, and because they also hadn’t delivered our firewood, they said they do plow driveways, but it still took them two days before they showed up. This was our third time staying in this home and overall I would recommend it but beware of the long, steep driveway if it is winter time. The pictures do not show the length or the steepness of the driveway.

name: Tommy
title: Great location and unit was very nice…
text: Great location and unit was very nice overall.  However, there was no bathroom sink.  At all.  Just missing.  That was just strange  Also called twice to try and get gas fireplace to work (we were in the mountains while it was snowing) and never received response. Talked with someone finally but no one really cared.

name: Payne Barbara
title: Our main complaint was with the…
text: Our main complaint was with the kitchen.  The oven door would not close properly and all the controls on the front of the stove would get very hot.  We had a toddler with us who wanted to be in the kitchen.   We had to watch her very closely so she didn't get burned.   I burned myself when I tried to turn on a burner on top of the stove.  That's whe I realized this was a significant safety hazard.  I called the maintenance number and was today they had nothing in the notes about the stove.l called the owner and she said it was Italian and she probably needed to buy a different stove.  She said there was one man at the maintenance office who has worked on it before.   He came on Tuesday ( this problem started on Saturday), and ended up putting 2 pieces of Gorilla tape on either side of the oven to keep the door closed.  He left a strip in the garage incase we needed more.  It helped but we still could not touch the dials without a pot holder.  Then the dishwasher didn't clean the dishes and we had to rewash most of them by hand.  Also, the cabinets were set back and it was difficult to get dishes, glasses etc.  Other than that the rest of the house was lovely.   The fenced yard was nice for our dogs.

name: Beth B.
title: Exceptional
text: The Heart Rock Lodge is everything you might want or need for a comfortable family vacation.  It is spacious but cozy, has beautiful mountain views, has a fully equipped kitchen with newer items, and comfortable beds.  Communication with the rental office was easy and we were well informed with important information.  Customer Service was quick to respond.  I highly recommend this Lodge and Blue Ridge Mt. Rentals and hope to return again soon.

name: Mccutcheon Robert
title: Renters Beware of Poor Service
text: I would caution renters from using BRMR.  We rented "Vilas Retreat" the weekend of 1/17.  We had a series of problems with maintenance.  To start the front door lock batteries were dead.  After waiting an hour for a call they got us in the garage.  Then the alarm went off and they didn't have the code.  Next we discovered the main floor heat wasn't operating.  We obviously asked for help and they said they would get back to us.  No one did.  The entire very cold weekend without heat on the first floor.  Finally, the BBQ had fallen over in the dirt..not burgers as planned.  I asked for resolution when we returned and they provided a $283 refund or 19% of our rental and a $100 credit for future rentals.  Ridiculous.  Insignificant and why would spend more $$ with a company that treated us so poorly.

name: Liz A
title: We loved it!
text: We loved this house and hope to go back someday! It was cozy yet roomy with fantastic views. The hot tub was a great addition. Communication was excellent.

name: Celetti Kristy
title: I called for maintenance due to our…
text: I called for maintenance due to our jets spitting out dirt and not being able to use the jacuzzi tub. Also, the hot tub didn’t quite get as hot as it needed to be. I was told that maintenance would come out but no one ever did.

name: Drew B.
title: Gorgeous, cozy cabin getaway
text: Beautiful cabin, actually even *more* cozy than we expected from the pictures. Gas heater is very strong and easily kept us toasty. Plenty of towels and blankets! Good dishes/cups/etc. and had coffee, tea and creamer available which was a nice surprise. Hot tub worked great and we had fun with it! We were very blessed with snow throughout the visit, and the grounds are beautiful to watch with snow falling. Overall everything we could have hoped for on a “snowcation”! We’d definitely like to return someday!We had a couple issues (the fireplace didn’t work and we had a pretty bad electrical short with the washer), but we were in contact with management during the trip, and after the visit they’ve followed up to genuinely try to make it right, so we are still very pleased.Last note: the owners advise you must have 4-wheel drive in the winter — this is true! We did and were totally fine, but a friend with front-wheel drive tried to stop by and couldn’t make it up!

name: Susan Hunt and Family
title: Aspen Family Ski
text: Office staff helped quickly to find us the perfect house for our family's winter ski Get Away - plus it was dog-friendly - reasonably priced too.  The home was very comfortable, roomy, clean, and had everything we needed and very close to Appalachian Mtn. Hot Tub was a bonus !Thank you, Blue Ridge - we will be using you again.  -

name: Davis Charlene
title: The rental company was great
text: The rental company was great. The house was good and accommodated us well. The only problem we had was that the hot tub & washer were not working but the rental company notified us a couple of days before arrival. The kids were disappointed about the hot tub but had a great time in the snow. House wasn’t ready until 430 but it was a holiday weekend so I guess they were busy. Appreciated the refund the rental company was able to get us since we were missing some amenities. They were great to work with & we ours use them again.

name: Karina Ribeiro
title: Would like to leave my feedback about…
text: Would like to leave my feedback about my stay here for these 4 days. I arrived at 4:05 and the house was all dirty. The cleaning lady arrived at 7 pm because I called to complain, but since there wasn't enough time to clean, the house wasn't cleaned. The next day I went to turn on the fireplace and it didn't work. I called to complain and they wanted to fix it on the penultimate day of my stay. The video game controller was faulty and the Jacuzzi wasn't in perfect condition either.

name: Kimberly
title: Beautiful views!
text: The views were gorgeous and the house is very spacious! We enjoyed the big hot tub. Our only small problem was that it could have been a little cleaner, especially on the main floor and kitchen/dining areas. As soon as we came in we had to sweep up and we found some trash in the couch cushions. Other than that our stay was great and we would come here again.

name: Gregory
title: Snowy Mountain Retreat
text: High end private community of Eagles Nest made our first experience in Banner Elk safe and special. Roads were plowed regularly made getting around less stressful than staying outside of a planned community with wonderful amenities. The wild life was plentiful and fun to watch. The unit is grand and we loved the "black bear" theme throughout. The house was well maintained but, the stove was missing a knob to control one of the burners, the hot water in the kitchen was frozen up for the first day only then was repaired. The right up is misleading showing 4 bedrooms when there are only 3.

name: Chelsey
title: Anniversary Trip with a Twist
text: My Husband and I rented a cabin for our 15 year anniversary it was a beautiful cabin “A River Runs Through It” we enjoyed our first two days there. We watched the presidential inauguration and the Buckeys win the Championship cozy by the fire! GO BUCKS! After the game we realized the pipes froze upstairs and the water came pouring into the kitchen just a few hours later. The ladies with BMR were angels! They had us in another cabin (Trillium) just as perfect as the first cabin within 2 hours. We were so relieved with the quick responses and fast transitioning to finish our trip. The Manager came out to the cabin at 1030pm to check on us. She was so sweet and helpful. Before we eventually left to head home (3 days later) we realized they refunded some money for our troubles and they explained the homeowner was very thankful we jumped into action and shut the well pump off so there would be no further damage to the cabin. All in all we will always use Blue Mountain Rentals for all of our trips! Absolutely wonderful customer service and hospitality!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Chamberlain Jim
title: A little snow helps
text: What a difference a little snowfall can make. That, along with a great view of the ski slopes made our long week-end something to remember. Being medically challenged I was able to witness the enjoyment my kids and their children had ice skating, sledding, riding the coaster or just taking a walk. Unfortunately they were not able to enjoy snowboarding as our reservation was canceled due to the "snow storm" Sunday, Jan 19th. We will look forward to coming back to Sugar Mountain in the near future to check that off our list. Overall a very enjoyable experience.(On a housekeeping note for the owners, the coffee maker still had old grounds from a previous tenant, no instructions on how to light the gas logs and the Xmas tree was still up a month after Dec 25. I didn't allow these to affect my review of 5 stars.)

name: David
title: Spacious with wonderful View of Grandfather MTN

name: Fields Jessica

name: Amsalem Yaniv

name: Cummings Melody

I am sure that if the homeowner knew the lack or maintenance and care for the safety of their renters, they would choose a different rental agency to rep them.

name: Sturman N
title: Ski Summit
text: The home was amazing and very well stocked with cute upgrades and supplies for the snow.  We had some shovels, some trash bags, normal salt/pepper, very little dish detergent/washer detergent.  That would have been a nice touch to have two of each to use for basic trash, dishes, one or two loads of laundry.     I enjoyed staying there however some of the key enhancements of the condo we not working.  i.e. the dishwasher, oven (the oven did not work in a baking situation only in convection which was harder to use) and lastly the grill needed service.  WE managed and did what we could with all of the services we had.  The refrigerator had some issues but nothing too crazy.  But mainly the oven, grill and the hot tub worked amazingly for our purposes.  we loved it.  Lastly I did not like the 10am checkout on sunday as we wanted to attend church and ski. could there been another options to stay or stay half a day.

name: Amanda G
title: Peaceful and cozy

It was incredibly peaceful and the interactions with the Blue Ridge Rentals were all pleasant and helpful. We will definitely look back into their properties next time we come to the area.

name: Altamirano Salomon

name: Cathi Propper

We had a great time and would definitely return in the future!! Thank you!

name: Bennet A

name: Lovelady Beverly

name: Probst Andria
title: The property was pristine
text: The property was pristine, cozy and absolutely perfect!!Amanda the owner was always available for any questions with a quick response time. The bonus was that is was a dog friendly property. We will be returning in the future!!

name: Eric Coronato
title: This is a great location if you’re…
text: This is a great location if you’re interested in visiting the area of Benner elk and Sugar Mountain and Beach Mountain. The accommodations were spacious and it was well kept.

name: Clark Family
title: The house was absolutely amazing
text: The house was absolutely amazing. The huge front yard and fresh snow made for a picture perfect sledding experience for 4 young children. The locations was central to Beech Mtn and Hawksnest along with Multiple restaurants. But the best was when Blue Ridge sent guys over to plow the driveway and assist us in leaving with all the fresh snow.! Highly recommend and will definitely rebook next year

name: Johnson Greg
title: Great View
text: The house was in a perfect location to experience winter. We did have to buy light bulbs for some of the interior and exterior lights as well as batteries for TV remotes.

name: Lettrick Laura
title: Clean, just as described.
text: House was clean and had great views. We had a little issue with the firepit and they sent someone out on a Sunday to address. Great communication and experience.

name: Leanne Radabaugh
title: Great Location - Lovely Home
text: This is a truly lovely home! We very much enjoyed our snowy weekend! It's very well appointed with plenty of space. The decks are lovely. Very convenient location to Boone, Valle Crucis and Banner Elk. In the winter months, you really need 4WD or All Wheel Drive at the least.

name: Key Kimberly
title: We loved the house
text: We loved the house. It was beautiful, obviously you can see by the pictures. The view was absolutely amazing. The beds were comfortable. And we had a lot of fun in the theater room and playing on the foosball table. My kids had never been in a sauna. We probably did that every single night along with the hot tub and it was amazing. The only thing that I will say about the house that I didn’t like was that the TVs were very hard to understand.If you want to watch TV, good luck. lolBut you do have a huge theater room downstairs that works great

name: Rebecca
title: Great cabin for a family trip
text: We had a wonderful stay at this cabin!  It was the perfect size for our family - plenty of room to have space when needed, but cozy enough that we had to spend time together.  The drive up the mountain takes ~ 15 min after you get through the gated entrance.  There was a heavy snow and we actually had to get snow chains to get up and down safely - with 4WD.  That being said, they did an excellent job at clearing the roads in the neighborhood the next day - and they continued to work on the roads through the day.  We were so appreciative.  Of note - the "back road" to Beech Mountain was not an option while we were there.  There was actually caution tape to prevent people from traveling on it - again likely for safety :)  Hopefully this will open soon as I can see this cutting down on travel time from the community to Beech Mountain.

name: Rebecca Frenia
title: This is the second home we rented…
text: This is the second home we rented through Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals. Both homes were exceptional. The reservation process is easy with great communication. We will definitely be booking with them again.

name: Harrison
title: Gorgeous Home
text: The home was absolutely stunning and provided a ton of space for our group.With that being said, the mountain view from the home is amazing, but more care needs to be taken in cleaning. The large windows and glass doors that showcase that beautiful view, were dirty and terribly streaky from previous cleanings and full of handprints. The tv in the living area was also full of what appeared to be child’s handprints and a trash can in the master bathroom was full from whoever was in the home prior.The hot tub was nice, but the walk up and down the steps were a little tricky with the ice and snow.Again, the home is amazing, just few minor things that were noted during our stay.

I have several thoughts on this - this weather was expected so I would have thought that extra caution would have been taken to prevent impact to water pipes; the rental co gave us several options to rent in place of our initial selection; we ended up in a smaller but acceptable cabin; this cabin was not clean - cobwebs throughout the house in kitchen cupboards, windows and closets - very dirty bedspreads, throws and sofa.

text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals is always easy to work with and they have some of the best properties in the area.  We have rented nearly 10 times. Easy to communicate with and if something isn’t perfect, they work hard to fix it.

name: Kayla S
title: Cute Spot with amazing views
text: The property has gorgeous mountain top views. We had a little problem checking in because the code that was provided was incorrect. After a couple phone calls that all went to voicemail, I finally Received a text from blue ridge rental with the correct door code. Our stay was great, however the bottom floor did get chilly at night. Thankfully there were extra blankets and space heaters. Leaving the property was a hassle due to a winter storm dumping 9 inches overnight, which only called for 1-3”. Despite having vehicles with 4 wheel drive, one of our SUVs wasn’t able to make it up the driveway and slide down.. there were shovels and 1 bag of ice in the shed. However the shed was frozen shut and when we were finally able to open it, the key froze in the lock and snapped in half. After 2hrs of shoveling we were able to get all vehicles out of the driveway. Very thankful for the kind neighbors that helped us!! So be mindful of potential snow storms and bring only big trucks! Aside from the driveway issues and the delayed responses from the rental property company, we loved our stay, loved the house, and would definitely stay here again!

We loved the location and the property in general.The beds were super comfy, and happily made already when we arrived.We were absolutely thrilled to have some beautiful snow during our visit, which definitely added to the cozy appeal!We could not be happier with blue Ridge Mountain Rentals- Everyone was friendly and flexible. title: Great stay

Maybe a little dusty in some areas (windows, around tv, night stands) but not a deal breaker.Close to stores but far enough from civilization. About 30 mins away from Ski Resort.Cabin had great views. I do recommend having an all wheel drive in the winter months or tire chains. We definitely brought ours and needed them with our Highlander.Overall, we loved it, would stay again.

name: mark guice
title: Fraudulent Practices / Scam Alert
text: I am appalled by the experience my family and I had with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, a company that exemplifies the worst customer service I have ever encountered. My wife has been dealing with them, and its been nothing short of a nightmare. They included in their rental agreement that they are not responsible if you cannot access the property, fully aware that you won't be able to navigate steep mountain roads in snow and ice. This blatant disregard for guest safety is unacceptable.We recently rented a house for two nights spending $2400, only to find ourselves stuck and unable to reach the property. The drop-off on one side was so steep that if we had slipped off, I would not be here writing this review. As someone who drives a Chevrolet 2500HD and has experience driving in snowy conditions, it was still impossible to make it up the mountain. We ended up with no place to go but back home, leaving us incredibly disappointed and out of pocket.Despite my wife reaching out to their customer service, they promised callbacks that never materialized. It's clear that this company is fully aware of the dangerous conditions of the subdivision roads yet continues to rent properties without any concern for the safety of their guests. They make you sign an agreement stating that you won't receive a refund, effectively trapping you in a situation where you are left with nothing but frustration and financial loss.We refuse to be scammed and will continue to share our experience on every single platform available until we receive a refund. Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals is a ripoff, and we strongly advise against using their services. They need to be held accountable for their actions!

title: Below average customer service
text: I have rented with Blue Ridge Mountain Rental at least 4 times but I won’t be using them again. The customer service provided was not satisfactory. I felt like they didn’t care about us. When we arrived the driveway was packed with snow and there were 2 large long boxes weighing more than 200 lbs each, occupying the driveway. There was no way to move them without a forklift. We tried to move them ourselves because we needed more space. We had to constantly be rearranging our cars because there was not enough space due to the packages. To make matters worse the house did not have a shovel for us to use. There should have been one accessible. There were no instructions stating we had to bring one. When I called to ask about plowing the driveway and removing the delivery I was told they were short staffed and probably wouldn’t be able to help. No one followed up with me.  If they expect people to do their own shoveling they could provide a shovel. The next day, the fusebox was tripped so we needed to reset the breaker. The breakers were behind locked doors. How is this allowed? The temperature was 58F downstairs. We waited over 3 hours for maintenance to call us. We finally got tired of waiting and went searching for the keys. We figured out where the keys to the doors were and successfully reset the breakers. The emails I sent were responded with sorry only. There was no attempt to remedy the situation. This is a million dollar neighborhood. People pay more to stay there and to be ignored is terrible customer service.

name: Elaine Guice
title: Disappointing and Dangerous experience
text: UPDATE: For any potential customers reading these reviews, it's essential to pay close attention to the tone of the company's responses. The replies come across as condescending, and the claims made are misleading. Writing reviews to inform others about possible fraud should not be dismissed as "spam." There is no way anyone could have accessed that mountain on the day we were there—this is simply untrue. While they offered me a credit for the same house, it feels pointless since I only travel to Boone to ski, meaning the same mountain would be just as treacherous as before. Additionally, the offer of six bottles of wine was inappropriate, as I do not consume alcohol. A fair resolution would have been a refund of $2,469 to stay at ANY of their rentals, but that was not provided. I have sought advice on this matter and someone will be in contact soon.I am writing this review to express my deep dissatisfaction with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals following a recent experience that was not only disappointing but also dangerous.I rented a house for two nights at a cost of $2400, and was advised to use a 4-wheel drive vehicle with chains. My husband’s Chevrolet 2500HD is a large, capable truck equipped for such conditions. We have lived in Western North Carolina our entire lives (55 years) and are well-acquainted with driving in the snow. However, the situation we encountered upon arriving at the community was unacceptable.The entrance to the community was covered in snow, and it was clear that no efforts had been made to scrape or salt the roads. As we began to drive up the steep mountain, the slick conditions quickly became alarming. After a few turns climbing up we got stuck, and it was terrifying! We were sliding backward down the mountain with a steep drop-off on one side. Thankfully, we had a shovel in the truck, which allowed my husband to create a space to turn around.Descending the mountain was equally perilous. The road was a solid sheet of ice, and even with the truck in the lowest gear, we struggled to maintain control and sliding off the side of the mountain. This was a nightmare of a situation, compounded by the fact that we had two children in the back seat, and I continue to have flashbacks about it. We understand the driveway to the property not being maintained, we expected that, but we had no idea that the main road in the subdivision getting to the house would be in such bad icy conditions!When I contacted the rental company to explain that we couldn’t reach the property due to the hazardous road conditions, their response was disappointing. They simply said they would pass my message along to customer care. We had nowhere to go and so we went back home! It was very disappointing. The next day, I did receive a call from one representative who seemed skeptical about my claims regarding the road conditions. She promised to investigate and follow up, but it has been several days and I have yet to hear back.Upon reviewing the lengthy rental agreement, I discovered that the company absolves itself of any responsibility for access issues due to snow. They are fully aware of the potential dangers posed by the steep, unmaintained roads, yet they continue to rent properties without ensuring safe access.This experience did not only ruin our trip but also put my family's safety at risk. I feel compelled to warn others about Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals. While some may leave positive reviews, I urge potential customers to pay close attention to the negative feedback. This company is a scam, and they do not prioritize the safety or satisfaction of their clients. My family and I will not be returning, and I will continue to share our experience to prevent others from facing the same ordeal.Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals, expect to hear more from me.

name: Alexander Kristin
title: Poor Customer Service
text: Our family was excited for a weekend getaway at Beech Mountain. My husband, daughter and niece were planning a Saturday ski day, while I caught up on some work at the cabin. Driving up on Friday afternoon put us into a welcome snowstorm. It was much later when we arrived at the cabin due to heavy traffic in the area. When we arrived at the cabin the check in code would not allow us entry. I had to call BRMR and after trying the code again a few times, given a new code to try, we were finally told where the hide-a-key was located. Our family unloaded and my daughter went to take a shower. She began yelling that the water would not start. We tried the water in the kitchen, it would also not run. Once again, I made a call to BRMR. They deemed this as an emergency and stated that they would put in a call to maintenance asap. I received a call about thirty minutes later that the water company should be there soon. Around an hour later, the water company sent me a text stating that due to the weather they would not be able to make it to our location that evening but would be there sometime the next morning. My husband went to the basement to make sure the water valve was cut on (which it was-inside).The next morning my family left for the ski slopes and I prepared for work. This is when I realized that the Wi-Fi login was not working. I made another call back to BRMR. I told them that I was very frustrated about the water and now the Wi-Fi. I spoke with an agent that was going to follow up with maintenance. The water company arrived within an hour but the shut on/off valve was frozen underground and they were unable to proceed. I spoke again with a representative from BRMR at 6:00 that evening. She apologized for the inconvenience and asked if we wished to move to another home for the night. She and I both agreed that by the time my family got home from skiing, we pack up and move to a new house, it would be time for bed and then wake up and check out. The representative then stated that she would make adjustments to our account the next day. It has been one week and I haven't heard anything. This is my third time renting from BRMR and I typically don't have problems. I am disappointed to have spent a weekend without water and no Wi-Fi without any other contact from BRMR.

title: 20 foot Dump Trailer 12/21-28/2024
text: We made our reservation in August 2024 planning for our Christmas vacation Dec 21-28, 2024. We arrived at the rental home that cost $3900 for the week to find a 20 foot dump trailer in the front of the house taking up the driveway, it appeared that this home was having the wrap around porch remodeled before we arrived and looked like the renovations would continue after we left. When I called to request the dump trailer be removed, they said no it will stay and there were no other options for us on our Christmas vacation in the mountains,  we would be forced to look at a dump trailer all week, give up a large part of our parking area and have 25% of the porch under construction and unusable. This rental company in our opinion does not care about complaints, they refunded us $500 but that was after multiple requests to resolve our issues. They said our contract doesn't give refunds, however we feel that by not giving us a warning about the property being under a remodel during our stay and not giving us as the consumer a choice in the matter is 100% a breach of the contract. The house itself was fine but not what we wanted to work around all week, it's just not fair, it's our 1 family vacation in years, since this reservation was made 4 plus months ago, to schedule a remodel while actively renting a vacation property is blatantly wrong and someone should be accountable.Buyer Beware, this rental company is not interested in customer service. If your rental has an issue, it is likely nothing will be resolved in your favor. It seems that they have too many properties and no quality control. Perhaps they are forgetting that vacation rental customers do have legal rights in these matters. If we as customers must abide by the signed contract, so must the rental company.

title: Book Elsewhere
text: When you are spending quite a bit of money to rent a cabin, you expect a great experience. Unfortunately, that was not the case for us. We stayed at The Nest at Seven Devils. When we walked into the cabin, we saw two fridges, one in the kitchen and the other right near the stairs where there's little space to walk past. We thought it was a bit odd until we started putting food in the fridge that is in the kitchen and realized the fridge isn't working. No one informed us of this. Made sense now that they had two fridges. We started putting our food in the other fridge and realized that fridge also was not working. So now there's two fridges that don't work. Then we tried to connect to the wifi. Could not find the wifi name on the list of networks. We called customer service about the fridge and the wifi. One of the maintenance guys came and informed us that the second fridge is here because the first one stopped working with the people before us, and he confirmed the second fridge wasn't working. He said first thing in the morning he would replace the fridge. We also spoke to him about the wifi and finally figured it out and confirmed the login information given was not correct. Next morning, it's 10AM and no one has come yet to replace the fridge. I call customer service which is in India and told me they reached out to whoever they needed to get the status of when we will be receiving the fridge. I told her I'll gladly stay on the phone until she receives a response, but she told me she has to end the session so she can contact whoever it is she needs to about the fridge. But she told me she already reached out to someone, so that made no sense, so I said I am not ending the call until you hear back from someone. So we sat on the phone in silence for about five minutes and then she proceeds to tell me the fridge request ticket is actually closed and was taken care of? I said no it's absolutely not resolved, and we did not get a replacement we need one. She said she would call me back in five minutes to reach out to them again, I said fine. Did she call me back? Nope. So I called customer service again, got a different rep, told them the situation and need someone asap. The maintenance guy from the first night called me and said he ended up switching days with someone else and will let them know to call me and give me a status. No one called. Three hours later I called the same maintenance guy back letting him know and he apologized and said he'll call them right away. They finally came and replaced the fridge. The replacement fridge also wasn't working correctly, but had a little coolness to it, and we were just very tired from the back and forth, so we just hoped for the best. Oven was filthy, kitchenware was not cleaned, found food on plates. Pictures on the website are outdated and don't have the same items in the cabin such as knives, table, end tables, etc. The blinds on the windows are broken, bathroom door handle is falling off, shower faucet is loose, blanket was dirty, found a used tissue on the floor. The welcome packet to read when you arrive is not up to date. It says they only have a gas fireplace, when the living room has a wood burning. The fireplace on the lower level is gas and it looks like it's taken apart, not sure if it works or not. The wood burning fireplace was the highlight of our stay, but overall, not worth booking through this company. And reading the BRMR responses in these google reviews, there seems to be no accountability at all and keep blaming their customers.

I reported this as well. The road to the house was not the description on the website. It was a total disaster and we have four-wheel-drive. title: I'd like to begin with the positives of…
text: I'd like to begin with the positives of the home. We spent our 1st christmas as a family in this beautiful place. Upon arriving, we were all excited with the views and comforts of the house. Well decorated for feeling of christmas spirit. It really is a place of peace. My complaints only come from a place of unfortunate events. Our hot tub seemed to have an electrical problem, so we were unable to use it for the entirety of our stay. Which was 4 nights. After reaching out to see if anyone could look at it, I had to call 3 more times to finally get a response to someone coming. 42 hours into our stay.  Informing us it was electrical and couldn't be fixed.  The master bedrooms bed had a foam piece layed on top of it. When my husband and I would lay on it, the bed folded us into the center. Seemed maybe the bed had broken underneath from a previous stay. The topper would try and fold us both up in it as though we were burritos. It left us unable to utilize the bed and sleep on the couch. The home is allowing animals, but the cleanliness of the hair, we found while laying on the rug, was proof of a faulty vacuum. They informed us they will switch out to help other stays in the future. There are mouse droppings under the stove area and large pan area, I assume from an opening under the stove.  As I stated, these are just happenings we encountered. This isn't anything to take away from the homes magnificent overall feeling. We were able to build memories in spite of our events. title: Best home in Eagle’s Nest!
text: The Heartstone Lodge was clearly built with a lot of heart. This house had EVERYTHING and we were happily surprised to see it already decorated so cute for Christmas. Little homey touches everywhere made it so comfortable for our two young children and their grandparents. We were lucky to get a snow day our first morning there and having such a cozy home to enjoy it made it fun to stick close to the house for the whole day.

name: Cathy F.
title: Great communication and updates…
text: Great communication and updates throughout our stay. Useful information about the effects of Helene, so we were better informed and prepared. The owners had the house decorated for Christmas which was lovely. Very clean property and the kitchen was stocked with everything you might need to make a meal. Perfect house for our family of ten. We can’t wait to come back in the spring!

name: Six Mary A
title: Thanksgiving stay with family
text: It was a great stay with my family but we had some issues.I reported them in an emailItems needing attention:Unable to enter property with code provided - delayed entry for 30 minutes.  Difficult to reach management team.Delivery of firewood ordered with rental should have been delivered prior to arrival.Propane tank for grill not adequate to prepare one of our first meals.  Propane should have been checked before arrival and new tanks providedPillows in some beds were too thick or too thin.Pots and pans need to be replaced.  Many were unusable especially ones with teflon coating.Ice maker doesn't allow cube delivery only crushed iceGas fireplace has no exhaust.  Unsafe for upstairs guests especially a babyNot enough hand towels provided for a 5 day stayNot enough teaspoons in kitchen cutleryFridge shelves missing in door made it difficult to house all grocery items easilyUpstairs toilet paper holder was completely broken and unusable.Batteries in remotes didn't work.  Additional batteries should be providedCornhole boards were available in rental even though I was told there weren't anyHair dryers were provided too - but listing indicates they weren't there.Hope this helps for other guests in the future.  This was certainly not the smoothest rental for me, and I've used many other rental apps/agencies. (Airbnb, VRBO, etc.)

name: James Laura
title: The perfect Thanksgiving experience!
text: Enjoyed a beautiful and snowy Thanksgiving in this lovely house. Cozy and well stocked with plenty of space!  We enjoyed ping-pong, puzzles and a picturesque view. Can’t wait to return.

name: Travel Agent
title: Home had no heat.
text: Our family of 12 arrived at Honey Bear Haven only to find that the heat was out. When they sent someone to check on it, he told us the heat had been out for over a week. Not only did they knowingly send us to a house with no heat, we had to spend an extra $700 to stay in a hotel the first night of our 5 night stay.They did find us another house by noon the next day. Even though there were not enough beds for our family of 12 and only 2 bathrooms, we felt we had no choice but to stay there.  We ask for compensation for our troubles. We wanted payment for the hotel rooms and first night rental for the unheated house. Long story short, we did not receive full compensation. I am very disappointed that first they sent us to a house with no heat and then would not fully compensate us. Had they tried to make things right in a timely manner and apologized I would not be writing this.

name: MAE
title: Just no.
text: Cold 45 degrees when arrived.DirtyDryer did not workDish washer sounds like it's burnt out

name: Seefus Douglas
title: Uncle John’s Cabin basement is unusable in winter but well equipped as a three bedroom 2 bath cabin
text: Overall a positive experience and well equipped. I think the advertising was misleading. To not have heat in the basement in the winter made it unusable. It should really be advertised as 3 bedroom 2 bath and two story cabin in winter. For that reason, we would not stay here again.

name: Tester Ann
title: We have rented from Blue Ridge Mountain…
text: We have rented from Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals quite a few times and it has always been a great experience. They make it so easy to rent and get to your property. We recently spent Thanksgiving week at Good Medicine. This is our favorite place that we have ever stayed. It is beautiful, well equipped in the kitchen, fireplace is awesome, spacious and updated. I can't say enough about our wonderful experience at this place. We appreciate Blue Ridge and especially this property. Thank you

name: Debbie Wiggs
title: Booking Apple Cove was easy
text: Booking Apple Cove was easy, the website was user friendly and pics and descriptions were accurate. This is a great rental company to work with if you are coming to the Boone area. We travel with pets and most of their rentals are pet friendly. I always look on their website first.

name: Phyllis
title: Handles issues promptly
text: Easy to book rentals. We had an issue with the code to enter the house. Customer service was professional and issue was handled promptly.

name: Mary M.
title: We’ve had many rentals with Blue Ridge…
text: We’ve had many rentals with Blue Ridge MRs and really appreciate the communication with your staff. The accommodations over the years have been excellent. Mostly we trust BRMR and their people based on our experiences.

name: Chris S.
title: Great House & Location
text: Great house!  Layout was great and the property was clean, with the exception of the main/large hot tub.  The main hot tub was unusable upon check in and was not fixed for a couple days, appears someone left it uncovered and leaves sat in it for an extended period of time, and it was not checked during the home cleaning/inspection phase prior to our arrival.  The staff who did clean it were awesome, and apologetic, so kudos to them for going above and beyond.  We understand this was likely a one-off situation due to the fact much of their staff is still working to recover from the hurricane damage, so it will not prevent us from renting through BRMR again.

name: Kimberly Blomeley
title: Amazing homes
text: The homes with this rental company are always top notch and very well maintained! Rented from them 6 times  and all different homes and never had a negative experience.

name: Ange Todd
title: JOY TO DO BUSINESS WITH!!
text: Easy to deal with, very polite no matter who answers the phone, very informative, and just an overall JOY TO DO BUSINESS WITH!!

name: Gatto Greg
title: I have used Blue Ridge over a dozen…
text: I have used Blue Ridge over a dozen times.  They do everything right.

name: Catherine D
title: Beautiful Cabin retreat
text: Cabin was awesome and my family had a great time. Kitchen was stocked plus more for cooking an amazing Thanksgiving meal! Quiet beautiful neighborhood and not hard to access at all. We arrived with snow on the ground,  slight trouble entering the house because code that was given was wrong. Took some time with limited cell service to get the right code. Customer service was friendly and attentive and got the job done. The book that was provided had the wrong wifi code, so 24hrs with very limited service and tvs run off of that but I was able to troubleshoot that by calling the internet provider. One of the electronic games featured in the basement stated no service and we could not play on it,  which was a bummer because we were all looking forward to a pac-man tournament.  All in all our week was amazing and I would stay again!

name: Hays Jonathan
title: Experience was fantastic
text: Experience was fantastic! The cabin, the customer service from blue ridge was all top notch! I would recommend this company and cabin to anyone who wants to stay in seven devils!

name: Patterson Nora
title: House was clean and well kept.
text: House was clean and well kept.Nice group of about 10 deer visited the property daily. Had a wonderful snowfall while my family was there.

name: Shauna
title: Home away from home!
text: The check-in experience was very efficient and seamless, the property was thoroughly cleaned, and the views were amazing!!

name: Rose
title: Precious Jewel
text: My sisters, my daughter and my husband arrived with my 95 year old mother who LOVES the mountains. Our concern was finding a clean home with a minimum number of steps to get in and with a bedroom on the 1st level. This home met all of our needs. It was spotless and fully stocked with things we needed! It was a real hilly travel to get to but it was like a precious jewel tucked away in a lost treasure chest. We are planning to go back.

name: Mcgann Michael
title: Great location and home
text: Great location and home!  Really enjoyed our time at Muir Lodge and loved the amenities in the home.  Close to hiking and the parkway it was a perfect getaway for my wife and I.  Thank you!

name: Garcia Claudia
title: Perfect cabin
text: The cabin was really nice and clean. The weather was cold with a little snow on the grounds. The kids had fun. The cabin was nice and warm. The fireplace didn’t work. They did send a repair guy but he couldn’t get it to work. It was close to restaurants. We brought our dogs and the place was pet friendly! We will definitely be back again.

name: Mike Smith
title: Engagement Ready Views
text: The house is just as described and has all the essentials you would need. Policies arent too bad either, so you won't be doing much to take care of the place or for checkout. Plus the view is fantastic up on top of mountain! Good enough to get engaged at!

name: Whitney
title: Great cabin
text: Great cabin, excellent customer service. Perfect setting for a family getaway!

name: customer
title: House was dusty and uncomfortable.
text: We stayed at Creeksong Cabin in Banner Elk and it was less than satisfactory. The home was extremely dusty to the point my family's allergies would be set off anytime we were in the home. We even had to have the rental company bring a cleaning crew but it was still dusty afterwards. The only way to heat the home (besides portable space heaters) was a wood fire stove. This was never marketed or mentioned in the booking details! We have a 3 year old so it was so unsafe since the stove is burning hot on the outside. There was always a faint smell of smoke which made me feel uneasy having a toddler in the home on top of my being pregnant. This should have been mentioned. The beds were extremely uncomfortable and sloped. Even with the mattress pad the rental company offered they were still miserable. There were no curtains on the windows and even the bathrooms! So if you value sleep or privacy then don't stay here. It smelled of dog dander everywhere. We left one night early because we simply didn't want to be in the home anymore. I would not recommend this home to anyone.

name: Fields Bradley
title: Communication was great
text: Communication was great, the cabin was itself amazing.  However,  We received a text message earlier in the morning that ok'd us for early check in.  It said the property had been cleaned and prepared for our arrival.  Upon our arrival, it appeared no one had been to the property in some time.  2 smoke alarms were sounding every few minutes due to dead batteries, there were dead flies everywhere, and ashes/previously burned logs in the fireplace.My complaint is that if the house was cleaned and prepared for our arrival, there would not have been those issues left.  The rental experience was great, BRMR did fix the issues.  I would recommend better attention to detail with your rental properties.

name: Simpson Adam
title: Fantastic cabin with picturesque views!
text: Fantastic cabin with picturesque views. Exactly what you would hope! Very clean and had everything you would need.

name: Brad
title: A+++
text: 2nd or 3rd time now at this property over past 5 yrs, will keep coming back!

name: Norris Sandy F
title: A most magical stay…
text: Our stay at The Cedar Wood Lodge, November 21 - 26, 2024, was exceptional to say the least. My husband and I, our daughter, her husband and our three grandchildren had the most extraordinary time at this absolutely gorgeous and well stocked and cleaned “home away from home”.We had a slight issue with a couple of the gas fireplaces, however, it was instantly taken care of when I called Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals to ask for assistance. I have spoken with several staff members of this company from the day I first booked our stay through reporting the fireplace issue; everyone has been so pleasant and helpful.It began to snow upon our arrival on Thursday so we stocked up on groceries at the Publix grocery in Boone, which is so convenient. What a magical Friday and Saturday we had with the grands in the snow at this most comfortable and cozy lodge! It was like a very sweet fairytale dream…simply perfect! We enjoyed morning coffee on the deck, making s’more’s and sipping hot cocoa by the outdoor wood burning fireplace with the children and watching the amazing sunsets in the evenings by the fire. What a breath taking view from all around the deck playing and relaxing outside!The location is convenient to Boone, Valle Crucis, Blowing Rock, West Jefferson and many other places, as well, where we visited to  choose and cut our Christmas trees and do  quite a bit of Christmas shopping! We are so thankful to give the NC mountain people our business after such a horrific tragedy in October. You have been in our hearts and prayers since the beginning and will remain there for the length of your recovery! We continue to follow your progress and donate where we are lead to for your healing! The NC Mountains have been deep in my heart since I was a very young child…it was so wonderful to be back with the people that I love…my family and all of you who live there!I miss the home that we sold there, but have found a simply perfect place to stay when we go…The Cedar Wood Lodge!Thank you so much Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals! You are awesome! And WNC…you are loved! ❤️Sandy

name: Tony Fernandez
title: Heating system failure

name: Monks Marc
title: Great experience
text: Great experience! Clean, and so so cozy!!! Would go back anytime.

name: Barbieri Connie
title: The cabin was just perfect
text: The cabin was just perfect.  From the many amenities like the hot tub and fireplaces to layout and cleanliness it provided the perfect weekend getaway.   We loved cooking on that amazing stove.Let’s not forget the spectacular views.

name: Candy Russell
title: Great home in a wonderful location Blowing…
text: This home that we rented in Blowing Rock was wonderful. There was plenty of space for our party of 8. Both kids and adults enjoyed themselves. Beds and home were comfy. Downtown was very close. We loved that. The community pool and sauna were great. We really enjoyed our weekend visiting the area. We hope to visit again soon.

name: Rose Stacy
title: Great Visit
text: Great location, serene, private, clean and comfy unit

name: Stephanie Riggan
title: Scenic Mountain View
text: As APP Alumni, we’ve been spending many years in the mountains at different properties. The drive to and from Boone is so scenic and enjoyable! The house is well designed and has beautiful updated furnishings. There is so much space for multiple families and friends to enjoy. The view on a beautiful fall day or even a snowy winter day is breathtaking. We can’t wait for our next trip!

name: Schumacher David
title: Thank you very much amazing place we…
text: Thank you very much amazing place we will be back.

name: Lynn R.
title: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals is our…
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals is our favorite place to rent our vacation mountain houses. BRMRs has great customer service and are easy to reach if we need anything during our stay.

name: Laura
title: Best home in BRMC for large groups, lacking consistency with rental company
text: We absolutely loved the home! Our top favorite out of all the homes we’ve stayed in at BRMC over the last 5 years. It was spacious for our large party but yet still provided a closeness. The home had all things that you would need during a stay.Unfortunately, we did not have a good experience with the communications with blue ridge mountain rentals as there were discrepancies with information and documents shared regarding use of ATV on the BRMC property. In previous years, we have always been allowed to bring our ATVs to ride the advertised trails in the mountain club. We learned of the recent changes in BRMC’s policy as we were walking in the home. The documents and signed agreements sent at booking near 6 months prior to our stay were different than what was sent just 2 days prior to our reservation. While the rental staff were pleasant there is much disappointment in how all was handled which is leading us to likely never stay at BRMC again in our blowing rock visits. Many opportunities for the changes to the rental company listings.

name: Reams Mitchell

text: Beautiful home in a movie like setting.

name: Tallen
title: Wonderful experience
text: The cabin greatly exceeded our expectations. We are 1st time BRMR users and we have already booked to stay again 4 months from now.

name: ROBERT
title: The house was WONDERFUL
text: The house was WONDERFUL. Well equipped kitchen, spacious living area.Could use a few dimmer switches for the lights rather than all or nothing, especially on the back porch.Multiple directions sent from the realtor were confusing.  NOT at all happy with the road conditions per directions sent to us the day of travel.Eagles Nest could have better street lighting and house lighting.

name: Young Erin
title: My stay was very enjoyable for me and…
text: My stay was very enjoyable for me and my friends. The communication was great between me and blueridge as well. When my cabin needed to change because of the hurricane they quickly found me other options. Loved my stay! Kinda wished check-in was earlier though.

name: Tender Carolina
title: We had a pleasant stay at cabin
text: We had a pleasant stay at cabin. The customer service was great — the team was responsive and helpful, even though the hot tub wasn’t working during our stay. The cabin itself was clean and well-maintained, with all the essentials needed for meal prep. The beds were comfortable, ensuring we had a restful sleep. While the hot tub issue was a bit disappointing, it didn’t take away from the overall experience. We’d consider staying here again!

name: Steve Johnson
title: Communication was so easy
text: Communication was so easy. We arrived a little late and the entry code didn’t work but we were able to reach someone immediately and the situation was resolved.Had a smoke detector that started beeping but was able to reach staff (Amy) quickly. Maintenance quickly fixed it. Everyone in your organization is very kind and super helpful. 5 stars!!!!! Planning a trip in March

name: Rick
title: No need to go far away to retreat
text: We had a delightful experience renting with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals. Google Maps sent us through a private street. That was our mistake. BRMR provided turn-by-turn instructions that we decided to ignore. After finding our way to the property, we found a cozy, well-maintained cabin that met our expectations. If you are looking of for a place to retreat or focus, this is the right place. The cabin and the area are very dark and there is not a single noise to be heard at night.We cooked our own food. We found all the needed cookware in the kitchen. We only had to wash the blender thoroughly as it was clear that nobody had used it in a long time.Our dog and cat enjoyed the property too. Our dog enjoyed promenades on the grounds. The cabin had lots of hideaways for the cat. We do appreciate that the property accepted cats. It is very hard to find properties that do.If darkness and silence is not for you, the cabin has a fast, reliable, Internet connection that you can use to catch up on your favorite TV series. We decided to bring our own Fire TV box. This is much less hassle that having to log on for each service in the provided Roku TVs.The cabin is a short drive away from Blowing Rock. We enjoyed shopping and fine dining there. The drive to and back to the cabin is quite a treat. You get magnificent views of the Blue Ridge mountains, especially at dusk and dawn.

name: Annas Lauren
title: Grandfather Vista
text: The cabin was in a convenient, yet peaceful location. It was very clean and we loved using the pavilion at the front of the neighborhood. The accommodations were perfect for our group of 8. The kitchen was large and spacious. The best of all was the incredible views off the back deck! Breathtaking! We loved exploring Lenoir for the first time!

name: Debbie

text: Great advice and information to help choose ideal rental property for my families needs.

name: charles lloyd

name: K. E.
title: We had a great experience with Blue Ridge Mountain
text: We had a great experience with Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals. They were so responsive and very accommodating. We inquired about adding a day to our trip and the turn around and confirmation was immediate. Very professional agency!

name: Scott Pro
title: Five star
text: From the beginning till even during our stay Mickie was extremely helpful. We originally were able to cancel because of the hurricane. So she was very helpful during that time. Answer all of our questions. That’s why we rebooked when everything was OK. There was 20 of us and everybody was extremely happy. The property that we stayed at was called the lodge five star house. The owners have done a great job with decorating and taking care of it. Thanks to everyone. We’ve been using your company for years for our rentals and every time has been great. Thank you, thank you thank you and we will see you in 2025.

name: John
title: Great location

name: Deanna
title: Beautiful cabin home
text: Beautiful mountain home. Love the decor and vibe. Great price for what you get compared to other rentals. The drive in wasn’t as treacherous as others so that was much appreciated for a city girl like me. Close to town. Only wish there was more grass for dogs to go to the bathroom. The little grassy area was on an incline so it was a little tough to take 2 dogs out all the time. Loved the ping pong area!

name: Sharon Parrish
title: Our experience at The Bear’s Eye View…
text: Our experience at The Bear’s Eye View was amazing…we will definitely be back next year….this is our 4th house with your company and we are looking forward to coming in the spring as a “Girls Trip”,,,,,I’ll contact you..l.lThanks soooooo much…Sharon Parrish

name: Allison
title: Great Stay!
text: The cabin is very clean and spacious!Kitchen was stocked with plenty of cooking supplies, which was nice for our group who stayed in the whole weekend.knocking one star because the TVs / wifi was very lagging, and the living room TV hardly worked. Luckily we brought our Laptop to HDMI to the TV or else we would not have been able to watch anything.

name: Novotny Carson
title: Engagement Weekend
text: This property is incredible. I planned a surprise party for my girlfriend here this weekend. We did not want to leave. The property is in an incredible location from nearby hikes to the town of Boone and local brewery’s. It is November so the weather was perfect for afternoon hikes and almost no crowds. There were 5 couples total and we had plenty of room. The cabin itself is spacious and very well maintained. Everything was immaculate when we arrived and the management company made it extremely easy to check in and check out. They had a great basement for entertaining which was great for the guys to go down and play some darts while the girls talked upstairs near the fireplace. The amenities are all updated and the beds were very comfortable. Everything was well laid out and easy to find. The house had been decorated for Christmas which made it extra cozy and warm. This weekend was very special to us because I proposed to my girlfriend and I genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better place to make this memory. Cannot wait to go back.

name: Purakal Alixandra
title: Perfect Blowing Rock area retreat
text: Extremely organized process and gorgeous home. Views were incredible. Decor is beautiful. We had a wonderful experience.

name: Mohr Rachael

text: Beautiful house with incredible views. Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was extremely responsive, welcoming, and helpful. Are stay was amazing and we will definitely be rebooking that house and using BRM Rentals again.

name: M Beane

text: We absolutely loved our experience at Baileys Creek Lodge!!! The home was gorgeous and incredibly well maintained. It was the perfect experience for our first home rental stay. We didn’t want to leave! Blue Ridge was easy to work with and maintained great correspondence during the stay making it so easy to enjoy our stay.

name: Anonymous
title: Fantastic Experience!
text: Bailey's Creek Lodge was amazing! We loved everything about our stay. Views were stunning and the home was everything we hoped and more. The location was a very convenient drive to Blowing Rock and Boone. We hope we get to revisit next year!

name: Kyle

The inside was very cozy and relaxing.  The nearby hikes were really fun as well. Would highly recommend staying at this cabin.

name: Alexander  Walker Jr

name: L. Mark

name: Mike N
title: Very Disappointing
text: We arrived at the property and the deck / stairs had been freshly stained and they were not dry, they were still tacky and probably have foot prints from bluestone dust.Water pressure is pretty bad and if someone is showering downstairs, there is hardly any pressure at all upstairs.  The ceiling fan upstairs bedroom makes a horrible sound when you turn it on and only one lamp in the fan worked when we arrived.  That lamp burnt out about 2 hours after being there and then there were NO lights that worked in the fan / light fixture.  There were two very obvious urine stains on the comforter, right near the pillows where we lay our heads . . .that was disgusting!  The sheets / pillow cases clearly had not been changed in this room.The upstairs bathroom had a broken shower curtain rod that was left leaning in the corner, there are water or mold stains throughout.  My wife described this bathroom as looking like a crime scene.The carpets throughout were pet urine stained . . . I've stayed at many pet friendly rentals . . .the carpets in this one were the worst i've ever experienced.  As mentioned earlier, there were even urine stains on the comforter.  That is easy to deal with, but it was left . . . what a repulsive welcome . . . urine on the comforter where you're going to sleep at night.one of the legs on an ottoman was broken and it had been carefully set up to look normal.  The first time we moved it, the front leg folded.  Why not just remove the ottoman.  The vent cover from the microwave was missing . . .who cares but it was par for the course.As was the case in the upstairs bathroom, water stains are prevalent throughout the space but really bad in the bathroom.  The common bathroom had a broken toilet paper holder and there was a roll placed on the sink.  Not a huge deal, but just like the rest of the property . . . nothing is well maintained.We were in town for a wedding and we were in and out.  No one wants to arrive and have to call to have maintenance done during your visit while you have guests in the home.  We were there for the wedding and chose a house so some of us could stay together and thought that it would be more enjoyable and more comfortable than a hotel.  Due to the nature and as is common in today's world, I had remote work to wrap up over the weekend.  I could not access WiFi and this was important the other stuff i decided to live with.  I called for help with the password . . . the password provided did not work.  Support offered password support but only offered the one that had already been provided.  They offered to come out saturday night and when I told them that was the night of the wedding and we wouldn't be in the unit, i never heard back from them.  WiFi isn't important, it was a necessity.  Someone had clearly replaced the netgear router with a new router prior to our arrival, but it was not accessible to any of the guests due to lack of a password.  This didn't only affect my ability to finish my work, but also affected the other guest from being able to stream to the t.v.s so most of the t.v. were useless.

name: Cheryl Fontenot
title: Mixed experience with this mostly nice home
text: After receiving loads of emails on everything from info on the house to neighborhood rules to how to deal with bears, they neglected to send me the door code to the house! Got the gate code, then got to the house to find that there was no house door code and BONUS the ring doorbell didn't work, so they couldn't unlock it remotely for us. Since there was no cell service at that hour (now 7:45pm) I had to keep going partway back down the mountain to get service. After 2 such trips speaking with BRMR trying to get the door code, we finally got in at 8:20pm. Once we got the door code settled, our stay was as expected. It's a nice, newer house (the backyard isn't finished, with random white pieces of pipe laying around!). The deck was our favorite place, even though the view is of forest, not overlooks. There were ample places to enjoy the outdoors, and we loved the fireplace and the firepit. The house was nice and clean, however, there was only one hand towel in the primary bathroom, and it was dirty! Other bathrooms had hand towels that served as origami features holding various bath items, but no nicely folded, ready to use hand towels. Thankfully, I'd brought a couple sets of our own towels (because you just never know what quality you're going to get and I'm picky!), so we had plenty of towels - but finding the hand towel in the primary bath with an obvious dirty spot on it was not the best. The furnishings were pleasant; however, I'd warn those travelling with older people that the beds are very low to the ground, so harder for some people to get in and out of. Ditto with the chairs - there were no arm chairs in the place, which made it difficult for one of our party to use, as she was having trouble with her knees. We never met the owners, so I can't comment on them. A maintenance guy stopped by the second day to try to fix the doorbell, but didn't have the right key. The door to the hall bathroom didn't close, and the sliding door out to the deck took a great deal of effort to open and close. Looks like some settling may have occurred, which I suppose happens over time. This home is quite literally at the end of the road, and directly across it is a house under construction (not shown in the pictures, of course!). No one was working on it while we were there, and it looks like a long term project. Construction items were littered all over the driveway and spilled over into the turn off to the home we rented. All these things kind of turned what would normally be a pleasant place to stay in into something that I probably wouldn't lease again. We chose the home because the interior was nice and bright, not too much wood inside and that didn't disappoint. We didn't use the firepit on the lower level as it is quite the walk down a steep flight of stairs (that gate from the deck to the ground doesn't close, either!). Of course we didn't use the hot tub, but the home does have one albeit without a very relaxing view given that it looks out over the construction project next door. Overall, this place met our needs for the time we were there. Blue Ridge was prolific in its emails, it just failed to send the most important thing. They did provide very good directions, and our GPS (Waze) directed us right to the house, with no problems. They did text me the house code...at 9:37pm! *Sigh* We stayed here because our 62 acre property nearby is currently on the market. Eagles Nest is a lovely property, with so much to do! I highly recommend the resort, but perhaps a different property. This one literally took 22 minutes from the Elk River Gate to the house. Beautiful drive, breathtaking views on the way, though! We were here for my father's memorial service from Wednesday to Sunday, so didn't have time to take advantage of all that the resort had to offer. I'd definitely return, and will when we come back up...just to a different property!

title: We had the pleasure of staying at…Beagles Rest
text: We had the pleasure of staying at Beagle’s Rest in mid-September. This well organized home allowed us to have a peaceful vacation where everything we needed was provided. Beagle’s Rest is located in the beauty of the most gorgeous Mountain views, with tons of things to do right in the community. We loved playing mini golf, hiking, and exploring nature (including many animal sightings!). The home is very clean with all needed supplies to cook and enjoy your stay. At Beagles Rest, we loved the fire-pit, hot-tub, and game room. In the surrounding areas we loved going on an off road course, hiking local waterfalls, gem-mining, and doing the Alpine roller coaster. There is so much adventure close by! We highly recommend this home to anyone- it’s perfect for quietly enjoying mountain time or getting out and exploring! The home's interior is beautifully decorated and has multiple layers to spread out for small groups, but you can gather in the main floor for big meals or games. The beds were amazing and comfy! We can’t say enough good things about our fabulous time here and look forward to coming back again. Beagles rest is a perfect get-away space that will leave you feeling like you want more time there! The icing on the cake was that our pup was also able to join us and he had the best time too!The rental company was very responsive through-out the experience and did a great job of sending helpful messages, answering questions prior to the visit, and following up during and after to ensure our experience was wonderful! They did a great job prepping the home with supplies and it was very clean.
