name: Cheryl Richards
title: Would we ever come back? No.
text: Within 1 hour of arriving we found 1.the large main refrigerator not working, 2. No propane for the grill, 3. No chemicals in the hot tub.The fridge had a large handwritten note stuck to the door saying to use the small fridge that was added to the dining room. When I called the office to see if there was a plan to fix it, no one had any idea it was even broken so there was not plan to fix it! (We bought groceries banking on the large fridge, not the small replacement)The empty propane tank we discovered when we wanted to start dinner. That was incredibly inconvenient! So we had to use the large gas oven. Which normally would be just fine. Except the damn thing would not turn on! Over the course of the week we discovered it was just very temperamental. It only worked about 25% of the time.The lack of chemicals in the hot tub of course we discovered when someone got in. YUK!The propane tank and the chemicals are routine maintenance!! How in the world do you miss that?In addition to these 3 HUGE items, the deck had so much crap from the trees on it. OK, not a huge deal. But after staying for a week, there was no way the deck was blown or swept in a month. Again, routine maintenance.  So until we swept it ourselves (and it's a big deck) we were dragging leaves and crap into the house and the hot tub (when we were finally able to use it).And then there was the door handle in the upstairs bedroom that when closed would just randomly lock. (Twice when someone was on the outside of the room)The door handle on the back door was broken.A cabinet door was hanging by 1 hinge.A dining room chair arm was broken.There were just so many little things that came up during our stay that you could tell, this house is not a home, it's definitely just a renal. And not one that is looked after very well.The only saving grace of this house were the bedrooms and bathrooms. Very large and very vice.Would we ever come back? No.My husband and I stay at a lot of vacation rentals. Either alone or with family and friends and there were too many things wrong and the first 3 were HUGE! text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals is the only rental agency we use for our Vacation Rentals in the Boone/Blowing Rock/Banner Elk areas. We recently stayed at Lilly’s Mountain Escape in Banner Elk. name: Unsatisfied
title: Not a very good experience.
text: The first night that we got there, we couldn’t get into the house for almost 2 hours. Finally they got us into the house and we get into the house and run the air conditioner for almost 3 hours and it doesn’t cool the house off it stays 82 Inside. By the time they agreed to move us to another cabin it was thundering, lightning pouring rain, and I had to drag kids in a one-year-old out in that to move to another cabin close to midnight. Then they proceeded to tell me that I had to pay the difference in the cabins that they had to move me to completely unacceptable. Then we get to the new cabin and there is cobwebs and spiders everywhere. The house didn’t look like it. Had anybody stay in it recently. So we get everything unloaded, and everybody inside in the pouring rain. Once we get inside, the lights switches don’t work. The lights don’t work so it was almost completely dark in the living room. The back door didn’t lock. And the AC wouldn’t go below 74. I don’t know if most of you know that cabins can get kind of hot. So then we get up the next morning and around 9 AM. The power goes out. There was a power outage that lasted until almost 5:00 PM. At this point, I’m pretty much over the whole situation and just ready to go back home. My oldest son got up and he had bites all over him throughout the day. Two other kids had bites all over them. I would be walking around the house and feel like somethings biting me. Not sure if it’s bedbugs or fleas or what it was. Needless to say our experience, this time wasn’t very great. The care team did offer to take off the charges for the difference in switching from one cabin to the other, which should’ve happened regardless. My mom and dad were so disappointed that they didn’t get to come down until Saturday morning then they get there and the powers out and they went ahead and left Sunday morning instead of Monday with us just because everything that was happening. I did deal with customer care and they made the choice not to charge us for the cabin move in the difference in price, which is understandable because it wasn’t my fault. The AC went out in the other cabin. That should’ve happened anyways, but I received the email that said they were doing that as a courtesy and that after we left the cabin, there would be no additional discount given. Acting like you’re doing me a huge favor by not charging me the price difference to move me cabins that didn’t compensate for all the trouble that we went through the entire weekend. I also own a business this is completely unacceptable.

name: J Allen
title: Never rent this Cabin again.
text: Rented a cabin on Labor Day weekend, Beaver Rock Lodge.  My family and I were looking forward too it, as we have rented 3 times with Blue Ridge. The cabin we rented, living room AC was not working, Kids bedroom upstairs had no AC. And two seperate porch doors were not locking, which is a huge safety concern, especially when I have 2 little kids. Lights porch deck would not turn on. I reached out to after hours support to ask for accommodations. The after hours team, mentioned I can't send anyone out tonight, but first thing tomorrow and just put a chair up against the door. Anybody with kids, would know this is 100% unacceptable. My Family and I drove home that night in pouring rain for 2.5 hours, very disappointed with the after hours support team, and how the cabin was not functioning properly to enjoy a long weekend.

name: Bill & Karen Hutchings
title: Excellent customer service from Blue Ridge Mountain Renals
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals website was accurate, the online chat feature was very helpful in answering a few questions.After booking our rental, they were very responsive sending emails informing us of all that would take place during and after our stay.Our rental was exactly as pictured and described and worked very well for our stay,We were contacted during our rental via text several times to insure all was well.

name: Kulikowski Adrian
title: The house was very clean and there was…
text: The house was very clean and there was a calling service to answer any questions or requests we had over the weekend. Our stay was great.  We rented through BRMR several times and always had a good experience.

name: Kim V.
title: Very nice
text: This was easy to book. Representative always available to assist and answer any questions. Cabin was very clean and loaded with dishes and cookware. Very nice hot tub. Nice back yard for our puppy to get some exercise. The main Camp of Eagles Nest was right around the corner and easy to access the amenities.

name: Dan Moses
title: Skylark 8/22 through 8/25 2024
text: Blue Ridge staff did a great job communicating the details of my stay and were available when I had a question or two about the VRBO property

name: Gary
title: They were very responsive
text: They were very responsive: had a water pressure issue and quickly had plumber to the property. Was a city issue, not house. Only issue was not informed of a narrow spiral staircase case between levels. Was difficult to maneuver and our pet had to be carried up and down. Not easy for me as well.

name: Suzanne Taliaferro
title: Great House, Stunning Location, driving challenging!
text: Decoys Nest is a special, happy house…who knew that hummingbirds chirp…and they do! Great kitchen, clear usage instructions….totally comfortable…except the garbage! The Mama bear with two cubs destroyed the garbage container, so we NEVER  put garbage out.We made sure The Rental agency had pick up service. Bedrooms and bathrooms are excellent, but we enjoyed the outdoors most of all!We lived on the porch with amazing views, and turkeys, deer, and above mentioned …. Temperatures were divine. A wonderful unique experience.

name: The Rorie’s
title: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was great…
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was great to work with. The communication and response time was exceptional.  I had a couple of small things to communicate regarding the property and received immediate response offering to address any issues.  We had a wonderful stay and will be using Blue Eidge Mountain Rentals again in the future.

name: Hinson Hazel
title: Loved the house and being surrounded by…
text: Loved the house and being surrounded by the forest. Loved the new kitchen appliances and the most comfortable mattresses I have ever experienced.

name: Jackson W Joel
title: The views of Lookout Lodge were…incredible.
text: The views of Lookout Lodge were unbelievable. House was very nice. The beds were a little uncomfortable but not a showstopper at all. Overall it was a very nice place and we will be back.

name: Shirley
title: Great trip with friends
text: Great trip with friends.  Very comfortable accommodations and the views were wonderful.  Nice grill and kitchen was well furnished for cooking.  The bedrooms had great window covering.

name: Customer
title: This home shares a road with only one…
text: This home shares a road with only one other home. The surrounding woods are full or hardwoods and rhododendrons. It’s truly a beautiful setting. The rental was nicely decorated and clean. My family had a lovey stay and would absolutely rent Walk in the Clouds again. Nancy

name: Michael S.
title: I stayed at Linville River Cottage #26
text: I stayed at Linville River Cottage #26, managed by Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals. It was a wonderful three days! The cottage was pristine-clean, cozy, and well-equipped. A nice treat awaited me when I arrived. Sitting on the porch and looking out over the river with the forest on the other side was a highlight. The staff were very responsive when I had questions. I'll be back!

name: Happy customer
title: The home was very nice
text: The home was very nice, brand new, and it was great for our needs. It also have nice views. We would have liked some hangers in the closet and/or drawers to put our clothes in. But it was not a problem for only 3 nights. The property is on a dirt road and the neighborhood is under construction so it is a lot of dirt and mud around. Not much for walking. It was not a problem for us because we were not at the house much only to change and sleep. We would rent again.

name: Mcnair Jeff
title: Great location!
text: This is a great cabin.  Everything was as promised

name: Frimpter Michael
title: Hook wine and sinker was in a great…
text: Hook wine and sinker was in a great location. Close to everything we wanted to see. Perfect lodge in great condition and the community is close and staff are helpful. We will return at some point.

name: Zippin Bette
title: Three adults in Blue Creek Cabin
text: Three adults stayed in Blue Creek Cabin-Eagles Nest NC for 10 days in Aug 2024. The Cabin was in great shape, clean and ready for our visit. We had an issue with a coffee pot..,it was easy to reach someone and the issue was resolved quickly.it was a great experience.

name: MC
title: Great company!
text: We have rented with Blue Ridge before and both times we had a great experience. While both times we have rented we did have issues with a code (the first time to the front door, the second time to a gate), the company was able to resolve the issue quickly for us even though we were arriving very late both times. Love their rentals and will continue to use them in the future!

name: Horne David
title: Nice clean rental
text: Nice clean rental, very clear communication leading up to our stay, and afterwards.

name: Jeanne
title: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was…mostly awesome
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was excellent in communication and responded within 30 min to texts (even at 9 PM).  They also provided water and a yummy granola mix as a welcome.  It's the little things!As far as improving: The cabin we stayed at looked clean; however, there was a stain on one of the cloth chairs and a sticky substance on the arm rest of the couch.  If I was an owner, I would want these cleaned (they would be easily cleaned with a spot remover and just wiping off the leather arm rest).  There was also a fuzz on the floor in the bathroom and when I went to pick it up with a Kleenex, a bunch of hair came up as well.  Thus, some attention/training to fully cleaning the property is warranted.

name: Peele Pam
title: Beautiful home
text: Beautiful home ! Perfect location.

name: Wall Joan
title: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals goes above…
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals goes above and beyond my expectations.  We've used them off and on for years, and will continue to do so. Very responsive,  helpful,  all the good things! I even lost a sentimental bracelet in the cabin, the housekeeper found it, and they mailed it to me! As I said,  above and beyond!!

name: Ray J
title: Beautiful cabin in near West Jefferson
text: The directions were perfect, the cabin was spotless and met all of our expectations.  Spent a good deal of our time on the deck as well as strolling through West Jefferson.  Owner checked in several times which was most appreciated.  Beautiful cabin!!

name: Donna
title: Great Location
text: House is in a great location between Boone, Blowing Rock and Banner Elk, with nice amenities of pool, tennis courts and basketball across the street. Great to walk dogs around the park and neighborhood.Recommend the house gets a deep cleaning, clean the carpets, and paint the decks. This would enhance the stayers experience.

name: michelle stokes
title: Great Cabin, Great Company
text: Our cabin was great, the staff is responsive and wonderful, this is our second time using BRMR and will continue to do so.  They simply can’t be beat, so please book directly through them!

name: Larry
title: Just my wife
text: Just my wife, our dog and me made it very relaxing especially afternoons on the screened porch listening to the babbling waters.  Once in a while it is good to leave the kids and grandkids for a few days and have a peaceful romantic getaway with just your spouse.  You owe it to each other.

name: Robbins David
title: Beautiful house
text: Beautiful house. Great service from Blue Ridge.

name: Riri
title: PERFECT for our family of 10
text: We chose Cruizin' River for our family vacation and couldn't be more satisfied! The home is beautiful with that classic cabin feel and TONS of room to accommodate the 10 of us (to include 2 small children) there are plenty of bed/sleep options, a lower level with games/game system and of course THE RIVER AND THE VIEWS. We all loved having the various decks to hang out on and the walk down to the river is short and easy (we were nervous with kids, but the yard is flat and it was easy to maneuver to get into the river) What a gorgeous place to be and visit! The home was clean, well stocked and I cannot express enough how helpful and kind Blue Ridge Rentals was throughout the process. We are already planning our vacation for next summer.

name: Werden William
title: We had the most amazing time
text: We had the most amazing time.  We had such a good time we left something and they went out of their way to keep it safe and make sure we got it back!!

name: Anderson Ana
title: Very attentive and great customer…
text: Very attentive and great customer service.

name: MATTHEW M
title: A Reunion in Paradise
text: The whole process was very simplified. I liked the texting communication. There were a few small issues that were addressed immediately:)

name: Meyers Grant
title: VV19 Winery
text: Very nice property.Outdoor amphitheater and camp recreation area for children.Looking forward to more restaurant options on property.Recommend better maps.Recommend stricter rules for contractors.Loud, screaming over equipment, playing loud hispanic music that we could hear inside of our rental. (VV19)Not a relaxing visit with new construction on both sides of our rental. Advise to choose another location.

name: Christine
title: Great Rental
text: Easy booking/keyless check in/ clean well appointed cabins.  Loved our stay!

name: Fulp Karen
title: The only problems we had was we…
text: The only problems we had was we couldn't get the code to work but the office helped us to get into cabin. Also the bathrooms up stairs in small bathroom the handle broke off in my sister's hand she used my shower on main floor. The other bath room my sister couldn't get the water to turn on and the other side was so high she couldn't reach it, she also used my shower on main floor. Besides that we absolutely loved this cabin its beautiful  and very well stocked.

name: Lewis Terry
title: Outstanding
text: Very impressive properties with excellent customer service. You will not be disappointed :)

name: Sarfatti Aaron
title: Elegant and "brand new" cabin
text: Elegant and "brand new" cabin, very sturdy construction on a mountain plateau with fire pit and hot tubExcellent for our family of five (3 kids under six including a toddler).  Safe for kids of all ages

name: Kristen Murray
title: Excellent, communicative management company
text: Really nice company. Very clear instructions on how to get into, operate, and leave the property we stayed at. Property itself was beautiful as advertised. Quiet, peaceful setting. We were very happy with both the stay and the management.

name: SK
title: Comfortable and Inviting
text: We immediately felt welcomed and comfortable in this cabin. There is plenty of room for large families, but we just wanted a little local getawayand it was perfect! The lower level is full of fun activities however it isn't easy to pull yourself away from the private back deck and beautiful views in every direction. The cattle roaming in the back pasture was  a nice surprise and the peace and quiet were exactly what we needed. We look forward to our next visit. Thank you for making our stay incredible!

name: Van Hekken Jeanne
title: House was great…very attractive
text: House was great…very attractive. Nice view and close to Banner Elk.

name: Derrick Ham
title: Met every need
text: All activities within the neighborhood. Weather and great house.

name: Marty Schlosberg
title: Everyone we dealt with has been very…
text: Everyone we dealt with has been very courteous and professional

name: Bernard Carpenter
title: great house with lots of room
text: great house with lots of room, love the deck,hot tub, kitchen is above average.

name: customer
title: Big Bear Lodge and Blue Ridge Mountain…
text: Big Bear Lodge and Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals were both fantastic.Blue Ridge has exceptional communication from start to finish. From the moment we reserved our spot until the day we left, Blue Ridge communicated constantly with directions, check in, check out procedures, area attractions, Eagles Nest information and more.  We had one small issue with the hot tub. Someone came out almost immediately and took care of the issue.The house was fabulous and was exactly as advertised.We will use Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals on our next visit to the High Country!

name: Collins George
title: Always a Great Experience! Have used BlueRidgeRentals many times
text: Have used BlueRidgeRentals many times. They are always helpful in finding the best house to rent for us. Great communication and help to solve any issues that arise very quickly.

name: Chris Wooley
title: A Beary Nice Cabin was beary nice
text: Booking directly thru Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was easy and hassle-free. They communicated with us early and often throughout the process so that we didn't have to wonder about anything. We also saved quite a bit by not booking the same cabin through Marriott (which charges an almost 50% fee). A Beary Nice Cabin was fantastic. It had more amenities, conveniences, and supplies than any cabin we've ever stayed in. The spa was fantastic, the master bath was luxurious, the furnishings and beds were wonderful, the table was huge (which was great for playing board games with the family), and the kitchen had everything we could want. The location is also great. It's secluded enough to enjoy the natural surroundings, especially the little walks up to the fire pit or down to the lake, but close enough to town to easily get groceries, take-out, or dine out. It's also very close to numerous hikes. We absolutely loved it and hope it's available next time we are in the area.

name: SA from Pennsylvania
title: Great customer service
text: Easy to book.  Response time was excellent when we had any questions.

name: Emily Deese
title: Blue Ridge Rentals is a very easy…
text: Blue Ridge Rentals is a very easy company to work with.  All the information is straightforward and very user friendly.  All their properties are top notch and well maintained.

name: Anonymous
title: The house was beautifully appointed
text: The house was beautifully appointed, and well located. We wish we had a view of the mountains. The only regret is that there was dog hair on one of the bed covers. Otherwise, we truly enjoyed our stay!

name: Hughes Joni
title: Consistently excellent service!
text: We’ve rented cabin stays through Blue Ridge Rentals about 8 times now and have received consistently excellent customer care with every visit.

name: alan fishman
title: This year blue ridge did a much better…
text: This year blue ridge did a much better job while we stayed at tested traveler very happy stayed 47 days and will be back next year

name: Fields Cherrie
title: The cabin was amazing
text: The cabin was amazing. The game room was a hit for our kids and grandkids. Only a few negatives and they would not stop me from going back. Several of the tubes provided had holes in them. They need to also let you know where to get off the river if you float down so you can plan ahead. Our gas tank ran out of gas in the middle of cooking steaks the second night. (They did bring another tank the next day)And the dryer was broken and we were told by a couple  that had stayed 3 weeks ago that it was broken when they stayed. Someone just needs to check these thing when they clean.But we still had a great weekend and will gsee back

name: chris MH
title: Great cabin with awesome amenities
text: Great cabin with awesome amenities.  Very clean.  Comfortable beds, furniture inside and out. Very nicely decorated and cozy.   Nice view of mountain and some wildlife out back.  Great place for quiet and relaxing times after hiking and exploring the areas.  Had trouble with water on our last day, but customer care stepped up along with the owners and put us into another wonderful place for the last day.  It also is a beautiful cabin with great amenities.  Will  rent here again in the future.  First cabin is Moonlight Lodge and the second is Whispering Pines.

name: Smith Tim
title: Very nice house
text: Very nice house - great amenities.  The drive was a bit further than we thought fro town, but not because of mileage, but the curviness of th eroad.  Not a big deal at all.BRMR accommodated for an early check-in and were easy to reach.

name: Anne, Bob
title: It is very remote - 3.6 miles from front gate to the house we rented down extremely curvy roads.  Did not want to venture out after dark!
text: Lovely house, great porch- Very well appointed

name: Brandt Keith

text: Responds quickly to request. Great communication regarding the property.

name: J Smith

text: Great cabin and beautiful property! Nice, comfortable beds and linens, pillows. Good parking.

name: Walter T.
title: Very responsive
text: Very responsive, kept us informed of the process and were prepared to help as needed. This transaction and the entire process went really smooth and our rental experience was perfect.

name: Metzker Frank
title: #1 Very uncomfortable bed.#2 musty…
text: #1 Very uncomfortable bed.#2 musty smell upon entering cabin, especially in the cabinets. #3 No control over the AC it was either heat or Fan only.#4 hot tub has obviously been leaking for quite some time as the deck was moldy and slick and Constant drip underneath deck. Traffic was non stop on the gravel road behind cabin . No batteries in candles above fire place. As someone who owns a company that maintains vacation rentals in the Asheville / Hendersonville NC area . I would have noticed these things upon arrival of guests. Surely the Maid would see these or smell these things. We didn't rest at all which is what the whole purpose of the trip was for. Just being honest. I would not recommend this dark place to no one.

name: Eakins Iii Robert
title: Beautiful cabin and property location, but…
text: I want this to be constructive for Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals and not critical of the property because we enjoyed our visit due to the location, the property and comfortable furnishings of cabin. First complaint is the TV did not work. Not life or death but after your day is done and chilling for the evening it’s nice to have a little TV time. Second the hot tub jets did not work to full capacity in fact barely putting out water. Third the outdoor flood lights on corner of house are evidently set on timer but continued to turn on and off every few minutes. My thoughts would be that minor as these seem I would think a property manager would do walk throughs to ensure things are in good working order for renters to come in. These were amenities listed in the cabin description and this was not a cheap rental. We rent a lot through VRBO and to be honest I have rented less expensive cabins and everything was on point. Thank you.

name: Henry Tony
title: The house inside was very nice and very…
text: The house inside was very nice and very well kept. The deck was great. When I booked this house I did so because of the river in the back yard. Our first trip to the water we noticed a few water snakes. Ok something we have to deal with being in the country. Then I seen more snakes in the very little bit of cut grass. Needless to say we didn't use the yard much or spend much time in the river. Before you say "well it's out in the country what do you expect". Well I've lived in the country my whole life. The yard is VERY overgrown with weeds. If you take away the weeds the snakes will leave. No cover no snakes. That was the only downside. West Jefferson is a beautiful town with extremely nice people. We did have a very nice and relaxing time

name: Holly Atkins
title: We’ve rented this wonderful home…
text: We’ve rented this wonderful home several times and have had many enjoyable weeks in the mountains. It’s both spacious, convenient to Blowing Rock and well stocked. Love the additions.

name: Baysden Andrew

name: Heck June
title: Absolute pleasure
text: The Blue Ridge Team makes renting a house an absolute pleasure. The Team is responsive and helpful. It’s my third rental from Blue Ridge. I wouldn’t use any other agency in this region.

name: Taylor Mark
title: Great getaway
text: Great getaway. The folks at Blue Ridge were excellent in every respect.

name: Bystricky Robert
title: broken chair
text: We had a broken chair that we called in to get it fixed on the first day there. Eleven days later it still wasn’t fixed. All it needed was four bolts and nuts. The condo we rented was great. BRMR not so good.

name: Jean MERENDA
title: Tranquility at its best
text: Our stay at mountain tranquility was exceptional.  The house and property are beautiful.  The kitchen is well equipped and we were able to cook many meals and relax on the deck to eat them.  Evenings were especially lovely sitting watching the sunset.  We loved sitting by the large windows drinking our coffee and watching the clouds disappear with the sun.The bedrooms are well equipped with great pillows and extra blankets if needed.  Great hot water and pressure in the showers.  Our grandchildren visited and had a grand time in the play area downstairs.  Even the dog had a good time walking through the neighborhood every morning and evening with me.Blue ridge was very responsive to our only complaint of a yellow jacket nest as it was taken care of immediately.Mountain Tranquility is exactly that a tranquil spot in the mountains.  We would definitely return.Great location near to lots of activities in the area.

name: Partin Vivian
title: Grandparents treat at Eagles Nest was…
text: Teddy Bear’s Retreat in Eagles Nest was a wonderful house. This is our third time staying in Eagles Nest and we have stayed in 3 different houses. Our family, daughter, son-in-law, 10 year old grandson and 7 year old granddaughter enjoyed the house very much. It has become our tradition to come the week before school starts. I would recommend this house for a family such as ours.

name: Whitt Karen

text: The Lodge was beautiful and it provided the perfect place to spend time with family and enjoy the weekend for our daughters wedding

name: DP

name: L. Malcom

name: GolfCrusade
title: Huge wow factor at BRMC
text: Huge wow factor at BRMC! Views for days and wonderful amenities just a few feet outside our rental. Close enough to Blowing Rock (town center) to get in and out if needed or just stay and relax here. Can’t go wrong with either!

name: Sven
title: Great stay!
text: Great stay!

name: Laura
title: We had a great stay at this home
text: We had a great stay at this home. The layout was perfect for our large family group with spaces to both hang out together and spread out when needed. The location was really convenient for enjoying Banner Elk as well as easy access to other attractions in the area. The company was very responsive and quick when we had a small issue with getting in to the home.

name: Edwin Young
title: Stayed at Natures Blessings
text: Stayed at NaturesBlessings for 5 nights.  Accommodations were nice.  Made several inquiries regarding non-functional wifi but never got satisfactory resolution.

name: Alice Hill
title: Boulder Sky was a lovely respite
text: Boulder Sky was a lovely home and perfect for our mini-family reunion.  Everyone was comfortable in their rooms, and the gathering area and open kitchen made it perfect for continuing to share time. We also enjoyed being out on the deck and at the fire pit areaWe called Blue Ridge about 3 issues on the first evening and someone arrived the next day to address them.  One was the under-counter lighting that did not work and they were clear about how that would need to be approved by the owners so may not get repaired while we were there.  The other 2 were fixed right away. Our experience both at the home and with Blue Ridge was great.

name: Griffin Timothy
title: This is a great company to stay with
text: This is a great company to stay with. They are great to work with and they have the best hospitality. We will definitely continue to stay with them when we take our mountain getaways!

name: April J
title: Amazing view and location...but a few issues
text: The view from the deck of this house is INCREDIBLE.  It was our favorite feature by a mile.  We had plenty of space for our large family and we enjoyed the location because of its great proximity to Boone, Blowing Rock and the Parkway.  We loved spending time together in the open great room/dining/kitchen area while taking in the view.  We were thankful to be able to have our dogs along with us.The house definitely shows some of the wear and tear of being a rental.  Paint is scuffed and worn, drawers falling out, a couple of curtain/towel rods were falling, etc.  We were informed before arrival that the unit's refrigerator wasn't working.  Thankfully, Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals had a temporary replacement there before check-in.  It did mean that we didn't have water/ice in the fridge for our whole stay.  For us, the biggest negative was the driveway.  It was actually quite treacherous for our vehicles to navigate (big drop off from washout). We worried each time we came/went that we were damaging our cars.  I reached out to the office on the first day to express my concern but never heard back.  It would have helped to be able to park in the garage (and not have to back out of the driveway), but the garage door wasn't functional...and my question about that wasn't answered, either.All in all, we enjoyed our time and made some wonderful memories.  We've been staying rental houses in the area for twenty years.  This one is near the top in terms of view and location, but it leaves a little to be desired in other aspects.

name: Jones Ashley
title: The views speak for themselves
text: From the minute we arrived to the minute we left, we had an amazing time.  The place is top notch.  The views speak for themselves.  We went to Blowing Rock, Grandfather Mtn, and Boone.  You are literally just off the parkway.  The driveway is steep and we had 4WD and would suggest that year round. The WiFi is listed as “not good for streaming” but we were able to.  T-Mobile did not work here unless connected to the WiFi (we expected this) but Verizon had service.  The first night we were here we were already talking about coming back.  Thank you for sharing your slice of Heaven with us.

name: Alan Fishman
title: Rested Travler
text: This is our second year in blowing rock and rested travler is an outstanding home clean great amenities and the owners care about their home we stayed 47 days and have booked next year again here

name: Oscar Hevia
title: Will not be coming back
text: We arrived on Saturday night 8/3 to find the garage smelling from the garbage of the prior renter that was never picked up (to their credit, they did pick up the garbage late on Sunday after notifying them)None of the blinds on the upstairs master would stay open. Always in the down positionSeveral blinds throughout the house had large stains on themThe pond from and indoor waterfall in the lower level had stagnant water in itThe interior door handle to the garage wasn’t working and would lock you outThe washer would leak on the floor and we had an error code one dayThe BBQ grill griddle was not cleanThe master shower on the top floor would leak onto the floor level below, especially if you used the hand held shower headI had no hot water in the downstairs shower on our departure dayOther than sending a maintenance person to take a look at all our concerns and jotting down notes, nothing was done.  Most disappointing of all, other than a brief call from “Joanie” to discuss our emails concerning the above during our stay, and a call from “Nick” the day after we left to apologize, nothing has ever been done.  We’ve been staying at BRMR properties for years, and we have never seen anything like this. We will not be coming back.

name: ROBERT PURCHIA
title: Was completely lied to about the state…
text: Was completely lied to about the state of affairs regarding the cabin not to mention the cabin was listed for sale at multiple prospective buyers came to interrupt my stay

name: Durrett Douglass
title: All the details important to know were the driveway was initially off putting, but with practice became manageable.
text: All the details important to know were communicated by the management company in a timely fashion.  The cabin was as advertised. View of distant mountains was good. Cabin was appointed with all of the critical tools, containers and equipment.

name: Family from Florida
title: Great stay
text: Excellent management company and great house. Fully equipped with all you could need/want including reliable internet.Super comfy beds, nice towels, plenty of dishes, pots/pans etc.

name: Wes Harrison
title: 3 week vacation in Eagles Nest
text: Blue Ridge Rentals are always accommodating and very attentive to our needs.  we have rented from this company yearly for several years and will continue to do so.  However, the home we stayed in did not meet our expectations.   Suggestive information for the owner would be to update the living room furniture in your home, use better linens for the beds and take inventory of the kitchen utensils. Also the clothes dryer took hours to dry towels and linens.

name: Kersey Nita
title: Great house and amenities
text: Great house and amenities.  Class act.  We were looking for a house with great accommodations, cool climate, and Banner Elk is a sweet little town.  Loved the Tavern and Stonewalls.  Great food.

name: Applebaum David
title: Great time in the N.C. Mountains in the summer
text: We’ve stayed here 2 years ago under a different management company and liked it enough to come back.However under Blue Ridge cabin rentals we noticed improvements from our last visit. Such as the key entry pad, the cabin being even cleaner than last time, the Sojo packs in bathrooms and kitchen, the hot tub having a new cover, and the refrigerator not leaking water.Didn’t know there was a problem with temperature reading in hot tub but I guess they did as someone came out Monday morning to fix it.They communicated with us via text and email several times during our stay, welcoming us and asking if we needed anything. One email offering us 50% off additional 3 days rental since nobody had rented it. Sounded good but could only stay 1 or 2 more days.Had they offered by day I would have taken them up on that.Not sure if the prior guests had put out all the corn 🌽 around the wooded area by the fire pit or that’s something new Blue Ridge did. But we enjoyed watching the deer come daily to eat the corn.This cabin is very close to my family’s house in Banner Elk making it very convenient to visit with them.We also like having the fenced in porch allowing our dogs to enjoy the outside without worrying about them roaming off.We would definitely rent through Blue Ridge cabin rental again.

name: Tibe Payne
title: House was very clean with all bath and kitchen essentials.

name: Tyler Adams/Jen Bailey
title: We have been long-time renters with…
text: We have been long-time renters with BRMR, renting with them for over 10 years.  In the last few years, the customer service, maintenance and cleanliness issues, and overall experience have just progressively worsened.  Our last two experiences have been nothing short of terrible.  As short-term rental owners ourselves, we understand that things can go wrong, in and out of your control.  The experience we have had the last two times have been issues well within their control and they did little to nothing to remedy the issues.  This last time, we were notified that we could arrive at 12pm for an early check in.  We show up with our one year old twins at nap time and are locked out for over 2 hours.  No one answered the phone for over 2 hours to let us in!  Once we were finally let in, we noticed the house had not been cleaned and two of the toilets were broken.  Over the next several days of our stay, we experienced a broken and leaking refrigerator, smoke detectors going off for hours (before my husband climbed up and removed them from the ceiling), and water leaking from the ceiling onto the couch.  Oh, this couch was also broken right down the middle, sagging to the floor.  All of these issues were brought to their attention and they offered us $200 as a refund.  We paid nearly $4,000 to stay there, so $200 wasn’t even the tax on this amount.  Nor was it even enough to reimburse the cleaning fee we paid to stay in an unclean house.  I am so disappointed and embarrassed that we brought a group of friends and their kids to stay with us in such a bad situation.  We will never rent with them again, which is also really disappointing following so much history.

title: pleasant enough experience but house is too far from the entrance and amenities
text: We had a very pleasant experience overall, it’s a beautiful community and the house of Olive and Georgia was nice enough. The things that we didn’t like is that the house is located 18 minutes drive from the main entrance. The community itself is relatively far from Boone, and with added time within the community this house was almost one hour from Publix, from Boone restaurants and from Tweetsie Railroad.We also would like to suggest providing hair conditioner and enough shampoo for guests as we were given just one tiny tube of shampoo per bathroom for our entire stay and no hair conditioner at all. Also, provide more trash bags and paper towels, as the scarce supply that was provided was not nearly enough and we had no time to make a trip to get those necessities. Kitchen was pretty well equipped, but can benefit from a baking tray for such things as warming up pizza. Overall, the house is brand new and has a pleasant smell of the new house, and was very clean. We have another suggestion regarding cleaning: to provide sponges and dish soap for the kitchen dishes. Also, check out instructions said to do our dishes before leaving, which we did not appreciate considering that it was already stressful enough to cook breakfast, get everyone ready (we have 4 kids), pack our suitcases by 10 am check out time, and on top of it to worry about emptying the dishwasher from the night before and doing a new load required another 30-40 minutes which we didn’t have. Plus, we felt like the cleaning fee which was over $500 should cover the dishes and cut down on stressful demands from guests. Also, the community website promised fishing and a pool, but there is no fishing and no pool there at the moment. We enjoyed Saturday night life music even a lot. If you don’t cook much during your vacation and don’t mind extra time driving, you will enjoy staying there.

name: Janice
title: Courteous staff
text: All my contacts were with courteous and helpful people.  When I needed to ask a question about the condo when we arrived, just as soon as I texted, I had someone texting back to help me.  I commented several times that I was really pleased with the personal servie.

name: Tracy
title: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals provided excellent and timely service
text: Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals provided excellent communication before, during, and after our trip.  We were informed every step of the way about what to expect at our rental and what the expectations were for us as renters of the property.  They really seem to care about their clients and work to provide the best experience possible.  We have owned property in the same mountain area where we recently stayed and Blue Ridge Rentals far surpassed the rental agencies we used for our rental clients.

name: Senior traveling with dogs

text: A beautiful cabin—the online pictures are very accurate. It’s a secluded location and the last location on a gravel road (approx 1mile). The cabin was dog friendly; the deck is enclosed on 3 sides. Our only suggestion would be a little more open/flat space for walking dogs. That gravel road is too steep for walking.

NOT WORTH THE MONEY

title: Enjoyable Experience
text: It was a great location with some minor quirks. There was no dish rack or place to dry dishes. The dishwasher did not fully dry the dishes. The location did not have air conditioning in the basement, which made it very humid and uncomfortable. Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals had an issue on their end where I did not receive the QR code to access community amenities automatically like I was supposed to. I did not receive it until the third day of my stay when I had to call and request it once I figured out what I needed to use the community amenities.There was plenty of space for my family of 5. They enjoyed all of the community amenities that we were able to take advantage of, loved the space, in particular the loft where they could go and play.Overall, it was a great experience with some minor hiccups.

name: Jennifer Ames
title: Better than expected
text: This cabin is beautiful, cleaner than clean, and has amenities for the whole family. From the hammock, to the swings, to the pool & ping pong table- we all were able to enjoy our vacation in our own way.

name: Cody Evans
title: Storybook Cottage
text: Edited: Stayed in a home this weekend in the lodges at eagles nest in banner elk. The community was awesome, very cool neighborhood and exactly what we were looking for.The home we rented though was a travesty.We spent our first day cleaning, outdoor furniture looked as if nobody had been to the home in months, thick spider webs covered everything along with a nice coating of dirt. The hot tub did have a little bit of debris in it as well. Outdoor heater and grill were out of propane along with the spare can(they say it was at checked and at 80% but I had two 20lb tanks replaced the second morning after we tried using them Friday night we did not use 40lb of propane in one night). The floors were covered in dirt and hadn’t been mopped or swept.The tv didn’t work and would not connect to WiFi for kids to watch something. We tried the tv every single morning and night and the WiFi never worked on it all 5 days.The outdoor fire pit and entire front yard was completely overgrown with weeds as if yard maintenance isn’t part of the management companies job. (Upon there reply if the neighbor hood is in control why isn’t the management company contacting them to fix the yard ? The weeds weren’t a week old they had been there for months and over two feet tall). The fire pit area also had Saran Wrap from previous bundles of fire wood sprung around the ground which we cleaned up for them.There was a snow sled in the middle of the front yard full of moldy water and it’s august…. When was the last time someone even came to this unit ?I could not have been more frustrated paying that much money to “get away” and feel on “vacation” pulling up to the mess of a home we got. (They replied saying we were interested in another day, yes because we had already spent a great deal of money to stay there and were thinking about extending our vacation because we wanted to spend more time together not because we were so happy with the home, that’s why we said for a cheap price we would and we found it surprising that you’d rather the home be empty then meet that price. Will never book through them again nor will I spread good praise of this company. Feel sorry for the home owners trusting these people with their property.

name: Bart Hedvig
title: Excellent stay at On Eagles Wings
text: My wife and I rented On Eagles Wings in Eagles Nest for 5 nights this summer and invited 5 other family members to join us and it was a great experience.  The house was unbelievable and we all could not get over how nice the house was and I have been renting mountain houses two to three times a year for the past 10 years and this was by far the best one I have ever stayed at.  The 4 Bedrooms were all very nice and the beds were very comfortable to sleep in, the 3 full bathrooms were very nice as well and had great walk-in showers.  We cooked several meals at the house and thought it had everything we needed and the appliance were excellent.  Our favorite part of the house was the huge back porch that had a great Mountain View’s, excellent furniture and a covered area with a fire place.  The Fire Pit and Hot Tub were excellent as well and we enjoyed those on a few of the evenings during our stay.

name: Robert Stewart
title: Rented Black Bear Lodge for the week July 28th
text: Rented Black Bear Lodge for the week of my birthday.  The cabin itself was great and had an impressive view - but the customer service from Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was terrible.  We had specific issues with garbage remaining from a prior rental and a non-working dryer that should have been handled immediately.  The garbage was picked up mid week - well after we had to store garbage in the linen closet because the outside dumpsters were completely full.  The dryer was never fixed after multiple texts and phone calls.  Just promises on an "update".  They were quick to respond to the texts and phone call, but with no follow up that is pointless.  We packed lightly with the expectation that we would be able to do laundry during the week and given only one set of towels is provided per person you have to be able to launder towels (especially if you're using the hot tub).  I've rented many cabins over the years and this is the first time using this company - but it will definitely be the last.  There are plenty of cabin rental companies with better customer service.

We were able to go canoeing, let the dogs run around, and have a bonfire.The vineyard was literally across the street, up the hill.   Daniella was staff at the vineyard.  Her service was exceptional and the wine was delicious.The purpose of our visit was to visit our property and search for additional land purchase opportunities.  We saw a couple of potential properties.Hope to visit again soon.

name: Christenson Margaret
title: The house was SO comfortable and WAY…
text: The house was SO comfortable and WAY more equipped than most we have stayed in. Plenty of kitchen ware and spices, laundry detergent, extra bath items, games, etc.  The house was super clean and in a beautiful setting.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  We had an issue with our door code upon arrival and i called the phone number provided and we gained access within 5 min!

text: We had a great time and loved the location, the cabin was awesome to. We missed not having the hot tub though and my kids were upset but overall we had a great time and would stay again!!!!

name: Mckenna John
title: We love Chasing Birdies!!
text: We had an incredibly relaxing stay this summer at Chasing Birdies. We had an easy time getting into the property and loved the decor of the home. This home is perfect for a large family or multiple families. The main floor is perfect for older adults. Our kiddos loved staying downstairs on the bunkbeds. They especially enjoyed the awesome game room with so many different activities!!  The master bedroom was spacious and we loved the private balcony. We were able to swim and have lunch at the clubhouse. We could not get over how friendly the deer were on the golf course. We loved being steps away from the beautiful golf course. Kitchen was stocked with everything, and it was nice having an extra fridge in the garage. We will definitely come back. Thanks for having us.

name: Meunier Sandra
title: We have used BRMR many times . . .
text: We have used BRMR many times, as we own property in the area and come often to manage our future build. The cabins have always been beautiful, clean, and nicely equipped.  Our most recent visit was in July for three weeks.  My husband and I ventured out early that morning to exercise and meet with a contractor.  We returned to the cabin just before 11:00 a.m.  He dropped me off and turned around and left again.  I entered my code into the door keypad, but it didn't work.  I waited for the keypad to reset and proceeded to repeat the process several times.  I was locked out.     I called BRMR several times using the main number and even some direct lines.  No one answered the phones.  I left messages.  No one called back. I had a few different telephone numbers.  Same thing.  No one answered or called back.  I called the afterhours line.  Same thing.  This went on for well over an hour and a half.  I had an idea to call the "Backyard Division" of BRMR, since nothing else was working.  Finally, someone answered the phone.  She reset the code for me, but it still didn't work until more than another 1/2 hour had passed.  It was a huge inconvenience, but not earth shattering.  These things happen.  The reason I gave BRMR a 3 Star rating was because of the fact that no one answered the phones, responded to my texts, or called back, for over an hour and a half, all during normal operating hours.  Nor, did any one reach out to me to apologize or explain, after the fact.

name: Gleicher Lori
title: Customer service was excellent
text: Customer service was excellent. We had a problem with the door lock. They were immediately responsive and resolved the issue.

name: Chesson Douglas
title: This was our 5th up to eagles nest and…
text: This was our 5th up to eagles nest and using blue ridge mountain rentals.  The experience is always easy and we will be back!

name: Marie
title: Beautiful mountain cabin!
text: This cabin was spacious, well stocked, and had a breathtaking view of the Blue Ridge Mountains. It had plenty of space for three separate families (one family of 6, one set of grandparents, and one eternal bachelor) to both spend quality time together and enjoy time apart when needed. The deck was our favorite hang-out spot and we loved feeding the birds and hummingbirds.Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals was wonderful to work with. As usual, the cabin was well-stocked with a Keurig, towels, linens, and starter kits of soaps/sponges/detergent. There was a yellow jacket nest under the deck which resulted in a couple of stings, but it was knocked down by an exterminator within hours of reporting the issue to management.Thank you for a wonderful vacation! We are so excited to return to this cabin again in the near future, and continue to vacation through Blue Ridge Mountain Rentals.

name: PB
title: Cabin was beautiful

text: Lovely well-appointed cabin in location convenient to town and hiking.  Great arrival/ check in directions and easy checkout procedure.  We were very happy with our experience.

name: Hicks
title: Nice location BUT .  .  .
text: You cannot beat the in-town location for this property.  Unfortunately there are a lot of updates needed inside.  Living room furniture is extremely uncomfortable and worn.  Bathrooms are all very small.  Red cushioned chairs shown in outside photos do NOT exist.  Outside area off kitchen very unkept and weedy.  When sitting on the outside porch, not only are the Ragged Garden dumpsters in clear view, but their smell can be experienced frequently.  Lots of current construction in the area. We have rented this unit twice but, as communicated with the rental managers, we will not be staying again.

name: Michael

name: Sullivan Shane

name: Mark James
title: What could have been!
text: 17 of us stayed in The Lodge. My wife got stung by yellow jackets 2x. They had built a huge nest under the deck. It took 3 days for the exterminator to come out.The bike machine didn't power on. The lights in the swimming pool didn't work properly. There was pornographic material left on the PS4. The tv remotes were stupid to figure out and half the TVs didn't work properly or respond to the remotes. The A/C stopped working properly and they brought us box fans! The HVAC guy never showed up to diagnose and fix the problem. I could go on, but I can't recommend this company as a rental/property management company.

name: Camp James
title: Great choice for our mountain vacation home !!!!!
text: Very good experience at A River Mist Walk. This cabin was exceptionally clean. Can't say enough about the heated floors in the bathrooms as well as showers with no doors. Very large tub as well if you wanted to enjoy that experience. One suggestion would be to find another home for the pool table upstairs and replace it with a nice bed versus the current sleeper sofa. King bed was very comfortable in the master bedroom and the walk in closets in both sleeping areas was a plus. The expansive downstairs living room and kitchen was very nice. Kitchen is well stocked with cookware, cutlery etc. Hot tub was nice but definitely needs a new cover. Nice walk around porch with plenty of doors to the outside. Nice fire pit to use as well as the outside gas grill. This cabin also has a stand by generator fueled by natural gas which I assume works. While there were other houses kind of close it was still mostly private especially with the leaves on the trees. Close enough to the river to even hear it. Only about a 25 minute drive to downtown Boone. Google maps took us straight to the Cabin. A relaxing vacation starts with a nice home away from home and this cabin fits the bill.

name: Harrop Richard
title: The location is great as is the cabin
text: The location is great as is the cabin.  This was our third year.  Understand it will not be available next summer.  Too bad.

name: Jacalyn Thomas
title: Great customer service
text: I had some difficulty interpreting instructions for entering the gated community, but the customer service was great and the staff person stayed on the phone with me all the way up the mountain to make sure that we got into the house easily. Which we did. The house was spotless and extremely well stocked. We have a Subaru and had no difficulty getting up the steep gravel drive but there were holes and ruts indicating that other vehicles might find it difficult or impossible to make it all the way to the front door. There is room to park with a short walk for those whose cars can't make it. A beautiful house with a great view obviously for short term rentals --no closets and no way to hang clothes in the bedrooms. Not a problem for most, but we had a tuxedo and evening gown and other clothes that needed hanging. Not having a bathroom on the same floor as the master bedroom meant that we gave up a king-size bed for a queen bed upstairs next to a bathroom (we are of the age that it makes a difference). But even with these quirks, it is an amazing house and we enjoyed every minute. It is obviously well maintained and cared for.

name: Jonathan Arthur
title: It was beyond our expectations
text: It was beyond our expectations. The house was beautiful and very clean. The kitchen was modern with excellent appliances and a huge center island for preparing meals. Loved the view of the lake at our doorstep. Bathrooms were up to date with relaxing showers. We have nothing negative to say about this rental.

name: Mike
title: Listing did not match up.  No mountain view.  Accommodations missing.  Wasn't cleaned.  Corners cut.
text: While the house was just fine on the inside when it came to the accommodations, the listing did NOT match the property in a few key areas.First, there was no mountain view unless you peeked through a tiny gap in a special way.  The pictures were clearly a misrepresentation.  It should not be advertised as having a mountain view.Second, there was no outside fire table - something we were specifically looking for and was on the listing.  In fact, there was no table on the deck at all - we had nothing to put food and drink on - and the patio furniture cushions were old and stained.Third, the place wasn't cleaned well.  There were several areas where things had been left behind by the previous guests and the trash cans were completely full.  We couldn't use them to throw any trash away until we made a call for it to be picked up.Fourth, it's clear the house was given the castoffs from their home.  While it's understandable the furniture was the way it was because of it being dog-friendly, refrigerator was duct-taped and missing shelves, the cookware was unusable, and the toaster should be thrown out tomorrow.  The outside grill also needs to be cleaned big-time.Fifth, our code didn't work when we got there and it took a half-dozen calls to resolve.  It's clear someone made a lazy error.  We were given a code with seven digits when it only took six.As a result of all of this, our vacation experience was diminished because we rented this property from you.

name: Alward Josh
title: Our cabin was perfect for our family
text: Our cabin was perfect for our family. We enjoyed the amenities inside Eagles Nest, the playground, amphitheater, volleyball court, and basketball. This was a last minute getaway and the whole process went smooth from the booking to the arrival to check out. We will stay here again. Thank you for a relaxing weekend.

name: Lynn barbari
title: Family, friends fun times The home We rented for 26 days was…
text: The home We rented for 26 days was awesome.The BRRC We rented it from was the best. Always answered and replied to our requests in a timely manner as well.Thank you

name: Terry Putnam
title: Super convenient to town
text: The house was beautiful and the location was perfect.  This was our 7th annual besties trip to the Boone area.  We've stayed in places with great views but this place is so close to town and we loved that.  Things I would suggest are:  1) better lighting in the living room.  We have big readers in our group and the lighting is dim.  2) more seating in the living room.  If a place "sleeps 8 or 9 then it should "sit" 8 or 9 all at once. I found this to be true a a bunch of the places we looked at.  3) the TV is small and awkwardly placed.  We hardly ever watch TV on our trips but many people enjoy movie nights.  Blue Ridge Mountain Rental was wonderful to work with.  They are very responsive.They let us in early and let us stay late on our departure day.  Also, two of us left our personal pillows and not only did the ship them to us for free, they washed the pillow cases before they sent them back.

name: Shawna
title: Great house, beautiful location
text: Great house, very clean and new. Well equipped and comfortable.  Amazing views from both balconies. Short walk to the pool but 10 min winding drive to the restaurant and gym, 15 minutes to the gate and 30 min to downtown Boone. WiFi  was painfully slow. Hot tub was lovely.

name: Ronsie &Tonya
title: Hello
text: Hello,Thank you communicating with me about our stay at Hidden Heaven from July 10-14, 2024I would like to offer a few suggestions and recommendations  Let me start by saying the home itself was very nice. However we arrived at night and the drive to the home once we left the main road and  processed to the home was scary to say the least it's almost like the path/dirt road to the home is something that you should not be driving on especially the very small bridge and the actual road that looks like a drop off once you get to High Meadows. One of the people traveling with us actually had to get out of his vehicle to look down the hill to make sure that it actually lead to the drive way for the home . It would help to let future guest know that the home is actually on a dirt road . Also the parking was terrible we were barely able to safely park at the actual home itself . The hill is very steep and the space is small for larger vehicles but not safe for small vehicles to make it up and down the steep driveway.Also the home was not very clean , it was dusty and their were dead flies in in the window sills of the living room, the stainless steel in the kitchen area was dull and needed to be cleaned properly. The stove top wasn't very clean and we had to clean that as well . There pantry shelves need to be cleaned as well and the old food items should be trashed. Some of the spices in the cabinet were expired and also need to be thrown out.The dishes in the cabinets were nice and some of the pots and pans were nice too. We were able to prepare a few family style meals there . The inside of the fridge needed to be wiped down. The bedding in the upstairs bedrooms were dated, old and stained as well as the ones on the bedrooms on the main level they were also stained. Bed in the bag comforter sets are usually fairly inexpensive and can usually be purchased at Walmart or Amazon.The extra sheets and pillow had hair on them and spots one of the pillows even had what appeared to be a stain from blood . We left that one in the laundry room on top of the machine. The twin sleeper sofas and the queen sleeper sofa in the bonus room were all nasty and stained . They could use a good deep scrubbing and steam cleaning and disinfecting. The mattress cover on the queen sleeper sofa needs to be replaced. It was so bad that we could not allow any guest to sleep on them and the children were looking forward to sleeping down there during our stay. We actually had to go buy  air mattresses from Walmart.  The dining room chairs were stained terribly, it really doesn't take much for the housekeeper to clean those . Some of them had really bad stains  and I was able to get a few of the red stains off. It was rather nasty to think about sitting in them , we temporarily covered them with towels to be able to sit down and have family breakfast and dinner.The board games in the living room were a nice addition but some of them were missing pieces, the Tv in the 2nd bedroom on the main level did not work . we couldn't get any channels to come up on that one. The shower curtain in the bonus room/game area was grungy looking and could be replaced for a very small cost.  The trash bins still had trach from the previous guest something that looked like maybe someone had worked on their car so it left very little space for our trash. Large trash bins would be great as well .The guest toiletries in the bathrooms smelled really good & the master bathroom was spacious and very nice and the outdoor seating area was nice . The deck could use a coat of paint or staining. But we enjoyed the amazing view in the mornings and evenings.The bonus room downstairs was freezing cold! It was almost unbearable to be down there . That area could really stand to be spruced up in the sleeping area and it could be a really nice area.Thank you so much for your time and we hope that we will have the opportunity to stay at another one of your properties in the future!

Large earth movers with cranes, moving large rock walls, many trucks moving dirt. The delay (we had to wait a long time) was 30 minutes each way, not to mention all the wear and tear on our car going through the rock, dirt, narrow one way road to get to the house. It cost us far more gasoline and wear and tear on our car.The house has a beautiful view with gorgeous porch to sit on and large living room with access to TV news and movies, fully equipped kitchen keurig and drip coffee maker, new appliances, generous cooking appliances, etc. Large beds and bathrooms all very comfortable. name: Phillips Jane
title: We stayed at a rental,Big Bear Lodge  …
text: We stayed at a rental,Big Bear Lodge   at Eagles Nest which is beautiful and clean. We loved the putt putt, playground and store up at the top of the mountain. The home was accessible to Banner Elk, for trout fishing, Blowing Rock, for lunch and shopping, as well as, Grandfather Mountain for our grandchildren along with Tweetsie.I would suggest the rental provide more towels, and new pillows for the beds. The home was comfortable and the 2 king beds I slept on were comfortable. We grilled steaks one night so nice they had a nice grill! The den and porches were nice for relaxing inside and out. Probably could use some new coffee mugs or cups because almost all of them have chips on the rim of the cup. The main floor and 2 bottom floors were  comfortable but got a little warm on the top floor where 2 king beds are. Loved the big tub in master bath downstairs and closet space! Would be nice to have some cooler air on that floor. Plenty of entertainment with pool table, ping pong, cards and air hockey. The greeters at the main entrance gate were very helpful. I would suggest if you would like to worship the Methodist Church in Banner Elk, with Mr. Ted, was a plus. The members were warm and inviting. The Stonewall Steakhouse was totally awesome! I suggest the fried deviled eggs and fresh trout! All our meals were great. The Town Tavern in Blowing Rock had the best hamburger sliders that would melt in your mouth. Of course, you have to go to The Daniel Boone Restaurant in Boone as well!The Dande Lion had great shopping in Banner Elk for ladies clothing.The coffee pots worked, enough silverware, need a few more kitchen bowls but all in all a great house and would rent again !!!!!The house with 5 bedrooms and enough baths for 12 people with 2 bunks for teenagers or elementary age children .

name: Julie
title: Caution when using hot tub
text: While the rental seemed clean, and we loved the theme and location of the cabin, we used the out door hot tub on our last night there. The next day when we were back home, my 7 year old started breaking out in a rash that looked like chicken pox. We took her to the doctor who diagnosed it immediately as “hot tub rash” from an improperly maintained hot tub, and prescribed medication. Our 9 year old also started breaking out. Thankfully the medication cleared both up without infection, but I learned more about hot tub illnesses to keep me out of them for a while. We advised the rental company who offered nothing more than an apology. We then asked for them to pay our portion of the doctor bill as there was no question it was from the hot tub. They eventually did, but acted like they were making a huge exception and doing us a favor. We had planned to keep this cabin on our list as we visit the area often and had even shared photos with friends of the cute decor and themed rooms, but this soured our experience. We will only book companies that list they fully drain and sanitize hot tubs between guests from now on. And hopefully the rental company learned from this and improved their cleaning process.

name: Giovanna Dominguez Timor

We were forced to live with AC and closed windows during a vacation away from the heat and AC in Florida. There were additional issues with overgrowth, poor maintenance of steep driveway, broken cabinet door, filthy oven etc. Owners are selling  and obviously not interested in maintenance, but making money until they sell. Management's job is to demand that owners do the right thing by every guest. I expected a fair resolution and was offered and issued an insulting fraction of a reimbursement which further illustrates how little guests mean to these people.

name: LC
title: Unwind in Luxury with Convenience to So Much!
text: My recent stay at Antler Trail Lodge completely exceeded all expectations of a visit to the North Carolina mountains! This exquisite newly built home atop a crest with unobstructed views of three states from nearly every room allowed me to enjoy my morning tea as though from “an eagle’s nest”. The home is comfortably furnished allowing for multiple areas that accommodate large groups as well as quiet spaces for alone time. The generously appointed kitchen with top of the line appliances has enough room for multiple chefs to prepare multi course meals. The hot tub is the perfect way to relax at the end of a fun-filled day. Three turns from the driveway placed us directly on the Blue Ridge Parkway with its multiple scenic overlooks, hiking and fishing opportunities, and just minutes from either Boone or Blowing Rock where we enjoyed shopping, dining, breweries, distilleries, and tourist attractions. Whether you’re looking for a convenient stay for your mountain visit or a luxury rental to relax, unwind, and re-energize this home has it all!

name: Smith Brian

The location was secluded and private, but downtown Boone was an easy 10-minute drive; plus, the Blue Ridge Parkway, Grandfather Mountain, Linville Falls, and Blowing Rock were between 20 and 45 minutes away. We will definitely be back!

name: JORDAN WOOD
title: This was the ideal cabin for an…
text: This was the ideal cabin for an anniversary trip. It was very cozy and secluded enough to feel like we weren't surrounded by activity. The accommodations were just right. The kitchen had plenty of things in it for the meals we enjoyed there. The bed was comfortable, and everything was clean. I wish we could transport the rushing creek and moderate temperatures home with us. While it was about a ten to twelve-minute drive to get into downtown Banner Elk, the scenery was so nice that I never tired of it. I would certainly return to the Yearling.

name: Sarah Mobley
title: Accommodations at the Creekside Cabin…
text: Accommodations at the Creekside Cabin were nice and beautifully quaint. We had a wonderful amount of space for our adult children to come and meet us and our dog, Max. We thoroughly enjoyed a lovely 4 days!We did have a small issue with the upstairs shower (my husband is guessing it was the seal around the basin, not a pipe issue) slow dripping through the kitchen ceiling for literally 10 minutes but it stopped on it’s own. The customer service line was quick to return our call regarding the leak and they immediately showed concern and took care of the issue.The Creekside Cabin was beautiful! Hardly slept, showered and was out of the house by 8:30 AM.Cancelled plans for Friday, ate at restaurant and sat at park waiting for a resolution. They sent someone out, who confirmed there was a “problem” with the house.They charged us the full cleaning fee $235. and (half) one night.Blue Ridge did move us (to a smaller house - on a busy road) at 1:00 Friday.I didn’t want to deal with it anymore while on vacation, so on Monday, I sent an email (regarding the charges). I offered to pay half the cleaning fee (even though I thought that was high) as we did sleep in one room and used one bathroom. But didn’t think it fair they charged us for the night stay.None of this was our fault.I got a reply that it was received and would be sent to management. Three days later, I sent another email - no answer.  Four days later (Monday), sent another email and did get a reply - that it could take up to 2 weeks to get a response from management on any (if any) resolution.Just got my answer - yesterday.Still charging us full cleaning fee and night stay.Gave 3 stars - only because we have used them in the past, and were pleased with their service, but on this one, Blue Ridge definitely dropped the ball.

title: NOT WORTH THE MONEY!!
text: 25th April - 6th May 2025.I recently took a trip to The Highlights of Ireland & Scotland.We travelled across Southern Ireland stopping in Dublin/Kilkenny/Waterford/Tramore. Then on to Blarney/Ring Of Kerry/Killarney.Then on to Adare/Cliffs of Moher/Galway/Sligo.Then on to Derry/Giant's Causeway and Belfast, Northern Ireland.Then we took a ferry from Belfast overto Alloway, Scotland & Glasgow.Then from Glasgow we went on to Fort William, Fort Augustus, Culloden Moor, Highlands.Then from The Highlands we went to Loch Lomond, Pitlochry, St Andrews and finishing in Edinburgh.Out of a coach of 45 people we were the only two from England and the rest of the coach (apart from an Indian couple) were Americans. We were not advised on booking that this would be the case.Some were ok, but the majority were very clicky and did not speak or acknowledge us.I asked our coach tour guide (who was Canadian) if you get many english people on the tours and she said no. She said they were mainly Americans, Australians & New Zealanders.I found that a bit strange as Cosmos are a UK based independent tour operator.Out of the 11 nights we were there we only got 5 evening meals.. 2 that were included on paid evening trips out and 3 in the hotels. Some hotels had a bar that you could order food from.For what the holiday cost I expected a much better service. After being on a coach for 8 hours every day, I assumed an evening meal would be included at each hotel. The old saying is "you get what you pay for" so I expected the hotel rooms to be better than what they were.By the time we had bought two meals  and a couple of drinks we had spent at least £50.00 a night.The stop off in Glasgow was in the centre of town and it was like a university dormatory room with no wardrobes.It was very tiring with bags out at the coach for 6.45am, 7 o'clock breakfasts and 8 o'clock starts. We were travelling all day until about 6pm when we would get to the next destination for the evening.It was an experience.. Galway and Giants Causeway were the best stop off places, but I wouldn't want to repeat it and I definitely wouldn't recommend it.

title: Amazing vacation but pre-trip communication need some work.
text: Firstly, the experience itself was amazing. Everything from the tour director to the driver was an incredible relaxing experience and I would recommend it to anybody. The tour director I really can't say enough good things about. He was a local from Rome and knew all of the areas the history and was able to translate if needed. He took care of everything soup to nuts and really made it enjoyable relaxing experience for everyone on board.However some pre-trip communications could be improved upon. About 6 months before the trip kicked off I accidentally stumbled upon a pretty major itinerary change. They had changed a day in Rome from Vatican, Sistine Chapel, coliseum, and basilica to just the basilica and a choice of other tours. To me, The change itself was not what upset me. I understand that things can happen. What upset me more was the fact that I was not notified. These are pretty significant tourist destinations and I would later find out that I was not the only one who was extremely upset by this. I as well as several other people on the trip had booked all of those locations to see separately because that was one of the primary reasons I booked the trip in the first place. Many of the people on the tour booked them in place of the included tour that they changed it to because they wanted to see it that badly. The tour guide was nice enough to tell us why the itinerary had changed but in my opinion, this should have been communicated as soon as the itinerary changed and we should have been given some options if we still wanted to see those things.Another less troublesome improvement that could be made is that Globus has deceptively simple descriptions for all of their itinerary and optional excursions. Now I'm not complaining about this because all the excursions were amazing I just think the descriptions didn't really do the excursions justice. Most notably was the balsamic vinegar tasting described simply as such. But what I experienced was a private historical tour of how balsamic vinegar was made, with integrated balsamic vinegar tasting and followed by an exquisite lunch with dried meats cheese and wine. Again it was a magnificent experience I just thought that the description didn't really do it justice and making the description a little bit more robust in what to expect may entice more people to splurge on the more expensive vacation instead of the lesser Globus priced vacation in which most of your excursions you do on your own.Lastly, but certainly not least, my favorite tours were the ones that were a little off the beaten path. That felt like private tours that had little crowds, but gave you amazing history as well as a minor culinary experience. One of my favorites was Jewish ghetto which had an incredibly rich history as well as getting to taste some pastrys. Paired with a detailed description of what to expect, I personally would be more likely to book a trip again if I knew those particular details were being looked at.
