text: We enjoyed our tour but are very very displeased with our return home. The Globus documents and app listed us returning from Edinburgh to Dublin via Aer Lingus on flight# EI 3251. Then go from Dublin to Boston via Aer Lingus (flight# EI 133) and then finally from Boston to Atlanta via Jet Blue (flight# EI 5375). When we arrived. We were instructed to go to the Transfer Desk. They couldn’t connect our names to the tickets. We were instructed to call our tour guide. We called the after hours Globus number and let our tour representative speak to the Aer Lingus attendant. Our flights had been changed multiple times since our initial booking so no one could determine the breakdown of why our tickets from Dublin to Boston were not associated with us (flight# EI 0133).Aer Lingus instructed us to leave the terminal and go out to check in again with customer service help. They booked us another flight from Dublin to LAX (flight# EI 069) which is an 11 hr flight. Then we will leave LAX to go to Atlanta (flight# DL#471). The LAX flight to Atlanta will take 4hrs.We got tickets but had to go through customs again and fly 14 hrs to return home. All of this was very stressful on our family and really tainted an otherwise wonderful trip. Globus documents and app didn’t reflect the correct travel plans.Thank you,Jamie Burns

text: We went on the 'Southern Italy Escape' and thoroughly enjoyed the tour.  This tour of a lesser know area of Italy focused on Matera, Lecce, and Alberobello, and is well worth a visit. Generally the hotels themselves exceeded expectations, but the locations relative to the key cities (especially Lecce) could be improved (That's only only reason it is not a 5 star rating: more like 4.5).  We took all 3 optional excursions, and each was well worth it - especially the last one that included a 'farmhouse dinner'.  The guide and driver were both outstanding. text: I took The Legacy of the Incas with Peru's Amazon tour that ended on March 8 2025. This was my 9th tour with the Globus/Cosmos company. Globus met my expectations on the previous 8 tours, and they continued to until this happened.We were staying at a hotel called Casa Andina Premium Miraflores in Lima with 3 days left on the tour. We were then going to a hotel in Paracas and then returning to the same hotel in Lima for the last night. I was low on cash, and I asked my tour director to recommend an ATM machine because I didn't have enough cash to tip him a decent amount that I thought he deserved. The ATM machine gave me the cash that I requested , but they stole my card! The hotel refused to let me talk to the hotel manager, they offered no apology, and no attempt to compensate me. My tour director, Mauricio, finally convinced them to assist me in calling my financial institution to get the card canceled. Whoopie!!!! I finally got an apology from the hotel after my card was canceled, but that apology was 40 minutes overdue, and still no compensation was offered, such as free room service, free laundry, free drinks at the bar, or a cash refund for the dollar amount spent in the room.For the lack of apology given to me in a timely manner, and for the lack of any compensation offered,  I then told Mauricio that I refused to go back to that hotel and asked Mauricio to contact Globus to hook me up to a new hotel. If Mauricio was telling me the truth, Globus completely ignored my request and didn't give me another hotel, and didn't have the common courtesy to call, text, or email me when they knew I was upset! I paid an extra $200 for another hotel, an Uber ride to that hotel, and the hotel dinner.When I got home, I reported this tour to Globus, and received a notification almost instantly saying they will look into the incident, but to allow 4 weeks for a decision. I checked my email today, (4 days later), and there was a response from Globus. A lady from Globus management, who gave her name as Stacey Nass apologized but gave me no compensation. Her excuse was that Globus, and the hotel didn't steal from me, it was the ATM. While technically true, these companies are all associated with each other. Stacey said the hotel offered me a free room upgrade, which was true, but they didn't offer that to until just a few hours before we arrived in Lima, and day and a half later. By then it was too late. I already paid for another hotel.In Globus attitude, the hotels can treat us like trash, and we are supposed to their robots and punching bags and take their crap! They don't respect people who stand up for themselves. If the hotel apologized and try to compensate me in a timely manner, then I wouldn't have needed Globus to compensate me. Globus would rather have a 1 star review then make us travelers happy. Use Gate 1, Intrepid, Trafalgar, Insight, Collette, or any other company for your future travels.

text: Lisbon to Madrid Escape was exactly what I needed, to escape the snow in Canada. Fair amount of time spent in each city with enough free time to do your own exploration. Hotels were well located in city centres with the exception of Salamanca, which was at a winery 15 minutes outside of Salamanca (a very nice break from city life!). José (TD) and Mario (driver) worked very well to ensure an amazing and enjoyable experience. Included dinners and optional meals were good with plenty of food. Would have liked to visit Sintra instead of Queluz Palace during the optional excursion to Cascais. This tour is best for those who may have been to some of these cities before and would like to revisit or explore a new spot they did not get a chance to see the last time as free time can be limited to late afternoon/evenings as well as physical mobility (the hills in Lisbon and Porto). Travel during off season is great for avoiding large crowds of tourists and allows you see how locals enjoy everyday living in each city. I would definitely do another Globus Escapes tour in the future!

text: Okay, so I just got back from the Globus Spain and Portugal tour (KPSX Jan 12), and it was a really interesting experience. While he clearly has a lot of personal stories to share, I felt that at times, it overshadowed the historical and cultural information we were hoping to receive about Spain and Portugal. I also found some of his interactions a bit dismissive, especially when it came to addressing my food allergy. It would have been helpful to have a bit more support in that area.I also noticed a strong emphasis on encouraging positive reviews. While I understand the importance of feedback, it felt a little pressured.On the bright side, our bus driver, Diogo, was absolutely fantastic. He was incredibly friendly, professional, and made the long journeys very comfortable. And the hotel in Salamanca was a real treat – the breakfast was especially delicious!Overall, the destinations were wonderful, and I really enjoyed the time spent exploring. We started in Rio de Janeiro and then visited Iguasso Falls both from the Brazil and Argentina sides. We stayed at the Hilton in Rio right across from Copacabana Beach and within easy walking to restaurants. Our guide in Rio was Alex Ma Ling and he was excellent.  While in Iguasso Falls we stayed at the Bourbon Cataratas. The pool was great and the restaurant options on site were exceptional. Our guide here was Jose Luis and he was very interesting to talk to as he knew so much history.Our second week started off in Santiago and we also visited Vina del Mar and Valparaiso with our guide Jaime.  Absolutely beautiful. Jaime also knew alot of history and he looked after us well.  We stayed at the Sheraton and also were able to walk to Sky Costanera, the tallest building in South America. After a few days here, we flew to East Island.  We met our guide Javier, who was very energetic and a fabulous guide.  He was Rapa Nui and you could see how proud he was to show us his culture and island. This was definitely the highlight of the 2 weeks. Visiting all the Moai on the island was absolutely spectacular.  Thank you Globus for another great experience!

title: Falling in love with Paris !
text: The Hotel Le Meridian Etoille where we stayed was excellent!! Such a lovely super clean & relaxing hotel . The decor was quite modern but had such a relaxed vibe to it just like the hotel itself . There was not one part of the hotel that I disliked . The lobby area was delightful with numerous seating areas each with their own character but blended perfectly together plus a coffee/snack bar with the most friendliest staff 🙂 .Infact we did not encounter one member of staff who wasn’t friendly 🤗 each would say Bonjour with a smile that actually felt very genuine & that was so much appreciated!The hotel was spotlessly clean & even the corridors had a lovely fresh smell to them !Our room was perfect for me as I am disabled & need the use of mobility aids. We were given a lovely room with a wet room with mobility aids & an optional shower seat 🤗. Maid service was great ! We had tea & coffee making facilities , hairdryer , iron & ironing board , fridge , access code security box & plenty of storage space 🤗Breakfast every morning was included in our package . The breakfast area was lovely with a very relaxed vibe to it. The staff were so friendly & helpful every morning which was a really nice start to the day ! The food selection was amazing 🤗 so much variety !!! , fresh baked croissants & pastries , fresh baked variety of Bread. So many cold & hot options i literally could not list them all. But honestly you will not be disappointed with what is on offer & you can eat & drink as much or as little as you like 🤗 The restaurants in the hotel all looked very cosy & inviting !Our Globus Representative was such a delight ! Super friendly , made us immediately at ease & we chatted for some time ! She was super informative & also said that we could contact her at any time 🤗 I honestly have to say that she was the best Representative that we have ever had over the many , many years of travelling! She was just “simply  Magnifique” !!! 🤗🤗We had a Boat tour on the River Sienne which was included with our package . We thoroughly enjoyed the 1hr journey & had priority boarding due to being Disabled & in a Wheelchair . The Crew were very friendly & helpful too which made the experience even more delightful!I would 100% recommend this Travel package to the Beautiful City of Paris and we most definitely will be booking it  again in the Future & most definitely will be staying again at the Hotel Le Meridian Etoille 🤗🤗🤗🤗I never imagined that I would fall in love with Paris but its beauty & friendly vibe certainly took me by surprise & I cannot wait to return !!!!

title: Useless Tour Guide & 4-5 Star Hotels were HORRIBLE
text: We did the Globus ‘Britian & Ireland In Depth’ Tour from 16 July – 8 Aug 2024Definitely won’t be using Globus again, ever........From when we’d read about Globus Tours, we started out with high expectations .. however that came to a crashing halt within a few nights.The supposedly 4-5 star hotels were appalling .. Hiltons, Marriotts & Radissons.From air-conditioning not working, to beds that had previously been slept in (yes, that did happen in a Marriott - in the middle of the night we found a bathrobe tie in the bed), a room without electricity, surly staff, inedible food and hotels (Radissons) too far out of the local town to be able to walk in to a look around.AND .. each time that there was a problem, we were told that there wasn’t any other rooms available for us to use.  Clearly nonsense...The tour guide was an intelligent man, but extremely unsuited for the job .. when he wasn’t sleeping on the bus.  He also gave everyone on the bus his phone number to contact if there was a problem, BUT he never responded when there was an issue, and wasn’t able to fix any issues the next day.  HOPELESS!!Not to mention, the ‘suggested tip’ information sheet he handed out of GBP 6.00 per day, PER PERSON.  NOT HAPPENNING !!!The timings for daily activities were also ‘odd’.  We left a hotel at 9.30 one morning, but then was only allowed 1 hour to tour Glastonbury Abbey (certainly not enough time).  All of the other travellers agreed we could have left the hotel an hour earlier and had a longer time at Glastonbury.Another ‘timing’ issue was when we visited Blarney in Ireland.  Again, we only had an hour there, so very few of our fellow travellers even bothered to go look at Blarney Castle or the Stone.  BUT, we still got to our hotel for that night at 4.30pm.  We obviously could have gotten to the hotel later & had a longer period at Blarney.The one saving grace was that the bus driver was amazing .. friendly, helpful and very approachable.Like I said, definitely won’t be using Globus again!!!

title: Rita was the best Portugal Tour Guide!
text: My wife and I recently had the pleasure of joining a Globus tour in Portugal, and our guide, Rita, was truly exceptional. From the very beginning, it was clear that Rita had a deep passion for her home country. Her enthusiasm for Portugal’s culture, history, and landscapes was infectious, and her compassion for her group made the experience even more special.Rita went above and beyond to ensure that every aspect of the trip was enjoyable and stress-free. She provided invaluable tips on where to find the best local restaurants, unique shopping spots, and entertainment options that gave us a real taste of Portuguese life. She even took the time to make sure we knew where the most convenient and clean restrooms were—something often overlooked but incredibly helpful when traveling.Her communication skills were outstanding. Rita had a way of sharing complex historical and cultural information in a way that was both engaging and easy to understand. Whether we were on the bus or exploring a site, her explanations were always clear and captivating.Above all, Rita genuinely cared about every single person on the tour. She took the time to check in with each of us, ensuring that we felt comfortable and included. Their vibrant cultures, remarkable histories, and warm, welcoming people left a lasting impression.Travel always brings a mix of experiences🙏great food, unforgettable sights, and occasional challenges. In Spain and Portugal, the history was awe-inspiring, the beauty of the places often stealing our attention from the tour director, and the culinary delights at remarkable restaurants added to the charm.Despite a few hiccups, this journey was a fantastic adventure filled with beautiful sights and rich culture. I deeply appreciate the effort Globus and Ines put into making this trip memorable. I would wholeheartedly recommend this tour to anyone looking to explore the wonders of Spain and Portugal.Thank you, Globus, for an incredible adventure and for giving me memories I will treasure forever.

title: Our tour guide
text: Our tour guide, Jorge, was a wonderful ambassador for Costa Rica and Globus Travel,  because he is genuinely kind, friendly, caring, well organized, and very knowledgeable about Costa Rica.  Our driver, Roberto, was a safe, experienced, efficient driver who was always ready to lend a hand with a smile.  Our included tours were all good, with a variety of activities both physical (hiking) and cultural (cooking class).  However, I would have liked even more activities that showcased the culture of the Costa Rican people, such as music and dance performances.  It felt as though there was nothing to do in the evenings after dinner.  Our accommodations were all good in their own ways, with their own charms and quirks.  I really enjoyed using the hot pools at our hotel in the Arenal region.  I really enjoyed the boat ride to and from the Evergreen Lodge on the Caribbean coast, and watching the monkeys frolicking close by in the trees.  The view of the Pacific Ocean from our hotel in Monte Verde was gorgeous.  The room was huge, but, strangely, there were no coat hooks or a closet in which to hang clothes.

This was such a difficult trip , I am sure forour tour guide although he handled everything so professionally.  These situations also caused anxiety for the group as we all cared for one another. Before booking I am going to inquire the numbers before laying down my money in the future.  We were not prepared for our “city” on wheels!!!!!!

name: Suzanne Rosato
title: Globus tours are filled with adventure
text: Globus tours are filled with interesting, entertaining and unexpected adventures.  On my recent trip, highlights of southern Italy and Sicily, the experience in Rome was unusual.  It did not include the normal tourist attractions, but provided instead an unusual tour of the Castel Gandolfo.  Very nice.  The included excursions to Pompeii, Naples, Capri, Bari, Lecce, Aberobello and Agrigento were very good.  Also Palermo. Local guides were good.  Our tour director helped expose us to Matera and Taomina.  Different people have different likes and abilities, so I suspect it is not easy to craft a tour where everyone enjoys everything.  For me, the extra dinners which I really liked were the one in Puglia (with the dancers) and the taste of Sicily outside of Taormina.  The excursion to Mt Etna had to be cancelled due to the weather, which was a disappointment, but understandable.  The special opportunity to visit the casa di Paolo was exceptional.  Thank you for providing that. I have taken this tour a number of years ago and also the hidden treasures of southern Italy.  I feel Globus does a good job, and if I had any suggestions to make I’d ask for arranging a single hotel for the Puglia area.  The hotel in Taormina had a smell to it which was unpleasant.  Perhaps due to the inclement weather.  The drivers for Globus tours are exceptionally good and the tour directors are informative and engaged.  I always feel safe when I’m traveling with Globus.  The area of Italy I enjoy the most is Campania, but it may not be somewhere others would enjoy as much as I do.

Our tour director, Alex, was unbelievably wonderful. She made sure we got the help we needed during the emergency. Then she did everything she could to make sure we were accommodated - handled everything with Globus head office, issued whatever refunds she could, assertively persuaded the hotel we were staying to honor an extremely low rate including free breakfast for the length of our stay (we were stuck there for over 3 weeks!), and even though she and the group had to continue the next morning, she messaged me every day to see how we were doing and ask if there was anything else she could do. The Globus head office also contact me at lease once a week while we were there to check in and offer assistance. I cannot say too much about the tour itself, as we were barely on it, but Alex and the Globus team were caring and proactive and really helped us through a very difficult situation. Thank you!

Now I understand why people stand in front of art for hours studying it because there is so much to see in a masterpiece such as what is in the Museo National Del Prado! The castle drawbridges & small towns were quaint & inviting.  The leg work was exhilarating but tiring at times but the company I was in kept me going.  The food was very interesting along with customs.  The music & entertainment was exceptional & Julian never fails.  His compassion,  concern for details & his personality prevails.  Thank you for a delightful time & since it was my first solo tour I made many friends picked up tips on packing lighter & other places to visit.  My only suggestion I have is I wasn’t aware of that the tax refund on items bought must have a specific piece of accompanying paperwork. I was not aware until I tried to get my tax money back so unfortunately for ME I wasn’t able to recover it.  So I would think maybe the agent involved with clients might review that with the other facts & possibly BOLD print in the agenda paperwork.  Thank you for a lovely time & experience & to the 10# I lost during my excursions 🤣.  Kuddos to Jodie James & Julian 💕

title: The Croatian Escape tour was a great…
text: The Croatian Escape tour was a great travel experience. Our Tour guide Viktor and Driver Richard went out of their way to be helpful and gave us recommendations for how to spend out free time and were personable and friendly. Driving was challenging when going from Croatia to Albania (especially the road through Montenegro). Richard was amazing. Viktor took extra attention to make sure my husband (who had some mobility issues due to an injury just prior to the vacation) was given common sense guidance on what he could do and offered places for rest when needed. The amount of free time was good; however, "free time" can be challenging with not knowing what to do, Viktor was very helpful. I always have liked optional tours as an alternative for independent exploring. This tour had only 2.Our hotels were all centrally located so that was definitely an advantage. They were clean and charming.I did not like the buffet options at our hotels however, food was often cold, with no flavor. All hotels served same breakfast options.The sit-down dinner at hotel in Albania was nice and served with attentive wait staff. Our Farewell dinner at the Villa Ferdinand was delicious and the Albanian folk dancing was a wonderful conclusion for our trip. We have been on 3 other Escape tours with Globus and this group of fellow travelers were friendly, looked out for each other and were very kind.The bus travel day from Croatia through Montenegro and into Albania was very long ( 07:30 and arrived at Hotel in Albania at 08:00 pm) and due to delays at the border and a police stop for "inspecting bus paperwork made the day very tiring. We had only 2 hours in Kotor and it would have been nice to have more time. Border wait time is out of Globus hands. but maybe extending tour a day more for travel comfort might be an option to consider in the future.I was not happy at all with the Flight to Frankfurt from Orlando as we were delayed over at hour and thus missed our connecting flight. Due to a rebooking of a flight 8 hours later we missed the welcome dinner and meeting our tour mates. We had to arrange our own transportation and did not get to hotel until almost midnight. We had originally been given 1 hour and 25 min transfer time at Frankfurt when Globus originally booked the tour I had spoken to the customer service department and was told that would be enough time. It clearly wasn't and I most likely will not accept any connecting times less then 2 1/5 hours in the future when Globus books our airfare. Anyone who has been to a major airport in Europe or anywhere else know that delays are common and have quite a domino effect.  If this is not possible, I will book my own flight in future!All in all, this was a wonderful tour and Croatia and Albania are full of culture and history. Very enjoyable and would definitely recommend booking this trip!Traveling off season is definitely a great option and I hope Globus continues to offer many options for future trips with off season travel.

title: I do not recommend the Sicily Tour
text: I do not recommend the Sicily Tour.I had been on another tour with Globus to the Tuscany area.  It was fabulous.  The Sicily Tour was disappointing to say the least.   The guides were great, the history was interesting, but we were then plopped off into a tourist's shopping area daily for 'free time" with instructions to stop and have some refreshments and shop.   We were SO shopped out by the 5th day and there were areas that were so filthy and garbage infested it was sort of depressing and gross.   The most awful dinner was one night at the hotel where we stayed which was obviously understaffed and served meals that differed between tables and were overcooked and cold and mushy by the time it reached our tables.  We were hoping for the Sicily experience.  This was not it.   The remaining dinners/lunches were much better when compared to the 2nd night.It would have been nice to view more of the infrastructure of the agriculture since we did seem to have so much extra time to shop our days away.  Seems that Olives, Lemons, Limes, and other citrus are a commodity.  Yet, there were no highlights to the trip or inclusion in the foods served.  I was looking forward to tasting some Lemoncello.I found some of the scheduled tourist stops personnel were not very friendly, impatient, and I understand that Americans are not well received in Sicily.  I didn't feel I was rude or demanding.  It made for an uncomfortable experience.I have visited other European countries and northern Italy without the feeling that I should not be here.   This is a first.Globus Guide, Guiseppe - 100%Globus Driver, Salvatore - 100%I wish I could remember the names of the 3 guides who were exceptional as well.

title: A Wonderful Snapshot of the UK and Ireland
text: Our guide Gavin’s knowledge and experience was an asset. Our driver Wayne was fantastic.The people on the tour were great and made new friends.Let me talk about the tour itself. The tour gives you a snapshot of the UK/Ireland. This is a long tour and at times long days, where you are up early and long days on the coach. We were very fortunate the weeks that we weee on the tour the weather was perfect and we got to see all the sites without issue. Understand that it is not always the case with the weather in the UK and Ireland. Which means you need to be understanding and flexible.The sites we got to go to were very impressive and the beauty of the countrysides and nature was exquisite. Remember this is a snapshot so some of the places like the bigger cities we really had no time in other than to sleep, but it is an incentive to go back and spend more time exploring.As I said this is a 24 day trip. I went on the last one of the season. I other than myself most of the people were older. If you are you need to have some stamina. Many people did get colds and such. I also am a solo traveler. There were 5 others traveling solo as well. Everyone pretty much got along on the trip. Everyone was respectful of being on time.There are places along the way to do laundry. In Killarney they will do it for 30 euros. In Dublin the hotel has 2 washers and 2 dryers cost 8 euros. At Inverness there is a laundry a couple of blocks away. The hotel will drop it off and you can pick it up. I wish Globus would have told me this prior to going, would have done asked less.One major issue were the dinners. You get a few as part of the tour and some with evening paid excursions. The issue is it is basically the same meal each time. After several weeks it is monotonous and to be honest I had, had enough of it.I did do all the excursions with exception of ones in London because I have been here before.Another thing about excursions I am from the US, so the conversion rate is not as bad as for Australia which many of the people on the tour were from. For them the conversion rate was double so many could not afford to do the extras.Overall it was a wonderful trip and I look forward to my next Globus tour.

Agent took all of my info and said he would open a ticket. That was it. Never heard back. Tried calling British Air to rebook and was put on never ending holds that never connected me to a person. Called Globus back and finally at 2am I had flights for 8:30. So at 5:30, back to the airport, but hotels shuttle didn’t start yet, so we were on our own. Finally got to London. Called the Airport Transfer phone number on our Globus documents. I was told they didn’t have anyone to pick us up and we were on our own. Waited another 45 minutes waiting for a transfer. Finally checked in our room, but no information left for us about time of breakfast or excursion time. We were exhausted, but got up early so we wouldn’t miss another day. I don't like the fact our meeting person at the Rome airport was not there when we arrived so we were in chaos for a while until they showed up, we also had no way of contacting them through the Globusgo APP to coordinate further. I also don't like the fact the guided tours ended far away from our hotels (where they started) and we were left to find our way back on our own. You would think that as long as Globus has been doing this there would be some physical locations (brick and mortar office) at the popular vacation destinations other than the "look for this person" holding up a small sign. We encountered the same issue when we arrived in Florence, we were told to go to this location and look for this person, our entire group (more than 20) roamed the train station in Florence until we found our guide who was not easy to find. Again, for as long as Globus has been in business, you would think they would have this down to a science and not have so many miscues along the way. I speak as a consumer who expects nothing but from a company whom you pay thousands of hard-earned dollars to provide a service but comes up short of expectations, performing simple tasks.
